EXO.17.PLAIN: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the Lord, saying, “Is the Lord among us or not?”

EXO.17.BSB: After this, the Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.
EXO.17.KJV: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
EXO.17.PLAIN: After this, the Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.

EXO.17.BSB: So Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on the hilltop with the staff of God in my hand.”
EXO.17.KJV: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.
EXO.17.PLAIN: So Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on the hilltop with the staff of God in my hand.”

EXO.17.BSB: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
EXO.17.KJV: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
EXO.17.PLAIN: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

EXO.17.BSB: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed; but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.
EXO.17.KJV: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
EXO.17.PLAIN: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed; but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.

EXO.17.BSB: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.
EXO.17.KJV: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
EXO.17.PLAIN: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.

EXO.17.BSB: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.
EXO.17.KJV: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
EXO.17.PLAIN: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.

EXO.17.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Write this on a scroll as a reminder and recite it to Joshua, because I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven.”
EXO.17.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
EXO.17.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Write this on a scroll as a reminder and recite it to Joshua, because I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven.”

EXO.17.BSB: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
EXO.17.KJV: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
EXO.17.PLAIN: Moses built an altar and called it The Lord Is My Banner.

EXO.17.BSB: “Indeed,” he said, “a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD. The LORD will war against Amalek from generation to generation.”
EXO.17.KJV: For he said, Because the LORD has sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
EXO.17.PLAIN: “Indeed,” he said, “a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the Lord. The Lord will war against Amalek from generation to generation.”

EXO.18.BSB: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel, and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
EXO.18.KJV: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
EXO.18.PLAIN: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel, and how the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt.

EXO.18.BSB: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her,
EXO.18.KJV: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,
EXO.18.PLAIN: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her,

EXO.18.BSB: along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”
EXO.18.KJV: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
EXO.18.PLAIN: along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”

EXO.18.BSB: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”
EXO.18.KJV: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
EXO.18.PLAIN: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”

EXO.18.BSB: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
EXO.18.KJV: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
EXO.18.PLAIN: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.

EXO.18.BSB: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.”
EXO.18.KJV: And he said to Moses, I your father in law Jethro am come to you, and your wife, and her two sons with her. ¶
EXO.18.PLAIN: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.”

EXO.18.BSB: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.
EXO.18.KJV: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
EXO.18.PLAIN: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.

EXO.18.BSB: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.
EXO.18.KJV: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, and all the travail that had come on them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the Lord had delivered them.

EXO.18.BSB: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the LORD had done for Israel, whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians.
EXO.18.KJV: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
EXO.18.PLAIN: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the Lord had done for Israel, whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians.

EXO.18.BSB: Jethro declared, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians.
EXO.18.KJV: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Jethro declared, “Blessed be the Lord, who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians.

EXO.18.BSB: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
EXO.18.KJV: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”

EXO.18.BSB: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.
EXO.18.KJV: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before God. ¶
EXO.18.PLAIN: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.

EXO.18.BSB: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.
EXO.18.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning to the evening.
EXO.18.PLAIN: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.

EXO.18.BSB: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone as judge, with all the people standing around you from morning till evening?”
EXO.18.KJV: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that you do to the people? why sit you yourself alone, and all the people stand by you from morning to even?
EXO.18.PLAIN: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone as judge, with all the people standing around you from morning till evening?”

EXO.18.BSB: “Because the people come to me to inquire of God,” Moses replied.
EXO.18.KJV: And Moses said to his father in law, Because the people come to me to inquire of God:
EXO.18.PLAIN: “Because the people come to me to inquire of God,” Moses replied.

EXO.18.BSB: “Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me to judge between one man and another, and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God.”
EXO.18.KJV: When they have a matter, they come to me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
EXO.18.PLAIN: “Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me to judge between one man and another, and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God.”

EXO.18.BSB: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.
EXO.18.KJV: And Moses’ father in law said to him, The thing that you do is not good.
EXO.18.PLAIN: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.

EXO.18.BSB: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.
EXO.18.KJV: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you: for this thing is too heavy for you; you are not able to perform it yourself alone.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.

EXO.18.BSB: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.
EXO.18.KJV: Listen now to my voice, I will give you counsel, and God shall be with you: Be you for the people to God-ward, that you may bring the causes to God:
EXO.18.PLAIN: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.

EXO.18.BSB: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.
EXO.18.KJV: And you shall teach them ordinances and laws, and shall show them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.

EXO.18.BSB: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
EXO.18.KJV: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
EXO.18.PLAIN: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

EXO.18.BSB: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.
EXO.18.KJV: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for yourself, and they shall bear the burden with you.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.

EXO.18.BSB: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”
EXO.18.KJV: If you shall do this thing, and God command you so, then you shall be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
EXO.18.PLAIN: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”

EXO.18.BSB: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
EXO.18.KJV: So Moses listened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.

EXO.18.BSB: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
EXO.18.KJV: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
EXO.18.PLAIN: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.

EXO.18.BSB: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.
EXO.18.KJV: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves. ¶
EXO.18.PLAIN: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.

EXO.18.BSB: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.
EXO.18.KJV: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
EXO.18.PLAIN: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.

EXO.19.BSB: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.
EXO.19.KJV: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
EXO.19.PLAIN: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.

EXO.19.BSB: After they had set out from Rephidim, they entered the Wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camped there in front of the mountain.
EXO.19.KJV: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
EXO.19.PLAIN: After they had set out from Rephidim, they entered the Wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camped there in front of the mountain.

EXO.19.BSB: Then Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, “This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel:
EXO.19.KJV: And Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shall you say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
EXO.19.PLAIN: Then Moses went up to God, and the Lord called to him from the mountain, “This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel:

EXO.19.BSB: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
EXO.19.KJV: You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
EXO.19.PLAIN: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.

EXO.19.BSB: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
EXO.19.KJV: Now therefore, if you will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then you shall be a peculiar treasure to me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
EXO.19.PLAIN: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession, for the whole earth is mine.

EXO.19.BSB: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
EXO.19.KJV: And you shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel. ¶
EXO.19.PLAIN: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”

EXO.19.BSB: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.
EXO.19.KJV: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
EXO.19.PLAIN: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the Lord had commanded him.

EXO.19.BSB: And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.” So Moses brought their words back to the LORD.
EXO.19.KJV: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD has spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people to the LORD.
EXO.19.PLAIN: And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the Lord has spoken.” So Moses brought their words back to the Lord.

EXO.19.BSB: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
EXO.19.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, See, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you for ever. And Moses told the words of the people to the LORD. ¶
EXO.19.PLAIN: The Lord said to Moses, “Look closely — I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the Lord what the people had said.

EXO.19.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes
EXO.19.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Go to the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
EXO.19.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes

EXO.19.BSB: and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
EXO.19.KJV: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on mount Sinai.
EXO.19.PLAIN: and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the Lord will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.

EXO.19.BSB: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.
EXO.19.KJV: And you shall set bounds to the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that you go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whoever touches the mount shall be surely put to death:
EXO.19.PLAIN: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.

EXO.19.BSB: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows—whether man or beast, he must not live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.”
EXO.19.KJV: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mount. ¶
EXO.19.PLAIN: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows—whether man or beast, he must not live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.”

EXO.19.BSB: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
EXO.19.KJV: And Moses went down from the mount to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
EXO.19.PLAIN: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.

EXO.19.BSB: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.”
EXO.19.KJV: And he said to the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives. ¶
EXO.19.PLAIN: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.”

EXO.19.BSB: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
EXO.19.KJV: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightning, and a thick cloud on the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
EXO.19.PLAIN: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.

EXO.19.BSB: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
EXO.19.KJV: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
EXO.19.PLAIN: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

EXO.19.BSB: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
EXO.19.KJV: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended on it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
EXO.19.PLAIN: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the Lord had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.

EXO.19.BSB: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
EXO.19.KJV: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
EXO.19.PLAIN: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.

EXO.19.BSB: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up,
EXO.19.KJV: And the LORD came down on mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
EXO.19.PLAIN: The Lord descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up,

EXO.19.BSB: and the LORD said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.
EXO.19.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
EXO.19.PLAIN: and the Lord said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the Lord, lest many of them perish.

EXO.19.BSB: Even the priests who approach the LORD must consecrate themselves, or the LORD will break out against them.”
EXO.19.KJV: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth on them.
EXO.19.PLAIN: Even the priests who approach the Lord must consecrate themselves, or the Lord will break out against them.”

EXO.19.BSB: But Moses said to the LORD, “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’”
EXO.19.KJV: And Moses said to the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for you charged us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
EXO.19.PLAIN: But Moses said to the Lord, “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’”

EXO.19.BSB: And the LORD replied, “Go down and bring Aaron with you. But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD, or He will break out against them.”
EXO.19.KJV: And the LORD said to him, Away, get you down, and you shall come up, you, and Aaron with you: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break forth on them.
EXO.19.PLAIN: And the Lord replied, “Go down and bring Aaron with you. But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the Lord, or He will break out against them.”

EXO.19.BSB: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
EXO.19.KJV: So Moses went down to the people, and spoke to them.
EXO.19.PLAIN: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.

EXO.20.BSB: And God spoke all these words:
EXO.20.KJV: And God spoke all these words, saying,
EXO.20.PLAIN: And God spoke all these words:

EXO.20.BSB: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
EXO.20.KJV: I am the LORD your God, which have brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
EXO.20.PLAIN: “I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall have no other gods before Me.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall have no other gods before me.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall have no other gods before me.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not make to you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not bow down yourself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD your God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, visiting the brokenness of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,

EXO.20.BSB: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
EXO.20.KJV: And showing mercy to thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
EXO.20.PLAIN: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain, for the Lord will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.

EXO.20.BSB: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
EXO.20.KJV: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
EXO.20.PLAIN: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

EXO.20.BSB: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
EXO.20.KJV: Six days shall you labor, and do all your work:
EXO.20.PLAIN: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

EXO.20.BSB: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.
EXO.20.KJV: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD your God: in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates:
EXO.20.PLAIN: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.

EXO.20.BSB: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
EXO.20.KJV: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: why the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it. ¶
EXO.20.PLAIN: For in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the Lord blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.

EXO.20.BSB: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
EXO.20.KJV: Honor your father and your mother: that your days may be long on the land which the LORD your God gives you.
EXO.20.PLAIN: Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not murder.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not kill.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not murder.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not commit adultery.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not commit adultery.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not commit adultery.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not steal.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not steal.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not steal.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.

EXO.20.BSB: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house, you shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is your neighbor’s. ¶
EXO.20.PLAIN: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”

EXO.20.BSB: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
EXO.20.KJV: And all the people saw the thunder, and the lightning, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
EXO.20.PLAIN: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.

EXO.20.BSB: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”
EXO.20.KJV: And they said to Moses, Speak you with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
EXO.20.PLAIN: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”

EXO.20.BSB: “Do not be afraid,” Moses replied. “For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.”
EXO.20.KJV: And Moses said to the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that you sin not.
EXO.20.PLAIN: “Do not be afraid,” Moses replied. “For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.”

EXO.20.BSB: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
EXO.20.KJV: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near to the thick darkness where God was. ¶
EXO.20.PLAIN: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.

EXO.20.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
EXO.20.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Thus you shall say to the children of Israel, You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
EXO.20.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.

EXO.20.BSB: You are not to make any gods alongside Me; you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold.
EXO.20.KJV: You shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall you make to you gods of gold. ¶
EXO.20.PLAIN: You are not to make any gods alongside Me; you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold.

EXO.20.BSB: You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
EXO.20.KJV: An altar of earth you shall make to me, and shall sacrifice thereon your burnt offerings, and your peace offerings, your sheep, and your oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come to you, and I will bless you.
EXO.20.PLAIN: You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.

EXO.20.BSB: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.
EXO.20.KJV: And if you will make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone: for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
EXO.20.PLAIN: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.

EXO.20.BSB: And you must not go up to My altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’
EXO.20.KJV: Neither shall you go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness be not discovered thereon.
EXO.20.PLAIN: And you must not go up to My altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’

EXO.21.BSB: “These are the ordinances that you are to set before them:
EXO.21.KJV: Now these are the judgments which you shall set before them.
EXO.21.PLAIN: “These are the ordinances that you are to set before them:

EXO.21.BSB: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free without paying anything.
EXO.21.KJV: If you buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free without paying anything.

EXO.21.BSB: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.
EXO.21.KJV: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.

EXO.21.BSB: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
EXO.21.KJV: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.

EXO.21.BSB: But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children; I do not want to go free,’
EXO.21.KJV: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
EXO.21.PLAIN: But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children; I do not want to go free,’

EXO.21.BSB: then his master is to bring him before the judges. And he shall take him to the door or doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he shall serve his master for life.
EXO.21.KJV: Then his master shall bring him to the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or to the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall serve him for ever. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: then his master is to bring him before the judges. And he shall take him to the door or doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he shall serve his master for life.

EXO.21.BSB: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as the menservants do.
EXO.21.KJV: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
EXO.21.PLAIN: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as the menservants do.

EXO.21.BSB: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who had designated her for himself, he must allow her to be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, since he has broken faith with her.
EXO.21.KJV: If she please not her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her to a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he has dealt deceitfully with her.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who had designated her for himself, he must allow her to be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, since he has broken faith with her.

EXO.21.BSB: And if he chooses her for his son, he must deal with her as with a daughter.
EXO.21.KJV: And if he have betrothed her to his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
EXO.21.PLAIN: And if he chooses her for his son, he must deal with her as with a daughter.

EXO.21.BSB: If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the food, clothing, or marital rights of his first wife.
EXO.21.KJV: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the food, clothing, or marital rights of his first wife.

EXO.21.BSB: If, however, he does not provide her with these three things, she is free to go without monetary payment.
EXO.21.KJV: And if he do not these three to her, then shall she go out free without money. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: If, however, he does not provide her with these three things, she is free to go without monetary payment.

EXO.21.BSB: Whoever strikes and kills a man must surely be put to death.
EXO.21.KJV: He that smites a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
EXO.21.PLAIN: Whoever strikes and kills a man must surely be put to death.

EXO.21.BSB: If, however, he did not lie in wait, but God allowed it to happen, then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee.
EXO.21.KJV: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If, however, he did not lie in wait, but God allowed it to happen, then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee.

EXO.21.BSB: But if a man schemes and acts willfully against his neighbor to kill him, you must take him away from My altar to be put to death.
EXO.21.KJV: But if a man come presumptuously on his neighbor, to slay him with guile; you shall take him from my altar, that he may die. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: But if a man schemes and acts willfully against his neighbor to kill him, you must take him away from My altar to be put to death.

EXO.21.BSB: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely be put to death.
EXO.21.KJV: And he that smites his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely be put to death.

EXO.21.BSB: Whoever kidnaps another man must be put to death, whether he sells him or the man is found in his possession.
EXO.21.KJV: And he that steals a man, and sells him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: Whoever kidnaps another man must be put to death, whether he sells him or the man is found in his possession.

EXO.21.BSB: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.
EXO.21.KJV: And he that curses his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.

EXO.21.BSB: If men are quarreling and one strikes the other with a stone or a fist, and he does not die but is confined to bed,
EXO.21.KJV: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keeps his bed:
EXO.21.PLAIN: If men are quarreling and one strikes the other with a stone or a fist, and he does not die but is confined to bed,

EXO.21.BSB: then the one who struck him shall go unpunished, as long as the other can get up and walk around outside with his staff. Nevertheless, he must compensate the man for his lost work and see that he is completely healed.
EXO.21.KJV: If he rise again, and walk abroad on his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: then the one who struck him shall go unpunished, as long as the other can get up and walk around outside with his staff. Nevertheless, he must compensate the man for his lost work and see that he is completely healed.

EXO.21.BSB: If a man strikes his manservant or maidservant with a rod, and the servant dies by his hand, he shall surely be punished.
EXO.21.KJV: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If a man strikes his manservant or maidservant with a rod, and the servant dies by his hand, he shall surely be punished.

EXO.21.BSB: However, if the servant gets up after a day or two, the owner shall not be punished, since the servant is his property.
EXO.21.KJV: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: However, if the servant gets up after a day or two, the owner shall not be punished, since the servant is his property.

EXO.21.BSB: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely, but there is no further injury, he shall surely be fined as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows.
EXO.21.KJV: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay on him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely, but there is no further injury, he shall surely be fined as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows.

EXO.21.BSB: But if a serious injury results, then you must require a life for a life—
EXO.21.KJV: And if any mischief follow, then you shall give life for life,
EXO.21.PLAIN: But if a serious injury results, then you must require a life for a life—

EXO.21.BSB: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
EXO.21.KJV: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
EXO.21.PLAIN: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

EXO.21.BSB: burn for burn, wound for wound, and stripe for stripe.
EXO.21.KJV: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: burn for burn, wound for wound, and stripe for stripe.

EXO.21.BSB: If a man strikes and blinds the eye of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the eye.
EXO.21.KJV: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If a man strikes and blinds the eye of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the eye.

EXO.21.BSB: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the tooth.
EXO.21.KJV: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the tooth.

EXO.21.BSB: If an ox gores a man or woman to death, the ox must surely be stoned, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the ox shall not be held responsible.
EXO.21.KJV: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If an ox gores a man or woman to death, the ox must surely be stoned, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the ox shall not be held responsible.

EXO.21.BSB: But if the ox has a habit of goring, and its owner has been warned yet does not restrain it, and it kills a man or woman, then the ox must be stoned and its owner must also be put to death.
EXO.21.KJV: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it has been testified to his owner, and he has not kept him in, but that he has killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
EXO.21.PLAIN: But if the ox has a habit of goring, and its owner has been warned yet does not restrain it, and it kills a man or woman, then the ox must be stoned and its owner must also be put to death.

EXO.21.BSB: If payment is demanded of him instead, he may redeem his life by paying the full amount demanded of him.
EXO.21.KJV: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatever is laid on him.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If payment is demanded of him instead, he may redeem his life by paying the full amount demanded of him.

EXO.21.BSB: If the ox gores a son or a daughter, it shall be done to him according to the same rule.
EXO.21.KJV: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done to him.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If the ox gores a son or a daughter, it shall be done to him according to the same rule.

EXO.21.BSB: If the ox gores a manservant or maidservant, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of that servant, and the ox must be stoned.
EXO.21.KJV: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give to their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: If the ox gores a manservant or maidservant, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of that servant, and the ox must be stoned.

EXO.21.BSB: If a man opens or digs a pit and fails to cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
EXO.21.KJV: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
EXO.21.PLAIN: If a man opens or digs a pit and fails to cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,

EXO.21.BSB: the owner of the pit shall make restitution; he must pay its owner, and the dead animal will be his.
EXO.21.KJV: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money to the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his. ¶
EXO.21.PLAIN: the owner of the pit shall make restitution; he must pay its owner, and the dead animal will be his.

EXO.21.BSB: If a man’s ox injures his neighbor’s ox and it dies, they must sell the live one and divide the proceeds; they also must divide the dead animal.
EXO.21.KJV: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
EXO.21.PLAIN: If a man’s ox injures his neighbor’s ox and it dies, they must sell the live one and divide the proceeds; they also must divide the dead animal.

EXO.21.BSB: But if it was known that the ox had a habit of goring, yet its owner failed to restrain it, he shall pay full compensation, ox for ox, and the dead animal will be his.
EXO.21.KJV: Or if it be known that the ox has used to push in time past, and his owner has not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
EXO.21.PLAIN: But if it was known that the ox had a habit of goring, yet its owner failed to restrain it, he shall pay full compensation, ox for ox, and the dead animal will be his.

EXO.22.BSB: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters or sells it, he must repay five oxen for an ox and four sheep for a sheep.
EXO.22.KJV: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters or sells it, he must repay five oxen for an ox and four sheep for a sheep.

EXO.22.BSB: If a thief is caught breaking in and is beaten to death, no one shall be guilty of bloodshed.
EXO.22.KJV: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a thief is caught breaking in and is beaten to death, no one shall be guilty of bloodshed.

EXO.22.BSB: But if it happens after sunrise, there is guilt for his bloodshed. A thief must make full restitution; if he has nothing, he himself shall be sold for his theft.
EXO.22.KJV: If the sun be risen on him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
EXO.22.PLAIN: But if it happens after sunrise, there is guilt for his bloodshed. A thief must make full restitution; if he has nothing, he himself shall be sold for his theft.

EXO.22.BSB: If what was stolen is actually found alive in his possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—he must pay back double.
EXO.22.KJV: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If what was stolen is actually found alive in his possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—he must pay back double.

EXO.22.BSB: If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and allows them to stray so that they graze in someone else’s field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.
EXO.22.KJV: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and allows them to stray so that they graze in someone else’s field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.

EXO.22.BSB: If a fire breaks out and spreads to thornbushes so that it consumes stacked or standing grain, or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make full restitution.
EXO.22.KJV: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a fire breaks out and spreads to thornbushes so that it consumes stacked or standing grain, or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make full restitution.

EXO.22.BSB: If a man gives his neighbor money or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.
EXO.22.KJV: If a man shall deliver to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a man gives his neighbor money or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.

EXO.22.BSB: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has taken his neighbor’s property.
EXO.22.KJV: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought to the judges, to see whether he have put his hand to his neighbor’s goods.
EXO.22.PLAIN: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has taken his neighbor’s property.

EXO.22.BSB: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any lost item that someone claims, ‘This is mine,’ both parties shall bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges find guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.
EXO.22.KJV: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing which another challenges to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double to his neighbor.
EXO.22.PLAIN: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any lost item that someone claims, ‘This is mine,’ both parties shall bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges find guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.

EXO.22.BSB: If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any other animal to be cared for by his neighbor, but it dies or is injured or stolen while no one is watching,
EXO.22.KJV: If a man deliver to his neighbor an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any other animal to be cared for by his neighbor, but it dies or is injured or stolen while no one is watching,

EXO.22.BSB: an oath before the LORD shall be made between the parties to determine whether or not the man has taken his neighbor’s property. The owner must accept the oath and require no restitution.
EXO.22.KJV: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he has not put his hand to his neighbor’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
EXO.22.PLAIN: an oath before the Lord shall be made between the parties to determine whether or not the man has taken his neighbor’s property. The owner must accept the oath and require no restitution.

EXO.22.BSB: But if the animal was actually stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.
EXO.22.KJV: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution to the owner thereof.
EXO.22.PLAIN: But if the animal was actually stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.

EXO.22.BSB: If the animal was torn to pieces, he shall bring it as evidence; he need not make restitution for the torn carcass.
EXO.22.KJV: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If the animal was torn to pieces, he shall bring it as evidence; he need not make restitution for the torn carcass.

EXO.22.BSB: If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while its owner is not present, he must make full restitution.
EXO.22.KJV: And if a man borrow something of his neighbor, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while its owner is not present, he must make full restitution.

EXO.22.BSB: If the owner was present, no restitution is required. If the animal was rented, the fee covers the loss.
EXO.22.KJV: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If the owner was present, no restitution is required. If the animal was rented, the fee covers the loss.

EXO.22.BSB: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her, he must pay the full dowry for her to be his wife.
EXO.22.KJV: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
EXO.22.PLAIN: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her, he must pay the full dowry for her to be his wife.

EXO.22.BSB: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, the man still must pay an amount comparable to the bridal price of a virgin.
EXO.22.KJV: If her father utterly refuse to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, the man still must pay an amount comparable to the bridal price of a virgin.

EXO.22.BSB: You must not allow a sorceress to live.
EXO.22.KJV: You shall not suffer a witch to live. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: You must not allow a sorceress to live.

EXO.22.BSB: Whoever lies with an animal must surely be put to death.
EXO.22.KJV: Whoever lies with a beast shall surely be put to death. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: Whoever lies with an animal must surely be put to death.

EXO.22.BSB: If anyone sacrifices to any god other than the LORD alone, he must be set apart for destruction.
EXO.22.KJV: He that sacrifices to any god, save to the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: If anyone sacrifices to any god other than the Lord alone, he must be set apart for destruction.

EXO.22.BSB: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
EXO.22.KJV: You shall neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

EXO.22.BSB: You must not mistreat any widow or orphan.
EXO.22.KJV: You shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
EXO.22.PLAIN: You must not mistreat any widow or orphan.

EXO.22.BSB: If you do mistreat them, and they cry out to Me in distress, I will surely hear their cry.
EXO.22.KJV: If you afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;
EXO.22.PLAIN: If you do mistreat them, and they cry out to Me in distress, I will surely hear their cry.

EXO.22.BSB: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.
EXO.22.KJV: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.

EXO.22.BSB: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.
EXO.22.KJV: If you lend money to any of my people that is poor by you, you shall not be to him as an usurer, neither shall you lay on him usury.
EXO.22.PLAIN: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.

EXO.22.BSB: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral, return it to him by sunset,
EXO.22.KJV: If you at all take your neighbor’s raiment to pledge, you shall deliver it to him by that the sun goes down:
EXO.22.PLAIN: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral, return it to him by sunset,

EXO.22.BSB: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? And if he cries out to Me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
EXO.22.KJV: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he cries to me, that I will hear; for I am gracious. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? And if he cries out to Me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

EXO.22.BSB: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.
EXO.22.KJV: You shall not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of your people. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

EXO.22.BSB: You must not hold back offerings from your granaries or vats. You are to give Me the firstborn of your sons.
EXO.22.KJV: You shall not delay to offer the first of your ripe fruits, and of your liquors: the firstborn of your sons shall you give to me.
EXO.22.PLAIN: You must not hold back offerings from your granaries or vats. You are to give Me the firstborn of your sons.

EXO.22.BSB: You shall do likewise with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day you are to give them to Me.
EXO.22.KJV: Likewise shall you do with your oxen, and with your sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day you shall give it me. ¶
EXO.22.PLAIN: You shall do likewise with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day you are to give them to Me.

EXO.22.BSB: You are to be My holy people. You must not eat the meat of a mauled animal found in the field; you are to throw it to the dogs.
EXO.22.KJV: And you shall be holy men to me: neither shall you eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; you shall cast it to the dogs.
EXO.22.PLAIN: You are to be My holy people. You must not eat the meat of a mauled animal found in the field; you are to throw it to the dogs.

EXO.23.BSB: “You shall not spread a false report. Do not join the wicked by being a malicious witness.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall not raise a false report: put not your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: “You shall not spread a false report. Do not join the wicked by being a malicious witness.

EXO.23.BSB: You shall not follow the crowd in wrongdoing. When you testify in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shall you speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment: ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: You shall not follow the crowd in wrongdoing. When you testify in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd.

EXO.23.BSB: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.
EXO.23.KJV: Neither shall you countenance a poor man in his cause. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.

EXO.23.BSB: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey, you must return it to him.
EXO.23.KJV: If you meet your enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
EXO.23.PLAIN: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey, you must return it to him.

EXO.23.BSB: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.
EXO.23.KJV: If you see the ass of him that hates you lying under his burden, and would forbear to help him, you shall surely help with him.
EXO.23.PLAIN: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.

EXO.23.BSB: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall not wrest the judgment of your poor in his cause.
EXO.23.PLAIN: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.

EXO.23.BSB: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.
EXO.23.KJV: Keep you far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay you not: for I will not justify the wicked. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.

EXO.23.BSB: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
EXO.23.KJV: And you shall take no gift: for the gift blinds the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.

EXO.23.BSB: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
EXO.23.KJV: Also you shall not oppress a stranger: for you know the heart of a stranger, seeing you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
EXO.23.PLAIN: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

EXO.23.BSB: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,
EXO.23.KJV: And six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in the fruits thereof:
EXO.23.PLAIN: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,

EXO.23.BSB: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.
EXO.23.KJV: But the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie still; that the poor of your people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner you shall deal with your vineyard, and with your olive grove.
EXO.23.PLAIN: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.

EXO.23.BSB: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.
EXO.23.KJV: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest: that your ox and your ass may rest, and the son of your handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
EXO.23.PLAIN: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.

EXO.23.BSB: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
EXO.23.KJV: And in all things that I have said to you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of your mouth. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.

EXO.23.BSB: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.
EXO.23.KJV: Three times you shall keep a feast to me in the year.
EXO.23.PLAIN: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.

EXO.23.BSB: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread: (you shall eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it you came out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
EXO.23.PLAIN: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.

EXO.23.BSB: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field. And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.
EXO.23.KJV: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you have sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when you have gathered in your labors out of the field.
EXO.23.PLAIN: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field. And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.

EXO.23.BSB: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
EXO.23.KJV: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the LORD God.
EXO.23.PLAIN: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.

EXO.23.BSB: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
EXO.23.PLAIN: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.

EXO.23.BSB: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
EXO.23.KJV: The first of the first fruits of your land you shall bring into the house of the LORD your God. You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the Lord your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.

EXO.23.BSB: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
EXO.23.KJV: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
EXO.23.PLAIN: See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

EXO.23.BSB: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.
EXO.23.KJV: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
EXO.23.PLAIN: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.

EXO.23.BSB: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
EXO.23.KJV: But if you shall indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.
EXO.23.PLAIN: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.

EXO.23.BSB: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
EXO.23.KJV: For my Angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
EXO.23.PLAIN: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.

EXO.23.BSB: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but you shall utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
EXO.23.PLAIN: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.

EXO.23.BSB: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.
EXO.23.KJV: And you shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless your bread, and your water; and I will take sickness away from the middle of you. ¶
EXO.23.PLAIN: So you shall serve the Lord your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.

EXO.23.BSB: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.
EXO.23.KJV: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in your land: the number of your days I will fulfill.
EXO.23.PLAIN: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.

EXO.23.BSB: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
EXO.23.KJV: I will send my fear before you, and will destroy all the people to whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.
EXO.23.PLAIN: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.

EXO.23.BSB: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
EXO.23.KJV: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
EXO.23.PLAIN: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

EXO.23.BSB: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.
EXO.23.KJV: I will not drive them out from before you in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against you.
EXO.23.PLAIN: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.

EXO.23.BSB: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.
EXO.23.KJV: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until you be increased, and inherit the land.
EXO.23.PLAIN: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.

EXO.23.BSB: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates. For I will deliver the inhabitants into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.
EXO.23.KJV: And I will set your bounds from the Red sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and you shall drive them out before you.
EXO.23.PLAIN: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates. For I will deliver the inhabitants into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.

EXO.23.BSB: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
EXO.23.KJV: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
EXO.23.PLAIN: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.

EXO.23.BSB: They must not remain in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
EXO.23.KJV: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me: for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.
EXO.23.PLAIN: They must not remain in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

EXO.24.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.
EXO.24.KJV: And he said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship you afar off.
EXO.24.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Come up to the Lord—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.

EXO.24.BSB: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come near; neither shall the people go up with him. ¶
EXO.24.PLAIN: Moses alone shall approach the Lord, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”

EXO.24.BSB: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD has said will we do.
EXO.24.PLAIN: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the Lord, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the Lord has spoken, we will do.”

EXO.24.BSB: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and built an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
EXO.24.PLAIN: And Moses wrote down all the words of the Lord. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

EXO.24.BSB: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
