EXO.24.KJV: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.
EXO.24.PLAIN: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the Lord.

EXO.24.BSB: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
EXO.24.PLAIN: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.

EXO.24.BSB: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
EXO.24.KJV: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD has said will we do, and be obedient.
EXO.24.PLAIN: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, 'We will do everything the Lord has said; we will obey.'

EXO.24.BSB: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words. ¶
EXO.24.PLAIN: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words.”

EXO.24.BSB: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
EXO.24.KJV: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
EXO.24.PLAIN: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,

EXO.24.BSB: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
EXO.24.KJV: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
EXO.24.PLAIN: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.

EXO.24.BSB: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.
EXO.24.KJV: And on the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink. ¶
EXO.24.PLAIN: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.

EXO.24.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”
EXO.24.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give you tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that you may teach them.
EXO.24.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”

EXO.24.BSB: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
EXO.24.PLAIN: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.

EXO.24.BSB: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”
EXO.24.KJV: And he said to the elders, Tarry you here for us, until we come again to you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come to them.
EXO.24.PLAIN: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”

EXO.24.BSB: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
EXO.24.PLAIN: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

EXO.24.BSB: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
EXO.24.KJV: And the glory of the LORD stayed on mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.
EXO.24.PLAIN: and the glory of the Lord settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the Lord called to Moses from within the cloud.

EXO.24.BSB: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
EXO.24.KJV: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
EXO.24.PLAIN: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.

EXO.24.BSB: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
EXO.24.KJV: And Moses went into the middle of the cloud, and got him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
EXO.24.PLAIN: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

EXO.25.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses,
EXO.25.KJV: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO.25.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses,

EXO.25.BSB: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.
EXO.25.KJV: Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that gives it willingly with his heart you shall take my offering.
EXO.25.PLAIN: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.

EXO.25.BSB: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
EXO.25.KJV: And this is the offering which you shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
EXO.25.PLAIN: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;

EXO.25.BSB: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;
EXO.25.KJV: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
EXO.25.PLAIN: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;

EXO.25.BSB: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;
EXO.25.KJV: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
EXO.25.PLAIN: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;

EXO.25.BSB: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
EXO.25.KJV: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
EXO.25.PLAIN: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

EXO.25.BSB: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
EXO.25.KJV: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
EXO.25.PLAIN: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

EXO.25.BSB: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
EXO.25.KJV: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

EXO.25.BSB: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.
EXO.25.KJV: According to all that I show you, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall you make it. ¶
EXO.25.PLAIN: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.

EXO.25.BSB: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
EXO.25.KJV: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

EXO.25.BSB: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, within and without shall you overlay it, and shall make on it a crown of gold round about.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

EXO.25.BSB: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.

EXO.25.BSB: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

EXO.25.BSB: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.

EXO.25.BSB: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.
EXO.25.KJV: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
EXO.25.PLAIN: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.

EXO.25.BSB: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

EXO.25.BSB: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

EXO.25.BSB: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make two cherubim of gold, of beaten work shall you make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,

EXO.25.BSB: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
EXO.25.KJV: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall you make the cherubim on the two ends thereof.
EXO.25.PLAIN: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.

EXO.25.BSB: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
EXO.25.KJV: And the cherubim shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubim be.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.

EXO.25.BSB: Set the mercy seat atop the ark, and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall put the mercy seat above on the ark; and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Set the mercy seat atop the ark, and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.

EXO.25.BSB: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
EXO.25.KJV: And there I will meet with you, and I will commune with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give you in commandment to the children of Israel. ¶
EXO.25.PLAIN: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.

EXO.25.BSB: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
EXO.25.KJV: You shall also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
EXO.25.PLAIN: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

EXO.25.BSB: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.

EXO.25.BSB: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make to it a border of an hand breadth round about, and you shall make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

EXO.25.BSB: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.

EXO.25.BSB: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
EXO.25.KJV: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
EXO.25.PLAIN: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.

EXO.25.BSB: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.

EXO.25.BSB: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover with: of pure gold shall you make them.
EXO.25.PLAIN: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.

EXO.25.BSB: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall set on the table show bread before me always. ¶
EXO.25.PLAIN: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.

EXO.25.BSB: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.

EXO.25.BSB: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
EXO.25.KJV: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
EXO.25.PLAIN: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.

EXO.25.BSB: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.
EXO.25.KJV: Three bowls made like to almonds, with a bud and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a bud and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
EXO.25.PLAIN: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.

EXO.25.BSB: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
EXO.25.KJV: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like to almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
EXO.25.PLAIN: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.

EXO.25.BSB: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
EXO.25.KJV: And there shall be a bud under two branches of the same, and a bud under two branches of the same, and a bud under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
EXO.25.PLAIN: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.

EXO.25.BSB: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
EXO.25.KJV: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
EXO.25.PLAIN: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

EXO.25.BSB: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
EXO.25.KJV: And you shall make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
EXO.25.PLAIN: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.

EXO.25.BSB: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.
EXO.25.KJV: And the tongs thereof, and the firepans thereof, shall be of pure gold.
EXO.25.PLAIN: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.

EXO.25.BSB: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
EXO.25.KJV: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
EXO.25.PLAIN: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.

EXO.25.BSB: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
EXO.25.KJV: And look that you make them after their pattern, which was showed you in the mount.
EXO.25.PLAIN: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

EXO.26.BSB: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.
EXO.26.KJV: Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubim of cunning work shall you make them.
EXO.26.PLAIN: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.

EXO.26.BSB: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide—all curtains the same size.
EXO.26.KJV: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide—all curtains the same size.

EXO.26.BSB: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.
EXO.26.KJV: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.

EXO.26.BSB: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shall you make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.

EXO.26.BSB: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.
EXO.26.KJV: Fifty loops shall you make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shall you make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.

EXO.26.BSB: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains together with the clasps: and it shall be one tabernacle. ¶
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.

EXO.26.BSB: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering on the tabernacle: eleven curtains shall you make.
EXO.26.PLAIN: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.

EXO.26.BSB: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
EXO.26.KJV: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

EXO.26.BSB: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.

EXO.26.BSB: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which couples the second.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.

EXO.26.BSB: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.

EXO.26.BSB: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
EXO.26.KJV: And the remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
EXO.26.PLAIN: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.

EXO.26.BSB: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
EXO.26.KJV: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
EXO.26.PLAIN: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.

EXO.26.BSB: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins. ¶
EXO.26.PLAIN: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.

EXO.26.BSB: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
EXO.26.PLAIN: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

EXO.26.BSB: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
EXO.26.KJV: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

EXO.26.BSB: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
EXO.26.KJV: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shall you make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

EXO.26.BSB: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,

EXO.26.BSB: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
EXO.26.PLAIN: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.

EXO.26.BSB: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames
EXO.26.KJV: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
EXO.26.PLAIN: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames

EXO.26.BSB: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
EXO.26.KJV: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
EXO.26.PLAIN: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.

EXO.26.BSB: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
EXO.26.KJV: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,

EXO.26.BSB: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
EXO.26.KJV: And two boards shall you make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
EXO.26.PLAIN: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,

EXO.26.BSB: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.
EXO.26.KJV: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
EXO.26.PLAIN: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.

EXO.26.BSB: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
EXO.26.KJV: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board. ¶
EXO.26.PLAIN: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

EXO.26.BSB: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
EXO.26.PLAIN: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

EXO.26.BSB: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
EXO.26.KJV: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
EXO.26.PLAIN: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.

EXO.26.BSB: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.
EXO.26.KJV: And the middle bar in the middle of the boards shall reach from end to end.
EXO.26.PLAIN: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.

EXO.26.BSB: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

EXO.26.BSB: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall raise up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was showed you in the mount. ¶
EXO.26.PLAIN: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

EXO.26.BSB: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubim shall it be made:
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.

EXO.26.BSB: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall hang it on four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, on the four sockets of silver. ¶
EXO.26.PLAIN: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

EXO.26.BSB: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall hang up the veil under the clasps, that you may bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony: and the veil shall divide to you between the holy place and the most holy.
EXO.26.PLAIN: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

EXO.26.BSB: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.

EXO.26.BSB: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall set the table without the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and you shall put the table on the north side.
EXO.26.PLAIN: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.

EXO.26.BSB: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, worked with needlework.
EXO.26.PLAIN: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.

EXO.26.BSB: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.
EXO.26.KJV: And you shall make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and you shall cast five sockets of brass for them.
EXO.26.PLAIN: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.

EXO.27.BSB: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
EXO.27.PLAIN: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.

EXO.27.BSB: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall make the horns of it on the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and you shall overlay it with brass.
EXO.27.PLAIN: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.

EXO.27.BSB: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basins, and his meat hooks, and his fire pans: all the vessels thereof you shall make of brass.
EXO.27.PLAIN: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.

EXO.27.BSB: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall make for it a grate of network of brass; and on the net shall you make four brazen rings in the four corners thereof.
EXO.27.PLAIN: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.

EXO.27.BSB: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the middle of the altar.
EXO.27.PLAIN: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.

EXO.27.BSB: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
EXO.27.PLAIN: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.

EXO.27.BSB: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
EXO.27.KJV: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be on the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
EXO.27.PLAIN: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.

EXO.27.BSB: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
EXO.27.KJV: Hollow with boards shall you make it: as it was showed you in the mount, so shall they make it. ¶
EXO.27.PLAIN: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

EXO.27.BSB: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side,
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
EXO.27.PLAIN: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side,

EXO.27.BSB: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
EXO.27.KJV: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
EXO.27.PLAIN: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.

EXO.27.BSB: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
EXO.27.KJV: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver. ¶
EXO.27.PLAIN: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

EXO.27.BSB: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
EXO.27.KJV: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
EXO.27.PLAIN: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.

EXO.27.BSB: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
EXO.27.KJV: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
EXO.27.PLAIN: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.

EXO.27.BSB: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,
EXO.27.KJV: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
EXO.27.PLAIN: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,

EXO.27.BSB: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
EXO.27.KJV: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three. ¶
EXO.27.PLAIN: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.

EXO.27.BSB: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
EXO.27.KJV: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, worked with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
EXO.27.PLAIN: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.

EXO.27.BSB: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
EXO.27.KJV: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass. ¶
EXO.27.PLAIN: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.

EXO.27.BSB: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
EXO.27.KJV: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
EXO.27.PLAIN: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.

EXO.27.BSB: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze.
EXO.27.KJV: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass. ¶
EXO.27.PLAIN: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze.

EXO.27.BSB: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
EXO.27.KJV: And you shall command the children of Israel, that they bring you pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
EXO.27.PLAIN: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.

EXO.27.BSB: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites for the generations to come.
EXO.27.KJV: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the veil, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever to their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
EXO.27.PLAIN: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the Lord from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites for the generations to come.

EXO.28.BSB: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.
EXO.28.KJV: And take you to you Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.
EXO.28.PLAIN: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.

EXO.28.BSB: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother for glory and for beauty.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.

EXO.28.BSB: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall speak to all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
EXO.28.PLAIN: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.

EXO.28.BSB: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.
EXO.28.KJV: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a turban, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.
EXO.28.PLAIN: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.

EXO.28.BSB: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
EXO.28.KJV: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

EXO.28.BSB: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
EXO.28.KJV: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
EXO.28.PLAIN: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

EXO.28.BSB: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
EXO.28.KJV: It shall have the two shoulder pieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
EXO.28.PLAIN: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.

EXO.28.BSB: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
EXO.28.KJV: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is on it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
EXO.28.PLAIN: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.

EXO.28.BSB: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
EXO.28.PLAIN: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:

EXO.28.BSB: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.
EXO.28.KJV: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
EXO.28.PLAIN: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.

EXO.28.BSB: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
EXO.28.KJV: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shall you engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: you shall make them to be set in ouches of gold.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.

EXO.28.BSB: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall put the two stones on the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial to the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD on his two shoulders for a memorial. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the Lord.

EXO.28.BSB: Fashion gold filigree settings
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make ouches of gold;
EXO.28.PLAIN: Fashion gold filigree settings

EXO.28.BSB: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.
EXO.28.KJV: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shall you make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.

EXO.28.BSB: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod. Construct it with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod you shall make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shall you make it.
EXO.28.PLAIN: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod. Construct it with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.

EXO.28.BSB: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
EXO.28.KJV: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
EXO.28.PLAIN: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.

EXO.28.BSB: And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones: In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
EXO.28.PLAIN: And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones: In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;

EXO.28.BSB: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
EXO.28.KJV: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
EXO.28.PLAIN: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;

EXO.28.BSB: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
EXO.28.KJV: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
EXO.28.PLAIN: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

EXO.28.BSB: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.
EXO.28.KJV: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their settings.
EXO.28.PLAIN: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.

EXO.28.BSB: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
EXO.28.KJV: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

EXO.28.BSB: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make on the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
EXO.28.PLAIN: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.

EXO.28.BSB: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make on the breastplate two rings of gold, and shall put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
EXO.28.PLAIN: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.

EXO.28.BSB: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

EXO.28.BSB: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
EXO.28.KJV: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains you shall fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod before it. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

EXO.28.BSB: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make two rings of gold, and you shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.

EXO.28.BSB: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
EXO.28.KJV: And two other rings of gold you shall make, and shall put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.

EXO.28.BSB: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.
EXO.28.KJV: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
EXO.28.PLAIN: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.

EXO.28.BSB: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
EXO.28.KJV: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment on his heart, when he goes in to the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the Lord.

EXO.28.BSB: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be on Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel on his heart before the LORD continually. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the Lord. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the Lord.

EXO.28.BSB: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
EXO.28.PLAIN: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

EXO.28.BSB: with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.
EXO.28.KJV: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the middle thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.

EXO.28.BSB: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,
EXO.28.KJV: And beneath on the hem of it you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
EXO.28.PLAIN: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,

EXO.28.BSB: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
EXO.28.KJV: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe round about.
EXO.28.PLAIN: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.

EXO.28.BSB: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.
EXO.28.KJV: And it shall be on Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goes in to the holy place before the LORD, and when he comes out, that he die not. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the Lord, so that he will not die.

EXO.28.BSB: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make a plate of pure gold, and grave on it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
EXO.28.PLAIN: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE Lord.

EXO.28.BSB: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall put it on a blue lace, that it may be on the turban; on the forefront of the turban it shall be.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.

EXO.28.BSB: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
EXO.28.KJV: And it shall be on Aaron’s forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always on his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the brokenness of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the Lord.

EXO.28.BSB: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall embroider the coat of fine linen, and you shall make the turban of fine linen, and you shall make the girdle of needlework. ¶
EXO.28.PLAIN: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.

EXO.28.BSB: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
EXO.28.KJV: And for Aaron’s sons you shall make coats, and you shall make for them girdles, and bonnets shall you make for them, for glory and for beauty.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.

EXO.28.BSB: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall put them on Aaron your brother, and his sons with him; and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
EXO.28.PLAIN: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.

EXO.28.BSB: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
EXO.28.KJV: And you shall make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even to the thighs they shall reach:
EXO.28.PLAIN: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.

EXO.28.BSB: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.
EXO.28.KJV: And they shall be on Aaron, and on his sons, when they come in to the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near to the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever to him and his seed after him.
EXO.28.PLAIN: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.

EXO.29.BSB: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,
EXO.29.KJV: And this is the thing that you shall do to them to hallow them, to minister to me in the priest’s office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
EXO.29.PLAIN: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,

EXO.29.BSB: along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour,
EXO.29.KJV: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shall you make them.
EXO.29.PLAIN: along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour,

EXO.29.BSB: put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
EXO.29.PLAIN: put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.

EXO.29.BSB: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
EXO.29.KJV: And Aaron and his sons you shall bring to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall wash them with water.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

EXO.29.BSB: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.

EXO.29.BSB: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall put the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.

EXO.29.BSB: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
EXO.29.KJV: Then shall you take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

EXO.29.BSB: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall bring his sons, and put coats on them.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.

EXO.29.BSB: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and you shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.

EXO.29.BSB: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the bullock.
EXO.29.PLAIN: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.

EXO.29.BSB: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
EXO.29.PLAIN: And you shall slaughter the bull before the Lord at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.29.BSB: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take of the blood of the bullock, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

EXO.29.BSB: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take all the fat that covers the inwards, and the lobe that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

EXO.29.BSB: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
EXO.29.KJV: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shall you burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering. ¶
EXO.29.PLAIN: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

EXO.29.BSB: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
EXO.29.KJV: You shall also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the ram.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

EXO.29.BSB: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall slay the ram, and you shall take his blood, and sprinkle it round about on the altar.
EXO.29.PLAIN: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.

EXO.29.BSB: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them to his pieces, and to his head.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.

EXO.29.BSB: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to the LORD: it is a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the LORD. ¶
EXO.29.PLAIN: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the Lord, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

EXO.29.BSB: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands on the head of the ram.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.

EXO.29.BSB: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Sprinkle the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.
EXO.29.KJV: Then shall you kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood on the altar round about.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Sprinkle the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.

EXO.29.BSB: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.
EXO.29.PLAIN: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.

EXO.29.BSB: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),
EXO.29.KJV: Also you shall take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the lobe above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),

EXO.29.BSB: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
EXO.29.KJV: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
EXO.29.PLAIN: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the Lord.

EXO.29.BSB: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the Lord as a wave offering.

EXO.29.BSB: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall receive them of their hands, and burn them on the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet smell before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the Lord; it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.

EXO.29.BSB: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be your part.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the Lord as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.

EXO.29.BSB: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
EXO.29.PLAIN: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.

EXO.29.BSB: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the LORD from their peace offerings.
EXO.29.KJV: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering to the LORD. ¶
EXO.29.PLAIN: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the Lord from their peace offerings.

EXO.29.BSB: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
EXO.29.KJV: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
EXO.29.PLAIN: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.

EXO.29.BSB: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days.
EXO.29.KJV: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he comes into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place. ¶
EXO.29.PLAIN: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days.

EXO.29.BSB: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
EXO.29.PLAIN: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.

EXO.29.BSB: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
EXO.29.KJV: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
EXO.29.PLAIN: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

EXO.29.BSB: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.
EXO.29.KJV: And they shall eat those things with which the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
EXO.29.PLAIN: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.

EXO.29.BSB: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
EXO.29.KJV: And if any of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
EXO.29.PLAIN: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

EXO.29.BSB: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
EXO.29.KJV: And thus shall you do to Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded you: seven days shall you consecrate them.
EXO.29.PLAIN: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

EXO.29.BSB: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
EXO.29.KJV: And you shall offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and you shall cleanse the altar, when you have made an atonement for it, and you shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

EXO.29.BSB: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.
EXO.29.KJV: Seven days you shall make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatever touches the altar shall be holy. ¶
EXO.29.PLAIN: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.

EXO.29.BSB: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
EXO.29.KJV: Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
EXO.29.PLAIN: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.

EXO.29.BSB: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.
EXO.29.KJV: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at even:
EXO.29.PLAIN: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.

EXO.29.BSB: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
EXO.29.KJV: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
EXO.29.PLAIN: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.

EXO.29.BSB: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
EXO.29.KJV: And the other lamb you shall offer at even, and shall do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
EXO.29.PLAIN: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

EXO.29.BSB: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
EXO.29.KJV: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there to you.
