EXO.29.PLAIN: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the Lord, where I will meet you to speak with you.

EXO.29.BSB: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
EXO.29.KJV: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
EXO.29.PLAIN: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.

EXO.29.BSB: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests.
EXO.29.KJV: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office. ¶
EXO.29.PLAIN: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests.

EXO.29.BSB: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
EXO.29.KJV: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
EXO.29.PLAIN: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

EXO.29.BSB: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
EXO.29.KJV: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
EXO.29.PLAIN: And they will know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the Lord their God.

EXO.30.BSB: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall make an altar to burn incense on: of shittim wood shall you make it.
EXO.30.PLAIN: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.

EXO.30.BSB: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.
EXO.30.KJV: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
EXO.30.PLAIN: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.

EXO.30.BSB: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and you shall make to it a crown of gold round about.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.

EXO.30.BSB: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
EXO.30.KJV: And two golden rings shall you make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, on the two sides of it shall you make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it with.
EXO.30.PLAIN: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.

EXO.30.BSB: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

EXO.30.BSB: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony—before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony—before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.

EXO.30.BSB: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.
EXO.30.KJV: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn incense on it.
EXO.30.PLAIN: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.

EXO.30.BSB: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
EXO.30.KJV: And when Aaron lights the lamps at even, he shall burn incense on it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
EXO.30.PLAIN: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the Lord for the generations to come.

EXO.30.BSB: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.
EXO.30.KJV: You shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall you pour drink offering thereon.
EXO.30.PLAIN: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.

EXO.30.BSB: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.”
EXO.30.KJV: And Aaron shall make an atonement on the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement on it throughout your generations: it is most holy to the LORD. ¶
EXO.30.PLAIN: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the Lord.”

EXO.30.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses,
EXO.30.KJV: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO.30.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses,

EXO.30.BSB: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
EXO.30.KJV: When you take the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul to the LORD, when you number them; that there be no plague among them, when you number them.
EXO.30.PLAIN: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the Lord a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.

EXO.30.BSB: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
EXO.30.KJV: This they shall give, every one that passes among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the Lord.

EXO.30.BSB: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
EXO.30.KJV: Every one that passes among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering to the LORD.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the Lord.

EXO.30.BSB: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.
EXO.30.KJV: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering to the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
EXO.30.PLAIN: In making the offering to the Lord to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.

EXO.30.BSB: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.”
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shall appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial to the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls. ¶
EXO.30.PLAIN: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the Lord to make atonement for your lives.”

EXO.30.BSB: And the LORD said to Moses,
EXO.30.KJV: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO.30.PLAIN: And the Lord said to Moses,

EXO.30.BSB: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,
EXO.30.KJV: You shall also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash with: and you shall put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and you shall put water therein.
EXO.30.PLAIN: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,

EXO.30.BSB: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
EXO.30.KJV: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
EXO.30.PLAIN: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.

EXO.30.BSB: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
EXO.30.KJV: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire to the LORD:
EXO.30.PLAIN: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the Lord, they must wash with water so that they will not die.

EXO.30.BSB: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
EXO.30.KJV: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations. ¶
EXO.30.PLAIN: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”

EXO.30.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses,
EXO.30.KJV: Moreover the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO.30.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses,

EXO.30.BSB: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,
EXO.30.KJV: Take you also to you principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
EXO.30.PLAIN: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,

EXO.30.BSB: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
EXO.30.KJV: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
EXO.30.PLAIN: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.

EXO.30.BSB: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the are of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.

EXO.30.BSB: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
EXO.30.PLAIN: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,

EXO.30.BSB: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,
EXO.30.KJV: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
EXO.30.PLAIN: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,

EXO.30.BSB: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
EXO.30.KJV: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
EXO.30.PLAIN: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.

EXO.30.BSB: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatever touches them shall be holy.
EXO.30.PLAIN: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

EXO.30.BSB: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.

EXO.30.BSB: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.
EXO.30.PLAIN: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

EXO.30.BSB: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.
EXO.30.KJV: On man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall you make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy to you.
EXO.30.PLAIN: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.

EXO.30.BSB: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’”
EXO.30.KJV: Whoever compounds any like it, or whoever puts any of it on a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people. ¶
EXO.30.PLAIN: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’”

EXO.30.BSB: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures,
EXO.30.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Take to you sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
EXO.30.PLAIN: The Lord also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures,

EXO.30.BSB: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall make it a perfume, a confection after the are of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
EXO.30.PLAIN: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

EXO.30.BSB: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
EXO.30.KJV: And you shall beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with you: it shall be to you most holy.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

EXO.30.BSB: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
EXO.30.KJV: And as for the perfume which you shall make, you shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be to you holy for the LORD.
EXO.30.PLAIN: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the Lord.

EXO.30.BSB: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
EXO.30.KJV: Whoever shall make like to that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
EXO.30.PLAIN: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”

EXO.31.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses,
EXO.31.KJV: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO.31.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses,

EXO.31.BSB: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
EXO.31.KJV: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
EXO.31.PLAIN: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

EXO.31.BSB: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
EXO.31.KJV: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
EXO.31.PLAIN: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge, and with all kinds of skills,

EXO.31.BSB: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
EXO.31.KJV: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
EXO.31.PLAIN: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,

EXO.31.BSB: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
EXO.31.KJV: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
EXO.31.PLAIN: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.

EXO.31.BSB: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
EXO.31.KJV: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you;
EXO.31.PLAIN: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:

EXO.31.BSB: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
EXO.31.KJV: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
EXO.31.PLAIN: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—

EXO.31.BSB: the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,
EXO.31.KJV: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
EXO.31.PLAIN: the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense,

EXO.31.BSB: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—
EXO.31.KJV: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
EXO.31.PLAIN: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—

EXO.31.BSB: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
EXO.31.KJV: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
EXO.31.PLAIN: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,

EXO.31.BSB: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”
EXO.31.KJV: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you shall they do. ¶
EXO.31.PLAIN: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”

EXO.31.BSB: And the LORD said to Moses,
EXO.31.KJV: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
EXO.31.PLAIN: And the Lord said to Moses,

EXO.31.BSB: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
EXO.31.KJV: Speak you also to the children of Israel, saying, Truly my sabbaths you shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that you may know that I am the LORD that does sanctify you.
EXO.31.PLAIN: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.

EXO.31.BSB: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.
EXO.31.KJV: You shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy to you: every one that defiles it shall surely be put to death: for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
EXO.31.PLAIN: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.

EXO.31.BSB: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
EXO.31.KJV: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whoever does any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
EXO.31.PLAIN: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the Lord. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.

EXO.31.BSB: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
EXO.31.KJV: Why the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
EXO.31.PLAIN: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.

EXO.31.BSB: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”
EXO.31.KJV: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed. ¶
EXO.31.PLAIN: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the Lord made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”

EXO.31.BSB: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
EXO.31.KJV: And he gave to Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him on mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
EXO.31.PLAIN: When the Lord had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

EXO.32.BSB: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!”
EXO.32.KJV: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him.
EXO.32.PLAIN: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!”

EXO.34.BSB: And the LORD descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the LORD.
EXO.34.KJV: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
EXO.34.PLAIN: And the Lord descended in a cloud, stood with him there, and proclaimed His name, the Lord.

EXO.34.BSB: Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
EXO.34.KJV: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

EXO.34.BSB: maintaining loving devotion to a thousand generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations.”
EXO.34.KJV: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, to the third and to the fourth generation.

EXO.34.BSB: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped.
EXO.34.KJV: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
EXO.34.PLAIN: Moses immediately bowed down to the ground and worshiped.

EXO.34.BSB: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our iniquity and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.”
EXO.34.KJV: And he said, If now I have found grace in your sight, O LORD, let my LORD, I pray you, go among us; for it is a stiff necked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance. ¶
EXO.34.PLAIN: “O Lord,” he said, “if I have indeed found favor in Your sight, my Lord, please go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our brokenness and sin, and take us as Your inheritance.”

EXO.34.BSB: And the LORD said, “Behold, I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world. All the people among whom you live will see the LORD’s work, for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you.
EXO.34.KJV: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which you are shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with you.
EXO.34.PLAIN: And the Lord said, “Look closely — I am making a covenant. Before all your people I will perform wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world. All the people among whom you live will see the Lord’s work, for it is an awesome thing that I am doing with you.

EXO.34.BSB: Observe what I command you this day. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
EXO.34.KJV: Observe you that which I command you this day: behold, I drive out before you the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

EXO.34.BSB: Be careful not to make a treaty with the inhabitants of the land you are entering, lest they become a snare in your midst.
EXO.34.KJV: Take heed to yourself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you go, lest it be for a snare in the middle of you:

EXO.34.BSB: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.
EXO.34.KJV: But you shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

EXO.34.BSB: For you must not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
EXO.34.KJV: For you shall worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
EXO.34.PLAIN: For you must not worship any other god, for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

EXO.34.BSB: Do not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you, and you will eat their sacrifices.
EXO.34.KJV: Lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice to their gods, and one call you, and you eat of his sacrifice;

EXO.34.PLAIN: You shall make no molten gods for yourselves.

EXO.34.KJV: The feast of unleavened bread shall you keep. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib you came out from Egypt.
EXO.34.PLAIN: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days at the appointed time in the month of Abib, you are to eat unleavened bread as I commanded you. For in the month of Abib you came out of Egypt.

EXO.34.KJV: All that opens the matrix is mine; and every firstling among your cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
EXO.34.PLAIN: The first offspring of every womb belongs to Me, including all the firstborn males among your livestock, whether cattle or sheep.

EXO.34.BSB: You must redeem the firstborn of a donkey with a lamb; but if you do not redeem it, you are to break its neck. You must redeem all the firstborn of your sons. No one shall appear before Me empty-handed.
EXO.34.KJV: But the firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb: and if you redeem him not, then shall you break his neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before me empty. ¶

EXO.34.PLAIN: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

EXO.34.BSB: For I will drive out the nations before you and enlarge your borders, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times a year to appear before the LORD your God.
EXO.34.KJV: For I will cast out the nations before you, and enlarge your borders: neither shall any man desire your land, when you shall go up to appear before the LORD your God thrice in the year.

EXO.34.PLAIN: The Lord also said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”

EXO.34.PLAIN: And after this all the Israelites came near, and Moses commanded them to do everything that the Lord had told him on Mount Sinai.

EXO.34.BSB: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

EXO.34.PLAIN: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

EXO.35.BSB: Then Moses assembled the whole congregation of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do:
