EXO.35.PLAIN: And the Lord has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

EXO.35.BSB: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.
EXO.35.KJV: Them has he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
EXO.35.PLAIN: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.

EXO.36.BSB: “So Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person are to carry out everything commanded by the LORD, who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary.”
EXO.36.KJV: Then worked Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
EXO.36.PLAIN: “So Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person are to carry out everything commanded by the Lord, who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary.”

EXO.36.BSB: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.
EXO.36.KJV: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it:
EXO.36.PLAIN: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the Lord had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.

EXO.36.BSB: They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary. Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,
EXO.36.KJV: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it with. And they brought yet to him free offerings every morning.
EXO.36.PLAIN: They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary. Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,

EXO.36.BSB: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work
EXO.36.KJV: And all the wise men, that worked all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made; ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work

EXO.36.BSB: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.”
EXO.36.KJV: And they spoke to Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
EXO.36.PLAIN: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the Lord has commanded us to do.”

EXO.36.BSB: After Moses had given an order, they sent a proclamation throughout the camp: “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more,
EXO.36.KJV: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
EXO.36.PLAIN: After Moses had given an order, they sent a proclamation throughout the camp: “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more,

EXO.36.BSB: since what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work.
EXO.36.KJV: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much. ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: since what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work.

EXO.36.BSB: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
EXO.36.KJV: And every wise hearted man among them that worked the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubim of cunning work made he them.
EXO.36.PLAIN: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.

EXO.36.BSB: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.
EXO.36.KJV: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
EXO.36.PLAIN: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.

EXO.36.BSB: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.
EXO.36.KJV: And he coupled the five curtains one to another: and the other five curtains he coupled one to another.
EXO.36.PLAIN: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.

EXO.36.BSB: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.

EXO.36.BSB: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
EXO.36.KJV: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.

EXO.36.BSB: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one to another with the clasps: so it became one tabernacle. ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit.

EXO.36.BSB: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made curtains of goats’ hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.

EXO.36.BSB: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
EXO.36.KJV: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
EXO.36.PLAIN: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

EXO.36.BSB: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.
EXO.36.KJV: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.

EXO.36.BSB: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made fifty loops on the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he on the edge of the curtain which couples the second.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.

EXO.36.BSB: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made fifty clasps of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.

EXO.36.BSB: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers’ skins above that. ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.

EXO.36.BSB: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
EXO.36.PLAIN: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

EXO.36.BSB: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
EXO.36.KJV: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
EXO.36.PLAIN: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

EXO.36.BSB: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
EXO.36.KJV: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
EXO.36.PLAIN: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

EXO.36.BSB: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
EXO.36.KJV: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
EXO.36.PLAIN: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,

EXO.36.BSB: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
EXO.36.KJV: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
EXO.36.PLAIN: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.

EXO.36.BSB: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames
EXO.36.KJV: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
EXO.36.PLAIN: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames

EXO.36.BSB: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
EXO.36.KJV: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
EXO.36.PLAIN: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.

EXO.36.BSB: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
EXO.36.KJV: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,

EXO.36.BSB: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
EXO.36.KJV: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
EXO.36.PLAIN: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,

EXO.36.BSB: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. He made both corners in this way.
EXO.36.KJV: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
EXO.36.PLAIN: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. He made both corners in this way.

EXO.36.BSB: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
EXO.36.KJV: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets. ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.

EXO.36.BSB: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
EXO.36.KJV: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
EXO.36.PLAIN: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

EXO.36.BSB: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
EXO.36.KJV: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
EXO.36.PLAIN: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.

EXO.36.BSB: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames, from one end to the other.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
EXO.36.PLAIN: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames, from one end to the other.

EXO.36.BSB: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
EXO.36.KJV: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold. ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold.

EXO.36.BSB: Next, he made the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubim made he it of cunning work.
EXO.36.PLAIN: Next, he made the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.

EXO.36.BSB: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts.
EXO.36.KJV: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver. ¶
EXO.36.PLAIN: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts.

EXO.36.BSB: For the entrance to the tent, he made a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen,
EXO.36.KJV: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
EXO.36.PLAIN: For the entrance to the tent, he made a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen,

EXO.36.BSB: together with five posts and their hooks. He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
EXO.36.KJV: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
EXO.36.PLAIN: together with five posts and their hooks. He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.

EXO.37.BSB: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
EXO.37.KJV: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
EXO.37.PLAIN: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

EXO.37.BSB: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
EXO.37.KJV: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.

EXO.37.BSB: And he cast four gold rings for its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
EXO.37.KJV: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
EXO.37.PLAIN: And he cast four gold rings for its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.

EXO.37.BSB: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
EXO.37.PLAIN: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

EXO.37.BSB: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it.
EXO.37.KJV: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark. ¶
EXO.37.PLAIN: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it.

EXO.37.BSB: He constructed a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He constructed a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

EXO.37.BSB: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
EXO.37.KJV: And he made two cherubim of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
EXO.37.PLAIN: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,

EXO.37.BSB: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
EXO.37.KJV: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubim on the two ends thereof.
EXO.37.PLAIN: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.

EXO.37.BSB: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
EXO.37.KJV: And the cherubim spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seat were the faces of the cherubim. ¶
EXO.37.PLAIN: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat.

EXO.37.BSB: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
EXO.37.PLAIN: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

EXO.37.BSB: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
EXO.37.KJV: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.

EXO.37.BSB: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
EXO.37.KJV: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
EXO.37.PLAIN: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.

EXO.37.BSB: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.
EXO.37.KJV: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings on the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.

EXO.37.BSB: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
EXO.37.KJV: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
EXO.37.PLAIN: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.

EXO.37.BSB: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.

EXO.37.BSB: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the vessels which were on the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover with, of pure gold. ¶
EXO.37.PLAIN: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.

EXO.37.BSB: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
EXO.37.PLAIN: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.

EXO.37.BSB: Six branches extended from the sides, three on one side and three on the other.
EXO.37.KJV: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
EXO.37.PLAIN: Six branches extended from the sides, three on one side and three on the other.

EXO.37.BSB: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.
EXO.37.KJV: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a bud and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
EXO.37.PLAIN: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.

EXO.37.BSB: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
EXO.37.KJV: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
EXO.37.PLAIN: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.

EXO.37.BSB: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
EXO.37.KJV: And a bud under two branches of the same, and a bud under two branches of the same, and a bud under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
EXO.37.PLAIN: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.

EXO.37.BSB: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
EXO.37.KJV: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
EXO.37.PLAIN: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.

EXO.37.BSB: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his firepans, of pure gold.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.

EXO.37.BSB: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.
EXO.37.KJV: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof. ¶
EXO.37.PLAIN: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.

EXO.37.BSB: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns were of one piece.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns were of one piece.

EXO.37.BSB: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.
EXO.37.KJV: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made to it a crown of gold round about.
EXO.37.PLAIN: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.

EXO.37.BSB: He made two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, on the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it with.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He made two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.

EXO.37.BSB: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold. ¶
EXO.37.PLAIN: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

EXO.37.BSB: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
EXO.37.KJV: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
EXO.37.PLAIN: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.

EXO.38.BSB: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood. It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
EXO.38.KJV: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
EXO.38.PLAIN: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood. It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.

EXO.38.BSB: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.
EXO.38.KJV: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
EXO.38.PLAIN: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.

EXO.38.BSB: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.
EXO.38.KJV: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, and the meat hooks, and the fire pans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
EXO.38.PLAIN: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.

EXO.38.BSB: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.
EXO.38.KJV: And he made for the altar a brazen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath to the middle of it.
EXO.38.PLAIN: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.

EXO.38.BSB: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
EXO.38.KJV: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
EXO.38.PLAIN: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.

EXO.38.BSB: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
EXO.38.KJV: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
EXO.38.PLAIN: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

EXO.38.BSB: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow.
EXO.38.KJV: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it with; he made the altar hollow with boards. ¶
EXO.38.PLAIN: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow.

EXO.38.BSB: Next he made the bronze basin and its stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
EXO.38.KJV: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the mirrors of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. ¶
EXO.38.PLAIN: Next he made the bronze basin and its stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

EXO.38.BSB: Then he constructed the courtyard. The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen,
EXO.38.KJV: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
EXO.38.PLAIN: Then he constructed the courtyard. The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen,

EXO.38.BSB: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
EXO.38.KJV: Their pillars were twenty, and their brazen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
EXO.38.PLAIN: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

EXO.38.BSB: The north side was also a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
EXO.38.KJV: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The north side was also a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.

EXO.38.BSB: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
EXO.38.KJV: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.

EXO.38.BSB: And the east side, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits long.
EXO.38.KJV: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
EXO.38.PLAIN: And the east side, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits long.

EXO.38.BSB: The curtains on one side of the entrance were fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
EXO.38.KJV: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The curtains on one side of the entrance were fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.

EXO.38.BSB: And the curtains on the other side were also fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases as well.
EXO.38.KJV: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
EXO.38.PLAIN: And the curtains on the other side were also fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases as well.

EXO.38.BSB: All the curtains around the courtyard were made of finely spun linen.
EXO.38.KJV: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
EXO.38.PLAIN: All the curtains around the courtyard were made of finely spun linen.

EXO.38.BSB: The bases for the posts were bronze, the hooks and bands were silver, and the plating for the tops of the posts was silver. So all the posts of the courtyard were banded with silver.
EXO.38.KJV: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their capitals of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The bases for the posts were bronze, the hooks and bands were silver, and the plating for the tops of the posts was silver. So all the posts of the courtyard were banded with silver.

EXO.38.BSB: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,
EXO.38.KJV: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,

EXO.38.BSB: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks were silver, as well as the bands and the plating of their tops.
EXO.38.KJV: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals and their fillets of silver.
EXO.38.PLAIN: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks were silver, as well as the bands and the plating of their tops.

EXO.38.BSB: All the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the surrounding courtyard were bronze.
EXO.38.KJV: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass. ¶
EXO.38.PLAIN: All the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the surrounding courtyard were bronze.

EXO.38.BSB: This is the inventory for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, as recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
EXO.38.KJV: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
EXO.38.PLAIN: This is the inventory for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, as recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

EXO.38.BSB: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.38.KJV: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
EXO.38.PLAIN: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.38.BSB: With him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen.
EXO.38.KJV: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
EXO.38.PLAIN: With him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen.

EXO.38.BSB: All the gold from the wave offering used for the work on the sanctuary totaled 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
EXO.38.KJV: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
EXO.38.PLAIN: All the gold from the wave offering used for the work on the sanctuary totaled 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

EXO.38.BSB: The silver from those numbered among the congregation totaled 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—
EXO.38.KJV: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and three score and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
EXO.38.PLAIN: The silver from those numbered among the congregation totaled 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—

EXO.38.BSB: a beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone twenty years of age or older who had crossed over to be numbered, a total of 603,550 men.
EXO.38.KJV: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
EXO.38.PLAIN: a beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone twenty years of age or older who had crossed over to be numbered, a total of 603,550 men.

EXO.38.BSB: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent per base.
EXO.38.KJV: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent per base.

EXO.38.BSB: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
EXO.38.KJV: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their capitals, and filleted them.
EXO.38.PLAIN: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.

EXO.38.BSB: The bronze from the wave offering totaled 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
EXO.38.KJV: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
EXO.38.PLAIN: The bronze from the wave offering totaled 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.

EXO.38.BSB: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar,
EXO.38.KJV: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brazen altar, and the brazen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
EXO.38.PLAIN: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar,

EXO.38.BSB: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and its gate, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and its surrounding courtyard.
EXO.38.KJV: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
EXO.38.PLAIN: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and its gate, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and its surrounding courtyard.

EXO.39.BSB: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
EXO.39.PLAIN: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
EXO.39.KJV: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
EXO.39.PLAIN: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

EXO.39.BSB: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.
EXO.39.KJV: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.

EXO.39.BSB: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
EXO.39.KJV: They made shoulder pieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

EXO.39.BSB: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was on it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
EXO.39.KJV: And they worked onyx stones enclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.

EXO.39.BSB: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
EXO.39.KJV: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
EXO.39.PLAIN: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.

EXO.39.BSB: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
EXO.39.KJV: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
EXO.39.PLAIN: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.

EXO.39.BSB: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
EXO.39.KJV: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
EXO.39.PLAIN: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;

EXO.39.BSB: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
EXO.39.KJV: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
EXO.39.PLAIN: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;

EXO.39.BSB: the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
EXO.39.KJV: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
EXO.39.PLAIN: the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

EXO.39.BSB: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
EXO.39.KJV: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were enclosed in ouches of gold in their settings.
EXO.39.PLAIN: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.

EXO.39.BSB: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
EXO.39.KJV: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
EXO.39.PLAIN: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

EXO.39.BSB: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.
EXO.39.KJV: And they made on the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
EXO.39.PLAIN: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.

EXO.39.BSB: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
EXO.39.KJV: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.

EXO.39.BSB: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
EXO.39.KJV: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
EXO.39.PLAIN: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,

EXO.39.BSB: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
EXO.39.KJV: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, before it.
EXO.39.PLAIN: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

EXO.39.BSB: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
EXO.39.KJV: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.

EXO.39.BSB: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.
EXO.39.KJV: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.

EXO.39.BSB: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,
EXO.39.KJV: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,

EXO.39.BSB: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.
EXO.39.KJV: And there was an hole in the middle of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
EXO.39.PLAIN: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.

EXO.39.BSB: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
EXO.39.KJV: And they made on the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.

EXO.39.BSB: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,
EXO.39.KJV: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
EXO.39.PLAIN: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,

EXO.39.BSB: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver,
EXO.39.KJV: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
EXO.39.PLAIN: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver,

EXO.39.BSB: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
EXO.39.KJV: And a turban of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
EXO.39.PLAIN: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,

EXO.39.BSB: and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
EXO.39.KJV: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
EXO.39.PLAIN: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE Lord.

EXO.39.BSB: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: And they tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high on the turban; as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
EXO.39.KJV: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they. ¶
EXO.39.PLAIN: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

EXO.39.BSB: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent with all its furnishings, its clasps, its frames, its crossbars, and its posts and bases;
EXO.39.KJV: And they brought the tabernacle to Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his clasps, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
EXO.39.PLAIN: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent with all its furnishings, its clasps, its frames, its crossbars, and its posts and bases;

EXO.39.BSB: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering;
EXO.39.KJV: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the veil of the covering,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering;

EXO.39.BSB: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;
EXO.39.KJV: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;

EXO.39.BSB: the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence;
EXO.39.KJV: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the show bread,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence;

EXO.39.BSB: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its utensils, as well as the oil for the light;
EXO.39.KJV: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its utensils, as well as the oil for the light;

EXO.39.BSB: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
EXO.39.KJV: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;

EXO.39.BSB: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
EXO.39.KJV: The brazen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

EXO.39.BSB: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;
EXO.39.KJV: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
EXO.39.PLAIN: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;
