LEV.19.PLAIN: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the Lord, you shall offer it for your acceptance.

LEV.19.BSB: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.
LEV.19.KJV: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the morrow: and if any remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
LEV.19.PLAIN: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.

LEV.19.BSB: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.
LEV.19.KJV: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
LEV.19.PLAIN: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.

LEV.19.BSB: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people.
LEV.19.KJV: Therefore every one that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: Whoever eats it will bear his brokenness, for he has profaned what is holy to the Lord. That person must be cut off from his people.

LEV.19.BSB: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
LEV.19.KJV: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
LEV.19.PLAIN: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
LEV.19.KJV: And you shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather every grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the Lord your God.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: And you shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shall you profane the name of your God: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him. You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not defraud your neighbor, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with you all night until the morning. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him. You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind, but shall fear your God: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: you shall not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shall you judge your neighbor. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not go up and down as a talebearer among your people: neither shall you stand against the blood of your neighbor; I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not hate your brother in your heart: you shall in any wise rebuke your neighbor, and not suffer sin on him. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.

LEV.19.BSB: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as yourself: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against anyone among your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your cattle engender with a diverse kind: you shall not sow your field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woolen come on you. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.

LEV.19.BSB: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
LEV.19.KJV: And whoever lies carnally with a woman, that is a female slave, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
LEV.19.PLAIN: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

LEV.19.BSB: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: And he shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
LEV.19.PLAIN: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.
LEV.19.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has done: and the sin which he has done shall be forgiven him. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the Lord with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.

LEV.19.BSB: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
LEV.19.KJV: And when you shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then you shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised to you: it shall not be eaten of.
LEV.19.PLAIN: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.

LEV.19.BSB: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD with.
LEV.19.PLAIN: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.
LEV.19.KJV: And in the fifth year shall you eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield to you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the Lord your God.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall you use enchantment, nor observe times.
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shall you mar the corners of your beard.
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks on you: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
LEV.19.KJV: Do not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.

LEV.19.BSB: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
LEV.19.KJV: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God.

LEV.19.BSB: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and fear your God: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the Lord.

LEV.19.BSB: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.
LEV.19.KJV: And if a stranger sojourn with you in your land, you shall not vex him.
LEV.19.PLAIN: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.

LEV.19.BSB: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
LEV.19.KJV: But the stranger that dwells with you shall be to you as one born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God. ¶
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

LEV.19.BSB: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
LEV.19.KJV: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in length, in weight, or in measure.
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.

LEV.19.BSB: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
LEV.19.KJV: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall you have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
LEV.19.PLAIN: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

LEV.19.BSB: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
LEV.19.KJV: Therefore shall you observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
LEV.19.PLAIN: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the Lord.”

LEV.20.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses,
LEV.20.KJV: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
LEV.20.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses,

LEV.20.BSB: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.
LEV.20.KJV: Again, you shall say to the children of Israel, Whoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that gives any of his seed to Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
LEV.20.PLAIN: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.

LEV.20.BSB: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.
LEV.20.KJV: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he has given of his seed to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
LEV.20.PLAIN: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.

LEV.20.BSB: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
LEV.20.KJV: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he gives of his seed to Molech, and kill him not:
LEV.20.PLAIN: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,

LEV.20.BSB: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
LEV.20.KJV: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit prostitution with Molech, from among their people. ¶
LEV.20.PLAIN: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.

LEV.20.BSB: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
LEV.20.KJV: And the soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people. ¶
LEV.20.PLAIN: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.

LEV.20.BSB: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
LEV.20.KJV: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be you holy: for I am the LORD your God.
LEV.20.PLAIN: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the Lord your God.

LEV.20.BSB: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
LEV.20.KJV: And you shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you. ¶
LEV.20.PLAIN: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the Lord who sanctifies you.

LEV.20.BSB: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.
LEV.20.KJV: For every one that curses his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be on him. ¶
LEV.20.PLAIN: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.
LEV.20.KJV: And the man that commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he that commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
LEV.20.KJV: And the man that lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be on them.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have worked confusion; their blood shall be on them.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
LEV.20.KJV: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lies with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be on them.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and you shall slay the beast.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.

LEV.20.BSB: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a woman approach to any beast, and lie down thereto, you shall kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be on them.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his brokenness.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he has discovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.

LEV.20.BSB: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.
LEV.20.KJV: And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister: for he uncovers his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
LEV.20.PLAIN: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their brokenness.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.

LEV.20.BSB: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.
LEV.20.KJV: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless. ¶
LEV.20.PLAIN: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.

LEV.20.BSB: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
LEV.20.KJV: You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, where I bring you to dwell therein, spew you not out.
LEV.20.PLAIN: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.

LEV.20.BSB: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
LEV.20.KJV: And you shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
LEV.20.PLAIN: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

LEV.20.BSB: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
LEV.20.KJV: But I have said to you, You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land that flows with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
LEV.20.PLAIN: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the Lord your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.

LEV.20.BSB: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.
LEV.20.KJV: You shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and you shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
LEV.20.PLAIN: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.

LEV.20.BSB: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
LEV.20.KJV: And you shall be holy to me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that you should be mine. ¶
LEV.20.PLAIN: You are to be holy to Me because I, the Lord, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.

LEV.20.BSB: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”
LEV.20.KJV: A man also or woman that has a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be on them.
LEV.20.PLAIN: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”

LEV.21.BSB: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,
LEV.21.KJV: And the LORD said to Moses, Speak to the priests the sons of Aaron, and say to them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
LEV.21.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron’s sons, the priests, and tell them that a priest is not to defile himself for a dead person among his people,

LEV.21.BSB: except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,
LEV.21.KJV: But for his kin, that is near to him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.
LEV.21.PLAIN: except for his immediate family—his mother, father, son, daughter, or brother,

LEV.21.BSB: or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.
LEV.21.KJV: And for his sister a virgin, that is near to him, which has had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
LEV.21.PLAIN: or his unmarried sister who is near to him, since she has no husband.

LEV.21.BSB: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.
LEV.21.KJV: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
LEV.21.PLAIN: He is not to defile himself for those related to him by marriage, and so profane himself.

LEV.21.BSB: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.
LEV.21.KJV: They shall not make baldness on their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
LEV.21.PLAIN: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.

LEV.21.BSB: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the LORD the offerings made by fire, the food of their God, they must be holy.
LEV.21.KJV: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
LEV.21.PLAIN: They must be holy to their God and not profane the name of their God. Because they present to the Lord the offerings made by fire, the food of their God, they must be holy.

LEV.25.KJV: Why you shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

LEV.25.BSB: Then the land will yield its fruit, so that you can eat your fill and dwell in safety in the land.
LEV.25.KJV: And the land shall yield her fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Then the land will yield its fruit, so that you can eat your fill and dwell in safety in the land.

LEV.25.BSB: Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’
LEV.25.KJV: And if you shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
LEV.25.PLAIN: Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’

LEV.25.BSB: But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.
LEV.25.KJV: Then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
LEV.25.PLAIN: But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.

LEV.25.BSB: While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.
LEV.25.KJV: And you shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in you shall eat of the old store. ¶
LEV.25.PLAIN: While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.

LEV.25.BSB: The land must not be sold permanently, because it is Mine, and you are but foreigners and residents with Me.
LEV.25.KJV: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine, for you are strangers and sojourners with me.
LEV.25.PLAIN: The land must not be sold permanently, because it is Mine, and you are but foreigners and residents with Me.

LEV.25.BSB: Thus for every piece of property you possess, you must provide for the redemption of the land.
LEV.25.KJV: And in all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land. ¶
LEV.25.PLAIN: Thus for every piece of property you possess, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

LEV.25.BSB: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his property, his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold.
LEV.25.KJV: If your brother be waxen poor, and has sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
LEV.25.PLAIN: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his property, his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold.

LEV.25.BSB: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,
LEV.25.KJV: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
LEV.25.PLAIN: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,

LEV.25.BSB: he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.
LEV.25.KJV: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the remainder to the man to whom he sold it; that he may return to his possession.
LEV.25.PLAIN: he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.

LEV.25.BSB: But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.
LEV.25.KJV: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that has bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return to his possession.
LEV.25.PLAIN: But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.

LEV.25.BSB: If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains his right of redemption until a full year after its sale; during that year it may be redeemed.
LEV.25.KJV: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
LEV.25.PLAIN: If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains his right of redemption until a full year after its sale; during that year it may be redeemed.

LEV.25.BSB: If it is not redeemed by the end of a full year, then the house in the walled city is permanently transferred to its buyer and his descendants. It is not to be released in the Jubilee.
LEV.25.KJV: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.
LEV.25.PLAIN: If it is not redeemed by the end of a full year, then the house in the walled city is permanently transferred to its buyer and his descendants. It is not to be released in the Jubilee.

LEV.25.BSB: But houses in villages with no walls around them are to be considered as open fields. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
LEV.25.KJV: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.
LEV.25.PLAIN: But houses in villages with no walls around them are to be considered as open fields. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

LEV.25.BSB: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.
LEV.25.KJV: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
LEV.25.PLAIN: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.

LEV.25.BSB: So whatever belongs to the Levites may be redeemed—a house sold in a city they possess—and must be released in the Jubilee, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the Israelites.
LEV.25.KJV: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubilee: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
LEV.25.PLAIN: So whatever belongs to the Levites may be redeemed—a house sold in a city they possess—and must be released in the Jubilee, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the Israelites.

LEV.25.BSB: But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.
LEV.25.KJV: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession. ¶
LEV.25.PLAIN: But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.

LEV.25.BSB: Now if your countryman becomes destitute and cannot support himself among you, then you are to help him as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.
LEV.25.KJV: And if your brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with you; then you shall relieve him: yes, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with you.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Now if your countryman becomes destitute and cannot support himself among you, then you are to help him as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.

LEV.25.BSB: Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.
LEV.25.KJV: Take you no usury of him, or increase: but fear your God; that your brother may live with you.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.

LEV.25.BSB: You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.
LEV.25.KJV: You shall not give him your money on usury, nor lend him your victuals for increase.
LEV.25.PLAIN: You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.

LEV.25.BSB: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
LEV.25.KJV: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God. ¶
LEV.25.PLAIN: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

LEV.25.BSB: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.
LEV.25.KJV: And if your brother that dwells by you be waxen poor, and be sold to you; you shall not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
LEV.25.PLAIN: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.

LEV.25.BSB: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
LEV.25.KJV: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with you, and shall serve you to the year of jubilee.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

LEV.25.BSB: Then he and his children are to be released, and he may return to his clan and to the property of his fathers.
LEV.25.KJV: And then shall he depart from you, both he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers shall he return.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Then he and his children are to be released, and he may return to his clan and to the property of his fathers.

LEV.25.BSB: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
LEV.25.KJV: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as slaves.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.

LEV.25.BSB: You are not to rule over them harshly, but you shall fear your God.
LEV.25.KJV: You shall not rule over him with rigor; but shall fear your God.
LEV.25.PLAIN: You are not to rule over them harshly, but you shall fear your God.

LEV.25.BSB: Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.
LEV.25.KJV: Both your slaves, and your bondmaids, which you shall have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall you buy slaves and bondmaids.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.

LEV.25.BSB: You may also purchase them from the foreigners residing among you or their clans living among you who are born in your land. These may become your property.
LEV.25.KJV: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall you buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
LEV.25.PLAIN: You may also purchase them from the foreigners residing among you or their clans living among you who are born in your land. These may become your property.

LEV.25.BSB: You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.
LEV.25.KJV: And you shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your slaves for ever: but over your brothers the children of Israel, you shall not rule one over another with rigor. ¶
LEV.25.PLAIN: You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.

LEV.25.BSB: If a foreigner residing among you prospers, but your countryman dwelling near him becomes destitute and sells himself to the foreigner or to a member of his clan,
LEV.25.KJV: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by you, and your brother that dwells by him wax poor, and sell himself to the stranger or sojourner by you, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
LEV.25.PLAIN: If a foreigner residing among you prospers, but your countryman dwelling near him becomes destitute and sells himself to the foreigner or to a member of his clan,

LEV.25.BSB: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him:
LEV.25.KJV: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brothers may redeem him:
LEV.25.PLAIN: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him:

LEV.25.BSB: either his uncle or cousin or any close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.
LEV.25.KJV: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is near of kin to him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
LEV.25.PLAIN: either his uncle or cousin or any close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.

LEV.25.BSB: He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale will be determined by the number of years, based on the daily wages of a hired hand.
LEV.25.KJV: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him to the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
LEV.25.PLAIN: He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale will be determined by the number of years, based on the daily wages of a hired hand.

LEV.25.BSB: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.
LEV.25.KJV: If there be yet many years behind, according to them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
LEV.25.PLAIN: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.

LEV.25.BSB: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to calculate and pay his redemption according to his remaining years.
LEV.25.KJV: And if there remain but few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him, and according to his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
LEV.25.PLAIN: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to calculate and pay his redemption according to his remaining years.

LEV.25.BSB: He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.
LEV.25.KJV: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigor over him in your sight.
LEV.25.PLAIN: He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.

LEV.25.BSB: Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children shall be released in the Year of Jubilee.
LEV.25.KJV: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, both he, and his children with him.
LEV.25.PLAIN: Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children shall be released in the Year of Jubilee.

LEV.25.BSB: For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
LEV.25.KJV: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
LEV.25.PLAIN: For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

LEV.26.BSB: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.
LEV.26.KJV: You shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither raise you up a standing image, neither shall you set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down to it: for I am the LORD your God.
LEV.26.PLAIN: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the Lord your God.

LEV.26.BSB: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
LEV.26.KJV: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD. ¶
LEV.26.PLAIN: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the Lord.

LEV.26.BSB: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,
LEV.26.KJV: If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
LEV.26.PLAIN: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,

LEV.26.BSB: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
LEV.26.KJV: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.

LEV.26.BSB: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.
LEV.26.KJV: And your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time: and you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
LEV.26.PLAIN: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.

LEV.26.BSB: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
LEV.26.PLAIN: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.

LEV.26.BSB: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.
LEV.26.KJV: And you shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
LEV.26.PLAIN: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

LEV.26.BSB: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
LEV.26.KJV: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
LEV.26.PLAIN: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.

LEV.26.BSB: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.
LEV.26.KJV: For I will have respect to you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.

LEV.26.BSB: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
LEV.26.KJV: And you shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
LEV.26.PLAIN: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.

LEV.26.BSB: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.
LEV.26.KJV: And I set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
LEV.26.PLAIN: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.

LEV.26.BSB: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you shall be my people.
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

LEV.26.BSB: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.
LEV.26.KJV: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright. ¶
LEV.26.PLAIN: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.

LEV.26.BSB: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,
LEV.26.KJV: But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments;
LEV.26.PLAIN: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,

LEV.26.BSB: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,
LEV.26.KJV: And if you shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that you will not do all my commandments, but that you break my covenant:
LEV.26.PLAIN: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,

LEV.26.BSB: then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
LEV.26.KJV: I also will do this to you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
LEV.26.PLAIN: then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

LEV.26.BSB: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will set my face against you, and you shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and you shall flee when none pursues you.
LEV.26.PLAIN: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.

LEV.26.BSB: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
LEV.26.KJV: And if you will not yet for all this listen to me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
LEV.26.PLAIN: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.

LEV.26.BSB: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,
LEV.26.KJV: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,

LEV.26.BSB: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
LEV.26.KJV: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits. ¶
LEV.26.PLAIN: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.

LEV.26.BSB: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.
LEV.26.KJV: And if you walk contrary to me, and will not listen to me; I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.
LEV.26.PLAIN: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.

LEV.26.BSB: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.
LEV.26.KJV: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.

LEV.26.BSB: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
LEV.26.KJV: And if you will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary to me;
LEV.26.PLAIN: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,

LEV.26.BSB: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
LEV.26.KJV: Then will I also walk contrary to you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
LEV.26.PLAIN: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.

LEV.26.BSB: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will bring a sword on you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when you are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
LEV.26.PLAIN: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

LEV.26.BSB: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.
LEV.26.KJV: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and you shall eat, and not be satisfied.
LEV.26.PLAIN: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.

LEV.26.BSB: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
LEV.26.KJV: And if you will not for all this listen to me, but walk contrary to me;
LEV.26.PLAIN: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,

LEV.26.BSB: then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.
LEV.26.KJV: Then I will walk contrary to you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
LEV.26.PLAIN: then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.

LEV.26.BSB: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
LEV.26.KJV: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall you eat.
LEV.26.PLAIN: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.

LEV.26.BSB: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcasses on the carcasses of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.

LEV.26.BSB: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries to desolation, and I will not smell the smell of your sweet odors.
LEV.26.PLAIN: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.

LEV.26.BSB: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.
LEV.26.KJV: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
LEV.26.PLAIN: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.

LEV.26.BSB: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.
