DEU.3.PLAIN: and to the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead to the Arnon Valley (the middle of the valley was the border) and up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.

DEU.3.BSB: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea) with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
DEU.3.KJV: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward. ¶
DEU.3.PLAIN: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea) with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.

DEU.3.BSB: At that time I commanded you: “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.
DEU.3.KJV: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it: you shall pass over armed before your brothers the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
DEU.3.PLAIN: At that time I commanded you: “The Lord your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.

DEU.3.BSB: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,
DEU.3.KJV: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that you have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
DEU.3.PLAIN: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,

DEU.3.BSB: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.”
DEU.3.KJV: Until the LORD have given rest to your brothers, as well as to you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God has given them beyond Jordan: and then shall you return every man to his possession, which I have given you. ¶
DEU.3.PLAIN: until the Lord gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the Lord your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.”

DEU.3.BSB: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.
DEU.3.KJV: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings: so shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you pass.
DEU.3.PLAIN: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. The Lord will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.

DEU.3.BSB: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God Himself will fight for you.”
DEU.3.KJV: You shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
DEU.3.PLAIN: Do not be afraid of them, for the Lord your God Himself will fight for you.”

DEU.3.BSB: At that time I also pleaded with the LORD:
DEU.3.KJV: And I sought the LORD at that time, saying,
DEU.3.PLAIN: At that time I also pleaded with the Lord:

DEU.3.BSB: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
DEU.3.KJV: O Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to your works, and according to your might?
DEU.3.PLAIN: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?

DEU.3.BSB: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
DEU.3.KJV: I pray you, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
DEU.3.PLAIN: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”

DEU.3.BSB: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the LORD said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.
DEU.3.KJV: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said to me, Let it suffice you; speak no more to me of this matter.
DEU.3.PLAIN: But the Lord was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the Lord said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.

DEU.3.BSB: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.
DEU.3.KJV: Get you up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with your eyes: for you shall not go over this Jordan.
DEU.3.PLAIN: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.

DEU.3.BSB: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”
DEU.3.KJV: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.
DEU.3.PLAIN: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”

DEU.3.BSB: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
DEU.3.KJV: So we stayed in the valley over against Bethpeor.
DEU.3.PLAIN: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.

DEU.4.BSB: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
DEU.4.KJV: Now therefore listen, O Israel, to the statutes and to the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that you may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers gives you.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

DEU.4.BSB: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.
DEU.4.KJV: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish anything from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
DEU.4.PLAIN: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the Lord your God that I am giving you.

DEU.4.BSB: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.
DEU.4.KJV: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD your God has destroyed them from among you.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did at Baal-peor, for the Lord your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.

DEU.4.BSB: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.
DEU.4.KJV: But you that did join to the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
DEU.4.PLAIN: But you who held fast to the Lord your God are alive to this day, every one of you.

DEU.4.BSB: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.
DEU.4.KJV: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the land where you go to possess it.
DEU.4.PLAIN: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the Lord my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.

DEU.4.BSB: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
DEU.4.KJV: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

DEU.4.BSB: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
DEU.4.KJV: For what nation is there so great, who has God so near to them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call on him for?
DEU.4.PLAIN: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the Lord our God is to us whenever we call on Him?

DEU.4.BSB: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?
DEU.4.KJV: And what nation is there so great, that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
DEU.4.PLAIN: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?

DEU.4.BSB: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
DEU.4.KJV: Only take heed to yourself, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life: but teach them your sons, and your sons’ sons;
DEU.4.PLAIN: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.

DEU.4.BSB: The day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, the LORD said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”
DEU.4.KJV: Specially the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.
DEU.4.PLAIN: The day you stood before the Lord your God at Horeb, the Lord said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”

DEU.4.BSB: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
DEU.4.KJV: And you came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire to the middle of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
DEU.4.PLAIN: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

DEU.4.BSB: And the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.
DEU.4.KJV: And the LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only you heard a voice.
DEU.4.PLAIN: And the Lord spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.

DEU.4.BSB: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.
DEU.4.KJV: And he declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them on two tables of stone. ¶
DEU.4.PLAIN: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.

DEU.4.BSB: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
DEU.4.KJV: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.
DEU.4.PLAIN: At that time the Lord commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

DEU.4.BSB: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful
DEU.4.KJV: Take you therefore good heed to yourselves; for you saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire:
DEU.4.PLAIN: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the Lord spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful

DEU.4.BSB: that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female,
DEU.4.KJV: Lest you corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
DEU.4.PLAIN: that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female,

DEU.4.BSB: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,
DEU.4.KJV: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flies in the air,
DEU.4.PLAIN: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,

DEU.4.BSB: or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.
DEU.4.KJV: The likeness of any thing that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
DEU.4.PLAIN: or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.

DEU.4.BSB: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
DEU.4.KJV: And lest you lift up your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, should be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has divided to all nations under the whole heaven.
DEU.4.PLAIN: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the Lord your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

DEU.4.BSB: Yet the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.
DEU.4.KJV: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as you are this day.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Yet the Lord has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.

DEU.4.BSB: The LORD, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
DEU.4.KJV: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land, which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance:
DEU.4.PLAIN: The Lord, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

DEU.4.BSB: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.
DEU.4.KJV: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
DEU.4.PLAIN: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.

DEU.4.BSB: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.
DEU.4.KJV: Take heed to yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD your God has forbidden you.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the Lord your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.

DEU.4.BSB: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
DEU.4.KJV: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God. ¶
DEU.4.PLAIN: For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

DEU.4.BSB: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God and provoking Him to anger—
DEU.4.KJV: When you shall beget children, and children’s children, and you shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD your God, to provoke him to anger:
DEU.4.PLAIN: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the Lord your God and provoking Him to anger—

DEU.4.BSB: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.
DEU.4.KJV: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land where you go over Jordan to possess it; you shall not prolong your days on it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
DEU.4.PLAIN: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.

DEU.4.BSB: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
DEU.4.KJV: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the heathen, where the LORD shall lead you.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Then the Lord will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the Lord will drive you.

DEU.4.BSB: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
DEU.4.KJV: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
DEU.4.PLAIN: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

DEU.4.BSB: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
DEU.4.KJV: But if from there you shall seek the LORD your God, you shall find him, if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.
DEU.4.PLAIN: But if from there you seek the Lord your God, you will find him if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.

DEU.4.BSB: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.
DEU.4.KJV: When you are in tribulation, and all these things are come on you, even in the latter days, if you turn to the LORD your God, and shall be obedient to his voice;
DEU.4.PLAIN: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the Lord your God and listen to His voice.

DEU.4.BSB: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath.
DEU.4.KJV: (For the LORD your God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.
DEU.4.PLAIN: For the Lord your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath.

DEU.4.BSB: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
DEU.4.KJV: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven to the other, whether there has been any such thing as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?
DEU.4.PLAIN: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?

DEU.4.BSB: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?
DEU.4.KJV: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
DEU.4.PLAIN: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?

DEU.4.BSB: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?
DEU.4.KJV: Or has God assayed to go and take him a nation from the middle of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
DEU.4.PLAIN: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the Lord your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?

DEU.4.BSB: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.
DEU.4.KJV: To you it was showed, that you might know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
DEU.4.PLAIN: You were shown these things so that you would know that the Lord is God; there is no other besides Him.

DEU.4.BSB: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.
DEU.4.KJV: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you: and on earth he showed you his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.
DEU.4.PLAIN: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.

DEU.4.BSB: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,
DEU.4.KJV: And because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought you out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
DEU.4.PLAIN: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,

DEU.4.BSB: to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.
DEU.4.KJV: To drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you are, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
DEU.4.PLAIN: to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.

DEU.4.BSB: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.
DEU.4.KJV: Know therefore this day, and consider it in your heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and on the earth beneath: there is none else.
DEU.4.PLAIN: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the Lord is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.

DEU.4.BSB: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
DEU.4.KJV: You shall keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you this day, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days on the earth, which the LORD your God gives you, for ever. ¶
DEU.4.PLAIN: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the Lord your God is giving you for all time.

DEU.4.BSB: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east
DEU.4.KJV: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sun rise;
DEU.4.PLAIN: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east

DEU.4.BSB: to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:
DEU.4.KJV: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbor unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:
DEU.4.PLAIN: to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:

DEU.4.BSB: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.
DEU.4.KJV: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites. ¶
DEU.4.PLAIN: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.

DEU.4.BSB: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.
DEU.4.KJV: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
DEU.4.PLAIN: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.

DEU.4.BSB: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,
DEU.4.KJV: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.
DEU.4.PLAIN: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,

DEU.4.BSB: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
DEU.4.KJV: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelled at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
DEU.4.PLAIN: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.

DEU.4.BSB: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east—
DEU.4.KJV: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sun rise;

DEU.7.PLAIN: For you are a people holy to the Lord your God. The Lord your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.

DEU.7.BSB: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
DEU.7.KJV: The LORD did not set his love on you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all people:
DEU.7.PLAIN: The Lord did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

DEU.7.BSB: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
DEU.7.KJV: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn to your fathers, has the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of slaves, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
DEU.7.PLAIN: But because the Lord loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

DEU.7.BSB: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
DEU.7.KJV: Know therefore that the LORD your God, he is God, the faithful God, which keeps covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
DEU.7.PLAIN: Know therefore that the Lord your God is God, the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commandments.

DEU.7.BSB: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.
DEU.7.KJV: And repays them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hates him, he will repay him to his face.
DEU.7.PLAIN: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.

DEU.7.BSB: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day.
DEU.7.KJV: You shall therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command you this day, to do them. ¶
DEU.7.PLAIN: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day.

DEU.7.BSB: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
DEU.7.KJV: Why it shall come to pass, if you listen to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD your God shall keep to you the covenant and the mercy which he swore to your fathers:
DEU.7.PLAIN: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the Lord your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.

DEU.7.BSB: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
DEU.7.KJV: And he will love you, and bless you, and multiply you: he will also bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your corn, and your wine, and your oil, the increase of your cows, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
DEU.7.PLAIN: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.

DEU.7.BSB: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.
DEU.7.KJV: You shall be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
DEU.7.PLAIN: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.

DEU.7.BSB: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
DEU.7.KJV: And the LORD will take away from you all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you; but will lay them on all them that hate you.
DEU.7.PLAIN: And the Lord will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.

DEU.7.BSB: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
DEU.7.KJV: And you shall consume all the people which the LORD your God shall deliver you; your eye shall have no pity on them: neither shall you serve their gods; for that will be a snare to you.
DEU.7.PLAIN: You must destroy all the peoples the Lord your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

DEU.7.BSB: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”
DEU.7.KJV: If you shall say in your heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
DEU.7.PLAIN: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”

DEU.7.BSB: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:
DEU.7.KJV: You shall not be afraid of them: but shall well remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt;
DEU.7.PLAIN: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:

DEU.7.BSB: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
DEU.7.KJV: The great temptations which your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD your God brought you out: so shall the LORD your God do to all the people of whom you are afraid.
DEU.7.PLAIN: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the Lord your God brought you out. The Lord your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

DEU.7.BSB: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
DEU.7.KJV: Moreover the LORD your God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from you, be destroyed.
DEU.7.PLAIN: Moreover, the Lord your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.

DEU.7.BSB: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
DEU.7.KJV: You shall not be affrighted at them: for the LORD your God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
DEU.7.PLAIN: Do not be terrified by them, for the Lord your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

DEU.7.BSB: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
DEU.7.KJV: And the LORD your God will put out those nations before you by little and little: you may not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase on you.
DEU.7.PLAIN: The Lord your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.

DEU.7.BSB: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
DEU.7.KJV: But the LORD your God shall deliver them to you, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
DEU.7.PLAIN: But the Lord your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.

DEU.7.BSB: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.
DEU.7.KJV: And he shall deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed them.
DEU.7.PLAIN: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.

DEU.7.BSB: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
DEU.7.KJV: The graven images of their gods shall you burn with fire: you shall not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it to you, lest you be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD your God.
DEU.7.PLAIN: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the Lord your God.

DEU.7.BSB: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.
DEU.7.KJV: Neither shall you bring an abomination into your house, lest you be a cursed thing like it: but you shall utterly detest it, and you shall utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
DEU.7.PLAIN: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.

DEU.8.BSB: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
DEU.8.KJV: All the commandments which I command you this day shall you observe to do, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers.
DEU.8.PLAIN: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the Lord swore to give your fathers.

DEU.8.BSB: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.
DEU.8.KJV: And you shall remember all the way which the LORD your God led you these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you, and to prove you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments, or no.
DEU.8.PLAIN: Remember that these forty years the Lord your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.

DEU.8.BSB: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
DEU.8.KJV: And he humbled you, and suffered you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you knew not, neither did your fathers know; that he might make you know that man does not live by bread only, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of the LORD does man live.
DEU.8.PLAIN: He humbled you and let you hunger, then fed you with manna, to teach you that people do not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord.

DEU.8.BSB: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.
DEU.8.KJV: Your raiment waxed not old on you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
DEU.8.PLAIN: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

DEU.8.BSB: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
DEU.8.KJV: You shall also consider in your heart, that, as a man chastens his son, so the LORD your God chastens you.
DEU.8.PLAIN: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the Lord your God disciplines you.

DEU.8.BSB: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
DEU.8.KJV: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
DEU.8.PLAIN: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.

DEU.8.BSB: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;
DEU.8.KJV: For the LORD your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
DEU.8.PLAIN: For the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;

DEU.8.BSB: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;
DEU.8.KJV: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
DEU.8.PLAIN: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;

DEU.8.BSB: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
DEU.8.KJV: A land wherein you shall eat bread without scarceness, you shall not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills you may dig brass.
DEU.8.PLAIN: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.

DEU.8.BSB: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
DEU.8.KJV: When you have eaten and are full, then you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.
DEU.8.PLAIN: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the Lord your God for the good land that He has given you.

DEU.8.BSB: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
DEU.8.KJV: Beware that you forget not the LORD your God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command you this day:
DEU.8.PLAIN: Be careful not to forget the Lord your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.

DEU.8.BSB: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell,
DEU.8.KJV: Lest when you have eaten and are full, and have built goodly houses, and dwelled therein;
DEU.8.PLAIN: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell,

DEU.8.BSB: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied,
DEU.8.KJV: And when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold is multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;
DEU.8.PLAIN: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied,

DEU.8.BSB: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
DEU.8.KJV: Then your heart be lifted up, and you forget the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
DEU.8.PLAIN: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the Lord your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

DEU.8.BSB: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
DEU.8.KJV: Who led you through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought you forth water out of the rock of flint;
DEU.8.PLAIN: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.

DEU.8.BSB: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
DEU.8.KJV: Who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers knew not, that he might humble you, and that he might prove you, to do you good at your latter end;
DEU.8.PLAIN: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.

DEU.8.BSB: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
DEU.8.KJV: And you say in your heart, My power and the might of my hand has gotten me this wealth.
DEU.8.PLAIN: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”

DEU.8.BSB: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
DEU.8.KJV: But you shall remember the LORD your God: for it is he that gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers, as it is this day.
DEU.8.PLAIN: But remember that it is the Lord your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.

DEU.8.BSB: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
DEU.8.KJV: And it shall be, if you do at all forget the LORD your God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that you shall surely perish.
DEU.8.PLAIN: If you ever forget the Lord your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.

DEU.8.BSB: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
DEU.8.KJV: As the nations which the LORD destroys before your face, so shall you perish; because you would not be obedient to the voice of the LORD your God.
DEU.8.PLAIN: Like the nations that the Lord has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the Lord your God.

DEU.9.BSB: Hear, O Israel: Today you are about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities fortified to the heavens.
DEU.9.KJV: Hear, O Israel: You are to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
DEU.9.PLAIN: Hear, O Israel: Today you are about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities fortified to the heavens.

DEU.9.BSB: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim. You know about them, and you have heard it said, “Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?”
DEU.9.KJV: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
DEU.9.PLAIN: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim. You know about them, and you have heard it said, “Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?”

DEU.9.BSB: But understand that today the LORD your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as the LORD has promised you.
DEU.9.KJV: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD your God is he which goes over before you; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before your face: so shall you drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD has said to you.
DEU.9.PLAIN: But understand that today the Lord your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as the Lord has promised you.

DEU.9.BSB: When the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.
DEU.9.KJV: Speak not you in your heart, after that the LORD your God has cast them out from before you, saying, For my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD does drive them out from before you.
DEU.9.PLAIN: When the Lord your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, the Lord is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.

DEU.9.BSB: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
DEU.9.KJV: Not for your righteousness, or for the uprightness of your heart, do you go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may perform the word which the LORD swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
DEU.9.PLAIN: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that the Lord your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

DEU.9.BSB: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.
DEU.9.KJV: Understand therefore, that the LORD your God gives you not this good land to possess it for your righteousness; for you are a stiff necked people. ¶
DEU.9.PLAIN: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the Lord your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

DEU.9.BSB: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against the LORD.
DEU.9.KJV: Remember, and forget not, how you provoked the LORD your God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that you did depart out of the land of Egypt, until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against the LORD.
DEU.9.PLAIN: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked the Lord your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against the Lord.

DEU.9.BSB: At Horeb you provoked the LORD, and He was angry enough to destroy you.
DEU.9.KJV: Also in Horeb you provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
DEU.9.PLAIN: At Horeb you provoked the Lord, and He was angry enough to destroy you.

DEU.9.BSB: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.
DEU.9.KJV: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I stayed in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
DEU.9.PLAIN: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the Lord made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.

DEU.9.BSB: Then the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
DEU.9.KJV: And the LORD delivered to me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spoke with you in the mount out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.
DEU.9.PLAIN: Then the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the Lord spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.

DEU.9.BSB: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
DEU.9.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
DEU.9.PLAIN: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

DEU.9.BSB: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”
DEU.9.KJV: And the LORD said to me, Arise, get you down quickly from hence; for your people which you have brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
DEU.9.PLAIN: And the Lord said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”

DEU.9.BSB: The LORD also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
DEU.9.KJV: Furthermore the LORD spoke to me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiff necked people:
DEU.9.PLAIN: The Lord also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

DEU.9.BSB: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”
DEU.9.KJV: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.
DEU.9.PLAIN: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”

DEU.9.BSB: So I went back down the mountain while it was blazing with fire, with the two tablets of the covenant in my hands.
DEU.9.KJV: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
DEU.9.PLAIN: So I went back down the mountain while it was blazing with fire, with the two tablets of the covenant in my hands.

DEU.9.BSB: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.
DEU.9.KJV: And I looked, and, behold, you had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: you had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
DEU.9.PLAIN: And I saw how you had sinned against the Lord your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the Lord had commanded you.

DEU.9.BSB: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, shattering them before your eyes.
DEU.9.KJV: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.
DEU.9.PLAIN: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, shattering them before your eyes.

DEU.9.BSB: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger.
DEU.9.KJV: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which you sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
DEU.9.PLAIN: Then I fell down before the Lord for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the Lord and provoking Him to anger.

DEU.9.BSB: For I was afraid of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you, enough to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me this time as well.

DEU.16.KJV: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which he has given you. ¶
DEU.16.PLAIN: Everyone must appear with a gift as he is able, according to the blessing the Lord your God has given you.

DEU.16.BSB: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the LORD your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.
DEU.16.KJV: Judges and officers shall you make you in all your gates, which the LORD your God gives you, throughout your tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
DEU.16.PLAIN: You are to appoint judges and officials for your tribes in every town that the Lord your God is giving you. They are to judge the people with righteous judgment.

DEU.16.BSB: Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
DEU.16.KJV: You shall not wrest judgment; you shall not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift does blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
DEU.16.PLAIN: Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

DEU.16.BSB: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
DEU.16.KJV: That which is altogether just shall you follow, that you may live, and inherit the land which the LORD your God gives you. ¶
DEU.16.PLAIN: Pursue justice, and justice alone, so that you may live, and you may possess the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

DEU.16.BSB: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,
DEU.16.KJV: You shall not plant you a grove of any trees near to the altar of the LORD your God, which you shall make you.
DEU.16.PLAIN: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the Lord your God,

DEU.16.BSB: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the LORD your God hates.
DEU.16.KJV: Neither shall you set you up any image; which the LORD your God hates.
DEU.16.PLAIN: and do not set up for yourselves a sacred pillar, which the Lord your God hates.

DEU.17.BSB: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to the LORD your God.
DEU.17.KJV: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any bad reputation: for that is an abomination to the LORD your God. ¶
DEU.17.PLAIN: You shall not sacrifice to the Lord your God an ox or a sheep with any defect or serious flaw, for that is detestable to the Lord your God.

DEU.17.BSB: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that the LORD your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God by transgressing His covenant
DEU.17.KJV: If there be found among you, within any of your gates which the LORD your God gives you, man or woman, that has worked wickedness in the sight of the LORD your God, in transgressing his covenant,
DEU.17.PLAIN: If a man or woman among you in one of the towns that the Lord your God gives you is found doing evil in the sight of the Lord your God by transgressing His covenant

DEU.17.BSB: and going to worship other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven—which I have forbidden—
DEU.17.KJV: And has gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
DEU.17.PLAIN: and going to worship other gods, bowing down to them or to the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven—which I have forbidden—

DEU.17.BSB: and if it is reported and you hear about it, you must investigate it thoroughly. If the report is true and such an abomination has happened in Israel,
DEU.17.KJV: And it be told you, and you have heard of it, and inquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is worked in Israel:
DEU.17.PLAIN: and if it is reported and you hear about it, you must investigate it thoroughly. If the report is true and such an abomination has happened in Israel,

DEU.17.BSB: you must bring out to your gates the man or woman who has done this evil thing, and you must stone that person to death.
DEU.17.KJV: Then shall you bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, to your gates, even that man or that woman, and shall stone them with stones, till they die.
DEU.17.PLAIN: you must bring out to your gates the man or woman who has done this evil thing, and you must stone that person to death.

DEU.17.BSB: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but he shall not be executed on the testimony of a lone witness.
DEU.17.KJV: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
DEU.17.PLAIN: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but he shall not be executed on the testimony of a lone witness.

DEU.17.BSB: The hands of the witnesses shall be the first in putting him to death, and after that, the hands of all the people. So you must purge the evil from among you.
DEU.17.KJV: The hands of the witnesses shall be first on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So you shall put the evil away from among you. ¶
DEU.17.PLAIN: The hands of the witnesses shall be the first in putting him to death, and after that, the hands of all the people. So you must purge the evil from among you.

DEU.17.BSB: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place the LORD your God will choose.
DEU.17.KJV: If there arise a matter too hard for you in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within your gates: then shall you arise, and get you up into the place which the LORD your God shall choose;
DEU.17.PLAIN: If a case is too difficult for you to judge, whether the controversy within your gates is regarding bloodshed, lawsuits, or assaults, you must go up to the place the Lord your God will choose.

DEU.17.BSB: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time. Inquire of them, and they will give you a verdict in the case.
DEU.17.KJV: And you shall come to the priests the Levites, and to the judge that shall be in those days, and inquire; and they shall show you the sentence of judgment:
DEU.17.PLAIN: You are to go to the Levitical priests and to the judge who presides at that time. Inquire of them, and they will give you a verdict in the case.

DEU.17.BSB: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,
DEU.17.KJV: And you shall do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall show you; and you shall observe to do according to all that they inform you:
DEU.17.PLAIN: You must abide by the verdict they give you at the place the Lord will choose. Be careful to do everything they instruct you,

DEU.17.BSB: according to the terms of law they give and the verdict they proclaim. Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from the decision they declare to you.
DEU.17.KJV: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell you, you shall do: you shall not decline from the sentence which they shall show you, to the right hand, nor to the left.
DEU.17.PLAIN: according to the terms of law they give and the verdict they proclaim. Do not turn aside to the right or to the left from the decision they declare to you.

DEU.17.BSB: But the man who acts presumptuously, refusing to listen either to the priest who stands there to serve the LORD your God, or to the judge, must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.
DEU.17.KJV: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not listen to the priest that stands to minister there before the LORD your God, or to the judge, even that man shall die: and you shall put away the evil from Israel.
DEU.17.PLAIN: But the man who acts presumptuously, refusing to listen either to the priest who stands there to serve the Lord your God, or to the judge, must be put to death. You must purge the evil from Israel.

DEU.17.BSB: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will no longer behave arrogantly.
DEU.17.KJV: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously. ¶
DEU.17.PLAIN: Then all the people will hear and be afraid, and will no longer behave arrogantly.

DEU.17.BSB: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”
DEU.17.KJV: When you are come to the land which the LORD your God gives you, and shall possess it, and shall dwell therein, and shall say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;
DEU.17.PLAIN: When you enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you and have taken possession of it and settled in it, and you say, “Let us set a king over us like all the nations around us,”

DEU.17.BSB: you are to appoint over yourselves the king whom the LORD your God shall choose. Appoint a king from among your brothers; you are not to set over yourselves a foreigner who is not one of your brothers.
DEU.17.KJV: You shall in any wise set him king over you, whom the LORD your God shall choose: one from among your brothers shall you set king over you: you may not set a stranger over you, which is not your brother.
DEU.17.PLAIN: you are to appoint over yourselves the king whom the Lord your God shall choose. Appoint a king from among your brothers; you are not to set over yourselves a foreigner who is not one of your brothers.

DEU.17.BSB: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for the LORD has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’
DEU.17.KJV: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: for as much as the LORD has said to you, You shall from now on return no more that way.
DEU.17.PLAIN: But the king must not acquire many horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to acquire more horses, for the Lord has said, ‘You are never to go back that way again.’

DEU.17.BSB: He must not take many wives for himself, lest his heart go astray. He must not accumulate for himself large amounts of silver and gold.
DEU.17.KJV: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
DEU.17.PLAIN: He must not take many wives for himself, lest his heart go astray. He must not accumulate for himself large amounts of silver and gold.

DEU.17.BSB: When he is seated on his royal throne, he must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.
DEU.17.KJV: And it shall be, when he sits on the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:
DEU.17.PLAIN: When he is seated on his royal throne, he must write for himself a copy of this instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Levitical priests.

DEU.17.BSB: It is to remain with him, and he is to read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the LORD his God by carefully observing all the words of this instruction and these statutes.
DEU.17.KJV: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:
DEU.17.PLAIN: It is to remain with him, and he is to read from it all the days of his life, so that he may learn to fear the Lord his God by carefully observing all the words of this instruction and these statutes.

DEU.17.BSB: Then his heart will not be exalted above his countrymen, and he will not turn aside from the commandment, to the right or to the left, in order that he and his sons may reign many years over his kingdom in Israel.
DEU.17.KJV: That his heart be not lifted up above his brothers, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the middle of Israel.
DEU.17.PLAIN: Then his heart will not be exalted above his countrymen, and he will not turn aside from the commandment, to the right or to the left, in order that he and his sons may reign many years over his kingdom in Israel.

DEU.18.BSB: The Levitical priests—indeed the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They are to eat the offerings made by fire to the LORD; that is their inheritance.
DEU.18.KJV: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.
DEU.18.PLAIN: The Levitical priests—indeed the whole tribe of Levi—shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel. They are to eat the offerings made by fire to the Lord; that is their inheritance.

DEU.18.BSB: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers, the LORD is their inheritance, as He promised them.
DEU.18.KJV: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brothers: the LORD is their inheritance, as he has said to them. ¶
DEU.18.PLAIN: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers, the Lord is their inheritance, as He promised them.

DEU.18.BSB: This shall be the priests’ share from the people who offer a sacrifice, whether a bull or a sheep: the priests are to be given the shoulder, the jowls, and the stomach.
DEU.18.KJV: And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give to the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
DEU.18.PLAIN: This shall be the priests’ share from the people who offer a sacrifice, whether a bull or a sheep: the priests are to be given the shoulder, the jowls, and the stomach.

DEU.18.BSB: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the first wool sheared from your flock.
DEU.18.KJV: The first fruit also of your corn, of your wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep, shall you give him.
DEU.18.PLAIN: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine, and oil, and the first wool sheared from your flock.

DEU.18.BSB: For the LORD your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His name for all time.
DEU.18.KJV: For the LORD your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever. ¶
DEU.18.PLAIN: For the Lord your God has chosen Levi and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in His name for all time.

DEU.18.BSB: Now if a Levite moves from any town of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose,
DEU.18.KJV: And if a Levite come from any of your gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind to the place which the LORD shall choose;
DEU.18.PLAIN: Now if a Levite moves from any town of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness to the place the Lord will choose,

DEU.18.BSB: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD.
DEU.18.KJV: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brothers the Levites do, which stand there before the LORD.
DEU.18.PLAIN: then he shall serve in the name of the Lord his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the Lord.

DEU.18.BSB: They shall eat equal portions, even though he has received money from the sale of his father’s estate.
DEU.18.KJV: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which comes of the sale of his patrimony. ¶
DEU.18.PLAIN: They shall eat equal portions, even though he has received money from the sale of his father’s estate.

DEU.18.BSB: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, do not imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.
DEU.18.KJV: When you are come into the land which the LORD your God gives you, you shall not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
DEU.18.PLAIN: When you enter the land that the Lord your God is giving you, do not imitate the detestable ways of the nations there.

DEU.18.BSB: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,
DEU.18.KJV: There shall not be found among you any one that makes his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that uses divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch.
DEU.18.PLAIN: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, practices divination or conjury, interprets omens, practices sorcery,

DEU.18.BSB: casts spells, consults a medium or spiritist, or inquires of the dead.
DEU.18.KJV: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
DEU.18.PLAIN: casts spells, consults a medium or spiritist, or inquires of the dead.

DEU.18.BSB: For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD. And because of these detestable things, the LORD your God is driving out the nations before you.
DEU.18.KJV: For all that do these things are an abomination to the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD your God does drive them out from before you.
DEU.18.PLAIN: For whoever does these things is detestable to the Lord. And because of these detestable things, the Lord your God is driving out the nations before you.

DEU.18.BSB: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.
DEU.18.KJV: You shall be perfect with the LORD your God.
DEU.18.PLAIN: You must be blameless before the Lord your God.

DEU.18.BSB: Though these nations, which you will dispossess, listen to conjurers and diviners, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.
DEU.18.KJV: For these nations, which you shall possess, listened to observers of times, and to diviners: but as for you, the LORD your God has not suffered you so to do. ¶
DEU.18.PLAIN: Though these nations, which you will dispossess, listen to conjurers and diviners, the Lord your God has not permitted you to do so.

DEU.18.BSB: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.
DEU.18.KJV: The LORD your God will raise up to you a Prophet from the middle of you, of your brothers, like to me; to him you shall listen;
DEU.18.PLAIN: The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.

DEU.18.BSB: This is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, “Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God or see this great fire anymore, so that we will not die!”
DEU.18.KJV: According to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
DEU.18.PLAIN: This is what you asked of the Lord your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly, when you said, “Let us not hear the voice of the Lord our God or see this great fire anymore, so that we will not die!”

DEU.18.BSB: Then the LORD said to me, “They have spoken well.
DEU.18.KJV: And the LORD said to me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.
DEU.18.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to me, “They have spoken well.

DEU.18.BSB: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.
DEU.18.KJV: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brothers, like to you, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak to them all that I shall command him.
DEU.18.PLAIN: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers. I will put My words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

DEU.18.BSB: And I will hold accountable anyone who does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name.
DEU.18.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that whoever will not listen to my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
DEU.18.PLAIN: And I will hold accountable anyone who does not listen to My words that the prophet speaks in My name.

DEU.18.BSB: But if any prophet dares to speak a message in My name that I have not commanded him to speak, or to speak in the name of other gods, that prophet must be put to death.”
