JOS.10.KJV: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings to me out of the cave.
JOS.10.PLAIN: Then Joshua said, “Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me.”

JOS.10.BSB: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
JOS.10.KJV: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings to him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
JOS.10.PLAIN: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.

JOS.10.BSB: When they had brought the kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had accompanied him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So the commanders came forward and put their feet on their necks.
JOS.10.KJV: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings to Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet on the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet on the necks of them.
JOS.10.PLAIN: When they had brought the kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had accompanied him, “Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings.” So the commanders came forward and put their feet on their necks.

JOS.10.BSB: “Do not be afraid or discouraged,” Joshua said. “Be strong and courageous, for the LORD will do this to all the enemies you fight.”
JOS.10.KJV: And Joshua said to them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom you fight.
JOS.10.PLAIN: “Do not be afraid or discouraged,” Joshua said. “Be strong and courageous, for the Lord will do this to all the enemies you fight.”

JOS.10.BSB: After this, Joshua struck down and killed the kings, and he hung their bodies on five trees and left them there until evening.
JOS.10.KJV: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging on the trees until the evening.
JOS.10.PLAIN: After this, Joshua struck down and killed the kings, and he hung their bodies on five trees and left them there until evening.

JOS.10.BSB: At sunset Joshua ordered that they be taken down from the trees and thrown into the cave in which they had hidden. Then large stones were placed against the mouth of the cave, and the stones are there to this day.
JOS.10.KJV: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave’s mouth, which remain until this very day. ¶
JOS.10.PLAIN: At sunset Joshua ordered that they be taken down from the trees and thrown into the cave in which they had hidden. Then large stones were placed against the mouth of the cave, and the stones are there to this day.

JOS.10.BSB: On that day Joshua captured Makkedah and put it to the sword, along with its king. He devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. So he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
JOS.10.KJV: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did to the king of Jericho.
JOS.10.PLAIN: On that day Joshua captured Makkedah and put it to the sword, along with its king. He devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. So he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

JOS.10.BSB: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and fought against Libnah.
JOS.10.KJV: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
JOS.10.PLAIN: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and fought against Libnah.

JOS.10.BSB: And the LORD also delivered that city and its king into the hand of Israel, and Joshua put all the people to the sword, leaving no survivors. And he did to the king of Libnah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
JOS.10.KJV: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did to the king thereof as he did to the king of Jericho. ¶
JOS.10.PLAIN: And the Lord also delivered that city and its king into the hand of Israel, and Joshua put all the people to the sword, leaving no survivors. And he did to the king of Libnah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

JOS.10.BSB: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
JOS.10.KJV: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
JOS.10.PLAIN: And Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish. They laid siege to it and fought against it.

JOS.10.BSB: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, and Joshua captured it on the second day. He put all the people to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
JOS.10.KJV: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah. ¶
JOS.10.PLAIN: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, and Joshua captured it on the second day. He put all the people to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

JOS.10.BSB: At that time Horam king of Gezer went to help Lachish, but Joshua struck him down along with his people, leaving no survivors.
JOS.10.KJV: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining. ¶
JOS.10.PLAIN: At that time Horam king of Gezer went to help Lachish, but Joshua struck him down along with his people, leaving no survivors.

JOS.10.BSB: So Joshua moved on from Lachish to Eglon, and all Israel with him. They laid siege to it and fought against it.
JOS.10.KJV: And from Lachish Joshua passed to Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
JOS.10.PLAIN: So Joshua moved on from Lachish to Eglon, and all Israel with him. They laid siege to it and fought against it.

JOS.10.BSB: That day they captured Eglon and put it to the sword, and Joshua devoted to destruction everyone in the city, just as he had done to Lachish.
JOS.10.KJV: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
JOS.10.PLAIN: That day they captured Eglon and put it to the sword, and Joshua devoted to destruction everyone in the city, just as he had done to Lachish.

JOS.10.BSB: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and fought against it.
JOS.10.KJV: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it:
JOS.10.PLAIN: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and fought against it.

JOS.10.BSB: They captured it and put to the sword its king, all its villages, and all the people. Joshua left no survivors, just as he had done at Eglon; he devoted to destruction Hebron and everyone in it.
JOS.10.KJV: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein. ¶
JOS.10.PLAIN: They captured it and put to the sword its king, all its villages, and all the people. Joshua left no survivors, just as he had done at Eglon; he devoted to destruction Hebron and everyone in it.

JOS.10.BSB: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him turned toward Debir and fought against it.
JOS.10.KJV: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
JOS.10.PLAIN: Finally Joshua and all Israel with him turned toward Debir and fought against it.

JOS.10.BSB: And they captured Debir, its king, and all its villages. They put them to the sword and devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. Joshua did to Debir and its king as he had done to Hebron and as he had done to Libnah and its king.
JOS.10.KJV: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king. ¶
JOS.10.PLAIN: And they captured Debir, its king, and all its villages. They put them to the sword and devoted to destruction everyone in the city, leaving no survivors. Joshua did to Debir and its king as he had done to Hebron and as he had done to Libnah and its king.

JOS.10.BSB: So Joshua conquered the whole region—the hill country, the Negev, the foothills, and the slopes, together with all their kings—leaving no survivors. He devoted to destruction everything that breathed, just as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded.
JOS.10.KJV: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.
JOS.10.PLAIN: So Joshua conquered the whole region—the hill country, the Negev, the foothills, and the slopes, together with all their kings—leaving no survivors. He devoted to destruction everything that breathed, just as the Lord, the God of Israel, had commanded.

JOS.10.BSB: Joshua conquered the area from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and the whole region of Goshen as far as Gibeon.
JOS.10.KJV: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even to Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even to Gibeon.
JOS.10.PLAIN: Joshua conquered the area from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and the whole region of Goshen as far as Gibeon.

JOS.10.BSB: And because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel, Joshua captured all these kings and their land in one campaign.
JOS.10.KJV: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.
JOS.10.PLAIN: And because the Lord, the God of Israel, fought for Israel, Joshua captured all these kings and their land in one campaign.

JOS.10.BSB: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
JOS.10.KJV: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp to Gilgal.
JOS.10.PLAIN: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

JOS.11.BSB: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon; to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph;
JOS.11.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
JOS.11.PLAIN: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon; to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph;

JOS.11.BSB: to the kings of the north in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Chinnereth, in the foothills, and in Naphoth-dor to the west;
JOS.11.KJV: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
JOS.11.PLAIN: to the kings of the north in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Chinnereth, in the foothills, and in Naphoth-dor to the west;

JOS.11.BSB: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
JOS.11.KJV: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
JOS.11.PLAIN: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

JOS.11.BSB: So these kings came out with all their armies, a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore, along with a great number of horses and chariots.
JOS.11.KJV: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is on the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
JOS.11.PLAIN: So these kings came out with all their armies, a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore, along with a great number of horses and chariots.

JOS.11.BSB: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
JOS.11.KJV: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel. ¶
JOS.11.PLAIN: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

JOS.11.BSB: Then the LORD said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn up their chariots.”
JOS.11.KJV: And the LORD said to Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: you shall hamstring their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
JOS.11.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Joshua, “Do not be afraid of them, for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn up their chariots.”

JOS.11.BSB: So by the waters of Merom, Joshua and his whole army came upon them suddenly and attacked them,
JOS.11.KJV: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell on them.
JOS.11.PLAIN: So by the waters of Merom, Joshua and his whole army came upon them suddenly and attacked them,

JOS.11.BSB: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. They struck them down, leaving no survivors.
JOS.11.KJV: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them to great Zidon, and to Misrephothmaim, and to the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
JOS.11.PLAIN: and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. They struck them down, leaving no survivors.

JOS.11.BSB: Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.
JOS.11.KJV: And Joshua did to them as the LORD bade him: he hamstrung their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire. ¶
JOS.11.PLAIN: Joshua treated them as the Lord had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned up their chariots.

JOS.11.BSB: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword, because Hazor was formerly the head of all these kingdoms.
JOS.11.KJV: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
JOS.11.PLAIN: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword, because Hazor was formerly the head of all these kingdoms.

JOS.11.BSB: The Israelites put everyone in Hazor to the sword, devoting them to destruction. Nothing that breathed remained, and Joshua burned down Hazor itself.
JOS.11.KJV: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
JOS.11.PLAIN: The Israelites put everyone in Hazor to the sword, devoting them to destruction. Nothing that breathed remained, and Joshua burned down Hazor itself.

JOS.11.BSB: Joshua captured all these kings and their cities and put them to the sword. He devoted them to destruction, as Moses the LORD’s servant had commanded.
JOS.11.KJV: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
JOS.11.PLAIN: Joshua captured all these kings and their cities and put them to the sword. He devoted them to destruction, as Moses the Lord’s servant had commanded.

JOS.11.BSB: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
JOS.11.KJV: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
JOS.11.PLAIN: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds, except Hazor, which Joshua burned.

JOS.11.BSB: The Israelites took for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but they put all the people to the sword until they had completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone who breathed.
JOS.11.KJV: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey to themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe. ¶
JOS.11.PLAIN: The Israelites took for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but they put all the people to the sword until they had completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone who breathed.

JOS.11.BSB: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. That is what Joshua did, leaving nothing undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
JOS.11.KJV: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
JOS.11.PLAIN: As the Lord had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. That is what Joshua did, leaving nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses.

JOS.11.BSB: So Joshua took this entire region: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel and their foothills,
JOS.11.KJV: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
JOS.11.PLAIN: So Joshua took this entire region: the hill country, all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah, and the mountains of Israel and their foothills,

JOS.11.BSB: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.
JOS.11.KJV: Even from the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
JOS.11.PLAIN: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.

JOS.11.BSB: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long period of time.
JOS.11.KJV: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
JOS.11.PLAIN: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long period of time.

JOS.11.BSB: No city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon; all others were taken in battle.
JOS.11.KJV: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
JOS.11.PLAIN: No city made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites living in Gibeon; all others were taken in battle.

JOS.11.BSB: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts to engage Israel in battle, so that they would be set apart for destruction and would receive no mercy, being annihilated as the LORD had commanded Moses.
JOS.11.KJV: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favor, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses. ¶
JOS.11.PLAIN: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts to engage Israel in battle, so that they would be set apart for destruction and would receive no mercy, being annihilated as the Lord had commanded Moses.

JOS.11.BSB: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and of Israel. Joshua devoted them to destruction, along with their cities.
JOS.11.KJV: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
JOS.11.PLAIN: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country of Hebron, Debir, and Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and of Israel. Joshua devoted them to destruction, along with their cities.

JOS.11.BSB: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did any survive.
JOS.11.KJV: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
JOS.11.PLAIN: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod did any survive.

JOS.11.BSB: So Joshua took the entire land, in keeping with all that the LORD had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
JOS.11.KJV: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
JOS.11.PLAIN: So Joshua took the entire land, in keeping with all that the Lord had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.

JOS.12.BSB: Now these are the kings of the land whom the Israelites struck down and whose lands they took beyond the Jordan to the east, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon, including all the Arabah eastward:
JOS.12.KJV: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon to mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
JOS.12.PLAIN: Now these are the kings of the land whom the Israelites struck down and whose lands they took beyond the Jordan to the east, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon, including all the Arabah eastward:

JOS.12.BSB: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along the middle of the valley, up to the Jabbok River (the border of the Ammonites), that is, half of Gilead,
JOS.12.KJV: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelled in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
JOS.12.PLAIN: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along the middle of the valley, up to the Jabbok River (the border of the Ammonites), that is, half of Gilead,

JOS.12.BSB: as well as the Arabah east of the Sea of Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), eastward through Beth-jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
JOS.12.KJV: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and to the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah: ¶
JOS.12.PLAIN: as well as the Arabah east of the Sea of Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), eastward through Beth-jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

JOS.12.BSB: And Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
JOS.12.KJV: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelled at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
JOS.12.PLAIN: And Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

JOS.12.BSB: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
JOS.12.KJV: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
JOS.12.PLAIN: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

JOS.12.BSB: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
JOS.12.KJV: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh. ¶
JOS.12.PLAIN: Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

JOS.12.BSB: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance
JOS.12.KJV: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even to the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir; which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
JOS.12.PLAIN: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance

JOS.12.BSB: the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):
JOS.12.KJV: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: ¶
JOS.12.PLAIN: the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):

JOS.12.BSB: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;
JOS.12.KJV: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
JOS.12.PLAIN: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;

JOS.12.BSB: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
JOS.12.KJV: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
JOS.12.PLAIN: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

JOS.12.BSB: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
JOS.12.KJV: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

JOS.23.PLAIN: “and you have seen everything that the Lord your God has done to all these nations for your sake, because it was the Lord your God who fought for you.

JOS.23.BSB: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.
JOS.23.KJV: Behold, I have divided to you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea westward.
JOS.23.PLAIN: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.

JOS.23.BSB: The LORD your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
JOS.23.KJV: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and you shall possess their land, as the LORD your God has promised to you.
JOS.23.PLAIN: The Lord your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the Lord your God promised you.

JOS.23.BSB: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.
JOS.23.KJV: Be you therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
JOS.23.PLAIN: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.

JOS.23.BSB: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.
JOS.23.KJV: That you come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves to them:
JOS.23.PLAIN: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.

JOS.23.BSB: Instead, you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
JOS.23.KJV: But hold to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
JOS.23.PLAIN: Instead, you shall hold fast to the Lord your God, as you have done to this day.

JOS.23.BSB: The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one can stand against you.
JOS.23.KJV: For the LORD has driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man has been able to stand before you to this day.
JOS.23.PLAIN: The Lord has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one can stand against you.

JOS.23.BSB: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.
JOS.23.KJV: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fights for you, as he has promised you.
JOS.23.PLAIN: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the Lord your God fights for you, just as He promised.

JOS.23.BSB: Therefore watch yourselves carefully, that you love the LORD your God.
JOS.23.KJV: Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love the LORD your God.
JOS.23.PLAIN: Therefore watch yourselves carefully, that you love the Lord your God.

JOS.23.BSB: For if you turn away and cling to the rest of these nations that remain among you, and if you intermarry and associate with them,
JOS.23.KJV: Else if you do in any wise go back, and join to the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in to them, and they to you:
JOS.23.PLAIN: For if you turn away and cling to the rest of these nations that remain among you, and if you intermarry and associate with them,

JOS.23.BSB: know for sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become for you a snare and a trap, a scourge in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.
JOS.23.KJV: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps to you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
JOS.23.PLAIN: know for sure that the Lord your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become for you a snare and a trap, a scourge in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the Lord your God has given you.

JOS.23.BSB: Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and soul that not one of the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed.
JOS.23.KJV: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and you know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing has failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spoke concerning you; all are come to pass to you, and not one thing has failed thereof.
JOS.23.PLAIN: Now look closely — today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and soul that not one of the good promises the Lord your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed.

JOS.23.BSB: But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.
JOS.23.KJV: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come on you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring on you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God has given you.
JOS.23.PLAIN: But just as every good thing the Lord your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the Lord will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.

JOS.23.BSB: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.”
JOS.23.KJV: When you have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and you shall perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.
JOS.23.PLAIN: If you transgress the covenant of the Lord your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the Lord will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.”

JOS.24.BSB: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.
JOS.24.KJV: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.

JOS.24.BSB: And Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.
JOS.24.KJV: And Joshua said to all the people, Thus says the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelled on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
JOS.24.PLAIN: And Joshua said to all the people, “This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, says: ‘Long ago your fathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods.

JOS.24.BSB: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,
JOS.24.KJV: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
JOS.24.PLAIN: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan, and I multiplied his descendants. I gave him Isaac,

JOS.24.BSB: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.
JOS.24.KJV: And I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
JOS.24.PLAIN: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

JOS.24.BSB: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.
JOS.24.KJV: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.

JOS.24.BSB: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.
JOS.24.KJV: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen to the Red sea.
JOS.24.PLAIN: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea, the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

JOS.24.BSB: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.
JOS.24.KJV: And when they cried to the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea on them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and you dwelled in the wilderness a long season.
JOS.24.PLAIN: So your fathers cried out to the Lord, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.

JOS.24.BSB: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.
JOS.24.KJV: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelled on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that you might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.

JOS.24.BSB: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,
JOS.24.KJV: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
JOS.24.PLAIN: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,

JOS.24.BSB: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.
JOS.24.KJV: But I would not listen to Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
JOS.24.PLAIN: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.

JOS.24.BSB: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.
JOS.24.KJV: And you went over Jordan, and came to Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
JOS.24.PLAIN: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.

JOS.24.BSB: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.
JOS.24.KJV: And I sent the hornet before you, which drove them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with your sword, nor with your bow.
JOS.24.PLAIN: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.

JOS.24.BSB: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
JOS.24.KJV: And I have given you a land for which you did not labor, and cities which you built not, and you dwell in them; of the vineyards and olive groves which you planted not do you eat. ¶
JOS.24.PLAIN: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’

JOS.24.BSB: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.
JOS.24.KJV: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve you the LORD.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Now, therefore, fear the Lord and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.

JOS.24.BSB: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
JOS.24.KJV: And if it seem evil to you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
JOS.24.PLAIN: But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

JOS.24.BSB: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
JOS.24.KJV: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
JOS.24.PLAIN: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the Lord to serve other gods!

JOS.24.BSB: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
JOS.24.KJV: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
JOS.24.PLAIN: For the Lord our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

JOS.24.BSB: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!”
JOS.24.KJV: And the LORD drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelled in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.
JOS.24.PLAIN: And the Lord drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the Lord, because He is our God!”

JOS.24.BSB: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.
JOS.24.KJV: And Joshua said to the people, You cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
JOS.24.PLAIN: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the Lord, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.

JOS.24.BSB: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you, even after He has been good to you.”
JOS.24.KJV: If you forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he has done you good.
JOS.24.PLAIN: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you, even after He has been good to you.”

JOS.24.BSB: “No!” replied the people. “We will serve the LORD!”
JOS.24.KJV: And the people said to Joshua, No; but we will serve the LORD.
JOS.24.PLAIN: “No!” replied the people. “We will serve the Lord!”

JOS.24.BSB: Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.” “We are witnesses!” they said.
JOS.24.KJV: And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord.” “We are witnesses!” they said.

JOS.24.BSB: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
JOS.24.KJV: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the LORD God of Israel.
JOS.24.PLAIN: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the Lord, the God of Israel.”

JOS.24.BSB: So the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.”
JOS.24.KJV: And the people said to Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
JOS.24.PLAIN: So the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the Lord our God and obey His voice.”

JOS.24.BSB: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance.
JOS.24.KJV: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem. ¶
JOS.24.PLAIN: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance.

JOS.24.BSB: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD.
JOS.24.KJV: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the Lord.

JOS.24.BSB: And Joshua said to all the people, “You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us, and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God.”
JOS.24.KJV: And Joshua said to all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us; for it has heard all the words of the LORD which he spoke to us: it shall be therefore a witness to you, lest you deny your God.
JOS.24.PLAIN: And Joshua said to all the people, “You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the Lord has spoken to us, and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God.”

JOS.24.BSB: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
JOS.24.KJV: So Joshua let the people depart, every man to his inheritance. ¶
JOS.24.PLAIN: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

JOS.24.BSB: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
JOS.24.KJV: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died at the age of 110.

JOS.24.BSB: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
JOS.24.KJV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
JOS.24.PLAIN: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

JOS.24.BSB: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel.
JOS.24.KJV: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel. ¶
JOS.24.PLAIN: Israel had served the Lord throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the Lord had done for Israel.

JOS.24.BSB: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants.
JOS.24.KJV: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
JOS.24.PLAIN: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants.

JOS.24.BSB: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
JOS.24.KJV: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
JOS.24.PLAIN: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.

JDG.1.BSB: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the LORD, “Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?”
JDG.1.KJV: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
JDG.1.PLAIN: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the Lord, “Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?”

JDG.1.BSB: “Judah shall go up,” answered the LORD. “Indeed, I have delivered the land into their hands.”
JDG.1.KJV: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
JDG.1.PLAIN: “Judah shall go up,” answered the Lord. “Indeed, I have delivered the land into their hands.”

JDG.1.BSB: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites. And we likewise will go with you to your territory.” So the Simeonites went with them.
JDG.1.KJV: And Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot. So Simeon went with him.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites. And we likewise will go with you to your territory.” So the Simeonites went with them.

JDG.1.BSB: When Judah attacked, the LORD delivered the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
JDG.1.KJV: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
JDG.1.PLAIN: When Judah attacked, the Lord delivered the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.

JDG.1.BSB: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.
JDG.1.KJV: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
JDG.1.PLAIN: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.

JDG.1.BSB: As Adoni-bezek fled, they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
JDG.1.KJV: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
JDG.1.PLAIN: As Adoni-bezek fled, they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

JDG.1.BSB: Then Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table. As I have done to them, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.
JDG.1.KJV: And Adonibezek said, Three score and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God has requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Then Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table. As I have done to them, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.

JDG.1.BSB: Then the men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
JDG.1.KJV: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire. ¶
JDG.1.PLAIN: Then the men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.

JDG.1.BSB: Afterward, the men of Judah marched down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the foothills.
JDG.1.KJV: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelled in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Afterward, the men of Judah marched down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the foothills.

JDG.1.BSB: Judah also marched against the Canaanites who were living in Hebron (formerly known as Kiriath-arba), and they struck down Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
JDG.1.KJV: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelled in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Judah also marched against the Canaanites who were living in Hebron (formerly known as Kiriath-arba), and they struck down Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

JDG.1.BSB: From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
JDG.1.KJV: And from there he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
JDG.1.PLAIN: From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).

JDG.1.BSB: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
JDG.1.KJV: And Caleb said, He that smites Kirjathsepher, and takes it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
JDG.1.PLAIN: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”

JDG.1.BSB: So Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
JDG.1.KJV: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

JDG.1.KJV: And she said to him, Give me a blessing: for you have given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs. ¶

JDG.1.BSB: Now the descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up with the men of Judah from the City of Palms to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev near Arad. They went to live among the people.
JDG.1.KJV: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lies in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelled among the people.

JDG.1.BSB: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction. So it was called Hormah.
JDG.1.KJV: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction. So it was called Hormah.

JDG.1.BSB: And Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron—each with its territory.
JDG.1.KJV: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
JDG.1.PLAIN: And Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron—each with its territory.

JDG.1.BSB: The LORD was with Judah, and they took possession of the hill country; but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the plains because they had chariots of iron.
JDG.1.KJV: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drove out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

JDG.1.KJV: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled there the three sons of Anak.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Just as Moses had promised, Judah gave Hebron to Caleb, who drove out the descendants of the three sons of Anak.

JDG.1.KJV: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day. ¶
JDG.1.PLAIN: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the Benjamites.

JDG.1.BSB: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
JDG.1.KJV: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
JDG.1.PLAIN: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the Lord was with them.

JDG.1.BSB: They sent spies to Bethel (formerly known as Luz),
JDG.1.KJV: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
JDG.1.PLAIN: They sent spies to Bethel (formerly known as Luz),

JDG.1.BSB: and when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, “Please show us how to get into the city, and we will treat you kindly.”
JDG.1.KJV: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said to him, Show us, we pray you, the entrance into the city, and we will show you mercy.
JDG.1.PLAIN: and when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, “Please show us how to get into the city, and we will treat you kindly.”

JDG.1.BSB: So the man showed them the entrance to the city, and they put the city to the sword but released that man and all his family.
JDG.1.KJV: And when he showed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
JDG.1.PLAIN: So the man showed them the entrance to the city, and they put the city to the sword but released that man and all his family.

JDG.1.BSB: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
JDG.1.KJV: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof to this day. ¶
JDG.1.PLAIN: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.

JDG.1.BSB: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
JDG.1.KJV: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
JDG.1.PLAIN: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.

JDG.1.BSB: Ephraim also failed to drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer; so the Canaanites continued to dwell among them in Gezer.
JDG.1.KJV: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelled in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelled in Gezer among them. ¶
JDG.1.PLAIN: Ephraim also failed to drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer; so the Canaanites continued to dwell among them in Gezer.

JDG.1.BSB: Zebulun failed to drive out the inhabitants of Kitron and Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and served as forced laborers.
JDG.1.KJV: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelled among them, and became tributaries. ¶
JDG.1.PLAIN: Zebulun failed to drive out the inhabitants of Kitron and Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and served as forced laborers.

JDG.1.BSB: Asher failed to drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
JDG.1.KJV: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
JDG.1.PLAIN: Asher failed to drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.

JDG.1.BSB: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.
JDG.1.KJV: But the Asherites dwelled among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out. ¶
JDG.1.PLAIN: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.

JDG.1.BSB: Naphtali failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath. So the Naphtalites also lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath served them as forced laborers.
JDG.1.KJV: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelled among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries to them.
JDG.1.PLAIN: Naphtali failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath. So the Naphtalites also lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath served them as forced laborers.

JDG.1.BSB: The Amorites forced the Danites into the hill country and did not allow them to come down into the plain.
JDG.1.KJV: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
JDG.1.PLAIN: The Amorites forced the Danites into the hill country and did not allow them to come down into the plain.

JDG.1.BSB: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.
JDG.1.KJV: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
JDG.1.PLAIN: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.

JDG.1.BSB: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.
JDG.1.KJV: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
JDG.1.PLAIN: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.

JDG.2.BSB: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I had promised to your fathers, and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you,
JDG.2.KJV: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
JDG.2.PLAIN: Now the angel of the Lord went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I had promised to your fathers, and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you,

JDG.2.KJV: And you shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; you shall throw down their altars: but you have not obeyed my voice: why have you done this?
JDG.2.PLAIN: and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall tear down their altars.’ Yet you have not obeyed My voice. What is this you have done?

JDG.2.BSB: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you; they will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.”
JDG.2.KJV: Why I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare to you.
JDG.2.PLAIN: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you; they will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.”

JDG.2.BSB: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these words to all the Israelites, the people lifted up their voices and wept.
JDG.2.KJV: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
JDG.2.PLAIN: When the angel of the Lord had spoken these words to all the Israelites, the people lifted up their voices and wept.

JDG.2.BSB: So they called that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD.
JDG.2.KJV: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there to the LORD. ¶
JDG.2.PLAIN: So they called that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the Lord.

JDG.2.BSB: After Joshua had dismissed the people, the Israelites went out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.
JDG.2.KJV: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man to his inheritance to possess the land.
JDG.2.PLAIN: After Joshua had dismissed the people, the Israelites went out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.

JDG.2.BSB: And the people served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him, who had seen all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel.
JDG.2.KJV: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
JDG.2.PLAIN: And the people served the Lord throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him, who had seen all the great works that the Lord had done for Israel.

JDG.2.BSB: And Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
JDG.2.KJV: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
JDG.2.PLAIN: And Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died at the age of 110.

JDG.2.BSB: They buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
JDG.2.KJV: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
JDG.2.PLAIN: They buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

JDG.2.BSB: After that whole generation had also been gathered to their fathers, another generation rose up who did not know the LORD or the works that He had done for Israel.
JDG.2.KJV: And also all that generation were gathered to their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel. ¶
JDG.2.PLAIN: After that whole generation had also been gathered to their fathers, another generation rose up who did not know the Lord or the works that He had done for Israel.

JDG.2.BSB: And the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals.
JDG.2.KJV: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
JDG.2.PLAIN: And the Israelites did evil in the sight of the Lord and served the Baals.

JDG.2.BSB: Thus they forsook the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed after various gods of the peoples around them. They bowed down to them and provoked the LORD to anger,
JDG.2.KJV: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves to them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
JDG.2.PLAIN: Thus they forsook the Lord, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed after various gods of the peoples around them. They bowed down to them and provoked the Lord to anger,

JDG.2.BSB: for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
JDG.2.KJV: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth. ¶
JDG.2.PLAIN: for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

JDG.2.BSB: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them into the hands of those who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
JDG.2.KJV: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
JDG.2.PLAIN: Then the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and He delivered them into the hands of those who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.

JDG.2.BSB: Wherever Israel marched out, the hand of the LORD was against them to bring calamity, just as He had sworn to them. So they were greatly distressed.
JDG.2.KJV: Wherever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn to them: and they were greatly distressed. ¶
JDG.2.PLAIN: Wherever Israel marched out, the hand of the Lord was against them to bring calamity, just as He had sworn to them. So they were greatly distressed.

JDG.2.BSB: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.
JDG.2.KJV: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
JDG.2.PLAIN: Then the Lord raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.

JDG.2.BSB: Israel, however, did not listen to their judges. Instead, they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them. They quickly turned from the way of their fathers, who had walked in obedience to the LORD’s commandments; they did not do as their fathers had done.
JDG.2.KJV: And yet they would not listen to their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves to them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
JDG.2.PLAIN: Israel, however, did not listen to their judges. Instead, they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them. They quickly turned from the way of their fathers, who had walked in obedience to the Lord’s commandments; they did not do as their fathers had done.

JDG.2.BSB: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for the Israelites, He was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge was still alive; for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them.
JDG.2.KJV: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
JDG.2.PLAIN: Whenever the Lord raised up a judge for the Israelites, He was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge was still alive; for the Lord was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them.

JDG.2.BSB: But when the judge died, the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them. They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
JDG.2.KJV: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down to them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way. ¶
JDG.2.PLAIN: But when the judge died, the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them. They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.

JDG.2.BSB: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He said, “Because this nation has transgressed the covenant I laid down for their fathers and has not heeded My voice,
JDG.2.KJV: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people has transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not listened to my voice;
JDG.2.PLAIN: So the anger of the Lord burned against Israel, and He said, “Because this nation has transgressed the covenant I laid down for their fathers and has not heeded My voice,

JDG.2.BSB: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
JDG.2.KJV: I also will not from now on drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
JDG.2.PLAIN: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.

JDG.2.BSB: In this way I will test whether Israel will keep the way of the LORD by walking in it as their fathers did.”
JDG.2.KJV: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
JDG.2.PLAIN: In this way I will test whether Israel will keep the way of the Lord by walking in it as their fathers did.”

JDG.2.BSB: That is why the LORD had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua.
JDG.2.KJV: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
JDG.2.PLAIN: That is why the Lord had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua.

JDG.3.BSB: These are the nations that the LORD left to test all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars in Canaan,
JDG.3.KJV: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
JDG.3.PLAIN: These are the nations that the Lord left to test all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars in Canaan,

JDG.3.BSB: if only to teach warfare to the subsequent generations of Israel, especially to those who had not known it formerly:
JDG.3.KJV: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
JDG.3.PLAIN: if only to teach warfare to the subsequent generations of Israel, especially to those who had not known it formerly:

JDG.3.BSB: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.
JDG.3.KJV: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelled in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon to the entering in of Hamath.
JDG.3.PLAIN: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.

JDG.3.BSB: These nations were left to test the Israelites, to find out whether they would keep the commandments of the LORD, which He had given their fathers through Moses.
JDG.3.KJV: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses. ¶
JDG.3.PLAIN: These nations were left to test the Israelites, to find out whether they would keep the commandments of the Lord, which He had given their fathers through Moses.

JDG.3.BSB: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
JDG.3.KJV: And the children of Israel dwelled among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
JDG.3.PLAIN: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

JDG.3.BSB: And they took the daughters of these people in marriage, gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
JDG.3.KJV: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
JDG.3.PLAIN: And they took the daughters of these people in marriage, gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
