1KI.1.KJV: As the LORD has been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
1KI.1.PLAIN: Just as the Lord was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon and make his throne even greater than that of my lord King David.”

1KI.1.BSB: Then Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, went down and set Solomon on King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.
1KI.1.KJV: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride on king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
1KI.1.PLAIN: Then Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, went down and set Solomon on King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.

1KI.1.BSB: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the ram’s horn, and all the people proclaimed, “Long live King Solomon!”
1KI.1.KJV: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
1KI.1.PLAIN: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the ram’s horn, and all the people proclaimed, “Long live King Solomon!”

1KI.1.BSB: All the people followed him, playing flutes and rejoicing with such a great joy that the earth was split by the sound.
1KI.1.KJV: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them. ¶
1KI.1.PLAIN: All the people followed him, playing flutes and rejoicing with such a great joy that the earth was split by the sound.

1KI.1.BSB: Now Adonijah and all his guests were finishing their feast when they heard the sound of the ram’s horn. “Why is the city in such a loud uproar?” asked Joab.
1KI.1.KJV: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Why is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
1KI.1.PLAIN: Now Adonijah and all his guests were finishing their feast when they heard the sound of the ram’s horn. “Why is the city in such a loud uproar?” asked Joab.

1KI.1.BSB: As he was speaking, suddenly Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest arrived. “Come in,” said Adonijah, “for you are a man of valor. You must be bringing good news.”
1KI.1.KJV: And while he yet spoke, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came; and Adonijah said to him, Come in; for you are a valiant man, and bring good tidings.
1KI.1.PLAIN: As he was speaking, suddenly Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest arrived. “Come in,” said Adonijah, “for you are a man of valor. You must be bringing good news.”

1KI.1.BSB: “Not at all,” Jonathan replied. “Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
1KI.1.KJV: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Truly our lord king David has made Solomon king.
1KI.1.PLAIN: “Not at all,” Jonathan replied. “Our lord King David has made Solomon king.

1KI.1.BSB: And with Solomon, the king has sent Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, and they have set him on the king’s mule.
1KI.1.KJV: And the king has sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride on the king’s mule:
1KI.1.PLAIN: And with Solomon, the king has sent Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, and they have set him on the king’s mule.

1KI.1.BSB: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon, and they have gone up from there with rejoicing that rings out in the city. That is the noise you hear.
1KI.1.KJV: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
1KI.1.PLAIN: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon, and they have gone up from there with rejoicing that rings out in the city. That is the noise you hear.

1KI.1.BSB: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.
1KI.1.KJV: And also Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
1KI.1.PLAIN: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.

1KI.1.BSB: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king has bowed in worship on his bed,
1KI.1.KJV: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne. And the king bowed himself on the bed.
1KI.1.PLAIN: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king has bowed in worship on his bed,

1KI.1.BSB: saying, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel! Today He has provided one to sit on my throne, and my eyes have seen it.’”
1KI.1.KJV: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which has given one to sit on my throne this day, my eyes even seeing it.
1KI.1.PLAIN: saying, ‘Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel! Today He has provided one to sit on my throne, and my eyes have seen it.’”

1KI.1.BSB: At this, all the guests of Adonijah arose in terror and scattered.
1KI.1.KJV: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way. ¶
1KI.1.PLAIN: At this, all the guests of Adonijah arose in terror and scattered.

1KI.1.BSB: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, got up and went to take hold of the horns of the altar.
1KI.1.KJV: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
1KI.1.PLAIN: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, got up and went to take hold of the horns of the altar.

1KI.1.BSB: It was reported to Solomon: “Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon, and he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon first swear to me not to put his servant to the sword.’”
1KI.1.KJV: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah fears king Solomon: for, see, he has caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear to me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
1KI.1.PLAIN: It was reported to Solomon: “Look closely — Adonijah fears King Solomon, and he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon first swear to me not to put his servant to the sword.’”

1KI.1.BSB: And Solomon replied, “If he is a man of character, not a single hair of his will fall to the ground. But if evil is found in him, he will die.”
1KI.1.KJV: And Solomon said, If he will show himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
1KI.1.PLAIN: And Solomon replied, “If he is a man of character, not a single hair of his will fall to the ground. But if evil is found in him, he will die.”

1KI.1.BSB: So King Solomon summoned Adonijah down from the altar, and he came and bowed down before King Solomon, who said to him, “Go to your home.”
1KI.1.KJV: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said to him, Go to your house.
1KI.1.PLAIN: So King Solomon summoned Adonijah down from the altar, and he came and bowed down before King Solomon, who said to him, “Go to your home.”

1KI.2.BSB: As the time drew near for David to die, he charged his son Solomon,
1KI.2.KJV: Now the days of David drew near that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
1KI.2.PLAIN: As the time drew near for David to die, he charged his son Solomon,

1KI.2.BSB: “I am about to go the way of all the earth. So be strong and prove yourself a man.
1KI.2.KJV: I go the way of all the earth: be you strong therefore, and show yourself a man;
1KI.2.PLAIN: “I am about to go the way of all the earth. So be strong and prove yourself a man.

1KI.2.BSB: And keep the charge of the LORD your God to walk in His ways and to keep His statutes, commandments, ordinances, and decrees, as is written in the Law of Moses, so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you turn,
1KI.2.KJV: And keep the charge of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do, and wherever you turn yourself:
1KI.2.PLAIN: And keep the charge of the Lord your God to walk in His ways and to keep His statutes, commandments, ordinances, and decrees, as is written in the Law of Moses, so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you turn,

1KI.2.BSB: and so that the LORD may fulfill His promise to me: ‘If your descendants take heed to walk faithfully before Me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
1KI.2.KJV: That the LORD may continue his word which he spoke concerning me, saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
1KI.2.PLAIN: and so that the Lord may fulfill His promise to me: ‘If your descendants take heed to walk faithfully before Me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’

1KI.2.BSB: Moreover, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of the armies of Israel. He killed them in peacetime to avenge the blood of war. He stained with the blood of war the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.
1KI.2.KJV: Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner, and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Moreover, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of the armies of Israel. He killed them in peacetime to avenge the blood of war. He stained with the blood of war the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.

1KI.2.BSB: So act according to your wisdom, and do not let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
1KI.2.KJV: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
1KI.2.PLAIN: So act according to your wisdom, and do not let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.

1KI.2.BSB: But show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, because they stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
1KI.2.KJV: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at your table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom your brother.
1KI.2.PLAIN: But show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, because they stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.

1KI.2.BSB: Keep an eye on Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim who is with you. He called down bitter curses against me on the day I went to Mahanaim, but when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD: ‘I will never put you to the sword.’
1KI.2.KJV: And, behold, you have with you Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I swore to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Keep an eye on Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim who is with you. He called down bitter curses against me on the day I went to Mahanaim, but when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord: ‘I will never put you to the sword.’

1KI.2.BSB: Now therefore, do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man. You know what you ought to do to him to bring his gray head down to Sheol in blood.”
1KI.2.KJV: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for you are a wise man, and know what you ought to do to him; but his hoar head bring you down to the grave with blood.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Now therefore, do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man. You know what you ought to do to him to bring his gray head down to Sheol in blood.”

1KI.2.BSB: Then David rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David.
1KI.2.KJV: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Then David rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David.

1KI.2.BSB: The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
1KI.2.KJV: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

1KI.2.BSB: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established.
1KI.2.KJV: Then sat Solomon on the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established.

1KI.2.BSB: Now Adonijah son of Haggith went to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, and she asked, “Do you come in peace?” “Yes, in peace,” he replied.
1KI.2.KJV: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Come you peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Now Adonijah son of Haggith went to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, and she asked, “Do you come in peace?” “Yes, in peace,” he replied.

1KI.2.BSB: Then he said, “I have something to tell you.” “Say it,” she answered.
1KI.2.KJV: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say to you. And she said, Say on.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Then he said, “I have something to tell you.” “Say it,” she answered.

1KI.2.BSB: “You know that the kingship was mine,” he said. “All Israel expected that I should reign, but the kingship has turned to my brother, for it has come to him from the LORD.
1KI.2.KJV: And he said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: however, the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD.
1KI.2.PLAIN: “You know that the kingship was mine,” he said. “All Israel expected that I should reign, but the kingship has turned to my brother, for it has come to him from the Lord.

1KI.2.BSB: So now I have just one request of you; do not deny me.” “State your request,” she told him.
1KI.2.KJV: And now I ask one petition of you, deny me not. And she said to him, Say on.
1KI.2.PLAIN: So now I have just one request of you; do not deny me.” “State your request,” she told him.

1KI.2.BSB: Adonijah replied, “Please speak to King Solomon, since he will not turn you down. Let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”
1KI.2.KJV: And he said, Speak, I pray you, to Solomon the king, (for he will not say you no,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Adonijah replied, “Please speak to King Solomon, since he will not turn you down. Let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”

1KI.2.BSB: “Very well,” Bathsheba replied. “I will speak to the king for you.”
1KI.2.KJV: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for you to the king. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: “Very well,” Bathsheba replied. “I will speak to the king for you.”

1KI.2.BSB: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah. The king stood up to greet her, bowed to her, and sat down on his throne. Then the king had a throne brought for his mother, who sat down at his right hand.
1KI.2.KJV: Bathsheba therefore went to king Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.
1KI.2.PLAIN: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah. The king stood up to greet her, bowed to her, and sat down on his throne. Then the king had a throne brought for his mother, who sat down at his right hand.

1KI.2.BSB: “I have just one small request of you,” she said. “Do not deny me.” “Make your request, my mother,” the king replied, “for I will not deny you.”
1KI.2.KJV: Then she said, I desire one small petition of you; I pray you, say me not no. And the king said to her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say you no.
1KI.2.PLAIN: “I have just one small request of you,” she said. “Do not deny me.” “Make your request, my mother,” the king replied, “for I will not deny you.”

1KI.2.BSB: So Bathsheba said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.”
1KI.2.KJV: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother to wife.
1KI.2.PLAIN: So Bathsheba said, “Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.”

1KI.2.BSB: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Since he is my older brother, you might as well request the kingdom for him and for Abiathar the priest and for Joab son of Zeruiah!”
1KI.2.KJV: And king Solomon answered and said to his mother, And why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
1KI.2.PLAIN: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Since he is my older brother, you might as well request the kingdom for him and for Abiathar the priest and for Joab son of Zeruiah!”

1KI.2.BSB: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD: “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if Adonijah has not made this request at the expense of his life.
1KI.2.KJV: Then king Solomon swore by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord: “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if Adonijah has not made this request at the expense of his life.

1KI.2.BSB: And now, as surely as the LORD lives—the One who established me, who set me on the throne of my father David, and who founded for me a dynasty as He promised—surely Adonijah shall be put to death today!”
1KI.2.KJV: Now therefore, as the LORD lives, which has established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
1KI.2.PLAIN: And now, as surely as the Lord lives—the One who established me, who set me on the throne of my father David, and who founded for me a dynasty as He promised—surely Adonijah shall be put to death today!”

1KI.2.BSB: So King Solomon sent the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who struck down Adonijah, and he died.
1KI.2.KJV: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell on him that he died. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: So King Solomon sent the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who struck down Adonijah, and he died.

1KI.2.BSB: Then the king said to Abiathar the priest, “Go back to your fields in Anathoth. Even though you deserve to die, I will not put you to death at this time, since you carried the ark of the Lord GOD before my father David, and you suffered through all that my father suffered.”
1KI.2.KJV: And to Abiathar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you bore the ark of the LORD God before David my father, and because you have been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Then the king said to Abiathar the priest, “Go back to your fields in Anathoth. Even though you deserve to die, I will not put you to death at this time, since you carried the ark of the Lord GOD before my father David, and you suffered through all that my father suffered.”

1KI.2.BSB: So Solomon banished Abiathar from the priesthood of the LORD and thus fulfilled the word that the LORD had spoken at Shiloh against the house of Eli.
1KI.2.KJV: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest to the LORD; that he might fulfill the word of the LORD, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: So Solomon banished Abiathar from the priesthood of the Lord and thus fulfilled the word that the Lord had spoken at Shiloh against the house of Eli.

1KI.2.BSB: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah but not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the LORD and took hold of the horns of the altar.
1KI.2.KJV: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled to the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
1KI.2.PLAIN: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah but not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.

1KI.2.BSB: It was reported to King Solomon: “Joab has fled to the tent of the LORD and is now beside the altar.” So Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, strike him down!”
1KI.2.KJV: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled to the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall on him.
1KI.2.PLAIN: It was reported to King Solomon: “Joab has fled to the tent of the Lord and is now beside the altar.” So Solomon sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada, saying, “Go, strike him down!”

1KI.2.BSB: And Benaiah entered the tent of the LORD and said to Joab, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” But Joab replied, “No, I will die here.” So Benaiah relayed the message to the king, saying, “This is how Joab answered me.”
1KI.2.KJV: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said to him, Thus says the king, Come forth. And he said, No; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
1KI.2.PLAIN: And Benaiah entered the tent of the Lord and said to Joab, “The king says, ‘Come out!’” But Joab replied, “No, I will die here.” So Benaiah relayed the message to the king, saying, “This is how Joab answered me.”

1KI.2.BSB: And the king replied, “Do just as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so remove from me and from the house of my father the innocent blood that Joab shed.
1KI.2.KJV: And the king said to him, Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him; that you may take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
1KI.2.PLAIN: And the king replied, “Do just as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so remove from me and from the house of my father the innocent blood that Joab shed.

1KI.2.BSB: The LORD will bring his bloodshed back upon his own head, for without the knowledge of my father David he struck down two men more righteous and better than he when he put to the sword Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army.
1KI.2.KJV: And the LORD shall return his blood on his own head, who fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
1KI.2.PLAIN: The Lord will bring his bloodshed back upon his own head, for without the knowledge of my father David he struck down two men more righteous and better than he when he put to the sword Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army.

1KI.2.BSB: Their blood will come back upon the heads of Joab and his descendants forever; but for David, his descendants, his house, and his throne, there shall be peace from the LORD forever.”
1KI.2.KJV: Their blood shall therefore return on the head of Joab, and on the head of his seed for ever: but on David, and on his seed, and on his house, and on his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Their blood will come back upon the heads of Joab and his descendants forever; but for David, his descendants, his house, and his throne, there shall be peace from the Lord forever.”

1KI.2.BSB: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up, struck down Joab, and killed him. He was buried at his own home in the wilderness.
1KI.2.KJV: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell on him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up, struck down Joab, and killed him. He was buried at his own home in the wilderness.

1KI.2.BSB: And the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada in Joab’s place over the army, and he appointed Zadok the priest in Abiathar’s place.
1KI.2.KJV: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar. ¶
1KI.2.PLAIN: And the king appointed Benaiah son of Jehoiada in Joab’s place over the army, and he appointed Zadok the priest in Abiathar’s place.

1KI.2.BSB: Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
1KI.2.KJV: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, Build you an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth there any where.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Then the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.

1KI.2.BSB: On the day you go out and cross the Kidron Valley, know for sure that you will die; your blood will be on your own head.”
1KI.2.KJV: For it shall be, that on the day you go out, and pass over the brook Kidron, you shall know for certain that you shall surely die: your blood shall be on your own head.
1KI.2.PLAIN: On the day you go out and cross the Kidron Valley, know for sure that you will die; your blood will be on your own head.”

1KI.2.BSB: “The sentence is fair,” Shimei replied. “Your servant will do as my lord the king has spoken.” And Shimei lived in Jerusalem for a long time.
1KI.2.KJV: And Shimei said to the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And Shimei dwelled in Jerusalem many days.
1KI.2.PLAIN: “The sentence is fair,” Shimei replied. “Your servant will do as my lord the king has spoken.” And Shimei lived in Jerusalem for a long time.

1KI.2.BSB: After three years, however, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish son of Maacah, king of Gath. And Shimei was told, “Look, your slaves are in Gath.”
1KI.2.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away to Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, your servants be in Gath.
1KI.2.PLAIN: After three years, however, two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to Achish son of Maacah, king of Gath. And Shimei was told, “Look, your slaves are in Gath.”

1KI.2.BSB: So Shimei saddled his donkey and set out to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves, and he brought them back from Gath.
1KI.2.KJV: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
1KI.2.PLAIN: So Shimei saddled his donkey and set out to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves, and he brought them back from Gath.

1KI.2.BSB: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,
1KI.2.KJV: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
1KI.2.PLAIN: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,

1KI.2.BSB: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not make you swear by the LORD and warn you, ‘On the day you leave and go elsewhere, know for sure that you will die’? And you told me, ‘The sentence is fair; I will comply.’
1KI.2.KJV: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, Did I not make you to swear by the LORD, and protested to you, saying, Know for a certain, on the day you go out, and walk abroad any where, that you shall surely die? and you said to me, The word that I have heard is good.
1KI.2.PLAIN: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, “Did I not make you swear by the Lord and warn you, ‘On the day you leave and go elsewhere, know for sure that you will die’? And you told me, ‘The sentence is fair; I will comply.’

1KI.2.BSB: So why have you not kept your oath to the LORD and the command that I gave you?”
1KI.2.KJV: Why then have you not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged you with?
1KI.2.PLAIN: So why have you not kept your oath to the Lord and the command that I gave you?”

1KI.2.BSB: The king also said, “You know in your heart all the evil that you did to my father David. Therefore the LORD will bring your evil back upon your head.
1KI.2.KJV: The king said moreover to Shimei, You know all the wickedness which your heart is privy to, that you did to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return your wickedness on your own head;
1KI.2.PLAIN: The king also said, “You know in your heart all the evil that you did to my father David. Therefore the Lord will bring your evil back upon your head.

1KI.2.BSB: But King Solomon will be blessed and David’s throne will remain secure before the LORD forever.”
1KI.2.KJV: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
1KI.2.PLAIN: But King Solomon will be blessed and David’s throne will remain secure before the Lord forever.”

1KI.2.BSB: Then the king commanded Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down, and he died. Thus the kingdom was firmly established in the hand of Solomon.
1KI.2.KJV: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell on him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
1KI.2.PLAIN: Then the king commanded Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down, and he died. Thus the kingdom was firmly established in the hand of Solomon.

1KI.3.BSB: Later, Solomon formed an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt by marrying his daughter. Solomon brought her to the City of David until he had finished building his palace and the house of the LORD, as well as the wall around Jerusalem.
1KI.3.KJV: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Later, Solomon formed an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt by marrying his daughter. Solomon brought her to the City of David until he had finished building his palace and the house of the Lord, as well as the wall around Jerusalem.

1KI.3.BSB: The people, however, were still sacrificing on the high places because a house for the Name of the LORD had not yet been built.
1KI.3.KJV: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built to the name of the LORD, until those days.
1KI.3.PLAIN: The people, however, were still sacrificing on the high places because a house for the Name of the Lord had not yet been built.

1KI.3.BSB: And Solomon loved the LORD and walked in the statutes of his father David, except that he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
1KI.3.KJV: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
1KI.3.PLAIN: And Solomon loved the Lord and walked in the statutes of his father David, except that he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.

1KI.3.BSB: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for it was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.
1KI.3.KJV: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer on that altar. ¶
1KI.3.PLAIN: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for it was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.

1KI.3.BSB: One night at Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream, and God said, “Ask, and I will give it to you!”
1KI.3.KJV: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give you.
1KI.3.PLAIN: One night at Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream, and God said, “Ask, and I will give it to you!”

1KI.3.BSB: Solomon replied, “You have shown much loving devotion to Your servant, my father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness, righteousness, and uprightness of heart. And You have maintained this loving devotion by giving him a son to sit on his throne this very day.
1KI.3.KJV: And Solomon said, You have showed to your servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before you in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept for him this great kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Solomon replied, “You have shown much loving devotion to Your servant, my father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness, righteousness, and uprightness of heart. And You have maintained this loving devotion by giving him a son to sit on his throne this very day.

1KI.3.BSB: And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in my father David’s place. But I am only a little child, not knowing how to go out or come in.
1KI.3.KJV: And now, O LORD my God, you have made your servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
1KI.3.PLAIN: And now, O Lord my God, You have made Your servant king in my father David’s place. But I am only a little child, not knowing how to go out or come in.

1KI.3.BSB: Your servant is here among the people You have chosen, a people too numerous to count or number.
1KI.3.KJV: And your servant is in the middle of your people which you have chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Your servant is here among the people You have chosen, a people too numerous to count or number.

1KI.3.BSB: Therefore give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people and to discern between good and evil. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”
1KI.3.KJV: Give therefore your servant an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this your so great a people?
1KI.3.PLAIN: Therefore give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people and to discern between good and evil. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”

1KI.3.BSB: Now it pleased the Lord that Solomon had made this request.
1KI.3.KJV: And the speech pleased the LORD, that Solomon had asked this thing.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Now it pleased the Lord that Solomon had made this request.

1KI.3.BSB: So God said to him, “Since you have asked for this instead of requesting long life or wealth for yourself or death for your enemies—but you have asked for discernment to administer justice—
1KI.3.KJV: And God said to him, Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life; neither have asked riches for yourself, nor have asked the life of your enemies; but have asked for yourself understanding to discern judgment;
1KI.3.PLAIN: So God said to him, “Since you have asked for this instead of requesting long life or wealth for yourself or death for your enemies—but you have asked for discernment to administer justice—

1KI.3.BSB: behold, I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there has never been nor will ever be another like you.
1KI.3.KJV: Behold, I have done according to your words: see, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like to you.
1KI.3.PLAIN: look closely — I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there has never been nor will ever be another like you.

1KI.3.BSB: Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.
1KI.3.KJV: And I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches, and honor: so that there shall not be any among the kings like to you all your days.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.

1KI.3.BSB: So if you walk in My ways and keep My statutes and commandments, just as your father David did, I will prolong your days.”
1KI.3.KJV: And if you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David did walk, then I will lengthen your days.
1KI.3.PLAIN: So if you walk in My ways and keep My statutes and commandments, just as your father David did, I will prolong your days.”

1KI.3.BSB: Then Solomon awoke, and indeed it had been a dream. So he returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then he held a feast for all his servants.
1KI.3.KJV: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants. ¶
1KI.3.PLAIN: Then Solomon awoke, and indeed it had been a dream. So he returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then he held a feast for all his servants.

1KI.3.BSB: At that time two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
1KI.3.KJV: Then came there two women, that were harlots, to the king, and stood before him.
1KI.3.PLAIN: At that time two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

1KI.3.BSB: One woman said, “Please, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house, and I gave birth while she was in the house.
1KI.3.KJV: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
1KI.3.PLAIN: One woman said, “Please, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house, and I gave birth while she was in the house.

1KI.3.BSB: On the third day after I gave birth, this woman also had a baby. We were alone, with no one in the house but the two of us.
1KI.3.KJV: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
1KI.3.PLAIN: On the third day after I gave birth, this woman also had a baby. We were alone, with no one in the house but the two of us.

1KI.3.BSB: During the night this woman’s son died because she rolled over on him.
1KI.3.KJV: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
1KI.3.PLAIN: During the night this woman’s son died because she rolled over on him.

1KI.3.BSB: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I was asleep. She laid him in her bosom and put her dead son at my bosom.
1KI.3.KJV: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while your handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
1KI.3.PLAIN: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I was asleep. She laid him in her bosom and put her dead son at my bosom.

1KI.3.BSB: The next morning, when I got up to nurse my son, I discovered he was dead. But when I examined him, I realized that he was not the son I had borne.”
1KI.3.KJV: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
1KI.3.PLAIN: The next morning, when I got up to nurse my son, I discovered he was dead. But when I examined him, I realized that he was not the son I had borne.”

1KI.3.BSB: “No,” said the other woman, “the living one is my son and the dead one is your son.” But the first woman insisted, “No, the dead one is yours and the living one is mine.” So they argued before the king.
1KI.3.KJV: And the other woman said, No; but the living is my son, and the dead is your son. And this said, No; but the dead is your son, and the living is my son. Thus they spoke before the king.
1KI.3.PLAIN: “No,” said the other woman, “the living one is my son and the dead one is your son.” But the first woman insisted, “No, the dead one is yours and the living one is mine.” So they argued before the king.

1KI.3.BSB: Then the king replied, “This woman says, ‘My son is alive and yours is dead,’ but that woman says, ‘No, your son is dead and mine is alive.’”
1KI.3.KJV: Then said the king, The one says, This is my son that lives, and your son is the dead: and the other says, No; but your son is the dead, and my son is the living.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Then the king replied, “This woman says, ‘My son is alive and yours is dead,’ but that woman says, ‘No, your son is dead and mine is alive.’”

1KI.3.BSB: The king continued, “Bring me a sword.” So they brought him a sword,
1KI.3.KJV: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
1KI.3.PLAIN: The king continued, “Bring me a sword.” So they brought him a sword,

1KI.3.BSB: and the king declared, “Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.”
1KI.3.KJV: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
1KI.3.PLAIN: and the king declared, “Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.”

1KI.3.BSB: Then the woman whose son was alive spoke to the king because she yearned with compassion for her son. “Please, my lord,” she said, “give her the living baby. Do not kill him!” But the other woman said, “He will be neither mine nor yours. Cut him in two!”
1KI.3.KJV: Then spoke the woman whose the living child was to the king, for her bowels yearned on her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither my nor yours, but divide it.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Then the woman whose son was alive spoke to the king because she yearned with compassion for her son. “Please, my lord,” she said, “give her the living baby. Do not kill him!” But the other woman said, “He will be neither mine nor yours. Cut him in two!”

1KI.3.BSB: Then the king gave his ruling: “Give the living baby to the first woman. By no means should you kill him; she is his mother.”
1KI.3.KJV: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
1KI.3.PLAIN: Then the king gave his ruling: “Give the living baby to the first woman. By no means should you kill him; she is his mother.”

1KI.3.BSB: When all Israel heard of the judgment the king had given, they stood in awe of him, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.
1KI.3.KJV: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
1KI.3.PLAIN: When all Israel heard of the judgment the king had given, they stood in awe of him, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.

1KI.4.BSB: So King Solomon ruled over Israel,
1KI.4.KJV: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
1KI.4.PLAIN: So King Solomon ruled over Israel,

1KI.4.BSB: and these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok was the priest;
1KI.4.KJV: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
1KI.4.PLAIN: and these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok was the priest;

1KI.4.BSB: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, were secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
1KI.4.KJV: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
1KI.4.PLAIN: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, were secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;

1KI.4.BSB: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
1KI.4.KJV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

1KI.4.BSB: Azariah son of Nathan was in charge of the governors; Zabud son of Nathan was a priest and adviser to the king;
1KI.4.KJV: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Azariah son of Nathan was in charge of the governors; Zabud son of Nathan was a priest and adviser to the king;

1KI.4.BSB: Ahishar was in charge of the palace; and Adoniram son of Abda was in charge of the forced labor.
1KI.4.KJV: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute. ¶
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ahishar was in charge of the palace; and Adoniram son of Abda was in charge of the forced labor.

1KI.4.BSB: Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel to provide food for the king and his household. Each one would arrange provisions for one month of the year,
1KI.4.KJV: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
1KI.4.PLAIN: Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel to provide food for the king and his household. Each one would arrange provisions for one month of the year,

1KI.4.BSB: and these were their names: Ben-hur in the hill country of Ephraim;
1KI.4.KJV: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
1KI.4.PLAIN: and these were their names: Ben-hur in the hill country of Ephraim;

1KI.4.BSB: Ben-deker in Makaz, in Shaalbim, in Beth-shemesh, and in Elon-beth-hanan;
1KI.4.KJV: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ben-deker in Makaz, in Shaalbim, in Beth-shemesh, and in Elon-beth-hanan;

1KI.4.BSB: Ben-hesed in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);
1KI.4.KJV: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ben-hesed in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher belonged to him);

1KI.4.BSB: Ben-abinadab in Naphath-dor (Taphath, a daughter of Solomon, was his wife);
1KI.4.KJV: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ben-abinadab in Naphath-dor (Taphath, a daughter of Solomon, was his wife);

1KI.4.BSB: Baana son of Ahilud in Taanach, in Megiddo, and in all of Beth-shean next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah and on past Jokmeam;
1KI.4.KJV: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even to the place that is beyond Jokneam:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Baana son of Ahilud in Taanach, in Megiddo, and in all of Beth-shean next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah and on past Jokmeam;

1KI.4.BSB: Ben-geber in Ramoth-gilead (the villages of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead belonged to him, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan with its sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);
1KI.4.KJV: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, three score great cities with walls and brazen bars:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ben-geber in Ramoth-gilead (the villages of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead belonged to him, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan with its sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);

1KI.4.BSB: Ahinadab son of Iddo in Mahanaim;
1KI.4.KJV: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ahinadab son of Iddo in Mahanaim;

1KI.4.BSB: Ahimaaz in Naphtali (he had married Basemath, a daughter of Solomon);
1KI.4.KJV: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Ahimaaz in Naphtali (he had married Basemath, a daughter of Solomon);

1KI.4.BSB: Baana son of Hushai in Asher and in Aloth;
1KI.4.KJV: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Baana son of Hushai in Asher and in Aloth;

1KI.4.BSB: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah in Issachar;
1KI.4.KJV: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah in Issachar;

1KI.4.BSB: Shimei son of Ela in Benjamin;
1KI.4.KJV: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
1KI.4.PLAIN: Shimei son of Ela in Benjamin;

1KI.4.BSB: Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead, including the territories of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. There was also one governor in the land of Judah.
1KI.4.KJV: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land. ¶
1KI.4.PLAIN: Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead, including the territories of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. There was also one governor in the land of Judah.

1KI.4.BSB: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore, and they were eating and drinking and rejoicing.
1KI.4.KJV: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
1KI.4.PLAIN: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore, and they were eating and drinking and rejoicing.

1KI.4.BSB: And Solomon reigned over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These kingdoms offered tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
1KI.4.KJV: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life. ¶
1KI.4.PLAIN: And Solomon reigned over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These kingdoms offered tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.

1KI.4.BSB: Solomon’s provisions for a single day were thirty cors of fine flour, sixty cors of meal,
1KI.4.KJV: And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and three score measures of meal,
1KI.4.PLAIN: Solomon’s provisions for a single day were thirty cors of fine flour, sixty cors of meal,

1KI.4.BSB: ten fat oxen, twenty range oxen, and a hundred sheep, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened poultry.
1KI.4.KJV: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallow deer, and fatted fowl.
1KI.4.PLAIN: ten fat oxen, twenty range oxen, and a hundred sheep, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened poultry.

1KI.4.BSB: For Solomon had dominion over everything west of the Euphrates—over all the kingdoms from Tiphsah to Gaza—and he had peace on all sides.
1KI.4.KJV: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
1KI.4.PLAIN: For Solomon had dominion over everything west of the Euphrates—over all the kingdoms from Tiphsah to Gaza—and he had peace on all sides.

1KI.4.BSB: Throughout the days of Solomon, Judah and Israel dwelt securely from Dan to Beersheba, each man under his own vine and his own fig tree.
1KI.4.KJV: And Judah and Israel dwelled safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon. ¶
1KI.4.PLAIN: Throughout the days of Solomon, Judah and Israel dwelt securely from Dan to Beersheba, each man under his own vine and his own fig tree.

1KI.4.BSB: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for his chariot horses and 12,000 horses.
1KI.4.KJV: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
1KI.4.PLAIN: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for his chariot horses and 12,000 horses.

1KI.4.BSB: Each month the governors in turn provided food for King Solomon and all who came to his table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.
1KI.4.KJV: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came to king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
1KI.4.PLAIN: Each month the governors in turn provided food for King Solomon and all who came to his table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.

1KI.4.BSB: Each one also brought to the required place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and other horses.
1KI.4.KJV: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they to the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge. ¶
1KI.4.PLAIN: Each one also brought to the required place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and other horses.

1KI.4.BSB: And God gave Solomon wisdom, exceedingly deep insight, and understanding beyond measure, like the sand on the seashore.
1KI.4.KJV: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
1KI.4.PLAIN: And God gave Solomon wisdom, exceedingly deep insight, and understanding beyond measure, like the sand on the seashore.

1KI.4.BSB: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than that of all the men of the East, greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.
1KI.4.KJV: And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
1KI.4.PLAIN: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than that of all the men of the East, greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.

1KI.4.BSB: He was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and wiser than Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread throughout the surrounding nations.
1KI.4.KJV: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
1KI.4.PLAIN: He was wiser than all men—wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and wiser than Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread throughout the surrounding nations.

1KI.4.BSB: Solomon composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
1KI.4.KJV: And he spoke three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
1KI.4.PLAIN: Solomon composed three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
