1KI.7.PLAIN: And the palace where Solomon would live, set further back, was of similar construction. He also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.

1KI.7.BSB: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones, cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves, and from the outside to the great courtyard.
1KI.7.KJV: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
1KI.7.PLAIN: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones, cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves, and from the outside to the great courtyard.

1KI.7.BSB: The foundations were laid with large, costly stones, some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long.
1KI.7.KJV: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
1KI.7.PLAIN: The foundations were laid with large, costly stones, some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long.

1KI.7.BSB: Above these were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
1KI.7.KJV: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Above these were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.

1KI.7.BSB: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD.
1KI.7.KJV: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house. ¶
1KI.7.PLAIN: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the Lord.

1KI.7.BSB: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre.
1KI.7.KJV: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre.

1KI.7.BSB: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.
1KI.7.KJV: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and worked all his work.
1KI.7.PLAIN: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.

1KI.7.BSB: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
1KI.7.KJV: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
1KI.7.PLAIN: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.

1KI.7.BSB: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars, each capital five cubits high.
1KI.7.KJV: And he made two capitals of molten brass, to set on the tops of the pillars: the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits:
1KI.7.PLAIN: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars, each capital five cubits high.

1KI.7.BSB: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice, with wreaths of chainwork, seven for each capital.
1KI.7.KJV: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.
1KI.7.PLAIN: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice, with wreaths of chainwork, seven for each capital.

1KI.7.BSB: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars.
1KI.7.KJV: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about on the one network, to cover the capitals that were on the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other capital.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars.

1KI.7.BSB: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.
1KI.7.KJV: And the capitals that were on the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
1KI.7.PLAIN: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.

1KI.7.BSB: On the capitals of both pillars, just above the rounded projection next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling each capital.
1KI.7.KJV: And the capitals on the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about on the other capital.
1KI.7.PLAIN: On the capitals of both pillars, just above the rounded projection next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling each capital.

1KI.7.BSB: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jachin, and the pillar to the north he named Boaz.
1KI.7.KJV: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jachin, and the pillar to the north he named Boaz.

1KI.7.BSB: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed.
1KI.7.KJV: And on the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished. ¶
1KI.7.PLAIN: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed.

1KI.7.BSB: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
1KI.7.KJV: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
1KI.7.PLAIN: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.

1KI.7.BSB: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
1KI.7.KJV: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.

1KI.7.BSB: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.
1KI.7.KJV: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above on them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
1KI.7.PLAIN: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.

1KI.7.BSB: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths.
1KI.7.KJV: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was worked like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths. ¶
1KI.7.PLAIN: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths.

1KI.7.BSB: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
1KI.7.KJV: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
1KI.7.PLAIN: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.

1KI.7.BSB: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights,
1KI.7.KJV: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
1KI.7.PLAIN: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights,

1KI.7.BSB: and on the panels between the uprights were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the uprights was a pedestal above, and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work.
1KI.7.KJV: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim: and on the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
1KI.7.PLAIN: and on the panels between the uprights were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the uprights was a pedestal above, and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work.

1KI.7.BSB: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports, with wreaths at each side.
1KI.7.KJV: And every base had four brazen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had supports: under the laver were supports molten, at the side of every addition.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports, with wreaths at each side.

1KI.7.BSB: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep, with a round opening like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half wide. And around its opening were engravings, but the panels of the stands were square, not round.
1KI.7.KJV: And the mouth of it within the capital and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also on the mouth of it were engravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
1KI.7.PLAIN: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep, with a round opening like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half wide. And around its opening were engravings, but the panels of the stands were square, not round.

1KI.7.BSB: There were four wheels under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand; each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.
1KI.7.KJV: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
1KI.7.PLAIN: There were four wheels under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand; each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.

1KI.7.BSB: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of cast metal.
1KI.7.KJV: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
1KI.7.PLAIN: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of cast metal.

1KI.7.BSB: Each stand had four handles, one for each corner, projecting from the stand.
1KI.7.KJV: And there were four supports to the four corners of one base: and the supports were of the very base itself.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Each stand had four handles, one for each corner, projecting from the stand.

1KI.7.BSB: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.
1KI.7.KJV: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
1KI.7.PLAIN: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.

1KI.7.BSB: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.
1KI.7.KJV: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
1KI.7.PLAIN: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.

1KI.7.BSB: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape.
1KI.7.KJV: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size. ¶
1KI.7.PLAIN: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape.

1KI.7.BSB: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.
1KI.7.KJV: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and on every one of the ten bases one laver.
1KI.7.PLAIN: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.

1KI.7.BSB: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north, and he put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.
1KI.7.KJV: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south. ¶
1KI.7.PLAIN: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north, and he put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.

1KI.7.BSB: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the LORD:
1KI.7.KJV: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
1KI.7.PLAIN: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:

1KI.7.BSB: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars;
1KI.7.KJV: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the top of the pillars;
1KI.7.PLAIN: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars;

1KI.7.BSB: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);
1KI.7.KJV: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;
1KI.7.PLAIN: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);

1KI.7.BSB: the ten stands; the ten basins on the stands;
1KI.7.KJV: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
1KI.7.PLAIN: the ten stands; the ten basins on the stands;

1KI.7.BSB: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;
1KI.7.KJV: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
1KI.7.PLAIN: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;

1KI.7.BSB: and the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. All the articles that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were made of burnished bronze.
1KI.7.KJV: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basins: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
1KI.7.PLAIN: and the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. All the articles that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the Lord were made of burnished bronze.

1KI.7.BSB: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.
1KI.7.KJV: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
1KI.7.PLAIN: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

1KI.7.BSB: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
1KI.7.KJV: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
1KI.7.PLAIN: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.

1KI.7.BSB: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;
1KI.7.KJV: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained to the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the show bread was,
1KI.7.PLAIN: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the Lord: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;

1KI.7.BSB: the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary, five on the right side and five on the left; the gold flowers, lamps, and tongs;
1KI.7.KJV: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
1KI.7.PLAIN: the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary, five on the right side and five on the left; the gold flowers, lamps, and tongs;

1KI.7.BSB: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers; and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place) as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
1KI.7.KJV: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
1KI.7.PLAIN: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers; and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place) as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple.

1KI.7.BSB: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
1KI.7.KJV: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
1KI.7.PLAIN: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the Lord was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the Lord.

1KI.8.BSB: At that time Solomon assembled before him in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.
1KI.8.KJV: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, to king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
1KI.8.PLAIN: At that time Solomon assembled before him in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from Zion, the City of David.

1KI.8.BSB: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim.
1KI.8.KJV: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves to king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
1KI.8.PLAIN: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim.

1KI.8.BSB: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,
1KI.8.KJV: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
1KI.8.PLAIN: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,

1KI.8.BSB: and they brought up the ark of the LORD and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. So the priests and Levites carried them up.
1KI.8.KJV: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
1KI.8.PLAIN: and they brought up the ark of the Lord and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. So the priests and Levites carried them up.

1KI.8.BSB: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
1KI.8.KJV: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
1KI.8.PLAIN: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.

1KI.8.BSB: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
1KI.8.KJV: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD to his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.
1KI.8.PLAIN: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.

1KI.8.BSB: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.
1KI.8.KJV: For the cherubim spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
1KI.8.PLAIN: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.

1KI.8.BSB: The poles extended far enough that their ends were visible from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are there to this day.
1KI.8.KJV: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are to this day.
1KI.8.PLAIN: The poles extended far enough that their ends were visible from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are there to this day.

1KI.8.BSB: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites after they had come out of the land of Egypt.
1KI.8.KJV: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
1KI.8.PLAIN: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord had made a covenant with the Israelites after they had come out of the land of Egypt.

1KI.8.BSB: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD
1KI.8.KJV: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
1KI.8.PLAIN: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the house of the Lord

1KI.8.BSB: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.
1KI.8.KJV: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD. ¶
1KI.8.PLAIN: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord.

1KI.8.BSB: Then Solomon declared: “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.
1KI.8.KJV: Then spoke Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
1KI.8.PLAIN: Then Solomon declared: “The Lord has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.

1KI.8.BSB: I have indeed built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”
1KI.8.KJV: I have surely built you an house to dwell in, a settled place for you to abide in for ever.
1KI.8.PLAIN: I have indeed built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”

1KI.8.BSB: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there, the king turned around and blessed them all
1KI.8.KJV: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
1KI.8.PLAIN: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there, the king turned around and blessed them all

1KI.8.BSB: and said: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
1KI.8.KJV: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spoke with his mouth to David my father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
1KI.8.PLAIN: and said: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,

1KI.8.BSB: ‘Since the day I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there. But I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
1KI.8.KJV: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
1KI.8.PLAIN: ‘Since the day I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there. But I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’

1KI.8.BSB: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
1KI.8.KJV: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
1KI.8.PLAIN: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the Lord, the God of Israel.

1KI.8.BSB: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
1KI.8.KJV: And the LORD said to David my father, Whereas it was in your heart to build an house to my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
1KI.8.PLAIN: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.

1KI.8.BSB: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’
1KI.8.KJV: Nevertheless you shall not build the house; but your son that shall come forth out of your loins, he shall build the house to my name.
