1CH.1.KJV: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty on the earth.
1CH.1.PLAIN: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.

1CH.1.BSB: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
1CH.1.KJV: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,

1CH.1.BSB: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
1CH.1.KJV: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
1CH.1.PLAIN: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.

1CH.1.BSB: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
1CH.1.KJV: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
1CH.1.PLAIN: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

1CH.1.BSB: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
1CH.1.KJV: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
1CH.1.PLAIN: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

1CH.1.BSB: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
1CH.1.KJV: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
1CH.1.PLAIN: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

1CH.1.BSB: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
1CH.1.KJV: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

1CH.1.BSB: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
1CH.1.KJV: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
1CH.1.PLAIN: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

1CH.1.BSB: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
1CH.1.KJV: And to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
1CH.1.PLAIN: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.

1CH.1.BSB: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
1CH.1.KJV: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
1CH.1.PLAIN: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

1CH.1.BSB: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
1CH.1.KJV: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

1CH.1.BSB: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
1CH.1.KJV: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

1CH.1.BSB: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
1CH.1.KJV: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

1CH.1.BSB: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
1CH.1.KJV: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
1CH.1.PLAIN: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,

1CH.1.BSB: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
1CH.1.KJV: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

1CH.1.BSB: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
1CH.1.KJV: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

1CH.1.BSB: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
1CH.1.KJV: Abram; the same is Abraham.
1CH.1.PLAIN: and Abram (that is, Abraham).

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.

1CH.1.BSB: These are their genealogies:
1CH.1.KJV: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
1CH.1.PLAIN: These are their genealogies:

1CH.1.BSB: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
1CH.1.KJV: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

1CH.1.BSB: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
1CH.1.KJV: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
1CH.1.KJV: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
1CH.1.KJV: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.

1CH.1.BSB: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
1CH.1.KJV: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
1CH.1.KJV: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
1CH.1.KJV: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. and the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

1CH.1.BSB: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
1CH.1.PLAIN: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

1CH.1.BSB: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
1CH.1.KJV: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

1CH.1.BSB: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
1CH.1.KJV: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
1CH.1.PLAIN: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.

1CH.1.BSB: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.

1CH.1.BSB: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

1CH.1.BSB: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.

1CH.1.BSB: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.

1CH.1.BSB: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.

1CH.1.BSB: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.

1CH.1.BSB: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
1CH.1.KJV: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab. ¶
1CH.1.PLAIN: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

1CH.1.BSB: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
1CH.1.KJV: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

1CH.1.BSB: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
1CH.1.KJV: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

1CH.1.BSB: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
1CH.1.KJV: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
1CH.1.PLAIN: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

1CH.1.BSB: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
1CH.1.KJV: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
1CH.1.PLAIN: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

1CH.2.BSB: These were the sons of Israel:
1CH.2.KJV: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
1CH.2.PLAIN: These were the sons of Israel:

1CH.2.BSB: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
1CH.2.KJV: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, who put him to death.
1CH.2.KJV: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born to him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord, who put him to death.

1CH.2.BSB: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
1CH.2.KJV: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
1CH.2.KJV: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all.

1CH.2.BSB: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.

1CH.2.BSB: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
1CH.2.KJV: The sons also of Hezron, that were born to him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

1CH.2.BSB: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
1CH.2.KJV: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
1CH.2.PLAIN: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.

1CH.2.BSB: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
1CH.2.KJV: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.

1CH.2.BSB: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
1CH.2.KJV: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse, ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.

1CH.2.BSB: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
1CH.2.KJV: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,

1CH.2.BSB: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,
1CH.2.KJV: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,

1CH.2.BSB: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
1CH.2.KJV: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
1CH.2.PLAIN: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.

1CH.2.BSB: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
1CH.2.KJV: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

1CH.2.BSB: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
1CH.2.KJV: And Abigail bore Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

1CH.2.BSB: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
1CH.2.KJV: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

1CH.2.BSB: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
1CH.2.KJV: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took to him Ephrath, which bore him Hur.
1CH.2.PLAIN: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.

1CH.2.BSB: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
1CH.2.KJV: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

1CH.2.BSB: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
1CH.2.KJV: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was three score years old; and she bore him Segub.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.

1CH.2.BSB: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
1CH.2.KJV: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

1CH.2.BSB: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
1CH.2.KJV: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even three score cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
1CH.2.PLAIN: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.

1CH.2.BSB: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
1CH.2.KJV: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashur the father of Tekoa. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron:

1CH.2.BSB: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
1CH.2.KJV: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah. Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai:
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab and Abishur.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai:

1CH.2.BSB: Nadab and Abishur. Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
1CH.2.KJV: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Nadab and Abishur. Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.

1CH.2.BSB: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

1CH.2.BSB: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; but he did have an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
1CH.2.KJV: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; but he did have an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

1CH.2.BSB: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
1CH.2.KJV: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bore him Attai.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.

1CH.2.BSB: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
1CH.2.KJV: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,

1CH.2.BSB: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
1CH.2.KJV: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,

1CH.2.BSB: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
1CH.2.KJV: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,

1CH.2.BSB: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
1CH.2.KJV: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,

1CH.2.BSB: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
1CH.2.KJV: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,

1CH.2.BSB: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
1CH.2.KJV: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
1CH.2.KJV: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Hebron:
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Hebron:

1CH.2.BSB: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
1CH.2.KJV: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema. Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.

1CH.2.BSB: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
1CH.2.KJV: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

1CH.2.BSB: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
1CH.2.KJV: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

1CH.2.BSB: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
1CH.2.KJV: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

1CH.2.BSB: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
1CH.2.KJV: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber, and Tirhanah.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

1CH.2.BSB: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
1CH.2.KJV: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa. ¶
1CH.2.PLAIN: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.

1CH.2.BSB: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah:
1CH.2.KJV: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim.
1CH.2.PLAIN: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah:

1CH.2.BSB: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim, Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
1CH.2.KJV: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim, Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

1CH.2.BSB: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim:
1CH.2.KJV: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
1CH.2.PLAIN: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim:

1CH.2.BSB: Haroeh, half the Manahathites, and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
1CH.2.KJV: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites,
1CH.2.PLAIN: Haroeh, half the Manahathites, and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.

1CH.2.BSB: The descendants of Salma:
1CH.2.KJV: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
1CH.2.PLAIN: The descendants of Salma:

1CH.2.BSB: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites, and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
1CH.2.KJV: And the families of the scribes which dwelled at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
1CH.2.PLAIN: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites, and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

1CH.3.BSB: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;
1CH.3.KJV: Now these were the sons of David, which were born to him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
1CH.3.PLAIN: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;

1CH.3.BSB: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
1CH.3.KJV: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
1CH.3.PLAIN: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;

1CH.3.BSB: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
1CH.3.KJV: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
1CH.3.PLAIN: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.

1CH.3.BSB: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
1CH.3.KJV: These six were born to him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
1CH.3.PLAIN: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,

1CH.3.BSB: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
1CH.3.KJV: And these were born to him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
1CH.3.PLAIN: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.

1CH.3.BSB: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
1CH.3.KJV: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
1CH.3.PLAIN: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,

1CH.3.BSB: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
1CH.3.KJV: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
1CH.3.PLAIN: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

1CH.3.BSB: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
1CH.3.KJV: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
1CH.3.PLAIN: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.

1CH.3.BSB: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
1CH.3.KJV: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister. ¶
1CH.3.PLAIN: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.

1CH.3.BSB: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam:
1CH.3.KJV: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
1CH.3.PLAIN: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam:

1CH.3.BSB: Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
1CH.3.KJV: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
1CH.3.PLAIN: Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son, Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

1CH.3.BSB: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
1CH.3.KJV: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
1CH.3.PLAIN: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

1CH.3.BSB: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
1CH.3.KJV: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
1CH.3.PLAIN: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

1CH.3.BSB: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
1CH.3.KJV: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
1CH.3.PLAIN: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

1CH.3.BSB: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
1CH.3.PLAIN: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.

1CH.3.BSB: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son. ¶
1CH.3.PLAIN: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.

1CH.3.BSB: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive:
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
1CH.3.PLAIN: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive:

1CH.3.BSB: Shealtiel his son, Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
1CH.3.KJV: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
1CH.3.PLAIN: Shealtiel his son, Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

1CH.3.BSB: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel:
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
1CH.3.PLAIN: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel:

1CH.3.BSB: Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith, and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
1CH.3.KJV: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
1CH.3.PLAIN: Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith, and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.

1CH.3.BSB: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
1CH.3.PLAIN: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.

1CH.3.BSB: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
1CH.3.PLAIN: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.

1CH.3.BSB: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
1CH.3.PLAIN: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.

1CH.3.BSB: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
1CH.3.KJV: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
1CH.3.PLAIN: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.

1CH.4.BSB: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
1CH.4.KJV: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

1CH.4.BSB: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
1CH.4.KJV: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.

1CH.4.BSB: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
1CH.4.KJV: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
1CH.4.PLAIN: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.

1CH.4.BSB: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
1CH.4.KJV: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem. ¶
1CH.4.PLAIN: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.

1CH.4.BSB: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
1CH.4.KJV: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

1CH.4.BSB: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
1CH.4.KJV: And Naarah bore him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,

1CH.4.BSB: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
1CH.4.KJV: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum. ¶
1CH.4.PLAIN: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.

1CH.4.BSB: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
1CH.4.KJV: And Jabez was more honorable than his brothers: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bore him with sorrow.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”

1CH.4.BSB: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez.
1CH.4.KJV: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested. ¶
1CH.4.PLAIN: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez.

1CH.4.BSB: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
1CH.4.KJV: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

1CH.4.BSB: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
1CH.4.KJV: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.

1CH.4.BSB: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
1CH.4.KJV: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bore Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon.

1CH.4.BSB: And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa. These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
1CH.4.KJV: And his wife Jehudijah bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
1CH.4.PLAIN: And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa. These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth. ¶
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Shelah son of Judah:
1CH.4.KJV: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Shelah son of Judah:

1CH.4.BSB: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea, Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
1CH.4.KJV: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea, Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)

1CH.4.BSB: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.
1CH.4.KJV: These were the potters, and those that dwelled among plants and hedges: there they dwelled with the king for his work. ¶
1CH.4.PLAIN: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.

1CH.4.BSB: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
1CH.4.KJV: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
1CH.4.PLAIN: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
1CH.4.KJV: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.

1CH.4.BSB: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
1CH.4.KJV: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
1CH.4.PLAIN: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.

1CH.4.BSB: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
1CH.4.KJV: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters: but his brothers had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.

1CH.4.BSB: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
1CH.4.KJV: And they dwelled at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
1CH.4.PLAIN: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,

1CH.4.BSB: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
1CH.4.KJV: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
1CH.4.PLAIN: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,

1CH.4.BSB: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
1CH.4.KJV: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
1CH.4.PLAIN: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,

1CH.4.BSB: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
1CH.4.KJV: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities to the reign of David.
1CH.4.PLAIN: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.

1CH.4.BSB: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns—
1CH.4.KJV: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
1CH.4.PLAIN: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns—

1CH.4.BSB: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
1CH.4.KJV: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, to Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
1CH.4.PLAIN: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:

1CH.4.BSB: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
1CH.4.KJV: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
1CH.4.PLAIN: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,

1CH.4.BSB: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),
1CH.4.KJV: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
1CH.4.PLAIN: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),

1CH.4.BSB: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
1CH.4.KJV: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
1CH.4.PLAIN: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

1CH.4.BSB: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
1CH.4.KJV: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
1CH.4.PLAIN: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).

1CH.4.BSB: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
1CH.4.KJV: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly. ¶
1CH.4.PLAIN: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,

1CH.4.BSB: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
1CH.4.KJV: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
1CH.4.PLAIN: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.

1CH.4.BSB: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
1CH.4.KJV: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelled there of old.
1CH.4.PLAIN: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.

1CH.4.BSB: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites and Meunites there in their dwellings, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
1CH.4.KJV: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly to this day, and dwelled in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
1CH.4.PLAIN: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites and Meunites there in their dwellings, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.

1CH.4.BSB: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
1CH.4.KJV: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
1CH.4.PLAIN: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir

1CH.4.BSB: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
1CH.4.KJV: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelled there to this day.
1CH.4.PLAIN: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.

1CH.5.BSB: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.
1CH.5.KJV: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but for as much as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
1CH.5.PLAIN: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.

1CH.5.BSB: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.
1CH.5.KJV: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)
1CH.5.PLAIN: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.

1CH.5.BSB: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
1CH.5.KJV: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
1CH.5.PLAIN: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

1CH.5.BSB: The descendants of Joel:
1CH.5.KJV: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
1CH.5.PLAIN: The descendants of Joel:

1CH.5.BSB: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son, Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
1CH.5.KJV: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
1CH.5.PLAIN: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son, Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

1CH.5.BSB: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile.
1CH.5.KJV: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
1CH.5.PLAIN: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile.

1CH.5.BSB: Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites. His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy:
1CH.5.KJV: And his brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
1CH.5.PLAIN: Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites. His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy:

1CH.5.BSB: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
1CH.5.KJV: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelled in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baalmeon:
1CH.5.PLAIN: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.

1CH.5.BSB: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
1CH.5.KJV: And eastward he inhabited to the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
1CH.5.PLAIN: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.

1CH.5.BSB: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the homes of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead.
1CH.5.KJV: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelled in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead. ¶
1CH.5.PLAIN: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the homes of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead.

1CH.5.BSB: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
1CH.5.KJV: And the children of Gad dwelled over against them, in the land of Bashan to Salcah:
1CH.5.PLAIN: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:

1CH.5.BSB: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.
1CH.5.KJV: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
1CH.5.PLAIN: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.

1CH.5.BSB: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.
1CH.5.KJV: And their brothers of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
1CH.5.PLAIN: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.

1CH.5.BSB: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
1CH.5.KJV: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
1CH.5.PLAIN: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.

1CH.5.BSB: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
1CH.5.KJV: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
1CH.5.PLAIN: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.

1CH.5.BSB: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
1CH.5.KJV: And they dwelled in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, on their borders.
1CH.5.PLAIN: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.

1CH.5.BSB: All of them were reckoned in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
1CH.5.KJV: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel. ¶
1CH.5.PLAIN: All of them were reckoned in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.

1CH.5.BSB: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors—valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.
1CH.5.KJV: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and three score, that went out to the war.
1CH.5.PLAIN: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors—valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.

1CH.5.BSB: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
1CH.5.KJV: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
1CH.5.PLAIN: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

1CH.5.BSB: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
1CH.5.KJV: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was entreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
1CH.5.PLAIN: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.

1CH.5.BSB: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,
1CH.5.KJV: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
1CH.5.PLAIN: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,

1CH.5.BSB: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile.
1CH.5.KJV: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelled in their steads until the captivity. ¶
1CH.5.PLAIN: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile.

1CH.5.BSB: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
1CH.5.KJV: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelled in the land: they increased from Bashan to Baalhermon and Senir, and to mount Hermon.
1CH.5.PLAIN: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).

1CH.5.BSB: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel.
1CH.5.KJV: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers. ¶
1CH.5.PLAIN: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel.

1CH.5.BSB: They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their families. But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
1CH.5.KJV: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
1CH.5.PLAIN: They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their families. But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

1CH.5.BSB: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
1CH.5.KJV: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, to this day.
1CH.5.PLAIN: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.

1CH.6.BSB: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
1CH.6.KJV: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
1CH.6.PLAIN: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

1CH.6.BSB: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
1CH.6.KJV: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
1CH.6.PLAIN: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

1CH.6.BSB: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
1CH.6.KJV: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. ¶
1CH.6.PLAIN: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

1CH.6.BSB: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua,
1CH.6.KJV: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua,

1CH.6.BSB: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
1CH.6.KJV: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,

1CH.6.BSB: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
1CH.6.KJV: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,

1CH.6.BSB: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
1CH.6.KJV: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,

1CH.6.BSB: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
1CH.6.KJV: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,

1CH.6.BSB: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,
1CH.6.KJV: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,

1CH.6.BSB: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,
1CH.6.KJV: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
1CH.6.PLAIN: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,

1CH.6.BSB: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
1CH.6.KJV: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,

1CH.6.BSB: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum,
1CH.6.KJV: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum,

1CH.6.BSB: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
1CH.6.KJV: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,

1CH.6.BSB: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
1CH.6.KJV: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.

1CH.6.BSB: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
1CH.6.KJV: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar. ¶
1CH.6.PLAIN: Jehozadak went into captivity when the Lord sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

1CH.6.BSB: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
1CH.6.KJV: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
1CH.6.PLAIN: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

1CH.6.BSB: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
1CH.6.KJV: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
1CH.6.PLAIN: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

1CH.6.BSB: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
1CH.6.KJV: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
1CH.6.PLAIN: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

1CH.6.BSB: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
1CH.6.KJV: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
1CH.6.PLAIN: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:

1CH.6.BSB: Of Gershom:
1CH.6.KJV: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
1CH.6.PLAIN: Of Gershom:

1CH.9.KJV: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

1CH.9.PLAIN: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.

1CH.9.BSB: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.

1CH.9.PLAIN: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.

1CH.9.BSB: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.

1CH.9.BSB: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.

1CH.9.PLAIN: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.

1CH.9.KJV: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
1CH.9.PLAIN: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.

1CH.9.KJV: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

1CH.9.KJV: And in Gibeon dwelled the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife’s name was Maachah:
