1CH.10.BSB: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
1CH.10.KJV: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
1CH.10.PLAIN: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.

1CH.10.BSB: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
1CH.10.KJV: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
1CH.10.PLAIN: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

1CH.10.BSB: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
1CH.10.KJV: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
1CH.10.PLAIN: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.

1CH.10.BSB: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!” But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
1CH.10.KJV: Then said Saul to his armor bearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armor bearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell on it.
1CH.10.PLAIN: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!” But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

1CH.10.BSB: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.
1CH.10.KJV: And when his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
1CH.10.PLAIN: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.

1CH.10.BSB: So Saul died together with his three sons and all his house.
1CH.10.KJV: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
1CH.10.PLAIN: So Saul died together with his three sons and all his house.

1CH.10.BSB: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
1CH.10.KJV: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelled in them. ¶
1CH.10.PLAIN: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.

1CH.10.BSB: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
1CH.10.KJV: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
1CH.10.PLAIN: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

1CH.10.BSB: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
1CH.10.KJV: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings to their idols, and to the people.
1CH.10.PLAIN: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.

1CH.10.BSB: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
1CH.10.KJV: And they put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon. ¶
1CH.10.PLAIN: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.

1CH.10.BSB: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,
1CH.10.KJV: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
1CH.10.PLAIN: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,

1CH.10.BSB: all their men of valor set out and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
1CH.10.KJV: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days. ¶
1CH.10.PLAIN: all their men of valor set out and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.

1CH.10.BSB: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
1CH.10.KJV: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire of it;
1CH.10.PLAIN: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the Lord, because he did not keep the word of the Lord and even consulted a medium for guidance,

1CH.10.BSB: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
1CH.10.KJV: And inquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.
1CH.10.PLAIN: and he failed to inquire of the Lord. So the Lord put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

1CH.11.BSB: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
1CH.11.KJV: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.

1CH.11.BSB: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
1CH.11.KJV: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, you were he that led out and brought in Israel: and the LORD your God said to you, You shall feed my people Israel, and you shall be ruler over my people Israel.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the Lord your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”

1CH.11.BSB: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD through Samuel.
1CH.11.KJV: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel. ¶
1CH.11.PLAIN: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the Lord. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord through Samuel.

1CH.11.BSB: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
1CH.11.KJV: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.

1CH.11.BSB: The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
1CH.11.KJV: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, You shall not come here. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
1CH.11.PLAIN: The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).

1CH.11.BSB: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
1CH.11.KJV: And David said, Whoever smites the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.

1CH.11.BSB: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.
1CH.11.KJV: And David dwelled in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
1CH.11.PLAIN: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.

1CH.11.BSB: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
1CH.11.KJV: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
1CH.11.PLAIN: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.

1CH.11.BSB: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him.
1CH.11.KJV: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him. ¶
1CH.11.PLAIN: And David became greater and greater, for the Lord of Hosts was with him.

1CH.11.BSB: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
1CH.11.KJV: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

1CH.11.BSB: This is the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
1CH.11.KJV: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
1CH.11.PLAIN: This is the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed at one time.

1CH.11.BSB: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.
1CH.11.KJV: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.

1CH.11.BSB: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At the place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
1CH.11.KJV: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
1CH.11.PLAIN: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At the place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.

1CH.11.BSB: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
1CH.11.KJV: And they set themselves in the middle of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance. ¶
1CH.11.PLAIN: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the Lord brought about a great victory.

1CH.11.BSB: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David, to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
1CH.11.KJV: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David, to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

1CH.11.BSB: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
1CH.11.KJV: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Bethlehem.
1CH.11.PLAIN: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.

1CH.11.BSB: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
1CH.11.KJV: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
1CH.11.PLAIN: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”

1CH.11.BSB: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
1CH.11.KJV: And the three broke through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD.
1CH.11.PLAIN: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the Lord,

1CH.11.BSB: saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
1CH.11.KJV: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest. ¶
1CH.11.PLAIN: saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.

1CH.11.BSB: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
1CH.11.KJV: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.

1CH.11.BSB: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
1CH.11.KJV: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two; for he was their captain: however, he attained not to the first three.
1CH.11.PLAIN: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.

1CH.11.BSB: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
1CH.11.KJV: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lion like men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
1CH.11.PLAIN: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.

1CH.11.BSB: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
1CH.11.KJV: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
1CH.11.PLAIN: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.

1CH.11.BSB: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
1CH.11.KJV: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighty men.
1CH.11.PLAIN: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.

1CH.11.BSB: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
1CH.11.KJV: Behold, he was honorable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard. ¶
1CH.11.PLAIN: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.

1CH.11.BSB: Now these were the mighty men: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
1CH.11.KJV: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Now these were the mighty men: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

1CH.11.BSB: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
1CH.11.KJV: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

1CH.11.BSB: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
1CH.11.KJV: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

1CH.11.BSB: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
1CH.11.KJV: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

1CH.11.BSB: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,

1CH.11.PLAIN: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,

1CH.11.BSB: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

1CH.11.PLAIN: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

1CH.11.BSB: Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
1CH.11.KJV: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

1CH.11.BSB: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
1CH.11.KJV: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

1CH.11.PLAIN: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,

1CH.11.BSB: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
1CH.11.KJV: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,

1CH.11.BSB: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
1CH.11.KJV: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

1CH.11.BSB: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
1CH.11.KJV: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,

1CH.11.BSB: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
1CH.11.KJV: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,

1CH.11.BSB: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,

1CH.11.PLAIN: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,

1CH.11.BSB: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
1CH.11.KJV: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

1CH.11.BSB: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
1CH.11.KJV: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,

1CH.11.BSB: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
1CH.11.KJV: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,

1CH.11.BSB: Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
1CH.11.KJV: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

1CH.11.PLAIN: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

1CH.11.KJV: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite,

1CH.11.BSB: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,
1CH.11.KJV: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
1CH.11.PLAIN: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,

1CH.11.BSB: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
1CH.11.KJV: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
1CH.11.PLAIN: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

1CH.12.BSB: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;
1CH.12.KJV: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;

1CH.12.BSB: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):
1CH.12.KJV: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brothers of Benjamin.
1CH.12.PLAIN: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):

1CH.12.BSB: Ahiezer their chief and Joash, who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
1CH.12.KJV: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Ahiezer their chief and Joash, who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

1CH.12.BSB: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
1CH.12.KJV: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;

1CH.12.BSB: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
1CH.12.KJV: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

1CH.12.BSB: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;
1CH.12.KJV: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;

1CH.12.BSB: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
1CH.12.KJV: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
1CH.12.PLAIN: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

1CH.12.BSB: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the desert. They were mighty men of valor, trained for battle, experts with the shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:
1CH.12.KJV: And of the Gadites there separated themselves to David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes on the mountains;
1CH.12.PLAIN: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the desert. They were mighty men of valor, trained for battle, experts with the shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:

1CH.12.BSB: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
1CH.12.KJV: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,

1CH.12.BSB: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
1CH.12.KJV: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

1CH.12.BSB: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
1CH.12.KJV: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

1CH.12.BSB: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
1CH.12.KJV: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
1CH.12.PLAIN: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

1CH.12.BSB: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
1CH.12.KJV: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.

1CH.12.BSB: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
1CH.12.KJV: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
1CH.12.PLAIN: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.

1CH.12.BSB: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.
1CH.12.KJV: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
1CH.12.PLAIN: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.

1CH.12.BSB: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
1CH.12.KJV: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold to David.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.

1CH.12.BSB: And David went out to meet them, saying, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.”
1CH.12.KJV: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If you be come peaceably to me to help me, my heart shall be knit to you: but if you be come to betray me to my enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
1CH.12.PLAIN: And David went out to meet them, saying, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.”

1CH.12.BSB: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.
1CH.12.KJV: Then the spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Your are we, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse: peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.

1CH.12.BSB: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away, saying, “It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.”)
1CH.12.KJV: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines on advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away, saying, “It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.”)

1CH.12.BSB: When David went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.
1CH.12.KJV: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
1CH.12.PLAIN: When David went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.

1CH.12.BSB: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.
1CH.12.KJV: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valor, and were captains in the host.
1CH.12.PLAIN: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.

1CH.12.BSB: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
1CH.12.KJV: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God. ¶
1CH.12.PLAIN: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.

1CH.12.BSB: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the LORD:
1CH.12.KJV: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
1CH.12.PLAIN: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the Lord:

1CH.12.BSB: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.
1CH.12.KJV: The children of Judah that bore shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.

1CH.12.BSB: From Simeon: 7,100 mighty men of valor, ready for battle.
1CH.12.KJV: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Simeon: 7,100 mighty men of valor, ready for battle.

1CH.12.BSB: From Levi: 4,600,
1CH.12.KJV: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Levi: 4,600,

1CH.12.BSB: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
1CH.12.KJV: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
1CH.12.PLAIN: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,

1CH.12.BSB: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
1CH.12.KJV: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
1CH.12.PLAIN: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.

1CH.12.BSB: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
1CH.12.KJV: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for till now the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.

1CH.12.BSB: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
1CH.12.KJV: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.

1CH.12.BSB: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.
1CH.12.KJV: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.

1CH.12.BSB: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.
1CH.12.KJV: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their commandment.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.

1CH.12.BSB: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.
1CH.12.KJV: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.

1CH.12.BSB: From Naphtali: 1,000 commanders, accompanied by 37,000 men with shield and spear.
1CH.12.KJV: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Naphtali: 1,000 commanders, accompanied by 37,000 men with shield and spear.

1CH.12.BSB: From Dan: 28,600 prepared for battle.
1CH.12.KJV: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Dan: 28,600 prepared for battle.

1CH.12.BSB: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.
1CH.12.KJV: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
1CH.12.PLAIN: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.

1CH.12.BSB: And from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh there: 120,000 armed with every kind of weapon of war.
1CH.12.KJV: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

1CH.26.KJV: Also to Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valor.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families because they were strong, capable men.

1CH.26.BSB: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
1CH.26.KJV: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.

1CH.26.BSB: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.
1CH.26.KJV: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brothers, able men for strength for the service, were three score and two of Obededom.
1CH.26.PLAIN: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.

1CH.26.BSB: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.
1CH.26.KJV: And Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, strong men, eighteen.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.

1CH.26.BSB: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),
1CH.26.KJV: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
1CH.26.PLAIN: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),

1CH.26.BSB: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.
1CH.26.KJV: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.

1CH.26.BSB: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their brothers did.
1CH.26.KJV: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD. ¶
1CH.26.PLAIN: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the Lord, just as their brothers did.

1CH.26.BSB: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
1CH.26.KJV: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
1CH.26.PLAIN: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.

1CH.26.BSB: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
1CH.26.KJV: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
1CH.26.PLAIN: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.

1CH.26.BSB: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
1CH.26.KJV: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
1CH.26.PLAIN: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.

1CH.26.BSB: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah. There were guards stationed at every watch.
1CH.26.KJV: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
1CH.26.PLAIN: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah. There were guards stationed at every watch.

1CH.26.BSB: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
1CH.26.KJV: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.

1CH.26.BSB: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.
1CH.26.KJV: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
1CH.26.PLAIN: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.

1CH.26.BSB: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
1CH.26.KJV: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari. ¶
1CH.26.PLAIN: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.

1CH.26.BSB: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.
1CH.26.KJV: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.

1CH.26.BSB: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
1CH.26.KJV: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
1CH.26.PLAIN: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,

1CH.26.BSB: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
1CH.26.KJV: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
1CH.26.PLAIN: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the Lord.

1CH.26.BSB: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
1CH.26.KJV: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
1CH.26.PLAIN: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

1CH.26.BSB: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
1CH.26.KJV: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.

1CH.26.BSB: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
1CH.26.KJV: And his brothers by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
1CH.26.PLAIN: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

1CH.26.BSB: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.
1CH.26.KJV: Which Shelomith and his brothers were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
1CH.26.PLAIN: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.

1CH.26.BSB: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.
1CH.26.KJV: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
1CH.26.PLAIN: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the Lord.

1CH.26.BSB: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.
1CH.26.KJV: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brothers. ¶
1CH.26.PLAIN: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.

1CH.26.BSB: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
1CH.26.KJV: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
1CH.26.PLAIN: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.

1CH.26.BSB: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king.
1CH.26.KJV: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, men of valor, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
1CH.26.PLAIN: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the Lord and for the service of the king.

1CH.26.BSB: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.
1CH.26.KJV: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valor at Jazer of Gilead.
1CH.26.PLAIN: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.

1CH.26.BSB: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and to the affairs of the king.
1CH.26.KJV: And his brothers, men of valor, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
1CH.26.PLAIN: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and to the affairs of the king.

1CH.27.BSB: This is the list of the Israelites—the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty each month throughout the year. There were 24,000 men in each division:
1CH.27.KJV: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: This is the list of the Israelites—the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty each month throughout the year. There were 24,000 men in each division:

1CH.27.BSB: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month.
1CH.27.KJV: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
1CH.27.PLAIN: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month.

1CH.27.BSB: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The third army commander, as chief for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The third army commander, as chief for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
1CH.27.KJV: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
1CH.27.PLAIN: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
1CH.27.PLAIN: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
1CH.27.KJV: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand. ¶
1CH.27.PLAIN: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

1CH.27.BSB: These officers were in charge of the tribes of Israel: Over the Reubenites was Eliezer son of Zichri; over the Simeonites was Shephatiah son of Maacah;
1CH.27.KJV: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
1CH.27.PLAIN: These officers were in charge of the tribes of Israel: Over the Reubenites was Eliezer son of Zichri; over the Simeonites was Shephatiah son of Maacah;

1CH.27.BSB: over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron was Zadok;
1CH.27.KJV: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
1CH.27.PLAIN: over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron was Zadok;

1CH.27.BSB: over Judah was Elihu, one of David’s brothers; over Issachar was Omri son of Michael;
1CH.27.KJV: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
1CH.27.PLAIN: over Judah was Elihu, one of David’s brothers; over Issachar was Omri son of Michael;

1CH.27.BSB: over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel;
1CH.27.KJV: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
1CH.27.PLAIN: over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel;

1CH.27.BSB: over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah; over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah;
1CH.27.KJV: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
1CH.27.PLAIN: over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah; over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah;

1CH.27.BSB: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner;
1CH.27.KJV: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
1CH.27.PLAIN: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner;

1CH.27.BSB: and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
1CH.27.KJV: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel. ¶
1CH.27.PLAIN: and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

1CH.27.BSB: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.
1CH.27.KJV: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
1CH.27.PLAIN: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the Lord had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.

1CH.27.BSB: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. For because of this census wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.
1CH.27.KJV: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David. ¶
1CH.27.PLAIN: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. For because of this census wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.

1CH.27.BSB: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
1CH.27.KJV: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.

1CH.27.BSB: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.
1CH.27.KJV: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.

1CH.27.BSB: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
1CH.27.KJV: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.

1CH.27.BSB: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills. Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
1CH.27.KJV: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills. Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.

1CH.27.BSB: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
1CH.27.KJV: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.

1CH.27.BSB: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
1CH.27.KJV: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.

1CH.27.BSB: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these officials were in charge of King David’s property.
1CH.27.KJV: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.
1CH.27.PLAIN: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these officials were in charge of King David’s property.

1CH.27.BSB: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.
1CH.27.KJV: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counselor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:
1CH.27.PLAIN: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.

1CH.27.BSB: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
1CH.27.KJV: And Ahithophel was the king’s counselor: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion:
1CH.27.PLAIN: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.

1CH.27.BSB: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
1CH.27.KJV: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.
1CH.27.PLAIN: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king’s army.

1CH.28.BSB: Now David summoned all the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem: the leaders of the tribes, the leaders of the divisions in the king’s service, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and cattle of the king and his sons, along with the court officials and mighty men—every mighty man of valor.
1CH.28.KJV: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, to Jerusalem.
