EZR.4.BSB: Thus the construction of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and it remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
EZR.4.KJV: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased to the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
EZR.4.PLAIN: Thus the construction of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and it remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

EZR.5.BSB: Later, the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.
EZR.5.KJV: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even to them.
EZR.5.PLAIN: Later, the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.

EZR.5.BSB: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. And the prophets of God were with them, helping them.
EZR.5.KJV: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them. ¶
EZR.5.PLAIN: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. And the prophets of God were with them, helping them.

EZR.5.BSB: At that time Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates went to the Jews and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
EZR.5.KJV: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai and their companions, and said thus to them, Who has commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
EZR.5.PLAIN: At that time Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates went to the Jews and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”

EZR.5.BSB: They also asked, “What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?”
EZR.5.KJV: Then said we to them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
EZR.5.PLAIN: They also asked, “What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?”

EZR.5.BSB: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, so that they were not stopped until a report was sent to Darius and written instructions about this matter were returned.
EZR.5.KJV: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter. ¶
EZR.5.PLAIN: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, so that they were not stopped until a report was sent to Darius and written instructions about this matter were returned.

EZR.5.BSB: This is the text of the letter that Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates, the officials in the region, sent to King Darius.
EZR.5.KJV: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shetharboznai and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent to Darius the king:
EZR.5.PLAIN: This is the text of the letter that Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates, the officials in the region, sent to King Darius.

EZR.5.BSB: The report they sent him read as follows: To King Darius: All peace.
EZR.5.KJV: They sent a letter to him, wherein was written thus; To Darius the king, all peace.
EZR.5.PLAIN: The report they sent him read as follows: To King Darius: All peace.

EZR.5.BSB: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. The people are rebuilding it with large stones, and placing timbers in the walls. This work is being carried out diligently and is prospering in their hands.
EZR.5.KJV: Be it known to the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is built with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goes fast on, and prospers in their hands.
EZR.5.PLAIN: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. The people are rebuilding it with large stones, and placing timbers in the walls. This work is being carried out diligently and is prospering in their hands.

EZR.5.BSB: So we questioned the elders and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
EZR.5.KJV: Then asked we those elders, and said to them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
EZR.5.PLAIN: So we questioned the elders and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”

EZR.5.BSB: We also asked for their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.
EZR.5.KJV: We asked their names also, to certify you, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
EZR.5.PLAIN: We also asked for their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.

EZR.5.BSB: And this is the answer they returned: “We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.
EZR.5.KJV: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was built these many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and set up.
EZR.5.PLAIN: And this is the answer they returned: “We are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, which a great king of Israel built and completed.

EZR.5.BSB: But since our fathers angered the God of heaven, He delivered them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean who destroyed this temple and carried away the people to Babylon.
EZR.5.KJV: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven to wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
EZR.5.PLAIN: But since our fathers angered the God of heaven, He delivered them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean who destroyed this temple and carried away the people to Babylon.

EZR.5.BSB: In his first year, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.
EZR.5.KJV: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
EZR.5.PLAIN: In his first year, however, Cyrus king of Babylon issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

EZR.5.BSB: He also removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles belonging to the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken and carried there from the temple in Jerusalem. King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor
EZR.5.KJV: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered to one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
EZR.5.PLAIN: He also removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles belonging to the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken and carried there from the temple in Jerusalem. King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he appointed governor

EZR.5.BSB: and instructed, ‘Take these articles, put them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.’
EZR.5.KJV: And said to him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in his place.
EZR.5.PLAIN: and instructed, ‘Take these articles, put them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site.’

EZR.5.BSB: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been under construction, but it has not yet been completed.”
EZR.5.KJV: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now has it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
EZR.5.PLAIN: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem, and from that time until now it has been under construction, but it has not yet been completed.”

EZR.5.BSB: Now, therefore, if it pleases the king, let a search be made of the royal archives in Babylon to see if King Cyrus did indeed issue a decree to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.
EZR.5.KJV: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king’s treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
EZR.5.PLAIN: Now, therefore, if it pleases the king, let a search be made of the royal archives in Babylon to see if King Cyrus did indeed issue a decree to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.

EZR.6.BSB: Thus King Darius ordered a search of the archives stored in the treasury of Babylon.
EZR.6.KJV: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
EZR.6.PLAIN: Thus King Darius ordered a search of the archives stored in the treasury of Babylon.

EZR.6.BSB: And a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media, with the following written on it: Memorandum:
EZR.6.KJV: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
EZR.6.PLAIN: And a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media, with the following written on it: Memorandum:

EZR.6.BSB: In the first year of King Cyrus, he issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices, and let its foundations be firmly laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,
EZR.6.KJV: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be built, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof three score cubits, and the breadth thereof three score cubits;
EZR.6.PLAIN: In the first year of King Cyrus, he issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices, and let its foundations be firmly laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,

EZR.6.BSB: with three layers of cut stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid from the royal treasury.
EZR.6.KJV: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house:
EZR.6.PLAIN: with three layers of cut stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid from the royal treasury.

EZR.6.BSB: Furthermore, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon, must also be returned to the temple in Jerusalem and deposited in the house of God.
EZR.6.KJV: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, be restored, and brought again to the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
EZR.6.PLAIN: Furthermore, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon, must also be returned to the temple in Jerusalem and deposited in the house of God.

EZR.6.BSB: Therefore Darius decreed: To Tattenai governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and your associates and officials in the region: You must stay away from that place!
EZR.6.KJV: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be you far from there:
EZR.6.PLAIN: Therefore Darius decreed: To Tattenai governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and your associates and officials in the region: You must stay away from that place!

EZR.6.BSB: Leave this work on the house of God alone. Let the governor and elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site.
EZR.6.KJV: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
EZR.6.PLAIN: Leave this work on the house of God alone. Let the governor and elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site.

EZR.6.BSB: I hereby decree what you must do for these elders of the Jews who are rebuilding this house of God: The cost is to be paid in full to these men from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces west of the Euphrates, so that the work will not be hindered.
EZR.6.KJV: Moreover I make a decree what you shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, immediately expenses be given to these men, that they be not hindered.
EZR.6.PLAIN: I hereby decree what you must do for these elders of the Jews who are rebuilding this house of God: The cost is to be paid in full to these men from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces west of the Euphrates, so that the work will not be hindered.

EZR.6.BSB: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given to them daily without fail.
EZR.6.KJV: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
EZR.6.PLAIN: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given to them daily without fail.

EZR.6.BSB: Then they will be able to offer sacrifices of a sweet aroma to the God of heaven and to pray for the lives of the king and his sons.
EZR.6.KJV: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet smells to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
EZR.6.PLAIN: Then they will be able to offer sacrifices of a sweet aroma to the God of heaven and to pray for the lives of the king and his sons.

EZR.6.BSB: I also decree that if any man interferes with this directive, a beam is to be torn from his house and raised up, and he is to be impaled on it. And his own house shall be made a pile of rubble for this offense.
EZR.6.KJV: Also I have made a decree, that whoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
EZR.6.PLAIN: I also decree that if any man interferes with this directive, a beam is to be torn from his house and raised up, and he is to be impaled on it. And his own house shall be made a pile of rubble for this offense.

EZR.6.BSB: May God, who has caused His Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to alter this decree or to destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decree. Let it be carried out with diligence.
EZR.6.KJV: And the God that has caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed. ¶
EZR.6.PLAIN: May God, who has caused His Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to alter this decree or to destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decree. Let it be carried out with diligence.

EZR.6.BSB: In response, Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates diligently carried out what King Darius had decreed.
EZR.6.KJV: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
EZR.6.PLAIN: In response, Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates diligently carried out what King Darius had decreed.

EZR.6.BSB: So the Jewish elders built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo. They finished building according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.
EZR.6.KJV: And the elders of the Jews built, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they built, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
EZR.6.PLAIN: So the Jewish elders built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo. They finished building according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.

EZR.6.BSB: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
EZR.6.KJV: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king. ¶
EZR.6.PLAIN: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

EZR.6.BSB: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.
EZR.6.KJV: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.
EZR.6.PLAIN: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

EZR.6.BSB: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and a sin offering for all Israel of twelve male goats, one for each tribe of Israel.
EZR.6.KJV: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
EZR.6.PLAIN: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and a sin offering for all Israel of twelve male goats, one for each tribe of Israel.

EZR.6.BSB: They also appointed the priests by their divisions and the Levites by their groups to the service of God in Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.
EZR.6.KJV: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
EZR.6.PLAIN: They also appointed the priests by their divisions and the Levites by their groups to the service of God in Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.

EZR.6.BSB: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles kept the Passover.
EZR.6.KJV: And the children of the captivity kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
EZR.6.PLAIN: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles kept the Passover.

EZR.6.BSB: All the priests and Levites had purified themselves and were ceremonially clean. And the Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their priestly brothers, and for themselves.
EZR.6.KJV: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.
EZR.6.PLAIN: All the priests and Levites had purified themselves and were ceremonially clean. And the Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their priestly brothers, and for themselves.

EZR.6.BSB: The Israelites who had returned from exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD, the God of Israel.
EZR.6.KJV: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves to them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
EZR.6.PLAIN: The Israelites who had returned from exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the Lord, the God of Israel.

EZR.6.BSB: For seven days they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread with joy, because the LORD had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God of Israel.
EZR.6.KJV: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
EZR.6.PLAIN: For seven days they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread with joy, because the Lord had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God of Israel.

EZR.7.BSB: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
EZR.7.KJV: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
EZR.7.PLAIN: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

EZR.7.BSB: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
EZR.7.KJV: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
EZR.7.PLAIN: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

EZR.7.BSB: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
EZR.7.KJV: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
EZR.7.PLAIN: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

EZR.7.BSB: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
EZR.7.KJV: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
EZR.7.PLAIN: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

EZR.7.BSB: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—
EZR.7.KJV: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
EZR.7.PLAIN: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

EZR.7.BSB: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted Ezra all his requests, for the hand of the LORD his God was upon him.
EZR.7.KJV: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God on him.
EZR.7.PLAIN: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted Ezra all his requests, for the hand of the Lord his God was upon him.

EZR.7.BSB: So in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes, he went up to Jerusalem with some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and temple servants.
EZR.7.KJV: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
EZR.7.PLAIN: So in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes, he went up to Jerusalem with some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and temple servants.

EZR.7.BSB: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.
EZR.7.KJV: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
EZR.7.PLAIN: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.

EZR.7.BSB: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.
EZR.7.KJV: For on the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God on him.
EZR.7.PLAIN: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.

EZR.7.BSB: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel.
EZR.7.KJV: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments. ¶
EZR.7.PLAIN: For Ezra had devoted himself to study and to observe the law of the Lord, and to teach its statutes and judgments in Israel.

EZR.7.BSB: This is the text of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and scribe, an expert in the commandments and statutes of the LORD to Israel:
EZR.7.KJV: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
EZR.7.PLAIN: This is the text of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and scribe, an expert in the commandments and statutes of the Lord to Israel:

EZR.7.BSB: Artaxerxes, king of kings. To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.
EZR.7.KJV: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
EZR.7.PLAIN: Artaxerxes, king of kings. To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.

EZR.7.BSB: I hereby decree that any volunteers among the Israelites in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may go up with you to Jerusalem.
EZR.7.KJV: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with you.
EZR.7.PLAIN: I hereby decree that any volunteers among the Israelites in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may go up with you to Jerusalem.

EZR.7.BSB: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.
EZR.7.KJV: For as much as you are sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand;
EZR.7.PLAIN: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.

EZR.7.BSB: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,
EZR.7.KJV: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
EZR.7.PLAIN: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

EZR.7.BSB: together with all the silver and gold you may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God in Jerusalem.
EZR.7.KJV: And all the silver and gold that you can find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
EZR.7.PLAIN: together with all the silver and gold you may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God in Jerusalem.

EZR.7.BSB: With this money, therefore, you are to buy as many bulls, rams, and lambs as needed, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer them on the altar at the house of your God in Jerusalem.
EZR.7.KJV: That you may buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
EZR.7.PLAIN: With this money, therefore, you are to buy as many bulls, rams, and lambs as needed, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer them on the altar at the house of your God in Jerusalem.

EZR.7.BSB: You and your brothers may do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.
EZR.7.KJV: And whatever shall seem good to you, and to your brothers, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
EZR.7.PLAIN: You and your brothers may do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.

EZR.7.BSB: You must deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles given to you for the service of the house of your God.
EZR.7.KJV: The vessels also that are given you for the service of the house of your God, those deliver you before the God of Jerusalem.
EZR.7.PLAIN: You must deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles given to you for the service of the house of your God.

EZR.7.BSB: And if anything else is needed for the house of your God that you may have occasion to supply, you may pay for it from the royal treasury.
EZR.7.KJV: And whatever more shall be needful for the house of your God, which you shall have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.
EZR.7.PLAIN: And if anything else is needed for the house of your God that you may have occasion to supply, you may pay for it from the royal treasury.

EZR.7.BSB: I, King Artaxerxes, decree to all the treasurers west of the Euphrates: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it must be provided promptly,
EZR.7.KJV: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
EZR.7.PLAIN: I, King Artaxerxes, decree to all the treasurers west of the Euphrates: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it must be provided promptly,

EZR.7.BSB: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.
EZR.7.KJV: To an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
EZR.7.PLAIN: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.

EZR.7.BSB: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven must be done diligently for His house. For why should wrath fall on the realm of the king and his sons?
EZR.7.KJV: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
EZR.7.PLAIN: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven must be done diligently for His house. For why should wrath fall on the realm of the king and his sons?

EZR.7.BSB: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.
EZR.7.KJV: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, on them.
EZR.7.PLAIN: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.

EZR.7.BSB: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which you possess, are to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people west of the Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.
EZR.7.KJV: And you, Ezra, after the wisdom of your God, that is in your hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of your God; and teach you them that know them not.
EZR.7.PLAIN: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which you possess, are to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people west of the Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.

EZR.7.BSB: If anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, let a strict judgment be executed against him, whether death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.
EZR.7.KJV: And whoever will not do the law of your God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily on him, whether it be to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment. ¶
EZR.7.PLAIN: If anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, let a strict judgment be executed against him, whether death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

EZR.7.BSB: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put into the heart of the king to so honor the house of the LORD in Jerusalem,
EZR.7.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which has put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:
EZR.7.PLAIN: Blessed be the Lord, the God of our fathers, who has put into the heart of the king to so honor the house of the Lord in Jerusalem,

EZR.7.BSB: and who has shown me favor before the king, his counselors, and all his powerful officials. And because the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, I took courage and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with me.
EZR.7.KJV: And has extended mercy to me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was on me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
EZR.7.PLAIN: and who has shown me favor before the king, his counselors, and all his powerful officials. And because the hand of the Lord my God was upon me, I took courage and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with me.

EZR.8.BSB: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:
EZR.8.KJV: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
EZR.8.PLAIN: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel;
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of David, Hattush of the descendants of Shecaniah; from the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men;
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of David, Hattush of the descendants of Shecaniah; from the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Pahath-Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Pahath-Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and three score males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;

EZR.8.BSB: from the later descendants of Adonikam, these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them three score males.
EZR.8.PLAIN: from the later descendants of Adonikam, these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;

EZR.8.BSB: and from the descendants of Bigvai, both Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men.
EZR.8.KJV: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males. ¶
EZR.8.PLAIN: and from the descendants of Bigvai, both Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men.

EZR.8.BSB: Now I assembled these exiles at the canal that flows to Ahava, and we camped there three days. And when I searched among the people and priests, I found no Levites there.
EZR.8.KJV: And I gathered them together to the river that runs to Ahava; and there stayed we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
EZR.8.PLAIN: Now I assembled these exiles at the canal that flows to Ahava, and we camped there three days. And when I searched among the people and priests, I found no Levites there.

EZR.8.BSB: Then I summoned the leaders: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, as well as the teachers Joiarib and Elnathan.
EZR.8.KJV: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
EZR.8.PLAIN: Then I summoned the leaders: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, as well as the teachers Joiarib and Elnathan.

EZR.8.BSB: And I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, with a message for him and his kinsmen, the temple servants at Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.
EZR.8.KJV: And I sent them with commandment to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say to Iddo, and to his brothers the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.
EZR.8.PLAIN: And I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, with a message for him and his kinsmen, the temple servants at Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

EZR.8.BSB: And since the gracious hand of our God was upon us, they brought us Sherebiah—a man of insight from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel—along with his sons and brothers, 18 men;
EZR.8.KJV: And by the good hand of our God on us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brothers, eighteen;
EZR.8.PLAIN: And since the gracious hand of our God was upon us, they brought us Sherebiah—a man of insight from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel—along with his sons and brothers, 18 men;

EZR.8.BSB: also Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah, from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and their sons, 20 men.
EZR.8.KJV: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
EZR.8.PLAIN: also Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah, from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and their sons, 20 men.

EZR.8.BSB: They also brought 220 of the temple servants, all designated by name. David and the officials had appointed them to assist the Levites.
EZR.8.KJV: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name. ¶
EZR.8.PLAIN: They also brought 220 of the temple servants, all designated by name. David and the officials had appointed them to assist the Levites.

EZR.8.BSB: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.
EZR.8.KJV: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
EZR.8.PLAIN: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

EZR.8.BSB: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”
EZR.8.KJV: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken to the king, saying, The hand of our God is on all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
EZR.8.PLAIN: We had told the king, 'The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him.'

EZR.8.BSB: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.
EZR.8.KJV: So we fasted and sought our God for this: and he was entreated of us. ¶
EZR.8.PLAIN: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request.

EZR.8.BSB: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,
EZR.8.KJV: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
EZR.8.PLAIN: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,

EZR.8.BSB: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.
EZR.8.KJV: And weighed to them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
EZR.8.PLAIN: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.

EZR.8.BSB: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, articles of silver weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,
EZR.8.KJV: I even weighed to their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
EZR.8.PLAIN: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, articles of silver weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,

EZR.8.BSB: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.
EZR.8.KJV: Also twenty basins of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
EZR.8.PLAIN: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.

EZR.8.BSB: Then I told them, “You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.
EZR.8.KJV: And I said to them, You are holy to the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to the LORD God of your fathers.
EZR.8.PLAIN: Then I told them, “You are holy to the Lord, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the Lord, the God of your fathers.

EZR.8.BSB: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.”
EZR.8.KJV: Watch you, and keep them, until you weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
EZR.8.PLAIN: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.”

EZR.8.BSB: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.
EZR.8.KJV: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God. ¶
EZR.8.PLAIN: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

EZR.8.BSB: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.
EZR.8.KJV: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
EZR.8.PLAIN: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way.

EZR.8.BSB: So we arrived at Jerusalem and rested there for three days.
EZR.8.KJV: And we came to Jerusalem, and stayed there three days. ¶
EZR.8.PLAIN: So we arrived at Jerusalem and rested there for three days.

EZR.8.BSB: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and sacred articles into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, along with the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
EZR.8.KJV: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
EZR.8.PLAIN: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and sacred articles into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, along with the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.

EZR.8.BSB: Everything was verified by number and weight, and the total weight was recorded at that time.
EZR.8.KJV: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
EZR.8.PLAIN: Everything was verified by number and weight, and the total weight was recorded at that time.

EZR.8.BSB: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: 12 bulls for all Israel, 96 rams, 77 lambs, and a sin offering of 12 male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.
EZR.8.KJV: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering to the LORD. ¶
EZR.8.PLAIN: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: 12 bulls for all Israel, 96 rams, 77 lambs, and a sin offering of 12 male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the Lord.

EZR.8.BSB: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates, who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God.
EZR.8.KJV: And they delivered the king’s commissions to the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
EZR.8.PLAIN: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates, who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God.

EZR.9.BSB: After these things had been accomplished, the leaders approached me and said, “The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.
EZR.9.KJV: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
EZR.9.PLAIN: After these things had been accomplished, the leaders approached me and said, “The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.

EZR.9.BSB: Indeed, the Israelites have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the people of the land. And the leaders and officials have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness!”
EZR.9.KJV: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yes, the hand of the princes and rulers has been chief in this trespass.
EZR.9.PLAIN: Indeed, the Israelites have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the people of the land. And the leaders and officials have taken the lead in this unfaithfulness!”

EZR.9.BSB: When I heard this report, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled out some hair from my head and beard, and sat down in horror.
EZR.9.KJV: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonished.
EZR.9.PLAIN: When I heard this report, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled out some hair from my head and beard, and sat down in horror.

EZR.9.BSB: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of the unfaithfulness of the exiles, while I sat there in horror until the evening offering.
EZR.9.KJV: Then were assembled to me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonished until the evening sacrifice. ¶
EZR.9.PLAIN: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of the unfaithfulness of the exiles, while I sat there in horror until the evening offering.

EZR.9.BSB: At the evening offering, I got up from my humiliation with my tunic and cloak torn, and I fell on my knees, spread out my hands to the LORD my God,
EZR.9.KJV: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell on my knees, and spread out my hands to the LORD my God,
EZR.9.PLAIN: At the evening offering, I got up from my humiliation with my tunic and cloak torn, and I fell on my knees, spread out my hands to the Lord my God,

EZR.9.BSB: and said: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
EZR.9.KJV: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to you, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up to the heavens.
EZR.9.PLAIN: and said: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.

EZR.9.BSB: From the days of our fathers to this day, our guilt has been great. Because of our iniquities, we and our kings and priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the earth and put to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation, as we are this day.
EZR.9.KJV: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass to this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
EZR.9.PLAIN: From the days of our fathers to this day, our guilt has been great. Because of our iniquities, we and our kings and priests have been delivered into the hands of the kings of the earth and put to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation, as we are this day.

EZR.9.BSB: But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the LORD our God to preserve for us a remnant and to give us a stake in His holy place. Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.
EZR.9.KJV: And now for a little space grace has been showed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
EZR.9.PLAIN: But now, for a brief moment, grace has come from the Lord our God to preserve for us a remnant and to give us a stake in His holy place. Even in our bondage, our God has given us new life and light to our eyes.

EZR.9.BSB: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia, giving us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and giving us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.
EZR.9.KJV: For we were slaves; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended mercy to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
EZR.9.PLAIN: Though we are slaves, our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but He has extended to us grace in the sight of the kings of Persia, giving us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and giving us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.

EZR.9.BSB: And now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commandments
EZR.9.KJV: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken your commandments,
EZR.9.PLAIN: And now, our God, what can we say after this? For we have forsaken the commandments

EZR.9.BSB: that You gave through Your servants the prophets, saying: ‘The land that you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the impurity of its peoples and the abominations with which they have filled it from end to end.
EZR.9.KJV: Which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, The land, to which you go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
EZR.9.PLAIN: that You gave through Your servants the prophets, saying: ‘The land that you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the impurity of its peoples and the abominations with which they have filled it from end to end.

EZR.9.BSB: Now, therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Never seek their peace or prosperity, so that you may be strong and may eat the good things of the land, leaving it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’
EZR.9.KJV: Now therefore give not your daughters to their sons, neither take their daughters to your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that you may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
EZR.9.PLAIN: Now, therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Never seek their peace or prosperity, so that you may be strong and may eat the good things of the land, leaving it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’

EZR.9.BSB: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
EZR.9.KJV: And after all that is come on us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that you our God have punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and have given us such deliverance as this;
EZR.9.PLAIN: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),

EZR.9.BSB: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who commit these abominations? Would You not become so angry with us as to wipe us out, leaving no remnant or survivor?
EZR.9.KJV: Should we again break your commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? would not you be angry with us till you had consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
EZR.9.PLAIN: shall we again break Your commandments and intermarry with the peoples who commit these abominations? Would You not become so angry with us as to wipe us out, leaving no remnant or survivor?

EZR.9.BSB: O LORD, God of Israel, You are righteous! For we remain this day as a remnant. Here we are before You in our guilt, though because of it no one can stand before You.”
EZR.9.KJV: O LORD God of Israel, you are righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before you in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before you because of this.
EZR.9.PLAIN: O Lord, God of Israel, You are righteous! For we remain this day as a remnant. Here we are before You in our guilt, though because of it no one can stand before You.”

EZR.10.BSB: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and falling facedown before the house of God, a very large assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly as well.
EZR.10.KJV: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled to him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
EZR.10.PLAIN: While Ezra prayed and made this confession, weeping and falling facedown before the house of God, a very large assembly of Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him, and the people wept bitterly as well.

EZR.10.BSB: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, said to Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.
EZR.10.KJV: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said to Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
EZR.10.PLAIN: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, an Elamite, said to Ezra: “We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the people of the land, yet in spite of this, there is hope for Israel.

EZR.10.BSB: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.
EZR.10.KJV: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
EZR.10.PLAIN: So now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all the foreign wives and their children, according to the counsel of my lord and of those who tremble at the command of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

EZR.10.BSB: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action!”
EZR.10.KJV: Arise; for this matter belongs to you: we also will be with you: be of good courage, and do it.
EZR.10.PLAIN: Get up, for this matter is your responsibility, and we will support you. Be strong and take action!”

EZR.10.BSB: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said. And they took the oath.
EZR.10.KJV: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they swore. ¶
EZR.10.PLAIN: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said. And they took the oath.

EZR.10.BSB: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and walked to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. And while he stayed there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.
EZR.10.KJV: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
EZR.10.PLAIN: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and walked to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. And while he stayed there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he was mourning over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

EZR.10.BSB: And a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles should gather at Jerusalem.
EZR.10.KJV: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together to Jerusalem;
EZR.10.PLAIN: And a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the exiles should gather at Jerusalem.

EZR.10.BSB: Whoever failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, according to the counsel of the leaders and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.
EZR.10.KJV: And that whoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away. ¶
EZR.10.PLAIN: Whoever failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, according to the counsel of the leaders and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.

EZR.10.BSB: So within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem, and on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the square at the house of God, trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain.
EZR.10.KJV: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together to Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
EZR.10.PLAIN: So within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin assembled in Jerusalem, and on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people sat in the square at the house of God, trembling regarding this matter and because of the heavy rain.

EZR.10.BSB: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.
EZR.10.KJV: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said to them, You have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
EZR.10.PLAIN: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.

EZR.10.BSB: Now, therefore, make a confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives.”
EZR.10.KJV: Now therefore make confession to the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
EZR.10.PLAIN: Now, therefore, make a confession to the Lord, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the people of the land and from your foreign wives.”

EZR.10.BSB: And the whole assembly responded in a loud voice: “Truly we must do as you say!
EZR.10.KJV: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As you have said, so must we do.
EZR.10.PLAIN: And the whole assembly responded in a loud voice: “Truly we must do as you say!

EZR.10.BSB: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.
EZR.10.KJV: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
EZR.10.PLAIN: But there are many people here, and it is the rainy season. We are not able to stay out in the open. Nor is this the work of one or two days, for we have transgressed greatly in this matter.

EZR.10.BSB: Let our leaders represent the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.”
EZR.10.KJV: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us. ¶
EZR.10.PLAIN: Let our leaders represent the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at an appointed time, together with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us.”
