PSA.27.KJV: Teach me your way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of my enemies.
PSA.27.PLAIN: Teach me Your way, O Lord, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.

PSA.27.BSB: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
PSA.27.KJV: Deliver me not over to the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
PSA.27.PLAIN: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

PSA.27.BSB: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
PSA.27.KJV: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
PSA.27.PLAIN: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

PSA.27.BSB: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
PSA.27.KJV: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
PSA.27.PLAIN: Wait patiently for the Lord; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the Lord!

PSA.28.BSB: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
PSA.28.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David. To you will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Of David. To You, O Lord, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.

PSA.28.BSB: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
PSA.28.KJV: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy oracle.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

PSA.28.BSB: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
PSA.28.KJV: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of brokenness, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.

PSA.28.BSB: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
PSA.28.KJV: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavors: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.

PSA.28.BSB: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
PSA.28.KJV: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Since they show no regard for the works of the Lord or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.

PSA.28.BSB: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
PSA.28.KJV: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my supplications.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Blessed be the Lord, for He has heard my cry for mercy.

PSA.28.BSB: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
PSA.28.KJV: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song will I praise him.
PSA.28.PLAIN: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

PSA.28.BSB: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
PSA.28.KJV: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
PSA.28.PLAIN: The Lord is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

PSA.28.BSB: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
PSA.28.KJV: Save your people, and bless your inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
PSA.28.PLAIN: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.

PSA.29.BSB: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
PSA.29.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David. Give to the LORD, O you mighty, give to the LORD glory and strength.
PSA.29.PLAIN: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the Lord, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

PSA.29.BSB: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
PSA.29.KJV: Give to the LORD the glory due to his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
PSA.29.PLAIN: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due His name; worship the Lord in the splendor of His holiness.

PSA.29.BSB: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
PSA.29.KJV: The voice of the LORD is on the waters: the God of glory thunders: the LORD is on many waters.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the Lord is heard over many waters.

PSA.29.BSB: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
PSA.29.KJV: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.

PSA.29.BSB: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
PSA.29.KJV: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; yes, the LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

PSA.29.BSB: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
PSA.29.KJV: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
PSA.29.PLAIN: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

PSA.29.BSB: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
PSA.29.KJV: The voice of the LORD divides the flames of fire.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The voice of the Lord strikes with flames of fire.

PSA.29.BSB: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
PSA.29.KJV: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.

PSA.29.BSB: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
PSA.29.KJV: The voice of the LORD makes the hinds to calve, and discovers the forests: and in his temple does every one speak of his glory.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The voice of the Lord twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”

PSA.29.BSB: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
PSA.29.KJV: The LORD sits on the flood; yes, the LORD sits King for ever.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

PSA.29.BSB: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
PSA.29.KJV: The LORD will give strength to his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
PSA.29.PLAIN: The Lord gives His people strength; the Lord blesses His people with peace.

PSA.30.BSB: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
PSA.30.KJV: ¶ A Psalm, and song at the dedication of the house of David. I will extol you, O LORD; for you have lifted me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
PSA.30.PLAIN: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O Lord, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

PSA.30.BSB: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
PSA.30.KJV: O LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
PSA.30.PLAIN: O Lord my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

PSA.30.BSB: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
PSA.30.KJV: O LORD, you have brought up my soul from the grave: you have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
PSA.30.PLAIN: O Lord, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.

PSA.30.BSB: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
PSA.30.KJV: Sing to the LORD, O you saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
PSA.30.PLAIN: Sing to the Lord, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.

PSA.30.BSB: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
PSA.30.KJV: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favor is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
PSA.30.PLAIN: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

PSA.30.BSB: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
PSA.30.KJV: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
PSA.30.PLAIN: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”

PSA.30.BSB: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
PSA.30.KJV: LORD, by your favor you have made my mountain to stand strong: you did hide your face, and I was troubled.
PSA.30.PLAIN: O Lord, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

PSA.30.BSB: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
PSA.30.KJV: I cried to you, O LORD; and to the LORD I made supplication.
PSA.30.PLAIN: To You, O Lord, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:

PSA.30.BSB: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
PSA.30.KJV: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? shall it declare your truth?
PSA.30.PLAIN: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?

PSA.30.BSB: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
PSA.30.KJV: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy on me: LORD, be you my helper.
PSA.30.PLAIN: Hear me, O Lord, and have mercy; O Lord, be my helper.”

PSA.30.BSB: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
PSA.30.KJV: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing: you have put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
PSA.30.PLAIN: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

PSA.30.BSB: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
PSA.30.KJV: To the end that my glory may sing praise to you, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks to you for ever.
PSA.30.PLAIN: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks forever.

PSA.31.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
PSA.31.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In you, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in your righteousness.
PSA.31.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O Lord, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.

PSA.31.BSB: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
PSA.31.KJV: Bow down your ear to me; deliver me speedily: be you my strong rock, for an house of defense to save me.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.

PSA.31.BSB: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
PSA.31.KJV: For you are my rock and my fortress; therefore for your name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
PSA.31.PLAIN: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.

PSA.31.BSB: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
PSA.31.KJV: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privately for me: for you are my strength.
PSA.31.PLAIN: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.

PSA.31.BSB: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
PSA.31.KJV: Into your hand I commit my spirit: you have redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O Lord, God of truth.

PSA.31.BSB: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
PSA.31.KJV: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
PSA.31.PLAIN: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the Lord I trust.

PSA.31.BSB: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
PSA.31.KJV: I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy: for you have considered my trouble; you have known my soul in adversities;
PSA.31.PLAIN: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.

PSA.31.BSB: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
PSA.31.KJV: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: you have set my feet in a large room.
PSA.31.PLAIN: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.

PSA.31.BSB: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
PSA.31.KJV: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, yes, my soul and my belly.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.

PSA.31.BSB: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
PSA.31.KJV: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
PSA.31.PLAIN: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my brokenness has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.

PSA.31.BSB: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
PSA.31.KJV: I was a reproach among all my enemies, but especially among my neighbors, and a fear to my acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.

PSA.31.BSB: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
PSA.31.KJV: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
PSA.31.PLAIN: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.

PSA.31.BSB: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
PSA.31.KJV: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
PSA.31.PLAIN: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.

PSA.31.BSB: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
PSA.31.KJV: But I trusted in you, O LORD: I said, You are my God.
PSA.31.PLAIN: But I trust in You, O Lord; I say, “You are my God.”

PSA.31.BSB: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
PSA.31.KJV: My times are in your hand: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from them that persecute me.
PSA.31.PLAIN: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

PSA.31.BSB: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
PSA.31.KJV: Make your face to shine on your servant: save me for your mercies’ sake.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.

PSA.31.BSB: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
PSA.31.KJV: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called on you: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
PSA.31.PLAIN: O Lord, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.

PSA.31.BSB: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
PSA.31.KJV: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
PSA.31.PLAIN: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.

PSA.31.BSB: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
PSA.31.KJV: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for them that fear you; which you have worked for them that trust in you before the sons of men!
PSA.31.PLAIN: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!

PSA.31.BSB: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
PSA.31.KJV: You shall hide them in the secret of your presence from the pride of man: you shall keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
PSA.31.PLAIN: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

PSA.31.BSB: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
PSA.31.KJV: Blessed be the LORD: for he has showed me his marvelous kindness in a strong city.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Blessed be the Lord, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.

PSA.31.BSB: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
PSA.31.KJV: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before your eyes: nevertheless you heard the voice of my supplications when I cried to you.
PSA.31.PLAIN: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.

PSA.31.BSB: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
PSA.31.KJV: O love the LORD, all you his saints: for the LORD preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewards the proud doer.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Love the Lord, all His saints. The Lord preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.

PSA.31.BSB: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
PSA.31.KJV: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all you that hope in the LORD.
PSA.31.PLAIN: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the Lord.

PSA.32.BSB: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
PSA.32.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David, Maschil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose wanderings and failures are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

PSA.32.BSB: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
PSA.32.KJV: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD imputes not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Blessed is the man whose brokenness the Lord does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

PSA.32.BSB: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
PSA.32.KJV: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
PSA.32.PLAIN: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.

PSA.32.BSB: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
PSA.32.KJV: For day and night your hand was heavy on me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
PSA.32.PLAIN: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah

PSA.32.BSB: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
PSA.32.KJV: I acknowledge my sin to you, and my iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD; and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my brokenness. I said, “I will confess my wanderings and failures to the Lord,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

PSA.32.BSB: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
PSA.32.KJV: For this shall every one that is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come near to him.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.

PSA.32.BSB: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
PSA.32.KJV: You are my hiding place; you shall preserve me from trouble; you shall compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
PSA.32.PLAIN: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

PSA.32.BSB: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
PSA.32.KJV: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go: I will guide you with my eye.
PSA.32.PLAIN: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.

PSA.32.BSB: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
PSA.32.KJV: Be you not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near to you.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.

PSA.32.BSB: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
PSA.32.KJV: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusts in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the Lord.

PSA.32.BSB: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
PSA.32.KJV: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous: and shout for joy, all you that are upright in heart.
PSA.32.PLAIN: Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

PSA.33.BSB: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
PSA.33.KJV: Rejoice in the LORD, O you righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
PSA.33.PLAIN: Rejoice in the Lord, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.

PSA.33.BSB: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
PSA.33.KJV: Praise the LORD with harp: sing to him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
PSA.33.PLAIN: Praise the Lord with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.

PSA.33.BSB: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
PSA.33.KJV: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with a loud noise.
PSA.33.PLAIN: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.

PSA.33.BSB: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
PSA.33.KJV: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
PSA.33.PLAIN: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.

PSA.33.BSB: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
PSA.33.KJV: He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
PSA.33.PLAIN: The Lord loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.

PSA.33.BSB: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
PSA.33.KJV: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
PSA.33.PLAIN: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

PSA.33.BSB: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
PSA.33.KJV: He gathers the waters of the sea together as an heap: he lays up the depth in storehouses.
PSA.33.PLAIN: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.

PSA.33.BSB: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
PSA.33.KJV: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
PSA.33.PLAIN: Let all the earth fear the Lord; let all the people of the world revere Him.

PSA.33.BSB: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
PSA.33.KJV: For he spoke, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
PSA.33.PLAIN: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

PSA.33.BSB: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
PSA.33.KJV: The LORD brings the counsel of the heathen to nothing: he makes the devices of the people of none effect.
PSA.33.PLAIN: The Lord frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.

PSA.33.BSB: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
PSA.33.KJV: The counsel of the LORD stands for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
PSA.33.PLAIN: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.

PSA.33.BSB: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
PSA.33.KJV: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD; and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
PSA.33.PLAIN: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!

PSA.33.BSB: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
PSA.33.KJV: The LORD looks from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.
PSA.33.PLAIN: The Lord looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.

PSA.33.BSB: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
PSA.33.KJV: From the place of his habitation he looks on all the inhabitants of the earth.
PSA.33.PLAIN: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.

PSA.33.BSB: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
PSA.33.KJV: He fashions their hearts alike; he considers all their works.
PSA.33.PLAIN: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.

PSA.33.BSB: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
PSA.33.KJV: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
PSA.33.PLAIN: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.

PSA.33.BSB: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
PSA.33.KJV: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
PSA.33.PLAIN: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.

PSA.33.BSB: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
PSA.33.KJV: Behold, the eye of the LORD is on them that fear him, on them that hope in his mercy;
PSA.33.PLAIN: Surely the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion

PSA.33.BSB: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
PSA.33.KJV: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
PSA.33.PLAIN: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

PSA.33.BSB: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
PSA.33.KJV: Our soul waits for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
PSA.33.PLAIN: Our soul waits for the Lord; He is our help and our shield.

PSA.33.BSB: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
PSA.33.KJV: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
PSA.33.PLAIN: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.

PSA.33.BSB: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
PSA.33.KJV: Let your mercy, O LORD, be on us, according as we hope in you.
PSA.33.PLAIN: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O Lord, as we put our hope in You.

PSA.34.BSB: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
PSA.34.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech: who drove him away and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.

PSA.34.BSB: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
PSA.34.KJV: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
PSA.34.PLAIN: My soul boasts in the Lord; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

PSA.34.BSB: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
PSA.34.KJV: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Magnify the Lord with me; let us exalt His name together.

PSA.34.BSB: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
PSA.34.KJV: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
PSA.34.PLAIN: I sought the Lord, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

PSA.34.BSB: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
PSA.34.KJV: They looked to him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.

PSA.34.BSB: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
PSA.34.KJV: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
PSA.34.PLAIN: This poor man called out, and the Lord heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.

PSA.34.BSB: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
PSA.34.KJV: The angel of the LORD encamps round about them that fear him, and delivers them.
PSA.34.PLAIN: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.

PSA.34.BSB: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
PSA.34.KJV: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusts in him.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!

PSA.34.BSB: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
PSA.34.KJV: O fear the LORD, you his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Fear the Lord, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.

PSA.34.BSB: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
PSA.34.KJV: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

PSA.34.BSB: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
PSA.34.KJV: Come, you children, listen to me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

PSA.34.BSB: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
PSA.34.KJV: What man is he that desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
PSA.34.PLAIN: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?

PSA.34.BSB: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
PSA.34.KJV: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.

PSA.34.BSB: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
PSA.34.KJV: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

PSA.34.BSB: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
PSA.34.KJV: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry.
PSA.34.PLAIN: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.

PSA.34.BSB: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
PSA.34.KJV: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
PSA.34.PLAIN: But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.

PSA.34.BSB: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
PSA.34.KJV: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
PSA.34.PLAIN: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.

PSA.34.BSB: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
PSA.34.KJV: The LORD is near to them that are of a broken heart; and saves such as be of a contrite spirit.
PSA.34.PLAIN: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

PSA.34.BSB: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
PSA.34.KJV: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivers him out of them all.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him from them all.

PSA.34.BSB: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
PSA.34.KJV: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.
PSA.34.PLAIN: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.

PSA.34.BSB: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
PSA.34.KJV: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
PSA.34.PLAIN: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.

PSA.34.BSB: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
PSA.34.KJV: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
PSA.34.PLAIN: The Lord redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.

PSA.35.BSB: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
PSA.35.KJV: ¶ Psalm of David. Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O Lord; fight against those who fight against me.

PSA.35.BSB: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
PSA.35.KJV: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

PSA.35.BSB: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
PSA.35.KJV: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say to my soul, I am your salvation.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”

PSA.35.BSB: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
PSA.35.KJV: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
PSA.35.PLAIN: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.

PSA.35.BSB: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
PSA.35.KJV: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
PSA.35.PLAIN: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the Lord drives them away.

PSA.35.BSB: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
PSA.35.KJV: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
PSA.35.PLAIN: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the Lord pursues.

PSA.35.BSB: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
PSA.35.KJV: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have dig for my soul.
PSA.35.PLAIN: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.

PSA.35.BSB: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
PSA.35.KJV: Let destruction come on him at unawares; and let his net that he has hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
PSA.35.PLAIN: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.

PSA.35.BSB: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
PSA.35.KJV: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord and exult in His salvation.

PSA.35.BSB: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
PSA.35.KJV: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like to you, which deliver the poor from him that is too strong for him, yes, the poor and the needy from him that spoils him?
PSA.35.PLAIN: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O Lord, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”

PSA.35.BSB: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
PSA.35.KJV: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.

PSA.35.BSB: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
PSA.35.KJV: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
PSA.35.PLAIN: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.

PSA.35.BSB: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
PSA.35.KJV: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.

PSA.35.BSB: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
PSA.35.KJV: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourns for his mother.
PSA.35.PLAIN: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.

PSA.35.BSB: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
PSA.35.KJV: But in my adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yes, the attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
PSA.35.PLAIN: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.

PSA.35.BSB: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
PSA.35.KJV: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed on me with their teeth.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

PSA.35.BSB: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
PSA.35.KJV: Lord, how long will you look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
PSA.35.PLAIN: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

PSA.35.BSB: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
PSA.35.KJV: I will give you thanks in the great congregation: I will praise you among much people.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.

PSA.35.BSB: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
PSA.35.KJV: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.

PSA.35.BSB: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
PSA.35.KJV: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
PSA.35.PLAIN: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.

PSA.35.BSB: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
PSA.35.KJV: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.
PSA.35.PLAIN: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”

PSA.35.BSB: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
PSA.35.KJV: This you have seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
PSA.35.PLAIN: O Lord, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.

PSA.35.BSB: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
PSA.35.KJV: Stir up yourself, and awake to my judgment, even to my cause, my God and my Lord.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!

PSA.35.BSB: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
PSA.35.KJV: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to your righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O Lord my God, and do not let them gloat over me.

PSA.35.BSB: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
PSA.35.KJV: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”

PSA.35.BSB: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
PSA.35.KJV: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonor that magnify themselves against me.
PSA.35.PLAIN: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.

PSA.35.BSB: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
PSA.35.KJV: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favor my righteous cause: yes, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
PSA.35.PLAIN: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the Lord who delights in His servant’s well-being.”

PSA.35.BSB: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
PSA.35.KJV: And my tongue shall speak of your righteousness and of your praise all the day long.
PSA.35.PLAIN: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.

PSA.36.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
PSA.36.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. The transgression of the wicked says within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
PSA.36.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the Lord. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

PSA.36.BSB: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
PSA.36.KJV: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
PSA.36.PLAIN: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.

PSA.36.BSB: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
PSA.36.KJV: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off to be wise, and to do good.
PSA.36.PLAIN: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.

PSA.36.BSB: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
PSA.36.KJV: He devises mischief on his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he abhors not evil.
PSA.36.PLAIN: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.

PSA.36.BSB: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
PSA.36.KJV: Your mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
PSA.36.PLAIN: Your loving devotion, O Lord, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.

PSA.36.BSB: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
PSA.36.KJV: Your righteousness is like the great mountains; your judgments are a great deep: O LORD, you preserve man and beast.
PSA.36.PLAIN: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O Lord, You preserve man and beast.

PSA.36.BSB: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
PSA.36.KJV: How excellent is your loving kindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings.
PSA.36.PLAIN: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!

PSA.36.BSB: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
PSA.36.KJV: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house; and you shall make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
PSA.36.PLAIN: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.

PSA.36.BSB: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
PSA.36.KJV: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.
PSA.36.PLAIN: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.

PSA.36.BSB: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
PSA.36.KJV: O continue your loving kindness to them that know you; and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
PSA.36.PLAIN: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.

PSA.36.BSB: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
PSA.36.KJV: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
PSA.36.PLAIN: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

PSA.36.BSB: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
PSA.36.KJV: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
PSA.36.PLAIN: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.

PSA.37.BSB: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
PSA.37.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David. Fret not yourself because of evildoers, neither be you envious against the workers of iniquity.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.

PSA.37.BSB: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
PSA.37.KJV: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
PSA.37.PLAIN: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.

PSA.37.BSB: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
PSA.37.KJV: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shall you dwell in the land, and truly you shall be fed.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.

PSA.37.BSB: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
PSA.37.KJV: Delight yourself also in the LORD: and he shall give you the desires of your heart.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Delight yourself in the Lord, and He will give you the desires of your heart.

PSA.37.BSB: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
PSA.37.KJV: Commit your way to the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Commit your way to the Lord; trust in Him, and He will do it.

PSA.37.BSB: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
PSA.37.KJV: And he shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your judgment as the noonday.
PSA.37.PLAIN: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.

PSA.37.BSB: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
PSA.37.KJV: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not yourself because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who brings wicked devices to pass.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.

PSA.37.BSB: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
PSA.37.KJV: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not yourself in any wise to do evil.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.

PSA.37.BSB: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
PSA.37.KJV: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait on the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
PSA.37.PLAIN: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

PSA.37.BSB: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
PSA.37.KJV: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yes, you shall diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

PSA.37.BSB: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
PSA.37.KJV: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
PSA.37.PLAIN: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.

PSA.37.BSB: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
PSA.37.KJV: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes on him with his teeth.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

PSA.37.BSB: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
PSA.37.KJV: The LORD shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.
PSA.37.PLAIN: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.

PSA.37.BSB: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
PSA.37.KJV: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

PSA.37.BSB: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
PSA.37.KJV: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
PSA.37.PLAIN: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

PSA.37.BSB: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
PSA.37.KJV: A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.

PSA.37.BSB: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
PSA.37.KJV: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholds the righteous.
PSA.37.PLAIN: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.

PSA.37.BSB: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
PSA.37.KJV: The LORD knows the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The Lord knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.

PSA.37.BSB: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
PSA.37.KJV: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
PSA.37.PLAIN: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.

PSA.37.BSB: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
PSA.37.KJV: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
PSA.37.PLAIN: But the wicked and enemies of the Lord will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.

PSA.37.BSB: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
PSA.37.KJV: The wicked borrows, and pays not again: but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.

PSA.37.BSB: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
PSA.37.KJV: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.

PSA.37.BSB: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
PSA.37.KJV: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delights in his way.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The steps of a man are ordered by the Lord who takes delight in his journey.

PSA.37.BSB: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
PSA.37.KJV: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholds him with his hand.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the Lord is holding his hand.

PSA.37.BSB: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
PSA.37.KJV: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
PSA.37.PLAIN: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.

PSA.37.BSB: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
PSA.37.KJV: He is ever merciful, and lends; and his seed is blessed.
PSA.37.PLAIN: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.

PSA.37.BSB: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
PSA.37.KJV: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for ever more.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.

PSA.37.BSB: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
PSA.37.KJV: For the LORD loves judgment, and forsakes not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
PSA.37.PLAIN: For the Lord loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.

PSA.37.BSB: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
PSA.37.KJV: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

PSA.37.BSB: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
PSA.37.KJV: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.

PSA.37.BSB: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
PSA.37.KJV: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.

PSA.37.BSB: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
PSA.37.KJV: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,

PSA.37.BSB: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
PSA.37.KJV: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
PSA.37.PLAIN: the Lord will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.

PSA.37.BSB: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
PSA.37.KJV: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt you to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Rest quietly and wait for the Lord and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

PSA.37.BSB: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
PSA.37.KJV: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
PSA.37.PLAIN: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,

PSA.37.BSB: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
PSA.37.KJV: Yet he passed away, and, see, he was not: yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
PSA.37.PLAIN: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.

PSA.37.BSB: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
PSA.37.KJV: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
PSA.37.PLAIN: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.

PSA.37.BSB: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
PSA.37.KJV: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
PSA.37.PLAIN: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

PSA.37.BSB: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
PSA.37.KJV: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.

PSA.37.BSB: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
PSA.37.KJV: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
PSA.37.PLAIN: The Lord helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.

PSA.38.BSB: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
PSA.38.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. O lord, rebuke me not in your wrath: neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
PSA.38.PLAIN: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O Lord, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

PSA.38.BSB: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
PSA.38.KJV: For your arrows stick fast in me, and your hand presses me sore.
PSA.38.PLAIN: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

PSA.38.BSB: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
PSA.38.KJV: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
PSA.38.PLAIN: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

PSA.38.BSB: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
PSA.38.KJV: For my iniquities are gone over my head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
PSA.38.PLAIN: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

PSA.38.BSB: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
PSA.38.KJV: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
PSA.38.PLAIN: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

PSA.38.BSB: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
PSA.38.KJV: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
PSA.38.PLAIN: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

PSA.38.BSB: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
PSA.38.KJV: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
PSA.38.PLAIN: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

PSA.38.BSB: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
PSA.38.KJV: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
PSA.38.PLAIN: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

PSA.38.BSB: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
PSA.38.KJV: Lord, all my desire is before you; and my groaning is not hid from you.
PSA.38.PLAIN: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

PSA.38.BSB: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
PSA.38.KJV: My heart pants, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.
PSA.38.PLAIN: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

PSA.38.BSB: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
PSA.38.KJV: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
PSA.38.PLAIN: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

PSA.38.BSB: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
PSA.38.KJV: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
PSA.38.PLAIN: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

PSA.38.BSB: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
PSA.38.KJV: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that opens not his mouth.
PSA.38.PLAIN: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

PSA.38.BSB: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
PSA.38.KJV: Thus I was as a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
PSA.38.PLAIN: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

PSA.38.BSB: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
PSA.38.KJV: For in you, O LORD, do I hope: you will hear, O Lord my God.
PSA.38.PLAIN: I wait for You, O Lord; You will answer, O Lord my God.

PSA.38.BSB: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
PSA.38.KJV: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.
PSA.38.PLAIN: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

PSA.38.BSB: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
PSA.38.KJV: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
PSA.38.PLAIN: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

PSA.38.BSB: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
PSA.38.KJV: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
PSA.38.PLAIN: Yes, I confess my brokenness; I am troubled by my sin.

PSA.38.BSB: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
PSA.38.KJV: But my enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
PSA.38.PLAIN: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.

PSA.38.BSB: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
PSA.38.KJV: They also that render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
PSA.38.PLAIN: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

PSA.38.BSB: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
PSA.38.KJV: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
PSA.38.PLAIN: Do not forsake me, O Lord; be not far from me, O my God.

PSA.38.BSB: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
PSA.38.KJV: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
PSA.38.PLAIN: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

PSA.39.BSB: For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
PSA.39.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician, even to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David. I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
PSA.39.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”

PSA.39.BSB: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
PSA.39.KJV: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
PSA.39.PLAIN: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.

PSA.39.BSB: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
PSA.39.KJV: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spoke I with my tongue,
PSA.39.PLAIN: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:

PSA.39.BSB: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.
PSA.39.KJV: LORD, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.
PSA.39.PLAIN: “Show me, O Lord, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.

PSA.39.BSB: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
PSA.39.KJV: Behold, you have made my days as an handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before you: truly every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
PSA.39.PLAIN: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah

PSA.39.BSB: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
PSA.39.KJV: Surely every man walks in a vain show: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heaps up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.
PSA.39.PLAIN: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.

PSA.39.BSB: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
PSA.39.KJV: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in you.
PSA.39.PLAIN: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.

PSA.39.BSB: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
PSA.39.KJV: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
PSA.39.PLAIN: Deliver me from all my wanderings and failures; do not make me the reproach of fools.

PSA.39.BSB: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
PSA.39.KJV: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because you did it.
PSA.39.PLAIN: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.

PSA.39.BSB: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
PSA.39.KJV: Remove your stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of your hand.
PSA.39.PLAIN: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.

PSA.39.BSB: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
PSA.39.KJV: When you with rebukes do correct man for iniquity, you make his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
PSA.39.PLAIN: You discipline and correct a man for his brokenness, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah

PSA.39.BSB: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.
PSA.39.KJV: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry; hold not your peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with you, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
PSA.39.PLAIN: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.

PSA.39.BSB: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
PSA.39.KJV: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
PSA.39.PLAIN: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”

PSA.40.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
PSA.40.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined to me, and heard my cry.
PSA.40.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the Lord; He inclined to me and heard my cry.

PSA.40.BSB: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
PSA.40.KJV: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet on a rock, and established my goings.
PSA.40.PLAIN: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

PSA.40.BSB: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
PSA.40.KJV: And he has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
PSA.40.PLAIN: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the Lord.

PSA.40.BSB: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
PSA.40.KJV: Blessed is that man that makes the LORD his trust, and respects not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
PSA.40.PLAIN: Blessed is the man who has made the Lord his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.

PSA.40.BSB: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
PSA.40.KJV: Many, O LORD my God, are your wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order to you: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
PSA.40.PLAIN: Many, O Lord my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us— none can compare to You— if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.

PSA.40.BSB: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
PSA.40.KJV: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; my ears have you opened: burnt offering and sin offering have you not required.
PSA.40.PLAIN: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.

PSA.40.BSB: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:
PSA.40.KJV: Then said I, See, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
PSA.40.PLAIN: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come— it is written about me in the scroll:

PSA.40.BSB: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
PSA.40.KJV: I delight to do your will, O my God: yes, your law is within my heart.
PSA.40.PLAIN: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”

PSA.40.BSB: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
PSA.40.KJV: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: see, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, you know.
PSA.40.PLAIN: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; look closely — I do not seal my lips, as You, O Lord, do know.

PSA.40.BSB: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
PSA.40.KJV: I have not hid your righteousness within my heart; I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation: I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great congregation.
PSA.40.PLAIN: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.

PSA.40.BSB: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
PSA.40.KJV: Withhold not you your tender mercies from me, O LORD: let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.
PSA.40.PLAIN: O Lord, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.

PSA.40.BSB: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
PSA.40.KJV: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold on me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.
PSA.40.PLAIN: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

PSA.40.BSB: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
PSA.40.KJV: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
PSA.40.PLAIN: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; hurry, O Lord, to help me.

PSA.40.BSB: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
PSA.40.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
PSA.40.PLAIN: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

PSA.40.BSB: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
PSA.40.KJV: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say to me, Aha, aha.
PSA.40.PLAIN: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.

PSA.40.BSB: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
PSA.40.KJV: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: let such as love your salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
PSA.40.PLAIN: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The Lord be magnified!”

PSA.40.BSB: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
PSA.40.KJV: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinks on me: you are my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
PSA.40.PLAIN: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

PSA.41.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
PSA.41.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Blessed is he that considers the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
PSA.41.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the Lord will deliver him in the day of trouble.

PSA.41.BSB: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
PSA.41.KJV: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed on the earth: and you will not deliver him to the will of his enemies.
PSA.41.PLAIN: The Lord will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.

PSA.41.BSB: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
PSA.41.KJV: The LORD will strengthen him on the bed of languishing: you will make all his bed in his sickness.
PSA.41.PLAIN: The Lord will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.

PSA.41.BSB: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
PSA.41.KJV: I said, LORD, be merciful to me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against you.
