PSA.41.PLAIN: I said, “O Lord, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”

PSA.41.BSB: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
PSA.41.KJV: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
PSA.41.PLAIN: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”

PSA.41.BSB: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
PSA.41.KJV: And if he come to see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he tells it.
PSA.41.PLAIN: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.

PSA.41.BSB: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
PSA.41.KJV: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
PSA.41.PLAIN: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:

PSA.41.BSB: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
PSA.41.KJV: An evil disease, say they, sticks fast to him: and now that he lies he shall rise up no more.
PSA.41.PLAIN: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”

PSA.41.BSB: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
PSA.41.KJV: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
PSA.41.PLAIN: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

PSA.41.BSB: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
PSA.41.KJV: But you, O LORD, be merciful to me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
PSA.41.PLAIN: But You, O Lord, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.

PSA.41.BSB: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
PSA.41.KJV: By this I know that you favor me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.
PSA.41.PLAIN: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

PSA.41.BSB: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
PSA.41.KJV: And as for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me before your face for ever.
PSA.41.PLAIN: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.

PSA.41.BSB: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
PSA.41.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
PSA.41.PLAIN: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

PSA.42.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
PSA.42.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah. As the hart pants after the water brooks, so pants my soul after you, O God.
PSA.42.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

PSA.42.BSB: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
PSA.42.KJV: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
PSA.42.PLAIN: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?

PSA.42.BSB: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
PSA.42.KJV: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say to me, Where is your God?
PSA.42.PLAIN: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

PSA.42.BSB: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
PSA.42.KJV: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holy day.
PSA.42.PLAIN: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.

PSA.42.BSB: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
PSA.42.KJV: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted in me? hope you in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
PSA.42.PLAIN: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

PSA.42.BSB: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.
PSA.42.KJV: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember you from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
PSA.42.PLAIN: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.

PSA.42.BSB: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
PSA.42.KJV: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterspouts: all your waves and your billows are gone over me.
PSA.42.PLAIN: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

PSA.42.BSB: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
PSA.42.KJV: Yet the LORD will command his loving kindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer to the God of my life.
PSA.42.PLAIN: The Lord decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.

PSA.42.BSB: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
PSA.42.KJV: I will say to God my rock, Why have you forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
PSA.42.PLAIN: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”

PSA.42.BSB: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
PSA.42.KJV: As with a sword in my bones, my enemies reproach me; while they say daily to me, Where is your God?
PSA.42.PLAIN: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

PSA.42.BSB: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
PSA.42.KJV: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope you in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
PSA.42.PLAIN: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

PSA.43.BSB: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
PSA.43.KJV: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
PSA.43.PLAIN: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.

PSA.43.BSB: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
PSA.43.KJV: For you are the God of my strength: why do you cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
PSA.43.PLAIN: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?

PSA.43.BSB: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.
PSA.43.KJV: O send out your light and your truth: let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy hill, and to your tabernacles.
PSA.43.PLAIN: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.

PSA.43.BSB: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
PSA.43.KJV: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy: yes, on the harp will I praise you, O God my God.
PSA.43.PLAIN: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.

PSA.43.BSB: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
PSA.43.KJV: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
PSA.43.PLAIN: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

PSA.44.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
PSA.44.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the times of old.
PSA.44.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.

PSA.44.BSB: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
PSA.44.KJV: How you did drive out the heathen with your hand, and planted them; how you did afflict the people, and cast them out.
PSA.44.PLAIN: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.

PSA.44.BSB: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
PSA.44.KJV: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you had a favor to them.
PSA.44.PLAIN: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.

PSA.44.BSB: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
PSA.44.KJV: You are my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
PSA.44.PLAIN: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.

PSA.44.BSB: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
PSA.44.KJV: Through you will we push down our enemies: through your name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
PSA.44.PLAIN: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.

PSA.44.BSB: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
PSA.44.KJV: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
PSA.44.PLAIN: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.

PSA.44.BSB: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
PSA.44.KJV: But you have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame that hated us.
PSA.44.PLAIN: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.

PSA.44.BSB: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
PSA.44.KJV: In God we boast all the day long, and praise your name for ever. Selah.
PSA.44.PLAIN: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah

PSA.44.BSB: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
PSA.44.KJV: But you have cast off, and put us to shame; and go not forth with our armies.
PSA.44.PLAIN: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.

PSA.44.BSB: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
PSA.44.KJV: You make us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
PSA.44.PLAIN: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.

PSA.44.BSB: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
PSA.44.KJV: You have given us like sheep appointed for meat; and have scattered us among the heathen.
PSA.44.PLAIN: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.

PSA.44.BSB: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
PSA.44.KJV: You sell your people for nothing, and do not increase your wealth by their price.
PSA.44.PLAIN: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.

PSA.44.BSB: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
PSA.44.KJV: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
PSA.44.PLAIN: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.

PSA.44.BSB: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
PSA.44.KJV: You make us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
PSA.44.PLAIN: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.

PSA.44.BSB: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
PSA.44.KJV: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
PSA.44.PLAIN: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,

PSA.44.BSB: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
PSA.44.KJV: For the voice of him that reproaches and blasphemes; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
PSA.44.PLAIN: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.

PSA.44.BSB: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
PSA.44.KJV: All this is come on us; yet have we not forgotten you, neither have we dealt falsely in your covenant.
PSA.44.PLAIN: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.

PSA.44.BSB: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
PSA.44.KJV: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from your way;
PSA.44.PLAIN: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.

PSA.44.BSB: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
PSA.44.KJV: Though you have sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
PSA.44.PLAIN: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.

PSA.44.BSB: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
PSA.44.KJV: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
PSA.44.PLAIN: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

PSA.44.BSB: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
PSA.44.KJV: Shall not God search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.
PSA.44.PLAIN: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?

PSA.44.BSB: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
PSA.44.KJV: Yes, for your sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
PSA.44.PLAIN: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

PSA.44.BSB: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
PSA.44.KJV: Awake, why sleep you, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
PSA.44.PLAIN: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.

PSA.44.BSB: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
PSA.44.KJV: Why hide you your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
PSA.44.PLAIN: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?

PSA.44.BSB: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
PSA.44.KJV: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly sticks to the earth.
PSA.44.PLAIN: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.

PSA.44.BSB: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
PSA.44.KJV: Arise for our help, and redeem us for your mercies’ sake.
PSA.44.PLAIN: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.

PSA.45.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
PSA.45.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil: a song of loves. My heart is gushing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
PSA.45.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

PSA.45.BSB: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.
PSA.45.KJV: You are fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into your lips: therefore God has blessed you for ever.
PSA.45.PLAIN: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.

PSA.45.BSB: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
PSA.45.KJV: Gird your sword on your thigh, O most mighty, with your glory and your majesty.
PSA.45.PLAIN: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.

PSA.45.BSB: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
PSA.45.KJV: And in your majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and your right hand shall teach you terrible things.
PSA.45.PLAIN: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.

PSA.45.BSB: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
PSA.45.KJV: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under you.
PSA.45.PLAIN: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.

PSA.45.BSB: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
PSA.45.KJV: Your throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the scepter of your kingdom is a right scepter.
PSA.45.PLAIN: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

PSA.45.BSB: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
PSA.45.KJV: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness: therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
PSA.45.PLAIN: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.

PSA.45.BSB: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
PSA.45.KJV: All your garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made you glad.
PSA.45.PLAIN: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.

PSA.45.BSB: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
PSA.45.KJV: Kings’ daughters were among your honorable women: on your right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
PSA.45.PLAIN: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.

PSA.45.BSB: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
PSA.45.KJV: Listen, O daughter, and consider, and incline your ear; forget also your own people, and your father’s house;
PSA.45.PLAIN: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,

PSA.45.BSB: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
PSA.45.KJV: So shall the king greatly desire your beauty: for he is your Lord; and worship you him.
PSA.45.PLAIN: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.

PSA.45.BSB: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
PSA.45.KJV: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall entreat your favor.
PSA.45.PLAIN: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

PSA.45.BSB: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
PSA.45.KJV: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of worked gold.
PSA.45.PLAIN: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.

PSA.45.BSB: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
PSA.45.KJV: She shall be brought to the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought to you.
PSA.45.PLAIN: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.

PSA.45.BSB: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
PSA.45.KJV: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king’s palace.
PSA.45.PLAIN: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

PSA.45.BSB: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
PSA.45.KJV: Instead of your fathers shall be your children, whom you may make princes in all the earth.
PSA.45.PLAIN: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

PSA.45.BSB: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
PSA.45.KJV: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise you for ever and ever.
PSA.45.PLAIN: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.

PSA.46.BSB: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
PSA.46.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, a song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
PSA.46.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

PSA.46.BSB: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
PSA.46.KJV: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the middle of the sea;
PSA.46.PLAIN: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
