PSA.51.BSB: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
PSA.51.KJV: Restore to me the joy of your salvation; and uphold me with your free spirit.
PSA.51.PLAIN: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.

PSA.51.BSB: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
PSA.51.KJV: Then will I teach transgressors your ways; and sinners shall be converted to you.
PSA.51.PLAIN: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

PSA.51.BSB: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
PSA.51.KJV: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, you God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.
PSA.51.PLAIN: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

PSA.51.BSB: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
PSA.51.KJV: O Lord, open you my lips; and my mouth shall show forth your praise.
PSA.51.PLAIN: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

PSA.51.BSB: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
PSA.51.KJV: For you desire not sacrifice; else would I give it: you delight not in burnt offering.
PSA.51.PLAIN: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.

PSA.51.BSB: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
PSA.51.KJV: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
PSA.51.PLAIN: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

PSA.51.BSB: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
PSA.51.KJV: Do good in your good pleasure to Zion: build you the walls of Jerusalem.
PSA.51.PLAIN: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

PSA.51.BSB: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
PSA.51.KJV: Then shall you be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks on your altar.
PSA.51.PLAIN: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.

PSA.52.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of David. After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
PSA.52.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician, Maschil, A Psalm of David: When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech. Why boast you yourself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endures continually.
PSA.52.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of David. After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.

PSA.52.BSB: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
PSA.52.KJV: The tongue devises mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
PSA.52.PLAIN: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.

PSA.52.BSB: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
PSA.52.KJV: You love evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
PSA.52.PLAIN: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah

PSA.52.BSB: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
PSA.52.KJV: You love all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.
PSA.52.PLAIN: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.

PSA.52.BSB: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
PSA.52.KJV: God shall likewise destroy you for ever, he shall take you away, and pluck you out of your dwelling place, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
PSA.52.PLAIN: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

PSA.52.BSB: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
PSA.52.KJV: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
PSA.52.PLAIN: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,

PSA.52.BSB: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
PSA.52.KJV: See, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
PSA.52.PLAIN: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”

PSA.52.BSB: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
PSA.52.KJV: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
PSA.52.PLAIN: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.

PSA.52.BSB: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name— for it is good— in the presence of Your saints.
PSA.52.KJV: I will praise you for ever, because you have done it: and I will wait on your name; for it is good before your saints.
PSA.52.PLAIN: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name— for it is good— in the presence of Your saints.

PSA.53.BSB: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
PSA.53.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, Psalm of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that does good.
PSA.53.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.

PSA.53.BSB: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
PSA.53.KJV: God looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
PSA.53.PLAIN: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.

PSA.53.BSB: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
PSA.53.KJV: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that does good, no, not one.
PSA.53.PLAIN: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

PSA.53.BSB: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
PSA.53.KJV: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called on God.
PSA.53.PLAIN: Will the workers of brokenness never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.

PSA.53.BSB: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
PSA.53.KJV: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God has scattered the bones of him that encamps against you: you have put them to shame, because God has despised them.
PSA.53.PLAIN: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.

PSA.53.BSB: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
PSA.53.KJV: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
PSA.53.PLAIN: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!

PSA.54.BSB: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
PSA.54.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician on Neginoth, Maschil, Psalm of David. Save me, O God, by your name, and judge me by your strength.
PSA.54.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!

PSA.54.BSB: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
PSA.54.KJV: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
PSA.54.PLAIN: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

PSA.54.BSB: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
PSA.54.KJV: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
PSA.54.PLAIN: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah

PSA.54.BSB: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
PSA.54.KJV: Behold, God is my helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
PSA.54.PLAIN: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.

PSA.54.BSB: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
PSA.54.KJV: He shall reward evil to my enemies: cut them off in your truth.
PSA.54.PLAIN: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.

PSA.54.BSB: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
PSA.54.KJV: I will freely sacrifice to you: I will praise your name, O LORD; for it is good.
PSA.54.PLAIN: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O Lord, for it is good.

PSA.54.BSB: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.
PSA.54.KJV: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his desire on my enemies.
PSA.54.PLAIN: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.

PSA.55.BSB: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
PSA.55.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician on Neginoth, Maschil. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not yourself from my supplication.
PSA.55.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.

PSA.55.BSB: Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught
PSA.55.KJV: Attend to me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
PSA.55.PLAIN: Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught

PSA.55.BSB: at the voice of the enemy, at the pressure of the wicked. For they release disaster upon me and revile me in their anger.
PSA.55.KJV: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity on me, and in wrath they hate me.
PSA.55.PLAIN: at the voice of the enemy, at the pressure of the wicked. For they release disaster upon me and revile me in their anger.

PSA.55.BSB: My heart murmurs within me, and the terrors of death assail me.
PSA.55.KJV: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen on me.
PSA.55.PLAIN: My heart murmurs within me, and the terrors of death assail me.

PSA.55.BSB: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
PSA.55.KJV: Fearfulness and trembling are come on me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
PSA.55.PLAIN: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.

PSA.55.BSB: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
PSA.55.KJV: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
PSA.55.PLAIN: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.

PSA.55.BSB: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
PSA.55.KJV: See, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
PSA.55.PLAIN: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah

PSA.55.BSB: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
PSA.55.KJV: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
PSA.55.PLAIN: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”

PSA.55.BSB: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
PSA.55.KJV: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
PSA.55.PLAIN: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.

PSA.55.BSB: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
PSA.55.KJV: Day and night they go about it on the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the middle of it.
PSA.55.PLAIN: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.

PSA.55.BSB: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
PSA.55.KJV: Wickedness is in the middle thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
PSA.55.PLAIN: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.

PSA.55.BSB: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
PSA.55.KJV: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
PSA.55.PLAIN: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.

PSA.55.BSB: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.
PSA.55.KJV: But it was you, a man my equal, my guide, and my acquaintance.
PSA.55.PLAIN: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.

PSA.55.BSB: We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.
PSA.55.KJV: We took sweet counsel together, and walked to the house of God in company.
PSA.55.PLAIN: We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.

PSA.55.BSB: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.
PSA.55.KJV: Let death seize on them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
PSA.55.PLAIN: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.

PSA.55.BSB: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
PSA.55.KJV: As for me, I will call on God; and the LORD shall save me.
PSA.55.PLAIN: But I call to God, and the Lord saves me.

PSA.55.BSB: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
PSA.55.KJV: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
PSA.55.PLAIN: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.

PSA.55.BSB: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
PSA.55.KJV: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
PSA.55.PLAIN: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

PSA.55.BSB: God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
PSA.55.KJV: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that stays of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
PSA.55.PLAIN: God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.

PSA.55.BSB: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
PSA.55.KJV: He has put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.
PSA.55.PLAIN: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

PSA.55.BSB: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
PSA.55.KJV: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
PSA.55.PLAIN: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.

PSA.55.BSB: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
PSA.55.KJV: Cast your burden on the LORD, and he shall sustain you: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
PSA.55.PLAIN: Cast your burden upon the Lord and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

PSA.55.BSB: But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
PSA.55.KJV: But you, O God, shall bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in you.
PSA.55.PLAIN: But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.

PSA.56.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
PSA.56.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician upon Jonath Elem Rechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresses me.
PSA.56.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.

PSA.56.BSB: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
PSA.56.KJV: My enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O you most High.
PSA.56.PLAIN: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.

PSA.56.BSB: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
PSA.56.KJV: What time I am afraid, I will trust in you.
PSA.56.PLAIN: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

PSA.56.BSB: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
PSA.56.KJV: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do to me.
PSA.56.PLAIN: In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

PSA.56.BSB: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
PSA.56.KJV: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
PSA.56.PLAIN: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.

PSA.56.BSB: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
PSA.56.KJV: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
PSA.56.PLAIN: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.

PSA.56.BSB: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
PSA.56.KJV: Shall they escape by iniquity? in your anger cast down the people, O God.
PSA.56.PLAIN: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.

PSA.56.BSB: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?
PSA.56.KJV: You tell my wanderings: put you my tears into your bottle: are they not in your book?
PSA.56.PLAIN: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle— are they not in Your book?

PSA.56.BSB: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
PSA.56.KJV: When I cry to you, then shall my enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
PSA.56.PLAIN: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.

PSA.56.BSB: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
PSA.56.KJV: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
PSA.56.PLAIN: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord, whose word I praise,

PSA.56.BSB: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
PSA.56.KJV: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do to me.
PSA.56.PLAIN: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

PSA.56.BSB: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
PSA.56.KJV: Your vows are on me, O God: I will render praises to you.
PSA.56.PLAIN: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.

PSA.56.BSB: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
PSA.56.KJV: For you have delivered my soul from death: will not you deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
PSA.56.PLAIN: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

PSA.57.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
PSA.57.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician Al-taschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave. Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me: for my soul trusts in you: yes, in the shadow of your wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be over.
PSA.57.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.

PSA.57.BSB: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
PSA.57.KJV: I will cry to God most high; to God that performs all things for me.
PSA.57.PLAIN: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.

PSA.57.BSB: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
PSA.57.KJV: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
PSA.57.PLAIN: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.

PSA.57.BSB: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
PSA.57.KJV: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
PSA.57.PLAIN: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

PSA.57.BSB: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
PSA.57.KJV: Be you exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be above all the earth.
PSA.57.PLAIN: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

PSA.57.BSB: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
PSA.57.KJV: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have dig a pit before me, into the middle whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
PSA.57.PLAIN: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah

PSA.57.BSB: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
PSA.57.KJV: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
PSA.57.PLAIN: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.

PSA.57.BSB: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
PSA.57.KJV: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
PSA.57.PLAIN: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

PSA.57.BSB: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
PSA.57.KJV: I will praise you, O Lord, among the people: I will sing to you among the nations.
PSA.57.PLAIN: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

PSA.57.BSB: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
PSA.57.KJV: For your mercy is great to the heavens, and your truth to the clouds.
PSA.57.PLAIN: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.

PSA.57.BSB: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
PSA.57.KJV: Be you exalted, O God, above the heavens: let your glory be above all the earth.
PSA.57.PLAIN: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

PSA.58.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
PSA.58.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician Al-taschith, Michtam of David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do you judge uprightly, O you sons of men?
PSA.58.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?

PSA.58.BSB: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
PSA.58.KJV: Yes, in heart you work wickedness; you weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
PSA.58.PLAIN: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.

PSA.58.BSB: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
PSA.58.KJV: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
PSA.58.PLAIN: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.

PSA.58.BSB: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
PSA.58.KJV: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stops her ear;
PSA.58.PLAIN: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,

PSA.58.BSB: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.
PSA.58.KJV: Which will not listen to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
PSA.58.PLAIN: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.

PSA.58.BSB: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
PSA.58.KJV: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
PSA.58.PLAIN: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O Lord, tear out the fangs of the lions.

PSA.58.BSB: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
PSA.58.KJV: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bends his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
PSA.58.PLAIN: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.

PSA.58.BSB: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.
PSA.58.KJV: As a snail which melts, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
PSA.58.PLAIN: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.

PSA.58.BSB: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry— He will sweep them away.
PSA.58.KJV: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
PSA.58.PLAIN: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns— whether green or dry— He will sweep them away.

PSA.58.BSB: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
PSA.58.KJV: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
PSA.58.PLAIN: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.

PSA.58.BSB: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”
PSA.58.KJV: So that a man shall say, Truly there is a reward for the righteous: truly he is a God that judges in the earth.
PSA.58.PLAIN: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”

PSA.59.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
PSA.59.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician Al-taschith, Michtam of David: when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
PSA.59.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.

PSA.59.BSB: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
PSA.59.KJV: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
PSA.59.PLAIN: Deliver me from workers of brokenness, and save me from men of bloodshed.

PSA.59.BSB: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
PSA.59.KJV: For, see, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
PSA.59.PLAIN: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O Lord.

PSA.59.BSB: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
PSA.59.KJV: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
PSA.59.PLAIN: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.

PSA.59.BSB: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
PSA.59.KJV: You therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
PSA.59.PLAIN: O Lord God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah

PSA.59.BSB: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
PSA.59.KJV: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
PSA.59.PLAIN: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.

PSA.59.BSB: See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
PSA.59.KJV: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, does hear?
PSA.59.PLAIN: See what they spew from their mouths— sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”

PSA.59.BSB: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
PSA.59.KJV: But you, O LORD, shall laugh at them; you shall have all the heathen in derision.
PSA.59.PLAIN: But You, O Lord, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.

PSA.59.BSB: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
PSA.59.KJV: Because of his strength will I wait on you: for God is my defense.
PSA.59.PLAIN: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.

PSA.59.BSB: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
PSA.59.KJV: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire on my enemies.
PSA.59.PLAIN: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.

PSA.59.BSB: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
PSA.59.KJV: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by your power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
PSA.59.PLAIN: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.

PSA.59.BSB: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
PSA.59.KJV: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
PSA.59.PLAIN: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.

PSA.59.BSB: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
PSA.59.KJV: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God rules in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Selah.
PSA.59.PLAIN: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

PSA.59.BSB: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
PSA.59.KJV: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
PSA.59.PLAIN: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.

PSA.59.BSB: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
PSA.59.KJV: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
PSA.59.PLAIN: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.

PSA.59.BSB: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
PSA.59.KJV: But I will sing of your power; yes, I will sing aloud of your mercy in the morning: for you have been my defense and refuge in the day of my trouble.
PSA.59.PLAIN: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

PSA.59.BSB: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
PSA.59.KJV: To you, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defense, and the God of my mercy.
PSA.59.PLAIN: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.

PSA.60.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction. When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
PSA.60.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician upon Shushan-Eduth Michtam of David, to teach. When he strove with Aram Zobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt, twelve thousand. O God, you have cast us off, you have scattered us, you have been displeased; O turn yourself to us again.
PSA.60.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction. When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!

PSA.60.BSB: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
PSA.60.KJV: You have made the earth to tremble; you have broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shakes.
PSA.60.PLAIN: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.

PSA.60.BSB: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
PSA.60.KJV: You have showed your people hard things: you have made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
PSA.60.PLAIN: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.

PSA.60.BSB: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
PSA.60.KJV: You have given a banner to them that fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
PSA.60.PLAIN: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah

PSA.60.BSB: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
PSA.60.KJV: That your beloved may be delivered; save with your right hand, and hear me.
PSA.60.PLAIN: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

PSA.60.BSB: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
PSA.60.KJV: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
PSA.60.PLAIN: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.

PSA.60.BSB: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
PSA.60.KJV: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Judah is my lawgiver;
PSA.60.PLAIN: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

PSA.60.BSB: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
PSA.60.KJV: Moab is my wash pot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph you because of me.
PSA.60.PLAIN: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”

PSA.60.BSB: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
PSA.60.KJV: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
PSA.60.PLAIN: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

PSA.60.BSB: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
PSA.60.KJV: Will not you, O God, which had cast us off? and you, O God, which did not go out with our armies?
PSA.60.PLAIN: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?

PSA.60.BSB: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
PSA.60.KJV: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
PSA.60.PLAIN: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

PSA.60.BSB: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
PSA.60.KJV: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
PSA.60.PLAIN: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.

PSA.61.BSB: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
PSA.61.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician upon Neginah. A Psalm of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
PSA.61.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

PSA.61.BSB: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
PSA.61.KJV: From the end of the earth will I cry to you, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
PSA.61.PLAIN: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

PSA.61.BSB: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
PSA.61.KJV: For you have been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
PSA.61.PLAIN: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.

PSA.61.BSB: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
PSA.61.KJV: I will abide in your tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of your wings. Selah.
PSA.61.PLAIN: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah

PSA.61.BSB: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
PSA.61.KJV: For you, O God, have heard my vows: you have given me the heritage of those that fear your name.
PSA.61.PLAIN: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.

PSA.61.BSB: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
PSA.61.KJV: You will prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.
PSA.61.PLAIN: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.

PSA.61.BSB: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
PSA.61.KJV: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
PSA.61.PLAIN: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.

PSA.61.BSB: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
PSA.61.KJV: So will I sing praise to your name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
PSA.61.PLAIN: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.

PSA.62.BSB: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
PSA.62.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David. Truly my soul waits on God: from him comes my salvation.
PSA.62.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.

PSA.62.BSB: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
PSA.62.KJV: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defense; I shall not be greatly moved.
PSA.62.PLAIN: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.

PSA.62.BSB: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
PSA.62.KJV: How long will you imagine mischief against a man? you shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall you be, and as a tottering fence.
PSA.62.PLAIN: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?

PSA.62.BSB: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
PSA.62.KJV: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
PSA.62.PLAIN: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah

PSA.62.BSB: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
PSA.62.KJV: My soul, wait you only on God; for my expectation is from him.
PSA.62.PLAIN: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.

PSA.62.BSB: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
PSA.62.KJV: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defense; I shall not be moved.
PSA.62.PLAIN: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.

PSA.62.BSB: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
PSA.62.KJV: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
PSA.62.PLAIN: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.

PSA.62.BSB: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
PSA.62.KJV: Trust in him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
PSA.62.PLAIN: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah

PSA.62.BSB: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
PSA.62.KJV: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
PSA.62.PLAIN: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.

PSA.62.BSB: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
PSA.62.KJV: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart on them.
PSA.62.PLAIN: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.

PSA.62.BSB: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
PSA.62.KJV: God has spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongs to God.
PSA.62.PLAIN: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,

PSA.62.BSB: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
PSA.62.KJV: Also to you, O Lord, belongs mercy: for you render to every man according to his work.
PSA.62.PLAIN: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.

PSA.63.BSB: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
PSA.63.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of David, when be was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, you are my God; early will I seek you: my soul thirsts for you, my flesh longs for you in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
PSA.63.PLAIN: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.

PSA.63.BSB: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
PSA.63.KJV: To see your power and your glory, so as I have seen you in the sanctuary.
PSA.63.PLAIN: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.

PSA.63.BSB: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
PSA.63.KJV: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
PSA.63.PLAIN: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.

PSA.63.BSB: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
PSA.63.KJV: Thus will I bless you while I live: I will lift up my hands in your name.
PSA.63.PLAIN: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.

PSA.63.BSB: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
PSA.63.KJV: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise you with joyful lips:
PSA.63.PLAIN: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.

PSA.63.BSB: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
PSA.63.KJV: When I remember you on my bed, and meditate on you in the night watches.
PSA.63.PLAIN: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.

PSA.63.BSB: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
PSA.63.KJV: Because you have been my help, therefore in the shadow of your wings will I rejoice.
PSA.63.PLAIN: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.

PSA.63.BSB: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
PSA.63.KJV: My soul follows hard after you: your right hand upholds me.
PSA.63.PLAIN: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.

PSA.63.BSB: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
PSA.63.KJV: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
PSA.63.PLAIN: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.

PSA.63.BSB: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
PSA.63.KJV: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
PSA.63.PLAIN: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

PSA.63.BSB: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
PSA.63.KJV: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that swears by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
PSA.63.PLAIN: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.

PSA.64.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
PSA.64.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, a Psalm of David. Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
PSA.64.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.

PSA.64.BSB: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
PSA.64.KJV: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
PSA.64.PLAIN: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of brokenness,

PSA.64.BSB: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
PSA.64.KJV: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
PSA.64.PLAIN: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,

PSA.64.BSB: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
PSA.64.KJV: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
PSA.64.PLAIN: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.

PSA.64.BSB: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
PSA.64.KJV: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privately; they say, Who shall see them?
PSA.64.PLAIN: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.

PSA.64.BSB: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
PSA.64.KJV: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
PSA.64.PLAIN: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.

PSA.64.BSB: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
PSA.64.KJV: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
PSA.64.PLAIN: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.

PSA.64.BSB: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
PSA.64.KJV: So they shall make their own tongue to fall on themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
PSA.64.PLAIN: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.

PSA.64.BSB: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
PSA.64.KJV: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
PSA.64.PLAIN: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.

PSA.64.BSB: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
PSA.64.KJV: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
PSA.64.PLAIN: Let the righteous rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.

PSA.65.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
PSA.65.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, a Psalm and song of David. Praise waits for you, O God, in Sion: and to you shall the vow be performed.
PSA.65.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.

PSA.65.BSB: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
PSA.65.KJV: O you that hear prayer, to you shall all flesh come.
PSA.65.PLAIN: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.

PSA.65.BSB: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
PSA.65.KJV: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, you shall purge them away.
PSA.65.PLAIN: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our wanderings and failures.

PSA.65.BSB: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
PSA.65.KJV: Blessed is the man whom you choose, and cause to approach to you, that he may dwell in your courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of your house, even of your holy temple.
PSA.65.PLAIN: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.

PSA.65.BSB: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
PSA.65.KJV: By terrible things in righteousness will you answer us, O God of our salvation; who are the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off on the sea:
PSA.65.PLAIN: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.

PSA.65.BSB: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
PSA.65.KJV: Which by his strength sets fast the mountains; being girded with power:
PSA.65.PLAIN: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.

PSA.65.BSB: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
PSA.65.KJV: Which stills the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
PSA.65.PLAIN: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.

PSA.65.BSB: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
PSA.65.KJV: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at your tokens: you make the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
PSA.65.PLAIN: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.

PSA.65.BSB: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
PSA.65.KJV: You visit the earth, and water it: you greatly enrich it with the river of God, which is full of water: you prepare them corn, when you have so provided for it.
PSA.65.PLAIN: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.

PSA.65.BSB: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
PSA.65.KJV: You water the ridges thereof abundantly: you settle the furrows thereof: you make it soft with showers: you bless the springing thereof.
PSA.65.PLAIN: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.

PSA.65.BSB: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
PSA.65.KJV: You crown the year with your goodness; and your paths drop fatness.
PSA.65.PLAIN: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.

PSA.65.BSB: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
PSA.65.KJV: They drop on the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
PSA.65.PLAIN: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.

PSA.65.BSB: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
PSA.65.KJV: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
PSA.65.PLAIN: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.

PSA.66.BSB: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
PSA.66.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, a song or Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all you lands:
PSA.66.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!

PSA.66.BSB: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
PSA.66.KJV: Sing forth the honor of his name: make his praise glorious.
PSA.66.PLAIN: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.

PSA.66.BSB: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
PSA.66.KJV: Say to God, How terrible are you in your works! through the greatness of your power shall your enemies submit themselves to you.
PSA.66.PLAIN: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.

PSA.66.BSB: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
PSA.66.KJV: All the earth shall worship you, and shall sing to you; they shall sing to your name. Selah.
PSA.66.PLAIN: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah

PSA.66.BSB: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
PSA.66.KJV: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
PSA.66.PLAIN: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.

PSA.66.BSB: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
PSA.66.KJV: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
PSA.66.PLAIN: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.

PSA.66.BSB: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
PSA.66.KJV: He rules by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
PSA.66.PLAIN: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah

PSA.66.BSB: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
PSA.66.KJV: O bless our God, you people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
PSA.66.PLAIN: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.

PSA.66.BSB: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
PSA.66.KJV: Which holds our soul in life, and suffers not our feet to be moved.
PSA.66.PLAIN: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.

PSA.66.BSB: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
PSA.66.KJV: For you, O God, have proved us: you have tried us, as silver is tried.
PSA.66.PLAIN: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.

PSA.66.BSB: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
PSA.66.KJV: You brought us into the net; you laid affliction on our loins.
PSA.66.PLAIN: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.

PSA.66.BSB: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
PSA.66.KJV: You have caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but you brought us out into a wealthy place.
PSA.66.PLAIN: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.

PSA.66.BSB: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
PSA.66.KJV: I will go into your house with burnt offerings: I will pay you my vows,
PSA.66.PLAIN: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—

PSA.66.BSB: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
PSA.66.KJV: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.
PSA.66.PLAIN: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.

PSA.66.BSB: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
PSA.66.KJV: I will offer to you burnt sacrifices of fatted calves, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
PSA.66.PLAIN: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

PSA.66.BSB: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
PSA.66.KJV: Come and hear, all you that fear God, and I will declare what he has done for my soul.
PSA.66.PLAIN: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.

PSA.66.BSB: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
PSA.66.KJV: I cried to him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
PSA.66.PLAIN: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.

PSA.66.BSB: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
PSA.66.KJV: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
PSA.66.PLAIN: If I had cherished brokenness in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.

PSA.66.BSB: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
PSA.66.KJV: But truly God has heard me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.
PSA.66.PLAIN: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.

PSA.66.BSB: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
PSA.66.KJV: Blessed be God, which has not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
PSA.66.PLAIN: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!

PSA.67.BSB: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
PSA.67.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician on Neginoth. A Psalm or song. God be merciful to us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine on us; Selah.
PSA.67.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah

PSA.67.BSB: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
PSA.67.KJV: That your way may be known on earth, your saving health among all nations.
PSA.67.PLAIN: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

PSA.67.BSB: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
PSA.67.KJV: Let the people praise you, O God; let all the people praise you.
PSA.67.PLAIN: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

PSA.67.BSB: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
PSA.67.KJV: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for you shall judge the people righteously, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.
PSA.67.PLAIN: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah

PSA.67.BSB: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
PSA.67.KJV: Let the people praise you, O God; let all the people praise you.
PSA.67.PLAIN: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

PSA.67.BSB: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
PSA.67.KJV: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
PSA.67.PLAIN: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.

PSA.67.BSB: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
PSA.67.KJV: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
PSA.67.PLAIN: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.

PSA.68.BSB: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
PSA.68.KJV: ¶ To the chief Musician. A Psalm or song of David. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
PSA.68.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.

PSA.68.BSB: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
PSA.68.KJV: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
PSA.68.PLAIN: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.

PSA.68.BSB: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
PSA.68.KJV: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yes, let them exceedingly rejoice.
PSA.68.PLAIN: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.

PSA.68.BSB: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds— His name is the LORD— and rejoice before Him.
PSA.68.KJV: Sing to God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rides on the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds— His name is the Lord— and rejoice before Him.

PSA.68.BSB: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
PSA.68.KJV: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
PSA.68.PLAIN: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.

PSA.68.BSB: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
PSA.68.KJV: God sets the solitary in families: he brings out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
PSA.68.PLAIN: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

PSA.68.BSB: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
PSA.68.KJV: O God, when you went forth before your people, when you did march through the wilderness; Selah:
PSA.68.PLAIN: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah

PSA.68.BSB: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
PSA.68.KJV: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
PSA.68.PLAIN: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

PSA.68.BSB: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
PSA.68.KJV: You, O God, did send a plentiful rain, whereby you did confirm your inheritance, when it was weary.
PSA.68.PLAIN: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.

PSA.68.BSB: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
PSA.68.KJV: Your congregation has dwelled therein: you, O God, have prepared of your goodness for the poor.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.

PSA.68.BSB: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
PSA.68.KJV: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
PSA.68.PLAIN: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:

PSA.68.BSB: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
PSA.68.KJV: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
PSA.68.PLAIN: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.

PSA.68.BSB: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
PSA.68.KJV: Though you have lien among the pots, yet shall you be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”

PSA.68.BSB: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
PSA.68.KJV: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
PSA.68.PLAIN: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.

PSA.68.BSB: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
PSA.68.KJV: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
PSA.68.PLAIN: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.

PSA.68.BSB: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
PSA.68.KJV: Why leap you, you high hills? this is the hill which God desires to dwell in; yes, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the Lord will surely dwell forever.

PSA.68.BSB: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
PSA.68.KJV: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
PSA.68.PLAIN: The chariots of God are tens of thousands— thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.

PSA.68.BSB: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
PSA.68.KJV: You have ascended on high, you have led captivity captive: you have received gifts for men; yes, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
PSA.68.PLAIN: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the Lord God may dwell there.

PSA.68.BSB: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
PSA.68.KJV: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loads us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah

PSA.68.BSB: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
PSA.68.KJV: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and to GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.

PSA.68.BSB: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
PSA.68.KJV: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goes on still in his trespasses.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.

PSA.68.BSB: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
PSA.68.KJV: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
PSA.68.PLAIN: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,

PSA.68.BSB: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
PSA.68.KJV: That your foot may be dipped in the blood of your enemies, and the tongue of your dogs in the same.
PSA.68.PLAIN: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes— the tongues of your dogs in the same.”

PSA.68.BSB: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
PSA.68.KJV: They have seen your goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
PSA.68.PLAIN: They have seen Your procession, O God— the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.

PSA.68.BSB: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
PSA.68.KJV: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with tambourines.
PSA.68.PLAIN: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
