PSA.68.KJV: Bless you God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the Lord from the fountain of Israel.

PSA.68.BSB: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
PSA.68.KJV: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
PSA.68.PLAIN: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

PSA.68.BSB: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
PSA.68.KJV: Your God has commanded your strength: strengthen, O God, that which you have worked for us.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.

PSA.68.BSB: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
PSA.68.KJV: Because of your temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents to you.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.

PSA.68.BSB: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
PSA.68.KJV: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter you the people that delight in war.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

PSA.68.BSB: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
PSA.68.KJV: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands to God.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.

PSA.68.BSB: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah
PSA.68.KJV: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises to the Lord; Selah:
PSA.68.PLAIN: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord— Selah

PSA.68.BSB: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
PSA.68.KJV: To him that rides on the heavens of heavens, which were of old; see, he does send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
PSA.68.PLAIN: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; look closely — His mighty voice resounds.

PSA.68.BSB: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
PSA.68.KJV: Ascribe you strength to God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
PSA.68.PLAIN: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.

PSA.68.BSB: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
PSA.68.KJV: O God, you are terrible out of your holy places: the God of Israel is he that gives strength and power to his people. Blessed be God.
PSA.68.PLAIN: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!

PSA.69.BSB: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
PSA.69.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician upon Shoshannim, A Psalm of David. Save me, O God; for the waters are come in to my soul.
PSA.69.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.

PSA.69.BSB: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
PSA.69.KJV: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
PSA.69.PLAIN: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.

PSA.69.BSB: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
PSA.69.KJV: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait for my God.
PSA.69.PLAIN: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

PSA.69.BSB: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
PSA.69.KJV: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: they that would destroy me, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.

PSA.69.BSB: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
PSA.69.KJV: O God, you know my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from you.
PSA.69.PLAIN: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.

PSA.69.BSB: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
PSA.69.KJV: Let not them that wait on you, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek you be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
PSA.69.PLAIN: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.

PSA.69.BSB: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
PSA.69.KJV: Because for your sake I have borne reproach; shame has covered my face.
PSA.69.PLAIN: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.

PSA.69.BSB: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
PSA.69.KJV: I am become a stranger to my brothers, and an alien to my mother’s children.
PSA.69.PLAIN: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,

PSA.69.BSB: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
PSA.69.KJV: For the zeal of your house has eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached you are fallen on me.
PSA.69.PLAIN: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.

PSA.69.BSB: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
PSA.69.KJV: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
PSA.69.PLAIN: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.

PSA.69.BSB: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
PSA.69.KJV: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
PSA.69.PLAIN: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.

PSA.69.BSB: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
PSA.69.KJV: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.

PSA.69.BSB: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
PSA.69.KJV: But as for me, my prayer is to you, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of your mercy hear me, in the truth of your salvation.
PSA.69.PLAIN: But my prayer to You, O Lord, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.

PSA.69.BSB: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
PSA.69.KJV: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.

PSA.69.BSB: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
PSA.69.KJV: Let not the flood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth on me.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.

PSA.69.BSB: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
PSA.69.KJV: Hear me, O LORD; for your loving kindness is good: turn to me according to the multitude of your tender mercies.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Answer me, O Lord, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.

PSA.69.BSB: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
PSA.69.KJV: And hide not your face from your servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!

PSA.69.BSB: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
PSA.69.KJV: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of my enemies.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.

PSA.69.BSB: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
PSA.69.KJV: You have known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: my adversaries are all before you.
PSA.69.PLAIN: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.

PSA.69.BSB: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
PSA.69.KJV: Reproach has broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.

PSA.69.BSB: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
PSA.69.KJV: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
PSA.69.PLAIN: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.

PSA.69.BSB: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
PSA.69.KJV: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
PSA.69.PLAIN: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.

PSA.69.BSB: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
PSA.69.KJV: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
PSA.69.PLAIN: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

PSA.69.BSB: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
PSA.69.KJV: Pour out your indignation on them, and let your wrathful anger take hold of them.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.

PSA.69.BSB: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
PSA.69.KJV: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
PSA.69.PLAIN: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

PSA.69.BSB: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
PSA.69.KJV: For they persecute him whom you have smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom you have wounded.
PSA.69.PLAIN: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.

PSA.69.BSB: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
PSA.69.KJV: Add iniquity to their iniquity: and let them not come into your righteousness.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Add brokenness to their brokenness; let them not share in Your righteousness.

PSA.69.BSB: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
PSA.69.KJV: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
PSA.69.PLAIN: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.

PSA.69.BSB: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
PSA.69.KJV: But I am poor and sorrowful: let your salvation, O God, set me up on high.
PSA.69.PLAIN: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.

PSA.69.BSB: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
PSA.69.KJV: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
PSA.69.PLAIN: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.

PSA.69.BSB: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
PSA.69.KJV: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that has horns and hoofs.
PSA.69.PLAIN: And this will please the Lord more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.

PSA.69.BSB: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
PSA.69.KJV: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
PSA.69.PLAIN: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!

PSA.69.BSB: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
PSA.69.KJV: For the LORD hears the poor, and despises not his prisoners.
PSA.69.PLAIN: For the Lord listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.

PSA.69.BSB: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
PSA.69.KJV: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moves therein.
PSA.69.PLAIN: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.

PSA.69.BSB: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
PSA.69.KJV: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
PSA.69.PLAIN: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.

PSA.69.BSB: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
PSA.69.KJV: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
PSA.69.PLAIN: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.

PSA.70.BSB: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
PSA.70.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, a psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
PSA.70.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O Lord, to help me!

PSA.70.BSB: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
PSA.70.KJV: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
PSA.70.PLAIN: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.

PSA.70.BSB: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
PSA.70.KJV: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
PSA.70.PLAIN: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.

PSA.70.BSB: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
PSA.70.KJV: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: and let such as love your salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
PSA.70.PLAIN: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”

PSA.70.BSB: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
PSA.70.KJV: But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: you are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
PSA.70.PLAIN: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord, do not delay.

PSA.71.BSB: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
PSA.71.KJV: In you, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
PSA.71.PLAIN: In You, O Lord, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

PSA.71.BSB: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
PSA.71.KJV: Deliver me in your righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline your ear to me, and save me.
PSA.71.PLAIN: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.

PSA.71.BSB: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
PSA.71.KJV: Be you my strong habitation, where I may continually resort: you have given commandment to save me; for you are my rock and my fortress.
PSA.71.PLAIN: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.

PSA.71.BSB: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
PSA.71.KJV: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
PSA.71.PLAIN: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.

PSA.71.BSB: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
PSA.71.KJV: For you are my hope, O Lord GOD: you are my trust from my youth.
PSA.71.PLAIN: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

PSA.71.BSB: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
PSA.71.KJV: By you have I been held up from the womb: you are he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of you.
PSA.71.PLAIN: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.

PSA.71.BSB: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
PSA.71.KJV: I am as a wonder to many; but you are my strong refuge.
PSA.71.PLAIN: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.

PSA.71.BSB: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
PSA.71.KJV: Let my mouth be filled with your praise and with your honor all the day.
PSA.71.PLAIN: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.

PSA.71.BSB: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
PSA.71.KJV: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.
PSA.71.PLAIN: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.

PSA.71.BSB: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
PSA.71.KJV: For my enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
PSA.71.PLAIN: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,

PSA.71.BSB: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
PSA.71.KJV: Saying, God has forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
PSA.71.PLAIN: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”

PSA.71.BSB: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
PSA.71.KJV: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
PSA.71.PLAIN: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.

PSA.71.BSB: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
PSA.71.KJV: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.
PSA.71.PLAIN: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.

PSA.71.BSB: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
PSA.71.KJV: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise you more and more.
PSA.71.PLAIN: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.

PSA.71.BSB: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
PSA.71.KJV: My mouth shall show forth your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
PSA.71.PLAIN: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.

PSA.71.BSB: I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
PSA.71.KJV: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of your righteousness, even of your only.
PSA.71.PLAIN: I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.

PSA.71.BSB: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
PSA.71.KJV: O God, you have taught me from my youth: and till now have I declared your wondrous works.
PSA.71.PLAIN: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.

PSA.71.BSB: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
PSA.71.KJV: Now also when I am old and gray headed, O God, forsake me not; until I have showed your strength to this generation, and your power to every one that is to come.
PSA.71.PLAIN: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.

PSA.71.BSB: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
PSA.71.KJV: Your righteousness also, O God, is very high, who have done great things: O God, who is like to you!
PSA.71.PLAIN: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?

PSA.71.BSB: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
PSA.71.KJV: You, which have showed me great and sore troubles, shall quicken me again, and shall bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
PSA.71.PLAIN: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.

PSA.71.BSB: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
PSA.71.KJV: You shall increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
PSA.71.PLAIN: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.

PSA.71.BSB: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
PSA.71.KJV: I will also praise you with the psaltery, even your truth, O my God: to you will I sing with the harp, O you Holy One of Israel.
PSA.71.PLAIN: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

PSA.71.BSB: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
PSA.71.KJV: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to you; and my soul, which you have redeemed.
PSA.71.PLAIN: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.

PSA.71.BSB: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
PSA.71.KJV: My tongue also shall talk of your righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought to shame, that seek my hurt.
PSA.71.PLAIN: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.

PSA.72.BSB: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
PSA.72.KJV: ¶ A Psalm for Solomon. Give the king your judgments, O God, and your righteousness to the king’s son.
PSA.72.PLAIN: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.

PSA.72.BSB: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
PSA.72.KJV: He shall judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with judgment.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.

PSA.72.BSB: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
PSA.72.KJV: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.

PSA.72.BSB: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
PSA.72.KJV: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

PSA.72.BSB: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
PSA.72.KJV: They shall fear you as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.

PSA.72.BSB: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
PSA.72.KJV: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.

PSA.72.BSB: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.
PSA.72.KJV: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endures.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.

PSA.72.BSB: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
PSA.72.KJV: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

PSA.72.BSB: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
PSA.72.KJV: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.

PSA.72.BSB: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
PSA.72.KJV: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.

PSA.72.BSB: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
PSA.72.KJV: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.

PSA.72.BSB: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
PSA.72.KJV: For he shall deliver the needy when he cries; the poor also, and him that has no helper.
PSA.72.PLAIN: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.

PSA.72.BSB: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
PSA.72.KJV: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
PSA.72.PLAIN: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.

PSA.72.BSB: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
PSA.72.KJV: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
PSA.72.PLAIN: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.

PSA.72.BSB: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
PSA.72.KJV: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
PSA.72.PLAIN: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.

PSA.72.BSB: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.
PSA.72.KJV: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth on the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.

PSA.72.BSB: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
PSA.72.KJV: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
PSA.72.PLAIN: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.

PSA.72.BSB: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
PSA.72.KJV: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only does wondrous things.
PSA.72.PLAIN: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

PSA.72.BSB: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
PSA.72.KJV: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
PSA.72.PLAIN: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.

PSA.72.BSB: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
PSA.72.KJV: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
PSA.72.PLAIN: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.

PSA.73.BSB: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
PSA.73.KJV: ¶ A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
PSA.73.PLAIN: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

PSA.73.BSB: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
PSA.73.KJV: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well near slipped.
PSA.73.PLAIN: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

PSA.73.BSB: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
PSA.73.KJV: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
PSA.73.PLAIN: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

PSA.73.BSB: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
PSA.73.KJV: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
PSA.73.PLAIN: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.

PSA.73.BSB: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
PSA.73.KJV: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
PSA.73.PLAIN: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.

PSA.73.BSB: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
PSA.73.KJV: Therefore pride compasses them about as a chain; violence covers them as a garment.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.

PSA.73.BSB: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
PSA.73.KJV: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
PSA.73.PLAIN: From their prosperity proceeds brokenness; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.

PSA.73.BSB: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
PSA.73.KJV: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
PSA.73.PLAIN: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

PSA.73.BSB: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
PSA.73.KJV: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.
PSA.73.PLAIN: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.

PSA.73.BSB: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
PSA.73.KJV: Therefore his people return here: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
PSA.73.PLAIN: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.

PSA.73.BSB: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
PSA.73.KJV: And they say, How does God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
PSA.73.PLAIN: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”

PSA.73.BSB: Behold, these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.
PSA.73.KJV: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Look closely — these are the wicked— always carefree as they increase their wealth.

PSA.73.BSB: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
PSA.73.KJV: Truly I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.

PSA.73.BSB: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
PSA.73.KJV: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
PSA.73.PLAIN: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.

PSA.73.BSB: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
PSA.73.KJV: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of your children.
PSA.73.PLAIN: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.

PSA.73.BSB: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
PSA.73.KJV: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
PSA.73.PLAIN: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight

PSA.73.BSB: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
PSA.73.KJV: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
PSA.73.PLAIN: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.

PSA.73.BSB: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
PSA.73.KJV: Surely you did set them in slippery places: you cast them down into destruction.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.

PSA.73.BSB: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
PSA.73.KJV: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
PSA.73.PLAIN: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!

PSA.73.BSB: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
PSA.73.KJV: As a dream when one wakes; so, O Lord, when you wake, you shall despise their image.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.

PSA.73.BSB: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
PSA.73.KJV: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
PSA.73.PLAIN: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,

PSA.73.BSB: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
PSA.73.KJV: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before you.
PSA.73.PLAIN: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.

PSA.73.BSB: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
PSA.73.KJV: Nevertheless I am continually with you: you have held me by my right hand.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.

PSA.73.BSB: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
PSA.73.KJV: You shall guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
PSA.73.PLAIN: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.

PSA.73.BSB: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
PSA.73.KJV: Whom have I in heaven but you? and there is none on earth that I desire beside you.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.

PSA.73.BSB: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
PSA.73.KJV: My flesh and my heart fails: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
PSA.73.PLAIN: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

PSA.73.BSB: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
PSA.73.KJV: For, see, they that are far from you shall perish: you have destroyed all them that go a whoring from you.
PSA.73.PLAIN: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.

PSA.73.BSB: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
PSA.73.KJV: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all your works.
PSA.73.PLAIN: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.

PSA.74.BSB: A Maskil of Asaph. Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
PSA.74.KJV: ¶ Maschil of Asaph. O God, why have you cast us off for ever? why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?
PSA.74.PLAIN: A Maskil of Asaph. Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?

PSA.74.BSB: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion where You dwell.
PSA.74.KJV: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old; the rod of your inheritance, which you have redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein you have dwelled.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance— Mount Zion where You dwell.

PSA.74.BSB: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
PSA.74.KJV: Lift up your feet to the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.

PSA.74.BSB: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
PSA.74.KJV: Your enemies roar in the middle of your congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,

PSA.74.BSB: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
PSA.74.KJV: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes on the thick trees.
PSA.74.PLAIN: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees

PSA.74.BSB: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
PSA.74.KJV: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
PSA.74.PLAIN: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.

PSA.74.BSB: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
PSA.74.KJV: They have cast fire into your sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of your name to the ground.
PSA.74.PLAIN: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.

PSA.74.BSB: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
PSA.74.KJV: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
PSA.74.PLAIN: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.

PSA.74.BSB: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
PSA.74.KJV: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knows how long.
PSA.74.PLAIN: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.

PSA.74.BSB: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
PSA.74.KJV: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme your name for ever?
PSA.74.PLAIN: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?

PSA.74.BSB: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
PSA.74.KJV: Why withdraw you your hand, even your right hand? pluck it out of your bosom.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!

PSA.74.BSB: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
PSA.74.KJV: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the middle of the earth.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.

PSA.74.BSB: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
PSA.74.KJV: You did divide the sea by your strength: you brake the heads of the dragons in the waters.
PSA.74.PLAIN: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;

PSA.74.BSB: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
PSA.74.KJV: You brake the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gave him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
PSA.74.PLAIN: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.

PSA.74.BSB: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
PSA.74.KJV: You did split the fountain and the flood: you dried up mighty rivers.
PSA.74.PLAIN: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.

PSA.74.BSB: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
PSA.74.KJV: The day is yours, the night also is yours: you have prepared the light and the sun.
PSA.74.PLAIN: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.

PSA.74.BSB: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
PSA.74.KJV: You have set all the borders of the earth: you have made summer and winter.
PSA.74.PLAIN: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.

PSA.74.BSB: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
PSA.74.KJV: Remember this, that the enemy has reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed your name.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O Lord, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.

PSA.74.BSB: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
PSA.74.KJV: O deliver not the soul of your turtledove to the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of your poor for ever.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.

PSA.74.BSB: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
PSA.74.KJV: Have respect to the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

PSA.74.BSB: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
PSA.74.KJV: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise your name.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.

PSA.74.BSB: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
PSA.74.KJV: Arise, O God, plead your own cause: remember how the foolish man reproaches you daily.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.

PSA.74.BSB: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
PSA.74.KJV: Forget not the voice of your enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against you increases continually.
PSA.74.PLAIN: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.

PSA.75.BSB: For the choirmaster: To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.
PSA.75.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician Al-taschith, A Psalm of Asaph. To you, O God, do we give thanks, to you do we give thanks: for that your name is near your wondrous works declare.
PSA.75.PLAIN: For the choirmaster: To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.

PSA.75.BSB: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
PSA.75.KJV: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
PSA.75.PLAIN: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.

PSA.75.BSB: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
PSA.75.KJV: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
PSA.75.PLAIN: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah

PSA.75.BSB: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
PSA.75.KJV: I said to the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
PSA.75.PLAIN: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.

PSA.75.BSB: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
PSA.75.KJV: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
PSA.75.PLAIN: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”

PSA.75.BSB: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
PSA.75.KJV: For promotion comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
PSA.75.PLAIN: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,

PSA.75.BSB: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
PSA.75.KJV: But God is the judge: he puts down one, and sets up another.
PSA.75.PLAIN: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.

PSA.75.BSB: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.
PSA.75.KJV: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
PSA.75.PLAIN: For a cup is in the hand of the Lord, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.

PSA.75.BSB: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
PSA.75.KJV: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
PSA.75.PLAIN: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

PSA.75.BSB: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
PSA.75.KJV: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
PSA.75.PLAIN: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”

PSA.76.BSB: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
PSA.76.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician on Neginoth, a Psalm or song of Asaph. In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
PSA.76.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.

PSA.76.BSB: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
PSA.76.KJV: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
PSA.76.PLAIN: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.

PSA.76.BSB: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
PSA.76.KJV: There broke he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
PSA.76.PLAIN: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah

PSA.76.BSB: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
PSA.76.KJV: You are more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
PSA.76.PLAIN: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.

PSA.76.BSB: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
PSA.76.KJV: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
PSA.76.PLAIN: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.

PSA.76.BSB: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
PSA.76.KJV: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
PSA.76.PLAIN: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.

PSA.76.BSB: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
PSA.76.KJV: You, even you, are to be feared: and who may stand in your sight when once you are angry?
PSA.76.PLAIN: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?

PSA.76.BSB: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
PSA.76.KJV: You did cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
PSA.76.PLAIN: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still

PSA.76.BSB: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
PSA.76.KJV: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
PSA.76.PLAIN: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah

PSA.76.BSB: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
PSA.76.KJV: Surely the wrath of man shall praise you: the remainder of wrath shall you restrain.
PSA.76.PLAIN: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.

PSA.76.BSB: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
PSA.76.KJV: Vow, and pay to the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents to him that ought to be feared.
PSA.76.PLAIN: Make and fulfill your vows to the Lord your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.

PSA.76.BSB: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
PSA.76.KJV: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
PSA.76.PLAIN: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.

PSA.77.BSB: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
PSA.77.KJV: ¶ To the chief musician, to Jeduthun, a Psalm of Asaph. I cried to God with my voice, even to God with my voice; and he gave ear to me.
PSA.77.PLAIN: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.

PSA.77.BSB: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
PSA.77.KJV: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
PSA.77.PLAIN: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.

PSA.77.BSB: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
PSA.77.KJV: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
PSA.77.PLAIN: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah

PSA.77.BSB: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
PSA.77.KJV: You hold my eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
PSA.77.PLAIN: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.

PSA.77.BSB: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
PSA.77.KJV: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
PSA.77.PLAIN: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.

PSA.77.BSB: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
PSA.77.KJV: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with my own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
PSA.77.PLAIN: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:

PSA.77.BSB: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
PSA.77.KJV: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favorable no more?
PSA.77.PLAIN: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?

PSA.77.BSB: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
PSA.77.KJV: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? does his promise fail for ever more?
PSA.77.PLAIN: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?

PSA.77.BSB: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
PSA.77.KJV: Has God forgotten to be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
PSA.77.PLAIN: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah

PSA.77.BSB: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
PSA.77.KJV: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
PSA.77.PLAIN: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”

PSA.77.BSB: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
PSA.77.KJV: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember your wonders of old.
PSA.77.PLAIN: I will remember the works of the Lord; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.

PSA.77.BSB: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
PSA.77.KJV: I will meditate also of all your work, and talk of your doings.
PSA.77.PLAIN: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.

PSA.77.BSB: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
PSA.77.KJV: Your way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
PSA.77.PLAIN: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?

PSA.77.BSB: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
PSA.77.KJV: You are the God that do wonders: you have declared your strength among the people.
PSA.77.PLAIN: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.

PSA.77.BSB: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
PSA.77.KJV: You have with your arm redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
PSA.77.PLAIN: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

PSA.77.BSB: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
PSA.77.KJV: The waters saw you, O God, the waters saw you; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
PSA.77.PLAIN: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.

PSA.77.BSB: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
PSA.77.KJV: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: your arrows also went abroad.
PSA.77.PLAIN: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.

PSA.77.BSB: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
