ISA.19.KJV: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say you to Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
ISA.19.PLAIN: The princes of Zoan are mere fools; Pharaoh’s wise counselors give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the wise, a son of eastern kings”?

ISA.19.BSB: Where are your wise men now? Let them tell you and reveal what the LORD of Hosts has planned against Egypt.
ISA.19.KJV: Where are they? where are your wise men? and let them tell you now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts has purposed on Egypt.
ISA.19.PLAIN: Where are your wise men now? Let them tell you and reveal what the Lord of Hosts has planned against Egypt.

ISA.19.BSB: The princes of Zoan have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deceived. The cornerstones of her tribes have led Egypt astray.
ISA.19.KJV: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
ISA.19.PLAIN: The princes of Zoan have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deceived. The cornerstones of her tribes have led Egypt astray.

ISA.19.BSB: The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion. Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers through his own vomit.
ISA.19.KJV: The LORD has mingled a perverse spirit in the middle thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
ISA.19.PLAIN: The Lord has poured into her a spirit of confusion. Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers through his own vomit.

ISA.19.BSB: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm or reed.
ISA.19.KJV: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
ISA.19.PLAIN: There is nothing Egypt can do— head or tail, palm or reed.

ISA.19.BSB: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble with fear beneath the uplifted hand of the LORD of Hosts, when He brandishes it against them.
ISA.19.KJV: In that day shall Egypt be like to women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shakes over it.
ISA.19.PLAIN: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble with fear beneath the uplifted hand of the Lord of Hosts, when He brandishes it against them.

ISA.19.BSB: The land of Judah will bring terror to Egypt; whenever Judah is mentioned, Egypt will tremble over what the LORD of Hosts has planned against it.
ISA.19.KJV: And the land of Judah shall be a terror to Egypt, every one that makes mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he has determined against it. ¶
ISA.19.PLAIN: The land of Judah will bring terror to Egypt; whenever Judah is mentioned, Egypt will tremble over what the Lord of Hosts has planned against it.

ISA.19.BSB: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
ISA.19.KJV: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
ISA.19.PLAIN: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the Lord of Hosts. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.

ISA.19.BSB: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD near her border.
ISA.19.KJV: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
ISA.19.PLAIN: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord near her border.

ISA.19.BSB: It will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of Hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
ISA.19.KJV: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry to the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a savior, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
ISA.19.PLAIN: It will be a sign and a witness to the Lord of Hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the Lord because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.

ISA.19.BSB: The LORD will make Himself known to Egypt, and on that day Egypt will acknowledge the LORD. They will worship with sacrifices and offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and fulfill them.
ISA.19.KJV: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yes, they shall vow a vow to the LORD, and perform it.
ISA.19.PLAIN: The Lord will make Himself known to Egypt, and on that day Egypt will acknowledge the Lord. They will worship with sacrifices and offerings; they will make vows to the Lord and fulfill them.

ISA.19.BSB: And the LORD will strike Egypt with a plague; He will strike them but heal them. They will turn to the LORD, and He will hear their prayers and heal them.
ISA.19.KJV: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be entreated of them, and shall heal them. ¶
ISA.19.PLAIN: And the Lord will strike Egypt with a plague; He will strike them but heal them. They will turn to the Lord, and He will hear their prayers and heal them.

ISA.19.BSB: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
ISA.19.KJV: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
ISA.19.PLAIN: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.

ISA.19.BSB: In that day Israel will join a three-party alliance with Egypt and Assyria—a blessing upon the earth.
ISA.19.KJV: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the middle of the land:
ISA.19.PLAIN: In that day Israel will join a three-party alliance with Egypt and Assyria—a blessing upon the earth.

ISA.19.BSB: The LORD of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”
ISA.19.KJV: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.
ISA.19.PLAIN: The Lord of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”

ISA.20.BSB: Before the year that the chief commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it,
ISA.20.KJV: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
ISA.20.PLAIN: Before the year that the chief commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it,

ISA.20.BSB: the LORD had already spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.” And Isaiah did so, walking around naked and barefoot.
ISA.20.KJV: At the same time spoke the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off your loins, and put off your shoe from your foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
ISA.20.PLAIN: the Lord had already spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.” And Isaiah did so, walking around naked and barefoot.

ISA.20.BSB: Then the LORD said, “Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush,
ISA.20.KJV: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder on Egypt and on Ethiopia;
ISA.20.PLAIN: Then the Lord said, “Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush,

ISA.20.BSB: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old alike, naked and barefoot, with bared buttocks—to Egypt’s shame.
ISA.20.KJV: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
ISA.20.PLAIN: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old alike, naked and barefoot, with bared buttocks—to Egypt’s shame.

ISA.20.BSB: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
ISA.20.KJV: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
ISA.20.PLAIN: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.

ISA.20.BSB: And on that day the dwellers of this coastland will say, ‘See what has happened to our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’”
ISA.20.KJV: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, where we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
ISA.20.PLAIN: And on that day the dwellers of this coastland will say, ‘See what has happened to our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’”

ISA.21.BSB: This is the burden against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negev, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.
ISA.21.KJV: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it comes from the desert, from a terrible land.
ISA.21.PLAIN: This is the burden against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negev, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.

ISA.21.BSB: A dire vision is declared to me: “The traitor still betrays, and the destroyer still destroys. Go up, O Elam! Lay siege, O Media! I will put an end to all her groaning.”
ISA.21.KJV: A grievous vision is declared to me; the treacherous dealer deals treacherously, and the spoiler spoils. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
ISA.21.PLAIN: A dire vision is declared to me: “The traitor still betrays, and the destroyer still destroys. Go up, O Elam! Lay siege, O Media! I will put an end to all her groaning.”

ISA.21.BSB: Therefore my body is filled with anguish. Pain grips me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am bewildered to hear, I am dismayed to see.
ISA.21.KJV: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold on me, as the pangs of a woman that travails: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
ISA.21.PLAIN: Therefore my body is filled with anguish. Pain grips me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am bewildered to hear, I am dismayed to see.

ISA.21.BSB: My heart falters; fear makes me tremble. The twilight of my desire has turned to horror.
ISA.21.KJV: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure has he turned into fear to me.
ISA.21.PLAIN: My heart falters; fear makes me tremble. The twilight of my desire has turned to horror.

ISA.21.BSB: They prepare a table, they lay out a carpet, they eat, they drink! Rise up, O princes, oil the shields!
ISA.21.KJV: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, you princes, and anoint the shield.
ISA.21.PLAIN: They prepare a table, they lay out a carpet, they eat, they drink! Rise up, O princes, oil the shields!

ISA.21.BSB: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
ISA.21.KJV: For thus has the LORD said to me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he sees.
ISA.21.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.

ISA.21.BSB: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, he must be alert, fully alert.”
ISA.21.KJV: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he listened diligently with much heed:
ISA.21.PLAIN: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, he must be alert, fully alert.”

ISA.21.BSB: Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
ISA.21.KJV: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
ISA.21.PLAIN: Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.

ISA.21.BSB: Look, here come the riders, horsemen in pairs.” And one answered, saying: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground!”
ISA.21.KJV: And, behold, here comes a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he has broken to the ground.
ISA.21.PLAIN: Look, here come the riders, horsemen in pairs.” And one answered, saying: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground!”

ISA.21.BSB: O my people, crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel.
ISA.21.KJV: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared to you. ¶
ISA.21.PLAIN: O my people, crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the Lord of Hosts, the God of Israel.

ISA.21.BSB: This is the burden against Dumah: One calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?”
ISA.21.KJV: The burden of Dumah. He calls to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
ISA.21.PLAIN: This is the burden against Dumah: One calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?”

ISA.21.BSB: The watchman replies, “Morning has come, but also the night. If you would inquire, then inquire. Come back yet again.”
ISA.21.KJV: The watchman said, The morning comes, and also the night: if you will inquire, inquire you: return, come. ¶
ISA.21.PLAIN: The watchman replies, “Morning has come, but also the night. If you would inquire, then inquire. Come back yet again.”

ISA.21.BSB: This is the burden against Arabia: In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.
ISA.21.KJV: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall you lodge, O you traveling companies of Dedanim.
ISA.21.PLAIN: This is the burden against Arabia: In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.

ISA.21.BSB: Bring water for the thirsty, O dwellers of Tema; meet the refugees with food.
ISA.21.KJV: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
ISA.21.PLAIN: Bring water for the thirsty, O dwellers of Tema; meet the refugees with food.

ISA.21.BSB: For they flee from the sword— the sword that is drawn— from the bow that is bent, and from the stress of battle.
ISA.21.KJV: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
ISA.21.PLAIN: For they flee from the sword— the sword that is drawn— from the bow that is bent, and from the stress of battle.

ISA.21.BSB: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.
ISA.21.KJV: For thus has the LORD said to me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
ISA.21.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.

ISA.21.BSB: The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.” For the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.
ISA.21.KJV: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel has spoken it.
ISA.21.PLAIN: The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.” For the Lord, the God of Israel, has spoken.

ISA.22.BSB: This is the burden against the Valley of Vision: What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the rooftops,
ISA.22.KJV: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you are wholly gone up to the housetops?
ISA.22.PLAIN: This is the burden against the Valley of Vision: What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the rooftops,

ISA.22.BSB: O city of commotion, O town of revelry? Your slain did not die by the sword, nor were they killed in battle.
ISA.22.KJV: You that are full of stirs, a tumultuous city, joyous city: your slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
ISA.22.PLAIN: O city of commotion, O town of revelry? Your slain did not die by the sword, nor were they killed in battle.

ISA.22.BSB: All your rulers have fled together, captured without a bow. All your fugitives were captured together, having fled to a distant place.
ISA.22.KJV: All your rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in you are bound together, which have fled from far.
ISA.22.PLAIN: All your rulers have fled together, captured without a bow. All your fugitives were captured together, having fled to a distant place.

ISA.22.BSB: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.”
ISA.22.KJV: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labor not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
ISA.22.PLAIN: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.”

ISA.22.BSB: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision— of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains.
ISA.22.KJV: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
ISA.22.PLAIN: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision— of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains.

ISA.22.BSB: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.
ISA.22.KJV: And Elam bore the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
ISA.22.PLAIN: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.

ISA.22.BSB: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the gates.
ISA.22.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that your choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate. ¶
ISA.22.PLAIN: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the gates.

ISA.22.BSB: He has uncovered the defenses of Judah. On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.
ISA.22.KJV: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and you did look in that day to the armor of the house of the forest.
ISA.22.PLAIN: He has uncovered the defenses of Judah. On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.

ISA.22.BSB: You saw that there were many breaches in the walls of the City of David. You collected water from the lower pool.
ISA.22.KJV: You have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
ISA.22.PLAIN: You saw that there were many breaches in the walls of the City of David. You collected water from the lower pool.

ISA.22.BSB: You counted the houses of Jerusalem and tore them down to strengthen the wall.
ISA.22.KJV: And you have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have you broken down to fortify the wall.
ISA.22.PLAIN: You counted the houses of Jerusalem and tore them down to strengthen the wall.

ISA.22.BSB: You built a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the ancient pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or consider Him who planned it long ago.
ISA.22.KJV: You made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but you have not looked to the maker thereof, neither had respect to him that fashioned it long ago.
ISA.22.PLAIN: You built a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the ancient pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or consider Him who planned it long ago.

ISA.22.BSB: On that day the Lord GOD of Hosts called for weeping and wailing, for shaven heads and the wearing of sackcloth.
ISA.22.KJV: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
ISA.22.PLAIN: On that day the Lord GOD of Hosts called for weeping and wailing, for shaven heads and the wearing of sackcloth.

ISA.22.BSB: But look, there is joy and gladness, butchering of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!”
ISA.22.KJV: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
ISA.22.PLAIN: But look, there is joy and gladness, butchering of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!”

ISA.22.BSB: The LORD of Hosts has revealed in my hearing: “Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.
ISA.22.KJV: And it was revealed in my ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till you die, says the Lord GOD of hosts. ¶
ISA.22.PLAIN: The Lord of Hosts has revealed in my hearing: “Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.

ISA.22.BSB: This is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says: “Go, say to Shebna, the steward in charge of the palace:
ISA.22.KJV: Thus says the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get you to this treasurer, even to Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
ISA.22.PLAIN: This is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says: “Go, say to Shebna, the steward in charge of the palace:

ISA.22.BSB: What are you doing here, and who authorized you to carve out a tomb for yourself here—to chisel your tomb in the height and cut your resting place in the rock?
ISA.22.KJV: What have you here? and whom have you here, that you have hewed you out a sepulcher here, as he that hews him out a sepulcher on high, and that engraves an habitation for himself in a rock?
ISA.22.PLAIN: What are you doing here, and who authorized you to carve out a tomb for yourself here—to chisel your tomb in the height and cut your resting place in the rock?

ISA.22.BSB: Look, O mighty man! The LORD is about to shake you violently. He will take hold of you,
ISA.22.KJV: Behold, the LORD will carry you away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover you.
ISA.22.PLAIN: Look, O mighty man! The Lord is about to shake you violently. He will take hold of you,

ISA.22.BSB: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land. There you will die, and there your glorious chariots will remain—a disgrace to the house of your master.
ISA.22.KJV: He will surely violently turn and toss you like a ball into a large country: there shall you die, and there the chariots of your glory shall be the shame of your lord’s house.
ISA.22.PLAIN: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land. There you will die, and there your glorious chariots will remain—a disgrace to the house of your master.

ISA.22.BSB: I will remove you from office, and you will be ousted from your position.
ISA.22.KJV: And I will drive you from your station, and from your state shall he pull you down. ¶
ISA.22.PLAIN: I will remove you from office, and you will be ousted from your position.

ISA.22.BSB: On that day I will summon My servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
ISA.22.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
ISA.22.PLAIN: On that day I will summon My servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

ISA.22.BSB: I will clothe him with your robe and tie your sash around him. I will put your authority in his hand, and he will be a father to the dwellers of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
ISA.22.KJV: And I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your girdle, and I will commit your government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
ISA.22.PLAIN: I will clothe him with your robe and tie your sash around him. I will put your authority in his hand, and he will be a father to the dwellers of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.

ISA.22.BSB: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
ISA.22.KJV: And the key of the house of David will I lay on his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
ISA.22.PLAIN: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

ISA.22.BSB: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place, and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father.
ISA.22.KJV: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.
ISA.22.PLAIN: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place, and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father.

ISA.22.BSB: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house: the descendants and the offshoots—all the lesser vessels, from bowls to every kind of jar.
ISA.22.KJV: And they shall hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
ISA.22.PLAIN: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house: the descendants and the offshoots—all the lesser vessels, from bowls to every kind of jar.

ISA.22.BSB: In that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and fall, and the load upon it will be cut down.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
ISA.22.KJV: In that day, says the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was on it shall be cut off: for the LORD has spoken it.
ISA.22.PLAIN: In that day, declares the Lord of Hosts, the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and fall, and the load upon it will be cut down.” Indeed, the Lord has spoken.

ISA.23.BSB: This is the burden against Tyre: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste, without house or harbor. Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus.
ISA.23.KJV: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
ISA.23.PLAIN: This is the burden against Tyre: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste, without house or harbor. Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus.

ISA.23.BSB: Be silent, O dwellers of the coastland, you merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.
ISA.23.KJV: Be still, you inhabitants of the isle; you whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Be silent, O dwellers of the coastland, you merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.

ISA.23.BSB: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre; she was the merchant of the nations.
ISA.23.KJV: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
ISA.23.PLAIN: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre; she was the merchant of the nations.

ISA.23.BSB: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”
ISA.23.KJV: Be you ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea has spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”

ISA.23.BSB: When the report reaches Egypt, they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre.
ISA.23.KJV: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
ISA.23.PLAIN: When the report reaches Egypt, they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre.

ISA.23.BSB: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!
ISA.23.KJV: Pass you over to Tarshish; howl, you inhabitants of the isle.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!

ISA.23.BSB: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
ISA.23.KJV: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?

ISA.23.BSB: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders are princes, whose merchants are renowned on the earth?
ISA.23.KJV: Who has taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?
ISA.23.PLAIN: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders are princes, whose merchants are renowned on the earth?

ISA.23.BSB: The LORD of Hosts planned it, to defile all its glorious beauty, to disgrace all the renowned of the earth.
ISA.23.KJV: The LORD of hosts has purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
ISA.23.PLAIN: The Lord of Hosts planned it, to defile all its glorious beauty, to disgrace all the renowned of the earth.

ISA.23.BSB: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.
ISA.23.KJV: Pass through your land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.

ISA.23.BSB: The LORD has stretched out His hand over the sea; He has made kingdoms tremble. He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.
ISA.23.KJV: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD has given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
ISA.23.PLAIN: The Lord has stretched out His hand over the sea; He has made kingdoms tremble. He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.

ISA.23.BSB: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus— even there you will find no rest.”
ISA.23.KJV: And he said, You shall no more rejoice, O you oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shall you have no rest.
ISA.23.PLAIN: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus— even there you will find no rest.”

ISA.23.BSB: Look at the land of the Chaldeans— a people now of no account. The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures; they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces. They brought it to ruin.
ISA.23.KJV: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Look at the land of the Chaldeans— a people now of no account. The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures; they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces. They brought it to ruin.

ISA.23.BSB: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor has been destroyed!
ISA.23.KJV: Howl, you ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor has been destroyed!

ISA.23.BSB: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life. But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
ISA.23.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
ISA.23.PLAIN: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life. But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:

ISA.23.BSB: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody, sing many a song, so you will be remembered.”
ISA.23.KJV: Take an harp, go about the city, you harlot that have been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that you may be remembered. ¶
ISA.23.PLAIN: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody, sing many a song, so you will be remembered.”

ISA.23.BSB: And at the end of seventy years, the LORD will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
ISA.23.KJV: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
ISA.23.PLAIN: And at the end of seventy years, the Lord will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.

ISA.23.BSB: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD; they will not be stored or saved, for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothing.
ISA.23.KJV: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
ISA.23.PLAIN: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the Lord; they will not be stored or saved, for her profit will go to those who live before the Lord, for abundant food and fine clothing.

ISA.24.BSB: Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—
ISA.24.KJV: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, and makes it waste, and turns it upside down, and scatters abroad the inhabitants thereof.
ISA.24.PLAIN: Look closely — the Lord lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—

ISA.24.BSB: people and priest alike, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.
ISA.24.KJV: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
ISA.24.PLAIN: people and priest alike, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.

ISA.24.BSB: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
ISA.24.KJV: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD has spoken this word.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the Lord has spoken this word.

ISA.24.BSB: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
ISA.24.KJV: The earth mourns and fades away, the world languishes and fades away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.

ISA.24.BSB: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
ISA.24.KJV: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.

ISA.24.BSB: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.
ISA.24.KJV: Therefore has the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
ISA.24.PLAIN: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.

ISA.24.BSB: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.
ISA.24.KJV: The new wine mourns, the vine languishes, all the merry hearted do sigh.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.

ISA.24.BSB: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
ISA.24.KJV: The mirth of tabrets ceases, the noise of them that rejoice ends, the joy of the harp ceases.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.

ISA.24.BSB: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
ISA.24.KJV: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
ISA.24.PLAIN: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.

ISA.24.BSB: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
ISA.24.KJV: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.

ISA.24.BSB: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.
ISA.24.KJV: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
ISA.24.PLAIN: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.

ISA.24.BSB: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
ISA.24.KJV: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction. ¶
ISA.24.PLAIN: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.

ISA.24.BSB: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.
ISA.24.KJV: When thus it shall be in the middle of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
ISA.24.PLAIN: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.

ISA.24.BSB: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
ISA.24.KJV: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
ISA.24.PLAIN: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the Lord.

ISA.24.BSB: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
ISA.24.KJV: Why glorify you the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea. ¶
ISA.24.PLAIN: Therefore glorify the Lord in the east. Extol the name of the Lord, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.

ISA.24.BSB: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.
ISA.24.KJV: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe to me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yes, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
ISA.24.PLAIN: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.

ISA.24.BSB: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
ISA.24.KJV: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are on you, O inhabitant of the earth.
ISA.24.PLAIN: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.

ISA.24.BSB: Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.
ISA.24.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that he who flees from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that comes up out of the middle of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
ISA.24.PLAIN: Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.

ISA.24.BSB: The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.
ISA.24.KJV: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.

ISA.24.BSB: The earth staggers like a drunkard and sways like a shack. Earth’s rebellion weighs it down, and it falls, never to rise again.
ISA.24.KJV: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy on it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The earth staggers like a drunkard and sways like a shack. Earth’s rebellion weighs it down, and it falls, never to rise again.

ISA.24.BSB: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above and the kings of the earth below.
ISA.24.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
ISA.24.PLAIN: In that day the Lord will punish the host of heaven above and the kings of the earth below.

ISA.24.BSB: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
ISA.24.KJV: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
ISA.24.PLAIN: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.

ISA.24.BSB: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
ISA.24.KJV: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
ISA.24.PLAIN: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the Lord of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.

ISA.25.BSB: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
ISA.25.KJV: O Lord, you are my God; I will exalt you, I will praise your name; for you have done wonderful things; your counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
ISA.25.PLAIN: O Lord, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.

ISA.25.BSB: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
ISA.25.KJV: For you have made of a city an heap; of a defended city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
ISA.25.PLAIN: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.

ISA.25.BSB: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
ISA.25.KJV: Therefore shall the strong people glorify you, the city of the terrible nations shall fear you.
ISA.25.PLAIN: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.

ISA.25.BSB: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
ISA.25.KJV: For you have been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
ISA.25.PLAIN: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,

ISA.25.BSB: like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.
ISA.25.KJV: You shall bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low. ¶
ISA.25.PLAIN: like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.

ISA.25.BSB: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
ISA.25.KJV: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make to all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
ISA.25.PLAIN: On this mountain the Lord of Hosts will prepare a banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.

ISA.25.BSB: On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;
ISA.25.KJV: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
ISA.25.PLAIN: On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;

ISA.25.BSB: He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
ISA.25.KJV: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD has spoken it. ¶
ISA.25.PLAIN: He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the Lord has spoken.

ISA.25.BSB: And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
ISA.25.KJV: And it shall be said in that day, See, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
ISA.25.PLAIN: And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the Lord for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”

ISA.25.BSB: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw is trodden into the dung pile.
ISA.25.KJV: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
ISA.25.PLAIN: For the hand of the Lord will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw is trodden into the dung pile.

ISA.25.BSB: He will spread out his hands within it, as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim. His pride will be brought low, despite the skill of his hands.
ISA.25.KJV: And he shall spread forth his hands in the middle of them, as he that swims spreads forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
ISA.25.PLAIN: He will spread out his hands within it, as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim. His pride will be brought low, despite the skill of his hands.

ISA.25.BSB: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.
ISA.25.KJV: And the fortress of the high fort of your walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
ISA.25.PLAIN: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.

ISA.26.BSB: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
ISA.26.KJV: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
ISA.26.PLAIN: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.

ISA.26.BSB: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
ISA.26.KJV: Open you the gates, that the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.
ISA.26.PLAIN: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.

ISA.26.BSB: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
ISA.26.KJV: You will keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on you: because he trusts in you.
ISA.26.PLAIN: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

ISA.26.BSB: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
ISA.26.KJV: Trust you in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength: ¶
ISA.26.PLAIN: Trust in the Lord forever, because GOD the Lord is the Rock eternal.

ISA.26.BSB: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.
ISA.26.KJV: For he brings down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he lays it low; he lays it low, even to the ground; he brings it even to the dust.
ISA.26.PLAIN: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.

ISA.26.BSB: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.
ISA.26.KJV: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
ISA.26.PLAIN: Feet trample it down— the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.

ISA.26.BSB: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
ISA.26.KJV: The way of the just is uprightness: you, most upright, do weigh the path of the just.
ISA.26.PLAIN: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.

ISA.26.BSB: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
ISA.26.KJV: Yes, in the way of your judgments, O LORD, have we waited for you; the desire of our soul is to your name, and to the remembrance of you.
ISA.26.PLAIN: Yes, we wait for You, O Lord; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.

ISA.26.BSB: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
ISA.26.KJV: With my soul have I desired you in the night; yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you early: for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
ISA.26.PLAIN: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.

ISA.26.BSB: Though grace is shown to the wicked man, he does not learn righteousness. In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the LORD.
ISA.26.KJV: Let favor be showed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
ISA.26.PLAIN: Though grace is shown to the wicked man, he does not learn righteousness. In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the Lord.

ISA.26.BSB: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
ISA.26.KJV: LORD, when your hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yes, the fire of your enemies shall devour them. ¶
ISA.26.PLAIN: O Lord, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!

ISA.26.BSB: O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
ISA.26.KJV: LORD, you will ordain peace for us: for you also have worked all our works in us.
ISA.26.PLAIN: O Lord, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.

ISA.26.BSB: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have had dominion, but Your name alone do we confess.
ISA.26.KJV: O LORD our God, other lords beside you have had dominion over us: but by you only will we make mention of your name.
ISA.26.PLAIN: O Lord our God, other lords besides You have had dominion, but Your name alone do we confess.

ISA.26.BSB: The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.
ISA.26.KJV: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
ISA.26.PLAIN: The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.

ISA.26.BSB: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.
ISA.26.KJV: You have increased the nation, O LORD, you have increased the nation: you are glorified: you had removed it far to all the ends of the earth.
ISA.26.PLAIN: You have enlarged the nation, O Lord; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.

ISA.26.BSB: O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
ISA.26.KJV: LORD, in trouble have they visited you, they poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
ISA.26.PLAIN: O Lord, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.

ISA.26.BSB: As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain, so were we in Your presence, O LORD.
ISA.26.KJV: Like as a woman with child, that draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and cries out in her pangs; so have we been in your sight, O LORD.
ISA.26.PLAIN: As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain, so were we in Your presence, O Lord.

ISA.26.BSB: We were with child; we writhed in pain; but we gave birth to wind. We have given no salvation to the earth, nor brought any life into the world.
ISA.26.KJV: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
ISA.26.PLAIN: We were with child; we writhed in pain; but we gave birth to wind. We have given no salvation to the earth, nor brought any life into the world.

ISA.26.BSB: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
ISA.26.KJV: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead. ¶
ISA.26.PLAIN: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.

ISA.26.BSB: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
ISA.26.KJV: Come, my people, enter you into your chambers, and shut your doors about you: hide yourself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be over.
ISA.26.PLAIN: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.

ISA.26.BSB: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
ISA.26.KJV: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
ISA.26.PLAIN: For look closely — the Lord is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their brokenness. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.

ISA.27.BSB: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent—Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
ISA.27.KJV: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
ISA.27.PLAIN: In that day the Lord will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent—Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.

ISA.27.BSB: In that day: “Sing about a fruitful vineyard.
ISA.27.KJV: In that day sing you to her, A vineyard of red wine.
ISA.27.PLAIN: In that day: “Sing about a fruitful vineyard.

ISA.27.BSB: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
ISA.27.KJV: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
ISA.27.PLAIN: I, the Lord, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;

ISA.27.BSB: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.
ISA.27.KJV: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
ISA.27.PLAIN: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.

ISA.27.BSB: Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me— yes, let them make peace with Me.”
ISA.27.KJV: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
ISA.27.PLAIN: Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me— yes, let them make peace with Me.”

ISA.27.BSB: In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.
ISA.27.KJV: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit. ¶
ISA.27.PLAIN: In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.

ISA.27.BSB: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?
ISA.27.KJV: Has he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
ISA.27.PLAIN: Has the Lord struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?

ISA.27.BSB: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the east wind blows.
ISA.27.KJV: In measure, when it shoots forth, you will debate with it: he stays his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
ISA.27.PLAIN: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the east wind blows.

ISA.27.BSB: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
ISA.27.KJV: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he makes all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
ISA.27.PLAIN: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.

ISA.27.BSB: For the fortified city lies deserted— a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
ISA.27.KJV: Yet the defended city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
ISA.27.PLAIN: For the fortified city lies deserted— a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.

ISA.27.BSB: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
ISA.27.KJV: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will show them no favor. ¶
ISA.27.PLAIN: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.

ISA.27.BSB: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
ISA.27.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river to the stream of Egypt, and you shall be gathered one by one, O you children of Israel.
ISA.27.PLAIN: In that day the Lord will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.

ISA.27.BSB: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt. And they will worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
ISA.27.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
ISA.27.PLAIN: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt. And they will worship the Lord on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

ISA.28.BSB: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
ISA.28.KJV: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
ISA.28.PLAIN: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.

ISA.28.BSB: Behold, the Lord has one who is strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest, like a driving rain or flooding downpour, he will smash that crown to the ground.
ISA.28.KJV: Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
ISA.28.PLAIN: Look closely — the Lord has one who is strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest, like a driving rain or flooding downpour, he will smash that crown to the ground.

ISA.28.BSB: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot.
ISA.28.KJV: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
ISA.28.PLAIN: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot.

ISA.28.BSB: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.
ISA.28.KJV: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looks on it sees, while it is yet in his hand he eats it up. ¶
ISA.28.PLAIN: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.

ISA.28.BSB: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
ISA.28.KJV: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people,
ISA.28.PLAIN: On that day the Lord of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,

ISA.28.BSB: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate.
ISA.28.KJV: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sits in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate. ¶
ISA.28.PLAIN: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate.

ISA.28.BSB: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.
ISA.28.KJV: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
ISA.28.PLAIN: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.

ISA.28.BSB: For all their tables are covered with vomit; there is not a place without filth.
ISA.28.KJV: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean. ¶
ISA.28.PLAIN: For all their tables are covered with vomit; there is not a place without filth.

ISA.28.BSB: Whom is He trying to teach? To whom is He explaining His message? To infants just weaned from milk? To babies removed from the breast?
ISA.28.KJV: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
ISA.28.PLAIN: Whom is He trying to teach? To whom is He explaining His message? To infants just weaned from milk? To babies removed from the breast?

ISA.28.BSB: For they hear: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there.”
ISA.28.KJV: For precept must be on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, and there a little:
ISA.28.PLAIN: For they hear: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there.”

ISA.28.BSB: Indeed, with mocking lips and foreign tongues, He will speak to this people
ISA.28.KJV: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
ISA.28.PLAIN: Indeed, with mocking lips and foreign tongues, He will speak to this people

ISA.28.BSB: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.
ISA.28.KJV: To whom he said, This is the rest with which you may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
ISA.28.PLAIN: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.

ISA.28.BSB: Then the word of the LORD to them will become: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there,” so that they will go stumbling backward and will be injured, ensnared, and captured.
ISA.28.KJV: But the word of the LORD was to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken. ¶
ISA.28.PLAIN: Then the word of the Lord to them will become: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there,” so that they will go stumbling backward and will be injured, ensnared, and captured.

ISA.28.BSB: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
ISA.28.KJV: Why hear the word of the LORD, you scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
ISA.28.PLAIN: Therefore hear the word of the Lord, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

ISA.28.BSB: For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
ISA.28.KJV: Because you have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing whip shall pass through, it shall not come to us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves: ¶
ISA.28.PLAIN: For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”

ISA.28.BSB: So this is what the Lord GOD says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.
ISA.28.KJV: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believes shall not make haste.
ISA.28.PLAIN: So this is what the Lord GOD says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.

ISA.28.BSB: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
ISA.28.KJV: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place. ¶
ISA.28.PLAIN: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.

ISA.28.BSB: Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
ISA.28.KJV: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing whip shall pass through, then you shall be trodden down by it.
ISA.28.PLAIN: Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.

ISA.28.BSB: As often as it passes through, it will carry you away; it will sweep through morning after morning, by day and by night.” The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.
ISA.28.KJV: From the time that it goes forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
ISA.28.PLAIN: As often as it passes through, it will carry you away; it will sweep through morning after morning, by day and by night.” The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.

ISA.28.BSB: Indeed, the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too small to wrap around you.
ISA.28.KJV: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
