ISA.30.BSB: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
ISA.30.KJV: You shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
ISA.30.PLAIN: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the Lord, to the Rock of Israel.

ISA.30.BSB: And the LORD will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed, striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.
ISA.30.KJV: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall show the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
ISA.30.PLAIN: And the Lord will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed, striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.

ISA.30.BSB: For Assyria will be shattered at the voice of the LORD; He will strike them with His scepter.
ISA.30.KJV: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
ISA.30.PLAIN: For Assyria will be shattered at the voice of the Lord; He will strike them with His scepter.

ISA.30.BSB: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.
ISA.30.KJV: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay on him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
ISA.30.PLAIN: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the Lord brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.

ISA.30.BSB: For Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its funeral pyre is deep and wide, with plenty of fire and wood. The breath of the LORD, like a torrent of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.
ISA.30.KJV: For Tophet is ordained of old; yes, for the king it is prepared; he has made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, does kindle it.
ISA.30.PLAIN: For Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its funeral pyre is deep and wide, with plenty of fire and wood. The breath of the Lord, like a torrent of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.

ISA.31.BSB: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
ISA.31.KJV: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not to the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
ISA.31.PLAIN: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the Lord.

ISA.31.BSB: Yet He too is wise and brings disaster; He does not call back His words. He will rise up against the house of the wicked and against the allies of evildoers.
ISA.31.KJV: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
ISA.31.PLAIN: Yet He too is wise and brings disaster; He does not call back His words. He will rise up against the house of the wicked and against the allies of evildoers.

ISA.31.BSB: But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.
ISA.31.KJV: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helps shall fall, and he that is helped shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
ISA.31.PLAIN: But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the Lord stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.

ISA.31.BSB: For this is what the LORD has said to me: “Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey— and though a band of shepherds is called out against it, it is not terrified by their shouting or subdued by their clamor— so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and its heights.
ISA.31.KJV: For thus has the LORD spoken to me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
ISA.31.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord has said to me: “Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey— and though a band of shepherds is called out against it, it is not terrified by their shouting or subdued by their clamor— so the Lord of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and its heights.

ISA.31.BSB: Like birds hovering overhead, so the LORD of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and deliver it; He will pass over it and preserve it.”
ISA.31.KJV: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it. ¶
ISA.31.PLAIN: Like birds hovering overhead, so the Lord of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and deliver it; He will pass over it and preserve it.”

ISA.31.BSB: Return to the One against whom you have so blatantly rebelled, O children of Israel.
ISA.31.KJV: Turn you to him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
ISA.31.PLAIN: Return to the One against whom you have so blatantly rebelled, O children of Israel.

ISA.31.BSB: For on that day, every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold that your own hands have sinfully made.
ISA.31.KJV: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made to you for a sin. ¶
ISA.31.PLAIN: For on that day, every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold that your own hands have sinfully made.

ISA.31.BSB: “Then Assyria will fall, but not by the sword of man; a sword will devour them, but not one made by mortals. They will flee before the sword, and their young men will be put to forced labor.
ISA.31.KJV: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
ISA.31.PLAIN: “Then Assyria will fall, but not by the sword of man; a sword will devour them, but not one made by mortals. They will flee before the sword, and their young men will be put to forced labor.

ISA.31.BSB: Their rock will pass away for fear, and their princes will panic at the sight of the battle standard,” declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
ISA.31.KJV: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
ISA.31.PLAIN: Their rock will pass away for fear, and their princes will panic at the sight of the battle standard,” declares the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

ISA.32.BSB: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule with justice.
ISA.32.KJV: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Look closely — a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule with justice.

ISA.32.BSB: Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.
ISA.32.KJV: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.

ISA.32.BSB: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
ISA.32.KJV: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall listen.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

ISA.32.BSB: The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.
ISA.32.KJV: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
ISA.32.PLAIN: The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.

ISA.32.BSB: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
ISA.32.KJV: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
ISA.32.PLAIN: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.

ISA.32.BSB: For a fool speaks foolishness; his mind plots iniquity. He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the LORD; he leaves the hungry empty and deprives the thirsty of drink.
ISA.32.KJV: For the vile person will speak villainy, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
ISA.32.PLAIN: For a fool speaks foolishness; his mind plots brokenness. He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the Lord; he leaves the hungry empty and deprives the thirsty of drink.

ISA.32.BSB: The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive; he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.
ISA.32.KJV: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he devises wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.
ISA.32.PLAIN: The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive; he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.

ISA.32.BSB: But a noble man makes honorable plans; he stands up for worthy causes.
ISA.32.KJV: But the liberal devises liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand. ¶
ISA.32.PLAIN: But a noble man makes honorable plans; he stands up for worthy causes.

ISA.32.BSB: Stand up, you complacent women; listen to me. Give ear to my word, you overconfident daughters.
ISA.32.KJV: Rise up, you women that are at ease; hear my voice, you careless daughters; give ear to my speech.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Stand up, you complacent women; listen to me. Give ear to my word, you overconfident daughters.

ISA.32.BSB: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.
ISA.32.KJV: Many days and years shall you be troubled, you careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
ISA.32.PLAIN: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.

ISA.32.BSB: Shudder, you ladies of leisure; tremble, you daughters of complacency. Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists.
ISA.32.KJV: Tremble, you women that are at ease; be troubled, you careless ones: strip you, and make you bore, and gird sackcloth on your loins.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Shudder, you ladies of leisure; tremble, you daughters of complacency. Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists.

ISA.32.BSB: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,
ISA.32.KJV: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,

ISA.32.BSB: and for the land of my people, overgrown with thorns and briers— even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry.
ISA.32.KJV: On the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
ISA.32.PLAIN: and for the land of my people, overgrown with thorns and briers— even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry.

ISA.32.BSB: For the palace will be forsaken, the busy city abandoned. The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever— the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks—
ISA.32.KJV: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
ISA.32.PLAIN: For the palace will be forsaken, the busy city abandoned. The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever— the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks—

ISA.32.BSB: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high. Then the desert will be an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.
ISA.32.KJV: Until the spirit be poured on us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
ISA.32.PLAIN: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high. Then the desert will be an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.

ISA.32.BSB: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.
ISA.32.KJV: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.

ISA.32.BSB: The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.
ISA.32.KJV: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
ISA.32.PLAIN: The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.

ISA.32.BSB: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place, in safe and secure places of rest.
ISA.32.KJV: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
ISA.32.PLAIN: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place, in safe and secure places of rest.

ISA.32.BSB: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.
ISA.32.KJV: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
ISA.32.PLAIN: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.

ISA.32.BSB: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.
ISA.32.KJV: Blessed are you that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
ISA.32.PLAIN: Held in quiet grace are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.

ISA.33.BSB: Woe to you, O destroyer never destroyed, O traitor never betrayed! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed. When you have finished betraying, you will be betrayed.
ISA.33.KJV: Woe to you that spoil, and you were not spoiled; and deal treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with you! when you shall cease to spoil, you shall be spoiled; and when you shall make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with you.
ISA.33.PLAIN: Woe to you, O destroyer never destroyed, O traitor never betrayed! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed. When you have finished betraying, you will be betrayed.

ISA.33.BSB: O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.
ISA.33.KJV: O LORD, be gracious to us; we have waited for you: be you their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
ISA.33.PLAIN: O Lord, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.

ISA.33.BSB: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice; the nations scatter when You rise.
ISA.33.KJV: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of yourself the nations were scattered.
ISA.33.PLAIN: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice; the nations scatter when You rise.

ISA.33.BSB: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts; like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.
ISA.33.KJV: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpillar: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run on them.
ISA.33.PLAIN: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts; like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.

ISA.33.BSB: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
ISA.33.KJV: The LORD is exalted; for he dwells on high: he has filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
ISA.33.PLAIN: The Lord is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

ISA.33.BSB: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.
ISA.33.KJV: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of your times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
ISA.33.PLAIN: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the Lord is Zion’s treasure.

ISA.33.BSB: Behold, their valiant ones cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.
ISA.33.KJV: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
ISA.33.PLAIN: Look closely — their valiant ones cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.

ISA.33.BSB: The highways are deserted; travel has ceased. The treaty has been broken, the witnesses are despised, and human life is disregarded.
ISA.33.KJV: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceases: he has broken the covenant, he has despised the cities, he regards no man.
ISA.33.PLAIN: The highways are deserted; travel has ceased. The treaty has been broken, the witnesses are despised, and human life is disregarded.

ISA.33.BSB: The land mourns and languishes; Lebanon is ashamed and decayed. Sharon is like a desert; Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.
ISA.33.KJV: The earth mourns and languishes: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
ISA.33.PLAIN: The land mourns and languishes; Lebanon is ashamed and decayed. Sharon is like a desert; Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.

ISA.33.BSB: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.
ISA.33.KJV: Now will I rise, says the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
ISA.33.PLAIN: “Now I will arise,” says the Lord. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.

ISA.33.BSB: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
ISA.33.KJV: You shall conceive chaff, you shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
ISA.33.PLAIN: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.

ISA.33.BSB: The peoples will be burned to ashes, like thorns cut down and set ablaze.
ISA.33.KJV: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire. ¶
ISA.33.PLAIN: The peoples will be burned to ashes, like thorns cut down and set ablaze.

ISA.33.BSB: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.”
ISA.33.KJV: Hear, you that are far off, what I have done; and, you that are near, acknowledge my might.
ISA.33.PLAIN: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.”

ISA.33.BSB: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames?”
ISA.33.KJV: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness has surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
ISA.33.PLAIN: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames?”

ISA.33.BSB: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity, who refuses gain from extortion, whose hand never takes a bribe, who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil—
ISA.33.KJV: He that walks righteously, and speaks uprightly; he that despises the gain of oppressions, that shakes his hands from holding of bribes, that stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from seeing evil;
ISA.33.PLAIN: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity, who refuses gain from extortion, whose hand never takes a bribe, who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil—

ISA.33.BSB: he will dwell on the heights; the mountain fortress will be his refuge; his food will be provided and his water assured.
ISA.33.KJV: He shall dwell on high: his place of defense shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
ISA.33.PLAIN: he will dwell on the heights; the mountain fortress will be his refuge; his food will be provided and his water assured.

ISA.33.BSB: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty and behold a land that stretches afar.
ISA.33.KJV: Your eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
ISA.33.PLAIN: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty and behold a land that stretches afar.

ISA.33.BSB: Your mind will ponder the former terror: “Where is he who tallies? Where is he who weighs? Where is he who counts the towers?”
ISA.33.KJV: Your heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
ISA.33.PLAIN: Your mind will ponder the former terror: “Where is he who tallies? Where is he who weighs? Where is he who counts the towers?”

ISA.33.BSB: You will no longer see the insolent, a people whose speech is unintelligible, who stammer in a language you cannot understand.
ISA.33.KJV: You shall not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than you can perceive; of a stammering tongue, that you can not understand.
ISA.33.PLAIN: You will no longer see the insolent, a people whose speech is unintelligible, who stammer in a language you cannot understand.

ISA.33.BSB: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful pasture, a tent that does not wander; its tent pegs will not be pulled up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
ISA.33.KJV: Look on Zion, the city of our solemnities: your eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
ISA.33.PLAIN: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful pasture, a tent that does not wander; its tent pegs will not be pulled up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

ISA.33.BSB: But there the Majestic One, our LORD, will be for us a place of rivers and wide canals, where no galley with oars will row, and no majestic vessel will pass.
ISA.33.KJV: But there the glorious LORD will be to us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
ISA.33.PLAIN: But there the Majestic One, our Lord, will be for us a place of rivers and wide canals, where no galley with oars will row, and no majestic vessel will pass.

ISA.33.BSB: For the LORD is our Judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our King. It is He who will save us.
ISA.33.KJV: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
ISA.33.PLAIN: For the Lord is our Judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our King. It is He who will save us.

ISA.33.BSB: Your ropes are slack; they cannot secure the mast or spread the sail. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided, and even the lame will carry off plunder.
ISA.33.KJV: Your tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
ISA.33.PLAIN: Your ropes are slack; they cannot secure the mast or spread the sail. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided, and even the lame will carry off plunder.

ISA.33.BSB: And no resident of Zion will say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell there will be forgiven of iniquity.
ISA.33.KJV: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
ISA.33.PLAIN: And no resident of Zion will say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell there will be forgiven of brokenness.

ISA.34.BSB: Come near, O nations, to listen; pay attention, O peoples. Let the earth hear, and all that fills it, the world and all that springs from it.
ISA.34.KJV: Come near, you nations, to hear; and listen, you people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
ISA.34.PLAIN: Come near, O nations, to listen; pay attention, O peoples. Let the earth hear, and all that fills it, the world and all that springs from it.

ISA.34.BSB: The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.
ISA.34.KJV: For the indignation of the LORD is on all nations, and his fury on all their armies: he has utterly destroyed them, he has delivered them to the slaughter.
ISA.34.PLAIN: The Lord is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.

ISA.34.BSB: Their slain will be left unburied, and the stench of their corpses will rise; the mountains will flow with their blood.
ISA.34.KJV: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcasses, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
ISA.34.PLAIN: Their slain will be left unburied, and the stench of their corpses will rise; the mountains will flow with their blood.

ISA.34.BSB: All the stars of heaven will be dissolved. The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and all their stars will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like foliage from the fig tree.
ISA.34.KJV: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falls off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
ISA.34.PLAIN: All the stars of heaven will be dissolved. The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and all their stars will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like foliage from the fig tree.

ISA.34.BSB: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, then it will come down upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
ISA.34.KJV: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down on Idumea, and on the people of my curse, to judgment.
ISA.34.PLAIN: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, then it will come down upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.

ISA.34.BSB: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood. It drips with fat— with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
ISA.34.KJV: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
ISA.34.PLAIN: The sword of the Lord is bathed in blood. It drips with fat— with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the Lord has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

ISA.34.BSB: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the young bulls with the strong ones. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their soil will be soaked with fat.
ISA.34.KJV: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
ISA.34.PLAIN: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the young bulls with the strong ones. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their soil will be soaked with fat.

ISA.34.BSB: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
ISA.34.KJV: For it is the day of the LORD’s vengeance, and the year of recompenses for the controversy of Zion.
ISA.34.PLAIN: For the Lord has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

ISA.34.BSB: Edom’s streams will be turned to tar, and her soil to sulfur; her land will become a blazing pitch.
ISA.34.KJV: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
ISA.34.PLAIN: Edom’s streams will be turned to tar, and her soil to sulfur; her land will become a blazing pitch.

ISA.34.BSB: It will not be quenched—day or night. Its smoke will ascend forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever again pass through it.
ISA.34.KJV: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever. ¶
ISA.34.PLAIN: It will not be quenched—day or night. Its smoke will ascend forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever again pass through it.

ISA.34.BSB: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it. The LORD will stretch out over Edom a measuring line of chaos and a plumb line of destruction.
ISA.34.KJV: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out on it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
ISA.34.PLAIN: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it. The Lord will stretch out over Edom a measuring line of chaos and a plumb line of destruction.

ISA.34.BSB: No nobles will be left to proclaim a king, and all her princes will come to nothing.
ISA.34.KJV: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
ISA.34.PLAIN: No nobles will be left to proclaim a king, and all her princes will come to nothing.

ISA.34.BSB: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
ISA.34.KJV: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
ISA.34.PLAIN: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.

ISA.34.BSB: The desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to another. There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose.
ISA.34.KJV: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
ISA.34.PLAIN: The desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to another. There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose.

ISA.34.BSB: There the owl will make her nest; she will lay and hatch her eggs and gather her brood under her shadow. Even there the birds of prey will gather, each with its mate.
ISA.34.KJV: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate. ¶
ISA.34.PLAIN: There the owl will make her nest; she will lay and hatch her eggs and gather her brood under her shadow. Even there the birds of prey will gather, each with its mate.

ISA.34.BSB: Search and read the scroll of the LORD: Not one of these will go missing, not one will lack her mate, because He has ordered it by His mouth, and He will gather them by His Spirit.
ISA.34.KJV: Seek you out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it has commanded, and his spirit it has gathered them.
ISA.34.PLAIN: Search and read the scroll of the Lord: Not one of these will go missing, not one will lack her mate, because He has ordered it by His mouth, and He will gather them by His Spirit.

ISA.34.BSB: He has allotted their portion; His hand has distributed it by measure. They will possess it forever; they will dwell in it from generation to generation.
ISA.34.KJV: And he has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
ISA.34.PLAIN: He has allotted their portion; His hand has distributed it by measure. They will possess it forever; they will dwell in it from generation to generation.

ISA.35.BSB: The wilderness and the land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
ISA.35.KJV: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
ISA.35.PLAIN: The wilderness and the land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

ISA.35.BSB: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
ISA.35.KJV: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given to it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God. ¶
ISA.35.PLAIN: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the Lord, the splendor of our God.

ISA.35.BSB: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
ISA.35.KJV: Strengthen you the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
ISA.35.PLAIN: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!

ISA.35.BSB: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”
ISA.35.KJV: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompense; he will come and save you.
ISA.35.PLAIN: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Look closely — your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”

ISA.35.BSB: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
ISA.35.KJV: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
ISA.35.PLAIN: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.

ISA.35.BSB: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
ISA.35.KJV: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
ISA.35.PLAIN: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

ISA.35.BSB: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.
ISA.35.KJV: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
ISA.35.PLAIN: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.

ISA.35.BSB: And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way— and fools will not stray onto it.
ISA.35.KJV: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
ISA.35.PLAIN: And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it— only those who walk in the Way— and fools will not stray onto it.

ISA.35.BSB: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.
ISA.35.KJV: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
ISA.35.PLAIN: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.

ISA.35.BSB: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
ISA.35.KJV: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy on their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
ISA.35.PLAIN: So the redeemed of the Lord will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.

ISA.36.BSB: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah.
ISA.36.KJV: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defended cities of Judah, and took them.
ISA.36.PLAIN: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah.

ISA.36.BSB: And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh, with a great army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. And he stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.
ISA.36.KJV: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
ISA.36.PLAIN: And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh, with a great army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. And he stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.

ISA.36.BSB: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, went out to him.
ISA.36.KJV: Then came forth to him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder. ¶
ISA.36.PLAIN: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, went out to him.

ISA.36.BSB: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
ISA.36.KJV: And Rabshakeh said to them, Say you now to Hezekiah, Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein you trust?
ISA.36.PLAIN: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?

ISA.36.BSB: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
ISA.36.KJV: I say, say you, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom do you trust, that you rebel against me?
ISA.36.PLAIN: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?

ISA.36.BSB: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
ISA.36.KJV: See, you trust in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; where on if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
ISA.36.PLAIN: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

ISA.36.BSB: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before this altar’?
ISA.36.KJV: But if you say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar?
ISA.36.PLAIN: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the Lord our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before this altar’?

ISA.36.BSB: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
ISA.36.KJV: Now therefore give pledges, I pray you, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you be able on your part to set riders on them.
ISA.36.PLAIN: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!

ISA.36.BSB: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
ISA.36.KJV: How then will you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
ISA.36.PLAIN: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

ISA.36.BSB: So now, was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The LORD Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’”
ISA.36.KJV: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it. ¶
ISA.36.PLAIN: So now, was it apart from the Lord that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The Lord Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’”

ISA.36.BSB: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”
ISA.36.KJV: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah to Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray you, to your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall. ¶
ISA.36.PLAIN: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”

ISA.36.BSB: But the Rabshakeh replied, “Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?”
ISA.36.KJV: But Rabshakeh said, Has my master sent me to your master and to you to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men that sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own urine with you?
ISA.36.PLAIN: But the Rabshakeh replied, “Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?”

ISA.36.BSB: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly in Hebrew: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
ISA.36.KJV: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear you the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
ISA.36.PLAIN: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly in Hebrew: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

ISA.36.BSB: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.
ISA.36.KJV: Thus says the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
ISA.36.PLAIN: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.

ISA.36.BSB: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
ISA.36.KJV: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
ISA.36.PLAIN: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the Lord when he says, ‘The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’

ISA.36.BSB: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree, and drink water from his own cistern,
ISA.36.KJV: Listen not to Hezekiah: for thus says the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat you every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink you every one the waters of his own cistern;
ISA.36.PLAIN: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree, and drink water from his own cistern,

ISA.36.BSB: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
ISA.36.KJV: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
ISA.36.PLAIN: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

ISA.36.BSB: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’ Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
ISA.36.KJV: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, the LORD will deliver us. Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
ISA.36.PLAIN: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The Lord will deliver us.’ Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

ISA.36.BSB: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
ISA.36.KJV: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
ISA.36.PLAIN: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

ISA.36.BSB: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
ISA.36.KJV: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
ISA.36.PLAIN: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the Lord deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”

ISA.36.BSB: But the people remained silent and did not answer a word, for Hezekiah had commanded, “Do not answer him.”
ISA.36.KJV: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not. ¶
ISA.36.PLAIN: But the people remained silent and did not answer a word, for Hezekiah had commanded, “Do not answer him.”

ISA.36.BSB: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh.
ISA.36.KJV: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
ISA.36.PLAIN: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh.

ISA.37.BSB: On hearing this report, King Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and entered the house of the LORD.
ISA.37.KJV: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
ISA.37.PLAIN: On hearing this report, King Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and entered the house of the Lord.

ISA.37.BSB: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz
ISA.37.KJV: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
ISA.37.PLAIN: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz

ISA.37.BSB: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
ISA.37.KJV: And they said to him, Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
ISA.37.PLAIN: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.

ISA.37.KJV: It may be the LORD your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD your God has heard: why lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.
ISA.37.PLAIN: Perhaps the Lord your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God, and He will rebuke him for the words that the Lord your God has heard. Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives.”

ISA.37.BSB: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah,
ISA.37.KJV: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah. ¶
ISA.37.PLAIN: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah,

ISA.37.BSB: who replied, “Tell your master that this is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.
ISA.37.KJV: And Isaiah said to them, Thus shall you say to your master, Thus says the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
ISA.37.PLAIN: who replied, “Tell your master that this is what the Lord says: ‘Do not be afraid of the words you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.

ISA.37.BSB: Behold, I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’”
ISA.37.KJV: Behold, I will send a blast on him, and he shall hear a rumor, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land. ¶
ISA.37.PLAIN: Look closely — I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land, where I will cause him to fall by the sword.’”

ISA.37.BSB: When the Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.
ISA.37.KJV: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
ISA.37.PLAIN: When the Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

ISA.37.KJV: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with you. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
ISA.37.PLAIN: Now Sennacherib had been warned about Tirhakah king of Cush: “He has set out to fight against you.” On hearing this, Sennacherib sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

ISA.37.BSB: “Give this message to Hezekiah king of Judah: ‘Do not let your God, in whom you trust, deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

ISA.37.KJV: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shall you be delivered?
ISA.37.PLAIN: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries, devoting them to destruction. Will you then be spared?

ISA.37.BSB: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?
ISA.37.KJV: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
ISA.37.PLAIN: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations—the gods of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and of the people of Eden in Telassar?

ISA.37.BSB: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?’”
ISA.37.KJV: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? ¶
ISA.37.PLAIN: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah?’”

ISA.37.BSB: So Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers, read it, and went up to the house of the LORD and spread it out before the LORD.
ISA.37.KJV: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up to the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
ISA.37.PLAIN: So Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers, read it, and went up to the house of the Lord and spread it out before the Lord.

ISA.37.BSB: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD:
ISA.37.KJV: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,
ISA.37.PLAIN: And Hezekiah prayed to the Lord:

ISA.37.BSB: “O LORD of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.
ISA.37.KJV: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwell between the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: you have made heaven and earth.
ISA.37.PLAIN: “O Lord of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You made the heavens and the earth.

ISA.37.BSB: Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see. Listen to all the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.
ISA.37.KJV: Incline your ear, O LORD, and hear; open your eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which has sent to reproach the living God.
ISA.37.PLAIN: Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear; open Your eyes, O Lord, and see. Listen to all the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God.

ISA.37.BSB: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all these countries and their lands.
ISA.37.KJV: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
