ISA.51.BSB: For the LORD will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.
ISA.51.KJV: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody. ¶
ISA.51.PLAIN: For the Lord will comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; He will make her wilderness like Eden and her desert like the garden of the Lord. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and melodious song.

ISA.51.BSB: Pay attention to Me, My people, and listen to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and My justice will become a light to the nations; I will bring it about quickly.
ISA.51.KJV: Listen to me, my people; and give ear to me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
ISA.51.PLAIN: Pay attention to Me, My people, and listen to Me, My nation; for a law will go out from Me, and My justice will become a light to the nations; I will bring it about quickly.

ISA.51.BSB: My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way, and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.
ISA.51.KJV: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and my arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait on me, and on my arm shall they trust.
ISA.51.PLAIN: My righteousness draws near, My salvation is on the way, and My arms will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look for Me and wait in hope for My arm.

ISA.51.BSB: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment, and its people will die like gnats. But My salvation will last forever, and My righteousness will never fail.
ISA.51.KJV: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look on the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished. ¶
ISA.51.PLAIN: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look at the earth below; for the heavens will vanish like smoke, the earth will wear out like a garment, and its people will die like gnats. But My salvation will last forever, and My righteousness will never fail.

ISA.51.BSB: Listen to Me, you who know what is right, you people with My law in your hearts: Do not fear the scorn of men; do not be broken by their insults.
ISA.51.KJV: Listen to me, you that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear you not the reproach of men, neither be you afraid of their revilings.
ISA.51.PLAIN: Listen to Me, you who know what is right, you people with My law in your hearts: Do not fear the scorn of men; do not be broken by their insults.

ISA.51.BSB: For the moth will devour them like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will last forever, My salvation through all generations.”
ISA.51.KJV: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation. ¶
ISA.51.PLAIN: For the moth will devour them like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool. But My righteousness will last forever, My salvation through all generations.”

ISA.51.BSB: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?
ISA.51.KJV: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Are you not it that has cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
ISA.51.PLAIN: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?

ISA.51.BSB: Was it not You who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over?
ISA.51.KJV: Are you not it which has dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that has made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
ISA.51.PLAIN: Was it not You who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea for the redeemed to cross over?

ISA.51.BSB: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
ISA.51.KJV: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy shall be on their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
ISA.51.PLAIN: So the redeemed of the Lord will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.

ISA.51.BSB: “I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man, of a son of man who withers like grass?
ISA.51.KJV: I, even I, am he that comforts you: who are you, that you should be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
ISA.51.PLAIN: “I, even I, am He who comforts you. Why should you be afraid of mortal man, of a son of man who withers like grass?

ISA.51.BSB: But you have forgotten the LORD, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?
ISA.51.KJV: And forget the LORD your maker, that has stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and have feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
ISA.51.PLAIN: But you have forgotten the Lord, your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction. But where is the fury of the oppressor?

ISA.51.BSB: The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon, and his bread will not be lacking.
ISA.51.KJV: The captive exile hastens that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
ISA.51.PLAIN: The captive will soon be freed; he will not die in the dungeon, and his bread will not be lacking.

ISA.51.BSB: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
ISA.51.KJV: But I am the LORD your God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.
ISA.51.PLAIN: For I am the Lord your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the Lord of Hosts is His name.

ISA.51.BSB: I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’”
ISA.51.KJV: And I have put my words in your mouth, and I have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say to Zion, You are my people. ¶
ISA.51.PLAIN: I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’”

ISA.51.BSB: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of His fury; you who have drained the goblet to the dregs— the cup that makes men stagger.
ISA.51.KJV: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which have drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; you have drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
ISA.51.PLAIN: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the Lord the cup of His fury; you who have drained the goblet to the dregs— the cup that makes men stagger.

ISA.51.BSB: Among all the sons she bore, there is no one to guide her; among all the sons she brought up, there is no one to take her hand.
ISA.51.KJV: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she has brought forth; neither is there any that takes her by the hand of all the sons that she has brought up.
ISA.51.PLAIN: Among all the sons she bore, there is no one to guide her; among all the sons she brought up, there is no one to take her hand.

ISA.51.BSB: These pairs have befallen you: devastation and destruction, famine and sword. Who will grieve for you? Who can comfort you?
ISA.51.KJV: These two things are come to you; who shall be sorry for you? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort you?
ISA.51.PLAIN: These pairs have befallen you: devastation and destruction, famine and sword. Who will grieve for you? Who can comfort you?

ISA.51.BSB: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the wrath of the LORD, the rebuke of your God.
ISA.51.KJV: Your sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of your God. ¶
ISA.51.PLAIN: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like an antelope in a net. They are full of the wrath of the Lord, the rebuke of your God.

ISA.51.BSB: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.
ISA.51.KJV: Therefore hear now this, you afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
ISA.51.PLAIN: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted one, drunken, but not with wine.

ISA.51.BSB: Thus says your Lord, the LORD, even your God, who defends His people: “See, I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering. From that goblet, the cup of My fury, you will never drink again.
ISA.51.KJV: Thus says your Lord the LORD, and your God that pleads the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; you shall no more drink it again:
ISA.51.PLAIN: Thus says your Lord, the Lord, even your God, who defends His people: “See, I have removed from your hand the cup of staggering. From that goblet, the cup of My fury, you will never drink again.

ISA.51.BSB: I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”
ISA.51.KJV: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict you; which have said to your soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and you have laid your body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
ISA.51.PLAIN: I will place it in the hands of your tormentors, who told you: ‘Lie down, so we can walk over you,’ so that you made your back like the ground, like a street to be traversed.”

ISA.52.BSB: Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, holy city! For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.
ISA.52.KJV: Awake, awake; put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for from now on there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean.
ISA.52.PLAIN: Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, holy city! For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.

ISA.52.BSB: Shake off your dust! Rise up and sit on your throne, O Jerusalem. Remove the chains from your neck, O captive Daughter of Zion.
ISA.52.KJV: Shake yourself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose yourself from the bands of your neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
ISA.52.PLAIN: Shake off your dust! Rise up and sit on your throne, O Jerusalem. Remove the chains from your neck, O captive Daughter of Zion.

ISA.52.BSB: For this is what the LORD says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”
ISA.52.KJV: For thus says the LORD, You have sold yourselves for nothing; and you shall be redeemed without money.
ISA.52.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord says: “You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed.”

ISA.52.BSB: For this is what the Lord GOD says: “At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.
ISA.52.KJV: For thus says the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
ISA.52.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord GOD says: “At first My people went down to Egypt to live, then Assyria oppressed them without cause.

ISA.52.BSB: And now what have I here? declares the LORD. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the LORD, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.
ISA.52.KJV: Now therefore, what have I here, says the LORD, that my people is taken away for nothing? they that rule over them make them to howl, said the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
ISA.52.PLAIN: And now what have I here? declares the Lord. For My people have been taken without cause; those who rule them taunt, declares the Lord, and My name is blasphemed continually all day long.

ISA.52.BSB: Therefore My people will know My name; therefore they will know on that day that I am He who speaks. Here I am!”
ISA.52.KJV: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that does speak: behold, it is I. ¶
ISA.52.PLAIN: Therefore My people will know My name; therefore they will know on that day that I am He who speaks. Here I am!”

ISA.52.BSB: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
ISA.52.KJV: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publishes peace; that brings good tidings of good, that publishes salvation; that said to Zion, Your God reigns!
ISA.52.PLAIN: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, “Your God reigns!”

ISA.52.BSB: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when the LORD returns to Zion.
ISA.52.KJV: Your watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion. ¶
ISA.52.PLAIN: Listen! Your watchmen lift up their voices, together they shout for joy. For every eye will see when the Lord returns to Zion.

ISA.52.BSB: Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.
ISA.52.KJV: Break forth into joy, sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.
ISA.52.PLAIN: Break forth in joy, sing together, O ruins of Jerusalem, for the Lord has comforted His people; He has redeemed Jerusalem.

ISA.52.BSB: The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
ISA.52.KJV: The LORD has made bore his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God. ¶
ISA.52.PLAIN: The Lord has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

ISA.52.BSB: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; come out from it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.
ISA.52.KJV: Depart you, depart you, go you out from there, touch no unclean thing; go you out of the middle of her; be you clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
ISA.52.PLAIN: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing; come out from it, purify yourselves, you who carry the vessels of the Lord.

ISA.52.BSB: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.
ISA.52.KJV: For you shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rear guard. ¶
ISA.52.PLAIN: For you will not leave in a hurry nor flee in haste, for the Lord goes before you, and the God of Israel is your rear guard.

ISA.52.BSB: Behold, My Servant will prosper; He will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.
ISA.52.KJV: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
ISA.52.PLAIN: Look closely — My Servant will prosper; He will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.

ISA.52.BSB: Just as many were appalled at Him— His appearance was disfigured beyond that of any man, and His form was marred beyond human likeness—
ISA.52.KJV: As many were astonished at you; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
ISA.52.PLAIN: Just as many were appalled at Him— His appearance was disfigured beyond that of any man, and His form was marred beyond human likeness—

ISA.52.BSB: so He will sprinkle many nations. Kings will shut their mouths because of Him. For they will see what they have not been told, and they will understand what they have not heard.
ISA.52.KJV: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
ISA.52.PLAIN: so He will sprinkle many nations. Kings will shut their mouths because of Him. For they will see what they have not been told, and they will understand what they have not heard.

ISA.53.BSB: Who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?
ISA.53.KJV: Who has believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
ISA.53.PLAIN: Who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

ISA.53.BSB: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no stately form or majesty to attract us, no beauty that we should desire Him.
ISA.53.KJV: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he has no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
ISA.53.PLAIN: He grew up before Him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no stately form or majesty to attract us, no beauty that we should desire Him.

ISA.53.BSB: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.
ISA.53.KJV: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not. ¶
ISA.53.PLAIN: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.

ISA.53.BSB: Surely He took on our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken by God, struck down and afflicted.
ISA.53.KJV: Surely he has borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
ISA.53.PLAIN: Surely He took on our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken by God, struck down and afflicted.

ISA.53.BSB: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.
ISA.53.KJV: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was on him; and with his stripes we are healed.
ISA.53.PLAIN: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was on him, and by his wounds we are healed.

ISA.53.BSB: We all like sheep have gone astray, each one has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid upon Him the iniquity of us all.
ISA.53.KJV: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
ISA.53.PLAIN: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to our own way; and the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

ISA.53.BSB: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
ISA.53.KJV: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.
ISA.53.PLAIN: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.

ISA.53.BSB: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants? For He was cut off from the land of the living; He was stricken for the transgression of My people.
ISA.53.KJV: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
ISA.53.PLAIN: By oppression and judgment He was taken away, and who can recount His descendants? For He was cut off from the land of the living; He was stricken for the transgression of My people.

ISA.53.BSB: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in His death, although He had done no violence, nor was any deceit in His mouth.
ISA.53.KJV: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth. ¶
ISA.53.PLAIN: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in His death, although He had done no violence, nor was any deceit in His mouth.

ISA.53.BSB: Yet it was the LORD’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of the LORD will prosper in His hand.
ISA.53.KJV: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he has put him to grief: when you shall make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
ISA.53.PLAIN: Yet it was the Lord’s will to crush Him and to cause Him to suffer; and when His soul is made a guilt offering, He will see His offspring, He will prolong His days, and the good pleasure of the Lord will prosper in His hand.

ISA.53.BSB: After the anguish of His soul, He will see the light of life and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many, and He will bear their iniquities.
ISA.53.KJV: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
ISA.53.PLAIN: After the anguish of His soul, He will see the light of life and be satisfied. By His knowledge My righteous Servant will justify many, and He will bear their iniquities.

ISA.53.BSB: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
ISA.53.KJV: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he has poured out his soul to death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
ISA.53.PLAIN: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

ISA.54.BSB: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the LORD.
ISA.54.KJV: Sing, O barren, you that did not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, you that did not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, says the LORD.
ISA.54.PLAIN: “Shout for joy, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth in song and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband,” says the Lord.

ISA.54.BSB: “Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.
ISA.54.KJV: Enlarge the place of your tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of your habitations: spare not, lengthen your cords, and strengthen your stakes;
ISA.54.PLAIN: “Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.

ISA.54.BSB: For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.
ISA.54.KJV: For you shall break forth on the right hand and on the left; and your seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
ISA.54.PLAIN: For you will spread out to the right and left; your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities.

ISA.54.BSB: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
ISA.54.KJV: Fear not; for you shall not be ashamed: neither be you confounded; for you shall not be put to shame: for you shall forget the shame of your youth, and shall not remember the reproach of your widowhood any more.
ISA.54.PLAIN: Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

ISA.54.BSB: For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
ISA.54.KJV: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and your Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
ISA.54.PLAIN: For your husband is your Maker— the Lord of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.

ISA.54.BSB: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
ISA.54.KJV: For the LORD has called you as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when you were refused, says your God.
ISA.54.PLAIN: For the Lord has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.

ISA.54.BSB: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
ISA.54.KJV: For a small moment have I forsaken you; but with great mercies will I gather you.
ISA.54.PLAIN: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.

ISA.54.BSB: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
ISA.54.KJV: In a little wrath I hid my face from you for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on you, says the LORD your Redeemer.
ISA.54.PLAIN: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the Lord your Redeemer.

ISA.54.BSB: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
ISA.54.KJV: For this is as the waters of Noah to me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with you, nor rebuke you.
ISA.54.PLAIN: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.

ISA.54.BSB: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
ISA.54.KJV: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from you, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, says the LORD that has mercy on you. ¶

JER.6.KJV: The shepherds with their flocks shall come to her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
JER.6.PLAIN: Shepherds and their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents all around her, each tending his own portion:

JER.6.BSB: ‘Prepare for battle against her; rise up, let us attack at noon. Woe to us, for the daylight is fading; the evening shadows grow long.
JER.6.KJV: Prepare you war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe to us! for the day goes away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
JER.6.PLAIN: ‘Prepare for battle against her; rise up, let us attack at noon. Woe to us, for the daylight is fading; the evening shadows grow long.

JER.6.BSB: Rise up, let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses!’”
JER.6.KJV: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces. ¶
JER.6.PLAIN: Rise up, let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses!’”

JER.6.BSB: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.
JER.6.KJV: For thus has the LORD of hosts said, Hew you down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the middle of her.
JER.6.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord of Hosts says: “Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.

JER.6.BSB: As a well gushes its water, so she pours out her evil. Violence and destruction resound in her; sickness and wounds are ever before Me.
JER.6.KJV: As a fountain casts out her waters, so she casts out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
JER.6.PLAIN: As a well gushes its water, so she pours out her evil. Violence and destruction resound in her; sickness and wounds are ever before Me.

JER.6.BSB: Be forewarned, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you; I will make you a desolation, a land without inhabitant.”
JER.6.KJV: Be you instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you; lest I make you desolate, a land not inhabited. ¶
JER.6.PLAIN: Be forewarned, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you; I will make you a desolation, a land without inhabitant.”

JER.6.BSB: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine. Pass your hand once more like a grape gatherer over the branches.”
JER.6.KJV: Thus says the LORD of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.
JER.6.PLAIN: This is what the Lord of Hosts says: “Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine. Pass your hand once more like a grape gatherer over the branches.”

JER.6.BSB: To whom can I give this warning? Who will listen to me? Look, their ears are closed, so they cannot hear. See, the word of the LORD has become offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.
JER.6.KJV: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot listen: behold, the word of the LORD is to them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
JER.6.PLAIN: To whom can I give this warning? Who will listen to me? Look, their ears are closed, so they cannot hear. See, the word of the Lord has become offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.

JER.6.BSB: But I am full of the LORD’s wrath; I am tired of holding it back. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the young men gathered together. For both husband and wife will be captured, the old and the very old alike.
JER.6.KJV: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out on the children abroad, and on the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
JER.6.PLAIN: But I am full of the Lord’s wrath; I am tired of holding it back. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the young men gathered together. For both husband and wife will be captured, the old and the very old alike.

JER.6.BSB: Their houses will be turned over to others, their fields and wives as well, for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land,” declares the LORD.
JER.6.KJV: And their houses shall be turned to others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says the LORD.
JER.6.PLAIN: Their houses will be turned over to others, their fields and wives as well, for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land,” declares the Lord.

JER.6.BSB: “For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
JER.6.KJV: For from the least of them even to the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even to the priest every one deals falsely.
JER.6.PLAIN: “For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.

JER.6.BSB: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
JER.6.KJV: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
JER.6.PLAIN: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.

JER.6.BSB: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse,” says the LORD.
JER.6.KJV: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? no, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, says the LORD.
JER.6.PLAIN: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse,” says the Lord.

JER.6.BSB: This is what the LORD says: “Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’
JER.6.KJV: Thus says the LORD, Stand you in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
JER.6.PLAIN: This is what the Lord says: “Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’

JER.6.BSB: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn.’ But they answered, ‘We will not listen!’
JER.6.KJV: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Listen to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not listen. ¶
JER.6.PLAIN: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn.’ But they answered, ‘We will not listen!’

JER.6.BSB: Therefore hear, O nations, and learn, O congregations, what will happen to them.
JER.6.KJV: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
JER.6.PLAIN: Therefore hear, O nations, and learn, O congregations, what will happen to them.

JER.6.BSB: Hear, O earth! I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes, because they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction.
JER.6.KJV: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
JER.6.PLAIN: Hear, O earth! I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes, because they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction.

JER.6.BSB: What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please Me.”
JER.6.KJV: To what purpose comes there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet to me.
JER.6.PLAIN: What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please Me.”

JER.6.BSB: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “I will lay stumbling blocks before this people; fathers and sons alike will be staggered; friends and neighbors will perish.”
JER.6.KJV: Therefore thus says the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall on them; the neighbor and his friend shall perish.
JER.6.PLAIN: Therefore this is what the Lord says: “I will lay stumbling blocks before this people; fathers and sons alike will be staggered; friends and neighbors will perish.”

JER.6.BSB: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth.
JER.6.KJV: Thus says the LORD, Behold, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
JER.6.PLAIN: This is what the Lord says: “Look closely — an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth.

JER.6.BSB: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Zion.”
JER.6.KJV: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roars like the sea; and they ride on horses, set in array as men for war against you, O daughter of Zion.
JER.6.PLAIN: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Zion.”

JER.6.BSB: We have heard the report; our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
JER.6.KJV: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
JER.6.PLAIN: We have heard the report; our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.

JER.6.BSB: Do not go out to the fields; do not walk the road. For the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.
JER.6.KJV: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side. ¶
JER.6.PLAIN: Do not go out to the fields; do not walk the road. For the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.

JER.6.BSB: O daughter of my people, dress yourselves in sackcloth and roll in ashes. Mourn with bitter wailing, as you would for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
JER.6.KJV: O daughter of my people, gird you with sackcloth, and wallow yourself in ashes: make you mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come on us.
JER.6.PLAIN: O daughter of my people, dress yourselves in sackcloth and roll in ashes. Mourn with bitter wailing, as you would for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

JER.6.BSB: “I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.
JER.6.KJV: I have set you for a tower and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
JER.6.PLAIN: “I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.

JER.6.BSB: All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
JER.6.KJV: They are all grievous rebels, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
JER.6.PLAIN: All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.

JER.6.BSB: The bellows blow fiercely, blasting away the lead with fire. The refining proceeds in vain, for the wicked are not purged.
JER.6.KJV: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melts in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
JER.6.PLAIN: The bellows blow fiercely, blasting away the lead with fire. The refining proceeds in vain, for the wicked are not purged.

JER.6.BSB: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
JER.6.KJV: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD has rejected them.
JER.6.PLAIN: They are called rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them.”

JER.7.BSB: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
JER.7.KJV: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
JER.7.PLAIN: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

JER.7.BSB: “Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this message: Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD.
JER.7.KJV: Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all you of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
JER.7.PLAIN: “Stand in the gate of the house of the Lord and proclaim this message: Hear the word of the Lord, all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the Lord.

JER.7.BSB: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: Correct your ways and deeds, and I will let you live in this place.
JER.7.KJV: Thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
JER.7.PLAIN: Thus says the Lord of Hosts, the God of Israel: Correct your ways and deeds, and I will let you live in this place.

JER.7.BSB: Do not trust in deceptive words, chanting: ‘This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.’
JER.7.KJV: Trust you not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
JER.7.PLAIN: Do not trust in deceptive words, chanting: ‘This is the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord.’

JER.7.BSB: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another,
JER.7.KJV: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if you thoroughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbor;
JER.7.PLAIN: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another,

JER.7.BSB: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm,
JER.7.KJV: If you oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
JER.7.PLAIN: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm,

JER.7.BSB: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
JER.7.KJV: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever. ¶
JER.7.PLAIN: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.

JER.7.BSB: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
JER.7.KJV: Behold, you trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
JER.7.PLAIN: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.

JER.7.BSB: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,
JER.7.KJV: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods whom you know not;
JER.7.PLAIN: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,

JER.7.BSB: and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My Name, and say, ‘We are delivered, so we can continue with all these abominations’?
JER.7.KJV: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
JER.7.PLAIN: and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My Name, and say, ‘We are delivered, so we can continue with all these abominations’?

JER.7.BSB: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
JER.7.KJV: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, says the LORD.
JER.7.PLAIN: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the Lord.

JER.7.BSB: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
JER.7.KJV: But go you now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
JER.7.PLAIN: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.

JER.7.BSB: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the LORD, and because I have spoken to you again and again but you would not listen, and I have called to you but you would not answer,
JER.7.KJV: And now, because you have done all these works, says the LORD, and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you heard not; and I called you, but you answered not;
JER.7.PLAIN: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the Lord, and because I have spoken to you again and again but you would not listen, and I have called to you but you would not answer,

JER.7.BSB: therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name, the house in which you trust, the place that I gave to you and your fathers.
JER.7.KJV: Therefore will I do to this house, which is called by my name, wherein you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
JER.7.PLAIN: therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name, the house in which you trust, the place that I gave to you and your fathers.

JER.7.BSB: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
JER.7.KJV: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
JER.7.PLAIN: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.

JER.7.BSB: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.
JER.7.KJV: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear you. ¶
JER.7.PLAIN: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.

JER.7.BSB: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
JER.7.KJV: See you not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
JER.7.PLAIN: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

JER.7.BSB: The sons gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven; they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.
JER.7.KJV: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
JER.7.PLAIN: The sons gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven; they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.

JER.7.BSB: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?
JER.7.KJV: Do they provoke me to anger? says the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
JER.7.PLAIN: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the Lord. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?

JER.7.BSB: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.
JER.7.KJV: Therefore thus says the Lord GOD; Behold, my anger and my fury shall be poured out on this place, on man, and on beast, and on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched. ¶
JER.7.PLAIN: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Look closely — My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.

JER.7.BSB: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
JER.7.KJV: Thus says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
JER.7.PLAIN: This is what the Lord of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

JER.7.BSB: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
JER.7.KJV: For I spoke not to your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
JER.7.PLAIN: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

JER.7.BSB: but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
JER.7.KJV: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people: and walk you in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well to you.
JER.7.PLAIN: but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.

JER.7.BSB: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
JER.7.KJV: But they listened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
JER.7.PLAIN: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

JER.7.BSB: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets again and again.
JER.7.KJV: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt to this day I have even sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
JER.7.PLAIN: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets again and again.

JER.7.BSB: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
JER.7.KJV: Yet they listened not to me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
JER.7.PLAIN: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.

JER.7.BSB: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
JER.7.KJV: Therefore you shall speak all these words to them; but they will not listen to you: you shall also call to them; but they will not answer you.
JER.7.PLAIN: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.

JER.7.BSB: Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.
JER.7.KJV: But you shall say to them, This is a nation that obeys not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receives correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth. ¶
JER.7.PLAIN: Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the Lord their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.

JER.7.BSB: Cut off your hair and throw it away. Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’
JER.7.KJV: Cut off your hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
JER.7.PLAIN: Cut off your hair and throw it away. Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights, for the Lord has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’

JER.7.BSB: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the LORD. They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
JER.7.KJV: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, says the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
JER.7.PLAIN: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the Lord. They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.

JER.7.BSB: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Hinnom so they could burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I never commanded, nor did it even enter My mind.
JER.7.KJV: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart. ¶
JER.7.PLAIN: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Hinnom so they could burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I never commanded, nor did it even enter My mind.

JER.7.BSB: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
JER.7.KJV: Therefore, behold, the days come, says the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
JER.7.PLAIN: So look closely — the days are coming, declares the Lord, when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

JER.7.BSB: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
JER.7.KJV: And the carcasses of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
JER.7.PLAIN: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.

JER.10.BSB: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
JER.10.KJV: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
JER.10.PLAIN: But the Lord is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.

JER.10.BSB: Thus you are to tell them: “These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.”
JER.10.KJV: Thus shall you say to them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
JER.10.PLAIN: Thus you are to tell them: “These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.”

JER.10.BSB: The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.
JER.10.KJV: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
JER.10.PLAIN: The Lord made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

JER.10.BSB: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
JER.10.KJV: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightning with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.
JER.10.PLAIN: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

JER.10.BSB: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
JER.10.KJV: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
JER.10.PLAIN: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.

JER.10.BSB: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
JER.10.KJV: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
JER.10.PLAIN: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.

JER.10.BSB: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
JER.10.KJV: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name. ¶
JER.10.PLAIN: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the Lord of Hosts is His name.

JER.10.BSB: Gather up your belongings from this land, you who live under siege.
JER.10.KJV: Gather up your wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
JER.10.PLAIN: Gather up your belongings from this land, you who live under siege.

JER.10.BSB: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
JER.10.KJV: For thus says the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so. ¶
JER.10.PLAIN: For this is what the Lord says: “Look closely — at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”

JER.10.BSB: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”
JER.10.KJV: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous; but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
JER.10.PLAIN: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”

JER.10.BSB: My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are snapped. My sons have departed from me and are no more. I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains.
JER.10.KJV: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
JER.10.PLAIN: My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are snapped. My sons have departed from me and are no more. I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains.

JER.10.BSB: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
JER.10.KJV: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
JER.10.PLAIN: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the Lord. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.

JER.10.BSB: Listen! The sound of a report is coming— a great commotion from the land to the north. The cities of Judah will be made a desolation, a haunt for jackals.
JER.10.KJV: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons. ¶
JER.10.PLAIN: Listen! The sound of a report is coming— a great commotion from the land to the north. The cities of Judah will be made a desolation, a haunt for jackals.

JER.10.BSB: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.
JER.10.KJV: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walks to direct his steps.
JER.10.PLAIN: I know, O Lord, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.

JER.10.BSB: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice— not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
JER.10.KJV: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.
JER.10.PLAIN: Correct me, O Lord, but only with justice— not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.

JER.10.BSB: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.
JER.10.KJV: Pour out your fury on the heathen that know you not, and on the families that call not on your name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
JER.10.PLAIN: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.

JER.11.BSB: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:
JER.11.KJV: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD saying,
JER.11.PLAIN: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord:

JER.11.BSB: “Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
JER.11.KJV: Hear you the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
JER.11.PLAIN: “Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.

JER.11.BSB: You must tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,
JER.11.KJV: And say you to them, Thus says the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeys not the words of this covenant,
JER.11.PLAIN: You must tell them that this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,

JER.11.BSB: which I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, ‘Obey Me, and do everything I command you, and you will be My people, and I will be your God.’
JER.11.KJV: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall you be my people, and I will be your God:
JER.11.PLAIN: which I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, ‘Obey Me, and do everything I command you, and you will be My people, and I will be your God.’

JER.11.BSB: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.” “Amen, LORD,” I answered.
JER.11.KJV: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
JER.11.PLAIN: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.” “Amen, Lord,” I answered.

JER.11.BSB: Then the LORD said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.
JER.11.KJV: Then the LORD said to me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear you the words of this covenant, and do them.
JER.11.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to me, “Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.

JER.11.BSB: For from the time I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt until today, I strongly warned them again and again, saying, ‘Obey My voice.’
JER.11.KJV: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
JER.11.PLAIN: For from the time I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt until today, I strongly warned them again and again, saying, ‘Obey My voice.’

JER.11.BSB: Yet they would not obey or incline their ears, but each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant I had commanded them to follow but they did not keep.”
JER.11.KJV: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do: but they did them not.
JER.11.PLAIN: Yet they would not obey or incline their ears, but each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant I had commanded them to follow but they did not keep.”

JER.11.BSB: And the LORD told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
JER.11.KJV: And the LORD said to me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
JER.11.PLAIN: And the Lord told me, “There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.

JER.11.BSB: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers who refused to obey My words. They have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers.
JER.11.KJV: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers. ¶
JER.11.PLAIN: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers who refused to obey My words. They have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers.

JER.11.BSB: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.
JER.11.KJV: Therefore thus says the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil on them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry to me, I will not listen to them.
JER.11.PLAIN: Therefore this is what the Lord says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.

JER.11.BSB: Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to which they have been burning incense, but these gods certainly will not save them in their time of disaster.
JER.11.KJV: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry to the gods to whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
JER.11.PLAIN: Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to which they have been burning incense, but these gods certainly will not save them in their time of disaster.

JER.11.BSB: Your gods are indeed as numerous as your cities, O Judah; the altars of shame you have set up—the altars to burn incense to Baal—are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’
JER.11.KJV: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.
JER.11.PLAIN: Your gods are indeed as numerous as your cities, O Judah; the altars of shame you have set up—the altars to burn incense to Baal—are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’

JER.11.BSB: As for you, do not pray for these people. Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, for I will not be listening when they call out to Me in their time of disaster.
JER.11.KJV: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me for their trouble.
JER.11.PLAIN: As for you, do not pray for these people. Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, for I will not be listening when they call out to Me in their time of disaster.

JER.11.BSB: What right has My beloved in My house, having carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom, so that you can rejoice?
JER.11.KJV: What has my beloved to do in my house, seeing she has worked lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do evil, then you rejoice.
JER.11.PLAIN: What right has My beloved in My house, having carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom, so that you can rejoice?

JER.11.BSB: The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.
JER.11.KJV: The LORD called your name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire on it, and the branches of it are broken.
JER.11.PLAIN: The Lord once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.

JER.11.BSB: The LORD of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.”
JER.11.KJV: For the LORD of hosts, that planted you, has pronounced evil against you, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense to Baal. ¶
JER.11.PLAIN: The Lord of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.”

JER.11.BSB: And the LORD informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.
JER.11.KJV: And the LORD has given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then you showed me their doings.
JER.11.PLAIN: And the Lord informed me, so I knew. Then You showed me their deeds.

JER.11.BSB: For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”
JER.11.KJV: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
JER.11.PLAIN: For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”

JER.11.BSB: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
JER.11.KJV: But, O LORD of hosts, that judge righteously, that try the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for to you have I revealed my cause.
JER.11.PLAIN: O Lord of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.

JER.11.BSB: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.”
JER.11.KJV: Therefore thus says the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek your life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that you die not by our hand:
JER.11.PLAIN: Therefore this is what the Lord says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the Lord, or you will die by our hand.”

JER.11.BSB: So this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
JER.11.KJV: Therefore thus says the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
JER.11.PLAIN: So this is what the Lord of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

JER.11.BSB: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”
JER.11.KJV: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
JER.11.PLAIN: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”

JER.12.BSB: Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
JER.12.KJV: Righteous are you, O LORD, when I plead with you: yet let me talk with you of your judgments: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? why are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
JER.12.PLAIN: Righteous are You, O Lord, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

JER.12.BSB: You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are ever on their lips, but far from their hearts.
JER.12.KJV: You have planted them, yes, they have taken root: they grow, yes, they bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
JER.12.PLAIN: You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are ever on their lips, but far from their hearts.

JER.12.BSB: But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
JER.12.KJV: But you, O LORD, know me: you have seen me, and tried my heart toward you: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
JER.12.PLAIN: But You know me, O Lord; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.

JER.12.BSB: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered? Because of the evil of its residents, the animals and birds have been swept away, for the people have said, “He cannot see what our end will be.”
JER.12.KJV: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end. ¶
JER.12.PLAIN: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered? Because of the evil of its residents, the animals and birds have been swept away, for the people have said, “He cannot see what our end will be.”

JER.12.BSB: “If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?
JER.12.KJV: If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein you trusted, they wearied you, then how will you do in the swelling of Jordan?
JER.12.PLAIN: “If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?
