LAM.1.BSB: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the LORD has brought her grief because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.
LAM.1.KJV: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
LAM.1.PLAIN: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the Lord has brought her grief because of her many wanderings and failures. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.

LAM.1.BSB: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; they lack the strength to flee in the face of the hunter.
LAM.1.KJV: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
LAM.1.PLAIN: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; they lack the strength to flee in the face of the hunter.

LAM.1.BSB: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.
LAM.1.KJV: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
LAM.1.PLAIN: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.

LAM.1.BSB: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.
LAM.1.KJV: Jerusalem has grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sighs, and turns backward.
LAM.1.PLAIN: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.

LAM.1.BSB: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
LAM.1.KJV: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembers not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy has magnified himself.
LAM.1.PLAIN: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O Lord, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!

LAM.1.BSB: The adversary has seized all her treasures. For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary— those You had forbidden to enter Your assembly.
LAM.1.KJV: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things: for she has seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom you did command that they should not enter into your congregation.
LAM.1.PLAIN: The adversary has seized all her treasures. For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary— those You had forbidden to enter Your assembly.

LAM.1.BSB: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have traded their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. Look, O LORD, and consider, for I have become despised.
LAM.1.KJV: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile. ¶
LAM.1.PLAIN: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have traded their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. Look, O Lord, and consider, for I have become despised.

LAM.1.BSB: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see! Is there any sorrow like mine, which was inflicted on me, which the LORD made me suffer on the day of His fierce anger?
LAM.1.KJV: Is it nothing to you, all you that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like to my sorrow, which is done to me, with which the LORD has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
LAM.1.PLAIN: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see! Is there any sorrow like mine, which was inflicted on me, which the Lord made me suffer on the day of His fierce anger?

LAM.1.BSB: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
LAM.1.KJV: From above has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them: he has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: he has made me desolate and faint all the day.
LAM.1.PLAIN: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.

LAM.1.BSB: My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
LAM.1.KJV: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up on my neck: he has made my strength to fall, the LORD has delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
LAM.1.PLAIN: My wanderings and failures are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.

LAM.1.BSB: The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst; He has summoned an army against me to crush my young warriors. Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
LAM.1.KJV: The LORD has trodden under foot all my mighty men in the middle of me: he has called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the LORD has trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a wine press.
LAM.1.PLAIN: The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst; He has summoned an army against me to crush my young warriors. Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.

LAM.1.BSB: For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.
LAM.1.KJV: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
LAM.1.PLAIN: For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.

LAM.1.BSB: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed against Jacob that his neighbors become his foes. Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
LAM.1.KJV: Zion spreads forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD has commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them. ¶
LAM.1.PLAIN: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The Lord has decreed against Jacob that his neighbors become his foes. Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.

LAM.1.BSB: The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.
LAM.1.KJV: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
LAM.1.PLAIN: The Lord is righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.

LAM.1.BSB: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
LAM.1.KJV: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
LAM.1.PLAIN: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.

LAM.1.BSB: See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.
LAM.1.KJV: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; my heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaves, at home there is as death.
LAM.1.PLAIN: See, O Lord, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.

LAM.1.BSB: People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that You have caused it. May You bring the day You have announced, so that they may become like me.
LAM.1.KJV: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it: you will bring the day that you have called, and they shall be like to me.
LAM.1.PLAIN: People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that You have caused it. May You bring the day You have announced, so that they may become like me.

LAM.1.BSB: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
LAM.1.KJV: Let all their wickedness come before you; and do to them, as you have done to me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
LAM.1.PLAIN: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my wanderings and failures. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.

LAM.2.BSB: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
LAM.2.KJV: How has the LORD covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
LAM.2.PLAIN: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.

LAM.2.BSB: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.
LAM.2.KJV: The LORD has swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and has not pitied: he has thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he has brought them down to the ground: he has polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
LAM.2.PLAIN: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.

LAM.2.BSB: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
LAM.2.KJV: He has cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours round about.
LAM.2.PLAIN: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.

LAM.2.BSB: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned. Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye; He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
LAM.2.KJV: He has bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
LAM.2.PLAIN: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned. Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye; He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.

LAM.2.BSB: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
LAM.2.KJV: The LORD was as an enemy: he has swallowed up Israel, he has swallowed up all her palaces: he has destroyed his strong holds, and has increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.

LAM.2.BSB: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
LAM.2.KJV: And he has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he has destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD has caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
LAM.2.PLAIN: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The Lord has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.

LAM.2.BSB: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.
LAM.2.KJV: The LORD has cast off his altar, he has abhorred his sanctuary, he has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the Lord as on the day of an appointed feast.

LAM.2.BSB: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.
LAM.2.KJV: The LORD has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he has stretched out a line, he has not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The Lord determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.

LAM.2.BSB: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
LAM.2.KJV: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
LAM.2.PLAIN: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the Lord.

LAM.2.BSB: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
LAM.2.KJV: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust on their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

LAM.2.BSB: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
LAM.2.KJV: My eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured on the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
LAM.2.PLAIN: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.

LAM.2.BSB: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.
LAM.2.KJV: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.
LAM.2.PLAIN: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.

LAM.2.BSB: What can I say for you? To what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?
LAM.2.KJV: What thing shall I take to witness for you? what thing shall I liken to you, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to you, that I may comfort you, O virgin daughter of Zion? for your breach is great like the sea: who can heal you?
LAM.2.PLAIN: What can I say for you? To what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?

LAM.2.BSB: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.
LAM.2.KJV: Your prophets have seen vain and foolish things for you: and they have not discovered your iniquity, to turn away your captivity; but have seen for you false burdens and causes of banishment.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.

LAM.2.BSB: All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
LAM.2.KJV: All that pass by clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
LAM.2.PLAIN: All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”

LAM.2.BSB: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”
LAM.2.KJV: All your enemies have opened their mouth against you: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
LAM.2.PLAIN: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”

LAM.2.BSB: The LORD has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes.
LAM.2.KJV: The LORD has done that which he had devised; he has fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he has thrown down, and has not pitied: and he has caused your enemy to rejoice over you, he has set up the horn of your adversaries.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The Lord has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes.

LAM.2.BSB: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.
LAM.2.KJV: Their heart cried to the LORD, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give yourself no rest; let not the apple of your eye cease.
LAM.2.PLAIN: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.

LAM.2.BSB: Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.
LAM.2.KJV: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out your heart like water before the face of the LORD: lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street. ¶
LAM.2.PLAIN: Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.

LAM.2.BSB: Look, O LORD, and consider: Whom have You ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the infants they have nurtured? Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
LAM.2.KJV: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom you have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
LAM.2.PLAIN: Look, O Lord, and consider: Whom have You ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the infants they have nurtured? Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

LAM.2.BSB: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered them without compassion.
LAM.2.KJV: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; you have slain them in the day of your anger; you have killed, and not pitied.
LAM.2.PLAIN: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered them without compassion.

LAM.2.BSB: You summoned my attackers on every side, as for the day of an appointed feast. In the day of the LORD’s anger no one escaped or survived; my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared.
LAM.2.KJV: You have called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’s anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up has my enemy consumed.
LAM.2.PLAIN: You summoned my attackers on every side, as for the day of an appointed feast. In the day of the Lord’s anger no one escaped or survived; my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared.

LAM.3.BSB: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
LAM.3.KJV: I AM the man that has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
LAM.3.PLAIN: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.

LAM.3.BSB: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
LAM.3.KJV: He has led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.

LAM.3.BSB: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
LAM.3.KJV: Surely against me is he turned; he turns his hand against me all the day.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.

LAM.3.BSB: He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
LAM.3.KJV: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.

LAM.3.BSB: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
LAM.3.KJV: He has built against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

LAM.3.BSB: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
LAM.3.KJV: He has set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.

LAM.3.BSB: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
LAM.3.KJV: He has hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he has made my chain heavy.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.

LAM.3.BSB: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
LAM.3.KJV: Also when I cry and shout, he shuts out my prayer.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.

LAM.3.BSB: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
LAM.3.KJV: He has enclosed my ways with hewn stone, he has made my paths crooked.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.

LAM.3.BSB: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
LAM.3.KJV: He was to me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.

LAM.3.BSB: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
LAM.3.KJV: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he has made me desolate.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.

LAM.3.BSB: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
LAM.3.KJV: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.

LAM.3.BSB: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
LAM.3.KJV: He has caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.

LAM.3.BSB: I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
LAM.3.KJV: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
LAM.3.PLAIN: I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.

LAM.3.BSB: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
LAM.3.KJV: He has filled me with bitterness, he has made me drunken with wormwood.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.

LAM.3.BSB: He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
LAM.3.KJV: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he has covered me with ashes.
LAM.3.PLAIN: He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.

LAM.3.BSB: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
LAM.3.KJV: And you have removed my soul far off from peace: I forgot prosperity.
LAM.3.PLAIN: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.

LAM.3.BSB: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
LAM.3.KJV: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
LAM.3.PLAIN: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the Lord.”

LAM.3.BSB: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
LAM.3.KJV: Remembering my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.

LAM.3.BSB: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
LAM.3.KJV: My soul has them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.

LAM.3.BSB: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
LAM.3.KJV: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope. ¶
LAM.3.PLAIN: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:

LAM.3.BSB: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
LAM.3.KJV: It is of the LORD’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

LAM.3.BSB: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
LAM.3.KJV: They are new every morning: great is your faithfulness.
LAM.3.PLAIN: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

LAM.3.BSB: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
LAM.3.KJV: The LORD is my portion, says my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
LAM.3.PLAIN: “The Lord is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”

LAM.3.BSB: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
LAM.3.KJV: The LORD is good to them that wait for him, to the soul that seeks him.
LAM.3.PLAIN: The Lord is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him.

LAM.3.BSB: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
LAM.3.KJV: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
LAM.3.PLAIN: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the Lord.

LAM.3.BSB: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
LAM.3.KJV: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke of his youth.
LAM.3.PLAIN: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.

LAM.3.BSB: Let him sit alone in silence, for God has disciplined him.
LAM.3.KJV: He sits alone and keeps silence, because he has borne it on him.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Let him sit alone in silence, for God has disciplined him.

LAM.3.BSB: Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.
LAM.3.KJV: He puts his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.

LAM.3.BSB: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
LAM.3.KJV: He gives his cheek to him that smites him: he is filled full with reproach.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.

LAM.3.BSB: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
LAM.3.KJV: For the LORD will not cast off for ever:
LAM.3.PLAIN: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.

LAM.3.BSB: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
LAM.3.KJV: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.

LAM.3.BSB: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
LAM.3.KJV: For he does not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
LAM.3.PLAIN: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.

LAM.3.BSB: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
LAM.3.KJV: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth.
LAM.3.PLAIN: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,

LAM.3.BSB: to deny a man justice before the Most High,
LAM.3.KJV: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
LAM.3.PLAIN: to deny a man justice before the Most High,

LAM.3.BSB: to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve.
LAM.3.KJV: To subvert a man in his cause, the LORD approves not. ¶
LAM.3.PLAIN: to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve.

LAM.3.BSB: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
LAM.3.KJV: Who is he that says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord commands it not?
LAM.3.PLAIN: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?

LAM.3.BSB: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
LAM.3.KJV: Out of the mouth of the most High proceeds not evil and good?
LAM.3.PLAIN: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?

LAM.3.BSB: Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
LAM.3.KJV: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
LAM.3.PLAIN: Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?

LAM.3.BSB: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
LAM.3.KJV: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the Lord.

LAM.3.BSB: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
LAM.3.KJV: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:

LAM.3.BSB: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
LAM.3.KJV: We have transgressed and have rebelled: you have not pardoned.
LAM.3.PLAIN: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”

LAM.3.BSB: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
LAM.3.KJV: You have covered with anger, and persecuted us: you have slain, you have not pitied.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.

LAM.3.BSB: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
LAM.3.KJV: You have covered yourself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.

LAM.3.BSB: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
LAM.3.KJV: You have made us as the offscouring and refuse in the middle of the people.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.

LAM.3.BSB: All our enemies open their mouths against us.
LAM.3.KJV: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
LAM.3.PLAIN: All our enemies open their mouths against us.

LAM.3.BSB: Panic and pitfall have come upon us— devastation and destruction.
LAM.3.KJV: Fear and a snare is come on us, desolation and destruction.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Panic and pitfall have come upon us— devastation and destruction.

LAM.3.BSB: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
LAM.3.KJV: My eye runs down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.

LAM.3.BSB: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
LAM.3.KJV: My eye trickles down, and ceases not, without any intermission.
LAM.3.PLAIN: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,

LAM.3.BSB: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
LAM.3.KJV: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
LAM.3.PLAIN: until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees.

LAM.3.BSB: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
LAM.3.KJV: My eye affects my heart because of all the daughters of my city.
LAM.3.PLAIN: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.

LAM.3.BSB: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
LAM.3.KJV: My enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.

LAM.3.BSB: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
LAM.3.KJV: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone on me.
LAM.3.PLAIN: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.

LAM.3.BSB: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
LAM.3.KJV: Waters flowed over my head; then I said, I am cut off. ¶
LAM.3.PLAIN: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.

LAM.3.BSB: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
LAM.3.KJV: I called on your name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
LAM.3.PLAIN: I called on Your name, O Lord, out of the depths of the Pit.

LAM.3.BSB: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
LAM.3.KJV: You have heard my voice: hide not your ear at my breathing, at my cry.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”

LAM.3.BSB: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
LAM.3.KJV: You drew near in the day that I called on you: you said, Fear not.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”

LAM.3.BSB: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
LAM.3.KJV: O LORD, you have pleaded the causes of my soul; you have redeemed my life.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.

LAM.3.BSB: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
LAM.3.KJV: O LORD, you have seen my wrong: judge you my cause.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You have seen, O Lord, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!

LAM.3.BSB: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
LAM.3.KJV: You have seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.

LAM.3.BSB: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
LAM.3.KJV: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
LAM.3.PLAIN: O Lord, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—

LAM.3.BSB: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
LAM.3.KJV: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
LAM.3.PLAIN: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.

LAM.3.BSB: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
LAM.3.KJV: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their music. ¶
LAM.3.PLAIN: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.

LAM.3.BSB: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
LAM.3.KJV: Render to them a recompense, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You will pay them back what they deserve, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

LAM.3.BSB: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
LAM.3.KJV: Give them sorrow of heart, your curse to them.
LAM.3.PLAIN: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!

LAM.3.BSB: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
LAM.3.KJV: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
LAM.3.PLAIN: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O Lord.

LAM.4.BSB: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
LAM.4.KJV: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
LAM.4.PLAIN: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.

LAM.4.BSB: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
LAM.4.KJV: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
LAM.4.PLAIN: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!

LAM.4.BSB: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
LAM.4.KJV: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
LAM.4.PLAIN: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.

LAM.4.BSB: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
LAM.4.KJV: The tongue of the sucking child sticks to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaks it to them.
LAM.4.PLAIN: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.

LAM.4.BSB: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
LAM.4.KJV: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
LAM.4.PLAIN: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.

LAM.4.BSB: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
LAM.4.KJV: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
LAM.4.PLAIN: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.

LAM.4.BSB: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
LAM.4.KJV: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
LAM.4.PLAIN: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.

LAM.4.BSB: But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
LAM.4.KJV: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin sticks to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
LAM.4.PLAIN: But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.

LAM.4.BSB: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
LAM.4.KJV: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
LAM.4.PLAIN: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.

LAM.4.BSB: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
LAM.4.KJV: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
LAM.4.PLAIN: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

LAM.4.BSB: The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
LAM.4.KJV: The LORD has accomplished his fury; he has poured out his fierce anger, and has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has devoured the foundations thereof.
LAM.4.PLAIN: The Lord has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.

LAM.4.BSB: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
LAM.4.KJV: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem. ¶
LAM.4.PLAIN: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.

LAM.4.BSB: But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
LAM.4.KJV: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the middle of her,
LAM.4.PLAIN: But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.

LAM.4.BSB: They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.
LAM.4.KJV: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
LAM.4.PLAIN: They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.

LAM.4.BSB: “Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”
LAM.4.KJV: They cried to them, Depart you; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
LAM.4.PLAIN: “Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”

LAM.4.BSB: The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
LAM.4.KJV: The anger of the LORD has divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.
LAM.4.PLAIN: The presence of the Lord has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.

LAM.4.BSB: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
LAM.4.KJV: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
LAM.4.PLAIN: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.

LAM.4.BSB: They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
LAM.4.KJV: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
LAM.4.PLAIN: They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!

LAM.4.BSB: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
LAM.4.KJV: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us on the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
LAM.4.PLAIN: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.

LAM.4.BSB: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”
LAM.4.KJV: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen. ¶
LAM.4.PLAIN: The Lord’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”

LAM.4.BSB: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
LAM.4.KJV: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwell in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through to you: you shall be drunken, and shall make yourself naked. ¶
LAM.4.PLAIN: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.

LAM.4.BSB: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.
LAM.4.KJV: The punishment of your iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry you away into captivity: he will visit your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover your sins.
LAM.4.PLAIN: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your brokenness, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.

LAM.5.BSB: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
LAM.5.KJV: Remember, O LORD, what is come on us: consider, and behold our reproach.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Remember, O Lord, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!

LAM.5.BSB: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
LAM.5.KJV: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.

LAM.5.BSB: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
LAM.5.KJV: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
LAM.5.PLAIN: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.

LAM.5.BSB: We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.
LAM.5.KJV: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold to us.
LAM.5.PLAIN: We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.

LAM.5.BSB: We are closely pursued; we are weary and find no rest.
LAM.5.KJV: Our necks are under persecution: we labor, and have no rest.
LAM.5.PLAIN: We are closely pursued; we are weary and find no rest.

LAM.5.BSB: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
LAM.5.KJV: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
LAM.5.PLAIN: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.

LAM.5.BSB: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.
LAM.5.KJV: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.

LAM.5.BSB: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.
LAM.5.KJV: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that does deliver us out of their hand.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.

LAM.5.BSB: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness.
LAM.5.KJV: We got our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
LAM.5.PLAIN: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness.

LAM.5.BSB: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.
LAM.5.KJV: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.

LAM.5.BSB: Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
LAM.5.KJV: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.

LAM.5.BSB: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
LAM.5.KJV: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honored.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.

LAM.5.BSB: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
LAM.5.KJV: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.

LAM.5.BSB: The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
LAM.5.KJV: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.
LAM.5.PLAIN: The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.

LAM.5.BSB: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
LAM.5.KJV: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.

LAM.5.BSB: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
LAM.5.KJV: The crown is fallen from our head: woe to us, that we have sinned!
LAM.5.PLAIN: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

LAM.5.BSB: Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—
LAM.5.KJV: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—

LAM.5.BSB: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate, patrolled by foxes.
LAM.5.KJV: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk on it.
LAM.5.PLAIN: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate, patrolled by foxes.

LAM.5.BSB: You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
LAM.5.KJV: You, O LORD, remain for ever; your throne from generation to generation.
LAM.5.PLAIN: You, O Lord, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.

LAM.5.BSB: Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
LAM.5.KJV: Why do you forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
LAM.5.PLAIN: Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?

LAM.5.BSB: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
LAM.5.KJV: Turn you us to you, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
LAM.5.PLAIN: Restore us to Yourself, O Lord, so we may return; renew our days as of old,

LAM.5.BSB: unless You have utterly rejected us and remain angry with us beyond measure.
LAM.5.KJV: But you have utterly rejected us; you are very wroth against us.
LAM.5.PLAIN: unless You have utterly rejected us and remain angry with us beyond measure.

EZK.1.BSB: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
EZK.1.KJV: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
EZK.1.PLAIN: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.

EZK.1.BSB: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
EZK.1.KJV: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin’s captivity,
EZK.1.PLAIN: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—

EZK.1.BSB: the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
EZK.1.KJV: The word of the LORD came expressly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there on him. ¶
EZK.1.PLAIN: the word of the Lord came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the Lord’s hand was upon him.

EZK.1.BSB: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
EZK.1.KJV: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire enfolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the middle thereof as the color of amber, out of the middle of the fire.
EZK.1.PLAIN: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,

EZK.1.BSB: and within it was the form of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: They had a human form,
EZK.1.KJV: Also out of the middle thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
EZK.1.PLAIN: and within it was the form of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: They had a human form,

EZK.1.BSB: but each had four faces and four wings.
EZK.1.KJV: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
EZK.1.PLAIN: but each had four faces and four wings.

EZK.1.BSB: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
EZK.1.KJV: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the color of burnished brass.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.

EZK.1.BSB: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
EZK.1.KJV: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,

EZK.1.BSB: and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
EZK.1.KJV: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
EZK.1.PLAIN: and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.

EZK.1.BSB: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
EZK.1.KJV: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
EZK.1.PLAIN: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.

EZK.1.BSB: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
EZK.1.KJV: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.

EZK.1.BSB: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
EZK.1.KJV: And they went every one straight forward: where the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.

EZK.1.BSB: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
EZK.1.KJV: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
EZK.1.PLAIN: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.

EZK.1.BSB: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
EZK.1.KJV: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning. ¶
EZK.1.PLAIN: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.

EZK.1.BSB: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
EZK.1.KJV: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel on the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
EZK.1.PLAIN: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.

EZK.1.BSB: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
EZK.1.KJV: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like to the color of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
EZK.1.PLAIN: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.

EZK.1.BSB: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
EZK.1.KJV: When they went, they went on their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
EZK.1.PLAIN: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.

EZK.1.BSB: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
EZK.1.KJV: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

EZK.1.BSB: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
EZK.1.KJV: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
EZK.1.PLAIN: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.

EZK.1.BSB: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
EZK.1.KJV: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

EZK.1.BSB: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
EZK.1.KJV: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
EZK.1.PLAIN: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

EZK.1.BSB: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
EZK.1.KJV: And the likeness of the firmament on the heads of the living creature was as the color of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.

EZK.1.BSB: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
EZK.1.KJV: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
EZK.1.PLAIN: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.

EZK.1.BSB: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
EZK.1.KJV: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
EZK.1.PLAIN: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

EZK.1.BSB: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
EZK.1.KJV: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings. ¶
EZK.1.PLAIN: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.

EZK.1.BSB: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
EZK.1.KJV: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and on the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above on it.
EZK.1.PLAIN: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.

EZK.1.BSB: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
EZK.1.KJV: And I saw as the color of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
EZK.1.PLAIN: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.

EZK.1.BSB: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
EZK.1.KJV: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell on my face, and I heard a voice of one that spoke.
EZK.1.PLAIN: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.

EZK.2.BSB: “Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
EZK.2.KJV: And he said to me, Son of man, stand on your feet, and I will speak to you.
EZK.2.PLAIN: “Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”

EZK.2.BSB: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
EZK.2.KJV: And the spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and set me on my feet, that I heard him that spoke to me.
EZK.2.PLAIN: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.

EZK.2.BSB: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
EZK.2.KJV: And he said to me, Son of man, I send you to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even to this very day.
EZK.2.PLAIN: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.

EZK.2.BSB: They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
EZK.2.KJV: For they are impudent children and stiff hearted. I do send you to them; and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord GOD.
EZK.2.PLAIN: They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’

EZK.2.BSB: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
EZK.2.KJV: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there has been a prophet among them. ¶
EZK.2.PLAIN: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.

EZK.2.BSB: But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
EZK.2.KJV: And you, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with you, and you do dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
EZK.2.PLAIN: But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.

EZK.2.BSB: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
EZK.2.KJV: And you shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
EZK.2.PLAIN: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.

EZK.2.BSB: And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
EZK.2.KJV: But you, son of man, hear what I say to you; Be not you rebellious like that rebellious house: open your mouth, and eat that I give you. ¶
EZK.2.PLAIN: And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”

EZK.2.BSB: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,
EZK.2.KJV: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent to me; and, see, a roll of a book was therein;
EZK.2.PLAIN: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,

EZK.2.BSB: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
EZK.2.KJV: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
EZK.2.PLAIN: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.

EZK.3.BSB: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”
EZK.3.KJV: Moreover he said to me, Son of man, eat that you find; eat this roll, and go speak to the house of Israel.
EZK.3.PLAIN: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”

EZK.3.BSB: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
EZK.3.KJV: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
EZK.3.PLAIN: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.

EZK.3.BSB: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat and fill your stomach with this scroll I am giving you.” So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
EZK.3.KJV: And he said to me, Son of man, cause your belly to eat, and fill your bowels with this roll that I give you. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness. ¶
EZK.3.PLAIN: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat and fill your stomach with this scroll I am giving you.” So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

EZK.3.BSB: Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.
EZK.3.KJV: And he said to me, Son of man, go, get you to the house of Israel, and speak with my words to them.
EZK.3.PLAIN: Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.

EZK.3.BSB: For you are not being sent to a people of unfamiliar speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel—
EZK.3.KJV: For you are not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
EZK.3.PLAIN: For you are not being sent to a people of unfamiliar speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel—

EZK.3.BSB: not to the many peoples of unfamiliar speech and difficult language whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
EZK.3.KJV: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words you can not understand. Surely, had I sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
EZK.3.PLAIN: not to the many peoples of unfamiliar speech and difficult language whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

EZK.3.BSB: But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.
EZK.3.KJV: But the house of Israel will not listen to you; for they will not listen to me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
EZK.3.PLAIN: But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.

EZK.3.BSB: Behold, I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.
EZK.3.KJV: Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your forehead strong against their foreheads.
EZK.3.PLAIN: Look closely — I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.

EZK.3.BSB: I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.”
EZK.3.KJV: As an adamant harder than flint have I made your forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
EZK.3.PLAIN: I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.”

EZK.3.BSB: “Son of man,” He added, “listen carefully to all the words I speak to you, and take them to heart.
EZK.3.KJV: Moreover he said to me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak to you receive in your heart, and hear with your ears.
EZK.3.PLAIN: “Son of man,” He added, “listen carefully to all the words I speak to you, and take them to heart.

EZK.3.BSB: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”
EZK.3.KJV: And go, get you to them of the captivity, to the children of your people, and speak to them, and tell them, Thus says the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
EZK.3.PLAIN: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”

EZK.3.BSB: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!’
EZK.3.KJV: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
EZK.3.PLAIN: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the Lord in His dwelling place!’

EZK.3.BSB: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, a great rumbling sound.
EZK.3.KJV: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
EZK.3.PLAIN: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, a great rumbling sound.

EZK.3.BSB: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.
EZK.3.KJV: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong on me. ¶
EZK.3.PLAIN: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the Lord upon me.

EZK.3.BSB: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. And for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.
EZK.3.KJV: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelled by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
EZK.3.PLAIN: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. And for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.

EZK.3.BSB: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK.3.KJV: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
EZK.3.PLAIN: At the end of seven days the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

EZK.3.BSB: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.
EZK.3.KJV: Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
EZK.3.PLAIN: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.
