EZK.43.PLAIN: Then the man brought me back to the gate that faces east,

EZK.43.BSB: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.
EZK.43.KJV: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
EZK.43.PLAIN: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of many waters, and the earth shone with His glory.

EZK.43.BSB: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when He came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the River Kebar. I fell facedown,
EZK.43.KJV: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
EZK.43.PLAIN: The vision I saw was like the vision I had seen when He came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the River Kebar. I fell facedown,

EZK.43.BSB: and the glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.
EZK.43.KJV: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
EZK.43.PLAIN: and the glory of the Lord entered the temple through the gate facing east.

EZK.43.BSB: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.
EZK.43.KJV: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
EZK.43.PLAIN: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.

EZK.43.BSB: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple,
EZK.43.KJV: And I heard him speaking to me out of the house; and the man stood by me. ¶
EZK.43.PLAIN: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple,

EZK.43.BSB: and He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.
EZK.43.KJV: And he said to me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the middle of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their prostitution, nor by the carcasses of their kings in their high places.
EZK.43.PLAIN: and He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet, where I will dwell among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name—neither they nor their kings—by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths.

EZK.43.BSB: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts, with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed. Therefore I have consumed them in My anger.
EZK.43.KJV: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: why I have consumed them in my anger.
EZK.43.PLAIN: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts, with only a wall between Me and them, they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed. Therefore I have consumed them in My anger.

EZK.43.BSB: Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will dwell among them forever.
EZK.43.KJV: Now let them put away their prostitution, and the carcasses of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the middle of them for ever. ¶
EZK.43.PLAIN: Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings, and I will dwell among them forever.

EZK.43.BSB: As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities. Let them measure the plan,
EZK.43.KJV: You son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
EZK.43.PLAIN: As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities. Let them measure the plan,

EZK.43.BSB: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, then make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement and its exits and entrances—its whole design along with all its statutes, forms, and laws. Write it down in their sight, so that they may keep its complete design and all its statutes and may carry them out.
EZK.43.KJV: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, show them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
EZK.43.PLAIN: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, then make known to them the design of the temple—its arrangement and its exits and entrances—its whole design along with all its statutes, forms, and laws. Write it down in their sight, so that they may keep its complete design and all its statutes and may carry them out.

EZK.43.BSB: This is the law of the temple: All its surrounding territory on top of the mountain will be most holy. Yes, this is the law of the temple.
EZK.43.KJV: This is the law of the house; On the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house. ¶
EZK.43.PLAIN: This is the law of the temple: All its surrounding territory on top of the mountain will be most holy. Yes, this is the law of the temple.

EZK.43.BSB: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): Its gutter shall be a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around its edge. And this is the height of the altar:
EZK.43.KJV: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
EZK.43.PLAIN: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits (a cubit and a handbreadth): Its gutter shall be a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around its edge. And this is the height of the altar:

EZK.43.BSB: The space from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide. The space from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide.
EZK.43.KJV: And from the bottom on the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.
EZK.43.PLAIN: The space from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide. The space from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits, and the ledge one cubit wide.

EZK.43.BSB: The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth.
EZK.43.KJV: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
EZK.43.PLAIN: The altar hearth shall be four cubits high, and four horns shall project upward from the hearth.

EZK.43.BSB: The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.
EZK.43.KJV: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
EZK.43.PLAIN: The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners, twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide.

EZK.43.BSB: The ledge shall also be square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it. The steps of the altar shall face east.”
EZK.43.KJV: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east. ¶
EZK.43.PLAIN: The ledge shall also be square, fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it. The steps of the altar shall face east.”

EZK.43.BSB: Then He said to me: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed, so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be sprinkled on it:
EZK.43.KJV: And he said to me, Son of man, thus says the Lord GOD; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
EZK.43.PLAIN: Then He said to me: “Son of man, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed, so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be sprinkled on it:

EZK.43.BSB: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok, who approach Me to minister before Me, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK.43.KJV: And you shall give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach to me, to minister to me, says the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
EZK.43.PLAIN: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok, who approach Me to minister before Me, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK.43.BSB: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and all around the rim; thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.
EZK.43.KJV: And you shall take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and on the border round about: thus shall you cleanse and purge it.
EZK.43.PLAIN: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar, on the four corners of the ledge, and all around the rim; thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it.

EZK.43.BSB: Then you are to take away the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.
EZK.43.KJV: You shall take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
EZK.43.PLAIN: Then you are to take away the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.

EZK.43.BSB: On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and the altar is to be cleansed as it was with the bull.
EZK.43.KJV: And on the second day you shall offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
EZK.43.PLAIN: On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat as a sin offering, and the altar is to be cleansed as it was with the bull.

EZK.43.BSB: When you have finished the purification, you are to present a young, unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.
EZK.43.KJV: When you have made an end of cleansing it, you shall offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
EZK.43.PLAIN: When you have finished the purification, you are to present a young, unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock.

EZK.43.BSB: You must present them before the LORD; the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.
EZK.43.KJV: And you shall offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt on them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering to the LORD.
EZK.43.PLAIN: You must present them before the Lord; the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the Lord.

EZK.43.BSB: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.
EZK.43.KJV: Seven days shall you prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
EZK.43.PLAIN: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.

EZK.43.BSB: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.
EZK.43.KJV: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
EZK.43.PLAIN: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so they shall consecrate it.

EZK.43.BSB: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD.’”
EZK.43.KJV: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that on the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings on the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, says the Lord GOD.
EZK.43.PLAIN: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Lord GOD.’”

EZK.44.BSB: The man then brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east, but it was shut.
EZK.44.KJV: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
EZK.44.PLAIN: The man then brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east, but it was shut.

EZK.44.BSB: And the LORD said to me, “This gate is to remain shut. It shall not be opened, and no man shall enter through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it. Therefore it will remain shut.
EZK.44.KJV: Then said the LORD to me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
EZK.44.PLAIN: And the Lord said to me, “This gate is to remain shut. It shall not be opened, and no man shall enter through it, because the Lord, the God of Israel, has entered through it. Therefore it will remain shut.

EZK.44.BSB: Only the prince himself may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the LORD. He must enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way.”
EZK.44.KJV: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same. ¶
EZK.44.PLAIN: Only the prince himself may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the Lord. He must enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way.”

EZK.44.BSB: Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling His temple, and I fell facedown.
EZK.44.KJV: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell on my face.
EZK.44.PLAIN: Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate. I looked and saw the glory of the Lord filling His temple, and I fell facedown.

EZK.44.BSB: The LORD said to me: “Son of man, pay attention; look carefully with your eyes and listen closely with your ears to everything I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD. Take careful note of the entrance to the temple, along with all the exits of the sanctuary.
EZK.44.KJV: And the LORD said to me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I say to you concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
EZK.44.PLAIN: The Lord said to me: “Son of man, pay attention; look carefully with your eyes and listen closely with your ears to everything I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the Lord. Take careful note of the entrance to the temple, along with all the exits of the sanctuary.

EZK.44.BSB: Tell the rebellious house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I have had enough of all your abominations, O house of Israel.
EZK.44.KJV: And you shall say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord GOD; O you house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
EZK.44.PLAIN: Tell the rebellious house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I have had enough of all your abominations, O house of Israel.

EZK.44.BSB: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.
EZK.44.KJV: In that you have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
EZK.44.PLAIN: In addition to all your other abominations, you brought in foreigners uncircumcised in both heart and flesh to occupy My sanctuary; you defiled My temple when you offered My food—the fat and the blood; you broke My covenant.

EZK.44.BSB: And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you.’
EZK.44.KJV: And you have not kept the charge of my holy things: but you have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves. ¶
EZK.44.PLAIN: And you have not kept charge of My holy things, but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you.’

EZK.44.BSB: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.
EZK.44.KJV: Thus says the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
EZK.44.PLAIN: This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh may enter My sanctuary—not even a foreigner who lives among the Israelites.

EZK.44.BSB: Surely the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray, and who wandered away from Me after their idols, will bear the consequences of their iniquity.
EZK.44.KJV: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
EZK.44.PLAIN: Surely the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray, and who wandered away from Me after their idols, will bear the consequences of their brokenness.

EZK.44.BSB: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and ministering there. They shall slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people and stand before them to minister to them.
EZK.44.KJV: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister to them.
EZK.44.PLAIN: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having charge of the gates of the temple and ministering there. They shall slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people and stand before them to minister to them.

EZK.44.BSB: Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK.44.KJV: Because they ministered to them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up my hand against them, says the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
EZK.44.PLAIN: Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of brokenness to the house of Israel, therefore I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their brokenness, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK.44.BSB: They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near any of My holy things or the most holy things. They will bear the shame of the abominations they have committed.
EZK.44.KJV: And they shall not come near to me, to do the office of a priest to me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
EZK.44.PLAIN: They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near any of My holy things or the most holy things. They will bear the shame of the abominations they have committed.

EZK.44.BSB: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it.
EZK.44.KJV: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein. ¶
EZK.44.PLAIN: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it.

EZK.44.BSB: But the Levitical priests, who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, are to approach Me to minister before Me. They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK.44.KJV: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister to me, and they shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood, says the Lord GOD:
EZK.44.PLAIN: But the Levitical priests, who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from Me, are to approach Me to minister before Me. They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK.44.BSB: They alone shall enter My sanctuary and draw near to My table to minister before Me. They will keep My charge.
EZK.44.KJV: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my charge. ¶
EZK.44.PLAIN: They alone shall enter My sanctuary and draw near to My table to minister before Me. They will keep My charge.

EZK.44.BSB: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen garments; they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.
EZK.44.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come on them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
EZK.44.PLAIN: When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen garments; they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

EZK.44.BSB: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.
EZK.44.KJV: They shall have linen bonnets on their heads, and shall have linen breeches on their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causes sweat.
EZK.44.PLAIN: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.

EZK.44.BSB: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.
EZK.44.KJV: And when they go forth into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
EZK.44.PLAIN: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.

EZK.44.BSB: They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but must carefully trim their hair.
EZK.44.KJV: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
EZK.44.PLAIN: They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but must carefully trim their hair.

EZK.44.BSB: No priest may drink wine before he enters the inner court.
EZK.44.KJV: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
EZK.44.PLAIN: No priest may drink wine before he enters the inner court.

EZK.44.BSB: And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.
EZK.44.KJV: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
EZK.44.PLAIN: And they shall not marry a widow or a divorced woman, but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel, or a widow of a priest.

EZK.44.BSB: They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean.
EZK.44.KJV: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
EZK.44.PLAIN: They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean.

EZK.44.BSB: In any dispute, they shall officiate as judges and judge according to My ordinances. They must keep My laws and statutes regarding all My appointed feasts, and they must keep My Sabbaths holy.
EZK.44.KJV: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all my assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
EZK.44.PLAIN: In any dispute, they shall officiate as judges and judge according to My ordinances. They must keep My laws and statutes regarding all My appointed feasts, and they must keep My Sabbaths holy.

EZK.44.BSB: A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person. However, for a father, a mother, a son, a daughter, a brother, or an unmarried sister, he may do so,
EZK.44.KJV: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that has had no husband, they may defile themselves.
EZK.44.PLAIN: A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person. However, for a father, a mother, a son, a daughter, a brother, or an unmarried sister, he may do so,

EZK.44.BSB: and after he is cleansed, he must count off seven days for himself.
EZK.44.KJV: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon to him seven days.
EZK.44.PLAIN: and after he is cleansed, he must count off seven days for himself.

EZK.44.BSB: And on the day he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he must present his sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.
EZK.44.KJV: And in the day that he goes into the sanctuary, to the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, says the Lord GOD.
EZK.44.PLAIN: And on the day he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he must present his sin offering, declares the Lord GOD.

EZK.44.BSB: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.
EZK.44.KJV: And it shall be to them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and you shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
EZK.44.PLAIN: In regard to their inheritance, I am their inheritance. You are to give them no possession in Israel, for I am their possession.

DAN.7.BSB: He will speak out against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High, intending to change the appointed times and laws; and the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.
DAN.7.KJV: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
DAN.7.PLAIN: He will speak out against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High, intending to change the appointed times and laws; and the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.

DAN.7.BSB: But the court will convene, and his dominion will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.
DAN.7.KJV: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.
DAN.7.PLAIN: But the court will convene, and his dominion will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.

DAN.7.BSB: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will serve and obey Him.’
DAN.7.KJV: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
DAN.7.PLAIN: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will serve and obey Him.’

DAN.7.BSB: Thus ends the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face turned pale. But I kept the matter to myself.”
DAN.7.KJV: Till now is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
DAN.7.PLAIN: Thus ends the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face turned pale. But I kept the matter to myself.”

DAN.8.BSB: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, Daniel, subsequent to the one that had appeared to me earlier.
DAN.8.KJV: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
DAN.8.PLAIN: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar, a vision appeared to me, Daniel, subsequent to the one that had appeared to me earlier.

DAN.8.BSB: And in the vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa, in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision that I was beside the Ulai Canal.
DAN.8.KJV: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
DAN.8.PLAIN: And in the vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa, in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision that I was beside the Ulai Canal.

DAN.8.BSB: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a ram with two horns standing beside the canal. The horns were long, but one was longer than the other, and the longer one grew up later.
DAN.8.KJV: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
DAN.8.PLAIN: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw a ram with two horns standing beside the canal. The horns were long, but one was longer than the other, and the longer one grew up later.

DAN.8.BSB: I saw the ram charging toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against him, and there was no deliverance from his power. He did as he pleased and became great.
DAN.8.KJV: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
DAN.8.PLAIN: I saw the ram charging toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against him, and there was no deliverance from his power. He did as he pleased and became great.

DAN.8.BSB: As I was contemplating all this, suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between his eyes came out of the west, crossing the surface of the entire earth without touching the ground.
DAN.8.KJV: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
DAN.8.PLAIN: As I was contemplating all this, suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between his eyes came out of the west, crossing the surface of the entire earth without touching the ground.

DAN.8.BSB: He came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and rushed at him with furious power.
DAN.8.KJV: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran to him in the fury of his power.
DAN.8.PLAIN: He came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and rushed at him with furious power.

DAN.8.BSB: I saw him approach the ram in a rage against him, and he struck the ram and shattered his two horns. The ram was powerless to stand against him, and the goat threw him to the ground and trampled him, and no one could deliver the ram from his power.
DAN.8.KJV: And I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and broke his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped on him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
DAN.8.PLAIN: I saw him approach the ram in a rage against him, and he struck the ram and shattered his two horns. The ram was powerless to stand against him, and the goat threw him to the ground and trampled him, and no one could deliver the ram from his power.

DAN.8.BSB: Thus the goat became very great, but at the height of his power, his large horn was broken off, and four prominent horns came up in its place, pointing toward the four winds of heaven.
DAN.8.KJV: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
DAN.8.PLAIN: Thus the goat became very great, but at the height of his power, his large horn was broken off, and four prominent horns came up in its place, pointing toward the four winds of heaven.

DAN.8.BSB: From one of these horns a little horn emerged and grew extensively toward the south and the east and toward the Beautiful Land.
DAN.8.KJV: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
DAN.8.PLAIN: From one of these horns a little horn emerged and grew extensively toward the south and the east and toward the Beautiful Land.

DAN.8.BSB: It grew as high as the host of heaven, and it cast down some of the host and some of the stars to the earth, and trampled them.
DAN.8.KJV: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped on them.
DAN.8.PLAIN: It grew as high as the host of heaven, and it cast down some of the host and some of the stars to the earth, and trampled them.

DAN.8.BSB: It magnified itself, even to the Prince of the host; it removed His daily sacrifice and overthrew the place of His sanctuary.
DAN.8.KJV: Yes, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of the sanctuary was cast down.
DAN.8.PLAIN: It magnified itself, even to the Prince of the host; it removed His daily sacrifice and overthrew the place of His sanctuary.

DAN.8.BSB: And in the rebellion, the host and the daily sacrifice were given over to the horn, and it flung truth to the ground and prospered in whatever it did.
DAN.8.KJV: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practiced, and prospered. ¶
DAN.8.PLAIN: And in the rebellion, the host and the daily sacrifice were given over to the horn, and it flung truth to the ground and prospered in whatever it did.

DAN.8.BSB: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, “How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled?”
DAN.8.KJV: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said to that certain saint which spoke, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
DAN.8.PLAIN: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, “How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled?”

DAN.8.BSB: He said to me, “It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be properly restored.”
DAN.8.KJV: And he said to me, To two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed. ¶
DAN.8.PLAIN: He said to me, “It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be properly restored.”

DAN.8.BSB: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.
DAN.8.KJV: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
DAN.8.PLAIN: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.

DAN.8.BSB: And I heard the voice of a man calling from between the banks of the Ulai: “Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.”
DAN.8.KJV: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
DAN.8.PLAIN: And I heard the voice of a man calling from between the banks of the Ulai: “Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.”

DAN.8.BSB: As he came near to where I stood, I was terrified and fell facedown. “Son of man,” he said to me, “understand that the vision concerns the time of the end.”
DAN.8.KJV: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell on my face: but he said to me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
DAN.8.PLAIN: As he came near to where I stood, I was terrified and fell facedown. “Son of man,” he said to me, “understand that the vision concerns the time of the end.”

DAN.8.BSB: While he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep, with my face to the ground. Then he touched me, helped me to my feet,
DAN.8.KJV: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
DAN.8.PLAIN: While he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep, with my face to the ground. Then he touched me, helped me to my feet,

DAN.8.BSB: and said, “Behold, I will make known to you what will happen in the latter time of wrath, because it concerns the appointed time of the end.
DAN.8.KJV: And he said, Behold, I will make you know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
DAN.8.PLAIN: and said, “Look closely — I will make known to you what will happen in the latter time of wrath, because it concerns the appointed time of the end.

DAN.8.BSB: The two-horned ram that you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.
DAN.8.KJV: The ram which you saw having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
DAN.8.PLAIN: The two-horned ram that you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.

DAN.8.BSB: The shaggy goat represents the king of Greece, and the large horn between his eyes is the first king.
DAN.8.KJV: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
DAN.8.PLAIN: The shaggy goat represents the king of Greece, and the large horn between his eyes is the first king.

DAN.8.BSB: The four horns that replaced the broken one represent four kingdoms that will rise from that nation, but will not have the same power.
DAN.8.KJV: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
DAN.8.PLAIN: The four horns that replaced the broken one represent four kingdoms that will rise from that nation, but will not have the same power.

DAN.8.BSB: In the latter part of their reign, when the rebellion has reached its full measure, an insolent king, skilled in intrigue, will come to the throne.
DAN.8.KJV: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
DAN.8.PLAIN: In the latter part of their reign, when the rebellion has reached its full measure, an insolent king, skilled in intrigue, will come to the throne.

DAN.8.BSB: His power will be great, but it will not be his own. He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people.
DAN.8.KJV: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practice, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
DAN.8.PLAIN: His power will be great, but it will not be his own. He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people.

DAN.8.BSB: Through his craft and by his hand, he will cause deceit to prosper, and in his own mind he will make himself great. In a time of peace he will destroy many, and he will even stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be broken off, but not by human hands.
DAN.8.KJV: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
DAN.8.PLAIN: Through his craft and by his hand, he will cause deceit to prosper, and in his own mind he will make himself great. In a time of peace he will destroy many, and he will even stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be broken off, but not by human hands.

DAN.8.BSB: The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been spoken is true. Now you must seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future.”
DAN.8.KJV: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: why shut you up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
DAN.8.PLAIN: The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been spoken is true. Now you must seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future.”

DAN.8.BSB: I, Daniel, was exhausted and lay ill for days. Then I got up and went about the king’s business. I was confounded by the vision; it was beyond understanding.
DAN.8.KJV: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
DAN.8.PLAIN: I, Daniel, was exhausted and lay ill for days. Then I got up and went about the king’s business. I was confounded by the vision; it was beyond understanding.

DAN.9.BSB: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes, a Mede by descent, who was made ruler over the kingdom of the Chaldeans—
DAN.9.KJV: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
DAN.9.PLAIN: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes, a Mede by descent, who was made ruler over the kingdom of the Chaldeans—

DAN.9.BSB: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the sacred books, according to the word of the LORD to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.
DAN.9.KJV: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem. ¶
DAN.9.PLAIN: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the sacred books, according to the word of the Lord to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.

DAN.9.BSB: So I turned my attention to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
DAN.9.KJV: And I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
DAN.9.PLAIN: So I turned my attention to the Lord God to seek Him by prayer and petition, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.

DAN.9.BSB: And I prayed to the LORD my God and confessed, “O, Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps His covenant of loving devotion to those who love Him and keep His commandments,
DAN.9.KJV: And I prayed to the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
DAN.9.PLAIN: And I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed, “O, Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps His covenant of loving devotion to those who love Him and keep His commandments,

DAN.9.BSB: we have sinned and done wrong. We have acted wickedly and rebelled. We have turned away from Your commandments and ordinances.
DAN.9.KJV: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from your precepts and from your judgments:
DAN.9.PLAIN: we have sinned and done wrong. We have acted wickedly and rebelled. We have turned away from Your commandments and ordinances.

DAN.9.BSB: We have not listened to Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings, leaders, and fathers, and to all the people of the land.
DAN.9.KJV: Neither have we listened to your servants the prophets, which spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
DAN.9.PLAIN: We have not listened to Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings, leaders, and fathers, and to all the people of the land.

DAN.9.BSB: To You, O Lord, belongs righteousness, but this day we are covered with shame—the men of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, and all Israel near and far, in all the countries to which You have driven us because of our unfaithfulness to You.
DAN.9.KJV: O LORD, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.
DAN.9.PLAIN: To You, O Lord, belongs righteousness, but this day we are covered with shame—the men of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, and all Israel near and far, in all the countries to which You have driven us because of our unfaithfulness to You.

DAN.9.BSB: O LORD, we are covered with shame—our kings, our leaders, and our fathers—because we have sinned against You.
DAN.9.KJV: O Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
DAN.9.PLAIN: O Lord, we are covered with shame—our kings, our leaders, and our fathers—because we have sinned against You.

DAN.9.BSB: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
DAN.9.KJV: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
DAN.9.PLAIN: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him

DAN.9.BSB: and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God to walk in His laws, which He set before us through His servants the prophets.
DAN.9.KJV: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
DAN.9.PLAIN: and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God to walk in His laws, which He set before us through His servants the prophets.

DAN.9.BSB: All Israel has transgressed Your law and turned away, refusing to obey Your voice; so the oath and the curse written in the Law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, because we have sinned against You.
DAN.9.KJV: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, even by departing, that they might not obey your voice; therefore the curse is poured on us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
DAN.9.PLAIN: All Israel has transgressed Your law and turned away, refusing to obey Your voice; so the oath and the curse written in the Law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, because we have sinned against You.

DAN.9.BSB: You have carried out the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing upon us a great disaster. For under all of heaven, nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.
DAN.9.KJV: And he has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing on us a great evil: for under the whole heaven has not been done as has been done on Jerusalem.
DAN.9.PLAIN: You have carried out the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing upon us a great disaster. For under all of heaven, nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.

DAN.9.BSB: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us, yet we have not sought the favor of the LORD our God by turning from our iniquities and giving attention to Your truth.
DAN.9.KJV: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come on us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand your truth.
DAN.9.PLAIN: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us, yet we have not sought the favor of the Lord our God by turning from our iniquities and giving attention to Your truth.

DAN.9.BSB: Therefore the LORD has kept the calamity in store and brought it upon us. For the LORD our God is righteous in all He does; yet we have not obeyed His voice.
DAN.9.KJV: Therefore has the LORD watched on the evil, and brought it on us: for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he does: for we obeyed not his voice.
DAN.9.PLAIN: Therefore the Lord has kept the calamity in store and brought it upon us. For the Lord our God is righteous in all He does; yet we have not obeyed His voice.

DAN.9.BSB: Now, O Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and who made for Yourself a name renowned to this day, we have sinned; we have acted wickedly.
DAN.9.KJV: And now, O Lord our God, that have brought your people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten you renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly. ¶
DAN.9.PLAIN: Now, O Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and who made for Yourself a name renowned to this day, we have sinned; we have acted wickedly.

DAN.9.BSB: O Lord, in keeping with all Your righteous acts, I pray that Your anger and wrath may turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all around us.
DAN.9.KJV: O LORD, according to all your righteousness, I beseech you, let your anger and your fury be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
DAN.9.PLAIN: O Lord, in keeping with all Your righteous acts, I pray that Your anger and wrath may turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all around us.

DAN.9.BSB: So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.
DAN.9.KJV: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of your servant, and his supplications, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
DAN.9.PLAIN: So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.

DAN.9.BSB: Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.
DAN.9.KJV: O my God, incline your ear, and hear; open your eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by your name: for we do not present our supplications before you for our righteousnesses, but for your great mercies.
DAN.9.PLAIN: Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.

DAN.9.BSB: O Lord, listen! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, hear and act! For Your sake, O my God, do not delay, because Your city and Your people bear Your name.”
DAN.9.KJV: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, listen and do; defer not, for your own sake, O my God: for your city and your people are called by your name. ¶
DAN.9.PLAIN: O Lord, listen! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, hear and act! For Your sake, O my God, do not delay, because Your city and Your people bear Your name.”

DAN.9.BSB: While I was speaking, praying, confessing my sin and that of my people Israel, and presenting my petition before the LORD my God concerning His holy mountain—
DAN.9.KJV: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;
DAN.9.PLAIN: While I was speaking, praying, confessing my sin and that of my people Israel, and presenting my petition before the Lord my God concerning His holy mountain—

DAN.9.BSB: while I was still praying, Gabriel, the man I had seen in the earlier vision, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.
DAN.9.KJV: Yes, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
DAN.9.PLAIN: while I was still praying, Gabriel, the man I had seen in the earlier vision, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.

DAN.9.BSB: He instructed me and spoke with me, saying: “O Daniel, I have come now to give you insight and understanding.
DAN.9.KJV: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give you skill and understanding.
DAN.9.PLAIN: He instructed me and spoke with me, saying: “O Daniel, I have come now to give you insight and understanding.

DAN.9.BSB: At the beginning of your petitions, an answer went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are highly precious. So consider the message and understand the vision:
DAN.9.KJV: At the beginning of your supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to show you; for you are greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
DAN.9.PLAIN: At the beginning of your petitions, an answer went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are highly precious. So consider the message and understand the vision:

DAN.9.BSB: Seventy weeks are decreed for your people and your holy city to stop their transgression, to put an end to sin, to make atonement for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
DAN.9.KJV: Seventy weeks are determined on your people and on your holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
DAN.9.PLAIN: Seventy weeks are decreed for your people and your holy city to stop their transgression, to put an end to sin, to make atonement for brokenness, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.

DAN.9.BSB: Know and understand this: From the issuance of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem, until the Messiah, the Prince, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of distress.

DAN.11.KJV: Now when they shall fall, they shall be helped with a little help: but many shall join to them with flatteries.
DAN.11.PLAIN: Now when they fall, they will be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.

DAN.11.BSB: Some of the wise will fall, so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
DAN.11.KJV: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
DAN.11.PLAIN: Some of the wise will fall, so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.

DAN.11.BSB: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.
DAN.11.KJV: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvelous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
DAN.11.PLAIN: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.

DAN.11.BSB: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.
DAN.11.KJV: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
DAN.11.PLAIN: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.

DAN.11.BSB: And in their place, he will honor a god of fortresses—a god his fathers did not know—with gold, silver, precious stones, and riches.
DAN.11.KJV: But in his estate shall he honor the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honor with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
DAN.11.PLAIN: And in their place, he will honor a god of fortresses—a god his fathers did not know—with gold, silver, precious stones, and riches.

DAN.11.BSB: He will attack the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him, making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price.
DAN.11.KJV: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
DAN.11.PLAIN: He will attack the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him, making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price.

DAN.11.BSB: At the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood.
DAN.11.KJV: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
DAN.11.PLAIN: At the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood.

DAN.11.BSB: He will also invade the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall. But these will be delivered from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites.
DAN.11.KJV: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
DAN.11.PLAIN: He will also invade the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall. But these will be delivered from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites.

DAN.11.BSB: He will extend his power over many countries, and not even the land of Egypt will escape.
DAN.11.KJV: He shall stretch forth his hand also on the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
DAN.11.PLAIN: He will extend his power over many countries, and not even the land of Egypt will escape.

DAN.11.BSB: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
DAN.11.KJV: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
DAN.11.PLAIN: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.

DAN.11.BSB: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
DAN.11.KJV: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
DAN.11.PLAIN: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.

DAN.11.BSB: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.
DAN.11.KJV: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
DAN.11.PLAIN: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.

DAN.12.BSB: “At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.
DAN.12.KJV: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
DAN.12.PLAIN: “At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.

DAN.12.BSB: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.
DAN.12.KJV: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
DAN.12.PLAIN: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.

DAN.12.BSB: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
DAN.12.KJV: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
DAN.12.PLAIN: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.

DAN.12.BSB: But you, Daniel, shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase.”
DAN.12.KJV: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased. ¶
DAN.12.PLAIN: But you, Daniel, shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase.”

DAN.12.BSB: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing there, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.
DAN.12.KJV: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
DAN.12.PLAIN: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing there, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.

DAN.12.BSB: One of them said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?”
DAN.12.KJV: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was on the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
DAN.12.PLAIN: One of them said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?”

DAN.12.BSB: And the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever, saying, “It will be for a time, and times, and half a time. When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered, all these things will be completed.”
DAN.12.KJV: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was on the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him that lives for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
DAN.12.PLAIN: And the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever, saying, “It will be for a time, and times, and half a time. When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered, all these things will be completed.”

DAN.12.BSB: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
DAN.12.KJV: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
DAN.12.PLAIN: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”

DAN.12.BSB: “Go on your way, Daniel,” he replied, “for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
DAN.12.KJV: And he said, Go your way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
DAN.12.PLAIN: “Go on your way, Daniel,” he replied, “for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.

DAN.12.BSB: Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.
DAN.12.KJV: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
DAN.12.PLAIN: Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.

DAN.12.BSB: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.
DAN.12.KJV: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
DAN.12.PLAIN: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.

DAN.12.BSB: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.
DAN.12.KJV: Blessed is he that waits, and comes to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
DAN.12.PLAIN: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.

DAN.12.BSB: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”
DAN.12.KJV: But go you your way till the end be: for you shall rest, and stand in your lot at the end of the days.
DAN.12.PLAIN: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”

HOS.1.BSB: This is the word of the LORD that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and of Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel.
HOS.1.KJV: The word of the LORD that came to Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
HOS.1.PLAIN: This is the word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and of Jeroboam son of Jehoash, king of Israel.

HOS.1.BSB: When the LORD first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.”
HOS.1.KJV: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take to you a wife of prostitutions and children of prostitutions: for the land has committed great prostitution, departing from the LORD.
HOS.1.PLAIN: When the Lord first spoke through Hosea, He told him, “Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the Lord.”

HOS.1.BSB: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.
HOS.1.KJV: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bore him a son.
HOS.1.PLAIN: So Hosea went and married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

HOS.1.BSB: Then the LORD said to Hosea, “Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
HOS.1.KJV: And the LORD said to him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
HOS.1.PLAIN: Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

HOS.1.BSB: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.”
HOS.1.KJV: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel, in the valley of Jezreel. ¶
HOS.1.PLAIN: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.”

HOS.1.BSB: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter, and the LORD said to Hosea, “Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.
HOS.1.KJV: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And God said to him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy on the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
HOS.1.PLAIN: Gomer again conceived and gave birth to a daughter, and the Lord said to Hosea, “Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.

HOS.1.BSB: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them—not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the LORD their God.”
HOS.1.KJV: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen. ¶
HOS.1.PLAIN: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them—not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the Lord their God.”

HOS.1.BSB: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.
HOS.1.KJV: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
HOS.1.PLAIN: After she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, Gomer conceived and gave birth to a son.

HOS.1.BSB: And the LORD said, “Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.
HOS.1.KJV: Then said God, Call his name Loammi: for you are not my people, and I will not be your God. ¶
HOS.1.PLAIN: And the Lord said, “Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.

HOS.1.BSB: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
HOS.1.KJV: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, there it shall be said to them, You are the sons of the living God.
HOS.1.PLAIN: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

HOS.1.BSB: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
HOS.1.KJV: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
HOS.1.PLAIN: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.

HOS.2.BSB: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
HOS.2.KJV: Say you to your brothers, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
HOS.2.PLAIN: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’

HOS.2.BSB: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
HOS.2.KJV: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her prostitutions out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
HOS.2.PLAIN: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

HOS.2.BSB: Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land, and I will let her die of thirst.
HOS.2.KJV: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
HOS.2.PLAIN: Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land, and I will let her die of thirst.

HOS.2.BSB: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
HOS.2.KJV: And I will not have mercy on her children; for they be the children of prostitutions.
HOS.2.PLAIN: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.

HOS.2.BSB: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’
HOS.2.KJV: For their mother has played the harlot: she that conceived them has done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink. ¶
HOS.2.PLAIN: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’

HOS.2.BSB: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.
HOS.2.KJV: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
HOS.2.PLAIN: Therefore, look closely — I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.

HOS.2.BSB: She will pursue her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will return to my first husband, for then I was better off than now.’
HOS.2.KJV: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
HOS.2.PLAIN: She will pursue her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will return to my first husband, for then I was better off than now.’
