MIC.7.BSB: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
MIC.7.KJV: He will turn again, he will have compassion on us; he will subdue our iniquities; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
MIC.7.PLAIN: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.

MIC.7.BSB: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
MIC.7.KJV: You will perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
MIC.7.PLAIN: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.

NAM.1.BSB: This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:
NAM.1.KJV: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
NAM.1.PLAIN: This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:

NAM.1.BSB: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
NAM.1.KJV: God is jealous, and the LORD revenges; the LORD revenges, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserves wrath for his enemies.
NAM.1.PLAIN: The Lord is a jealous and avenging God; the Lord is avenging and full of wrath. The Lord takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.

NAM.1.BSB: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
NAM.1.KJV: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
NAM.1.PLAIN: The Lord is slow to anger and great in power; the Lord will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.

NAM.1.BSB: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
NAM.1.KJV: He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers: Bashan languishes, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languishes.
NAM.1.PLAIN: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.

NAM.1.BSB: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.
NAM.1.KJV: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yes, the world, and all that dwell therein.
NAM.1.PLAIN: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence— the world and all its dwellers.

NAM.1.BSB: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
NAM.1.KJV: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
NAM.1.PLAIN: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.

NAM.1.BSB: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
NAM.1.KJV: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knows them that trust in him.
NAM.1.PLAIN: The Lord is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; he knows those who take refuge in him.

NAM.1.BSB: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end of Nineveh and pursue His enemies into darkness.
NAM.1.KJV: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
NAM.1.PLAIN: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end of Nineveh and pursue His enemies into darkness.

NAM.1.BSB: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
NAM.1.KJV: What do you imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
NAM.1.PLAIN: Whatever you plot against the Lord, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.

NAM.1.BSB: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard— like stubble that is fully dry.
NAM.1.KJV: For while they be entwined together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
NAM.1.PLAIN: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard— like stubble that is fully dry.

NAM.1.BSB: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.
NAM.1.KJV: There is one come out of you, that imagines evil against the LORD, a wicked counselor.
NAM.1.PLAIN: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the Lord, a counselor of wickedness.

NAM.1.BSB: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
NAM.1.KJV: Thus says the LORD; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
NAM.1.PLAIN: This is what the Lord says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.

NAM.1.BSB: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.”
NAM.1.KJV: For now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds in sunder.
NAM.1.PLAIN: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.”

NAM.1.BSB: The LORD has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”
NAM.1.KJV: And the LORD has given a commandment concerning you, that no more of your name be sown: out of the house of your gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make your grave; for you are vile.
NAM.1.PLAIN: The Lord has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”

NAM.1.BSB: Look to the mountains— the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked will never again march through you; they will be utterly cut off.
NAM.1.KJV: Behold on the mountains the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publishes peace! O Judah, keep your solemn feasts, perform your vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through you; he is utterly cut off.
NAM.1.PLAIN: Look to the mountains— the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked will never again march through you; they will be utterly cut off.

NAM.2.BSB: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!
NAM.2.KJV: He that dashes in pieces is come up before your face: keep the fortification, watch the way, make your loins strong, fortify your power mightily.
NAM.2.PLAIN: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!

NAM.2.BSB: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.
NAM.2.KJV: For the LORD has turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
NAM.2.PLAIN: For the Lord will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.

NAM.2.BSB: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet. The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared, and the spears of cypress have been brandished.
NAM.2.KJV: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
NAM.2.PLAIN: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet. The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared, and the spears of cypress have been brandished.

NAM.2.BSB: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.
NAM.2.KJV: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall jostle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightning.
NAM.2.PLAIN: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.

NAM.2.BSB: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.
NAM.2.KJV: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defense shall be prepared.
NAM.2.PLAIN: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.

NAM.2.BSB: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
NAM.2.KJV: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
NAM.2.PLAIN: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

NAM.2.BSB: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.
NAM.2.KJV: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.
NAM.2.PLAIN: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.

NAM.2.BSB: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
NAM.2.KJV: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
NAM.2.PLAIN: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.

NAM.2.BSB: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
NAM.2.KJV: Take you the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
NAM.2.PLAIN: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.

NAM.2.BSB: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!
NAM.2.KJV: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melts, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
NAM.2.PLAIN: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!

NAM.2.BSB: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?
NAM.2.KJV: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion’s whelp, and none made them afraid?
NAM.2.PLAIN: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?

NAM.2.BSB: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness. It filled its dens with the kill, and its lairs with mauled prey.
NAM.2.KJV: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with shred.
NAM.2.PLAIN: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness. It filled its dens with the kill, and its lairs with mauled prey.

NAM.2.BSB: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
NAM.2.KJV: Behold, I am against you, says the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions: and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no more be heard.
NAM.2.PLAIN: “Look closely — I am against you,” declares the Lord of Hosts. “I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

NAM.3.BSB: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without prey.
NAM.3.KJV: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departs not;
NAM.3.PLAIN: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without prey.

NAM.3.BSB: The crack of the whip, the rumble of the wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
NAM.3.KJV: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the prancing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
NAM.3.PLAIN: The crack of the whip, the rumble of the wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!

NAM.3.BSB: Charging horseman, flashing sword, shining spear; heaps of slain, mounds of corpses, dead bodies without end— they stumble over their dead—
NAM.3.KJV: The horseman lifts up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcasses; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble on their corpses:
NAM.3.PLAIN: Charging horseman, flashing sword, shining spear; heaps of slain, mounds of corpses, dead bodies without end— they stumble over their dead—

NAM.3.BSB: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.
NAM.3.KJV: Because of the multitude of the prostitutions of the well favored harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that sells nations through her prostitutions, and families through her witchcrafts.
NAM.3.PLAIN: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.

NAM.3.BSB: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
NAM.3.KJV: Behold, I am against you, says the LORD of hosts; and I will discover your skirts on your face, and I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
NAM.3.PLAIN: “Look closely — I am against you,” declares the Lord of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.

NAM.3.BSB: I will pelt you with filth and treat you with contempt; I will make a spectacle of you.
NAM.3.KJV: And I will cast abominable filth on you, and make you vile, and will set you as a spectacle.
NAM.3.PLAIN: I will pelt you with filth and treat you with contempt; I will make a spectacle of you.

NAM.3.BSB: Then all who see you will recoil from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated; who will grieve for her?’ Where can I find comforters for you?”
NAM.3.KJV: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look on you shall flee from you, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? from where shall I seek comforters for you?
NAM.3.PLAIN: Then all who see you will recoil from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated; who will grieve for her?’ Where can I find comforters for you?”

NAM.3.BSB: Are you better than Thebes, stationed by the Nile with water around her, whose rampart was the sea, whose wall was the water?
NAM.3.KJV: Are you better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
NAM.3.PLAIN: Are you better than Thebes, stationed by the Nile with water around her, whose rampart was the sea, whose wall was the water?

NAM.3.BSB: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were her allies.
NAM.3.KJV: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were your helpers.
NAM.3.PLAIN: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were her allies.

NAM.3.BSB: Yet she became an exile; she went into captivity. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her dignitaries, and all her nobles were bound in chains.
NAM.3.KJV: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
NAM.3.PLAIN: Yet she became an exile; she went into captivity. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her dignitaries, and all her nobles were bound in chains.

NAM.3.BSB: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.
NAM.3.KJV: You also shall be drunken: you shall be hid, you also shall seek strength because of the enemy.
NAM.3.PLAIN: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.

NAM.3.BSB: All your fortresses are fig trees with the first ripe figs; when shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater!
NAM.3.KJV: All your strong holds shall be like fig trees with the first ripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
NAM.3.PLAIN: All your fortresses are fig trees with the first ripe figs; when shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater!

NAM.3.BSB: Look at your troops— they are like your women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire consumes their bars.
NAM.3.KJV: Behold, your people in the middle of you are women: the gates of your land shall be set wide open to your enemies: the fire shall devour your bars.
NAM.3.PLAIN: Look at your troops— they are like your women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire consumes their bars.

NAM.3.BSB: Draw your water for the siege; strengthen your fortresses. Work the clay and tread the mortar; repair the brick kiln!
NAM.3.KJV: Draw you waters for the siege, fortify your strong holds: go into clay, and tread the mortar, make strong the brick kiln.
NAM.3.PLAIN: Draw your water for the siege; strengthen your fortresses. Work the clay and tread the mortar; repair the brick kiln!

NAM.3.BSB: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and consume you like a young locust. Make yourself many like the young locust; make yourself many like the swarming locust!
NAM.3.KJV: There shall the fire devour you; the sword shall cut you off, it shall eat you up like the cankerworm: make yourself many as the cankerworm, make yourself many as the locusts.
NAM.3.PLAIN: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and consume you like a young locust. Make yourself many like the young locust; make yourself many like the swarming locust!

NAM.3.BSB: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of the sky. The young locust strips the land and flies away.
NAM.3.KJV: You have multiplied your merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoils, and flees away.
NAM.3.PLAIN: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of the sky. The young locust strips the land and flies away.

NAM.3.BSB: Your guards are like the swarming locust, and your scribes like clouds of locusts that settle on the walls on a cold day. When the sun rises, they fly away, and no one knows where.
NAM.3.KJV: Your crowned are as the locusts, and your captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun rises they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
NAM.3.PLAIN: Your guards are like the swarming locust, and your scribes like clouds of locusts that settle on the walls on a cold day. When the sun rises, they fly away, and no one knows where.

NAM.3.BSB: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
NAM.3.KJV: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: your nobles shall dwell in the dust: your people is scattered on the mountains, and no man gathers them.
NAM.3.PLAIN: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.

NAM.3.BSB: There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?
NAM.3.KJV: There is no healing of your bruise; your wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of you shall clap the hands over you: for on whom has not your wickedness passed continually?
NAM.3.PLAIN: There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?

HAB.1.BSB: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:
HAB.1.KJV: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
HAB.1.PLAIN: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:

HAB.1.BSB: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
HAB.1.KJV: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and you will not hear! even cry out to you of violence, and you will not save!
HAB.1.PLAIN: How long, O Lord, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?

HAB.1.BSB: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.
HAB.1.KJV: Why do you show me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
HAB.1.PLAIN: Why do You make me see brokenness? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.

HAB.1.BSB: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
HAB.1.KJV: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment does never go forth: for the wicked does compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceeds. ¶
HAB.1.PLAIN: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

HAB.1.BSB: “Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.
HAB.1.KJV: Behold you among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvelously: for I will work a work in your days which you will not believe, though it be told you.
HAB.1.PLAIN: “Look at the nations and observe— be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.

HAB.1.BSB: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans— that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
HAB.1.KJV: For, see, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwelling places that are not theirs.
HAB.1.PLAIN: For look closely — I am raising up the Chaldeans— that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.

HAB.1.BSB: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.
HAB.1.KJV: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
HAB.1.PLAIN: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.

HAB.1.BSB: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
HAB.1.KJV: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hastens to eat.
HAB.1.PLAIN: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.

HAB.1.BSB: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.
HAB.1.KJV: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
HAB.1.PLAIN: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.

HAB.1.BSB: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.
HAB.1.KJV: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn to them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
HAB.1.PLAIN: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.

HAB.1.BSB: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”
HAB.1.KJV: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power to his god. ¶
HAB.1.PLAIN: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”

HAB.1.BSB: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
HAB.1.KJV: Are you not from everlasting, O LORD my God, my Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, you have ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, you have established them for correction.
HAB.1.PLAIN: Are You not from everlasting, O Lord, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O Lord, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.

HAB.1.BSB: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
HAB.1.KJV: You are of purer eyes than to behold evil, and can not look on iniquity: why look you on them that deal treacherously, and hold your tongue when the wicked devours the man that is more righteous than he?
HAB.1.PLAIN: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

HAB.1.BSB: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
HAB.1.KJV: And make men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
HAB.1.PLAIN: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.

HAB.1.BSB: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.
HAB.1.KJV: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
HAB.1.PLAIN: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.

HAB.1.BSB: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.
HAB.1.KJV: Therefore they sacrifice to their net, and burn incense to their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
HAB.1.PLAIN: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.

HAB.1.BSB: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?
HAB.1.KJV: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
HAB.1.PLAIN: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?

HAB.2.BSB: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and how I should answer when corrected.
HAB.2.KJV: I will stand on my watch, and set me on the tower, and will watch to see what he will say to me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
HAB.2.PLAIN: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and how I should answer when corrected.

HAB.2.BSB: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
HAB.2.KJV: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain on tables, that he may run that reads it.
HAB.2.PLAIN: Then the Lord answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.

HAB.2.BSB: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
HAB.2.KJV: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
HAB.2.PLAIN: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.

HAB.2.BSB: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright— but the righteous will live by faith—
HAB.2.KJV: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith. ¶
HAB.2.PLAIN: See, the enemy is puffed up; his desires are not upright — but the righteous person will live by his faithfulness.

HAB.2.BSB: and wealth indeed betrays him. He is an arrogant man never at rest. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, and like Death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own.
HAB.2.KJV: Yes also, because he transgresses by wine, he is a proud man, neither keeps at home, who enlarges his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathers to him all nations, and heaps to him all people:
HAB.2.PLAIN: and wealth indeed betrays him. He is an arrogant man never at rest. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, and like Death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own.

HAB.2.BSB: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision: ‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans! How long will this go on?’
HAB.2.KJV: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increases that which is not his! how long? and to him that lades himself with thick clay!
HAB.2.PLAIN: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision: ‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans! How long will this go on?’

HAB.2.BSB: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken? Then you will become their prey.
HAB.2.KJV: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite you, and awake that shall vex you, and you shall be for booties to them?
HAB.2.PLAIN: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken? Then you will become their prey.

HAB.2.BSB: Because you have plundered many nations, the remnant of the people will plunder you— because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
HAB.2.KJV: Because you have spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil you; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein. ¶
HAB.2.PLAIN: Because you have plundered many nations, the remnant of the people will plunder you— because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.

HAB.2.BSB: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
HAB.2.KJV: Woe to him that covets an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
HAB.2.PLAIN: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!

HAB.2.BSB: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life.
HAB.2.KJV: You have consulted shame to your house by cutting off many people, and have sinned against your soul.
HAB.2.PLAIN: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life.

HAB.2.BSB: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.
HAB.2.KJV: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it. ¶
HAB.2.PLAIN: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.

HAB.2.BSB: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity!
HAB.2.KJV: Woe to him that builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!
HAB.2.PLAIN: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by brokenness!

HAB.2.BSB: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
HAB.2.KJV: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labor in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
HAB.2.PLAIN: Is it not indeed from the Lord of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?

HAB.2.BSB: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
HAB.2.KJV: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea. ¶
HAB.2.PLAIN: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.

HAB.2.BSB: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk, in order to gaze at their nakedness!
HAB.2.KJV: Woe to him that gives his neighbor drink, that put your bottle to him, and make him drunken also, that you may look on their nakedness!
HAB.2.PLAIN: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk, in order to gaze at their nakedness!

HAB.2.BSB: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
HAB.2.KJV: You are filled with shame for glory: drink you also, and let your foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’s right hand shall be turned to you, and shameful spewing shall be on your glory.
HAB.2.PLAIN: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the Lord’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.

HAB.2.BSB: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of animals will terrify you, because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
HAB.2.KJV: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover you, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein. ¶
HAB.2.PLAIN: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of animals will terrify you, because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.

HAB.2.BSB: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
HAB.2.KJV: What profits the graven image that the maker thereof has graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusts therein, to make dumb idols?
HAB.2.PLAIN: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

HAB.2.BSB: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”
HAB.2.KJV: Woe to him that says to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the middle of it.
HAB.2.PLAIN: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Look closely — it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”

HAB.2.BSB: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
HAB.2.KJV: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
HAB.2.PLAIN: But the Lord is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.

HAB.3.BSB: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:
HAB.3.KJV: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet on Shigionoth.
HAB.3.PLAIN: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:

HAB.3.BSB: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
HAB.3.KJV: O LORD, I have heard your speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive your work in the middle of the years, in the middle of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
HAB.3.PLAIN: O Lord, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O Lord, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!

HAB.3.BSB: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
HAB.3.KJV: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
HAB.3.PLAIN: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.

HAB.3.BSB: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.
HAB.3.KJV: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
HAB.3.PLAIN: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.

HAB.3.BSB: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
HAB.3.KJV: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
HAB.3.PLAIN: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.

HAB.3.BSB: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
HAB.3.KJV: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
HAB.3.PLAIN: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.

HAB.3.BSB: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.
HAB.3.KJV: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
HAB.3.PLAIN: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.

HAB.3.BSB: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
HAB.3.KJV: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was your anger against the rivers? was your wrath against the sea, that you did ride on your horses and your chariots of salvation?
HAB.3.PLAIN: Were You angry at the rivers, O Lord? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?

HAB.3.BSB: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
HAB.3.KJV: Your bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even your word. Selah. You did split the earth with rivers.
HAB.3.PLAIN: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.

HAB.3.BSB: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
HAB.3.KJV: The mountains saw you, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
HAB.3.PLAIN: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.

HAB.3.BSB: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
HAB.3.KJV: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of your arrows they went, and at the shining of your glittering spear.
HAB.3.PLAIN: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.

HAB.3.BSB: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
HAB.3.KJV: You did march through the land in indignation, you did thresh the heathen in anger.
HAB.3.PLAIN: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.

HAB.3.BSB: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah
HAB.3.KJV: You went forth for the salvation of your people, even for salvation with your anointed; you wounded the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation to the neck. Selah.
HAB.3.PLAIN: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah

HAB.3.BSB: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
HAB.3.KJV: You did strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
HAB.3.PLAIN: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.

HAB.3.BSB: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
HAB.3.KJV: You did walk through the sea with your horses, through the heap of great waters.
HAB.3.PLAIN: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.

HAB.3.BSB: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.
HAB.3.KJV: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he comes up to the people, he will invade them with his troops. ¶
HAB.3.PLAIN: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.

HAB.3.BSB: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
HAB.3.KJV: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
HAB.3.PLAIN: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,

HAB.3.BSB: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
HAB.3.KJV: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
HAB.3.PLAIN: yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will be joyful in God my Savior.

HAB.3.BSB: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
HAB.3.KJV: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk on my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
HAB.3.PLAIN: The Sovereign Lord is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, and enables me to tread on the heights.

ZEP.1.BSB: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
ZEP.1.KJV: The word of the LORD which came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: This is the word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

ZEP.1.BSB: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
ZEP.1.KJV: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, says the LORD.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the Lord.

ZEP.1.BSB: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
ZEP.1.KJV: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked: and I will cut off man from off the land, says the LORD.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the Lord.

ZEP.1.BSB: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—
ZEP.1.KJV: I will also stretch out my hand on Judah, and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
ZEP.1.PLAIN: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—

ZEP.1.BSB: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,
ZEP.1.KJV: And them that worship the host of heaven on the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;
ZEP.1.PLAIN: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the Lord but also swear by Milcom,

ZEP.1.BSB: and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.”
ZEP.1.KJV: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor inquired for him.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: and those who turn back from following the Lord, neither seeking the Lord nor inquiring of Him.”

ZEP.1.BSB: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
ZEP.1.KJV: Hold your peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD has prepared a sacrifice, he has bid his guests.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the Lord is near. Indeed, the Lord has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.

ZEP.1.BSB: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
ZEP.1.KJV: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: “On the Day of the Lord’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.

ZEP.1.BSB: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
ZEP.1.KJV: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.

ZEP.1.BSB: On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
ZEP.1.KJV: And it shall come to pass in that day, says the LORD, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: On that day,” declares the Lord, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.

ZEP.1.BSB: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
ZEP.1.KJV: Howl, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.

ZEP.1.BSB: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
ZEP.1.KJV: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The Lord will do nothing, either good or bad.’

ZEP.1.BSB: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
ZEP.1.KJV: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.

ZEP.1.BSB: The great Day of the LORD is near— near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
ZEP.1.KJV: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hastens greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: The great Day of the Lord is near— near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the Lord! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.

ZEP.1.BSB: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
ZEP.1.KJV: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of devastation and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
ZEP.1.PLAIN: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

ZEP.1.BSB: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.
ZEP.1.KJV: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.

ZEP.1.BSB: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
ZEP.1.KJV: And I will bring distress on men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the Lord. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.

ZEP.1.BSB: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
ZEP.1.KJV: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
ZEP.1.PLAIN: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the Lord’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.

ZEP.2.BSB: Gather yourselves, gather together, O shameful nation,
ZEP.2.KJV: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, O nation not desired;
ZEP.2.PLAIN: Gather yourselves, gather together, O shameful nation,

ZEP.2.BSB: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you.
ZEP.2.KJV: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come on you, before the day of the LORD’s anger come on you.
ZEP.2.PLAIN: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of the Lord comes upon you, before the Day of the Lord’s anger comes upon you.

ZEP.2.BSB: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger.
ZEP.2.KJV: Seek you the LORD, all you meek of the earth, which have worked his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be you shall be hid in the day of the LORD’s anger. ¶
ZEP.2.PLAIN: Seek the Lord, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the Lord’s anger.

ZEP.2.BSB: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
ZEP.2.KJV: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
ZEP.2.PLAIN: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.

ZEP.2.BSB: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”
ZEP.2.KJV: Woe to the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy you, that there shall be no inhabitant.

ZEC.9.PLAIN: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

ZEC.9.BSB: As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.

ZEC.9.BSB: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; even today I declare that I will restore to you double.
