MAL.1.KJV: But cursed be the deceiver, which has in his flock a male, and vows, and sacrifices to the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, says the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
MAL.1.PLAIN: “But cursed is the deceiver who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but sacrifices a defective animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,” says the Lord of Hosts, “and My name is to be feared among the nations.

MAL.2.BSB: “And now this decree is for you, O priests:
MAL.2.KJV: And now, O you priests, this commandment is for you.
MAL.2.PLAIN: “And now this decree is for you, O priests:

MAL.2.BSB: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the LORD of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.
MAL.2.KJV: If you will not hear, and if you will not lay it to heart, to give glory to my name, says the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse on you, and I will curse your blessings: yes, I have cursed them already, because you do not lay it to heart.
MAL.2.PLAIN: If you do not listen, and if you do not take it to heart to honor My name,” says the Lord of Hosts, “I will send a curse among you, and I will curse your blessings. Yes, I have already begun to curse them, because you are not taking it to heart.

MAL.2.BSB: Behold, I will rebuke your descendants, and I will spread dung on your faces, the waste from your feasts, and you will be carried off with it.
MAL.2.KJV: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.
MAL.2.PLAIN: Look closely — I will rebuke your descendants, and I will spread dung on your faces, the waste from your feasts, and you will be carried off with it.

MAL.2.BSB: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.2.KJV: And you shall know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant might be with Levi, says the LORD of hosts.
MAL.2.PLAIN: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.2.BSB: “My covenant with him was one of life and peace, which I gave to him; it called for reverence, and he revered Me and stood in awe of My name.
MAL.2.KJV: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear with which he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
MAL.2.PLAIN: “My covenant with him was one of life and peace, which I gave to him; it called for reverence, and he revered Me and stood in awe of My name.

MAL.2.BSB: True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from iniquity.
MAL.2.KJV: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
MAL.2.PLAIN: True instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, and he turned many from brokenness.

MAL.2.BSB: For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.2.KJV: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.
MAL.2.PLAIN: For the lips of a priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.2.BSB: But you have departed from the way, and your instruction has caused many to stumble. You have violated the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.2.KJV: But you are departed out of the way; you have caused many to stumble at the law; you have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says the LORD of hosts.
MAL.2.PLAIN: But you have departed from the way, and your instruction has caused many to stumble. You have violated the covenant of Levi,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.2.BSB: “So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.”
MAL.2.KJV: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as you have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
MAL.2.PLAIN: “So I in turn have made you despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not kept My ways, but have shown partiality in matters of the law.”

MAL.2.BSB: Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us? Why then do we break faith with one another so as to profane the covenant of our fathers?
MAL.2.KJV: Have we not all one father? has not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers? ¶
MAL.2.PLAIN: Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us? Why then do we break faith with one another so as to profane the covenant of our fathers?

MAL.2.BSB: Judah has broken faith; an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem. For Judah has profaned the LORD’s beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.
MAL.2.KJV: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved, and has married the daughter of a strange god.
MAL.2.PLAIN: Judah has broken faith; an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem. For Judah has profaned the Lord’s beloved sanctuary by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.

MAL.2.BSB: As for the man who does this, may the LORD cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware—even if he brings an offering to the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.2.KJV: The LORD will cut off the man that does this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offers an offering to the LORD of hosts.
MAL.2.PLAIN: As for the man who does this, may the Lord cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware—even if he brings an offering to the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.2.BSB: And this is another thing you do: You cover the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping and groaning, because He no longer regards your offerings or receives them gladly from your hands.
MAL.2.KJV: And this have you done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, so that he regards not the offering any more, or receives it with good will at your hand. ¶
MAL.2.PLAIN: And this is another thing you do: You cover the altar of the Lord with tears, with weeping and groaning, because He no longer regards your offerings or receives them gladly from your hands.

MAL.2.BSB: Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the LORD has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.
MAL.2.KJV: Yet you say, Why? Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously: yet is she your companion, and the wife of your covenant.
MAL.2.PLAIN: Yet you ask, “Why?” It is because the Lord has been a witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have broken faith, though she is your companion and your wife by covenant.

MAL.2.BSB: Has not the LORD made them one, having a portion of the Spirit? And why one? Because He seeks godly offspring. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith with the wife of your youth.
MAL.2.KJV: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And why one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
MAL.2.PLAIN: Has not the Lord made them one, having a portion of the Spirit? And why one? Because He seeks godly offspring. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith with the wife of your youth.

MAL.2.BSB: “For I hate divorce,” says the LORD, the God of Israel. “He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,” says the LORD of Hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.
MAL.2.KJV: For the LORD, the God of Israel, says that he hates putting away: for one covers violence with his garment, says the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that you deal not treacherously. ¶
MAL.2.PLAIN: “For I hate divorce,” says the Lord, the God of Israel. “He who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence,” says the Lord of Hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.

MAL.2.BSB: You have wearied the LORD with your words; yet you ask, “How have we wearied Him?” By saying, “All who do evil are good in the sight of the LORD, and in them He delights,” or, “Where is the God of justice?”
MAL.2.KJV: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, Wherein have we wearied him? When you say, Every one that does evil is good in the sight of the LORD, and he delights in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?
MAL.2.PLAIN: You have wearied the Lord with your words; yet you ask, “How have we wearied Him?” By saying, “All who do evil are good in the sight of the Lord, and in them He delights,” or, “Where is the God of justice?”

MAL.3.BSB: “Behold, I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.3.KJV: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the LORD, whom you seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom you delight in: behold, he shall come, says the LORD of hosts.
MAL.3.PLAIN: “Look closely — I will send My messenger, who will prepare the way before Me. Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple—the Messenger of the covenant, in whom you delight—see, He is coming,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.3.BSB: But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refiner’s fire, like a launderer’s soap.
MAL.3.KJV: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appears? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:
MAL.3.PLAIN: But who can endure the day of His coming? And who can stand when He appears? For He will be like a refiner’s fire, like a launderer’s soap.

MAL.3.BSB: And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
MAL.3.KJV: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer to the LORD an offering in righteousness.
MAL.3.PLAIN: And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the Lord in righteousness.

MAL.3.BSB: Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD, as in days of old and years gone by.
MAL.3.KJV: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant to the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.
MAL.3.PLAIN: Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the Lord, as in days of old and years gone by.

MAL.3.BSB: “Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.3.KJV: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, says the LORD of hosts.
MAL.3.PLAIN: “Then I will draw near to you for judgment. And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.3.BSB: “Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
MAL.3.KJV: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore you sons of Jacob are not consumed. ¶
MAL.3.PLAIN: I the Lord do not change. So you, the descendants of Jacob, are not destroyed.

MAL.3.BSB: Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Hosts. “But you ask, ‘How can we return?’
MAL.3.KJV: Even from the days of your fathers you are gone away from my ordinances, and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you, says the LORD of hosts. But you said, Wherein shall we return? ¶
MAL.3.PLAIN: Yet from the days of your fathers, you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the Lord of Hosts. “But you ask, ‘How can we return?’

MAL.3.BSB: Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’ In tithes and offerings.
MAL.3.KJV: Will a man rob God? Yet you have robbed me. But you say, Wherein have we robbed you? In tithes and offerings.
MAL.3.PLAIN: Will a man rob God? Yet you are robbing Me! But you ask, ‘How do we rob You?’ In tithes and offerings.

MAL.3.BSB: You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.
MAL.3.KJV: You are cursed with a curse: for you have robbed me, even this whole nation.
MAL.3.PLAIN: You are cursed with a curse, yet you—the whole nation—are still robbing Me.

MAL.3.BSB: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, so that there may be food in My house. Test Me in this,” says the LORD of Hosts. “See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing without measure.
MAL.3.KJV: Bring you all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in my house, and prove me now herewith, says the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
MAL.3.PLAIN: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house. Test me in this, says the Lord Almighty, and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.

MAL.3.BSB: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.3.KJV: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, says the LORD of hosts.
MAL.3.PLAIN: I will rebuke the devourer for you, so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land, and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.3.BSB: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.3.KJV: And all nations shall call you blessed: for you shall be a delightsome land, says the LORD of hosts. ¶
MAL.3.PLAIN: “Then all the nations will call you blessed, for you will be a land of delight,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.3.BSB: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the LORD. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’
MAL.3.KJV: Your words have been stout against me, says the LORD. Yet you say, What have we spoken so much against you?
MAL.3.PLAIN: “Your words against Me have been harsh,” says the Lord. “Yet you ask, ‘What have we spoken against You?’

MAL.3.BSB: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts?
MAL.3.KJV: You have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?
MAL.3.PLAIN: You have said, ‘It is futile to serve God. What have we gained by keeping His requirements and walking mournfully before the Lord of Hosts?

MAL.3.BSB: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”
MAL.3.KJV: And now we call the proud happy; yes, they that work wickedness are set up; yes, they that tempt God are even delivered. ¶
MAL.3.PLAIN: So now we call the arrogant blessed. Not only do evildoers prosper, they even test God and escape.’”

MAL.3.BSB: At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one another, and the LORD listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
MAL.3.KJV: Then they that feared the LORD spoke often one to another: and the LORD listened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought on his name.
MAL.3.PLAIN: At that time those who feared the Lord spoke with one another, and the Lord listened and heard them. So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the Lord and honored His name.

MAL.3.BSB: “They will be Mine,” says the LORD of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.
MAL.3.KJV: And they shall be mine, says the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spares his own son that serves him.
MAL.3.PLAIN: “They will be Mine,” says the Lord of Hosts, “on the day when I prepare My treasured possession. And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him.

MAL.3.BSB: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”
MAL.3.KJV: Then shall you return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serves God and him that serves him not.
MAL.3.PLAIN: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those who serve God and those who do not.”

MAL.4.BSB: “For behold, the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the LORD of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”
MAL.4.KJV: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yes, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch. ¶
MAL.4.PLAIN: “For look closely — the day is coming, burning like a furnace, when all the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble; the day is coming when I will set them ablaze,” says the Lord of Hosts. “Not a root or branch will be left to them.”

MAL.4.BSB: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.
MAL.4.KJV: But to you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and you shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
MAL.4.PLAIN: “But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.

MAL.4.BSB: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
MAL.4.KJV: And you shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, says the LORD of hosts. ¶
MAL.4.PLAIN: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the Lord of Hosts.

MAL.4.BSB: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.
MAL.4.KJV: Remember you the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments. ¶
MAL.4.PLAIN: “Remember the law of My servant Moses, the statutes and ordinances I commanded him for all Israel at Horeb.

MAL.4.BSB: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
MAL.4.KJV: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:
MAL.4.PLAIN: Look closely — I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the Lord.

MAL.4.BSB: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.”
MAL.4.KJV: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
MAL.4.PLAIN: And he will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.”

MAT.1.BSB: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:
MAT.1.KJV: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
MAT.1.PLAIN: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham:

MAT.1.BSB: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.
MAT.1.KJV: Abraham was the father of Isaac; and Isaac was the father of Jacob; and Jacob was the father of Judas and his brothers;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers.

MAT.1.BSB: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.
MAT.1.KJV: And Judas was the father of Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares was the father of Esrom; and Esrom was the father of Aram;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, and Hezron the father of Ram.

MAT.1.BSB: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.
MAT.1.KJV: And Aram was the father of Aminadab; and Aminadab was the father of Naasson; and Naasson was the father of Salmon;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Ram was the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon the father of Salmon.

MAT.1.BSB: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
MAT.1.KJV: And Salmon was the father of Booz of Rachab; and Booz was the father of Obed of Ruth; and Obed was the father of Jesse;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,

MAT.1.BSB: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,
MAT.1.KJV: And Jesse was the father of David the king; and David the king was the father of Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
MAT.1.PLAIN: and Jesse the father of David the king. Next: David was the father of Solomon by Uriah’s wife,

MAT.1.BSB: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.
MAT.1.KJV: And Solomon was the father of Roboam; and Roboam was the father of Abia; and Abia was the father of Asa;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, and Abijah the father of Asa.

MAT.1.BSB: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.
MAT.1.KJV: And Asa was the father of Josaphat; and Josaphat was the father of Joram; and Joram was the father of Ozias;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Joram, and Joram the father of Uzziah.

MAT.1.BSB: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.
MAT.1.KJV: And Ozias was the father of Joatham; and Joatham was the father of Achaz; and Achaz was the father of Ezekias;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Uzziah was the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah.

MAT.1.BSB: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
MAT.1.KJV: And Ezekias was the father of Manasses; and Manasses was the father of Amon; and Amon was the father of Josias;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,

MAT.1.BSB: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
MAT.1.KJV: And Josias was the father of Jechonias and his brothers, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
MAT.1.PLAIN: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

MAT.1.BSB: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
MAT.1.KJV: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias was the father of Salathiel; and Salathiel was the father of Zorobabel;
MAT.1.PLAIN: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,

MAT.1.BSB: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.
MAT.1.KJV: And Zorobabel was the father of Abiud; and Abiud was the father of Eliakim; and Eliakim was the father of Azor;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, and Eliakim the father of Azor.

MAT.1.BSB: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.
MAT.1.KJV: And Azor was the father of Sadoc; and Sadoc was the father of Achim; and Achim was the father of Eliud;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Azor was the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Achim, and Achim the father of Eliud.

MAT.1.BSB: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
MAT.1.KJV: And Eliud was the father of Eleazar; and Eleazar was the father of Matthan; and Matthan was the father of Jacob;
MAT.1.PLAIN: Eliud was the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,

MAT.1.BSB: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
MAT.1.KJV: And Jacob was the father of Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
MAT.1.PLAIN: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

MAT.1.BSB: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.
MAT.1.KJV: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon to Christ are fourteen generations. ¶
MAT.1.PLAIN: In all, then, there were fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.

MAT.1.BSB: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.
MAT.1.KJV: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
MAT.1.PLAIN: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.

MAT.1.BSB: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.
MAT.1.KJV: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privately.
MAT.1.PLAIN: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly, he resolved to divorce her quietly.

MAT.1.BSB: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
MAT.1.KJV: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, you son of David, fear not to take to you Mary your wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
MAT.1.PLAIN: But after he had pondered these things, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to embrace Mary as your wife, for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.

MAT.1.BSB: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”
MAT.1.KJV: And she shall bring forth a son, and you shall call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
MAT.1.PLAIN: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.”

MAT.1.BSB: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
MAT.1.KJV: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
MAT.1.PLAIN: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

MAT.1.BSB: “Behold, the virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call Him Immanuel” (which means, “God with us”).
MAT.1.KJV: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
MAT.1.PLAIN: A child is coming who will be called Emmanuel — a name that means 'God with us.'

MAT.1.BSB: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and embraced Mary as his wife.
MAT.1.KJV: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took to him his wife:
MAT.1.PLAIN: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him, and embraced Mary as his wife.

MAT.1.BSB: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
MAT.1.KJV: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
MAT.1.PLAIN: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.

MAT.2.BSB: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,
MAT.2.KJV: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
MAT.2.PLAIN: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem,

MAT.2.BSB: asking, “Where is the One who has been born King of the Jews? We saw His star in the east and have come to worship Him.”
MAT.2.KJV: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
MAT.2.PLAIN: Where is the newborn King? We saw his star rise, and we've come to worship him.

MAT.2.BSB: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
MAT.2.KJV: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
MAT.2.PLAIN: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

MAT.2.BSB: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
MAT.2.KJV: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
MAT.2.PLAIN: And when he had assembled all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.

MAT.2.BSB: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:
MAT.2.KJV: And they said to him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
MAT.2.PLAIN: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:

MAT.2.BSB: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”
MAT.2.KJV: And you Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, are not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of you shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
MAT.2.PLAIN: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”

MAT.2.BSB: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.
MAT.2.KJV: Then Herod, when he had privately called the wise men, inquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
MAT.2.PLAIN: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and learned from them the exact time the star had appeared.

MAT.2.BSB: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”
MAT.2.KJV: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when you have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
MAT.2.PLAIN: And sending them to Bethlehem, he said: “Go and search carefully for the Child, and when you find Him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship Him.”

MAT.2.BSB: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.
MAT.2.KJV: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, see, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
MAT.2.PLAIN: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the Child was.

MAT.2.BSB: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.
MAT.2.KJV: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy. ¶
MAT.2.PLAIN: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with great delight.

MAT.2.BSB: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.
MAT.2.KJV: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented to him gifts; gold, and frankincense and myrrh.
MAT.2.PLAIN: On coming to the house, they saw the Child with His mother Mary, and they fell down and worshiped Him. Then they opened their treasures and presented Him with gifts of gold and frankincense and myrrh.

MAT.2.BSB: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route.
MAT.2.KJV: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
MAT.2.PLAIN: And having been warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they withdrew to their country by another route.

MAT.2.BSB: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”
MAT.2.KJV: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appears to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be you there until I bring you word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
MAT.2.PLAIN: When the Magi had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and flee to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the Child to kill Him.”

MAT.2.BSB: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,
MAT.2.KJV: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
MAT.2.PLAIN: So he got up, took the Child and His mother by night, and withdrew to Egypt,

MAT.2.BSB: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”
MAT.2.KJV: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son. ¶
MAT.2.PLAIN: where he stayed until the death of Herod. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called My Son.”

MAT.2.BSB: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.
MAT.2.KJV: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently inquired of the wise men.
MAT.2.PLAIN: When Herod saw that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was filled with rage. Sending orders, he put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, according to the time he had learned from the Magi.

MAT.2.BSB: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
MAT.2.KJV: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
MAT.2.PLAIN: Then what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

MAT.2.BSB: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
MAT.2.KJV: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not. ¶
MAT.2.PLAIN: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”

MAT.2.BSB: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
MAT.2.KJV: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appears in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
MAT.2.PLAIN: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.

MAT.2.BSB: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
MAT.2.KJV: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.
MAT.2.PLAIN: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”

MAT.2.BSB: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
MAT.2.KJV: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
MAT.2.PLAIN: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.

MAT.2.BSB: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
MAT.2.KJV: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
MAT.2.PLAIN: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,

MAT.2.BSB: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
MAT.2.KJV: And he came and dwelled in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
MAT.2.PLAIN: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”

MAT.3.BSB: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
MAT.3.KJV: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
MAT.3.PLAIN: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

MAT.3.BSB: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
MAT.3.KJV: And saying, Repent you: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
MAT.3.PLAIN: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”

MAT.3.BSB: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
MAT.3.KJV: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Isaiah, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare you the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
MAT.3.PLAIN: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”

MAT.3.BSB: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
MAT.3.KJV: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leather girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
MAT.3.PLAIN: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

MAT.3.BSB: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
MAT.3.KJV: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
MAT.3.PLAIN: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.

MAT.3.BSB: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
MAT.3.KJV: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins. ¶
MAT.3.PLAIN: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

MAT.3.BSB: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
MAT.3.KJV: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said to them, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
MAT.3.PLAIN: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

MAT.3.BSB: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
MAT.3.KJV: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
MAT.3.PLAIN: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.

MAT.3.BSB: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
MAT.3.KJV: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say to you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children to Abraham.
MAT.3.PLAIN: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

MAT.3.BSB: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
MAT.3.KJV: And now also the ax is laid to the root of the trees: therefore every tree which brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
MAT.3.PLAIN: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.

MAT.3.BSB: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
MAT.3.KJV: I indeed baptize you with water to repentance. but he that comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
MAT.3.PLAIN: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

MAT.3.BSB: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
MAT.3.KJV: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire. ¶
MAT.3.PLAIN: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

MAT.3.BSB: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
MAT.3.KJV: Then comes Jesus from Galilee to Jordan to John, to be baptized of him.
MAT.3.PLAIN: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

MAT.3.BSB: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
MAT.3.KJV: But John forbade him, saying, I have need to be baptized of you, and come you to me?
MAT.3.PLAIN: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”

MAT.3.BSB: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
MAT.3.KJV: And Jesus answering said to him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becomes us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
MAT.3.PLAIN: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.

MAT.3.BSB: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
MAT.3.KJV: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, see, the heavens were opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting on him:
MAT.3.PLAIN: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.

MAT.3.BSB: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
MAT.3.KJV: And see a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
MAT.3.PLAIN: Then a voice came from heaven: 'This is my Son, the one I love; I'm so pleased with him.'

MAT.4.BSB: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
MAT.4.KJV: Then was Jesus led up of the spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
MAT.4.PLAIN: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

MAT.4.BSB: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
MAT.4.KJV: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungered.
MAT.4.PLAIN: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.

MAT.4.BSB: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
MAT.4.KJV: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If you be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
MAT.4.PLAIN: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

MAT.4.BSB: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
MAT.4.KJV: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.
MAT.4.PLAIN: People don't live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.

MAT.4.BSB: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
MAT.4.KJV: Then the devil takes him up into the holy city, and sets him on a pinnacle of the temple,
MAT.4.PLAIN: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.

MAT.4.BSB: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
MAT.4.KJV: And says to him, If you be the Son of God, cast yourself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning you: and in their hands they shall bear you up, lest at any time you dash your foot against a stone.
MAT.4.PLAIN: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”

MAT.4.BSB: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
MAT.4.KJV: Jesus said to him, It is written again, You shall not tempt the Lord your God.
MAT.4.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”

MAT.4.BSB: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
MAT.4.KJV: Again, the devil takes him up into an exceeding high mountain, and shows him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

MAT.4.BSB: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
MAT.4.KJV: And says to him, All these things will I give you, if you will fall down and worship me.
MAT.4.PLAIN: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”

MAT.4.BSB: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus declared. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”
MAT.4.KJV: Then says Jesus to him, Get you hence, Satan: for it is written, You shall worship the Lord your God, and him only shall you serve.
MAT.4.PLAIN: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus declared. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”

MAT.4.BSB: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.
MAT.4.KJV: Then the devil leaves him, and, behold, angels came and ministered to him. ¶
MAT.4.PLAIN: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.

MAT.4.KJV: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
MAT.4.PLAIN: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.

MAT.4.KJV: And going on from there, he saw other two brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
MAT.4.PLAIN: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,

MAT.6.BSB: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
MAT.6.KJV: Therefore I say to you, Take no thought for your life, what you shall eat, or what you shall drink; nor yet for your body, what you shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
MAT.6.PLAIN: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

MAT.6.BSB: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
MAT.6.KJV: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much better than they?
MAT.6.PLAIN: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

MAT.6.BSB: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
MAT.6.KJV: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit to his stature?
MAT.6.PLAIN: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

MAT.6.BSB: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
MAT.6.KJV: And why take you thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
MAT.6.PLAIN: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.

MAT.6.BSB: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
MAT.6.KJV: And yet I say to you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
MAT.6.PLAIN: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.

MAT.6.BSB: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
MAT.6.KJV: Why, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
MAT.6.PLAIN: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?

MAT.6.BSB: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
MAT.6.KJV: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
MAT.6.PLAIN: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’

MAT.6.BSB: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
MAT.6.KJV: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knows that you have need of all these things.
MAT.6.PLAIN: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

MAT.6.BSB: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
MAT.6.KJV: But seek you first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added to you.
MAT.6.PLAIN: Seek God's kingdom and his kind of living first, and everything else you need will be given to you as well.

MAT.6.BSB: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
MAT.6.KJV: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient to the day is the evil thereof.
MAT.6.PLAIN: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

MAT.7.BSB: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
MAT.7.KJV: Judge not, that you be not judged.
MAT.7.PLAIN: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.

MAT.7.BSB: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
MAT.7.KJV: For with what judgment you judge, you shall be judged: and with what measure you mete, it shall be measured to you again.
MAT.7.PLAIN: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.

MAT.7.BSB: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
MAT.7.KJV: And why behold you the mote that is in your brother’s eye, but consider not the beam that is in your own eye?
MAT.7.PLAIN: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?

MAT.7.BSB: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
MAT.7.KJV: Or how will you say to your brother, Let me pull out the mote out of your eye; and, behold, a beam is in your own eye?
MAT.7.PLAIN: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?

MAT.7.BSB: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
MAT.7.KJV: You hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of your own eye; and then shall you see clearly to cast out the mote out of your brother’s eye. ¶
MAT.7.PLAIN: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.

MAT.7.BSB: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
MAT.7.KJV: Give not that which is holy to the dogs, neither cast you your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you. ¶
MAT.7.PLAIN: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.

MAT.7.BSB: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
MAT.7.KJV: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened to you:
MAT.7.PLAIN: Ask, and it will be given to you; look, and you'll find; knock, and the door will be opened.

MAT.7.BSB: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
MAT.7.KJV: For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened.
MAT.7.PLAIN: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

MAT.7.BSB: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
MAT.7.KJV: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
MAT.7.PLAIN: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

MAT.7.BSB: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
MAT.7.KJV: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
MAT.7.PLAIN: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?

MAT.7.BSB: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
MAT.7.KJV: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
MAT.7.PLAIN: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!

MAT.7.BSB: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
MAT.7.KJV: Therefore all things whatever you would that men should do to you, do you even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets. ¶
MAT.7.PLAIN: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.

MAT.7.BSB: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
MAT.7.KJV: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
MAT.7.PLAIN: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

MAT.7.BSB: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
MAT.7.KJV: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads to life, and few there be that find it. ¶
MAT.7.PLAIN: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.

MAT.7.BSB: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
MAT.7.KJV: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
MAT.7.PLAIN: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.

MAT.7.BSB: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
MAT.7.KJV: You shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
MAT.7.PLAIN: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

MAT.7.BSB: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
MAT.7.KJV: Even so every good tree brings forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree brings forth evil fruit.
MAT.7.PLAIN: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.

MAT.7.BSB: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
MAT.7.KJV: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
MAT.7.PLAIN: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.

MAT.7.BSB: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
MAT.7.KJV: Every tree that brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
MAT.7.PLAIN: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

MAT.7.BSB: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
MAT.7.KJV: Why by their fruits you shall know them. ¶
MAT.7.PLAIN: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.

MAT.7.BSB: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
MAT.7.KJV: Not every one that says to me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that does the will of my Father which is in heaven.
MAT.7.PLAIN: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.

MAT.7.BSB: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
MAT.7.KJV: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in your name? and in your name have cast out devils? and in your name done many wonderful works?
MAT.7.PLAIN: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’

MAT.7.BSB: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
MAT.7.KJV: And then will I profess to them, I never knew you: depart from me, you that work iniquity. ¶
MAT.7.PLAIN: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’

MAT.7.BSB: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
MAT.7.KJV: Therefore whoever hears these sayings of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, which built his house on a rock:
MAT.7.PLAIN: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

MAT.7.BSB: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
MAT.7.KJV: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell not: for it was founded on a rock.
MAT.7.PLAIN: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.

MAT.7.BSB: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
MAT.7.KJV: And every one that hears these sayings of mine, and does them not, shall be likened to a foolish man, which built his house on the sand:
MAT.7.PLAIN: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

MAT.7.BSB: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
MAT.7.KJV: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
MAT.7.PLAIN: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”

MAT.7.BSB: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
MAT.7.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
MAT.7.PLAIN: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,

MAT.7.BSB: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
MAT.7.KJV: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
MAT.7.PLAIN: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.

MAT.8.BSB: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
MAT.8.KJV: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
MAT.8.PLAIN: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.

MAT.8.BSB: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
MAT.8.KJV: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”

MAT.8.BSB: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
MAT.8.KJV: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be you clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

MAT.8.BSB: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”
MAT.8.KJV: And Jesus says to him, See you tell no man; but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony to them. ¶
MAT.8.PLAIN: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”

MAT.8.BSB: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,
MAT.8.KJV: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came to him a centurion, beseeching him,
MAT.8.PLAIN: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,

MAT.8.BSB: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”
MAT.8.KJV: And saying, Lord, my servant lies at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
MAT.8.PLAIN: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”

MAT.8.BSB: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
MAT.8.KJV: And Jesus says to him, I will come and heal him.
MAT.8.PLAIN: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.

MAT.8.BSB: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
MAT.8.KJV: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that you should come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
MAT.8.PLAIN: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

MAT.8.BSB: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
MAT.8.KJV: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.
MAT.8.PLAIN: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”

MAT.8.BSB: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
MAT.8.KJV: When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to them that followed, Truly I say to you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
MAT.8.PLAIN: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

MAT.8.BSB: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
MAT.8.KJV: And I say to you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
MAT.8.PLAIN: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

MAT.8.BSB: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
MAT.8.KJV: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
MAT.8.PLAIN: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

MAT.8.BSB: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.
MAT.8.KJV: And Jesus said to the centurion, Go your way; and as you have believed, so be it done to you. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour. ¶
MAT.8.PLAIN: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.

MAT.8.BSB: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
MAT.8.KJV: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
MAT.8.PLAIN: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.

MAT.8.BSB: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve Him.
MAT.8.KJV: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered to them. ¶
MAT.8.PLAIN: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve Him.

MAT.8.BSB: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
MAT.8.KJV: When the even was come, they brought to him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
MAT.8.PLAIN: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

MAT.8.BSB: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.”
MAT.8.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bore our sicknesses. ¶
MAT.8.PLAIN: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.”

MAT.8.BSB: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
MAT.8.KJV: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart to the other side.
MAT.8.PLAIN: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.

MAT.8.BSB: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
MAT.8.KJV: And a certain scribe came, and said to him, Master, I will follow you wherever you go.
MAT.8.PLAIN: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”

MAT.8.BSB: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
MAT.8.KJV: And Jesus says to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man has not where to lay his head.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”

MAT.8.BSB: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
MAT.8.KJV: And another of his disciples said to him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”

MAT.8.BSB: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”
MAT.8.KJV: But Jesus said to him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead. ¶
MAT.8.PLAIN: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

MAT.8.BSB: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
MAT.8.KJV: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
MAT.8.PLAIN: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.

MAT.8.BSB: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
MAT.8.KJV: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, so that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.

MAT.8.BSB: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
MAT.8.KJV: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
MAT.8.PLAIN: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”

MAT.8.BSB: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
MAT.8.KJV: And he says to them, Why are you fearful, O you of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Why are you so afraid? Where's your faith? Then he stood up, told the wind and waves to stop, and everything went perfectly calm.

MAT.8.BSB: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
MAT.8.KJV: But the men marveled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him! ¶
MAT.8.PLAIN: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”

MAT.8.BSB: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
MAT.8.KJV: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
MAT.8.PLAIN: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

MAT.8.BSB: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
MAT.8.KJV: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus, you Son of God? are you come here to torment us before the time?
MAT.8.PLAIN: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”

MAT.8.BSB: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
MAT.8.KJV: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
MAT.8.PLAIN: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.

MAT.8.BSB: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
MAT.8.KJV: So the devils sought him, saying, If you cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
MAT.8.PLAIN: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”

MAT.8.BSB: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
MAT.8.KJV: And he said to them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
MAT.8.PLAIN: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.

MAT.8.BSB: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
MAT.8.KJV: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.

MAT.8.BSB: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
MAT.8.KJV: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they sought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
MAT.8.PLAIN: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.

MAT.9.BSB: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
MAT.9.KJV: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
MAT.9.PLAIN: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.

MAT.9.BSB: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”
MAT.9.KJV: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said to the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; your sins be forgiven you.
MAT.9.PLAIN: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”

MAT.9.BSB: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
MAT.9.KJV: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemes.
MAT.9.PLAIN: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
