MAT.10.KJV: And whoever shall give to drink to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
MAT.10.PLAIN: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”

MAT.11.BSB: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
MAT.11.KJV: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed there to teach and to preach in their cities.
MAT.11.PLAIN: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.

MAT.11.BSB: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent his disciples
MAT.11.KJV: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
MAT.11.PLAIN: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent his disciples

MAT.11.BSB: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
MAT.11.KJV: And said to him, Are you he that should come, or do we look for another?
MAT.11.PLAIN: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”

MAT.11.BSB: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
MAT.11.KJV: Jesus answered and said to them, Go and show John again those things which you do hear and see:
MAT.11.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:

MAT.11.BSB: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
MAT.11.KJV: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
MAT.11.PLAIN: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

MAT.11.BSB: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
MAT.11.KJV: And blessed is he, whoever shall not be offended in me. ¶
MAT.11.PLAIN: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”

MAT.11.BSB: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
MAT.11.KJV: And as they departed, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, What went you out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
MAT.11.PLAIN: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?

MAT.11.BSB: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
MAT.11.KJV: But what went you out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.
MAT.11.PLAIN: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.

MAT.11.BSB: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
MAT.11.KJV: But what went you out for to see? A prophet? yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.
MAT.11.PLAIN: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

MAT.11.BSB: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
MAT.11.KJV: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you.
MAT.11.PLAIN: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Look closely — I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’

MAT.11.BSB: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
MAT.11.KJV: Truly I say to you, Among them that are born of women there has not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
MAT.11.PLAIN: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

MAT.11.BSB: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.
MAT.11.KJV: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
MAT.11.PLAIN: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.

MAT.11.BSB: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
MAT.11.KJV: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
MAT.11.PLAIN: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.

MAT.11.BSB: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
MAT.11.KJV: And if you will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
MAT.11.PLAIN: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.

MAT.11.BSB: He who has ears, let him hear.
MAT.11.KJV: He that has ears to hear, let him hear. ¶
MAT.11.PLAIN: He who has ears, let him hear.

MAT.11.BSB: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
MAT.11.KJV: But to what shall I liken this generation? It is like to children sitting in the markets, and calling to their fellows,
MAT.11.PLAIN: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:

MAT.11.BSB: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
MAT.11.KJV: And saying, We have piped to you, and you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and you have not lamented.
MAT.11.PLAIN: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’

MAT.11.BSB: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
MAT.11.KJV: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He has a devil.
MAT.11.PLAIN: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’

MAT.11.BSB: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.”
MAT.11.KJV: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a drunkard, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children. ¶
MAT.11.PLAIN: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.”

MAT.11.BSB: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
MAT.11.KJV: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
MAT.11.PLAIN: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.

MAT.11.BSB: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
MAT.11.KJV: Woe to you, Chorazin! woe to you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
MAT.11.PLAIN: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

MAT.11.BSB: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
MAT.11.KJV: But I say to you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
MAT.11.PLAIN: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

MAT.11.BSB: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
MAT.11.KJV: And you, Capernaum, which are exalted to heaven, shall be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in you, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
MAT.11.PLAIN: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.

MAT.11.BSB: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”
MAT.11.KJV: But I say to you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for you. ¶
MAT.11.PLAIN: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”

MAT.11.BSB: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
MAT.11.KJV: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them to babes.
MAT.11.PLAIN: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.

MAT.11.BSB: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
MAT.11.KJV: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in your sight.
MAT.11.PLAIN: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.

MAT.11.BSB: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
MAT.11.KJV: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knows the Son, but the Father; neither knows any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him. ¶
MAT.11.PLAIN: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

MAT.11.BSB: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
MAT.11.KJV: Come to me, all you that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
MAT.11.PLAIN: Come to me, all of you who are worn out and weighed down, and I will give you rest.

MAT.11.BSB: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
MAT.11.KJV: Take my yoke on you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and you shall find rest to your souls.
MAT.11.PLAIN: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

MAT.11.BSB: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
MAT.11.KJV: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
MAT.11.PLAIN: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”

MAT.12.BSB: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.
MAT.12.KJV: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungered, and began to pluck the ears of corn and to eat.
MAT.12.PLAIN: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.

MAT.12.BSB: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”
MAT.12.KJV: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said to him, Behold, your disciples do that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath day.
MAT.12.PLAIN: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”

MAT.12.BSB: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
MAT.12.KJV: But he said to them, Have you not read what David did, when he was an hungered, and they that were with him;
MAT.12.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

MAT.12.BSB: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
MAT.12.KJV: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
MAT.12.PLAIN: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.

MAT.12.BSB: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
MAT.12.KJV: Or have you not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
MAT.12.PLAIN: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?

MAT.12.BSB: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
MAT.12.KJV: But I say to you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
MAT.12.PLAIN: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.

MAT.12.BSB: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
MAT.12.KJV: But if you had known what this means, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, you would not have condemned the guiltless.
MAT.12.PLAIN: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.

MAT.12.BSB: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
MAT.12.KJV: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
MAT.12.PLAIN: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

MAT.12.BSB: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,
MAT.12.KJV: And when he was departed there, he went into their synagogue: ¶
MAT.12.PLAIN: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,

MAT.12.BSB: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
MAT.12.KJV: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
MAT.12.PLAIN: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

MAT.12.BSB: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
MAT.12.KJV: And he said to them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
MAT.12.PLAIN: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?

MAT.12.BSB: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
MAT.12.KJV: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Why it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
MAT.12.PLAIN: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”

MAT.12.BSB: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.
MAT.12.KJV: Then says he to the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other. ¶
MAT.12.PLAIN: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.

MAT.12.BSB: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
MAT.12.KJV: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
MAT.12.PLAIN: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.

MAT.12.BSB: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
MAT.12.KJV: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from there: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
MAT.12.PLAIN: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,

MAT.12.BSB: warning them not to make Him known.
MAT.12.KJV: And charged them that they should not make him known:
MAT.12.PLAIN: warning them not to make Him known.

MAT.12.BSB: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
MAT.12.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Isaiah the prophet, saying,
MAT.12.PLAIN: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:

MAT.12.BSB: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
MAT.12.KJV: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit on him, and he shall show judgment to the Gentiles.
MAT.12.PLAIN: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.

MAT.12.BSB: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.
MAT.12.KJV: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
MAT.12.PLAIN: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.

MAT.12.BSB: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
MAT.12.KJV: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment to victory.
MAT.12.PLAIN: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.

MAT.12.BSB: In His name the nations will put their hope.”
MAT.12.KJV: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust. ¶
MAT.12.PLAIN: In His name the nations will put their hope.”

MAT.12.BSB: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
MAT.12.KJV: Then was brought to him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, so that the blind and dumb both spoke and saw.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.

MAT.12.BSB: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
MAT.12.KJV: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
MAT.12.PLAIN: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”

MAT.12.BSB: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
MAT.12.KJV: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow does not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
MAT.12.PLAIN: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”

MAT.12.BSB: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
MAT.12.KJV: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
MAT.12.PLAIN: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.

MAT.12.BSB: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
MAT.12.KJV: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
MAT.12.PLAIN: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?

MAT.12.BSB: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
MAT.12.KJV: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
MAT.12.PLAIN: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

MAT.12.BSB: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
MAT.12.KJV: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come to you.
MAT.12.PLAIN: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

MAT.12.BSB: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
MAT.12.KJV: Or else how can one enter into a strong man’s house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.

MAT.12.BSB: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
MAT.12.KJV: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad. ¶
MAT.12.PLAIN: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.

MAT.12.BSB: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
MAT.12.KJV: Why I say to you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven to men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven to men.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

MAT.12.BSB: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
MAT.12.KJV: And whoever speaks a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whoever speaks against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.

MAT.12.BSB: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
MAT.12.KJV: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.

MAT.12.BSB: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
MAT.12.KJV: O generation of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
MAT.12.PLAIN: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.

MAT.12.BSB: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
MAT.12.KJV: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart brings forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure brings forth evil things.
MAT.12.PLAIN: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.

MAT.12.BSB: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
MAT.12.KJV: But I say to you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
MAT.12.PLAIN: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.

MAT.12.BSB: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
MAT.12.KJV: For by your words you shall be justified, and by your words you shall be condemned. ¶
MAT.12.PLAIN: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”

MAT.12.BSB: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”
MAT.12.KJV: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”

MAT.12.BSB: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
MAT.12.KJV: But he answered and said to them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
MAT.12.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

MAT.12.BSB: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
MAT.12.KJV: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
MAT.12.PLAIN: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

MAT.12.BSB: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
MAT.12.KJV: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
MAT.12.PLAIN: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.

MAT.12.BSB: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
MAT.12.KJV: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
MAT.12.PLAIN: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.

MAT.12.BSB: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
MAT.12.KJV: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest, and finds none.
MAT.12.PLAIN: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.

MAT.12.BSB: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
MAT.12.KJV: Then he says, I will return into my house from where I came out; and when he is come, he finds it empty, swept, and garnished.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.

MAT.12.BSB: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there; and the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”
MAT.12.KJV: Then goes he, and takes with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also to this wicked generation. ¶
MAT.12.PLAIN: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there; and the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”

MAT.12.BSB: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.
MAT.12.KJV: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brothers stood without, desiring to speak with him.
MAT.12.PLAIN: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.

MAT.12.BSB: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”
MAT.12.KJV: Then one said to him, Behold, your mother and your brothers stand without, desiring to speak with you.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”

MAT.12.BSB: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
MAT.12.KJV: But he answered and said to him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brothers?
MAT.12.PLAIN: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”

MAT.12.BSB: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.
MAT.12.KJV: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brothers!
MAT.12.PLAIN: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.

MAT.12.BSB: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”
MAT.12.KJV: For whoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
MAT.12.PLAIN: Anyone who does what my Father in heaven wants is my brother and sister and mother.

MAT.13.BSB: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
MAT.13.KJV: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
MAT.13.PLAIN: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.

MAT.13.BSB: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
MAT.13.KJV: And great multitudes were gathered together to him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
MAT.13.PLAIN: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.

MAT.13.BSB: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
MAT.13.KJV: And he spoke many things to them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
MAT.13.PLAIN: And He told them many things in parables, saying, “A farmer went out to sow his seed.

MAT.13.BSB: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
MAT.13.KJV: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
MAT.13.PLAIN: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.

MAT.13.BSB: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
MAT.13.KJV: Some fell on stony places, where they had not much earth: and immediately they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
MAT.13.PLAIN: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.

MAT.13.BSB: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
MAT.13.KJV: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
MAT.13.PLAIN: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.

MAT.13.BSB: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
MAT.13.KJV: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
MAT.13.PLAIN: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.

MAT.13.BSB: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
MAT.13.KJV: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundred times, some sixty times, some thirty times.
MAT.13.PLAIN: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.

MAT.13.BSB: He who has ears, let him hear.”
MAT.13.KJV: Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
MAT.13.PLAIN: He who has ears, let him hear.”

MAT.13.BSB: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”
MAT.13.KJV: And the disciples came, and said to him, Why speak you to them in parables?
MAT.13.PLAIN: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”

MAT.13.BSB: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
MAT.13.KJV: He answered and said to them, Because it is given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
MAT.13.PLAIN: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.

MAT.13.BSB: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
MAT.13.KJV: For whoever has, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whoever has not, from him shall be taken away even that he has.
MAT.13.PLAIN: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.

MAT.13.BSB: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
MAT.13.KJV: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
MAT.13.PLAIN: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’

MAT.13.BSB: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
MAT.13.KJV: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
MAT.13.PLAIN: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.

MAT.13.BSB: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
MAT.13.KJV: For this people’s heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
MAT.13.PLAIN: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’

MAT.13.BSB: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
MAT.13.KJV: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
MAT.13.PLAIN: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.

MAT.13.BSB: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
MAT.13.KJV: For truly I say to you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which you hear, and have not heard them. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.

MAT.13.BSB: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
MAT.13.KJV: Hear you therefore the parable of the sower.
MAT.13.PLAIN: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:

MAT.13.BSB: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
MAT.13.KJV: When any one hears the word of the kingdom, and understands it not, then comes the wicked one, and catches away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
MAT.13.PLAIN: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.

MAT.13.BSB: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
MAT.13.KJV: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;
MAT.13.PLAIN: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.

MAT.13.BSB: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
MAT.13.KJV: Yet has he not root in himself, but endures for a while: for when tribulation or persecution rises because of the word, by and by he is offended.
MAT.13.PLAIN: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.

MAT.13.BSB: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
MAT.13.KJV: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that hears the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.
MAT.13.PLAIN: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

MAT.13.BSB: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”
MAT.13.KJV: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that hears the word, and understands it; which also bears fruit, and brings forth, some an hundred times, some sixty, some thirty. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: The seed on good ground is the person who hears the message and really gets it — and their life bears fruit, far more than was planted.

MAT.13.BSB: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
MAT.13.KJV: Another parable put he forth to them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened to a man which sowed good seed in his field:
MAT.13.PLAIN: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.

MAT.13.BSB: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
MAT.13.KJV: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
MAT.13.PLAIN: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.

MAT.13.BSB: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
MAT.13.KJV: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
MAT.13.PLAIN: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.

MAT.13.BSB: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
MAT.13.KJV: So the servants of the householder came and said to him, Sir, did not you sow good seed in your field? from where then has it tares?
MAT.13.PLAIN: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’

MAT.13.BSB: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
MAT.13.KJV: He said to them, An enemy has done this. The servants said to him, Will you then that we go and gather them up?
MAT.13.PLAIN: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’

MAT.13.BSB: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
MAT.13.KJV: But he said, No; lest while you gather up the tares, you root up also the wheat with them.
MAT.13.PLAIN: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.

MAT.13.BSB: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”
MAT.13.KJV: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”

MAT.13.BSB: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.
MAT.13.KJV: Another parable put he forth to them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
MAT.13.PLAIN: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.

MAT.13.BSB: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
MAT.13.KJV: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”

MAT.13.BSB: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
MAT.13.KJV: Another parable spoke he to them; The kingdom of heaven is like to leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
MAT.13.PLAIN: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”

MAT.13.BSB: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
MAT.13.KJV: All these things spoke Jesus to the multitude in parables; and without a parable spoke he not to them:
MAT.13.PLAIN: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.

MAT.13.BSB: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”
MAT.13.KJV: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
MAT.13.PLAIN: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”

MAT.13.BSB: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
MAT.13.KJV: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came to him, saying, Declare to us the parable of the tares of the field.
MAT.13.PLAIN: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”

MAT.13.BSB: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
MAT.13.KJV: He answered and said to them, He that sows the good seed is the Son of man;
MAT.13.PLAIN: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.

MAT.13.BSB: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
MAT.13.KJV: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
MAT.13.PLAIN: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,

MAT.13.BSB: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
MAT.13.KJV: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
MAT.13.PLAIN: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.

MAT.13.BSB: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
MAT.13.KJV: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
MAT.13.PLAIN: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.

MAT.13.BSB: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
MAT.13.KJV: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
MAT.13.PLAIN: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.

MAT.13.BSB: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
MAT.13.KJV: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
MAT.13.PLAIN: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

MAT.13.BSB: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
MAT.13.KJV: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.

MAT.13.BSB: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
MAT.13.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like to treasure hid in a field; the which when a man has found, he hides, and for joy thereof goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.

MAT.13.BSB: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
MAT.13.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like to a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
MAT.13.PLAIN: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.

MAT.13.BSB: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
MAT.13.KJV: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.

MAT.13.BSB: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
MAT.13.KJV: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like to a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
MAT.13.PLAIN: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.

MAT.13.BSB: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.
MAT.13.KJV: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
MAT.13.PLAIN: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.

MAT.13.BSB: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,
MAT.13.KJV: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
MAT.13.PLAIN: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,

MAT.13.BSB: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
MAT.13.KJV: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
MAT.13.PLAIN: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

MAT.13.BSB: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.
MAT.13.KJV: Jesus says to them, Have you understood all these things? They say to him, Yes, Lord.
MAT.13.PLAIN: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.

MAT.13.BSB: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
MAT.13.KJV: Then said he to them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed to the kingdom of heaven is like to a man that is an householder, which brings forth out of his treasure things new and old. ¶
MAT.13.PLAIN: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”

MAT.13.BSB: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.
MAT.13.KJV: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed there.
MAT.13.PLAIN: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.

MAT.13.BSB: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.
MAT.13.KJV: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, From where has this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
MAT.13.PLAIN: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.

MAT.13.BSB: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
MAT.13.KJV: Is not this the carpenter’s son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brothers, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
MAT.13.PLAIN: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?

MAT.13.BSB: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
MAT.13.KJV: And his sisters, are they not all with us? From where then has this man all these things?
MAT.13.PLAIN: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”

MAT.13.BSB: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
MAT.13.KJV: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, save in his own country, and in his own house.
MAT.13.PLAIN: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”

MAT.13.BSB: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
MAT.13.KJV: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
MAT.13.PLAIN: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.

MAT.14.BSB: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
MAT.14.KJV: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
MAT.14.PLAIN: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus

MAT.14.BSB: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
MAT.14.KJV: And said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do show forth themselves in him. ¶
MAT.14.PLAIN: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”

MAT.14.BSB: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
MAT.14.KJV: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
MAT.14.PLAIN: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,

MAT.14.BSB: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
MAT.14.KJV: For John said to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.
MAT.14.PLAIN: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

MAT.14.BSB: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
MAT.14.KJV: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
MAT.14.PLAIN: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.

MAT.14.BSB: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod
MAT.14.KJV: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
MAT.14.PLAIN: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod

MAT.14.BSB: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
MAT.14.KJV: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she would ask.
MAT.14.PLAIN: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.

MAT.14.BSB: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
MAT.14.KJV: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
MAT.14.PLAIN: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”

MAT.14.BSB: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
MAT.14.KJV: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
MAT.14.PLAIN: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted

MAT.14.BSB: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
MAT.14.KJV: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
MAT.14.PLAIN: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
