MAT.21.KJV: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
MAT.21.PLAIN: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”

MAT.21.BSB: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
MAT.21.KJV: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
MAT.21.PLAIN: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”

MAT.21.BSB: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
MAT.21.KJV: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee. ¶
MAT.21.PLAIN: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”

MAT.21.BSB: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
MAT.21.KJV: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
MAT.21.PLAIN: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.

MAT.21.BSB: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”
MAT.21.KJV: And said to them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but you have made it a den of thieves.
MAT.21.PLAIN: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”

MAT.21.BSB: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.
MAT.21.KJV: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
MAT.21.PLAIN: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.

MAT.21.BSB: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
MAT.21.KJV: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
MAT.21.PLAIN: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”

MAT.21.BSB: “Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”
MAT.21.KJV: And said to him, Hear you what these say? And Jesus says to them, Yes; have you never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings you have perfected praise? ¶
MAT.21.PLAIN: “Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”

MAT.21.BSB: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He spent the night.
MAT.21.KJV: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He spent the night.

MAT.21.BSB: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.
MAT.21.KJV: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungry.
MAT.21.PLAIN: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.

MAT.21.BSB: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
MAT.21.KJV: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said to it, Let no fruit grow on you henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.

MAT.21.BSB: When the disciples saw this, they marveled and asked, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”
MAT.21.KJV: And when the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
MAT.21.PLAIN: When the disciples saw this, they marveled and asked, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”

MAT.21.BSB: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
MAT.21.KJV: Jesus answered and said to them, Truly I say to you, If you have faith, and doubt not, you shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if you shall say to this mountain, Be you removed, and be you cast into the sea; it shall be done.
MAT.21.PLAIN: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.

MAT.21.BSB: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
MAT.21.KJV: And all things, whatever you shall ask in prayer, believing, you shall receive. ¶
MAT.21.PLAIN: Whatever you ask for in prayer, if you truly believe, you'll receive it.

MAT.21.BSB: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”
MAT.21.KJV: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority do you these things? and who gave you this authority?
MAT.21.PLAIN: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”

MAT.21.BSB: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
MAT.21.KJV: And Jesus answered and said to them, I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
MAT.21.PLAIN: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

MAT.21.BSB: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
MAT.21.KJV: The baptism of John, from where was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say to us, Why did you not then believe him?
MAT.21.PLAIN: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

MAT.21.BSB: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
MAT.21.KJV: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
MAT.21.PLAIN: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”

MAT.21.BSB: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
MAT.21.KJV: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said to them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things. ¶
MAT.21.PLAIN: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

MAT.21.BSB: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
MAT.21.KJV: But what think you? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
MAT.21.PLAIN: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’

MAT.21.BSB: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.
MAT.21.KJV: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
MAT.21.PLAIN: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.

MAT.21.BSB: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
MAT.21.KJV: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.

MAT.21.BSB: Which of the two did the will of his father?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.
MAT.21.KJV: Whether of them two did the will of his father? They say to him, The first. Jesus says to them, Truly I say to you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Which of the two did the will of his father?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.

MAT.21.BSB: For John came to you in a righteous way and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
MAT.21.KJV: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and you, when you had seen it, repented not afterward, that you might believe him. ¶
MAT.21.PLAIN: For John came to you in a righteous way and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.

MAT.21.BSB: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
MAT.21.KJV: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and dig a wine press in it, and built a tower, and let it out to farmers, and went into a far country:
MAT.21.PLAIN: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.

MAT.21.BSB: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
MAT.21.KJV: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the farmers, that they might receive the fruits of it.
MAT.21.PLAIN: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.

MAT.21.BSB: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
MAT.21.KJV: And the farmers took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
MAT.21.PLAIN: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

MAT.21.BSB: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
MAT.21.KJV: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did to them likewise.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.

MAT.21.BSB: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
MAT.21.KJV: But last of all he sent to them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.

MAT.21.BSB: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’
MAT.21.KJV: But when the farmers saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
MAT.21.PLAIN: But when the tenants saw the son, they said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and take his inheritance.’

MAT.21.BSB: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
MAT.21.KJV: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
MAT.21.PLAIN: So they seized him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

MAT.21.BSB: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?”
MAT.21.KJV: When the lord therefore of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?
MAT.21.PLAIN: Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard returns, what will he do to those tenants?”

MAT.21.BSB: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.”
MAT.21.KJV: They say to him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard to other farmers, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
MAT.21.PLAIN: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and will rent out the vineyard to other tenants who will give him his share of the fruit at harvest time.”

MAT.21.BSB: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
MAT.21.KJV: Jesus says to them, Did you never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes?
MAT.21.PLAIN: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?

MAT.21.BSB: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
MAT.21.KJV: Therefore say I to you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

MAT.21.BSB: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”
MAT.21.KJV: And whoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
MAT.21.PLAIN: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”

MAT.21.BSB: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that Jesus was speaking about them.
MAT.21.KJV: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke of them.
MAT.21.PLAIN: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they knew that Jesus was speaking about them.

MAT.21.BSB: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.
MAT.21.KJV: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
MAT.21.PLAIN: Although they wanted to arrest Him, they were afraid of the crowds, because the people regarded Him as a prophet.

MAT.22.BSB: Once again, Jesus spoke to them in parables:
MAT.22.KJV: And Jesus answered and spoke to them again by parables, and said,
MAT.22.PLAIN: Once again, Jesus spoke to them in parables:

MAT.22.BSB: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
MAT.22.KJV: The kingdom of heaven is like to a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
MAT.22.PLAIN: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

MAT.22.BSB: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
MAT.22.KJV: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
MAT.22.PLAIN: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.

MAT.22.BSB: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
MAT.22.KJV: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatted calves are killed, and all things are ready: come to the marriage.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Again, he sent other servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner. My oxen and fattened cattle have been killed, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’

MAT.22.BSB: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.
MAT.22.KJV: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
MAT.22.PLAIN: But they paid no attention and went away, one to his field, another to his business.

MAT.22.BSB: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.
MAT.22.KJV: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
MAT.22.PLAIN: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them, and killed them.

MAT.22.BSB: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.
MAT.22.KJV: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
MAT.22.PLAIN: The king was enraged, and he sent his troops to destroy those murderers and burn their city.

MAT.22.BSB: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.
MAT.22.KJV: Then says he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited were not worthy.

MAT.22.BSB: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’
MAT.22.KJV: Go you therefore into the highways, and as many as you shall find, bid to the marriage.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Go therefore to the crossroads and invite to the banquet as many as you can find.’

MAT.22.BSB: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
MAT.22.KJV: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests. ¶
MAT.22.PLAIN: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered everyone they could find, both evil and good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

MAT.22.BSB: But when the king came in to see the guests, he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.
MAT.22.KJV: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
MAT.22.PLAIN: But when the king came in to see the guests, he spotted a man who was not dressed in wedding clothes.

MAT.22.BSB: ‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ But the man was speechless.
MAT.22.KJV: And he says to him, Friend, how came you in here not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
MAT.22.PLAIN: ‘Friend,’ he asked, ‘how did you get in here without wedding clothes?’ But the man was speechless.

MAT.22.BSB: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
MAT.22.KJV: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness, there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Then the king told the servants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

MAT.22.BSB: For many are called, but few are chosen.”
MAT.22.KJV: For many are called, but few are chosen. ¶
MAT.22.PLAIN: For many are called, but few are chosen.”

MAT.22.BSB: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.
MAT.22.KJV: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Then the Pharisees went out and conspired to trap Jesus in His words.

MAT.22.BSB: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.
MAT.22.KJV: And they sent out to him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that you are true, and teach the way of God in truth, neither care you for any man: for you regard not the person of men.
MAT.22.PLAIN: They sent their disciples to Him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and that You teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You seek favor from no one, because You pay no attention to external appearance.

MAT.22.BSB: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
MAT.22.KJV: Tell us therefore, What think you? Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
MAT.22.PLAIN: So tell us what You think: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”

MAT.22.BSB: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?
MAT.22.KJV: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt you me, you hypocrites?
MAT.22.PLAIN: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?

MAT.22.BSB: Show Me the coin used for the tax.” And they brought Him a denarius.
MAT.22.KJV: Show me the tribute money. And they brought to him a penny.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Show Me the coin used for the tax.” And they brought Him a denarius.

MAT.22.BSB: “Whose image is this,” He asked, “and whose inscription?”
MAT.22.KJV: And he says to them, Whose is this image and superscription?
MAT.22.PLAIN: “Whose image is this,” He asked, “and whose inscription?”

MAT.22.BSB: “Caesar’s,” they answered. So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
MAT.22.KJV: They say to him, Caesar’s. Then says he to them, Render therefore to Caesar the things which are Caesar’s; and to God the things that are God’s.
MAT.22.PLAIN: “Caesar’s,” they answered. So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”

MAT.22.BSB: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.
MAT.22.KJV: When they had heard these words, they marveled, and left him, and went their way. ¶
MAT.22.PLAIN: And when they heard this, they were amazed. So they left Him and went away.

MAT.22.BSB: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.
MAT.22.KJV: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
MAT.22.PLAIN: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.

MAT.22.BSB: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
MAT.22.KJV: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.
MAT.22.PLAIN: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses declared that if a man dies without having children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.

MAT.22.BSB: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.
MAT.22.KJV: Now there were with us seven brothers: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife to his brother:
MAT.22.PLAIN: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died without having children. So he left his wife to his brother.

MAT.22.BSB: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.
MAT.22.KJV: Likewise the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
MAT.22.PLAIN: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.

MAT.22.BSB: And last of all, the woman died.
MAT.22.KJV: And last of all the woman died also.
MAT.22.PLAIN: And last of all, the woman died.

MAT.22.BSB: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
MAT.22.KJV: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
MAT.22.PLAIN: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”

MAT.22.BSB: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
MAT.22.KJV: Jesus answered and said to them, You do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Jesus answered, “You are mistaken because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

MAT.22.BSB: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
MAT.22.KJV: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
MAT.22.PLAIN: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.

MAT.22.BSB: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:
MAT.22.KJV: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have you not read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,
MAT.22.PLAIN: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what God said to you:

MAT.22.BSB: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”
MAT.22.KJV: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
MAT.22.PLAIN: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

MAT.22.BSB: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.
MAT.22.KJV: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine. ¶
MAT.22.PLAIN: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.

MAT.22.BSB: And when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they themselves gathered together.
MAT.22.KJV: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
MAT.22.PLAIN: And when the Pharisees heard that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they themselves gathered together.

MAT.22.BSB: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:
MAT.22.KJV: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
MAT.22.PLAIN: One of them, an expert in the law, tested Him with a question:

MAT.22.BSB: “Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?”
MAT.22.KJV: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
MAT.22.PLAIN: “Teacher, which commandment is the greatest in the Law?”

MAT.22.BSB: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
MAT.22.KJV: Jesus said to him, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.
MAT.22.PLAIN: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.

MAT.22.BSB: This is the first and greatest commandment.
MAT.22.KJV: This is the first and great commandment.
MAT.22.PLAIN: This is the first and greatest commandment.

MAT.22.BSB: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
MAT.22.KJV: And the second is like to it, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.
MAT.22.PLAIN: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’

MAT.22.BSB: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”
MAT.22.KJV: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets. ¶
MAT.22.PLAIN: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”

MAT.22.BSB: While the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them:
MAT.22.KJV: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
MAT.22.PLAIN: While the Pharisees were assembled, Jesus questioned them:

MAT.22.BSB: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.
MAT.22.KJV: Saying, What think you of Christ? whose son is he? They say to him, The son of David.
MAT.22.PLAIN: “What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is He?” “David’s,” they answered.

MAT.22.BSB: Jesus said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says:
MAT.22.KJV: He says to them, How then does David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
MAT.22.PLAIN: Jesus said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call Him ‘Lord’? For he says:

MAT.22.BSB: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
MAT.22.KJV: The LORD said to my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool?
MAT.22.PLAIN: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’

MAT.22.BSB: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”
MAT.22.KJV: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
MAT.22.PLAIN: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”

MAT.22.BSB: No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.
MAT.22.KJV: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither dared any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
MAT.22.PLAIN: No one was able to answer a word, and from that day on no one dared to question Him any further.

MAT.23.BSB: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples:
MAT.23.KJV: Then spoke Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
MAT.23.PLAIN: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples:

MAT.23.BSB: “The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.
MAT.23.KJV: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:
MAT.23.PLAIN: “The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat.

MAT.23.BSB: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
MAT.23.KJV: All therefore whatever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not you after their works: for they say, and do not.
MAT.23.PLAIN: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.

MAT.23.BSB: They tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
MAT.23.KJV: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
MAT.23.PLAIN: They tie up heavy, burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

MAT.23.BSB: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.
MAT.23.KJV: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
MAT.23.PLAIN: All their deeds are done for men to see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels.

MAT.23.BSB: They love the places of honor at banquets, the chief seats in the synagogues,
MAT.23.KJV: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
MAT.23.PLAIN: They love the places of honor at banquets, the chief seats in the synagogues,

MAT.23.BSB: the greetings in the marketplaces, and the title of ‘Rabbi’ by which they are addressed.
MAT.23.KJV: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
MAT.23.PLAIN: the greetings in the marketplaces, and the title of ‘Rabbi’ by which they are addressed.

MAT.23.BSB: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
MAT.23.KJV: But be not you called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all you are brothers.
MAT.23.PLAIN: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.

MAT.23.BSB: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.
MAT.23.KJV: And call no man your father on the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
MAT.23.PLAIN: And do not call anyone on earth your father, for you have one Father, who is in heaven.

MAT.23.BSB: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
MAT.23.KJV: Neither be you called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.

MAT.23.BSB: The greatest among you shall be your servant.
MAT.23.KJV: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
MAT.23.PLAIN: The greatest among you shall be your servant.

MAT.23.BSB: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
MAT.23.KJV: And whoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted. ¶
MAT.23.PLAIN: Anyone who lifts himself up will be brought low, and anyone who humbles himself will be lifted up.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.
MAT.23.KJV: But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for you neither go in yourselves, neither suffer you them that are entering to go in.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let in those who wish to enter.

MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayer: therefore you shall receive the greater damnation.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.
MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You traverse land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’
MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, you blind guides, which say, Whoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.’

MAT.23.BSB: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?
MAT.23.KJV: You fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
MAT.23.PLAIN: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes it sacred?

MAT.23.BSB: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’
MAT.23.KJV: And, Whoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is guilty.
MAT.23.PLAIN: And you say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.’

MAT.23.BSB: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?
MAT.23.KJV: You fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?
MAT.23.PLAIN: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes it sacred?

MAT.23.BSB: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
MAT.23.KJV: Whoever therefore shall swear by the altar, swears by it, and by all things thereon.
MAT.23.PLAIN: So then, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

MAT.23.BSB: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.
MAT.23.KJV: And whoever shall swear by the temple, swears by it, and by him that dwells therein.
MAT.23.PLAIN: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it.

MAT.23.BSB: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.
MAT.23.KJV: And he that shall swear by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him that sits thereon.
MAT.23.PLAIN: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these you should have done, and not to leave the other undone.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.

MAT.23.BSB: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
MAT.23.KJV: You blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
MAT.23.PLAIN: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.

MAT.23.BSB: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
MAT.23.KJV: You blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside, but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are like to white washed sepulchers, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside, but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.

MAT.23.BSB: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
MAT.23.KJV: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but within you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
MAT.23.PLAIN: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

MAT.23.BSB: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.
MAT.23.KJV: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because you build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchers of the righteous,
MAT.23.PLAIN: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.

MAT.23.BSB: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
MAT.23.KJV: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
MAT.23.PLAIN: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’

MAT.23.BSB: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
MAT.23.KJV: Why you be witnesses to yourselves, that you are the children of them which killed the prophets.
MAT.23.PLAIN: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.

MAT.23.BSB: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.
MAT.23.KJV: Fill you up then the measure of your fathers.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.

MAT.23.BSB: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
MAT.23.KJV: You serpents, you generation of vipers, how can you escape the damnation of hell? ¶
MAT.23.PLAIN: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?

MAT.23.BSB: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute in town after town.
MAT.23.KJV: Why, behold, I send to you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them you shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall you whip in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
MAT.23.PLAIN: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute in town after town.

MAT.23.BSB: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
MAT.23.KJV: That on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom you slew between the temple and the altar.
MAT.23.PLAIN: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

MAT.23.BSB: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
MAT.23.KJV: Truly I say to you, All these things shall come on this generation.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

MAT.23.BSB: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
MAT.23.KJV: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that kill the prophets, and stone them which are sent to you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!
MAT.23.PLAIN: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!

MAT.23.BSB: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
MAT.23.KJV: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.
MAT.23.PLAIN: Look, your house is left to you desolate.

MAT.23.BSB: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
MAT.23.KJV: For I say to you, You shall not see me from now on, till you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord.
MAT.23.PLAIN: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”

MAT.24.BSB: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
MAT.24.KJV: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to show him the buildings of the temple.
MAT.24.PLAIN: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.

MAT.24.BSB: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
MAT.24.KJV: And Jesus said to them, See you not all these things? truly I say to you, There shall not be left here one stone on another, that shall not be thrown down. ¶
MAT.24.PLAIN: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”

MAT.24.BSB: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
MAT.24.KJV: And as he sat on the mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the world?
MAT.24.PLAIN: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”

MAT.24.BSB: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
MAT.24.KJV: And Jesus answered and said to them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
MAT.24.PLAIN: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.

MAT.24.BSB: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
MAT.24.KJV: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
MAT.24.PLAIN: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.

MAT.24.BSB: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
MAT.24.KJV: And you shall hear of wars and rumors of wars: see that you be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
MAT.24.PLAIN: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.

MAT.24.BSB: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
MAT.24.KJV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
MAT.24.PLAIN: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

MAT.24.BSB: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
MAT.24.KJV: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
MAT.24.PLAIN: All these are the beginning of birth pains.

MAT.24.BSB: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
MAT.24.KJV: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and you shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
MAT.24.PLAIN: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.

MAT.24.BSB: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
MAT.24.KJV: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
MAT.24.PLAIN: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,

MAT.24.BSB: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.
MAT.24.KJV: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
MAT.24.PLAIN: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.

MAT.24.BSB: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
MAT.24.KJV: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
MAT.24.PLAIN: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.

MAT.24.BSB: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
MAT.24.KJV: But he that shall endure to the end, the same shall be saved.
MAT.24.PLAIN: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.

MAT.24.BSB: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
MAT.24.KJV: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness to all nations; and then shall the end come.
MAT.24.PLAIN: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

MAT.24.BSB: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
MAT.24.KJV: When you therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoever reads, let him understand:)
MAT.24.PLAIN: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),

MAT.24.BSB: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
MAT.24.KJV: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
MAT.24.PLAIN: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

MAT.24.BSB: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
MAT.24.KJV: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
MAT.24.PLAIN: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.

MAT.24.BSB: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
MAT.24.KJV: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
MAT.24.PLAIN: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.

MAT.24.BSB: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
MAT.24.KJV: And woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
MAT.24.PLAIN: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!

MAT.24.BSB: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
MAT.24.KJV: But pray you that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
MAT.24.PLAIN: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.

MAT.24.BSB: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
MAT.24.KJV: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
MAT.24.PLAIN: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.

MAT.24.BSB: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
MAT.24.KJV: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
MAT.24.PLAIN: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.

MAT.24.BSB: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
MAT.24.KJV: Then if any man shall say to you, See, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
MAT.24.PLAIN: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.

MAT.24.BSB: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
MAT.24.KJV: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; so that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
MAT.24.PLAIN: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.

MAT.24.BSB: See, I have told you in advance.
MAT.24.KJV: Behold, I have told you before.
MAT.24.PLAIN: See, I have told you in advance.

MAT.24.BSB: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
MAT.24.KJV: Why if they shall say to you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
MAT.24.PLAIN: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.

MAT.24.BSB: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
MAT.24.KJV: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shines even to the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
MAT.24.PLAIN: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

MAT.24.BSB: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
MAT.24.KJV: For wherever the carcass is, there will the eagles be gathered together. ¶
MAT.24.PLAIN: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

MAT.24.BSB: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
MAT.24.KJV: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
MAT.24.PLAIN: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’

MAT.24.BSB: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
MAT.24.KJV: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
MAT.24.PLAIN: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

MAT.24.BSB: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
MAT.24.KJV: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

MAT.27.KJV: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom will you that I release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
MAT.27.PLAIN: So when the crowd had assembled, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

MAT.27.PLAIN: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.

MAT.27.BSB: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they replied.
MAT.27.KJV: The governor answered and said to them, Whether of the two will you that I release to you? They said, Barabbas.
MAT.27.PLAIN: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they replied.

MAT.27.BSB: “What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify Him!”
MAT.27.KJV: Pilate says to them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say to him, Let him be crucified.
MAT.27.PLAIN: “What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify Him!”

MAT.27.KJV: And the governor said, Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified. ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”

MAT.27.BSB: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
MAT.27.KJV: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see you to it.
MAT.27.PLAIN: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”

MAT.27.KJV: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children. ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!”

MAT.27.BSB: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.

MAT.27.PLAIN: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.

MAT.27.BSB: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.

MAT.27.KJV: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe. ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.

MAT.27.KJV: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
MAT.27.PLAIN: And they twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head. They put a staff in His right hand and knelt down before Him to mock Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

MAT.27.KJV: And they spit on him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
MAT.27.PLAIN: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.

MAT.27.KJV: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
MAT.27.PLAIN: After they had mocked Him, they removed the robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him away to crucify Him.

MAT.27.BSB: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
MAT.27.KJV: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
MAT.27.PLAIN: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.

MAT.27.BSB: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
MAT.27.KJV: And when they were come to a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull, ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,

MAT.27.KJV: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
MAT.27.PLAIN: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.

MAT.27.BSB: When they had crucified Him, they divided up His garments by casting lots.
MAT.27.KJV: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and on my clothing did they cast lots.
MAT.27.PLAIN: When they had crucified Him, they divided up His garments by casting lots.

MAT.27.BSB: And sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
MAT.27.KJV: And sitting down they watched him there;
MAT.27.PLAIN: And sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.

MAT.27.KJV: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
MAT.27.PLAIN: Above His head they posted the written charge against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

MAT.27.KJV: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left. ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: Two robbers were crucified with Him, one on His right hand and the other on His left.

MAT.27.KJV: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
MAT.27.PLAIN: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads

MAT.27.KJV: And saying, You that destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself. If you be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

MAT.27.KJV: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

MAT.27.KJV: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

MAT.27.KJV: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land to the ninth hour.
MAT.27.PLAIN: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.

MAT.27.KJV: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
MAT.27.PLAIN: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”

MAT.27.KJV: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calls for Elias.
MAT.27.PLAIN: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He is calling Elijah.”

MAT.27.KJV: And straightway one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
MAT.27.PLAIN: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge. He filled it with sour wine, put it on a reed, and held it up for Jesus to drink.

MAT.27.BSB: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
MAT.27.KJV: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him. ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”

MAT.27.BSB: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He yielded up His spirit.

MAT.27.PLAIN: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He yielded up His spirit.

MAT.27.BSB: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
MAT.27.KJV: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

MAT.27.BSB: The tombs broke open, and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised.

MAT.27.PLAIN: The tombs broke open, and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised.

MAT.27.KJV: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared to many.
MAT.27.PLAIN: After Jesus’ resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, they entered the holy city and appeared to many people.

MAT.27.BSB: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
MAT.27.KJV: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
MAT.27.PLAIN: When the soldiers guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that happened, they were terrified and said, 'This really was the Son of God.'

MAT.27.BSB: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.
MAT.27.KJV: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering to him:
MAT.27.PLAIN: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.

MAT.27.BSB: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
MAT.27.KJV: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee’s children.
MAT.27.PLAIN: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.

MAT.27.BSB: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself was a disciple of Jesus.
MAT.27.KJV: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus’ disciple:
MAT.27.PLAIN: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself was a disciple of Jesus.

MAT.27.BSB: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
MAT.27.KJV: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
MAT.27.PLAIN: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

MAT.27.BSB: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
MAT.27.KJV: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
MAT.27.PLAIN: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

MAT.27.BSB: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
MAT.27.KJV: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulcher, and departed.
MAT.27.PLAIN: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.

MAT.27.BSB: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
MAT.27.KJV: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulcher. ¶
MAT.27.PLAIN: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

MAT.27.BSB: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
MAT.27.KJV: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,
MAT.27.PLAIN: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.

MAT.27.BSB: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
MAT.27.KJV: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
MAT.27.PLAIN: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’

MAT.27.BSB: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”
MAT.27.KJV: Command therefore that the sepulcher be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say to the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
MAT.27.PLAIN: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”

MAT.27.BSB: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
MAT.27.KJV: Pilate said to them, You have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as you can.
MAT.27.PLAIN: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”

MAT.27.BSB: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.
MAT.27.KJV: So they went, and made the sepulcher sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
MAT.27.PLAIN: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.

MAT.28.BSB: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.

MAT.28.PLAIN: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.

MAT.28.KJV: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat on it.

MAT.28.KJV: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

MAT.28.PLAIN: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

MAT.28.BSB: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
MAT.28.KJV: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
MAT.28.PLAIN: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.

MAT.28.BSB: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
MAT.28.KJV: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there shall you see him: see, I have told you.

MAT.28.PLAIN: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.

MAT.28.KJV: Then said Jesus to them, Be not afraid: go tell my brothers that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me. ¶
MAT.28.PLAIN: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.”

MAT.28.KJV: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and showed to the chief priests all the things that were done.
MAT.28.PLAIN: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.

MAT.28.KJV: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money to the soldiers,
MAT.28.PLAIN: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money

MAT.28.BSB: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’

MAT.28.KJV: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

MAT.28.BSB: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
MAT.28.KJV: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day. ¶

MAT.28.BSB: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.

MAT.28.PLAIN: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

MAT.28.KJV: Go you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
MAT.28.PLAIN: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,

MAT.28.KJV: Teaching them to observe all things whatever I have commanded you: and, see, I am with you always, even to the end of the world. Amen.

MRK.11.KJV: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

MRK.12.KJV: But those farmers said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
MRK.12.PLAIN: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

MRK.12.BSB: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

MRK.12.KJV: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
MRK.12.PLAIN: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.

MRK.12.BSB: Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

MRK.12.BSB: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
MRK.12.KJV: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvelous in our eyes?

MRK.12.BSB: At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away.
MRK.12.KJV: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way. ¶

MRK.12.BSB: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?”
MRK.12.KJV: And when they were come, they say to him, Master, we know that you are true, and care for no man: for you regard not the person of men, but teach the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
MRK.12.PLAIN: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not? Should we pay them or not?”

MRK.12.BSB: But Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, “Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to inspect.”
MRK.12.KJV: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, Why tempt you me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

MRK.12.KJV: And they brought it. And he says to them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said to him, Caesar’s.
MRK.12.PLAIN: So they brought it, and He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.

MRK.12.BSB: Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him.
MRK.12.KJV: And Jesus answering said to them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marveled at him. ¶
MRK.12.PLAIN: Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him.

MRK.12.BSB: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:

MRK.12.KJV: Master, Moses wrote to us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed to his brother.

MRK.12.PLAIN: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”

MRK.12.BSB: Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
MRK.12.KJV: And Jesus answering said to them, Do you not therefore err, because you know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

MRK.12.KJV: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
MRK.12.PLAIN: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.

MRK.12.BSB: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
MRK.12.KJV: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have you not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spoke to him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
MRK.12.PLAIN: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

MRK.12.BSB: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
MRK.12.KJV: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: you therefore do greatly err. ¶
MRK.12.PLAIN: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”

MRK.12.KJV: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

MRK.12.KJV: And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength: this is the first commandment.
MRK.12.PLAIN: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’

MRK.12.KJV: And the second is like, namely this, You shall love your neighbor as yourself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
MRK.12.PLAIN: Love your neighbor as yourself. No commandment is greater than these.

MRK.12.BSB: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
MRK.12.KJV: And the scribe said to him, Well, Master, you have said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
MRK.12.PLAIN: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,

MRK.12.BSB: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, which is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
MRK.12.KJV: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
MRK.12.PLAIN: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, which is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

MRK.12.KJV: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool.

MRK.12.KJV: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
MRK.12.PLAIN: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”

MRK.13.BSB: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”

MRK.13.PLAIN: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.

MRK.13.BSB: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.

MRK.13.KJV: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows. ¶

MRK.13.PLAIN: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
