JHN.5.BSB: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
JHN.5.KJV: Jesus says to him, Rise, take up your bed, and walk.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”

JHN.5.BSB: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
JHN.5.KJV: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath. ¶
JHN.5.PLAIN: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk. Now this happened on the Sabbath day,

JHN.5.BSB: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
JHN.5.KJV: The Jews therefore said to him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for you to carry your bed.
JHN.5.PLAIN: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”

JHN.5.BSB: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
JHN.5.KJV: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said to me, Take up your bed, and walk.
JHN.5.PLAIN: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”

JHN.5.BSB: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
JHN.5.KJV: Then asked they him, What man is that which said to you, Take up your bed, and walk?
JHN.5.PLAIN: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.

JHN.5.BSB: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
JHN.5.KJV: And he that was healed knew not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
JHN.5.PLAIN: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.

JHN.5.BSB: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
JHN.5.KJV: Afterward Jesus finds him in the temple, and said to him, Behold, you are made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come to you.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”

JHN.5.BSB: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
JHN.5.KJV: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
JHN.5.PLAIN: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

JHN.5.BSB: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
JHN.5.KJV: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day. ¶
JHN.5.PLAIN: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.

JHN.5.BSB: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
JHN.5.KJV: But Jesus answered them, My Father works till now, and I work.
JHN.5.PLAIN: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”

JHN.5.BSB: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
JHN.5.KJV: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.

JHN.5.BSB: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
JHN.5.KJV: Then answered Jesus and said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father do: for what things soever he does, these also does the Son likewise.
JHN.5.PLAIN: So Jesus replied, “Hear this steady truth, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.

JHN.5.BSB: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
JHN.5.KJV: For the Father loves the Son, and shows him all things that himself does: and he will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
JHN.5.PLAIN: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.

JHN.5.BSB: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
JHN.5.KJV: For as the Father raises up the dead, and vivifies them; even so the Son vivifies whom he will.
JHN.5.PLAIN: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.

JHN.5.BSB: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
JHN.5.KJV: For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment to the Son:
JHN.5.PLAIN: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,

JHN.5.BSB: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
JHN.5.KJV: That all men should honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He that honors not the Son honors not the Father which has sent him.
JHN.5.PLAIN: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.

JHN.5.BSB: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
JHN.5.KJV: Truly, truly, I say to you, He that hears my word, and believes on him that sent me, has everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death to life.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Anyone who hears my word and believes the One who sent me has eternal life. They won't be condemned — they've already crossed over from death into life.

JHN.5.BSB: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
JHN.5.KJV: Truly, truly, I say to you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Hear this steady truth, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.

JHN.5.BSB: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
JHN.5.KJV: For as the Father has life in himself; so has he given to the Son to have life in himself;
JHN.5.PLAIN: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.

JHN.5.BSB: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
JHN.5.KJV: And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
JHN.5.PLAIN: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.

JHN.5.BSB: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
JHN.5.KJV: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
JHN.5.PLAIN: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice

JHN.5.BSB: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
JHN.5.KJV: And shall come forth; they that have done good, to the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, to the resurrection of damnation.
JHN.5.PLAIN: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.

JHN.5.BSB: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
JHN.5.KJV: I can of my own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father which has sent me.
JHN.5.PLAIN: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.

JHN.5.BSB: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
JHN.5.KJV: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true. ¶
JHN.5.PLAIN: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.

JHN.5.BSB: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
JHN.5.KJV: There is another that bears witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesses of me is true.
JHN.5.PLAIN: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.

JHN.5.BSB: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
JHN.5.KJV: You sent to John, and he bore witness to the truth.
JHN.5.PLAIN: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

JHN.5.BSB: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
JHN.5.KJV: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that you might be saved.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.

JHN.5.BSB: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
JHN.5.KJV: He was a burning and a shining light: and you were willing for a season to rejoice in his light. ¶
JHN.5.PLAIN: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.

JHN.5.BSB: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
JHN.5.KJV: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father has given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father has sent me.
JHN.5.PLAIN: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.

JHN.5.BSB: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
JHN.5.KJV: And the Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
JHN.5.PLAIN: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,

JHN.5.BSB: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
JHN.5.KJV: And you have not his word abiding in you: for whom he has sent, him you believe not. ¶
JHN.5.PLAIN: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.

JHN.5.BSB: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
JHN.5.KJV: Search the scriptures; for in them you think you have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
JHN.5.PLAIN: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,

JHN.5.BSB: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
JHN.5.KJV: And you will not come to me, that you might have life.
JHN.5.PLAIN: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.

JHN.5.BSB: I do not accept glory from men,
JHN.5.KJV: I receive not honor from men.
JHN.5.PLAIN: I do not accept glory from men,

JHN.5.BSB: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
JHN.5.KJV: But I know you, that you have not the love of God in you.
JHN.5.PLAIN: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.

JHN.5.BSB: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
JHN.5.KJV: I am come in my Father’s name, and you receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him you will receive.
JHN.5.PLAIN: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.

JHN.5.BSB: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
JHN.5.KJV: How can you believe, which receive honor one of another, and seek not the honor that comes from God only?
JHN.5.PLAIN: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?

JHN.5.BSB: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
JHN.5.KJV: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuses you, even Moses, in whom you trust.
JHN.5.PLAIN: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.

JHN.5.BSB: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
JHN.5.KJV: For had you believed Moses, you would have believed me; for he wrote of me.
JHN.5.PLAIN: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.

JHN.5.BSB: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
JHN.5.KJV: But if you believe not his writings, how shall you believe my words?
JHN.5.PLAIN: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”

JHN.6.BSB: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
JHN.6.KJV: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
JHN.6.PLAIN: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).

JHN.6.BSB: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.
JHN.6.KJV: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
JHN.6.PLAIN: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.

JHN.6.BSB: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
JHN.6.KJV: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.

JHN.6.BSB: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
JHN.6.KJV: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was near. ¶
JHN.6.PLAIN: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.

JHN.6.BSB: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
JHN.6.KJV: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come to him, he says to Philip, From where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
JHN.6.PLAIN: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”

JHN.6.BSB: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
JHN.6.KJV: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
JHN.6.PLAIN: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.

JHN.6.BSB: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
JHN.6.KJV: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”

JHN.6.BSB: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
JHN.6.KJV: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, says to him,
JHN.6.PLAIN: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,

JHN.6.BSB: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
JHN.6.KJV: There is a lad here, which has five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
JHN.6.PLAIN: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”

JHN.6.BSB: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
JHN.6.KJV: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
JHN.6.PLAIN: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.

JHN.6.BSB: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
JHN.6.KJV: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.

JHN.6.BSB: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
JHN.6.KJV: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
JHN.6.PLAIN: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”

JHN.6.BSB: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
JHN.6.KJV: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above to them that had eaten.
JHN.6.PLAIN: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

JHN.6.BSB: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
JHN.6.KJV: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world. ¶
JHN.6.PLAIN: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”

JHN.6.BSB: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.
JHN.6.KJV: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.

JHN.6.BSB: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
JHN.6.KJV: And when even was now come, his disciples went down to the sea,
JHN.6.PLAIN: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,

JHN.6.BSB: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.
JHN.6.KJV: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
JHN.6.PLAIN: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.

JHN.6.BSB: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
JHN.6.KJV: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
JHN.6.PLAIN: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.

JHN.6.BSB: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
JHN.6.KJV: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the ship: and they were afraid.
JHN.6.PLAIN: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.

JHN.6.BSB: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
JHN.6.KJV: But he says to them, It is I; be not afraid.
JHN.6.PLAIN: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”

JHN.6.BSB: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
JHN.6.KJV: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land where they went. ¶
JHN.6.PLAIN: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.

JHN.6.BSB: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
JHN.6.KJV: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one into where his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
JHN.6.PLAIN: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.

JHN.6.BSB: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
JHN.6.KJV: (However, there came other boats from Tiberias near to the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
JHN.6.PLAIN: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

JHN.6.BSB: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
JHN.6.KJV: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
JHN.6.PLAIN: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.

JHN.6.BSB: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
JHN.6.KJV: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, Rabbi, when came you here?
JHN.6.PLAIN: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”

JHN.6.BSB: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
JHN.6.KJV: Jesus answered them and said, Truly, truly, I say to you, You seek me, not because you saw the miracles, but because you did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “Hear this steady truth, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.

JHN.6.BSB: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
JHN.6.KJV: Labor not for the meat which perishes, but for that meat which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give to you: for him has God the Father sealed.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”

JHN.6.BSB: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
JHN.6.KJV: Then said they to him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
JHN.6.PLAIN: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”

JHN.6.BSB: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
JHN.6.KJV: Jesus answered and said to them, This is the work of God, that you believe on him whom he has sent.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”

JHN.6.BSB: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
JHN.6.KJV: They said therefore to him, What sign show you then, that we may see, and believe you? what do you work?
JHN.6.PLAIN: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?

JHN.6.BSB: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
JHN.6.KJV: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”

JHN.6.BSB: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
JHN.6.KJV: Then Jesus said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Jesus said to them, “Hear this steady truth, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

JHN.6.BSB: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
JHN.6.KJV: For the bread of God is he which comes down from heaven, and gives life to the world.
JHN.6.PLAIN: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”

JHN.6.BSB: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
JHN.6.KJV: Then said they to him, Lord, ever more give us this bread.
JHN.6.PLAIN: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”

JHN.6.BSB: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
JHN.6.KJV: And Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life: he that comes to me shall never hunger; and he that believes on me shall never thirst.
JHN.6.PLAIN: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

JHN.6.BSB: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
JHN.6.KJV: But I said to you, That you also have seen me, and believe not.
JHN.6.PLAIN: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.

JHN.6.BSB: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
JHN.6.KJV: All that the Father gives me shall come to me; and him that comes to me I will in no wise cast out.
JHN.6.PLAIN: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.

JHN.6.BSB: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
JHN.6.KJV: For I came down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him that sent me.
JHN.6.PLAIN: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
