JHN.16.KJV: A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembers no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
JHN.16.PLAIN: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

JHN.16.BSB: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
JHN.16.KJV: And you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man takes from you.
JHN.16.PLAIN: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

JHN.16.BSB: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
JHN.16.KJV: And in that day you shall ask me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to you, Whatever you shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
JHN.16.PLAIN: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Hear this steady truth, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

JHN.16.BSB: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
JHN.16.KJV: Till now have you asked nothing in my name: ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.
JHN.16.PLAIN: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.

JHN.16.BSB: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
JHN.16.KJV: These things have I spoken to you in proverbs: but the time comes, when I shall no more speak to you in proverbs, but I shall show you plainly of the Father.
JHN.16.PLAIN: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

JHN.16.BSB: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
JHN.16.KJV: At that day you shall ask in my name: and I say not to you, that I will pray the Father for you:
JHN.16.PLAIN: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

JHN.16.BSB: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
JHN.16.KJV: For the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
JHN.16.PLAIN: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.

JHN.16.BSB: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
JHN.16.KJV: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
JHN.16.PLAIN: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”

JHN.16.BSB: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
JHN.16.KJV: His disciples said to him, See, now speak you plainly, and speak no proverb.
JHN.16.PLAIN: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.

JHN.16.BSB: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
JHN.16.KJV: Now are we sure that you know all things, and need not that any man should ask you: by this we believe that you came forth from God.
JHN.16.PLAIN: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”

JHN.16.BSB: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.
JHN.16.KJV: Jesus answered them, Do you now believe?
JHN.16.PLAIN: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.

JHN.16.BSB: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
JHN.16.KJV: Behold, the hour comes, yes, is now come, that you shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
JHN.16.PLAIN: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.

JHN.16.BSB: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
JHN.16.KJV: These things I have spoken to you, that in me you might have peace. In the world you shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
JHN.16.PLAIN: I've told you this so that in me you can have peace. In this world you'll have trouble — but take heart: I have overcome the world.

JHN.17.BSB: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
JHN.17.KJV: These words spoke Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify your Son, that your Son also may glorify you:
JHN.17.PLAIN: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.

JHN.17.BSB: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
JHN.17.KJV: As you have given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as you have given him.
JHN.17.PLAIN: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.

JHN.17.BSB: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
JHN.17.KJV: And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
JHN.17.PLAIN: This is eternal life: to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you sent.

JHN.17.BSB: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
JHN.17.KJV: I have glorified you on the earth: I have finished the work which you gave me to do.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.

JHN.17.BSB: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
JHN.17.KJV: And now, O Father, glorify you me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world was.
JHN.17.PLAIN: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.

JHN.17.BSB: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
JHN.17.KJV: I have manifested your name to the men which you gave me out of the world: your they were, and you gave them me; and they have kept your word.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.

JHN.17.BSB: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
JHN.17.KJV: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are of you.
JHN.17.PLAIN: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.

JHN.17.BSB: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
JHN.17.KJV: For I have given to them the words which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and they have believed that you did send me.
JHN.17.PLAIN: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.

JHN.17.BSB: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
JHN.17.KJV: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you have given me; for they are yours.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.

JHN.17.BSB: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
JHN.17.KJV: And all my are yours, and your are mine; and I am glorified in them.
JHN.17.PLAIN: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.

JHN.17.BSB: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
JHN.17.KJV: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep through your own name those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.

JHN.17.BSB: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
JHN.17.KJV: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
JHN.17.PLAIN: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.

JHN.17.BSB: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
JHN.17.KJV: And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
JHN.17.PLAIN: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.

JHN.17.BSB: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
JHN.17.KJV: I have given them your word; and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

JHN.17.BSB: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
JHN.17.KJV: I pray not that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from the evil.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.

JHN.17.BSB: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
JHN.17.KJV: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
JHN.17.PLAIN: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.

JHN.17.BSB: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
JHN.17.KJV: Sanctify them through your truth: your word is truth.
JHN.17.PLAIN: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.

JHN.17.BSB: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
JHN.17.KJV: As you have sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
JHN.17.PLAIN: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.

JHN.17.BSB: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
JHN.17.KJV: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
JHN.17.PLAIN: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.

JHN.17.BSB: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
JHN.17.KJV: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
JHN.17.PLAIN: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,

JHN.17.BSB: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
JHN.17.KJV: That they all may be one; as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that you have sent me.
JHN.17.PLAIN: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.

JHN.17.BSB: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
JHN.17.KJV: And the glory which you gave me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
JHN.17.PLAIN: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

JHN.17.BSB: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
JHN.17.KJV: I in them, and you in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that you have sent me, and have loved them, as you have loved me.
JHN.17.PLAIN: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.

JHN.17.BSB: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
JHN.17.KJV: Father, I will that they also, whom you have given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which you have given me: for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
JHN.17.PLAIN: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.

JHN.17.BSB: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
JHN.17.KJV: O righteous Father, the world has not known you: but I have known you, and these have known that you have sent me.
JHN.17.PLAIN: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.

JHN.17.BSB: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
JHN.17.KJV: And I have declared to them your name, and will declare it: that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.
JHN.17.PLAIN: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”

JHN.18.BSB: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
JHN.18.KJV: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
JHN.18.PLAIN: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.

JHN.18.BSB: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
JHN.18.KJV: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus often resorted thither with his disciples.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.

JHN.18.BSB: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
JHN.18.KJV: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, comes thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
JHN.18.PLAIN: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.

JHN.18.BSB: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
JHN.18.KJV: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come on him, went forth, and said to them, Whom seek you?
JHN.18.PLAIN: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”

JHN.18.BSB: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
JHN.18.KJV: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus says to them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
JHN.18.PLAIN: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.

JHN.18.BSB: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
JHN.18.KJV: As soon then as he had said to them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
JHN.18.PLAIN: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

JHN.18.BSB: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
JHN.18.KJV: Then asked he them again, Whom seek you? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
JHN.18.PLAIN: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.

JHN.18.BSB: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
JHN.18.KJV: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore you seek me, let these go their way:
JHN.18.PLAIN: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”

JHN.18.BSB: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
JHN.18.KJV: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Of them which you gave me have I lost none.
JHN.18.PLAIN: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”

JHN.18.BSB: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
JHN.18.KJV: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

JHN.18.BSB: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
JHN.18.KJV: Then said Jesus to Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it?
JHN.18.PLAIN: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”

JHN.18.BSB: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
JHN.18.KJV: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
JHN.18.PLAIN: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.

JHN.18.BSB: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
JHN.18.KJV: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
JHN.18.PLAIN: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

JHN.18.BSB: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.
JHN.18.KJV: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people. ¶
JHN.18.PLAIN: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.

JHN.18.BSB: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
JHN.18.KJV: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known to the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.

JHN.18.BSB: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
JHN.18.KJV: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known to the high priest, and spoke to her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
JHN.18.PLAIN: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.

JHN.18.BSB: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
JHN.18.KJV: Then says the damsel that kept the door to Peter, Are not you also one of this man’s disciples? He says, I am not.
JHN.18.PLAIN: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.

JHN.18.BSB: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.
JHN.18.KJV: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself. ¶
JHN.18.PLAIN: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.

JHN.18.BSB: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
JHN.18.KJV: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.

JHN.18.BSB: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
JHN.18.KJV: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
JHN.18.PLAIN: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.

JHN.18.BSB: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
JHN.18.KJV: Why ask you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said to them: behold, they know what I said.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”

JHN.18.BSB: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
JHN.18.KJV: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answer you the high priest so?
JHN.18.PLAIN: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”

JHN.18.BSB: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
JHN.18.KJV: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smite you me?
JHN.18.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”

JHN.18.BSB: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
JHN.18.KJV: Now Annas had sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

JHN.18.BSB: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
JHN.18.KJV: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore to him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

JHN.18.BSB: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
JHN.18.KJV: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him?
JHN.18.PLAIN: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”

JHN.18.BSB: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.
JHN.18.KJV: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew. ¶
JHN.18.PLAIN: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.

JHN.18.BSB: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
JHN.18.KJV: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas to the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.

JHN.18.BSB: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
JHN.18.KJV: Pilate then went out to them, and said, What accusation bring you against this man?
JHN.18.PLAIN: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”

JHN.18.BSB: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
JHN.18.KJV: They answered and said to him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up to you.
JHN.18.PLAIN: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”

JHN.18.BSB: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.
JHN.18.KJV: Then said Pilate to them, Take you him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said to him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
JHN.18.PLAIN: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.

JHN.18.BSB: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
JHN.18.KJV: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die.
JHN.18.PLAIN: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.

JHN.18.BSB: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
JHN.18.KJV: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?
JHN.18.PLAIN: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”

JHN.18.BSB: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”
JHN.18.KJV: Jesus answered him, Say you this thing of yourself, or did others tell it you of me?
JHN.18.PLAIN: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”

JHN.18.BSB: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
JHN.18.KJV: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered you to me: what have you done?
JHN.18.PLAIN: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”

JHN.18.BSB: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
JHN.18.KJV: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
JHN.18.PLAIN: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”

JHN.18.BSB: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
JHN.18.KJV: Pilate therefore said to him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You say that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness to the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice.
JHN.18.PLAIN: 'So you are a king?' Jesus answered, 'You say I'm a king. For this I was born, and for this I came into the world — to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.'

JHN.18.BSB: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
JHN.18.KJV: Pilate says to him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, I find in him no fault at all.
JHN.18.PLAIN: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.

JHN.18.BSB: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
JHN.18.KJV: But you have a custom, that I should release to you one at the passover: will you therefore that I release to you the King of the Jews?
JHN.18.PLAIN: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

JHN.18.BSB: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
JHN.18.KJV: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
JHN.18.PLAIN: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)

JHN.19.BSB: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
JHN.19.KJV: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.

JHN.19.BSB: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
JHN.19.KJV: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
JHN.19.PLAIN: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.

JHN.19.BSB: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
JHN.19.KJV: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
JHN.19.PLAIN: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.

JHN.19.BSB: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
JHN.19.KJV: Pilate therefore went forth again, and says to them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that you may know that I find no fault in him.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”

JHN.19.BSB: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
JHN.19.KJV: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says to them, Behold the man!
JHN.19.PLAIN: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”

JHN.19.BSB: As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him, they shouted, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!” “You take Him and crucify Him,” Pilate replied, “for I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
JHN.19.KJV: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate says to them, Take you him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
JHN.19.PLAIN: As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him, they shouted, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!” “You take Him and crucify Him,” Pilate replied, “for I find no basis for a charge against Him.”

JHN.19.BSB: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
JHN.19.KJV: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”

JHN.19.BSB: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid,
JHN.19.KJV: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
JHN.19.PLAIN: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid,

JHN.19.BSB: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
JHN.19.KJV: And went again into the judgment hall, and says to Jesus, From where are you? But Jesus gave him no answer.
JHN.19.PLAIN: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.

JHN.19.BSB: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”
JHN.19.KJV: Then says Pilate to him, Speak you not to me? know you not that I have power to crucify you, and have power to release you?
JHN.19.PLAIN: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”

JHN.19.BSB: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
JHN.19.KJV: Jesus answered, You could have no power at all against me, except it were given you from above: therefore he that delivered me to you has the greater sin.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”

JHN.19.BSB: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
JHN.19.KJV: And from thereafter Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you are not Caesar’s friend: whoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”

JHN.19.BSB: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
JHN.19.KJV: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
JHN.19.PLAIN: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.

JHN.19.BSB: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
JHN.19.KJV: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he says to the Jews, Behold your King!
JHN.19.PLAIN: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”

JHN.19.BSB: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
JHN.19.KJV: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate says to them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
JHN.19.PLAIN: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.

JHN.19.BSB: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
JHN.19.KJV: Then delivered he him therefore to them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.

JHN.19.BSB: Carrying His own cross, He went out to The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
JHN.19.KJV: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
JHN.19.PLAIN: Carrying His own cross, He went out to The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.

JHN.19.BSB: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.
JHN.19.KJV: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.

JHN.19.BSB: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
JHN.19.KJV: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

JHN.19.BSB: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
JHN.19.KJV: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was near to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.

JHN.19.BSB: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
JHN.19.KJV: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
JHN.19.PLAIN: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”

JHN.19.BSB: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
JHN.19.KJV: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

JHN.19.BSB: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
JHN.19.KJV: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
JHN.19.PLAIN: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

JHN.19.BSB: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.
JHN.19.KJV: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my raiment among them, and for my clothing they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.

JHN.19.BSB: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
JHN.19.KJV: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.

JHN.19.BSB: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
JHN.19.KJV: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he says to his mother, Woman, behold your son!
JHN.19.PLAIN: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”

JHN.19.BSB: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.
JHN.19.KJV: Then says he to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her to his own home. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.

JHN.19.BSB: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
JHN.19.KJV: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst.
JHN.19.PLAIN: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”

JHN.19.BSB: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
JHN.19.KJV: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a sponge with vinegar, and put it on hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
JHN.19.PLAIN: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.

JHN.19.BSB: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
JHN.19.KJV: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
JHN.19.PLAIN: When Jesus had received the drink, he said, 'It is finished.' Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

JHN.19.BSB: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.
JHN.19.KJV: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain on the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) sought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
JHN.19.PLAIN: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.

JHN.19.BSB: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and those of the other.
JHN.19.KJV: Then came the soldiers, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
JHN.19.PLAIN: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and those of the other.

JHN.19.BSB: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
JHN.19.KJV: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they broke not his legs:
JHN.19.PLAIN: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.

JHN.19.BSB: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
JHN.19.KJV: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and immediately came there out blood and water.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.

JHN.19.BSB: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
JHN.19.KJV: And he that saw it bore record, and his record is true: and he knows that he says true, that you might believe.
JHN.19.PLAIN: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.

JHN.19.BSB: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
JHN.19.KJV: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”

JHN.19.BSB: And, as another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they have pierced.”
JHN.19.KJV: And again another scripture says, They shall look on him whom they pierced. ¶
JHN.19.PLAIN: And, as another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they have pierced.”

JHN.19.BSB: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed His body.
JHN.19.KJV: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, sought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed His body.

JHN.19.BSB: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
JHN.19.KJV: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.

JHN.19.BSB: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
JHN.19.KJV: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
JHN.19.PLAIN: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.

JHN.19.BSB: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
JHN.19.KJV: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulcher, wherein was never man yet laid.
JHN.19.PLAIN: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.

JHN.19.BSB: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
JHN.19.KJV: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews’ preparation day; for the sepulcher was near at hand.
JHN.19.PLAIN: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.

JHN.20.BSB: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
JHN.20.KJV: The first day of the week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, to the sepulcher, and sees the stone taken away from the sepulcher.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

JHN.20.BSB: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
JHN.20.KJV: Then she runs, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and says to them, They have taken away the LORD out of the sepulcher, and we know not where they have laid him.
JHN.20.PLAIN: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”

JHN.20.BSB: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
JHN.20.KJV: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulcher.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.

JHN.20.BSB: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
JHN.20.KJV: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulcher.
JHN.20.PLAIN: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

JHN.20.BSB: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
JHN.20.KJV: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
JHN.20.PLAIN: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.

JHN.20.BSB: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
JHN.20.KJV: Then comes Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulcher, and sees the linen clothes lie,
JHN.20.PLAIN: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.

JHN.20.BSB: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
JHN.20.KJV: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
JHN.20.PLAIN: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.

JHN.20.BSB: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
JHN.20.KJV: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulcher, and he saw, and believed.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.

JHN.20.BSB: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.
JHN.20.KJV: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
JHN.20.PLAIN: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.

JHN.20.BSB: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
JHN.20.KJV: Then the disciples went away again to their own home. ¶
JHN.20.PLAIN: Then the disciples returned to their homes.

JHN.20.BSB: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
JHN.20.KJV: But Mary stood without at the sepulcher weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulcher,
JHN.20.PLAIN: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,

JHN.20.BSB: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
JHN.20.KJV: And sees two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
JHN.20.PLAIN: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.

JHN.20.BSB: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
JHN.20.KJV: And they say to her, Woman, why weep you? She says to them, Because they have taken away my LORD, and I know not where they have laid him.
JHN.20.PLAIN: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”

JHN.20.BSB: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
JHN.20.KJV: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
JHN.20.PLAIN: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not recognize that it was Jesus.

JHN.20.BSB: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
JHN.20.KJV: Jesus says to her, Woman, why weep you? whom seek you? She, supposing him to be the gardener, says to him, Sir, if you have borne him hence, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.
JHN.20.PLAIN: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”

JHN.20.BSB: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
JHN.20.KJV: Jesus says to her, Mary. She turned herself, and says to him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

JHN.20.BSB: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
JHN.20.KJV: Jesus says to her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brothers, and say to them, I ascend to my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
JHN.20.PLAIN: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”

JHN.20.BSB: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.
JHN.20.KJV: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the LORD, and that he had spoken these things to her. ¶
JHN.20.PLAIN: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.

JHN.20.BSB: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
JHN.20.KJV: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the middle, and says to them, Peace be to you.
JHN.20.PLAIN: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.

JHN.20.BSB: After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
JHN.20.KJV: And when he had so said, he showed to them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the LORD.
JHN.20.PLAIN: After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.

JHN.20.BSB: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”
JHN.20.KJV: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be to you: as my Father has sent me, even so send I you.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”

JHN.20.BSB: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
JHN.20.KJV: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and says to them, Receive you the Holy Ghost:
JHN.20.PLAIN: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.

JHN.20.BSB: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”
JHN.20.KJV: Whose soever sins you remit, they are remitted to them; and whose soever sins you retain, they are retained. ¶
JHN.20.PLAIN: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”

JHN.20.BSB: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
JHN.20.KJV: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.

JHN.20.BSB: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
JHN.20.KJV: The other disciples therefore said to him, We have seen the LORD. But he said to them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe. ¶
JHN.20.PLAIN: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”

JHN.20.BSB: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
JHN.20.KJV: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the middle, and said, Peace be to you.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”

JHN.20.BSB: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
JHN.20.KJV: Then says he to Thomas, Reach here your finger, and behold my hands; and reach here your hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”

JHN.20.BSB: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
JHN.20.KJV: And Thomas answered and said to him, My LORD and my God.
JHN.20.PLAIN: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”

JHN.20.BSB: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
JHN.20.KJV: Jesus says to him, Thomas, because you have seen me, you have believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed. ¶
JHN.20.PLAIN: Because you've seen me, you believe, Thomas. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.

JHN.20.BSB: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
JHN.20.KJV: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
JHN.20.PLAIN: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.

JHN.20.BSB: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
JHN.20.KJV: But these are written, that you might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing you might have life through his name.
JHN.20.PLAIN: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.

JHN.21.BSB: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:

JHN.21.PLAIN: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:

JHN.21.BSB: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
JHN.21.KJV: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

JHN.21.BSB: Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.” “We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.
JHN.21.KJV: Simon Peter says to them, I go a fishing. They say to him, We also go with you. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.” “We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.

JHN.21.BSB: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
JHN.21.KJV: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.

JHN.21.BSB: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
JHN.21.KJV: Then Jesus says to them, Children, have you any meat? They answered him, No.
JHN.21.PLAIN: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.

JHN.21.BSB: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.
JHN.21.KJV: And he said to them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and you shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
JHN.21.PLAIN: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.

JHN.21.BSB: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
JHN.21.KJV: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved says to Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher’s coat to him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.

JHN.21.BSB: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
JHN.21.KJV: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
JHN.21.PLAIN: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.

JHN.21.BSB: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
JHN.21.KJV: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
JHN.21.PLAIN: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.

JHN.21.BSB: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
JHN.21.KJV: Jesus says to them, Bring of the fish which you have now caught.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”

JHN.21.BSB: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
JHN.21.KJV: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
JHN.21.PLAIN: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.

JHN.21.BSB: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
JHN.21.KJV: Jesus says to them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples dared ask him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.
JHN.21.PLAIN: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.

JHN.21.BSB: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
JHN.21.KJV: Jesus then comes, and takes bread, and gives them, and fish likewise.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.

JHN.21.BSB: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
JHN.21.KJV: This is now the third time that Jesus showed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead. ¶
JHN.21.PLAIN: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.

JHN.21.BSB: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
JHN.21.KJV: So when they had dined, Jesus says to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me more than these? He says to him, Yes, Lord; you know that I love you. He said to him, Feed my lambs.
JHN.21.PLAIN: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”

JHN.21.BSB: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
JHN.21.KJV: He says to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? He says to him, Yes, Lord; you know that I love you. He said to him, Feed my sheep.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”

JHN.21.BSB: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
JHN.21.KJV: He says to him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, Love you me? And he said to him, Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you. Jesus says to him, Feed my sheep.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.

JHN.21.BSB: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
JHN.21.KJV: Truly, truly, I say to you, When you were young, you gird yourself, and walked where you would: but when you shall be old, you shall stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you, and carry you where you would not.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Hear this steady truth, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”

JHN.21.BSB: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
JHN.21.KJV: This spoke he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he says to him, Follow me.
JHN.21.PLAIN: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”

JHN.21.BSB: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
JHN.21.KJV: Then Peter, turning about, sees the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrays you?
JHN.21.PLAIN: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”

JHN.21.BSB: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
JHN.21.KJV: Peter seeing him says to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
JHN.21.PLAIN: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”

JHN.21.BSB: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
JHN.21.KJV: Jesus says to him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you? follow you me.
JHN.21.PLAIN: If I want him to stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.

JHN.21.BSB: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
JHN.21.KJV: Then went this saying abroad among the brothers, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not to him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you?
JHN.21.PLAIN: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”

JHN.21.BSB: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
JHN.21.KJV: This is the disciple which testifies of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
JHN.21.PLAIN: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.

JHN.21.BSB: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
JHN.21.KJV: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
JHN.21.PLAIN: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.

ACT.1.BSB: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
ACT.1.KJV: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
ACT.1.PLAIN: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,

ACT.1.BSB: until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
ACT.1.KJV: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments to the apostles whom he had chosen:

ACT.1.BSB: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
ACT.1.KJV: To whom also he showed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

ACT.1.PLAIN: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.

ACT.1.PLAIN: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”

ACT.1.BSB: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.

ACT.1.PLAIN: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.

ACT.1.KJV: But you shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come on you: and you shall be witnesses to me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and to the uttermost part of the earth.

ACT.1.BSB: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
ACT.1.KJV: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

ACT.1.BSB: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

ACT.1.PLAIN: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

ACT.1.KJV: Which also said, You men of Galilee, why stand you gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as you have seen him go into heaven.

ACT.1.PLAIN: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

ACT.1.KJV: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where stayed both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
ACT.1.PLAIN: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.

ACT.1.KJV: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers. ¶
ACT.1.PLAIN: They all met together and gave themselves to prayer, along with the women, Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

ACT.1.PLAIN: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,

ACT.1.KJV: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his position as bishop let another take.

ACT.11.KJV: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spoke to the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus.

ACT.12.KJV: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

ACT.12.BSB: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
ACT.12.KJV: And they said to her, You are mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

ACT.12.BSB: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
ACT.12.KJV: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
ACT.12.PLAIN: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.

ACT.12.KJV: But he, beckoning to them with the hand to hold their peace, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go show these things to James, and to the brothers. And he departed, and went into another place.

ACT.12.KJV: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
ACT.12.PLAIN: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

ACT.12.BSB: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.

ACT.12.PLAIN: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.

ACT.12.KJV: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
ACT.12.PLAIN: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.
