1CO.12.PLAIN: To each person the Spirit is given for the good of all.

1CO.12.BSB: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,
1CO.12.KJV: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
1CO.12.PLAIN: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,

1CO.12.BSB: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
1CO.12.KJV: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
1CO.12.PLAIN: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

1CO.12.BSB: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.
1CO.12.KJV: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
1CO.12.PLAIN: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.

1CO.12.BSB: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.
1CO.12.KJV: But all these works that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
1CO.12.PLAIN: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.

1CO.12.BSB: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
1CO.12.KJV: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
1CO.12.PLAIN: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.

1CO.12.BSB: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
1CO.12.KJV: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
1CO.12.PLAIN: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.

1CO.12.BSB: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
1CO.12.KJV: For the body is not one member, but many.
1CO.12.PLAIN: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.

1CO.12.BSB: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
1CO.12.KJV: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
1CO.12.PLAIN: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.

1CO.12.BSB: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
1CO.12.KJV: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
1CO.12.PLAIN: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.

1CO.12.BSB: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
1CO.12.KJV: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
1CO.12.PLAIN: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?

1CO.12.BSB: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
1CO.12.KJV: But now has God set the members every one of them in the body, as it has pleased him.
1CO.12.PLAIN: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.

1CO.12.BSB: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
1CO.12.KJV: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
1CO.12.PLAIN: If they were all one part, where would the body be?

1CO.12.BSB: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
1CO.12.KJV: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
1CO.12.PLAIN: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

1CO.12.BSB: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
1CO.12.KJV: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of you: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
1CO.12.PLAIN: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”

1CO.12.BSB: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
1CO.12.KJV: No, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
1CO.12.PLAIN: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,

1CO.12.BSB: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
1CO.12.KJV: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honorable, on these we bestow more abundant honor; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
1CO.12.PLAIN: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,

1CO.12.BSB: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
1CO.12.KJV: For our comely parts have no need: but God has tempered the body together, having given more abundant honor to that part which lacked.
1CO.12.PLAIN: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,

1CO.12.BSB: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
1CO.12.KJV: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
1CO.12.PLAIN: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.

1CO.12.BSB: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
1CO.12.KJV: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honored, all the members rejoice with it.
1CO.12.PLAIN: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

1CO.12.BSB: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
1CO.12.KJV: Now you are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
1CO.12.PLAIN: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a part of it.

1CO.12.BSB: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.
1CO.12.KJV: And God has set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
1CO.12.PLAIN: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.

1CO.12.BSB: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
1CO.12.KJV: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
1CO.12.PLAIN: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

1CO.12.BSB: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
1CO.12.KJV: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
1CO.12.PLAIN: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

1CO.12.BSB: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
1CO.12.KJV: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet show I to you a more excellent way.
1CO.12.PLAIN: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.

1CO.13.BSB: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
1CO.13.KJV: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
1CO.13.PLAIN: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels but don't have love, I'm only a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.

1CO.13.BSB: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
1CO.13.KJV: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
1CO.13.PLAIN: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

1CO.13.BSB: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
1CO.13.KJV: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profits me nothing.
1CO.13.PLAIN: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.

1CO.13.BSB: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
1CO.13.KJV: Charity suffers long, and is kind; charity envies not; charity brags not itself, is not puffed up,
1CO.13.PLAIN: Love is patient, love is kind. It doesn't envy, it doesn't boast, it isn't proud.

1CO.13.BSB: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
1CO.13.KJV: Does not behave itself unseemly, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil;
1CO.13.PLAIN: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.

1CO.13.BSB: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.
1CO.13.KJV: Rejoices not in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth;
1CO.13.PLAIN: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.

1CO.13.BSB: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
1CO.13.KJV: Bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
1CO.13.PLAIN: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

1CO.13.BSB: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.
1CO.13.KJV: Charity never fails: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
1CO.13.PLAIN: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will end; where there are tongues, they will be stilled; where there is knowledge, it will pass away.

1CO.13.BSB: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
1CO.13.KJV: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
1CO.13.PLAIN: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

1CO.13.BSB: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
1CO.13.KJV: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
1CO.13.PLAIN: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.

1CO.13.BSB: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
1CO.13.KJV: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
1CO.13.PLAIN: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.

1CO.13.BSB: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
1CO.13.KJV: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
1CO.13.PLAIN: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

1CO.13.BSB: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
1CO.13.KJV: And now stays faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
1CO.13.PLAIN: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love.

1CO.14.BSB: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.
1CO.14.KJV: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that you may prophesy.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.

1CO.14.BSB: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.
1CO.14.KJV: For he that speaks in an unknown tongue speaks not to men, but to God: for no man understands him; however, in the spirit he speaks mysteries.
1CO.14.PLAIN: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.

1CO.14.BSB: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.
1CO.14.KJV: But he that prophesies speaks to men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
1CO.14.PLAIN: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.

1CO.14.BSB: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
1CO.14.KJV: He that speaks in an unknown tongue edifies himself; but he that prophesies edifies the church.
1CO.14.PLAIN: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.

1CO.14.BSB: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
1CO.14.KJV: I would that you all spoke with tongues but rather that you prophesied: for greater is he that prophesies than he that speaks with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
1CO.14.PLAIN: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.

1CO.14.BSB: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
1CO.14.KJV: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
1CO.14.PLAIN: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?

1CO.14.BSB: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
1CO.14.KJV: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
1CO.14.PLAIN: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?

1CO.14.BSB: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
1CO.14.KJV: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
1CO.14.PLAIN: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?

1CO.14.BSB: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
1CO.14.KJV: So likewise you, except you utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for you shall speak into the air.
1CO.14.PLAIN: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

1CO.14.BSB: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
1CO.14.KJV: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

1CO.14.BSB: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
1CO.14.KJV: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be to him that speaks a barbarian, and he that speaks shall be a barbarian to me.
1CO.14.PLAIN: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.

1CO.14.BSB: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
1CO.14.KJV: Even so you, for as much as you are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that you may excel to the edifying of the church.
1CO.14.PLAIN: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.

1CO.14.BSB: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
1CO.14.KJV: Why let him that speaks in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.

1CO.14.BSB: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
1CO.14.KJV: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
1CO.14.PLAIN: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

1CO.14.BSB: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
1CO.14.KJV: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
1CO.14.PLAIN: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.

1CO.14.BSB: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
1CO.14.KJV: Else when you shall bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupies the room of the unlearned say Amen at your giving of thanks, seeing he understands not what you say?
1CO.14.PLAIN: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?

1CO.14.BSB: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
1CO.14.KJV: For you truly give thanks well, but the other is not edified.
1CO.14.PLAIN: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.

1CO.14.BSB: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
1CO.14.KJV: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than you all:
1CO.14.PLAIN: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

1CO.14.BSB: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
1CO.14.KJV: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
1CO.14.PLAIN: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

1CO.14.BSB: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
1CO.14.KJV: Brothers, be not children in understanding: however, in malice be you children, but in understanding be men.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.

1CO.14.BSB: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
1CO.14.KJV: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak to this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, says the LORD.
1CO.14.PLAIN: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”

1CO.14.BSB: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
1CO.14.KJV: Why tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serves not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.

1CO.14.BSB: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
1CO.14.KJV: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that you are mad?
1CO.14.PLAIN: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?

1CO.14.BSB: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
1CO.14.KJV: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believes not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
1CO.14.PLAIN: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,

1CO.14.BSB: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”
1CO.14.KJV: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
1CO.14.PLAIN: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”

1CO.14.BSB: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
1CO.14.KJV: How is it then, brothers? when you come together, every one of you has a psalm, has a doctrine, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to edifying.
1CO.14.PLAIN: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.

1CO.14.BSB: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
1CO.14.KJV: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
1CO.14.PLAIN: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.

1CO.14.BSB: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
1CO.14.KJV: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
1CO.14.PLAIN: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.

1CO.14.BSB: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
1CO.14.KJV: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

1CO.14.BSB: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
1CO.14.KJV: If any thing be revealed to another that sits by, let the first hold his peace.
1CO.14.PLAIN: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.

1CO.14.BSB: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
1CO.14.KJV: For you may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
1CO.14.PLAIN: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.

1CO.14.BSB: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
1CO.14.KJV: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
1CO.14.PLAIN: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.

1CO.14.BSB: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.
1CO.14.KJV: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
1CO.14.PLAIN: For God is not a God of confusion but of peace.

1CO.14.BSB: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
1CO.14.KJV: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted to them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience as also says the law.
1CO.14.PLAIN: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.

1CO.14.BSB: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
1CO.14.KJV: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
1CO.14.PLAIN: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.

1CO.14.BSB: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?
1CO.14.KJV: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it to you only?
1CO.14.PLAIN: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?

1CO.14.BSB: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
1CO.14.KJV: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write to you are the commandments of the Lord.
1CO.14.PLAIN: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.

1CO.14.BSB: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
1CO.14.KJV: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
1CO.14.PLAIN: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.

1CO.14.BSB: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
1CO.14.KJV: Why, brothers, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
1CO.14.PLAIN: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

1CO.14.BSB: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
1CO.14.KJV: Let all things be done decently and in order.
1CO.14.PLAIN: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.

1CO.15.BSB: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
1CO.15.KJV: Moreover, brothers, I declare to you the gospel which I preached to you, which also you have received, and wherein you stand;
1CO.15.PLAIN: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.

1CO.15.BSB: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
1CO.15.KJV: By which also you are saved, if you keep in memory what I preached to you, unless you have believed in vain.
1CO.15.PLAIN: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

1CO.15.BSB: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
1CO.15.KJV: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
1CO.15.PLAIN: For what I received I passed on to you as most important: that Christ died for our sins, just as the scriptures said,

1CO.15.BSB: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
1CO.15.KJV: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
1CO.15.PLAIN: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

1CO.15.BSB: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.
1CO.15.KJV: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
1CO.15.PLAIN: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.

1CO.15.BSB: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
1CO.15.KJV: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brothers at once; of whom the greater part remain to this present, but some are fallen asleep.
1CO.15.PLAIN: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

1CO.15.BSB: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
1CO.15.KJV: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

1CO.15.BSB: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
1CO.15.KJV: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
1CO.15.PLAIN: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.

1CO.15.BSB: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
1CO.15.KJV: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
1CO.15.PLAIN: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

1CO.15.BSB: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
1CO.15.KJV: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed on me was not in vain; but I labored more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
1CO.15.PLAIN: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

1CO.15.BSB: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
1CO.15.KJV: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

1CO.15.BSB: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
1CO.15.KJV: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
1CO.15.PLAIN: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

1CO.15.BSB: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
1CO.15.KJV: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
1CO.15.PLAIN: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

1CO.15.BSB: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
1CO.15.KJV: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
1CO.15.PLAIN: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.

1CO.15.BSB: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
1CO.15.KJV: Yes, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
1CO.15.PLAIN: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.

1CO.15.BSB: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
1CO.15.KJV: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
1CO.15.PLAIN: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.

1CO.15.BSB: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
1CO.15.KJV: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; you are yet in your sins.
1CO.15.PLAIN: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

1CO.15.BSB: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
1CO.15.KJV: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

1CO.15.BSB: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
1CO.15.KJV: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
1CO.15.PLAIN: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.

1CO.15.BSB: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
1CO.15.KJV: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the first fruits of them that slept.
1CO.15.PLAIN: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

1CO.15.BSB: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
1CO.15.KJV: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
1CO.15.PLAIN: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.

1CO.15.BSB: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
1CO.15.KJV: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
1CO.15.PLAIN: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

1CO.15.BSB: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.
1CO.15.KJV: But every man in his own order: Christ the first fruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
1CO.15.PLAIN: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.

1CO.15.BSB: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
1CO.15.KJV: Then comes the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.

1CO.15.BSB: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
1CO.15.KJV: For he must reign, till he has put all enemies under his feet.
1CO.15.PLAIN: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.

1CO.15.BSB: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
1CO.15.KJV: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
1CO.15.PLAIN: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

1CO.15.BSB: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
1CO.15.KJV: For he has put all things under his feet. But when he says all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
1CO.15.PLAIN: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.

1CO.15.BSB: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
1CO.15.KJV: And when all things shall be subdued to him, then shall the Son also himself be subject to him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
1CO.15.PLAIN: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.

1CO.15.BSB: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
1CO.15.KJV: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
1CO.15.PLAIN: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

1CO.15.BSB: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
1CO.15.KJV: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
1CO.15.PLAIN: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

1CO.15.BSB: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
1CO.15.KJV: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our LORD, I die daily.
1CO.15.PLAIN: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

1CO.15.BSB: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
1CO.15.KJV: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantages it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
1CO.15.PLAIN: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

1CO.15.BSB: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”
1CO.15.KJV: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”

1CO.15.BSB: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
1CO.15.KJV: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.

1CO.15.BSB: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”
1CO.15.KJV: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
1CO.15.PLAIN: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”

1CO.15.BSB: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
1CO.15.KJV: You fool, that which you sow is not quickened, except it die:
1CO.15.PLAIN: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

1CO.15.BSB: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
1CO.15.KJV: And that which you sow, you sow not that body that shall be, but bore grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
1CO.15.PLAIN: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.

1CO.15.BSB: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
1CO.15.KJV: But God gives it a body as it has pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
1CO.15.PLAIN: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.

1CO.15.BSB: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.
1CO.15.KJV: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.

1CO.15.BSB: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
1CO.15.KJV: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
1CO.15.PLAIN: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.

1CO.15.BSB: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
1CO.15.KJV: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differs from another star in glory.
1CO.15.PLAIN: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

1CO.15.BSB: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
1CO.15.KJV: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
1CO.15.PLAIN: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.

1CO.15.BSB: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
1CO.15.KJV: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
1CO.15.PLAIN: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

1CO.15.BSB: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
1CO.15.KJV: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
1CO.15.PLAIN: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

1CO.15.BSB: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
1CO.15.KJV: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
1CO.15.PLAIN: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.

1CO.15.BSB: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.
1CO.15.KJV: However, that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
1CO.15.PLAIN: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.

1CO.15.BSB: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.
1CO.15.KJV: The first man is of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord from heaven.
1CO.15.PLAIN: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.

1CO.15.BSB: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
1CO.15.KJV: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
1CO.15.PLAIN: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.

1CO.15.BSB: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
1CO.15.KJV: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
1CO.15.PLAIN: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.

1CO.15.BSB: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
1CO.15.KJV: Now this I say, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.
1CO.15.PLAIN: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

1CO.15.BSB: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
1CO.15.KJV: Behold, I show you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
1CO.15.PLAIN: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

1CO.15.BSB: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
1CO.15.KJV: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
1CO.15.PLAIN: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

1CO.15.BSB: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
1CO.15.KJV: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
1CO.15.PLAIN: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

1CO.15.BSB: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
1CO.15.KJV: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
1CO.15.PLAIN: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”

1CO.15.BSB: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”
1CO.15.KJV: O death, where is your sting? O grave, where is your victory?
1CO.15.PLAIN: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”

1CO.15.BSB: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
1CO.15.KJV: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
1CO.15.PLAIN: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

1CO.15.BSB: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
1CO.15.KJV: But thanks be to God, which gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
1CO.15.PLAIN: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

1CO.15.BSB: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
1CO.15.KJV: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be you steadfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, for as much as you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
1CO.15.PLAIN: So, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

1CO.16.BSB: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
1CO.16.KJV: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do you.
1CO.16.PLAIN: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:

1CO.16.BSB: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
1CO.16.KJV: On the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God has prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
1CO.16.PLAIN: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.

1CO.16.BSB: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
1CO.16.KJV: And when I come, whomsoever you shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality to Jerusalem.
1CO.16.PLAIN: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.

1CO.16.BSB: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
1CO.16.KJV: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
1CO.16.PLAIN: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.

1CO.16.BSB: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
1CO.16.KJV: Now I will come to you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
1CO.16.PLAIN: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.

1CO.16.BSB: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
1CO.16.KJV: And it may be that I will abide, yes, and winter with you, that you may bring me on my journey wherever I go.
1CO.16.PLAIN: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

1CO.16.BSB: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
1CO.16.KJV: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
1CO.16.PLAIN: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

1CO.16.BSB: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
1CO.16.KJV: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
1CO.16.PLAIN: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,

1CO.16.BSB: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
1CO.16.KJV: For a great door and effectual is opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
1CO.16.PLAIN: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.

1CO.16.BSB: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
1CO.16.KJV: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he works the work of the Lord, as I also do.
1CO.16.PLAIN: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.

1CO.16.BSB: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.
1CO.16.KJV: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come to me: for I look for him with the brothers.
1CO.16.PLAIN: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.

1CO.16.BSB: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
1CO.16.KJV: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come to you with the brothers: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
1CO.16.PLAIN: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

1CO.16.BSB: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
1CO.16.KJV: Watch you, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
1CO.16.PLAIN: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

1CO.16.BSB: Do everything in love.
1CO.16.KJV: Let all your things be done with charity.
1CO.16.PLAIN: Do everything in love.

1CO.16.BSB: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
1CO.16.KJV: I beseech you, brothers, (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
1CO.16.PLAIN: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,

1CO.16.BSB: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
1CO.16.KJV: That you submit yourselves to such, and to every one that helps with us, and labors.
1CO.16.PLAIN: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.

1CO.16.BSB: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
1CO.16.KJV: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
1CO.16.PLAIN: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

1CO.16.BSB: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.
1CO.16.KJV: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge you them that are such.
1CO.16.PLAIN: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.

1CO.16.BSB: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
1CO.16.KJV: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
1CO.16.PLAIN: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

1CO.16.BSB: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
1CO.16.KJV: All the brothers greet you. Greet you one another with an holy kiss.
1CO.16.PLAIN: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

1CO.16.BSB: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
1CO.16.KJV: The salutation of me Paul with my own hand.
1CO.16.PLAIN: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.

1CO.16.BSB: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
1CO.16.KJV: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
1CO.16.PLAIN: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!

1CO.16.BSB: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
1CO.16.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
1CO.16.PLAIN: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

1CO.16.BSB: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
1CO.16.KJV: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
1CO.16.PLAIN: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

2CO.1.BSB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
2CO.1.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
2CO.1.PLAIN: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:

2CO.1.BSB: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2CO.1.KJV: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
2CO.1.PLAIN: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2CO.1.BSB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
2CO.1.KJV: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
2CO.1.PLAIN: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

2CO.1.BSB: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
2CO.1.KJV: Who comforts us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted of God.
2CO.1.PLAIN: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the same comfort we ourselves received from God.

2CO.1.BSB: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
2CO.1.KJV: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also abounds by Christ.
2CO.1.PLAIN: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.

2CO.1.BSB: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
2CO.1.KJV: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
2CO.1.PLAIN: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.

2CO.1.BSB: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
2CO.1.KJV: And our hope of you is steadfast, knowing, that as you are partakers of the sufferings, so shall you be also of the consolation.
2CO.1.PLAIN: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.

2CO.1.BSB: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
2CO.1.KJV: For we would not, brothers, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, so that we despaired even of life:
2CO.1.PLAIN: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.

2CO.1.BSB: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
2CO.1.KJV: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raises the dead:
2CO.1.PLAIN: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.

2CO.1.BSB: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
2CO.1.KJV: Who delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
2CO.1.PLAIN: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,

2CO.1.BSB: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.
2CO.1.KJV: You also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed on us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
2CO.1.PLAIN: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.

2CO.1.BSB: And this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God—not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.
2CO.1.KJV: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
2CO.1.PLAIN: And this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God—not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.

2CO.1.BSB: For we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. And I hope that you will understand us completely,
2CO.1.KJV: For we write none other things to you, than what you read or acknowledge; and I trust you shall acknowledge even to the end;
2CO.1.PLAIN: For we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. And I hope that you will understand us completely,

2CO.1.BSB: as you have already understood us in part, so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
2CO.1.KJV: As also you have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as you also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
2CO.1.PLAIN: as you have already understood us in part, so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.

2CO.1.BSB: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
2CO.1.KJV: And in this confidence I was minded to come to you before, that you might have a second benefit;
2CO.1.PLAIN: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.

2CO.1.BSB: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to return to you from Macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to Judea.
2CO.1.KJV: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia to you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
2CO.1.PLAIN: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to return to you from Macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to Judea.

2CO.1.BSB: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” when I really mean “No, no”?
2CO.1.KJV: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yes yes, and no no?
2CO.1.PLAIN: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” when I really mean “No, no”?

2CO.1.BSB: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”
2CO.1.KJV: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yes and no.
2CO.1.PLAIN: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”

2CO.1.BSB: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”
2CO.1.KJV: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yes and no, but in him was yes.
2CO.1.PLAIN: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”

2CO.1.BSB: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. And so through Him, our “Amen” is spoken to the glory of God.
2CO.1.KJV: For all the promises of God in him are yes, and in him Amen, to the glory of God by us.
2CO.1.PLAIN: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are all 'Yes' in Christ — and so through him we say 'Amen' to the glory of God.

2CO.1.BSB: Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,
2CO.1.KJV: Now he which establishes us with you in Christ, and has anointed us, is God;
2CO.1.PLAIN: Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,

2CO.1.BSB: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.
2CO.1.KJV: Who has also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
2CO.1.PLAIN: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.

2CO.1.BSB: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.
2CO.1.KJV: Moreover I call God for a record on my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet to Corinth.
2CO.1.PLAIN: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.

2CO.1.BSB: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
2CO.1.KJV: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith you stand.
2CO.1.PLAIN: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.

2CO.2.BSB: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
2CO.2.KJV: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
2CO.2.PLAIN: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.

2CO.2.BSB: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
2CO.2.KJV: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that makes me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
2CO.2.PLAIN: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?

2CO.2.BSB: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be saddened by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
2CO.2.KJV: And I wrote this same to you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
2CO.2.PLAIN: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be saddened by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.

2CO.2.BSB: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much I love you.
2CO.2.KJV: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears; not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have more abundantly to you.
2CO.2.PLAIN: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much I love you.

2CO.2.BSB: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
2CO.2.KJV: But if any have caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
2CO.2.PLAIN: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.

2CO.2.BSB: The punishment imposed on him by the majority is sufficient for him.
2CO.2.KJV: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
2CO.2.PLAIN: The punishment imposed on him by the majority is sufficient for him.

2CO.2.BSB: So instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
2CO.2.KJV: So that contrariwise you ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
2CO.2.PLAIN: So instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.

2CO.2.BSB: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
2CO.2.KJV: Why I beseech you that you would confirm your love toward him.
2CO.2.PLAIN: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.

2CO.2.BSB: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
2CO.2.KJV: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether you be obedient in all things.
2CO.2.PLAIN: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

2CO.2.BSB: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,
2CO.2.KJV: To whom you forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
2CO.2.PLAIN: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,

2CO.2.BSB: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.
2CO.2.KJV: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
2CO.2.PLAIN: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.

2CO.2.BSB: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,
2CO.2.KJV: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened to me of the Lord,
2CO.2.PLAIN: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,

2CO.2.BSB: I had no peace in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.
2CO.2.KJV: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from there into Macedonia.
2CO.2.PLAIN: I had no peace in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.

2CO.2.BSB: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
2CO.2.KJV: Now thanks be to God, which always causes us to triumph in Christ, and makes manifest the aroma of his knowledge by us in every place.
2CO.2.PLAIN: Thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ and, through us, spreads the fragrance of knowing him everywhere.

2CO.2.BSB: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
2CO.2.KJV: For we are to God a sweet smell of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
2CO.2.PLAIN: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.

2CO.2.BSB: To the one, we are an odor of death and demise; to the other, a fragrance that brings life. And who is qualified for such a task?
2CO.2.KJV: To the one we are the smell of death to death; and to the other the smell of life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?
2CO.2.PLAIN: To the one, we are an odor of death and demise; to the other, a fragrance that brings life. And who is qualified for such a task?

2CO.2.BSB: For we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.
2CO.2.KJV: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
2CO.2.PLAIN: For we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.

2CO.3.BSB: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
2CO.3.KJV: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, letters of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
2CO.3.PLAIN: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

2CO.3.BSB: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
2CO.3.KJV: You are our letter written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
2CO.3.PLAIN: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.

2CO.3.BSB: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
2CO.3.KJV: For as much as you are manifestly declared to be the letter of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
2CO.3.PLAIN: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

2CO.3.BSB: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
2CO.3.KJV: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
2CO.3.PLAIN: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.

2CO.3.BSB: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
2CO.3.KJV: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
2CO.3.PLAIN: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.

2CO.3.BSB: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
2CO.3.KJV: Who also has made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter kills, but the spirit gives life.
2CO.3.PLAIN: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

2CO.3.BSB: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
2CO.3.KJV: But if the ministration of death, written and engraved in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not steadfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
2CO.3.PLAIN: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,

2CO.3.BSB: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
2CO.3.KJV: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
2CO.3.PLAIN: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?

2CO.3.BSB: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
2CO.3.KJV: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more does the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
2CO.3.PLAIN: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!

2CO.3.BSB: Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.
2CO.3.KJV: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excels.
2CO.3.PLAIN: Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.

2CO.3.BSB: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
2CO.3.KJV: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remains is glorious.
2CO.3.PLAIN: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!

2CO.3.BSB: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
2CO.3.KJV: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
2CO.3.PLAIN: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.

2CO.3.BSB: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
2CO.3.KJV: And not as Moses, which put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not steadfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
2CO.3.PLAIN: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.

2CO.3.BSB: But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.
2CO.3.KJV: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remains the same veil not taken away in the reading of the old testament; which veil is done away in Christ.
2CO.3.PLAIN: But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.

2CO.3.BSB: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
2CO.3.KJV: But even to this day, when Moses is read, the veil is on their heart.
2CO.3.PLAIN: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.

2CO.3.BSB: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
2CO.3.KJV: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the veil shall be taken away.
2CO.3.PLAIN: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

2CO.3.BSB: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
2CO.3.KJV: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
2CO.3.PLAIN: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

2CO.3.BSB: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
2CO.3.KJV: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the LORD.
2CO.3.PLAIN: And we all, with unveiled faces, reflecting the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

2CO.4.BSB: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
2CO.4.KJV: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
2CO.4.PLAIN: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.

2CO.4.BSB: Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
