2CO.4.KJV: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
2CO.4.PLAIN: Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

2CO.4.BSB: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
2CO.4.KJV: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
2CO.4.PLAIN: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.

2CO.4.BSB: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
2CO.4.KJV: In whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine to them.
2CO.4.PLAIN: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

2CO.4.BSB: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
2CO.4.KJV: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.
2CO.4.PLAIN: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.

2CO.4.BSB: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
2CO.4.KJV: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, has shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
2CO.4.PLAIN: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

2CO.4.BSB: Now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from God and not from us.
2CO.4.KJV: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
2CO.4.PLAIN: But we hold this treasure in clay jars, to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

2CO.4.BSB: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
2CO.4.KJV: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
2CO.4.PLAIN: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;

2CO.4.BSB: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
2CO.4.KJV: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
2CO.4.PLAIN: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.

2CO.4.BSB: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
2CO.4.KJV: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
2CO.4.PLAIN: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

2CO.4.BSB: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
2CO.4.KJV: For we which live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
2CO.4.PLAIN: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.

2CO.4.BSB: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
2CO.4.KJV: So then death works in us, but life in you.
2CO.4.PLAIN: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

2CO.4.BSB: And in keeping with what is written: “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,
2CO.4.KJV: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
2CO.4.PLAIN: And in keeping with what is written: “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,

2CO.4.BSB: knowing that the One who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in His presence.
2CO.4.KJV: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
2CO.4.PLAIN: knowing that the One who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in His presence.

2CO.4.BSB: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may overflow in thanksgiving, to the glory of God.
2CO.4.KJV: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
2CO.4.PLAIN: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may overflow in thanksgiving, to the glory of God.

2CO.4.BSB: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
2CO.4.KJV: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
2CO.4.PLAIN: So we don't lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

2CO.4.BSB: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
2CO.4.KJV: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, works for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
2CO.4.PLAIN: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

2CO.4.BSB: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
2CO.4.KJV: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
2CO.4.PLAIN: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen — because what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

2CO.5.BSB: Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
2CO.5.KJV: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
2CO.5.PLAIN: Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

2CO.5.BSB: For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,
2CO.5.KJV: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed on with our house which is from heaven:
2CO.5.PLAIN: For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,

2CO.5.BSB: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
2CO.5.KJV: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
2CO.5.PLAIN: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.

2CO.5.BSB: So while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
2CO.5.KJV: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed on, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
2CO.5.PLAIN: So while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.

2CO.5.BSB: And God has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come.
2CO.5.KJV: Now he that has worked us for the selfsame thing is God, who also has given to us the earnest of the Spirit.
2CO.5.PLAIN: And God has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come.

2CO.5.BSB: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
2CO.5.KJV: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
2CO.5.PLAIN: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.

2CO.5.BSB: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
2CO.5.KJV: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
2CO.5.PLAIN: For we live by faith, not by sight.

2CO.5.BSB: We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
2CO.5.KJV: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
2CO.5.PLAIN: We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

2CO.5.BSB: So we aspire to please Him, whether we are here in this body or away from it.
2CO.5.KJV: Why we labor, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
2CO.5.PLAIN: So we aspire to please Him, whether we are here in this body or away from it.

2CO.5.BSB: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
2CO.5.KJV: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he has done, whether it be good or bad.
2CO.5.PLAIN: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.

2CO.5.BSB: Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.
2CO.5.KJV: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest to God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
2CO.5.PLAIN: Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.

2CO.5.BSB: We are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
2CO.5.KJV: For we commend not ourselves again to you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that you may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
2CO.5.PLAIN: We are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.

2CO.5.BSB: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
2CO.5.KJV: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
2CO.5.PLAIN: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.

2CO.5.BSB: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
2CO.5.KJV: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
2CO.5.PLAIN: For Christ’s love compels us, because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.

2CO.5.BSB: And He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.
2CO.5.KJV: And that he died for all, that they which live should not from now on live to themselves, but to him which died for them, and rose again.
2CO.5.PLAIN: And He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.

2CO.5.BSB: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
2CO.5.KJV: Why from now on know we no man after the flesh: yes, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now from now on know we him no more.
2CO.5.PLAIN: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

2CO.5.BSB: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
2CO.5.KJV: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
2CO.5.PLAIN: So if anyone is in Christ, they are a new creation. The old has gone; the new has come.

2CO.5.BSB: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
2CO.5.KJV: And all things are of God, who has reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and has given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
2CO.5.PLAIN: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

2CO.5.BSB: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
2CO.5.KJV: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world to himself, not imputing their trespasses to them; and has committed to us the word of reconciliation.
2CO.5.PLAIN: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.

2CO.5.BSB: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
2CO.5.KJV: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ’s stead, be you reconciled to God.
2CO.5.PLAIN: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.

2CO.5.BSB: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
2CO.5.KJV: For he has made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
2CO.5.PLAIN: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

2CO.6.BSB: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
2CO.6.KJV: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that you receive not the grace of God in vain.
2CO.6.PLAIN: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.

2CO.6.BSB: For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
2CO.6.KJV: (For he says, I have heard you in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succored you: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
2CO.6.PLAIN: For he says, 'In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.' I tell you, now is the time of God's favor; now is the day of salvation.

2CO.6.BSB: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
2CO.6.KJV: Giving no offense in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
2CO.6.PLAIN: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.

2CO.6.BSB: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
2CO.6.KJV: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
2CO.6.PLAIN: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;

2CO.6.BSB: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;
2CO.6.KJV: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
2CO.6.PLAIN: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;

2CO.6.BSB: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;
2CO.6.KJV: By pureness, by knowledge, by long-suffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
2CO.6.PLAIN: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;

2CO.6.BSB: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
2CO.6.KJV: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
2CO.6.PLAIN: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;

2CO.6.BSB: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
2CO.6.KJV: By honor and dishonor, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
2CO.6.PLAIN: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;

2CO.6.BSB: as unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;
2CO.6.KJV: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
2CO.6.PLAIN: as unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;

2CO.6.BSB: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
2CO.6.KJV: As sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
2CO.6.PLAIN: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.

2CO.6.BSB: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.
2CO.6.KJV: O you Corinthians, our mouth is open to you, our heart is enlarged.
2CO.6.PLAIN: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.

2CO.6.BSB: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
2CO.6.KJV: You are not straitened in us, but you are straitened in your own bowels.
2CO.6.PLAIN: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.

2CO.6.BSB: As a fair exchange, I ask you as my children: Open wide your hearts also.
2CO.6.KJV: Now for a recompense in the same, (I speak as to my children,) be you also enlarged.
2CO.6.PLAIN: As a fair exchange, I ask you as my children: Open wide your hearts also.

2CO.6.BSB: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
2CO.6.KJV: Be you not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship has righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion has light with darkness?
2CO.6.PLAIN: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

2CO.6.BSB: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
2CO.6.KJV: And what concord has Christ with Belial? or what part has he that believes with an infidel?
2CO.6.PLAIN: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?

2CO.6.BSB: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
2CO.6.KJV: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? for you are the temple of the living God; as God has said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
2CO.6.PLAIN: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”

2CO.6.BSB: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
2CO.6.KJV: Why come out from among them, and be you separate, says the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.
2CO.6.PLAIN: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”

2CO.6.BSB: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
2CO.6.KJV: And will be a Father to you, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.
2CO.6.PLAIN: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”

2CO.7.BSB: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
2CO.7.KJV: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

2CO.7.BSB: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
2CO.7.KJV: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.

2CO.7.BSB: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
2CO.7.KJV: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die and live with you.
2CO.7.PLAIN: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.

2CO.7.BSB: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.
2CO.7.KJV: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.

2CO.7.BSB: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
2CO.7.KJV: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fights, within were fears.
2CO.7.PLAIN: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.

2CO.7.BSB: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,
2CO.7.KJV: Nevertheless God, that comforts those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
2CO.7.PLAIN: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,

2CO.7.BSB: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.
2CO.7.KJV: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation with which he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
2CO.7.PLAIN: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.

2CO.7.BSB: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it, I now see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time.
2CO.7.KJV: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same letter has made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it, I now see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time.

2CO.7.BSB: And now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you felt the sorrow that God had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.
2CO.7.KJV: Now I rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you sorrowed to repentance: for you were made sorry after a godly manner, that you might receive damage by us in nothing.
2CO.7.PLAIN: And now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you felt the sorrow that God had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.

2CO.7.BSB: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
2CO.7.KJV: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world works death.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

2CO.7.BSB: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
2CO.7.KJV: For behold this selfsame thing, that you sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it worked in you, yes, what clearing of yourselves, yes, what indignation, yes, what fear, yes, what vehement desire, yes, what zeal, yes, what revenge! In all things you have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

2CO.7.BSB: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.
2CO.7.KJV: Why, though I wrote to you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear to you.
2CO.7.PLAIN: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.

2CO.7.BSB: On account of this, we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
2CO.7.KJV: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yes, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
2CO.7.PLAIN: On account of this, we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

2CO.7.BSB: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
2CO.7.KJV: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spoke all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
2CO.7.PLAIN: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.

2CO.7.BSB: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
2CO.7.KJV: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembers the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling you received him.
2CO.7.PLAIN: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.

2CO.7.BSB: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
2CO.7.KJV: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
2CO.7.PLAIN: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.

2CO.8.BSB: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.
2CO.8.KJV: Moreover, brothers, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
2CO.8.PLAIN: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.

2CO.8.BSB: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.
2CO.8.KJV: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their liberality.
2CO.8.PLAIN: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.

2CO.8.BSB: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. Of their own accord,
2CO.8.KJV: For to their power, I bear record, yes, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
2CO.8.PLAIN: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. Of their own accord,

2CO.8.BSB: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.
2CO.8.KJV: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift, and take on us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
2CO.8.PLAIN: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.

2CO.8.BSB: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, because it was the will of God.
2CO.8.KJV: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us by the will of God.
2CO.8.PLAIN: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, because it was the will of God.

2CO.8.BSB: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
2CO.8.KJV: So that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
2CO.8.PLAIN: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.

2CO.8.BSB: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you—see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
2CO.8.KJV: Therefore, as you abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that you abound in this grace also.
2CO.8.PLAIN: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you—see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

2CO.8.BSB: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.
2CO.8.KJV: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
2CO.8.PLAIN: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.

2CO.8.BSB: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
2CO.8.KJV: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might be rich.
2CO.8.PLAIN: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ: though he was rich, for your sakes he became poor, so that through his poverty you might become rich.

2CO.8.BSB: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
2CO.8.KJV: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
2CO.8.PLAIN: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.

2CO.8.BSB: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it just as eagerly as you began, according to your means.
2CO.8.KJV: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which you have.
2CO.8.PLAIN: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it just as eagerly as you began, according to your means.

2CO.8.BSB: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
2CO.8.KJV: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man has, and not according to that he has not.
2CO.8.PLAIN: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.

2CO.8.BSB: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.
2CO.8.KJV: For I mean not that other men be eased, and you burdened:
2CO.8.PLAIN: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.

2CO.8.BSB: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. Then there will be equality.
2CO.8.KJV: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
2CO.8.PLAIN: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. Then there will be equality.

2CO.8.BSB: As it is written: “He who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.”
2CO.8.KJV: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
2CO.8.PLAIN: As it is written: “He who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.”

2CO.8.BSB: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.
2CO.8.KJV: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
2CO.8.PLAIN: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.

2CO.8.BSB: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.
2CO.8.KJV: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went to you.
2CO.8.PLAIN: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.

2CO.8.BSB: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.
2CO.8.KJV: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
2CO.8.PLAIN: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.

2CO.8.BSB: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the offering—the gracious gift we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.
2CO.8.KJV: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
2CO.8.PLAIN: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the offering—the gracious gift we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.

2CO.8.BSB: We hope to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.
2CO.8.KJV: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
2CO.8.PLAIN: We hope to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.

2CO.8.BSB: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
2CO.8.KJV: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
2CO.8.PLAIN: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.

2CO.8.BSB: And we are sending along with them our brother whose earnestness has been proven many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.
2CO.8.KJV: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, on the great confidence which I have in you.
2CO.8.PLAIN: And we are sending along with them our brother whose earnestness has been proven many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.

2CO.8.BSB: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, to the glory of Christ.
2CO.8.KJV: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellow helper concerning you: or our brothers be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
2CO.8.PLAIN: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, to the glory of Christ.

2CO.8.BSB: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
2CO.8.KJV: Why show you to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
2CO.8.PLAIN: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.

2CO.9.BSB: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.
2CO.9.KJV: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
2CO.9.PLAIN: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.

2CO.9.BSB: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.
2CO.9.KJV: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has provoked very many.
2CO.9.PLAIN: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.

2CO.9.BSB: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.
2CO.9.KJV: Yet have I sent the brothers, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, you may be ready:
2CO.9.PLAIN: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.

2CO.9.BSB: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.
2CO.9.KJV: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, you) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
2CO.9.PLAIN: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.

2CO.9.BSB: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
2CO.9.KJV: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brothers, that they would go before to you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof you had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
2CO.9.PLAIN: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.

2CO.9.BSB: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
2CO.9.KJV: But this I say, He which sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
2CO.9.PLAIN: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

2CO.9.BSB: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.
2CO.9.KJV: Every man according as he purposes in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loves a cheerful giver.
2CO.9.PLAIN: Each of you should give what you've decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under pressure, for God loves a cheerful giver.

2CO.9.BSB: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
2CO.9.KJV: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
2CO.9.PLAIN: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all you need, you will overflow in every good work.

2CO.9.BSB: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
2CO.9.KJV: (As it is written, He has dispersed abroad; he has given to the poor: his righteousness remains for ever.
2CO.9.PLAIN: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”

2CO.9.BSB: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.
2CO.9.KJV: Now he that ministers seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
2CO.9.PLAIN: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.

2CO.9.BSB: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to God.
2CO.9.KJV: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causes through us thanksgiving to God.
2CO.9.PLAIN: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to God.

2CO.9.BSB: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.
2CO.9.KJV: For the administration of this service not only supplies the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings to God;
2CO.9.PLAIN: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.

2CO.9.BSB: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
2CO.9.KJV: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection to the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution to them, and to all men;
2CO.9.PLAIN: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.

2CO.9.BSB: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.
2CO.9.KJV: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
2CO.9.PLAIN: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

2CO.9.BSB: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
2CO.9.KJV: Thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift.
2CO.9.PLAIN: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!

2CO.10.BSB: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.
2CO.10.KJV: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
2CO.10.PLAIN: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.

2CO.10.BSB: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.
2CO.10.KJV: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, with which I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
2CO.10.PLAIN: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.

2CO.10.BSB: For though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.
2CO.10.KJV: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
2CO.10.PLAIN: For though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.

2CO.10.BSB: The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the world. Instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
2CO.10.KJV: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
2CO.10.PLAIN: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of this world; they have divine power to tear down strongholds.

2CO.10.BSB: We tear down arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
2CO.10.KJV: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
2CO.10.PLAIN: We tear down arguments and every pretension that sets itself up against the knowledge of God, and we take every thought captive to make it obey Christ.

2CO.10.BSB: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
2CO.10.KJV: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
2CO.10.PLAIN: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.

2CO.10.BSB: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.
2CO.10.KJV: Do you look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.
2CO.10.PLAIN: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.

2CO.10.BSB: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
2CO.10.KJV: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord has given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
2CO.10.PLAIN: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.

2CO.10.BSB: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.
2CO.10.KJV: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
2CO.10.PLAIN: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.

2CO.10.BSB: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”
2CO.10.KJV: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
2CO.10.PLAIN: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”

2CO.10.BSB: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
2CO.10.KJV: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
2CO.10.PLAIN: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.

2CO.10.BSB: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.
2CO.10.KJV: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
2CO.10.PLAIN: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.

2CO.10.BSB: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us—a field that reaches even to you.
2CO.10.KJV: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God has distributed to us, a measure to reach even to you.
2CO.10.PLAIN: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us—a field that reaches even to you.

2CO.10.BSB: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.
2CO.10.KJV: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not to you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
2CO.10.PLAIN: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.

2CO.10.BSB: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,
2CO.10.KJV: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labors; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
2CO.10.PLAIN: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,

2CO.10.BSB: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
2CO.10.KJV: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
2CO.10.PLAIN: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.

2CO.10.BSB: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
2CO.10.KJV: But he that glories, let him glory in the Lord.
2CO.10.PLAIN: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”

2CO.10.BSB: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
2CO.10.KJV: For not he that commends himself is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
2CO.10.PLAIN: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

2CO.11.BSB: I hope you will bear with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.
2CO.11.KJV: Would to God you could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
2CO.11.PLAIN: I hope you will bear with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.

2CO.11.BSB: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
2CO.11.KJV: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
2CO.11.PLAIN: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

2CO.11.BSB: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.
2CO.11.KJV: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtlety, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
2CO.11.PLAIN: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.

2CO.11.BSB: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it way too easily.
2CO.11.KJV: For if he that comes preaches another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if you receive another spirit, which you have not received, or another gospel, which you have not accepted, you might well bear with him.
2CO.11.PLAIN: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it way too easily.

2CO.11.BSB: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
2CO.11.KJV: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very most chief apostles.
2CO.11.PLAIN: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”

2CO.11.BSB: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.
2CO.11.KJV: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.

2CO.11.BSB: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?
2CO.11.KJV: Have I committed an offense in abasing myself that you might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
2CO.11.PLAIN: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?

2CO.11.BSB: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.
2CO.11.KJV: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
2CO.11.PLAIN: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.

2CO.11.BSB: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.
2CO.11.KJV: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brothers which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome to you, and so will I keep myself.
2CO.11.PLAIN: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.

2CO.11.BSB: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
2CO.11.KJV: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
2CO.11.PLAIN: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.

2CO.11.BSB: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
2CO.11.KJV: Why? because I love you not? God knows.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!

2CO.11.BSB: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.
2CO.11.KJV: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
2CO.11.PLAIN: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.

2CO.11.BSB: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
2CO.11.KJV: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
2CO.11.PLAIN: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.

2CO.11.BSB: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
2CO.11.KJV: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
2CO.11.PLAIN: And no wonder — for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

2CO.11.BSB: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.
2CO.11.KJV: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
2CO.11.PLAIN: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.

2CO.11.BSB: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
2CO.11.KJV: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
2CO.11.PLAIN: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.

2CO.11.BSB: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
2CO.11.KJV: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
2CO.11.PLAIN: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

2CO.11.BSB: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.
2CO.11.KJV: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.

2CO.11.BSB: For you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.
2CO.11.KJV: For you suffer fools gladly, seeing you yourselves are wise.
2CO.11.PLAIN: For you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.

2CO.11.BSB: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
2CO.11.KJV: For you suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
2CO.11.PLAIN: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.

2CO.11.BSB: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.
2CO.11.KJV: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. However, when ever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
2CO.11.PLAIN: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.

2CO.11.BSB: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
2CO.11.KJV: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

2CO.11.BSB: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking like I am out of my mind, but I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.
2CO.11.KJV: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labors more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking like I am out of my mind, but I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.

2CO.11.BSB: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
2CO.11.KJV: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.

2CO.11.BSB: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.
2CO.11.KJV: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
2CO.11.PLAIN: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.

2CO.11.BSB: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,
2CO.11.KJV: In journeys often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by my own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brothers;
2CO.11.PLAIN: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,

2CO.11.BSB: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.
2CO.11.KJV: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
2CO.11.PLAIN: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.

2CO.11.BSB: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
2CO.11.KJV: Beside those things that are without, that which comes on me daily, the care of all the churches.
2CO.11.PLAIN: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

2CO.11.BSB: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?
2CO.11.KJV: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
2CO.11.PLAIN: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?

2CO.11.BSB: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
2CO.11.KJV: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern my infirmities.
2CO.11.PLAIN: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

2CO.11.BSB: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
2CO.11.KJV: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for ever more, knows that I lie not.
2CO.11.PLAIN: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.

2CO.11.BSB: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.
2CO.11.KJV: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
2CO.11.PLAIN: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.

2CO.11.BSB: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.
2CO.11.KJV: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
2CO.11.PLAIN: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.

2CO.12.BSB: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
2CO.12.KJV: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
2CO.12.PLAIN: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.

2CO.12.BSB: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
2CO.12.KJV: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knows;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
2CO.12.PLAIN: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.

2CO.12.BSB: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—
2CO.12.KJV: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knows;)
2CO.12.PLAIN: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—

2CO.12.BSB: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell.
2CO.12.KJV: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
2CO.12.PLAIN: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell.

2CO.12.BSB: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
2CO.12.KJV: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in my infirmities.
2CO.12.PLAIN: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.

2CO.12.BSB: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
2CO.12.KJV: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he sees me to be, or that he hears of me.
2CO.12.PLAIN: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,

2CO.12.BSB: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
2CO.12.KJV: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
2CO.12.PLAIN: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

2CO.12.BSB: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
2CO.12.KJV: For this thing I sought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
2CO.12.PLAIN: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

2CO.12.BSB: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
2CO.12.KJV: And he said to me, My grace is sufficient for you: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
2CO.12.PLAIN: But he said to me, 'My grace is enough for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.' So I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may rest on me.

2CO.12.BSB: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
2CO.12.KJV: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
2CO.12.PLAIN: That's why, for Christ's sake, I take pleasure in weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

2CO.12.BSB: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
2CO.12.KJV: I am become a fool in glorying; you have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very most chief apostles, though I be nothing.
2CO.12.PLAIN: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.

2CO.12.BSB: The true marks of an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.
2CO.12.KJV: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
2CO.12.PLAIN: The true marks of an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.

2CO.12.BSB: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
2CO.12.KJV: For what is it wherein you were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
2CO.12.PLAIN: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

2CO.12.BSB: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
2CO.12.KJV: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
2CO.12.PLAIN: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

2CO.12.BSB: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?
2CO.12.KJV: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
2CO.12.PLAIN: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?

2CO.12.BSB: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.
2CO.12.KJV: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
2CO.12.PLAIN: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.

2CO.12.BSB: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?
2CO.12.KJV: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent to you?
2CO.12.PLAIN: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?

2CO.12.BSB: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?
2CO.12.KJV: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
2CO.12.PLAIN: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?

2CO.12.BSB: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
2CO.12.KJV: Again, think you that we excuse ourselves to you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
2CO.12.PLAIN: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.

2CO.12.BSB: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
2CO.12.KJV: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found to you such as you would not: lest there be debates, contentions, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, arrogance, tumults:
2CO.12.PLAIN: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.

2CO.12.BSB: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
2CO.12.KJV: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall mourn many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
2CO.12.PLAIN: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.

2CO.13.BSB: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
2CO.13.KJV: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
2CO.13.PLAIN: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”

2CO.13.BSB: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
2CO.13.KJV: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
2CO.13.PLAIN: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,

2CO.13.BSB: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
2CO.13.KJV: Since you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
2CO.13.PLAIN: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.

2CO.13.BSB: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.
2CO.13.KJV: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
2CO.13.PLAIN: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.

2CO.13.BSB: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Can’t you see for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?
2CO.13.KJV: Examine yourselves, whether you be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know you not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except you be reprobates?
2CO.13.PLAIN: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Can’t you see for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?

2CO.13.BSB: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
2CO.13.KJV: But I trust that you shall know that we are not reprobates.
2CO.13.PLAIN: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.

2CO.13.BSB: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
2CO.13.KJV: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that you should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
2CO.13.PLAIN: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.

2CO.13.BSB: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
2CO.13.KJV: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
2CO.13.PLAIN: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

2CO.13.BSB: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.
2CO.13.KJV: For we are glad, when we are weak, and you are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
2CO.13.PLAIN: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.

2CO.13.BSB: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
2CO.13.KJV: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord has given me to edification, and not to destruction.
2CO.13.PLAIN: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

2CO.13.BSB: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
2CO.13.KJV: Finally, brothers, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
2CO.13.PLAIN: Finally, brothers and sisters, rejoice. Aim for full restoration, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace — and the God of love and peace will be with you.

2CO.13.BSB: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
2CO.13.KJV: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
2CO.13.PLAIN: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

2CO.13.BSB: All the saints send you greetings.
2CO.13.PLAIN: All the saints send you greetings.

2CO.13.BSB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
2CO.13.KJV: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
