EPH.4.BSB: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
EPH.4.KJV: If so be that you have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
EPH.4.PLAIN: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—

EPH.4.BSB: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
EPH.4.KJV: That you put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
EPH.4.PLAIN: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;

EPH.4.BSB: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
EPH.4.KJV: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
EPH.4.PLAIN: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;

EPH.4.BSB: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
EPH.4.KJV: And that you put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
EPH.4.PLAIN: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

EPH.4.BSB: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
EPH.4.KJV: Why putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbor: for we are members one of another.
EPH.4.PLAIN: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.

EPH.4.BSB: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
EPH.4.KJV: Be you angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down on your wrath:
EPH.4.PLAIN: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,

EPH.4.BSB: and do not give the devil a foothold.
EPH.4.KJV: Neither give place to the devil.
EPH.4.PLAIN: and do not give the devil a foothold.

EPH.4.BSB: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
EPH.4.KJV: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needs.
EPH.4.PLAIN: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.

EPH.4.BSB: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
EPH.4.KJV: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace to the hearers.
EPH.4.PLAIN: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.

EPH.4.BSB: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
EPH.4.KJV: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby you are sealed to the day of redemption.
EPH.4.PLAIN: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

EPH.4.BSB: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
EPH.4.KJV: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamor, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
EPH.4.PLAIN: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.

EPH.4.BSB: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
EPH.4.KJV: And be you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake has forgiven you.
EPH.4.PLAIN: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other, just as God in Christ forgave you.

EPH.5.BSB: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
EPH.5.KJV: Be you therefore followers of God, as dear children;
EPH.5.PLAIN: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,

EPH.5.BSB: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
EPH.5.KJV: And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, and has given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling smell.
EPH.5.PLAIN: And walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

EPH.5.BSB: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
EPH.5.KJV: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becomes saints;
EPH.5.PLAIN: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.

EPH.5.BSB: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
EPH.5.KJV: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.

EPH.5.BSB: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
EPH.5.KJV: For this you know, that no fornicator, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
EPH.5.PLAIN: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

EPH.5.BSB: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
EPH.5.KJV: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things comes the wrath of God on the children of disobedience.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.

EPH.5.BSB: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
EPH.5.KJV: Be not you therefore partakers with them.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Therefore do not be partakers with them.

EPH.5.BSB: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
EPH.5.KJV: For you were sometimes darkness, but now are you light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
EPH.5.PLAIN: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

EPH.5.BSB: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
EPH.5.KJV: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
EPH.5.PLAIN: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.

EPH.5.BSB: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
EPH.5.KJV: Proving what is acceptable to the Lord.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.

EPH.5.BSB: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
EPH.5.KJV: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

EPH.5.BSB: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
EPH.5.KJV: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
EPH.5.PLAIN: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.

EPH.5.BSB: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
EPH.5.KJV: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatever does make manifest is light.
EPH.5.PLAIN: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.

EPH.5.BSB: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
EPH.5.KJV: Why he says, Awake you that sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light.
EPH.5.PLAIN: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

EPH.5.BSB: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
EPH.5.KJV: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
EPH.5.PLAIN: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,

EPH.5.BSB: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
EPH.5.KJV: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
EPH.5.PLAIN: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

EPH.5.BSB: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
EPH.5.KJV: Why be you not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.

EPH.5.BSB: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
EPH.5.KJV: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
EPH.5.PLAIN: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.

EPH.5.BSB: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
EPH.5.KJV: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
EPH.5.PLAIN: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,

EPH.5.BSB: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
EPH.5.KJV: Giving thanks always for all things to God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
EPH.5.PLAIN: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

EPH.5.BSB: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
EPH.5.KJV: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

EPH.5.BSB: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
EPH.5.KJV: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.

EPH.5.BSB: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
EPH.5.KJV: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the savior of the body.
EPH.5.PLAIN: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.

EPH.5.BSB: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
EPH.5.KJV: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

EPH.5.BSB: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
EPH.5.KJV: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
EPH.5.PLAIN: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her

EPH.5.BSB: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
EPH.5.KJV: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
EPH.5.PLAIN: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,

EPH.5.BSB: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
EPH.5.KJV: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
EPH.5.PLAIN: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.

EPH.5.BSB: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
EPH.5.KJV: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself.
EPH.5.PLAIN: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

EPH.5.BSB: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
EPH.5.KJV: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord the church:
EPH.5.PLAIN: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.

EPH.5.BSB: For we are members of His body.
EPH.5.KJV: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
EPH.5.PLAIN: For we are members of His body.

EPH.5.BSB: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
EPH.5.KJV: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
EPH.5.PLAIN: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”

EPH.5.BSB: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
EPH.5.KJV: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
EPH.5.PLAIN: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.

EPH.5.BSB: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
EPH.5.KJV: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
EPH.5.PLAIN: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

EPH.6.BSB: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
EPH.6.KJV: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

EPH.6.BSB: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
EPH.6.KJV: Honor your father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;
EPH.6.PLAIN: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),

EPH.6.BSB: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
EPH.6.KJV: That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.
EPH.6.PLAIN: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”

EPH.6.BSB: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
EPH.6.KJV: And, you fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

EPH.6.BSB: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
EPH.6.KJV: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;
EPH.6.PLAIN: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.

EPH.6.BSB: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
EPH.6.KJV: Not with eye-service, as men pleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
EPH.6.PLAIN: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.

EPH.6.BSB: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
EPH.6.KJV: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
EPH.6.PLAIN: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,

EPH.6.BSB: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
EPH.6.KJV: Knowing that whatever good thing any man does, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
EPH.6.PLAIN: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.

EPH.6.BSB: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
EPH.6.KJV: And, you masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
EPH.6.PLAIN: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.

EPH.6.BSB: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
EPH.6.KJV: Finally, my brothers, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

EPH.6.BSB: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
EPH.6.KJV: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Put on the full armor of God, so you can stand against the devil's schemes.

EPH.6.BSB: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
EPH.6.KJV: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
EPH.6.PLAIN: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, the authorities, the powers of this dark world, and the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places.

EPH.6.BSB: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
EPH.6.KJV: Why take to you the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.

EPH.6.BSB: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
EPH.6.KJV: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
EPH.6.PLAIN: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,

EPH.6.BSB: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
EPH.6.KJV: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
EPH.6.PLAIN: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.

EPH.6.BSB: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
EPH.6.KJV: Above all, taking the shield of faith, with which you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
EPH.6.PLAIN: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

EPH.6.BSB: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
EPH.6.KJV: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
EPH.6.PLAIN: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

EPH.6.BSB: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
EPH.6.KJV: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
EPH.6.PLAIN: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.

EPH.6.BSB: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
EPH.6.KJV: And for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
EPH.6.PLAIN: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,

EPH.6.BSB: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.
EPH.6.KJV: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
EPH.6.PLAIN: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.

EPH.6.BSB: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
EPH.6.KJV: But that you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
EPH.6.PLAIN: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.

EPH.6.BSB: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
EPH.6.KJV: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
EPH.6.PLAIN: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.

EPH.6.BSB: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
EPH.6.KJV: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

EPH.6.BSB: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
EPH.6.KJV: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
EPH.6.PLAIN: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.

PHP.1.BSB: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
PHP.1.KJV: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
PHP.1.PLAIN: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:

PHP.1.BSB: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
PHP.1.KJV: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
PHP.1.PLAIN: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PHP.1.BSB: I thank my God every time I remember you.
PHP.1.KJV: I thank my God on every remembrance of you,
PHP.1.PLAIN: I thank my God every time I remember you.

PHP.1.BSB: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
PHP.1.KJV: Always in every prayer of my for you all making request with joy,
PHP.1.PLAIN: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,

PHP.1.BSB: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
PHP.1.KJV: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
PHP.1.PLAIN: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

PHP.1.BSB: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
PHP.1.KJV: Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
PHP.1.PLAIN: I'm confident of this: that the one who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.BSB: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
PHP.1.KJV: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of my grace.
PHP.1.PLAIN: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.

PHP.1.BSB: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
PHP.1.KJV: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
PHP.1.PLAIN: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

PHP.1.BSB: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
PHP.1.KJV: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
PHP.1.PLAIN: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,

PHP.1.BSB: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
PHP.1.KJV: That you may approve things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense till the day of Christ.
PHP.1.PLAIN: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

PHP.1.BSB: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
PHP.1.KJV: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
PHP.1.PLAIN: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

PHP.1.BSB: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
PHP.1.KJV: But I would you should understand, brothers, that the things which happened to me have fallen out rather to the furtherance of the gospel;
PHP.1.PLAIN: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.

PHP.1.BSB: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
PHP.1.KJV: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
PHP.1.PLAIN: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.

PHP.1.BSB: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
PHP.1.KJV: And many of the brothers in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
PHP.1.PLAIN: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.

PHP.1.BSB: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
PHP.1.KJV: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
PHP.1.PLAIN: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.

PHP.4.BSB: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
PHP.4.KJV: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatever state I am, therewith to be content.
PHP.4.PLAIN: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.

PHP.4.BSB: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.
PHP.4.KJV: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
PHP.4.PLAIN: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.

PHP.4.BSB: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
PHP.4.KJV: I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me.
PHP.4.PLAIN: I can do all things through Christ, who gives me strength.

PHP.4.BSB: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
PHP.4.KJV: Notwithstanding you have well done, that you did communicate with my affliction.
PHP.4.PLAIN: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.

PHP.4.BSB: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
PHP.4.KJV: Now you Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but you only.
PHP.4.PLAIN: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.

PHP.4.BSB: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
PHP.4.KJV: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my necessity.
PHP.4.PLAIN: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.

PHP.4.BSB: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
PHP.4.KJV: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
PHP.4.PLAIN: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.

PHP.4.BSB: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
PHP.4.KJV: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well pleasing to God.
PHP.4.PLAIN: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

PHP.4.BSB: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
PHP.4.KJV: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
PHP.4.PLAIN: And my God will supply all your needs according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

PHP.4.BSB: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
PHP.4.KJV: Now to God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
PHP.4.PLAIN: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.

PHP.4.BSB: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
PHP.4.KJV: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers which are with me greet you.
PHP.4.PLAIN: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.

PHP.4.BSB: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
PHP.4.KJV: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household.
PHP.4.PLAIN: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.

PHP.4.BSB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
PHP.4.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
PHP.4.PLAIN: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

COL.1.BSB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
COL.1.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
COL.1.PLAIN: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

COL.1.BSB: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
COL.1.KJV: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
COL.1.PLAIN: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

COL.1.BSB: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
COL.1.KJV: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
COL.1.PLAIN: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

COL.1.BSB: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
COL.1.KJV: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have to all the saints,
COL.1.PLAIN: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—

COL.1.BSB: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel
COL.1.KJV: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof you heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
COL.1.PLAIN: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel

COL.1.BSB: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
COL.1.KJV: Which is come to you, as it is in all the world; and brings forth fruit, as it does also in you, since the day you heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
COL.1.PLAIN: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.

COL.1.BSB: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
COL.1.KJV: As you also learned of Epaphras our dear fellow servant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
COL.1.PLAIN: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

COL.1.BSB: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.
COL.1.KJV: Who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
COL.1.PLAIN: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.

COL.1.BSB: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
COL.1.KJV: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that you might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
COL.1.PLAIN: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

COL.1.BSB: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
COL.1.KJV: That you might walk worthy of the Lord to all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
COL.1.PLAIN: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

COL.1.BSB: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully
COL.1.KJV: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, to all patience and long-suffering with joyfulness;
COL.1.PLAIN: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

COL.1.BSB: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.
COL.1.KJV: Giving thanks to the Father, which has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
COL.1.PLAIN: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.

COL.1.BSB: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
COL.1.KJV: Who has delivered us from the power of darkness, and has translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
COL.1.PLAIN: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

COL.1.BSB: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
COL.1.KJV: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
COL.1.PLAIN: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

COL.1.BSB: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
COL.1.KJV: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
COL.1.PLAIN: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

COL.1.BSB: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.
COL.1.KJV: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
COL.1.PLAIN: For in him all things were created, in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible — whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through him and for him.

COL.1.BSB: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
COL.1.KJV: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
COL.1.PLAIN: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

COL.1.BSB: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
COL.1.KJV: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
COL.1.PLAIN: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.

COL.1.BSB: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
COL.1.KJV: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fullness dwell;
COL.1.PLAIN: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,

COL.1.BSB: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
COL.1.KJV: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things to himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
COL.1.PLAIN: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.

COL.1.BSB: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.
COL.1.KJV: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now has he reconciled
COL.1.PLAIN: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.

COL.1.BSB: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
COL.1.KJV: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and blameless and unreproveable in his sight:
COL.1.PLAIN: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—

COL.1.BSB: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
COL.1.KJV: If you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which you have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
COL.1.PLAIN: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

COL.1.BSB: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
COL.1.KJV: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
COL.1.PLAIN: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.

COL.1.BSB: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,
COL.1.KJV: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God;
COL.1.PLAIN: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,

COL.1.BSB: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.
COL.1.KJV: Even the mystery which has been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
COL.1.PLAIN: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.

COL.1.BSB: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
COL.1.KJV: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
COL.1.PLAIN: God chose to make known among the nations the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

COL.1.BSB: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.
COL.1.KJV: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
COL.1.PLAIN: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.

COL.1.BSB: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.
COL.1.KJV: Whereunto I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
COL.1.PLAIN: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.

COL.2.BSB: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
COL.2.KJV: For I would that you knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
COL.2.PLAIN: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,

COL.2.BSB: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
COL.2.KJV: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and to all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgment of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
COL.2.PLAIN: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,

COL.2.BSB: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
COL.2.KJV: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
COL.2.PLAIN: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

COL.2.BSB: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
COL.2.KJV: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
COL.2.PLAIN: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.

COL.2.BSB: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
COL.2.KJV: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and beholding your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
COL.2.PLAIN: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.

COL.2.BSB: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
COL.2.KJV: As you have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk you in him:
COL.2.PLAIN: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live your lives in him,

COL.2.BSB: rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
COL.2.KJV: Rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
COL.2.PLAIN: rooted and built up in him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

COL.2.BSB: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
COL.2.KJV: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
COL.2.PLAIN: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.

COL.2.BSB: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.
COL.2.KJV: For in him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily.
COL.2.PLAIN: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.

COL.2.BSB: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
COL.2.KJV: And you are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
COL.2.PLAIN: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.

COL.2.BSB: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
COL.2.KJV: In whom also you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
COL.2.PLAIN: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.

COL.2.BSB: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.
COL.2.KJV: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who has raised him from the dead.
COL.2.PLAIN: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.

COL.2.BSB: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
COL.2.KJV: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, has he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
COL.2.PLAIN: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,

COL.2.BSB: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
COL.2.KJV: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
COL.2.PLAIN: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!

COL.2.BSB: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.
COL.2.KJV: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
COL.2.PLAIN: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

COL.2.BSB: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
COL.2.KJV: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holy day, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
COL.2.PLAIN: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.

COL.2.BSB: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
COL.2.KJV: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
COL.2.PLAIN: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.

COL.2.BSB: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.
COL.2.KJV: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
COL.2.PLAIN: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.

COL.2.BSB: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
COL.2.KJV: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increases with the increase of God.
COL.2.PLAIN: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.

COL.2.BSB: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
COL.2.KJV: Why if you be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are you subject to ordinances,
COL.2.PLAIN: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:

COL.2.BSB: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?
COL.2.KJV: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
COL.2.PLAIN: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?

COL.2.BSB: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
COL.2.KJV: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
COL.2.PLAIN: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.

COL.2.BSB: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
COL.2.KJV: Which things have indeed a show of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honor to the satisfying of the flesh.
COL.2.PLAIN: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.

COL.3.BSB: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
COL.3.KJV: If you then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sits on the right hand of God.
COL.3.PLAIN: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

COL.3.BSB: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
COL.3.KJV: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
COL.3.PLAIN: Set your mind on things above, not on earthly things.

COL.3.BSB: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
COL.3.KJV: For you are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
COL.3.PLAIN: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

COL.3.BSB: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
COL.3.KJV: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall you also appear with him in glory.
COL.3.PLAIN: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.

COL.3.BSB: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
COL.3.KJV: Mortify therefore your members which are on the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
COL.3.PLAIN: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.

COL.3.BSB: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
COL.3.KJV: For which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience:
COL.3.PLAIN: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.

COL.3.BSB: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.
COL.3.KJV: In the which you also walked some time, when you lived in them.
COL.3.PLAIN: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.

COL.3.BSB: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
COL.3.KJV: But now you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
COL.3.PLAIN: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

COL.3.BSB: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
COL.3.KJV: Lie not one to another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his deeds;
COL.3.PLAIN: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,

COL.3.BSB: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
COL.3.KJV: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
COL.3.PLAIN: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

COL.3.BSB: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
COL.3.KJV: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
COL.3.PLAIN: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.

COL.3.BSB: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
COL.3.KJV: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, long-suffering;
COL.3.PLAIN: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

COL.3.BSB: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
COL.3.KJV: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do you.
COL.3.PLAIN: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

COL.3.BSB: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
COL.3.KJV: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfection.
COL.3.PLAIN: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.

COL.3.BSB: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
COL.3.KJV: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also you are called in one body; and be you thankful.
COL.3.PLAIN: Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.

COL.3.BSB: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
COL.3.KJV: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
COL.3.PLAIN: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.

COL.3.BSB: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
COL.3.KJV: And whatever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
COL.3.PLAIN: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

COL.3.BSB: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
COL.3.KJV: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
COL.3.PLAIN: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

COL.3.BSB: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
COL.3.KJV: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
COL.3.PLAIN: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

COL.3.BSB: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
COL.3.KJV: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing to the Lord.
COL.3.PLAIN: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

COL.3.BSB: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.
COL.3.KJV: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
COL.3.PLAIN: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.

COL.3.BSB: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
COL.3.KJV: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men pleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God;
COL.3.PLAIN: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.

COL.3.BSB: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,
COL.3.KJV: And whatever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not to men;
COL.3.PLAIN: Whatever you do, work at it wholeheartedly, as for the Lord and not for people,

COL.3.BSB: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
COL.3.KJV: Knowing that of the Lord you shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for you serve the Lord Christ.
COL.3.PLAIN: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

COL.3.BSB: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.
COL.3.KJV: But he that does wrong shall receive for the wrong which he has done: and there is no respect of persons.
COL.3.PLAIN: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.

COL.4.BSB: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
COL.4.KJV: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
COL.4.PLAIN: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

COL.4.BSB: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,
COL.4.KJV: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
COL.4.PLAIN: Devote yourselves to prayer, staying alert in it with thanksgiving.

COL.4.BSB: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.
COL.4.KJV: With praying also for us, that God would open to us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
COL.4.PLAIN: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

COL.4.BSB: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.
COL.4.KJV: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
COL.4.PLAIN: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.

COL.4.BSB: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.
COL.4.KJV: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
COL.4.PLAIN: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.

COL.4.BSB: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
COL.4.KJV: Let your speech be always with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer every man.
COL.4.PLAIN: Let your conversation always be full of grace, seasoned with salt, so you'll know how to answer everyone.

COL.4.BSB: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
COL.4.KJV: All my state shall Tychicus declare to you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord:
COL.4.PLAIN: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.

COL.4.BSB: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
COL.4.KJV: Whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
COL.4.PLAIN: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.

COL.4.BSB: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
COL.4.KJV: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known to you all things which are done here.
COL.4.PLAIN: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.

COL.4.BSB: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
COL.4.KJV: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner salutes you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom you received commandments: if he come to you, receive him;)
COL.4.PLAIN: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.

COL.4.BSB: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
COL.4.KJV: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellow workers to the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort to me.
COL.4.PLAIN: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.

COL.4.BSB: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.
COL.4.KJV: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
COL.4.PLAIN: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.

COL.4.BSB: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.
COL.4.KJV: For I bear him record, that he has a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
COL.4.PLAIN: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

COL.4.BSB: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.
COL.4.KJV: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
COL.4.PLAIN: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.

COL.4.BSB: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.
COL.4.KJV: Salute the brothers which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
COL.4.PLAIN: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.

COL.4.BSB: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.
COL.4.KJV: And when this letter is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that you likewise read the letter from Laodicea.
COL.4.PLAIN: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

COL.4.BSB: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”
COL.4.KJV: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.
COL.4.PLAIN: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”

COL.4.BSB: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
COL.4.KJV: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
COL.4.PLAIN: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.

1TH.1.BSB: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
1TH.1.KJV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, to the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1TH.1.PLAIN: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

1TH.1.BSB: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
1TH.1.KJV: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
1TH.1.PLAIN: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers

1TH.1.BSB: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
1TH.1.KJV: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labor of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
1TH.1.PLAIN: We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.1.BSB: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
1TH.1.KJV: Knowing, brothers beloved, your election of God.
1TH.1.PLAIN: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,

1TH.1.BSB: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
1TH.1.KJV: For our gospel came not to you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as you know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
1TH.1.PLAIN: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.

1TH.1.BSB: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
1TH.1.KJV: And you became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost.
1TH.1.PLAIN: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.

1TH.1.BSB: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
1TH.1.KJV: So that you were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
1TH.1.PLAIN: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

1TH.1.BSB: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
1TH.1.KJV: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
1TH.1.PLAIN: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.

1TH.1.BSB: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
1TH.1.KJV: For they themselves show of us what manner of entering in we had to you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
1TH.1.PLAIN: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God

1TH.1.BSB: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
1TH.1.KJV: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
1TH.1.PLAIN: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.

1TH.2.BSB: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.
1TH.2.KJV: For yourselves, brothers, know our entrance in to you, that it was not in vain:
1TH.2.PLAIN: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.

1TH.2.BSB: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
1TH.2.KJV: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as you know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God with much contention.
1TH.2.PLAIN: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.

1TH.2.BSB: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
1TH.2.KJV: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
1TH.2.PLAIN: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.

1TH.2.BSB: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
1TH.2.KJV: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which tries our hearts.
1TH.2.PLAIN: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.

1TH.2.BSB: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
1TH.2.KJV: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness; God is witness:
1TH.2.PLAIN: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!

1TH.2.BSB: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
1TH.2.KJV: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
1TH.2.PLAIN: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.

1TH.2.BSB: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
1TH.2.KJV: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherishes her children:
1TH.2.PLAIN: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.

1TH.2.BSB: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
1TH.2.KJV: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted to you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because you were dear to us.
1TH.2.PLAIN: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.

1TH.2.BSB: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
1TH.2.KJV: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail: for laboring night and day, because we would not be chargeable to any of you, we preached to you the gospel of God.
1TH.2.PLAIN: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.

1TH.2.BSB: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
1TH.2.KJV: You are witnesses, and God also, how piously and justly and blamelessly we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
1TH.2.PLAIN: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.

1TH.2.BSB: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
1TH.2.KJV: As you know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father does his children,
1TH.2.PLAIN: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—

1TH.2.BSB: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
1TH.2.KJV: That you would walk worthy of God, who has called you to his kingdom and glory.
1TH.2.PLAIN: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.

1TH.2.BSB: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as the true word of God—the word which is now at work in you who believe.
1TH.2.KJV: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when you received the word of God which you heard of us, you received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually works also in you that believe.
1TH.2.PLAIN: We also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God from us, you accepted it not as a human message but as what it truly is — the word of God, which is at work in you who believe.

1TH.2.BSB: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
1TH.2.KJV: For you, brothers, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for you also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
1TH.2.PLAIN: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,

1TH.2.BSB: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
1TH.2.KJV: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
1TH.2.PLAIN: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,

1TH.2.BSB: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.
1TH.2.KJV: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins always: for the wrath is come on them to the uttermost.
1TH.2.PLAIN: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.

1TH.2.BSB: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.
1TH.2.KJV: But we, brothers, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavored the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
1TH.2.PLAIN: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.

1TH.2.BSB: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
1TH.2.KJV: Why we would have come to you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
1TH.2.PLAIN: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.

1TH.2.BSB: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
1TH.2.KJV: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even you in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
1TH.2.PLAIN: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?

1TH.2.BSB: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
1TH.2.KJV: For you are our glory and joy.
1TH.2.PLAIN: You are indeed our glory and our joy.

1TH.3.BSB: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
1TH.3.KJV: Why when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
1TH.3.PLAIN: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
