1TH.3.BSB: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
1TH.3.KJV: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellow laborer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
1TH.3.PLAIN: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,

1TH.3.BSB: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
1TH.3.KJV: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
1TH.3.PLAIN: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.

1TH.3.BSB: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
1TH.3.KJV: For truly, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and you know.
1TH.3.PLAIN: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.

1TH.3.BSB: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and caused our labor to be in vain.
1TH.3.KJV: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labor be in vain.
1TH.3.PLAIN: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and caused our labor to be in vain.

1TH.3.BSB: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
1TH.3.KJV: But now when Timotheus came from you to us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
1TH.3.PLAIN: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.

1TH.3.BSB: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
1TH.3.KJV: Therefore, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
1TH.3.PLAIN: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.

1TH.3.BSB: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
1TH.3.KJV: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
1TH.3.PLAIN: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.

1TH.3.BSB: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
1TH.3.KJV: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy with which we joy for your sakes before our God;
1TH.3.PLAIN: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?

1TH.3.BSB: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.
1TH.3.KJV: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
1TH.3.PLAIN: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.

1TH.3.BSB: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
1TH.3.KJV: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
1TH.3.PLAIN: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.

1TH.3.BSB: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
1TH.3.KJV: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
1TH.3.PLAIN: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for one another and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

1TH.3.BSB: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
1TH.3.KJV: To the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
1TH.3.PLAIN: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.

1TH.4.BSB: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
1TH.4.KJV: Furthermore then we beseech you, brothers, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as you have received of us how you ought to walk and to please God, so you would abound more and more.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.

1TH.4.BSB: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
1TH.4.KJV: For you know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
1TH.4.PLAIN: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

1TH.4.BSB: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
1TH.4.KJV: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that you should abstain from fornication:
1TH.4.PLAIN: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;

1TH.4.BSB: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
1TH.4.KJV: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honor;
1TH.4.PLAIN: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,

1TH.4.BSB: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
1TH.4.KJV: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
1TH.4.PLAIN: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;

1TH.4.BSB: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
1TH.4.KJV: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
1TH.4.PLAIN: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.

1TH.4.BSB: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
1TH.4.KJV: For God has not called us to uncleanness, but to holiness.
1TH.4.PLAIN: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.

1TH.4.BSB: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
1TH.4.KJV: He therefore that despises, despises not man, but God, who has also given to us his holy Spirit.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.

1TH.4.BSB: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
1TH.4.KJV: But as touching brotherly love you need not that I write to you: for you yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.

1TH.4.BSB: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
1TH.4.KJV: And indeed you do it toward all the brothers which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brothers, that you increase more and more;
1TH.4.PLAIN: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more

1TH.4.BSB: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
1TH.4.KJV: And that you study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
1TH.4.PLAIN: Make it your goal to live quietly, to mind your own affairs, and to work with your hands, just as we told you,

1TH.4.BSB: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
1TH.4.KJV: That you may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that you may have lack of nothing.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.

1TH.4.BSB: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
1TH.4.KJV: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning them which are asleep, that you sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.

1TH.4.BSB: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
1TH.4.KJV: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
1TH.4.PLAIN: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.

1TH.4.BSB: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
1TH.4.KJV: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain to the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
1TH.4.PLAIN: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.

1TH.4.BSB: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
1TH.4.KJV: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
1TH.4.PLAIN: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.

1TH.4.BSB: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
1TH.4.KJV: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Then we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will be with the Lord forever.

1TH.4.BSB: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
1TH.4.KJV: Why comfort one another with these words.
1TH.4.PLAIN: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

1TH.5.BSB: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
1TH.5.KJV: But of the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that I write to you.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.

1TH.5.BSB: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
1TH.5.KJV: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.
1TH.5.PLAIN: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

1TH.5.BSB: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
1TH.5.KJV: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction comes on them, as travail on a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
1TH.5.PLAIN: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

1TH.5.BSB: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
1TH.5.KJV: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
1TH.5.PLAIN: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.

1TH.5.BSB: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
1TH.5.KJV: You are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
1TH.5.PLAIN: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

1TH.5.BSB: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
1TH.5.KJV: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
1TH.5.PLAIN: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.

1TH.5.BSB: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
1TH.5.KJV: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
1TH.5.PLAIN: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

1TH.5.BSB: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
1TH.5.KJV: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
1TH.5.PLAIN: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.

1TH.5.BSB: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
1TH.5.KJV: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
1TH.5.PLAIN: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.5.BSB: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
1TH.5.KJV: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
1TH.5.PLAIN: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.

1TH.5.BSB: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
1TH.5.KJV: Why comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also you do.
1TH.5.PLAIN: So encourage one another and build each other up, just as you are already doing.

1TH.5.BSB: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.
1TH.5.KJV: And we beseech you, brothers, to know them which labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
1TH.5.PLAIN: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.

1TH.5.BSB: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
1TH.5.KJV: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
1TH.5.PLAIN: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.

1TH.5.BSB: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
1TH.5.KJV: Now we exhort you, brothers, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
1TH.5.PLAIN: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.

1TH.5.BSB: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
1TH.5.KJV: See that none render evil for evil to any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.

1TH.5.BSB: Rejoice at all times.
1TH.5.KJV: Rejoice ever more.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Rejoice always.

1TH.5.BSB: Pray without ceasing.
1TH.5.KJV: Pray without ceasing.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Pray continually.

1TH.5.BSB: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
1TH.5.KJV: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Give thanks in every situation, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

1TH.5.BSB: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
1TH.5.KJV: Quench not the Spirit.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Do not extinguish the Spirit.

1TH.5.BSB: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
1TH.5.KJV: Despise not prophesyings.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,

1TH.5.BSB: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
1TH.5.KJV: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Test everything; hold on to what is good.

1TH.5.BSB: Abstain from every form of evil.
1TH.5.KJV: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Abstain from every form of evil.

1TH.5.BSB: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
1TH.5.KJV: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1TH.5.BSB: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
1TH.5.KJV: Faithful is he that calls you, who also will do it.
1TH.5.PLAIN: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.

1TH.5.BSB: Brothers, pray for us as well.
1TH.5.KJV: Brothers, pray for us.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Brothers, pray for us as well.

1TH.5.BSB: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
1TH.5.KJV: Greet all the brothers with an holy kiss.
1TH.5.PLAIN: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

1TH.5.BSB: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
1TH.5.KJV: I charge you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
1TH.5.PLAIN: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.

1TH.5.BSB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
1TH.5.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
1TH.5.PLAIN: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

2TH.1.BSB: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
2TH.1.KJV: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
2TH.1.PLAIN: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

2TH.1.BSB: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2TH.1.KJV: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2TH.1.PLAIN: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2TH.1.BSB: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
2TH.1.KJV: We are bound to thank God always for you, brothers, as it is meet, because that your faith grows exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other abounds;
2TH.1.PLAIN: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, and rightly so, because your faith is growing more and more, and the love all of you have for one another is increasing.

2TH.1.BSB: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.
2TH.1.KJV: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that you endure:
2TH.1.PLAIN: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring.

2TH.1.BSB: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.
2TH.1.KJV: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you also suffer:
2TH.1.PLAIN: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

2TH.1.BSB: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
2TH.1.KJV: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
2TH.1.PLAIN: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

2TH.1.BSB: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels
2TH.1.KJV: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
2TH.1.PLAIN: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels

2TH.1.BSB: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
2TH.1.KJV: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
2TH.1.PLAIN: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

2TH.1.BSB: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,
2TH.1.KJV: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
2TH.1.PLAIN: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,

2TH.1.BSB: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.
2TH.1.KJV: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
2TH.1.PLAIN: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.

2TH.1.BSB: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,
2TH.1.KJV: Why also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfill all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
2TH.1.PLAIN: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,

2TH.1.BSB: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
2TH.1.KJV: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
2TH.1.PLAIN: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.

2TH.2.BSB: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,
2TH.2.KJV: Now we beseech you, brothers, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together to him,
2TH.2.PLAIN: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you, brothers,

2TH.2.BSB: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.
2TH.2.KJV: That you be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
2TH.2.PLAIN: not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit or message or letter seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.

2TH.2.BSB: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.
2TH.2.KJV: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
2TH.2.PLAIN: Let no one deceive you in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness—the son of destruction—is revealed.

2TH.2.BSB: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.
2TH.2.KJV: Who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sits in the temple of God, showing himself that he is God.
2TH.2.PLAIN: He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God, proclaiming himself to be God.

2TH.2.BSB: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
2TH.2.KJV: Remember you not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
2TH.2.PLAIN: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?

2TH.2.BSB: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.
2TH.2.KJV: And now you know what withholds that he might be revealed in his time.
2TH.2.PLAIN: And you know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

2TH.2.BSB: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
2TH.2.KJV: For the mystery of iniquity does already work: only he who now lets will let, until he be taken out of the way.
2TH.2.PLAIN: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.

2TH.2.BSB: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
2TH.2.KJV: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
2TH.2.PLAIN: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will slay with the breath of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.

2TH.2.BSB: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,
2TH.2.KJV: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
2TH.2.PLAIN: The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan, with every kind of power, sign, and false wonder,

2TH.2.BSB: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.
2TH.2.KJV: And with all delusion of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
2TH.2.PLAIN: and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love of the truth that would have saved them.

2TH.2.BSB: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
2TH.2.KJV: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
2TH.2.PLAIN: For this reason God will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,

2TH.2.BSB: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.
2TH.2.KJV: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
2TH.2.PLAIN: in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness.

2TH.2.BSB: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God has chosen you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.
2TH.2.KJV: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
2TH.2.PLAIN: But we should always thank God for you, brothers who are loved by the Lord, because God has chosen you from the beginning to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit and by faith in the truth.

2TH.2.BSB: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2TH.2.KJV: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2TH.2.PLAIN: To this He called you through our gospel, so that you may share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2TH.2.BSB: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.
2TH.2.KJV: Therefore, brothers, stand fast, and hold the traditions which you have been taught, whether by word, or our letter.
2TH.2.PLAIN: Therefore, brothers, stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you, whether by speech or by letter.

2TH.2.BSB: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
2TH.2.KJV: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which has loved us, and has given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
2TH.2.PLAIN: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal comfort and good hope,

2TH.2.BSB: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
2TH.2.KJV: Comfort your hearts, and establish you in every good word and work.
2TH.2.PLAIN: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

2TH.3.BSB: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.
2TH.3.KJV: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
2TH.3.PLAIN: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread quickly and be held in honor, just as it was with you.

2TH.3.BSB: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.
2TH.3.KJV: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
2TH.3.PLAIN: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men; for not everyone holds to the faith.

2TH.3.BSB: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
2TH.3.KJV: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you, and keep you from evil.
2TH.3.PLAIN: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

2TH.3.BSB: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
2TH.3.KJV: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.
2TH.3.PLAIN: And we have confidence in the Lord that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.

2TH.3.BSB: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.
2TH.3.KJV: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
2TH.3.PLAIN: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s perseverance.

2TH.3.BSB: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.
2TH.3.KJV: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother that walks disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
2TH.3.PLAIN: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from any brother who leads an undisciplined life that is not in keeping with the tradition you received from us.

2TH.3.BSB: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,
2TH.3.KJV: For yourselves know how you ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
2TH.3.PLAIN: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not undisciplined among you,

2TH.3.BSB: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.
2TH.3.KJV: Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nothing; but worked with labor and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
2TH.3.PLAIN: nor did we eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, in labor and toil, we worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

2TH.3.BSB: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
2TH.3.KJV: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample to you to follow us.
2TH.3.PLAIN: Not that we lack this right, but we wanted to offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.

2TH.3.BSB: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
2TH.3.KJV: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
2TH.3.PLAIN: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”

2TH.3.BSB: Yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.
2TH.3.KJV: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
2TH.3.PLAIN: Yet we hear that some of you are leading undisciplined lives and accomplishing nothing but being busybodies.

2TH.3.BSB: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.
2TH.3.KJV: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
2TH.3.PLAIN: We command and urge such people by our Lord Jesus Christ to begin working quietly to earn their own living.

2TH.3.BSB: But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.
2TH.3.KJV: But you, brothers, be not weary in well doing.
2TH.3.PLAIN: And as for you, brothers and sisters, never tire of doing what is good.

2TH.3.BSB: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
2TH.3.KJV: And if any man obey not our word by this letter, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
2TH.3.PLAIN: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.

2TH.3.BSB: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.
2TH.3.KJV: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
2TH.3.PLAIN: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.

2TH.3.BSB: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
2TH.3.KJV: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
2TH.3.PLAIN: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with you all.

2TH.3.BSB: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.
2TH.3.KJV: The salutation of Paul with my own hand, which is the token in every letter: so I write.
2TH.3.PLAIN: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter; it is the way I write.

2TH.3.BSB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
2TH.3.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
2TH.3.PLAIN: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.

1TI.1.BSB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
1TI.1.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Savior, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
1TI.1.PLAIN: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

1TI.1.BSB: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
1TI.1.KJV: To Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
1TI.1.PLAIN: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

1TI.1.BSB: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines
1TI.1.KJV: As I sought you to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
1TI.1.PLAIN: As I urged you on my departure to Macedonia, you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines

1TI.1.BSB: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.
1TI.1.KJV: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
1TI.1.PLAIN: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than the stewardship of God’s work, which is by faith.

1TI.1.BSB: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.
1TI.1.KJV: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
1TI.1.PLAIN: The goal of our instruction is the love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and a sincere faith.

1TI.1.BSB: Some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.
1TI.1.KJV: From which some having swerved have turned aside to vain jangling;
1TI.1.PLAIN: Some have strayed from these ways and turned aside to empty talk.

1TI.1.BSB: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.
1TI.1.KJV: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
1TI.1.PLAIN: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not understand what they are saying or that which they so confidently assert.

1TI.1.BSB: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
1TI.1.KJV: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
1TI.1.PLAIN: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.

1TI.1.BSB: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,
1TI.1.KJV: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for murderers,
1TI.1.PLAIN: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers,

1TI.1.BSB: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
1TI.1.KJV: For fornicators, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for enslavers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
1TI.1.PLAIN: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching

1TI.1.BSB: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.
1TI.1.KJV: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
1TI.1.PLAIN: that agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God, with which I have been entrusted.

1TI.1.BSB: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.
1TI.1.KJV: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
1TI.1.PLAIN: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, that He considered me faithful and appointed me to service.

1TI.1.BSB: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
1TI.1.KJV: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
1TI.1.PLAIN: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.

1TI.1.BSB: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
1TI.1.KJV: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
1TI.1.PLAIN: And the grace of our Lord overflowed to me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

1TI.1.BSB: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.
1TI.1.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
1TI.1.PLAIN: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners — of whom I am the worst.

1TI.1.BSB: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.
1TI.1.KJV: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all long-suffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
1TI.1.PLAIN: But for this very reason I was shown mercy, so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display His perfect patience as an example to those who would believe in Him for eternal life.

1TI.1.BSB: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
1TI.1.KJV: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
1TI.1.PLAIN: Now to the King eternal, immortal, and invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

1TI.1.BSB: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
1TI.1.KJV: This charge I commit to you, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on you, that you by them might war a good warfare;
1TI.1.PLAIN: Timothy, my child, I entrust you with this command in keeping with the previous prophecies about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,

1TI.1.BSB: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.
1TI.1.KJV: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
1TI.1.PLAIN: holding on to faith and a good conscience, which some have rejected and thereby shipwrecked their faith.

1TI.1.BSB: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
1TI.1.KJV: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered to Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
1TI.1.PLAIN: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.

1TI.2.BSB: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone—
1TI.2.KJV: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
1TI.2.PLAIN: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercession, and thanksgiving be made for everyone,

1TI.2.BSB: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.
1TI.2.KJV: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
1TI.2.PLAIN: for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.

1TI.2.BSB: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,
1TI.2.KJV: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;
1TI.2.PLAIN: This is good and pleasing in the sight of God our Savior,

1TI.2.BSB: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
1TI.2.KJV: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
1TI.2.PLAIN: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

1TI.2.BSB: For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
1TI.2.KJV: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
1TI.2.PLAIN: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

1TI.2.BSB: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
1TI.2.KJV: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
1TI.2.PLAIN: who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.

1TI.2.BSB: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.
1TI.2.KJV: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
1TI.2.PLAIN: For this reason I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a faithful and true teacher of the Gentiles. I am telling the truth; I am not lying about anything.

1TI.2.BSB: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
1TI.2.KJV: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
1TI.2.PLAIN: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.

1TI.2.BSB: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
1TI.2.KJV: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with modesty and sobriety; not with braided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
1TI.2.PLAIN: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,

1TI.2.BSB: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
1TI.2.KJV: But (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.
1TI.2.PLAIN: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.

1TI.2.BSB: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
1TI.2.KJV: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
1TI.2.PLAIN: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.

1TI.2.BSB: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
1TI.2.KJV: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
1TI.2.PLAIN: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.

1TI.2.BSB: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
1TI.2.KJV: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
1TI.2.PLAIN: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.

1TI.2.BSB: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
1TI.2.KJV: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
1TI.2.PLAIN: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.

1TI.2.BSB: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
1TI.2.KJV: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
1TI.2.PLAIN: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.

1TI.3.BSB: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
1TI.3.KJV: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desires a good work.
1TI.3.PLAIN: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.

1TI.3.BSB: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
1TI.3.KJV: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behavior, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
1TI.3.PLAIN: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,

1TI.3.BSB: not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
1TI.3.KJV: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
1TI.3.PLAIN: not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.

1TI.3.BSB: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
1TI.3.KJV: One that rules well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
1TI.3.PLAIN: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.

1TI.3.BSB: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
1TI.3.KJV: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
1TI.3.PLAIN: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?

1TI.3.BSB: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
1TI.3.KJV: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
1TI.3.PLAIN: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.

1TI.3.BSB: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
1TI.3.KJV: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
1TI.3.PLAIN: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.

1TI.3.BSB: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
1TI.3.KJV: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
1TI.3.PLAIN: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.

1TI.3.BSB: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
1TI.3.KJV: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
1TI.3.PLAIN: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.

1TI.3.BSB: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
1TI.3.KJV: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
1TI.3.PLAIN: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.

1TI.3.BSB: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
1TI.3.KJV: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
1TI.3.PLAIN: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.

1TI.3.BSB: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
1TI.3.KJV: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
1TI.3.PLAIN: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.

1TI.3.BSB: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
1TI.3.KJV: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
1TI.3.PLAIN: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.

1TI.3.BSB: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these things
1TI.3.KJV: These things write I to you, hoping to come to you shortly:
1TI.3.PLAIN: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these things

1TI.3.BSB: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
1TI.3.KJV: But if I tarry long, that you may know how you ought to behave yourself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
1TI.3.PLAIN: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.

1TI.3.BSB: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
1TI.3.KJV: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached to the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
1TI.3.PLAIN: Beyond all question, the mystery from which true godliness springs is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.

1TI.4.BSB: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
1TI.4.KJV: Now the Spirit speaks expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
1TI.4.PLAIN: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,

1TI.4.BSB: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
1TI.4.KJV: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
1TI.4.PLAIN: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.

1TI.4.BSB: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
1TI.4.KJV: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God has created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
1TI.4.PLAIN: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

1TI.4.BSB: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
1TI.4.KJV: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
1TI.4.PLAIN: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,

1TI.4.BSB: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
1TI.4.KJV: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
1TI.4.PLAIN: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

1TI.4.BSB: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
1TI.4.KJV: If you put the brothers in remembrance of these things, you shall be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, to which you have attained.
1TI.4.PLAIN: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.

1TI.4.BSB: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
1TI.4.KJV: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables, and exercise yourself rather to godliness.
1TI.4.PLAIN: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.

1TI.4.BSB: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
1TI.4.KJV: For bodily exercise profits little: but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
1TI.4.PLAIN: Physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for everything, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.

1TI.4.BSB: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
1TI.4.KJV: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
1TI.4.PLAIN: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.

1TI.4.BSB: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
1TI.4.KJV: For therefore we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, specially of those that believe.
1TI.4.PLAIN: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.

1TI.4.BSB: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
1TI.4.KJV: Let no man despise your youth; but be you an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
1TI.4.PLAIN: Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, and in purity.

1TI.4.BSB: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
1TI.4.KJV: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
1TI.4.PLAIN: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.

1TI.4.BSB: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
1TI.4.KJV: Neglect not the gift that is in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
1TI.4.PLAIN: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.

1TI.4.BSB: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
1TI.4.KJV: Meditate on these things; give yourself wholly to them; that your profiting may appear to all.
1TI.4.PLAIN: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.

1TI.4.BSB: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
1TI.4.KJV: Take heed to yourself, and to the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this you shall both save yourself, and them that hear you.
1TI.4.PLAIN: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

1TI.5.BSB: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,
1TI.5.KJV: Rebuke not an elder, but entreat him as a father; and the younger men as brothers;
1TI.5.PLAIN: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,

1TI.5.BSB: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
1TI.5.KJV: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
1TI.5.PLAIN: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.

1TI.5.BSB: Honor the widows who are truly widows.
1TI.5.KJV: Honor widows that are widows indeed.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Honor the widows who are truly widows.

1TI.5.BSB: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
1TI.5.KJV: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to show piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
1TI.5.PLAIN: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.

1TI.5.BSB: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
1TI.5.KJV: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusts in God, and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.
1TI.5.PLAIN: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.

1TI.5.BSB: But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.
1TI.5.KJV: But she that lives in pleasure is dead while she lives.
1TI.5.PLAIN: But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.

1TI.5.BSB: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
1TI.5.KJV: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.

1TI.5.BSB: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
1TI.5.KJV: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Anyone who does not provide for their own, and especially their own household, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

1TI.5.BSB: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, the wife of one man,
1TI.5.KJV: Let not a widow be taken into the number under three score years old, having been the wife of one man.
1TI.5.PLAIN: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, the wife of one man,

1TI.5.BSB: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
1TI.5.KJV: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
1TI.5.PLAIN: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.

1TI.5.BSB: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
1TI.5.KJV: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
1TI.5.PLAIN: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,

1TI.5.BSB: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
1TI.5.KJV: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
1TI.5.PLAIN: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.

1TI.5.BSB: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
1TI.5.KJV: And with they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they should not.
1TI.5.PLAIN: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.

1TI.5.BSB: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
1TI.5.KJV: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
1TI.5.PLAIN: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.

1TI.5.BSB: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
1TI.5.KJV: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
1TI.5.PLAIN: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.

1TI.5.BSB: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
1TI.5.KJV: If any man or woman that believes have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
1TI.5.PLAIN: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.

1TI.5.BSB: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
1TI.5.KJV: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially they who labor in the word and doctrine.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.

1TI.5.BSB: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
1TI.5.KJV: For the scripture says, You shall not muzzle the ox that treads out the corn. And, The laborer is worthy of his reward.
1TI.5.PLAIN: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”

1TI.5.BSB: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
1TI.5.KJV: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

1TI.5.BSB: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
1TI.5.KJV: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
1TI.5.PLAIN: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.

1TI.5.BSB: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
1TI.5.KJV: I charge you before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that you observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
1TI.5.PLAIN: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.

1TI.5.BSB: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
1TI.5.KJV: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep yourself pure.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

1TI.5.BSB: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
1TI.5.KJV: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your often infirmities.
1TI.5.PLAIN: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.

1TI.5.BSB: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
1TI.5.KJV: Some men’s sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
1TI.5.PLAIN: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.

1TI.5.BSB: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
1TI.5.KJV: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
1TI.5.PLAIN: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.

1TI.6.BSB: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
1TI.6.KJV: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
1TI.6.PLAIN: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.

1TI.6.BSB: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.
1TI.6.KJV: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brothers; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
1TI.6.PLAIN: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.

1TI.6.BSB: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
1TI.6.KJV: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
1TI.6.PLAIN: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,

1TI.6.BSB: he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and semantics, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
1TI.6.KJV: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof comes envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
1TI.6.PLAIN: he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and semantics, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,

1TI.6.BSB: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain.
1TI.6.KJV: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw yourself.
1TI.6.PLAIN: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain.

1TI.6.BSB: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
1TI.6.KJV: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
1TI.6.PLAIN: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

1TI.6.BSB: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.
1TI.6.KJV: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
1TI.6.PLAIN: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.

1TI.6.BSB: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
1TI.6.KJV: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
1TI.6.PLAIN: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.

1TI.6.BSB: Those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
1TI.6.KJV: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
1TI.6.PLAIN: Those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.

1TI.6.BSB: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
1TI.6.KJV: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
1TI.6.PLAIN: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. Some, eager for it, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.

1TI.6.BSB: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
1TI.6.KJV: But you, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
1TI.6.PLAIN: But you, person of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.

1TI.6.BSB: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made the good confession before many witnesses.
1TI.6.KJV: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, to which you are also called, and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.
1TI.6.PLAIN: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession before many witnesses.

1TI.6.BSB: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:
1TI.6.KJV: I give you charge in the sight of God, who vivifies all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
1TI.6.PLAIN: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:

1TI.6.BSB: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,
1TI.6.KJV: That you keep this commandment without spot, unrebukable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
1TI.6.PLAIN: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,

1TI.6.BSB: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.
1TI.6.KJV: Which in his times he shall show, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
1TI.6.PLAIN: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time.

1TI.6.BSB: He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.
1TI.6.KJV: Who only has immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach to; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and power everlasting. Amen.
1TI.6.PLAIN: He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him. To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.

1TI.6.BSB: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
1TI.6.KJV: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not high minded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who gives us richly all things to enjoy;
1TI.6.PLAIN: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.

1TI.6.BSB: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,
1TI.6.KJV: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
1TI.6.PLAIN: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,

1TI.6.BSB: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.
1TI.6.KJV: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
1TI.6.PLAIN: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.

1TI.6.BSB: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”
1TI.6.KJV: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to your trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
1TI.6.PLAIN: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,”

1TI.6.BSB: which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. Grace be with you all.
1TI.6.KJV: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
