1TI.6.PLAIN: which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith. Grace be with you all.

2TI.1.BSB: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,
2TI.1.KJV: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
2TI.1.PLAIN: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life in Christ Jesus,

2TI.1.BSB: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
2TI.1.KJV: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
2TI.1.PLAIN: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

2TI.1.BSB: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.
2TI.1.KJV: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of you in my prayers night and day;
2TI.1.PLAIN: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.

2TI.1.BSB: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
2TI.1.KJV: Greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
2TI.1.PLAIN: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.

2TI.1.BSB: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.
2TI.1.KJV: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in you, which dwelled first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in you also.
2TI.1.PLAIN: I am reminded of your sincere faith, which first dwelt in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, and I am convinced is in you as well.

2TI.1.BSB: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
2TI.1.KJV: Why I put you in remembrance that you stir up the gift of God, which is in you by the putting on of my hands.
2TI.1.PLAIN: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

2TI.1.BSB: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
2TI.1.KJV: For God has not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
2TI.1.PLAIN: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind.

2TI.1.BSB: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.
2TI.1.KJV: Be not you therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be you partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
2TI.1.PLAIN: So do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, or of me, His prisoner. Instead, join me in suffering for the gospel by the power of God.

2TI.1.BSB: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.
2TI.1.KJV: Who has saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
2TI.1.PLAIN: He has saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works, but by His own purpose and by the grace He granted us in Christ Jesus before time began.

2TI.1.BSB: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,
2TI.1.KJV: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who has abolished death, and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
2TI.1.PLAIN: And now He has revealed this grace through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has abolished death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the gospel,

2TI.1.BSB: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
2TI.1.KJV: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
2TI.1.PLAIN: to which I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.

2TI.1.BSB: For this reason, even though I suffer as I do, I am not ashamed; for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that He is able to guard what I have entrusted to Him for that day.
2TI.1.KJV: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed to him against that day.
2TI.1.PLAIN: That is why I suffer as I do. Yet I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until that day.

2TI.1.BSB: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
2TI.1.KJV: Hold fast the form of sound words, which you have heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
2TI.1.PLAIN: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching you have heard from me, with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

2TI.1.BSB: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
2TI.1.KJV: That good thing which was committed to you keep by the Holy Ghost which dwells in us.
2TI.1.PLAIN: Guard the treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

2TI.1.BSB: You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
2TI.1.KJV: This you know, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
2TI.1.PLAIN: You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

2TI.1.BSB: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.
2TI.1.KJV: The Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
2TI.1.PLAIN: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he has often refreshed me and was unashamed of my chains.

2TI.1.BSB: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.
2TI.1.KJV: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
2TI.1.PLAIN: Indeed, when he arrived in Rome, he searched diligently until he found me.

2TI.1.BSB: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.
2TI.1.KJV: The Lord grant to him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered to me at Ephesus, you know very well.
2TI.1.PLAIN: May the Lord grant Onesiphorus His mercy on that day. You know very well how much he ministered to me in Ephesus.

2TI.2.BSB: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2TI.2.KJV: You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
2TI.2.PLAIN: You therefore, my child, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.BSB: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.
2TI.2.KJV: And the things that you have heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit you to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
2TI.2.PLAIN: And the things that you have heard me say among many witnesses, entrust these to faithful men who will be qualified to teach others as well.

2TI.2.BSB: Join me in suffering, like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
2TI.2.KJV: You therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Endure hardship with us like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

2TI.2.BSB: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.
2TI.2.KJV: No man that wars entangles himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who has chosen him to be a soldier.
2TI.2.PLAIN: A soldier refrains from entangling himself in civilian affairs, in order to please the one who enlisted him.

2TI.2.BSB: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.
2TI.2.KJV: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Likewise, a competitor does not receive the crown unless he competes according to the rules.

2TI.2.BSB: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.
2TI.2.KJV: The farmer that labors must be first partaker of the fruits.
2TI.2.PLAIN: The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops.

2TI.2.BSB: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.
2TI.2.KJV: Consider what I say; and the Lord give you understanding in all things.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Consider what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all things.

2TI.2.BSB: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,
2TI.2.KJV: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
2TI.2.PLAIN: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel,

2TI.2.BSB: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
2TI.2.KJV: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even to bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
2TI.2.PLAIN: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!

2TI.2.BSB: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.
2TI.2.KJV: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
2TI.2.PLAIN: For this reason I endure all things for the sake of the elect, so that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

2TI.2.BSB: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
2TI.2.KJV: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
2TI.2.PLAIN: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;

2TI.2.BSB: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
2TI.2.KJV: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
2TI.2.PLAIN: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;

2TI.2.BSB: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
2TI.2.KJV: If we believe not, yet he stays faithful: he cannot deny himself.
2TI.2.PLAIN: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.

2TI.2.BSB: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.
2TI.2.KJV: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Remind the believers of these things, charging them before God to avoid quarreling over words, which succeeds only in leading the listeners to ruin.

2TI.2.BSB: Make every effort to present yourself approved to God, an unashamed workman who accurately handles the word of truth.
2TI.2.KJV: Study to show yourself approved to God, a workman that needs not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a worker who has no need to be ashamed, rightly handling the word of truth.

2TI.2.BSB: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,
2TI.2.KJV: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase to more ungodliness.
2TI.2.PLAIN: But avoid irreverent, empty chatter, which will only lead to more ungodliness,

2TI.2.BSB: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
2TI.2.KJV: And their word will eat as does a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
2TI.2.PLAIN: and the talk of such men will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

2TI.2.BSB: who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.
2TI.2.KJV: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
2TI.2.PLAIN: who have deviated from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already occurred, and they undermine the faith of some.

2TI.2.BSB: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from iniquity.”
2TI.2.KJV: Nevertheless the foundation of God stands sure, having this seal, The Lord knows them that are his. And, Let every one that names the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Nevertheless, God’s firm foundation stands, bearing this seal: “The Lord knows those who are His,” and, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord must turn away from brokenness.”

2TI.2.BSB: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.
2TI.2.KJV: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honor, and some to dishonor.
2TI.2.PLAIN: A large house contains not only vessels of gold and silver, but also of wood and clay. Some indeed are for honorable use, but others are for common use.

2TI.2.BSB: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.
2TI.2.KJV: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel to honor, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared to every good work.
2TI.2.PLAIN: So if anyone cleanses himself of what is unfit, he will be a vessel for honor: sanctified, useful to the Master, and prepared for every good work.

2TI.2.BSB: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
2TI.2.KJV: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Flee from youthful passions and pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

2TI.2.BSB: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.
2TI.2.KJV: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do engender strifes.
2TI.2.PLAIN: But reject foolish and ignorant speculation, for you know that it breeds quarreling.

2TI.2.BSB: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.
2TI.2.KJV: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle to all men, apt to teach, patient,
2TI.2.PLAIN: And a servant of the Lord must not be quarrelsome, but must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and forbearing.

2TI.2.BSB: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.
2TI.2.KJV: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
2TI.2.PLAIN: He must gently reprove those who oppose him, in the hope that God may grant them repentance leading to a knowledge of the truth.

2TI.2.BSB: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.
2TI.2.KJV: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
2TI.2.PLAIN: Then they will come to their senses and escape the snare of the devil, who has taken them captive to his will.

2TI.3.BSB: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.
2TI.3.KJV: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
2TI.3.PLAIN: But understand this: In the last days terrible times will come.

2TI.3.BSB: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,
2TI.3.KJV: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
2TI.3.PLAIN: For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

2TI.3.BSB: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,
2TI.3.KJV: Without natural affection, truce breakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
2TI.3.PLAIN: unloving, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, without love of good,

2TI.3.BSB: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,
2TI.3.KJV: Traitors, heady, high minded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
2TI.3.PLAIN: traitorous, reckless, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

2TI.3.BSB: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!
2TI.3.KJV: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
2TI.3.PLAIN: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Turn away from such as these!

2TI.3.BSB: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
2TI.3.KJV: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
2TI.3.PLAIN: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,

2TI.3.BSB: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.
2TI.3.KJV: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
2TI.3.PLAIN: who are always learning but never able to come to a knowledge of the truth.

2TI.3.BSB: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.
2TI.3.KJV: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
2TI.3.PLAIN: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth. They are depraved in mind and disqualified from the faith.

2TI.3.BSB: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.
2TI.3.KJV: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest to all men, as theirs also was.
2TI.3.PLAIN: But they will not advance much further. For just like Jannes and Jambres, their folly will be plain to everyone.

2TI.3.BSB: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,
2TI.3.KJV: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering, charity, patience,
2TI.3.PLAIN: You, however, have observed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my patience, my love, my perseverance,

2TI.3.BSB: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.
2TI.3.KJV: Persecutions, afflictions, which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
2TI.3.PLAIN: my persecutions, and the sufferings that came upon me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. What persecutions I endured! Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

2TI.3.BSB: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,
2TI.3.KJV: Yes, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
2TI.3.PLAIN: Indeed, all who desire to live godly lives in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

2TI.3.BSB: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.
2TI.3.KJV: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
2TI.3.PLAIN: while evil men and imposters go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

2TI.3.BSB: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.
2TI.3.KJV: But continue you in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing of whom you have learned them;
2TI.3.PLAIN: But as for you, continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed, since you know from whom you have learned them.

2TI.3.BSB: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.
2TI.3.KJV: And that from a child you have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make you wise to salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
2TI.3.PLAIN: From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

2TI.3.BSB: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
2TI.3.KJV: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
2TI.3.PLAIN: All scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, for rebuking, for correcting, and for training in righteousness,

2TI.3.BSB: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
2TI.3.KJV: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished to all good works.
2TI.3.PLAIN: so that the person of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

2TI.4.BSB: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
2TI.4.KJV: I charge you therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
2TI.4.PLAIN: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:

2TI.4.BSB: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
2TI.4.KJV: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long-suffering and doctrine.
2TI.4.PLAIN: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.

2TI.4.BSB: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
2TI.4.KJV: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
2TI.4.PLAIN: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.

2TI.4.BSB: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
2TI.4.KJV: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned to fables.
2TI.4.PLAIN: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

2TI.4.BSB: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
2TI.4.KJV: But watch you in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of your ministry.
2TI.4.PLAIN: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.

2TI.4.BSB: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
2TI.4.KJV: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
2TI.4.PLAIN: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.

2TI.4.BSB: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
2TI.4.KJV: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
2TI.4.PLAIN: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

2TI.4.BSB: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
2TI.4.KJV: From now on there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but to all them also that love his appearing.
2TI.4.PLAIN: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.

2TI.4.BSB: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
2TI.4.KJV: Do your diligence to come shortly to me:
2TI.4.PLAIN: Make every effort to come to me quickly,

2TI.4.BSB: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
2TI.4.KJV: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
2TI.4.PLAIN: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

2TI.4.BSB: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
2TI.4.KJV: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
2TI.4.PLAIN: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.

2TI.4.BSB: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.
2TI.4.KJV: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
2TI.4.PLAIN: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.

2TI.4.BSB: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
2TI.4.KJV: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, when you come, bring with you, and the books, but especially the parchments.
2TI.4.PLAIN: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.

2TI.4.BSB: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
2TI.4.KJV: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
2TI.4.PLAIN: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

2TI.4.BSB: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
2TI.4.KJV: Of whom be you ware also; for he has greatly withstood our words.
2TI.4.PLAIN: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.

2TI.4.BSB: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
2TI.4.KJV: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
2TI.4.PLAIN: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.

2TI.4.BSB: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
2TI.4.KJV: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
2TI.4.PLAIN: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.

2TI.4.BSB: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
2TI.4.KJV: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me to his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
2TI.4.PLAIN: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

2TI.4.BSB: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.
2TI.4.KJV: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
2TI.4.PLAIN: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.

2TI.4.BSB: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
2TI.4.KJV: Erastus stayed at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
2TI.4.PLAIN: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.

2TI.4.BSB: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
2TI.4.KJV: Do your diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.
2TI.4.PLAIN: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

2TI.4.BSB: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
2TI.4.KJV: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
2TI.4.PLAIN: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.

TIT.1.BSB: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
TIT.1.KJV: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
TIT.1.PLAIN: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,

TIT.1.BSB: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
TIT.1.KJV: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
TIT.1.PLAIN: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began;

TIT.1.BSB: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
TIT.1.KJV: But has in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed to me according to the commandment of God our Savior;
TIT.1.PLAIN: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.

TIT.1.BSB: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
TIT.1.KJV: To Titus, my own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
TIT.1.PLAIN: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

TIT.1.BSB: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
TIT.1.KJV: For this cause left I you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you:
TIT.1.PLAIN: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

TIT.1.BSB: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
TIT.1.KJV: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
TIT.1.PLAIN: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.

TIT.1.BSB: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-absorbed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
TIT.1.KJV: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not self-willed, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
TIT.1.PLAIN: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-absorbed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.

TIT.1.BSB: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
TIT.1.KJV: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
TIT.1.PLAIN: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.

TIT.1.BSB: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
TIT.1.KJV: Holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the disputers.
TIT.1.PLAIN: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.

TIT.1.BSB: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
TIT.1.KJV: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
TIT.1.PLAIN: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,

TIT.1.BSB: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
TIT.1.KJV: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they should not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
TIT.1.PLAIN: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.

TIT.1.BSB: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
TIT.1.KJV: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are always liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
TIT.1.PLAIN: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”

TIT.1.BSB: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
TIT.1.KJV: This witness is true. Why rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
TIT.1.PLAIN: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith

TIT.1.BSB: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
TIT.1.KJV: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
TIT.1.PLAIN: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.

TIT.1.BSB: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
TIT.1.KJV: To the pure all things are pure: but to them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
TIT.1.PLAIN: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.

TIT.1.BSB: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
TIT.1.KJV: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and to every good work reprobate.
TIT.1.PLAIN: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.

TIT.2.BSB: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
TIT.2.KJV: But speak you the things which become sound doctrine:
TIT.2.PLAIN: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.

TIT.2.BSB: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
TIT.2.KJV: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
TIT.2.PLAIN: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.

TIT.2.BSB: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
TIT.2.KJV: The aged women likewise, that they be in behavior as becomes holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
TIT.2.PLAIN: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.

TIT.2.BSB: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
TIT.2.KJV: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
TIT.2.PLAIN: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,

TIT.2.BSB: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
TIT.2.KJV: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
TIT.2.PLAIN: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.

TIT.2.BSB: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
TIT.2.KJV: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
TIT.2.PLAIN: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.

TIT.2.BSB: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
TIT.2.KJV: In all things showing yourself a pattern of good works: in doctrine showing soundness, gravity, sincerity,
TIT.2.PLAIN: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,

TIT.2.BSB: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
TIT.2.KJV: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
TIT.2.PLAIN: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.

TIT.2.BSB: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
TIT.2.KJV: Exhort servants to be obedient to their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
TIT.2.PLAIN: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,

TIT.2.BSB: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
TIT.2.KJV: Not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.
TIT.2.PLAIN: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.

TIT.2.BSB: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
TIT.2.KJV: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,
TIT.2.PLAIN: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people,

TIT.2.BSB: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
TIT.2.KJV: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
TIT.2.PLAIN: teaching us to say no to ungodliness and worldly desires, and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in this present age,

TIT.2.BSB: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
TIT.2.KJV: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Savior Jesus Christ;
TIT.2.PLAIN: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.

TIT.2.BSB: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
TIT.2.KJV: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify to himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
TIT.2.PLAIN: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.

TIT.2.BSB: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
TIT.2.KJV: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise you.
TIT.2.PLAIN: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.

TIT.3.BSB: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
TIT.3.KJV: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
TIT.3.PLAIN: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,

TIT.3.BSB: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
TIT.3.KJV: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, showing all meekness to all men.
TIT.3.PLAIN: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.

TIT.3.BSB: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
TIT.3.KJV: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
TIT.3.PLAIN: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

TIT.3.BSB: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
TIT.3.KJV: But after that the kindness and love of God our Savior toward man appeared,
TIT.3.PLAIN: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,

TIT.3.BSB: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
TIT.3.KJV: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
TIT.3.PLAIN: he saved us — not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy — through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,

TIT.3.BSB: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
TIT.3.KJV: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
TIT.3.PLAIN: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

TIT.3.BSB: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
TIT.3.KJV: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
TIT.3.PLAIN: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.

TIT.3.BSB: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
TIT.3.KJV: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that you affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.
TIT.3.PLAIN: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.

TIT.3.BSB: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
TIT.3.KJV: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
TIT.3.PLAIN: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.

TIT.3.BSB: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
TIT.3.KJV: A man that is an heretic after the first and second admonition reject;
TIT.3.PLAIN: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,

TIT.3.BSB: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
TIT.3.KJV: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sins, being condemned of himself.
TIT.3.PLAIN: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.

TIT.3.BSB: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
TIT.3.KJV: When I shall send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
TIT.3.PLAIN: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

TIT.3.BSB: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
TIT.3.KJV: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting to them.
TIT.3.PLAIN: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.

TIT.3.BSB: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
TIT.3.KJV: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
TIT.3.PLAIN: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.

TIT.3.BSB: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
TIT.3.KJV: All that are with me salute you. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
TIT.3.PLAIN: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.

PHM.1.BSB: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
PHM.1.KJV: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellow laborer,
PHM.1.PLAIN: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,

PHM.1.BSB: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
PHM.1.KJV: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house:
PHM.1.PLAIN: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:

PHM.1.BSB: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
PHM.1.KJV: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
PHM.1.PLAIN: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

PHM.1.BSB: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
PHM.1.KJV: I thank my God, making mention of you always in my prayers,
PHM.1.PLAIN: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,

PHM.1.BSB: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.
PHM.1.KJV: Hearing of your love and faith, which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
PHM.1.PLAIN: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.

PHM.1.BSB: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ.
PHM.1.KJV: That the communication of your faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
PHM.1.PLAIN: I pray that the sharing of your faith may become effective as you fully recognize every good thing we have in Christ.

PHM.1.BSB: I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.
PHM.1.KJV: For we have great joy and consolation in your love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by you, brother.
PHM.1.PLAIN: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the Lord's people.

PHM.1.BSB: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,
PHM.1.KJV: Why, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin you that which is convenient,
PHM.1.PLAIN: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,

PHM.1.BSB: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.
PHM.1.KJV: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech you, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
PHM.1.PLAIN: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.

PHM.1.BSB: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.
PHM.1.KJV: I beseech you for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
PHM.1.PLAIN: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.

PHM.1.BSB: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.
PHM.1.KJV: Which in time past was to you unprofitable, but now profitable to you and to me:
PHM.1.PLAIN: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

PHM.1.BSB: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.
PHM.1.KJV: Whom I have sent again: you therefore receive him, that is, my own bowels:
PHM.1.PLAIN: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.

PHM.1.BSB: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.
PHM.1.KJV: Whom I would have retained with me, that in your stead he might have ministered to me in the bonds of the gospel:
PHM.1.PLAIN: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.

PHM.1.BSB: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.
PHM.1.KJV: But without your mind would I do nothing; that your benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
PHM.1.PLAIN: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.

PHM.1.BSB: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—
PHM.1.KJV: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that you should receive him for ever;
PHM.1.PLAIN: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—

PHM.1.BSB: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.
PHM.1.KJV: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
PHM.1.PLAIN: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother. He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, both in person and in the Lord.

PHM.1.BSB: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
PHM.1.KJV: If you count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
PHM.1.PLAIN: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

PHM.1.BSB: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
PHM.1.KJV: If he has wronged you, or owes you something, put that on my account;
PHM.1.PLAIN: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.

PHM.1.BSB: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.
PHM.1.KJV: I Paul have written it with my own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to you how you owe to me even your own self besides.
PHM.1.PLAIN: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it—not to mention that you owe me your very self.

PHM.1.BSB: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.
PHM.1.KJV: Yes, brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
PHM.1.PLAIN: Yes, brother, let me have some benefit from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in Christ.

PHM.1.BSB: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.
PHM.1.KJV: Having confidence in your obedience I wrote to you, knowing that you will also do more than I say.
PHM.1.PLAIN: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

PHM.1.BSB: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
PHM.1.KJV: But with prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given to you.
PHM.1.PLAIN: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

PHM.1.BSB: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,
PHM.1.KJV: There salute you Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus;
PHM.1.PLAIN: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings,

PHM.1.BSB: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
PHM.1.KJV: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellow laborers.
PHM.1.PLAIN: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

PHM.1.BSB: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
PHM.1.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
PHM.1.PLAIN: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

HEB.1.BSB: On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.
HEB.1.KJV: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,
HEB.1.PLAIN: On many past occasions and in many different ways, God spoke to our fathers through the prophets.

HEB.1.BSB: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.
HEB.1.KJV: Has in these last days spoken to us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
HEB.1.PLAIN: But in these last days He has spoken to us by His Son, whom He appointed heir of all things, and through whom He made the universe.

HEB.1.BSB: The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of His nature, upholding all things by His powerful word. After He had provided purification for sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high.
HEB.1.KJV: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high:
HEB.1.PLAIN: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact expression of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

HEB.1.BSB: So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.
HEB.1.KJV: Being made so much better than the angels, as he has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
HEB.1.PLAIN: So He became as far superior to the angels as the name He has inherited is excellent beyond theirs.

HEB.1.BSB: For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?
HEB.1.KJV: For to which of the angels said he at any time, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
HEB.1.PLAIN: For to which of the angels did God ever say: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father”? Or again: “I will be His Father, and He will be My Son”?

HEB.1.BSB: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”
HEB.1.KJV: And again, when he brings in the first-begotten into the world, he says, And let all the angels of God worship him.
HEB.1.PLAIN: And again, when God brings His firstborn into the world, He says: “Let all God’s angels worship Him.”

HEB.1.BSB: Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”
HEB.1.KJV: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
HEB.1.PLAIN: Now about the angels He says: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.”

HEB.1.BSB: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
HEB.1.KJV: But to the Son he says, Your throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a scepter of righteousness is the scepter of your kingdom.
HEB.1.PLAIN: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

HEB.1.BSB: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”
HEB.1.KJV: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
HEB.1.PLAIN: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, Your God, has anointed You above Your companions with the oil of joy.”

HEB.1.BSB: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
HEB.1.KJV: And, You, Lord, in the beginning have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of your hands:
HEB.1.PLAIN: And: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.

HEB.1.BSB: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.
HEB.1.KJV: They shall perish; but you remain; and they all shall wax old as does a garment;
HEB.1.PLAIN: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

HEB.1.BSB: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
HEB.1.KJV: And as a clothing shall you fold them up, and they shall be changed: but you are the same, and your years shall not fail.
HEB.1.PLAIN: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”

HEB.1.BSB: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?
HEB.1.KJV: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool?
HEB.1.PLAIN: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?

HEB.1.BSB: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?
HEB.1.KJV: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
HEB.1.PLAIN: Are not the angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

HEB.2.BSB: We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.
HEB.2.KJV: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
HEB.2.PLAIN: We must pay closer attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.

HEB.2.BSB: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,
HEB.2.KJV: For if the word spoken by angels was steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward;
HEB.2.PLAIN: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,

HEB.2.BSB: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? This salvation was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,
HEB.2.KJV: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed to us by them that heard him;
HEB.2.PLAIN: how shall we escape if we neglect such a great salvation? This salvation was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard Him,

HEB.2.BSB: and was affirmed by God through signs, wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will.
HEB.2.KJV: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
HEB.2.PLAIN: and was affirmed by God through signs, wonders, various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will.

HEB.2.BSB: For it is not to angels that He has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
HEB.2.KJV: For to the angels has he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
HEB.2.PLAIN: For it is not to angels that He has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

HEB.2.BSB: But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
HEB.2.KJV: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of man that you visit him?
HEB.2.PLAIN: But somewhere it is testified in these words: “What is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?

HEB.2.BSB: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor
HEB.2.KJV: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor, and did set him over the works of your hands:
HEB.2.PLAIN: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor

HEB.2.BSB: and placed everything under his feet.” When God subjected all things to him, He left nothing outside of his control. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.
HEB.2.KJV: You have put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
HEB.2.PLAIN: and placed everything under his feet.” When God subjected all things to him, He left nothing outside of his control. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.

HEB.2.BSB: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.
HEB.2.KJV: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honor; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
HEB.2.PLAIN: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because He suffered death, so that by the grace of God He might taste death for everyone.

HEB.2.BSB: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.
HEB.2.KJV: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
HEB.2.PLAIN: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting for God, for whom and through whom all things exist, to make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.

HEB.2.BSB: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.
HEB.2.KJV: For both he that sanctifies and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
HEB.2.PLAIN: For both the One who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.

HEB.2.BSB: He says: “I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing Your praises in the assembly.”
HEB.2.KJV: Saying, I will declare your name to my brothers, in the middle of the church will I sing praise to you.
HEB.2.PLAIN: He says: “I will proclaim Your name to My brothers; I will sing Your praises in the assembly.”

HEB.2.BSB: And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”
HEB.2.KJV: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God has given me.
HEB.2.PLAIN: And again: “I will put My trust in Him.” And once again: “Here am I, and the children God has given Me.”

HEB.2.BSB: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,
HEB.2.KJV: For as much then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
HEB.2.PLAIN: Now since the children have flesh and blood, He too shared in their humanity, so that by His death He might destroy him who holds the power of death, that is, the devil,

HEB.2.BSB: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.
HEB.2.KJV: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
HEB.2.PLAIN: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

HEB.2.BSB: For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.
HEB.2.KJV: For truly he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
HEB.2.PLAIN: For surely it is not the angels He helps, but the descendants of Abraham.

HEB.2.BSB: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.
HEB.2.KJV: Why in all things it behooved him to be made like to his brothers, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
HEB.2.PLAIN: For this reason He had to be made like His brothers in every way, so that He might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, in order to make atonement for the sins of the people.

HEB.2.BSB: Because He Himself suffered when He was tempted, He is able to help those who are being tempted.
HEB.2.KJV: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to succor them that are tempted.
HEB.2.PLAIN: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.

HEB.3.BSB: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.
HEB.3.KJV: Why, holy brothers, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
HEB.3.PLAIN: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, set your focus on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.

HEB.3.BSB: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.
HEB.3.KJV: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
HEB.3.PLAIN: He was faithful to the One who appointed Him, just as Moses was faithful in all God’s house.

HEB.3.BSB: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
HEB.3.KJV: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who has built the house has more honor than the house.
HEB.3.PLAIN: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.

HEB.3.BSB: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.
HEB.3.KJV: For every house is built by some man; but he that built all things is God.
HEB.3.PLAIN: And every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

HEB.3.BSB: Now Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house, testifying to what would be spoken later.
HEB.3.KJV: And Moses truly was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
HEB.3.PLAIN: Now Moses was faithful as a servant in all God’s house, testifying to what would be spoken later.

HEB.3.BSB: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.
HEB.3.KJV: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.
HEB.3.PLAIN: But Christ is faithful as the Son over God’s house. And we are His house, if we hold firmly to our confidence and the hope of which we boast.

HEB.3.BSB: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear His voice,
HEB.3.KJV: Why (as the Holy Ghost says, To day if you will hear his voice,
HEB.3.PLAIN: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says: “Today, if you hear His voice,

HEB.3.BSB: do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness,
HEB.3.KJV: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
HEB.3.PLAIN: do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion, in the day of testing in the wilderness,

HEB.3.BSB: where your fathers tested and tried Me, and for forty years saw My works.
HEB.3.KJV: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
HEB.3.PLAIN: where your fathers tested and tried Me, and for forty years saw My works.

HEB.3.BSB: Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known My ways.’
HEB.3.KJV: Why I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do always err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
HEB.3.PLAIN: Therefore I was angry with that generation, and I said, ‘Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known My ways.’

HEB.3.BSB: So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’”
HEB.3.KJV: So I swore in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
HEB.3.PLAIN: So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’”

HEB.3.BSB: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
HEB.3.KJV: Take heed, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
HEB.3.PLAIN: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.

HEB.3.BSB: But exhort one another daily, as long as it is called today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin’s deceitfulness.
HEB.3.KJV: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
HEB.3.PLAIN: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called 'Today,' so that none of you is hardened by sin's deceit.

HEB.3.BSB: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.
HEB.3.KJV: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to the end;
HEB.3.PLAIN: We have come to share in Christ if we hold firmly to the end the assurance we had at first.

HEB.3.BSB: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”
HEB.3.KJV: While it is said, To day if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
HEB.3.PLAIN: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”

HEB.3.BSB: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
HEB.3.KJV: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: however, not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
HEB.3.PLAIN: For who were the ones who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?

HEB.3.BSB: And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
HEB.3.KJV: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?
HEB.3.PLAIN: And with whom was God angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

HEB.3.BSB: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
HEB.3.KJV: And to whom swore he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
HEB.3.PLAIN: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?

HEB.3.BSB: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
HEB.3.KJV: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
HEB.3.PLAIN: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.

HEB.4.BSB: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
HEB.4.KJV: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
HEB.4.PLAIN: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.

HEB.4.BSB: For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.
HEB.4.KJV: For to us was the gospel preached, as well as to them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
HEB.4.PLAIN: For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.

HEB.4.BSB: Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
HEB.4.KJV: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
HEB.4.PLAIN: Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.

HEB.4.BSB: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
HEB.4.KJV: For he spoke in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
HEB.4.PLAIN: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”

HEB.4.BSB: And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
HEB.4.KJV: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
HEB.4.PLAIN: And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”

HEB.4.BSB: Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,
HEB.4.KJV: Seeing therefore it remains that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
HEB.4.PLAIN: Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,

HEB.4.BSB: God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
HEB.4.KJV: Again, he limits a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
HEB.4.PLAIN: God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”

HEB.4.BSB: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
HEB.4.KJV: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
HEB.4.PLAIN: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

HEB.4.BSB: There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
HEB.4.KJV: There remains therefore a rest to the people of God.
HEB.4.PLAIN: There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

HEB.4.BSB: For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.
HEB.4.KJV: For he that is entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
HEB.4.PLAIN: For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.

HEB.4.BSB: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.
HEB.4.KJV: Let us labor therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
HEB.4.PLAIN: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.

HEB.4.BSB: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
HEB.4.KJV: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any two edged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
