HEB.4.PLAIN: For the word of God is alive and active, sharper than any two-edged sword. It cuts deep — dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow — and it judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

HEB.4.BSB: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
HEB.4.KJV: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened to the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
HEB.4.PLAIN: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.

HEB.4.BSB: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
HEB.4.KJV: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
HEB.4.PLAIN: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.

HEB.4.BSB: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
HEB.4.KJV: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
HEB.4.PLAIN: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but one who was tempted in every way, just as we are — yet he did not sin.

HEB.4.BSB: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
HEB.4.KJV: Let us therefore come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
HEB.4.PLAIN: So let us come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

HEB.5.BSB: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
HEB.5.KJV: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
HEB.5.PLAIN: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

HEB.5.BSB: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided, since he himself is beset by weakness.
HEB.5.KJV: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
HEB.5.PLAIN: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided, since he himself is beset by weakness.

HEB.5.BSB: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
HEB.5.KJV: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
HEB.5.PLAIN: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.

HEB.5.BSB: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
HEB.5.KJV: And no man takes this honor to himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
HEB.5.PLAIN: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.

HEB.5.BSB: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
HEB.5.KJV: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said to him, You are my Son, to day have I begotten you.
HEB.5.PLAIN: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”

HEB.5.BSB: And in another passage God says: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
HEB.5.KJV: As he says also in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
HEB.5.PLAIN: And in another passage God says: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

HEB.5.BSB: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
HEB.5.KJV: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears to him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
HEB.5.PLAIN: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.

HEB.5.BSB: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.
HEB.5.KJV: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
HEB.5.PLAIN: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.

HEB.5.BSB: And having been made perfect, He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him
HEB.5.KJV: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation to all them that obey him;
HEB.5.PLAIN: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him,

HEB.5.BSB: and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
HEB.5.KJV: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
HEB.5.PLAIN: and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

HEB.5.BSB: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
HEB.5.KJV: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing you are dull of hearing.
HEB.5.PLAIN: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.

HEB.5.BSB: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
HEB.5.KJV: For when for the time you ought to be teachers, you have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
HEB.5.PLAIN: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!

HEB.5.BSB: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
HEB.5.KJV: For every one that uses milk is unskillful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
HEB.5.PLAIN: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.

HEB.5.BSB: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
HEB.5.KJV: But strong meat belongs to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
HEB.5.PLAIN: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.

HEB.6.BSB: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,
HEB.6.KJV: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on to perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
HEB.6.PLAIN: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,

HEB.6.BSB: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
HEB.6.KJV: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
HEB.6.PLAIN: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

HEB.6.BSB: And this we will do, if God permits.
HEB.6.KJV: And this will we do, if God permit.
HEB.6.PLAIN: And this we will do, if God permits.

HEB.6.BSB: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
HEB.6.KJV: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
HEB.6.PLAIN: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

HEB.6.BSB: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—
HEB.6.KJV: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
HEB.6.PLAIN: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—

HEB.6.BSB: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.
HEB.6.KJV: If they shall fall away, to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
HEB.6.PLAIN: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.

HEB.6.BSB: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.
HEB.6.KJV: For the earth which drinks in the rain that comes oft on it, and brings forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receives blessing from God:
HEB.6.PLAIN: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.

HEB.6.BSB: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.
HEB.6.KJV: But that which bears thorns and briers is rejected, and is near to cursing; whose end is to be burned.
HEB.6.PLAIN: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.

HEB.6.BSB: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
HEB.6.KJV: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
HEB.6.PLAIN: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.

HEB.6.BSB: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
HEB.6.KJV: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labor of love, which you have showed toward his name, in that you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
HEB.6.PLAIN: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.

HEB.6.BSB: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.
HEB.6.KJV: And we desire that every one of you do show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope to the end:
HEB.6.PLAIN: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.

HEB.6.BSB: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
HEB.6.KJV: That you be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
HEB.6.PLAIN: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.

HEB.6.BSB: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,
HEB.6.KJV: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he swore by himself,
HEB.6.PLAIN: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,

HEB.6.BSB: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”
HEB.6.KJV: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.
HEB.6.PLAIN: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”

HEB.6.BSB: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.
HEB.6.KJV: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
HEB.6.PLAIN: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.

HEB.6.BSB: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.
HEB.6.KJV: For men truly swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
HEB.6.PLAIN: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.

HEB.6.BSB: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.
HEB.6.KJV: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to show to the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
HEB.6.PLAIN: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.

HEB.6.BSB: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
HEB.6.KJV: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold on the hope set before us:
HEB.6.PLAIN: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.

HEB.6.BSB: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
HEB.6.KJV: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and which enters into that within the veil;
HEB.6.PLAIN: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It reaches behind the curtain into God's very presence,

HEB.6.BSB: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
HEB.6.KJV: Where the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
HEB.6.PLAIN: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.

HEB.7.BSB: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
HEB.7.KJV: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
HEB.7.PLAIN: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

HEB.7.BSB: and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”
HEB.7.KJV: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
HEB.7.PLAIN: and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”

HEB.7.BSB: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
HEB.7.KJV: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like to the Son of God; stays a priest continually.
HEB.7.PLAIN: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.

HEB.7.BSB: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
HEB.7.KJV: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
HEB.7.PLAIN: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.

HEB.7.BSB: Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.
HEB.7.KJV: And truly they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
HEB.7.PLAIN: Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.

HEB.7.BSB: But Melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
HEB.7.KJV: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
HEB.7.PLAIN: But Melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

HEB.7.BSB: And indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.
HEB.7.KJV: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
HEB.7.PLAIN: And indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.

HEB.7.BSB: In the case of the Levites, mortal men collect the tenth; but in the case of Melchizedek, it is affirmed that he lives on.
HEB.7.KJV: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.
HEB.7.PLAIN: In the case of the Levites, mortal men collect the tenth; but in the case of Melchizedek, it is affirmed that he lives on.

HEB.7.BSB: And so to speak, Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.
HEB.7.KJV: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receives tithes, paid tithes in Abraham.
HEB.7.PLAIN: And so to speak, Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.

HEB.7.BSB: For when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the loin of his ancestor.
HEB.7.KJV: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
HEB.7.PLAIN: For when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the loin of his ancestor.

HEB.7.BSB: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
HEB.7.KJV: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
HEB.7.PLAIN: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?

HEB.7.BSB: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed as well.
HEB.7.KJV: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
HEB.7.PLAIN: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed as well.

HEB.7.BSB: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
HEB.7.KJV: For he of whom these things are spoken pertains to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
HEB.7.PLAIN: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.

HEB.7.BSB: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
HEB.7.KJV: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
HEB.7.PLAIN: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.

HEB.7.BSB: And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
HEB.7.KJV: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there rises another priest,
HEB.7.PLAIN: And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

HEB.7.BSB: one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.
HEB.7.KJV: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
HEB.7.PLAIN: one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.

HEB.7.BSB: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
HEB.7.KJV: For he testifies, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
HEB.7.PLAIN: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

HEB.7.BSB: So the former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless
HEB.7.KJV: For there is truly a cancellation of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
HEB.7.PLAIN: So the former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless

HEB.7.BSB: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.
HEB.7.KJV: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw near to God.
HEB.7.PLAIN: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.

HEB.7.BSB: And none of this happened without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,
HEB.7.KJV: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
HEB.7.PLAIN: And none of this happened without an oath. For others became priests without an oath,

HEB.7.BSB: but Jesus became a priest with an oath by the One who said to Him: “The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’”
HEB.7.KJV: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said to him, The Lord swore and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
HEB.7.PLAIN: but Jesus became a priest with an oath by the One who said to Him: “The Lord has sworn and will not change His mind: ‘You are a priest forever.’”

HEB.7.BSB: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
HEB.7.KJV: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
HEB.7.PLAIN: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

HEB.7.BSB: Now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.
HEB.7.KJV: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
HEB.7.PLAIN: Now there have been many other priests, since death prevented them from continuing in office.

HEB.7.BSB: But because Jesus lives forever, He has a permanent priesthood.
HEB.7.KJV: But this man, because he continues ever, has an unchangeable priesthood.
HEB.7.PLAIN: But because Jesus lives forever, He has a permanent priesthood.

HEB.7.BSB: Therefore He is able to save completely those who draw near to God through Him, since He always lives to intercede for them.
HEB.7.KJV: Why he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come to God by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.
HEB.7.PLAIN: So he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

HEB.7.BSB: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.
HEB.7.KJV: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
HEB.7.PLAIN: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.

HEB.7.BSB: Unlike the other high priests, He does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people; He sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.
HEB.7.KJV: Who needs not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
HEB.7.PLAIN: Unlike the other high priests, He does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people; He sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.

HEB.7.BSB: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.
HEB.7.KJV: For the law makes men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, makes the Son, who is consecrated for ever more.
HEB.7.PLAIN: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

HEB.8.BSB: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
HEB.8.KJV: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
HEB.8.PLAIN: The point of what we are saying is this: We do have such a high priest, who sat down at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,

HEB.8.BSB: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
HEB.8.KJV: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
HEB.8.PLAIN: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.

HEB.8.BSB: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.
HEB.8.KJV: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: why it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
HEB.8.PLAIN: And since every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices, it was necessary for this One also to have something to offer.

HEB.8.BSB: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
HEB.8.KJV: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
HEB.8.PLAIN: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.

HEB.8.BSB: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”
HEB.8.KJV: Who serve to the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, says he, that you make all things according to the pattern showed to you in the mount.
HEB.8.PLAIN: The place where they serve is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: “See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.”

HEB.8.BSB: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.
HEB.8.KJV: But now has he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established on better promises.
HEB.8.PLAIN: Now, however, Jesus has received a much more excellent ministry, just as the covenant He mediates is better and is founded on better promises.

HEB.8.BSB: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.
HEB.8.KJV: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
HEB.8.PLAIN: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.

HEB.8.BSB: But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
HEB.8.KJV: For finding fault with them, he says, Behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:
HEB.8.PLAIN: But God found fault with the people and said: “Look closely — the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

HEB.8.BSB: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord.
HEB.8.KJV: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, says the Lord.
HEB.8.PLAIN: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord.

HEB.8.BSB: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
HEB.8.KJV: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:
HEB.8.PLAIN: For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.

HEB.8.BSB: No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.
HEB.8.KJV: And they shall not teach every man his neighbor, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
HEB.8.PLAIN: No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest.

HEB.8.BSB: For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
HEB.8.KJV: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
HEB.8.PLAIN: For I will forgive their wrongdoing and remember their sins no more.

HEB.8.BSB: By speaking of a new covenant, He has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.
HEB.8.KJV: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. Now that which decays and waxes old is ready to vanish away.
HEB.8.PLAIN: By speaking of a new covenant, He has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.

HEB.9.BSB: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.
HEB.9.KJV: Then truly the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
HEB.9.PLAIN: Now the first covenant had regulations for worship and also an earthly sanctuary.

HEB.9.BSB: A tabernacle was prepared. In its first room were the lampstand, the table, and the consecrated bread. This was called the Holy Place.
HEB.9.KJV: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the show bread; which is called the sanctuary.
HEB.9.PLAIN: A tabernacle was prepared. In its first room were the lampstand, the table, and the consecrated bread. This was called the Holy Place.

HEB.9.BSB: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,
HEB.9.KJV: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
HEB.9.PLAIN: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,

HEB.9.BSB: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
HEB.9.KJV: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
HEB.9.PLAIN: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

HEB.9.BSB: Above the ark were the cherubim of glory, overshadowing the mercy seat. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.
HEB.9.KJV: And over it the cherubim of glory shadowing the mercy seat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
HEB.9.PLAIN: Above the ark were the cherubim of glory, overshadowing the mercy seat. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.

HEB.9.BSB: When everything had been prepared in this way, the priests entered regularly into the first room to perform their sacred duties.
HEB.9.KJV: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.
HEB.9.PLAIN: When everything had been prepared in this way, the priests entered regularly into the first room to perform their sacred duties.

HEB.9.BSB: But only the high priest entered the second room, and then only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
HEB.9.KJV: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
HEB.9.PLAIN: But only the high priest entered the second room, and then only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.

HEB.9.BSB: By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.
HEB.9.KJV: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
HEB.9.PLAIN: By this arrangement the Holy Spirit was showing that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.

HEB.9.BSB: It is an illustration for the present time, because the gifts and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse the conscience of the worshiper.
HEB.9.KJV: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
HEB.9.PLAIN: It is an illustration for the present time, because the gifts and sacrifices being offered were unable to cleanse the conscience of the worshiper.

HEB.9.BSB: They consist only in food and drink and special washings—external regulations imposed until the time of reform.
HEB.9.KJV: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
HEB.9.PLAIN: They consist only in food and drink and special washings—external regulations imposed until the time of reform.

HEB.9.BSB: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.
HEB.9.KJV: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
HEB.9.PLAIN: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.

HEB.9.BSB: He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves, but He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption.
HEB.9.KJV: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
HEB.9.PLAIN: He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves, but He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption.

HEB.9.BSB: For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,
HEB.9.KJV: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifies to the purifying of the flesh:
HEB.9.PLAIN: For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,

HEB.9.BSB: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!
HEB.9.KJV: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
HEB.9.PLAIN: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished to God, purify our consciences from works of death, so that we may serve the living God!

HEB.9.BSB: Therefore Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, now that He has died to redeem them from the transgressions committed under the first covenant.
HEB.9.KJV: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
HEB.9.PLAIN: Therefore Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance, now that He has died to redeem them from the wanderings and failures committed under the first covenant.

HEB.9.BSB: In the case of a will, it is necessary to establish the death of the one who made it,
HEB.9.KJV: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
HEB.9.PLAIN: In the case of a will, it is necessary to establish the death of the one who made it,

HEB.9.BSB: because a will does not take effect until the one who made it has died; it cannot be executed while he is still alive.
HEB.9.KJV: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator lives.
HEB.9.PLAIN: because a will does not take effect until the one who made it has died; it cannot be executed while he is still alive.

HEB.9.BSB: That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
HEB.9.KJV: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
HEB.9.PLAIN: That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.

HEB.9.BSB: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,
HEB.9.KJV: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
HEB.9.PLAIN: For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,

HEB.9.BSB: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”
HEB.9.KJV: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God has enjoined to you.
HEB.9.PLAIN: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep.”

HEB.9.BSB: In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.
HEB.9.KJV: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
HEB.9.PLAIN: In the same way, he sprinkled with blood the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship.

HEB.9.BSB: According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
HEB.9.KJV: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
HEB.9.PLAIN: According to the law, in fact, nearly everything must be purified with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

HEB.9.BSB: So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
HEB.9.KJV: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
HEB.9.PLAIN: So it was necessary for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

HEB.9.BSB: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.
HEB.9.KJV: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
HEB.9.PLAIN: For Christ did not enter a man-made copy of the true sanctuary, but He entered heaven itself, now to appear on our behalf in the presence of God.

HEB.9.BSB: Nor did He enter heaven to offer Himself again and again, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.
HEB.9.KJV: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place every year with blood of others;
HEB.9.PLAIN: Nor did He enter heaven to offer Himself again and again, as the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.

HEB.9.BSB: Otherwise, Christ would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But now He has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of Himself.
HEB.9.KJV: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world has he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
HEB.9.PLAIN: Otherwise, Christ would have had to suffer repeatedly since the foundation of the world. But now He has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of Himself.

HEB.9.BSB: Just as man is appointed to die once, and after that to face judgment,
HEB.9.KJV: And as it is appointed to men once to die, but after this the judgment:
HEB.9.PLAIN: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

HEB.9.BSB: so also Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and He will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who eagerly await Him.
HEB.9.KJV: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and to them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin to salvation.
HEB.9.PLAIN: so Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many; and he will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

HEB.10.BSB: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
HEB.10.KJV: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
HEB.10.PLAIN: For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

HEB.10.BSB: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.
HEB.10.KJV: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
HEB.10.PLAIN: If it could, would not the offerings have ceased? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt the guilt of their sins.

HEB.10.BSB: Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,
HEB.10.KJV: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
HEB.10.PLAIN: Instead, those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,

HEB.10.BSB: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
HEB.10.KJV: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
HEB.10.PLAIN: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

HEB.10.BSB: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
HEB.10.KJV: Why when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you would not, but a body have you prepared me:
HEB.10.PLAIN: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.

HEB.10.BSB: In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight.
HEB.10.KJV: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you have had no pleasure.
HEB.10.PLAIN: In burnt offerings and sin offerings You took no delight.

HEB.10.BSB: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”
HEB.10.KJV: Then said I, See, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do your will, O God.
HEB.10.PLAIN: Then I said, ‘Here I am, it is written about Me in the scroll: I have come to do Your will, O God.’”

HEB.10.BSB: In the passage above He says, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).
HEB.10.KJV: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin you would not, neither had pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
HEB.10.PLAIN: In the passage above He says, “Sacrifices and offerings, burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not desire, nor did You delight in them” (although they are offered according to the law).

HEB.10.BSB: Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first to establish the second.
HEB.10.KJV: Then said he, See, I come to do your will, O God. He takes away the first, that he may establish the second.
HEB.10.PLAIN: Then He adds, “Here I am, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first to establish the second.

HEB.10.BSB: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
HEB.10.KJV: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
HEB.10.PLAIN: And by that will, we have been sanctified through the sacrifice of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

HEB.10.BSB: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
HEB.10.KJV: And every priest stands daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
HEB.10.PLAIN: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

HEB.10.BSB: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.
HEB.10.KJV: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
HEB.10.PLAIN: But when this Priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, He sat down at the right hand of God.

HEB.10.BSB: Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,
HEB.10.KJV: From now on expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
HEB.10.PLAIN: Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,

HEB.10.BSB: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.
HEB.10.KJV: For by one offering he has perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
HEB.10.PLAIN: because by a single offering He has made perfect for all time those who are being sanctified.

HEB.10.BSB: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First He says:
HEB.10.KJV: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
HEB.10.PLAIN: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First He says:

HEB.10.BSB: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
HEB.10.KJV: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
HEB.10.PLAIN: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”

HEB.10.BSB: Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”
HEB.10.KJV: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
HEB.10.PLAIN: Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”

HEB.10.BSB: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.
HEB.10.KJV: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
HEB.10.PLAIN: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.

HEB.10.BSB: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
HEB.10.KJV: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
HEB.10.PLAIN: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

HEB.10.BSB: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
HEB.10.KJV: By a new and living way, which he has consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
HEB.10.PLAIN: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,

HEB.10.BSB: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
HEB.10.KJV: And having an high priest over the house of God;
HEB.10.PLAIN: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

HEB.10.BSB: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
HEB.10.KJV: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
HEB.10.PLAIN: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.

HEB.10.BSB: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
HEB.10.KJV: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
HEB.10.PLAIN: Let us hold tightly to the hope we profess, without wavering, for the one who promised is faithful.

HEB.10.BSB: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
HEB.10.KJV: And let us consider one another to provoke to love and to good works:
HEB.10.PLAIN: And let us consider how we can spur one another on toward love and good deeds,

HEB.10.BSB: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
HEB.10.KJV: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as you see the day approaching.
HEB.10.PLAIN: not neglecting to meet together, as some are in the habit of doing, but encouraging one another — and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

HEB.10.BSB: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,
HEB.10.KJV: For if we sin willfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,
HEB.10.PLAIN: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,

HEB.10.BSB: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.
HEB.10.KJV: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
HEB.10.PLAIN: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.

HEB.10.BSB: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
HEB.10.KJV: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
HEB.10.PLAIN: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

HEB.10.BSB: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
HEB.10.KJV: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose you, shall he be thought worthy, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant, with which he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and has done despite to the Spirit of grace?
HEB.10.PLAIN: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?

HEB.10.BSB: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
HEB.10.KJV: For we know him that has says, Vengeance belongs to me, I will recompense, said the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
HEB.10.PLAIN: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”

HEB.10.BSB: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
HEB.10.KJV: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
HEB.10.PLAIN: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

HEB.10.BSB: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.
HEB.10.KJV: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great fight of afflictions;
HEB.10.PLAIN: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.

HEB.10.BSB: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
HEB.10.KJV: Partly, whilst you were made a spectacle both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst you became companions of them that were so used.
HEB.10.PLAIN: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.

HEB.10.BSB: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
HEB.10.KJV: For you had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that you have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
HEB.10.PLAIN: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.

HEB.10.BSB: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
HEB.10.KJV: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which has great recompense of reward.
HEB.10.PLAIN: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.

HEB.10.BSB: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
HEB.10.KJV: For you have need of patience, that, after you have done the will of God, you might receive the promise.
HEB.10.PLAIN: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.

HEB.10.BSB: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
HEB.10.KJV: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
HEB.10.PLAIN: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.

HEB.10.BSB: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
HEB.10.KJV: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
HEB.10.PLAIN: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”

HEB.10.BSB: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
HEB.10.KJV: But we are not of them who draw back to perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
HEB.10.PLAIN: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.

HEB.11.BSB: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
HEB.11.KJV: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
HEB.11.PLAIN: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

HEB.11.BSB: This is why the ancients were commended.
HEB.11.KJV: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
HEB.11.PLAIN: This is why the ancients were commended.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
HEB.11.KJV: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

HEB.11.BSB: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
HEB.11.KJV: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that comes to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
HEB.11.PLAIN: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing where he went.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

HEB.11.BSB: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
HEB.11.KJV: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
HEB.11.PLAIN: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.
HEB.11.KJV: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.

HEB.11.BSB: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
HEB.11.KJV: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
HEB.11.PLAIN: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

HEB.11.BSB: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
HEB.11.KJV: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
HEB.11.PLAIN: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.

HEB.11.BSB: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.
HEB.11.KJV: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
HEB.11.PLAIN: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.

HEB.11.BSB: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
HEB.11.KJV: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from where they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
HEB.11.PLAIN: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.

HEB.11.BSB: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
HEB.11.KJV: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: why God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he has prepared for them a city.
HEB.11.PLAIN: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,

HEB.11.BSB: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
HEB.11.KJV: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall your seed be called:
HEB.11.PLAIN: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”

HEB.11.BSB: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.
HEB.11.KJV: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from where also he received him in a figure.
HEB.11.PLAIN: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning on the top of his staff.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.

HEB.11.BSB: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
HEB.11.KJV: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
HEB.11.PLAIN: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.

HEB.11.BSB: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.
HEB.11.KJV: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect to the recompense of the reward.
HEB.11.PLAIN: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
HEB.11.KJV: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

HEB.11.BSB: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.
HEB.11.KJV: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
HEB.11.PLAIN: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.

HEB.11.BSB: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,
HEB.11.KJV: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
HEB.11.PLAIN: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,

HEB.11.BSB: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
HEB.11.KJV: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions.
HEB.11.PLAIN: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

HEB.11.BSB: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.
HEB.11.KJV: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
HEB.11.PLAIN: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.

HEB.11.BSB: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
HEB.11.KJV: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
HEB.11.PLAIN: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.

HEB.11.BSB: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
HEB.11.KJV: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yes, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
HEB.11.PLAIN: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.

HEB.11.BSB: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.
HEB.11.KJV: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
HEB.11.PLAIN: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.

HEB.11.BSB: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
HEB.11.KJV: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
HEB.11.PLAIN: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.

HEB.11.BSB: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
HEB.11.KJV: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
HEB.11.PLAIN: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.

HEB.11.BSB: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.
HEB.11.KJV: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
HEB.11.PLAIN: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.

HEB.12.BSB: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
HEB.12.KJV: Why seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which does so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
HEB.12.PLAIN: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that holds us back and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us,

HEB.12.BSB: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
HEB.12.KJV: Looking to Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
HEB.12.PLAIN: fixing our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

HEB.12.BSB: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
HEB.12.KJV: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest you be wearied and faint in your minds.
HEB.12.PLAIN: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

HEB.12.BSB: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
HEB.12.KJV: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
HEB.12.PLAIN: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

HEB.12.BSB: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
HEB.12.KJV: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to children, My son, despise not you the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are rebuked of him:
HEB.12.PLAIN: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.

HEB.12.BSB: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
HEB.12.KJV: For whom the Lord loves he chastens, and whips every son whom he receives.
HEB.12.PLAIN: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”

HEB.12.BSB: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
HEB.12.KJV: If you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chastens not?
HEB.12.PLAIN: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?

HEB.12.BSB: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
HEB.12.KJV: But if you be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are you bastards, and not sons.
HEB.12.PLAIN: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.

HEB.12.BSB: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
HEB.12.KJV: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
HEB.12.PLAIN: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?

HEB.12.BSB: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
HEB.12.KJV: For they truly for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
HEB.12.PLAIN: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.

HEB.12.BSB: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
