HEB.12.KJV: Now no chastening for the present seems to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to them which are exercised thereby.
HEB.12.PLAIN: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, though, it produces a harvest of peace and righteousness for those who have been trained by it.

HEB.12.BSB: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
HEB.12.KJV: Why lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
HEB.12.PLAIN: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.

HEB.12.BSB: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.
HEB.12.KJV: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
HEB.12.PLAIN: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

HEB.12.BSB: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
HEB.12.KJV: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
HEB.12.PLAIN: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.

HEB.12.BSB: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
HEB.12.KJV: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
HEB.12.PLAIN: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.

HEB.12.BSB: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
HEB.12.KJV: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
HEB.12.PLAIN: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.

HEB.12.BSB: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.
HEB.12.KJV: For you know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
HEB.12.PLAIN: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.

HEB.12.BSB: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;
HEB.12.KJV: For you are not come to the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor to blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
HEB.12.PLAIN: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;

HEB.12.BSB: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.
HEB.12.KJV: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
HEB.12.PLAIN: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.

HEB.12.BSB: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
HEB.12.KJV: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
HEB.12.PLAIN: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”

HEB.12.BSB: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
HEB.12.KJV: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
HEB.12.PLAIN: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”

HEB.12.BSB: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
HEB.12.KJV: But you are come to mount Sion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
HEB.12.PLAIN: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels

HEB.12.BSB: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
HEB.12.KJV: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
HEB.12.PLAIN: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,

HEB.12.BSB: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
HEB.12.KJV: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaks better things than that of Abel.
HEB.12.PLAIN: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

HEB.12.BSB: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
HEB.12.KJV: See that you refuse not him that speaks. For if they escaped not who refused him that spoke on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaks from heaven:
HEB.12.PLAIN: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?

HEB.12.BSB: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”
HEB.12.KJV: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
HEB.12.PLAIN: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”

HEB.12.BSB: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.
HEB.12.KJV: And this word, Yet once more, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
HEB.12.PLAIN: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.

HEB.12.BSB: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
HEB.12.KJV: Why we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
HEB.12.PLAIN: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.

HEB.12.BSB: “For our God is a consuming fire.”
HEB.12.KJV: For our God is a consuming fire.
HEB.12.PLAIN: “For our God is a consuming fire.”

HEB.13.BSB: Continue in brotherly love.
HEB.13.KJV: Let brotherly love continue.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Continue in brotherly love.

HEB.13.BSB: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
HEB.13.KJV: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

HEB.13.BSB: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
HEB.13.KJV: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.

HEB.13.BSB: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
HEB.13.KJV: Marriage is honorable in all, and the bed undefiled: but fornicators and adulterers God will judge.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

HEB.13.BSB: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
HEB.13.KJV: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as you have: for he has said, I will never leave you, nor forsake you.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Keep your life free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, 'I will never leave you, nor forsake you.'

HEB.13.BSB: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
HEB.13.KJV: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do to me.
HEB.13.PLAIN: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”

HEB.13.BSB: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
HEB.13.KJV: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken to you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

HEB.13.BSB: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
HEB.13.KJV: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

HEB.13.BSB: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
HEB.13.KJV: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

HEB.13.BSB: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
HEB.13.KJV: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
HEB.13.PLAIN: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.

HEB.13.BSB: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
HEB.13.KJV: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.

HEB.13.BSB: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
HEB.13.KJV: Why Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
HEB.13.PLAIN: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.

HEB.13.BSB: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
HEB.13.KJV: Let us go forth therefore to him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.

HEB.13.BSB: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
HEB.13.KJV: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
HEB.13.PLAIN: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

HEB.13.BSB: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
HEB.13.KJV: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.

HEB.13.BSB: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
HEB.13.KJV: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
HEB.13.PLAIN: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.

HEB.13.BSB: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.
HEB.13.KJV: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.

HEB.13.BSB: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
HEB.13.KJV: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

HEB.13.BSB: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.
HEB.13.KJV: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
HEB.13.PLAIN: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.

HEB.13.BSB: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
HEB.13.KJV: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
HEB.13.PLAIN: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,

HEB.13.BSB: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
HEB.13.KJV: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
HEB.13.PLAIN: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.

HEB.13.BSB: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.
HEB.13.KJV: And I beseech you, brothers, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter to you in few words.
HEB.13.PLAIN: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.

HEB.13.BSB: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
HEB.13.KJV: Know you that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

HEB.13.BSB: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.
HEB.13.KJV: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.

HEB.13.BSB: Grace be with all of you.
HEB.13.KJV: Grace be with you all. Amen.
HEB.13.PLAIN: Grace be with all of you.

JAS.1.BSB: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
JAS.1.KJV: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
JAS.1.PLAIN: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.

JAS.1.BSB: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
JAS.1.KJV: My brothers, count it all joy when you fall into divers temptations;
JAS.1.PLAIN: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

JAS.1.BSB: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
JAS.1.KJV: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith works patience.
JAS.1.PLAIN: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

JAS.1.BSB: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
JAS.1.KJV: But let patience have her perfect work, that you may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

JAS.1.BSB: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
JAS.1.KJV: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that gives to all men liberally, and upbraids not; and it shall be given him.
JAS.1.PLAIN: If any of you lacks wisdom, ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to you.

JAS.1.BSB: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
JAS.1.KJV: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavers is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
JAS.1.PLAIN: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

JAS.1.BSB: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
JAS.1.KJV: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
JAS.1.PLAIN: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.

JAS.1.BSB: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
JAS.1.KJV: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
JAS.1.PLAIN: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

JAS.1.BSB: The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.
JAS.1.KJV: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
JAS.1.PLAIN: The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.

JAS.1.BSB: But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
JAS.1.KJV: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
JAS.1.PLAIN: But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.

JAS.1.BSB: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
JAS.1.KJV: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it wither the grass, and the flower thereof falls, and the grace of the fashion of it perishes: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
JAS.1.PLAIN: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.

JAS.1.BSB: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
JAS.1.KJV: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Blessed is the one who perseveres under trial, because having stood the test, they will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love him.

JAS.1.BSB: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
JAS.1.KJV: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempts he any man:
JAS.1.PLAIN: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.

JAS.1.BSB: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
JAS.1.KJV: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
JAS.1.PLAIN: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.

JAS.1.BSB: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
JAS.1.KJV: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

JAS.1.BSB: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
JAS.1.KJV: Do not err, my beloved brothers.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.

JAS.1.BSB: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
JAS.1.KJV: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no ficklenss, neither shadow of turning.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, who does not change like shifting shadows.

JAS.1.BSB: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.
JAS.1.KJV: Of his own will fathered he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
JAS.1.PLAIN: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.

JAS.1.BSB: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
JAS.1.KJV: Why, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
JAS.1.PLAIN: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,

JAS.1.BSB: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
JAS.1.KJV: For the wrath of man works not the righteousness of God.
JAS.1.PLAIN: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.

JAS.1.BSB: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
JAS.1.KJV: Why lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.

JAS.1.BSB: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
JAS.1.KJV: But be you doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
JAS.1.PLAIN: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.

JAS.1.BSB: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
JAS.1.KJV: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like to a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
JAS.1.PLAIN: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,

JAS.1.BSB: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
JAS.1.KJV: For he beholds himself, and goes his way, and straightway forgets what manner of man he was.
JAS.1.PLAIN: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

JAS.1.BSB: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
JAS.1.KJV: But whoever looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
JAS.1.PLAIN: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.

JAS.1.BSB: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
JAS.1.KJV: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridles not his tongue, but deceives his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
JAS.1.PLAIN: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.

JAS.1.BSB: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
JAS.1.KJV: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
JAS.1.PLAIN: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

JAS.2.BSB: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
JAS.2.KJV: My brothers, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
JAS.2.PLAIN: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.

JAS.2.BSB: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
JAS.2.KJV: For if there come to your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
JAS.2.PLAIN: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.

JAS.2.BSB: If you lavish attention on the man in fine clothes and say, “Here is a seat of honor,” but say to the poor man, “You must stand” or “Sit at my feet,”
JAS.2.KJV: And you have respect to him that wears the gay clothing, and say to him, Sit you here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand you there, or sit here under my footstool:
JAS.2.PLAIN: If you lavish attention on the man in fine clothes and say, “Here is a seat of honor,” but say to the poor man, “You must stand” or “Sit at my feet,”

JAS.2.BSB: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
JAS.2.KJV: Are you not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
JAS.2.PLAIN: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?

JAS.2.BSB: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
JAS.2.KJV: Listen, my beloved brothers, Has not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he has promised to them that love him?
JAS.2.PLAIN: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?

JAS.2.BSB: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
JAS.2.KJV: But you have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
JAS.2.PLAIN: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?

JAS.2.BSB: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
JAS.2.KJV: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which you are called?
JAS.2.PLAIN: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?

JAS.2.BSB: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
JAS.2.KJV: If you fulfill the royal law according to the scripture, You shall love your neighbor as yourself, you do well:
JAS.2.PLAIN: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.

JAS.2.BSB: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
JAS.2.KJV: But if you have respect to persons, you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
JAS.2.PLAIN: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.

JAS.2.BSB: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
JAS.2.KJV: For whoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
JAS.2.PLAIN: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

JAS.2.BSB: For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
JAS.2.KJV: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if you commit no adultery, yet if you kill, you are become a transgressor of the law.
JAS.2.PLAIN: For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.

JAS.2.BSB: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
JAS.2.KJV: So speak you, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
JAS.2.PLAIN: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.

JAS.2.BSB: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
JAS.2.KJV: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that has showed no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.
JAS.2.PLAIN: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

JAS.2.BSB: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
JAS.2.KJV: What does it profit, my brothers, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
JAS.2.PLAIN: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?

JAS.2.BSB: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
JAS.2.KJV: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
JAS.2.PLAIN: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.

JAS.2.BSB: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
JAS.2.KJV: And one of you say to them, Depart in peace, be you warmed and filled; notwithstanding you give them not those things which are needful to the body; what does it profit?
JAS.2.PLAIN: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?

JAS.2.BSB: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
JAS.2.KJV: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.
JAS.2.PLAIN: In the same way, faith by itself, if it isn't accompanied by action, is dead.

JAS.2.BSB: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
JAS.2.KJV: Yes, a man may say, You have faith, and I have works: show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
JAS.2.PLAIN: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.

JAS.2.BSB: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
JAS.2.KJV: You believe that there is one God; you do well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
JAS.2.PLAIN: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.

JAS.2.BSB: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
JAS.2.KJV: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
JAS.2.PLAIN: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?

JAS.2.BSB: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
JAS.2.KJV: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son on the altar?
JAS.2.PLAIN: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?

JAS.2.BSB: You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
JAS.2.KJV: See you how faith worked with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
JAS.2.PLAIN: You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.

JAS.2.BSB: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
JAS.2.KJV: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed to him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
JAS.2.PLAIN: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.

JAS.2.BSB: As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
JAS.2.KJV: You see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
JAS.2.PLAIN: As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.

JAS.2.BSB: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
JAS.2.KJV: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
JAS.2.PLAIN: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?

JAS.2.BSB: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
JAS.2.KJV: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
JAS.2.PLAIN: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

JAS.3.BSB: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
JAS.3.KJV: My brothers, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
JAS.3.PLAIN: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.

JAS.3.BSB: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
JAS.3.KJV: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
JAS.3.PLAIN: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.

JAS.3.BSB: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
JAS.3.KJV: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
JAS.3.PLAIN: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.

JAS.3.BSB: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
JAS.3.KJV: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, wherever the governor wants.
JAS.3.PLAIN: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.

JAS.3.BSB: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
JAS.3.KJV: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasts great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindles!
JAS.3.PLAIN: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.

JAS.3.BSB: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
JAS.3.KJV: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
JAS.3.PLAIN: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

JAS.3.BSB: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
JAS.3.KJV: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind:
JAS.3.PLAIN: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,

JAS.3.BSB: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
JAS.3.KJV: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
JAS.3.PLAIN: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

JAS.3.BSB: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
JAS.3.KJV: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
JAS.3.PLAIN: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.

JAS.3.BSB: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!
JAS.3.KJV: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not so to be.
JAS.3.PLAIN: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!

JAS.3.BSB: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
JAS.3.KJV: Does a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
JAS.3.PLAIN: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

JAS.3.BSB: My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.
JAS.3.KJV: Can the fig tree, my brothers, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
JAS.3.PLAIN: My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.

JAS.3.BSB: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
JAS.3.KJV: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him show out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
JAS.3.PLAIN: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

JAS.3.BSB: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
JAS.3.KJV: But if you have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
JAS.3.PLAIN: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.

JAS.3.BSB: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
JAS.3.KJV: This wisdom descends not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
JAS.3.PLAIN: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.

JAS.3.BSB: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
JAS.3.KJV: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
JAS.3.PLAIN: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.

JAS.3.BSB: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
JAS.3.KJV: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
JAS.3.PLAIN: But the wisdom that comes from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, willing to yield, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.

JAS.3.BSB: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
JAS.3.KJV: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
JAS.3.PLAIN: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.

JAS.4.BSB: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
JAS.4.KJV: From where come wars and fights among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
JAS.4.PLAIN: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?

JAS.4.BSB: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
JAS.4.KJV: You lust, and have not: you kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: you fight and war, yet you have not, because you ask not.
JAS.4.PLAIN: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.

JAS.4.BSB: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
JAS.4.KJV: You ask, and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may consume it on your lusts.
JAS.4.PLAIN: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.

JAS.4.BSB: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
JAS.4.KJV: You adulterers and adulteresses, know you not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
JAS.4.PLAIN: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.

JAS.4.BSB: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
JAS.4.KJV: Do you think that the scripture says in vain, The spirit that dwells in us lusts to envy?
JAS.4.PLAIN: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?

JAS.4.BSB: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
JAS.4.KJV: But he gives more grace. Why he says, God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.
JAS.4.PLAIN: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

JAS.4.BSB: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
JAS.4.KJV: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
JAS.4.PLAIN: So submit yourselves to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

JAS.4.BSB: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
JAS.4.KJV: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double minded.
JAS.4.PLAIN: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

JAS.4.BSB: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
JAS.4.KJV: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
JAS.4.PLAIN: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

JAS.4.BSB: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
JAS.4.KJV: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
JAS.4.PLAIN: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

JAS.4.BSB: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
JAS.4.KJV: Speak not evil one of another, brothers. He that speaks evil of his brother, and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law, and judges the law: but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
JAS.4.PLAIN: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.

JAS.4.BSB: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
JAS.4.KJV: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who are you that judge another?
JAS.4.PLAIN: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?

JAS.4.BSB: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”
JAS.4.KJV: Go to now, you that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
JAS.4.PLAIN: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”

JAS.4.BSB: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
JAS.4.KJV: Whereas you know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
JAS.4.PLAIN: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

JAS.4.BSB: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
JAS.4.KJV: For that you ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
JAS.4.PLAIN: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”

JAS.4.BSB: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
JAS.4.KJV: But now you rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
JAS.4.PLAIN: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.

JAS.4.BSB: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
JAS.4.KJV: Therefore to him that knows to do good, and does it not, to him it is sin.
JAS.4.PLAIN: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.

JAS.5.BSB: Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you.
JAS.5.KJV: Go to now, you rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come on you.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you.

JAS.5.BSB: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes.
JAS.5.KJV: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are moth-eaten.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes.

JAS.5.BSB: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
JAS.5.KJV: Your gold and silver is corroded; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. You have heaped treasure together for the last days.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.

JAS.5.BSB: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
JAS.5.KJV: Behold, the hire of the laborers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, cries: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.

JAS.5.BSB: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter.
JAS.5.KJV: You have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; you have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
JAS.5.PLAIN: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter.

JAS.5.BSB: You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.
JAS.5.KJV: You have condemned and killed the just; and he does not resist you.
JAS.5.PLAIN: You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.

JAS.5.BSB: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
JAS.5.KJV: Be patient therefore, brothers, to the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, and has long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.

JAS.5.BSB: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
JAS.5.KJV: Be you also patient; establish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draws near.
JAS.5.PLAIN: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.

JAS.5.BSB: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
JAS.5.KJV: Grudge not one against another, brothers, lest you be condemned: behold, the judge stands before the door.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!

JAS.5.BSB: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
JAS.5.KJV: Take, my brothers, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

JAS.5.BSB: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
JAS.5.KJV: Behold, we count them happy which endure. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
JAS.5.PLAIN: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

JAS.5.BSB: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
JAS.5.KJV: But above all things, my brothers, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yes be yes; and your no, no; lest you fall into condemnation.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.

JAS.5.BSB: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
JAS.5.KJV: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.

JAS.5.BSB: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.
JAS.5.KJV: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
JAS.5.PLAIN: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.

JAS.5.BSB: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
JAS.5.KJV: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
JAS.5.PLAIN: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.

JAS.5.BSB: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
JAS.5.KJV: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that you may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.
JAS.5.PLAIN: So confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The earnest prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.

JAS.5.BSB: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
JAS.5.KJV: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

JAS.5.BSB: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
JAS.5.KJV: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
JAS.5.PLAIN: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.

JAS.5.BSB: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
JAS.5.KJV: Brothers, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
JAS.5.PLAIN: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,

JAS.5.BSB: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
JAS.5.KJV: Let him know, that he which converts the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
JAS.5.PLAIN: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.

1PE.1.BSB: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen
1PE.1.KJV: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
1PE.1.PLAIN: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia, chosen

1PE.1.BSB: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
1PE.1.KJV: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, to obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you, and peace, be multiplied.
1PE.1.PLAIN: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

1PE.1.BSB: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
1PE.1.KJV: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy has begotten us again to a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
1PE.1.PLAIN: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

1PE.1.BSB: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
1PE.1.KJV: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fades not away, reserved in heaven for you,
1PE.1.PLAIN: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,

1PE.1.BSB: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
1PE.1.KJV: Who are kept by the power of God through faith to salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
1PE.1.PLAIN: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

1PE.1.BSB: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
1PE.1.KJV: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, you are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
1PE.1.PLAIN: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials

1PE.1.BSB: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
1PE.1.KJV: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perishes, though it be tried with fire, might be found to praise and honor and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
1PE.1.PLAIN: so that the tested genuineness of your faith — more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire — may result in praise, glory, and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.

1PE.1.BSB: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
1PE.1.KJV: Whom having not seen, you love; in whom, though now you see him not, yet believing, you rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
1PE.1.PLAIN: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you don't see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

1PE.1.BSB: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
1PE.1.KJV: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
1PE.1.PLAIN: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

1PE.1.BSB: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
1PE.1.KJV: Of which salvation the prophets have inquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come to you:
1PE.1.PLAIN: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,

1PE.1.BSB: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
1PE.1.KJV: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
1PE.1.PLAIN: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.

1PE.1.BSB: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.
1PE.1.KJV: To whom it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to us they did minister the things, which are now reported to you by them that have preached the gospel to you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
1PE.1.PLAIN: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.

1PE.1.BSB: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
1PE.1.KJV: Why gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
1PE.1.PLAIN: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

1PE.1.BSB: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
1PE.1.KJV: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
1PE.1.PLAIN: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.

1PE.1.BSB: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
1PE.1.KJV: But as he which has called you is holy, so be you holy in all manner of conversation;
1PE.1.PLAIN: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,

1PE.1.BSB: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
1PE.1.KJV: Because it is written, Be you holy; for I am holy.
1PE.1.PLAIN: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”

1PE.1.BSB: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
1PE.1.KJV: And if you call on the Father, who without respect of persons judges according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
1PE.1.PLAIN: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.

1PE.1.BSB: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
1PE.1.KJV: For as much as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
1PE.1.PLAIN: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,

1PE.1.BSB: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
1PE.1.KJV: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
1PE.1.PLAIN: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.

1PE.1.BSB: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
1PE.1.KJV: Who truly was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
1PE.1.PLAIN: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.

1PE.1.BSB: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
1PE.1.KJV: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
1PE.1.PLAIN: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.

1PE.1.BSB: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
1PE.1.KJV: Seeing you have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit to unfeigned love of the brothers, see that you love one another with a pure heart fervently:
1PE.1.PLAIN: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.

1PE.1.BSB: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
1PE.1.KJV: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which lives and stays for ever.
1PE.1.PLAIN: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

1PE.1.BSB: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
1PE.1.KJV: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass wither, and the flower thereof falls away:
1PE.1.PLAIN: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

1PE.1.BSB: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
1PE.1.KJV: But the word of the Lord endures for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached to you.
1PE.1.PLAIN: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.

1PE.2.BSB: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
1PE.2.KJV: Why laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, all evil speakings,
1PE.2.PLAIN: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.

1PE.2.BSB: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
1PE.2.KJV: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that you may grow thereby:
1PE.2.PLAIN: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,

1PE.2.BSB: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
1PE.2.KJV: If so be you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
1PE.2.PLAIN: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.

1PE.2.BSB: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
1PE.2.KJV: To whom coming, as to a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
1PE.2.PLAIN: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,

1PE.2.BSB: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
1PE.2.KJV: You also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
1PE.2.PLAIN: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

1PE.2.BSB: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
1PE.2.KJV: Why also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believes on him shall not be confounded.
1PE.2.PLAIN: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”

1PE.2.BSB: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
1PE.2.KJV: To you therefore which believe he is precious: but to them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
1PE.2.PLAIN: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”

1PE.2.BSB: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
1PE.2.KJV: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: to which also they were appointed.
1PE.2.PLAIN: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.

1PE.2.BSB: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
1PE.2.KJV: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that you should show forth the praises of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvelous light;
1PE.2.PLAIN: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession — so that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.

1PE.2.BSB: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
1PE.2.KJV: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
1PE.2.PLAIN: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

1PE.2.BSB: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
1PE.2.KJV: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
1PE.2.PLAIN: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.

1PE.2.BSB: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.
1PE.2.KJV: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
1PE.2.PLAIN: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.

1PE.2.BSB: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,
1PE.2.KJV: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
1PE.2.PLAIN: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,

1PE.2.BSB: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
1PE.2.KJV: Or to governors, as to them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
1PE.2.PLAIN: or to governors as those sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.

1PE.2.BSB: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
1PE.2.KJV: For so is the will of God, that with well doing you may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
1PE.2.PLAIN: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.

1PE.2.BSB: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
1PE.2.KJV: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloak of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
1PE.2.PLAIN: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.

1PE.2.BSB: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
1PE.2.KJV: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
1PE.2.PLAIN: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.

1PE.2.BSB: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.
1PE.2.KJV: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the fraudulent.
1PE.2.PLAIN: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.

1PE.2.BSB: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
1PE.2.KJV: For this is thank worthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
1PE.2.PLAIN: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.

1PE.2.BSB: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
1PE.2.KJV: For what glory is it, if, when you be buffeted for your faults, you shall take it patiently? but if, when you do well, and suffer for it, you take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
1PE.2.PLAIN: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

1PE.2.BSB: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:
1PE.2.KJV: For even hereunto were you called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow his steps:
1PE.2.PLAIN: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in His footsteps:

1PE.2.BSB: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
1PE.2.KJV: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
1PE.2.PLAIN: “He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”

1PE.2.BSB: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
1PE.2.KJV: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judges righteously:
1PE.2.PLAIN: When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.

1PE.2.BSB: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
1PE.2.KJV: Who his own self bore our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live to righteousness: by whose stripes you were healed.
1PE.2.PLAIN: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sin and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

1PE.2.BSB: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
1PE.2.KJV: For you were as sheep going astray; but are now returned to the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
1PE.2.PLAIN: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

1PE.3.BSB: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
1PE.3.KJV: Likewise, you wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
1PE.3.PLAIN: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives

1PE.3.BSB: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
1PE.3.KJV: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
1PE.3.PLAIN: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.

1PE.3.BSB: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
1PE.3.KJV: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
1PE.3.PLAIN: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,

1PE.3.BSB: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
1PE.3.KJV: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
1PE.3.PLAIN: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.

1PE.3.BSB: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
1PE.3.KJV: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
1PE.3.PLAIN: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,

1PE.3.BSB: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
1PE.3.KJV: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters you are, as long as you do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
1PE.3.PLAIN: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.

1PE.3.BSB: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
1PE.3.KJV: Likewise, you husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor to the wife, as to the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
1PE.3.PLAIN: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.

1PE.3.BSB: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
1PE.3.KJV: Finally, be you all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brothers, be pitiful, be courteous:
