1PE.3.PLAIN: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.

1PE.3.BSB: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
1PE.3.KJV: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that you are thereunto called, that you should inherit a blessing.
1PE.3.PLAIN: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

1PE.3.BSB: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
1PE.3.KJV: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
1PE.3.PLAIN: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.

1PE.3.BSB: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
1PE.3.KJV: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
1PE.3.PLAIN: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.

1PE.3.BSB: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
1PE.3.KJV: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open to their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
1PE.3.PLAIN: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

1PE.3.BSB: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
1PE.3.KJV: And who is he that will harm you, if you be followers of that which is good?
1PE.3.PLAIN: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?

1PE.3.BSB: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
1PE.3.KJV: But and if you suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are you: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
1PE.3.PLAIN: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”

1PE.3.BSB: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
1PE.3.KJV: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asks you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
1PE.3.PLAIN: But in your hearts honor Christ as Lord. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope you have — but do so with gentleness and respect.

1PE.3.BSB: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
1PE.3.KJV: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
1PE.3.PLAIN: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.

1PE.3.BSB: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
1PE.3.KJV: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that you suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
1PE.3.PLAIN: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

1PE.3.BSB: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
1PE.3.KJV: For Christ also has once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
1PE.3.PLAIN: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit.

1PE.3.BSB: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
1PE.3.KJV: By which also he went and preached to the spirits in prison;
1PE.3.PLAIN: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison

1PE.3.BSB: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
1PE.3.KJV: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the long-suffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
1PE.3.PLAIN: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.

1PE.3.BSB: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
1PE.3.KJV: The like figure to which even baptism does also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
1PE.3.PLAIN: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

1PE.3.BSB: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
1PE.3.KJV: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
1PE.3.PLAIN: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.

1PE.4.BSB: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
1PE.4.KJV: For as much then as Christ has suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;
1PE.4.PLAIN: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.

1PE.4.BSB: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
1PE.4.KJV: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
1PE.4.PLAIN: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.

1PE.4.BSB: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
1PE.4.KJV: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have worked the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revelings, parties, and abominable idolatries:
1PE.4.PLAIN: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.

1PE.4.BSB: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
1PE.4.KJV: Wherein they think it strange that you run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
1PE.4.PLAIN: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.

1PE.4.BSB: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
1PE.4.KJV: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
1PE.4.PLAIN: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

1PE.4.BSB: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
1PE.4.KJV: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
1PE.4.PLAIN: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

1PE.4.BSB: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
1PE.4.KJV: But the end of all things is at hand: be you therefore sober, and watch to prayer.
1PE.4.PLAIN: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.

1PE.4.BSB: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
1PE.4.KJV: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
1PE.4.PLAIN: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

1PE.4.BSB: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
1PE.4.KJV: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
1PE.4.PLAIN: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.

1PE.4.BSB: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
1PE.4.KJV: As every man has received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
1PE.4.PLAIN: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God's grace in its various forms.

1PE.4.BSB: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
1PE.4.KJV: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God gives: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
1PE.4.PLAIN: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.4.BSB: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
1PE.4.KJV: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened to you:
1PE.4.PLAIN: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.

1PE.4.BSB: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
1PE.4.KJV: But rejoice, inasmuch as you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, you may be glad also with exceeding joy.
1PE.4.PLAIN: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.

1PE.4.BSB: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
1PE.4.KJV: If you be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are you; for the spirit of glory and of God rests on you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
1PE.4.PLAIN: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

1PE.4.BSB: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
1PE.4.KJV: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
1PE.4.PLAIN: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.

1PE.4.BSB: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
1PE.4.KJV: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
1PE.4.PLAIN: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.

1PE.4.BSB: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
1PE.4.KJV: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
1PE.4.PLAIN: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?

1PE.4.BSB: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
1PE.4.KJV: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
1PE.4.PLAIN: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”

1PE.4.BSB: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
1PE.4.KJV: Why let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as to a faithful Creator.
1PE.4.PLAIN: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

1PE.5.BSB: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
1PE.5.KJV: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
1PE.5.PLAIN: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:

1PE.5.BSB: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
1PE.5.KJV: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
1PE.5.PLAIN: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;

1PE.5.BSB: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
1PE.5.KJV: Neither as being lords over God’s heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
1PE.5.PLAIN: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

1PE.5.BSB: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
1PE.5.KJV: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, you shall receive a crown of glory that fades not away.
1PE.5.PLAIN: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

1PE.5.BSB: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
1PE.5.KJV: Likewise, you younger, submit yourselves to the elder. Yes, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resists the proud, and gives grace to the humble.
1PE.5.PLAIN: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

1PE.5.BSB: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
1PE.5.KJV: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
1PE.5.PLAIN: Humble yourselves, then, under God's mighty hand, so that he may lift you up in due time.

1PE.5.BSB: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
1PE.5.KJV: Casting all your care on him; for he cares for you.
1PE.5.PLAIN: Cast all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.

1PE.5.BSB: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
1PE.5.KJV: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:
1PE.5.PLAIN: Be alert and clear-minded. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.

1PE.5.BSB: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
1PE.5.KJV: Whom resist steadfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brothers that are in the world.
1PE.5.PLAIN: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.

1PE.5.BSB: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
1PE.5.KJV: But the God of all grace, who has called us to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that you have suffered a while, make you perfect, establish, strengthen, settle you.
1PE.5.PLAIN: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

1PE.5.BSB: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
1PE.5.KJV: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
1PE.5.PLAIN: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.

1PE.5.BSB: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
1PE.5.KJV: By Silvanus, a faithful brother to you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein you stand.
1PE.5.PLAIN: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

1PE.5.BSB: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
1PE.5.KJV: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, salutes you; and so does Marcus my son.
1PE.5.PLAIN: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.

1PE.5.BSB: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
1PE.5.KJV: Greet you one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
1PE.5.PLAIN: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

2PE.1.BSB: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
2PE.1.KJV: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Savior Jesus Christ:
2PE.1.PLAIN: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:

2PE.1.BSB: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
2PE.1.KJV: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
2PE.1.PLAIN: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

2PE.1.BSB: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
2PE.1.KJV: According as his divine power has given to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that has called us to glory and virtue:
2PE.1.PLAIN: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness, through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.

2PE.1.BSB: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
2PE.1.KJV: Whereby are given to us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these you might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
2PE.1.PLAIN: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may share in the divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

2PE.1.BSB: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
2PE.1.KJV: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
2PE.1.PLAIN: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;

2PE.1.BSB: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
2PE.1.KJV: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
2PE.1.PLAIN: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;

2PE.1.BSB: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
2PE.1.KJV: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
2PE.1.PLAIN: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.

2PE.1.BSB: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2PE.1.KJV: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that you shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2PE.1.PLAIN: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

2PE.1.BSB: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
2PE.1.KJV: But he that lacks these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and has forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
2PE.1.PLAIN: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.

2PE.1.BSB: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,
2PE.1.KJV: Why the rather, brothers, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if you do these things, you shall never fall:
2PE.1.PLAIN: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,

2PE.1.BSB: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
2PE.1.KJV: For so an entrance shall be ministered to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
2PE.1.PLAIN: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

2PE.1.BSB: Therefore I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.
2PE.1.KJV: Why I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though you know them, and be established in the present truth.
2PE.1.PLAIN: Therefore I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.

2PE.1.BSB: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
2PE.1.KJV: Yes, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
2PE.1.PLAIN: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,

2PE.1.BSB: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
2PE.1.KJV: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ has showed me.
2PE.1.PLAIN: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

2PE.1.BSB: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
2PE.1.KJV: Moreover I will endeavor that you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
2PE.1.PLAIN: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.

2PE.1.BSB: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
2PE.1.KJV: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
2PE.1.PLAIN: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.

2PE.1.BSB: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
2PE.1.KJV: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
2PE.1.PLAIN: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

2PE.1.BSB: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
2PE.1.KJV: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
2PE.1.PLAIN: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.

2PE.1.BSB: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
2PE.1.KJV: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; to which you do well that you take heed, as to a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
2PE.1.PLAIN: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

2PE.1.BSB: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.
2PE.1.KJV: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
2PE.1.PLAIN: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.

2PE.1.BSB: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
2PE.1.KJV: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
2PE.1.PLAIN: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

2PE.2.BSB: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
2PE.2.KJV: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privately shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring on themselves swift destruction.
2PE.2.PLAIN: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.

2PE.2.BSB: Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
2PE.2.KJV: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
2PE.2.PLAIN: Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.

2PE.2.BSB: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.
2PE.2.KJV: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingers not, and their damnation slumbers not.
2PE.2.PLAIN: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.

2PE.2.BSB: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
2PE.2.KJV: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved to judgment;
2PE.2.PLAIN: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;

2PE.2.BSB: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
2PE.2.KJV: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood on the world of the ungodly;
2PE.2.PLAIN: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;

2PE.2.BSB: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
2PE.2.KJV: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample to those that after should live ungodly;
2PE.2.PLAIN: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;

2PE.2.BSB: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
2PE.2.KJV: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
2PE.2.PLAIN: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless

2PE.2.BSB: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
2PE.2.KJV: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
2PE.2.PLAIN: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—

2PE.2.BSB: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
2PE.2.KJV: The Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust to the day of judgment to be punished:
2PE.2.PLAIN: the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.

2PE.2.BSB: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
2PE.2.KJV: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
2PE.2.PLAIN: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.

2PE.2.BSB: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
2PE.2.KJV: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
2PE.2.PLAIN: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.

2PE.2.BSB: These men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.
2PE.2.KJV: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
2PE.2.PLAIN: These men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.

2PE.2.BSB: The harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness. They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.
2PE.2.KJV: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
2PE.2.PLAIN: The harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness. They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.

2PE.2.BSB: Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
2PE.2.KJV: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
2PE.2.PLAIN: Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.

2PE.2.BSB: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
2PE.2.KJV: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
2PE.2.PLAIN: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.

2PE.2.BSB: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
2PE.2.KJV: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbade the madness of the prophet.
2PE.2.PLAIN: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.

2PE.2.BSB: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
2PE.2.KJV: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
2PE.2.PLAIN: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.

2PE.2.BSB: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.
2PE.2.KJV: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
2PE.2.PLAIN: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.

2PE.2.BSB: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.
2PE.2.KJV: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
2PE.2.PLAIN: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.

2PE.2.BSB: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
2PE.2.KJV: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
2PE.2.PLAIN: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.

2PE.2.BSB: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.
2PE.2.KJV: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered to them.
2PE.2.PLAIN: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.

2PE.2.BSB: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
2PE.2.KJV: But it is happened to them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
2PE.2.PLAIN: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”

2PE.3.BSB: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
2PE.3.KJV: This second letter, beloved, I now write to you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
2PE.3.PLAIN: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking

2PE.3.BSB: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
2PE.3.KJV: That you may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Savior:
2PE.3.PLAIN: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

2PE.3.BSB: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
2PE.3.KJV: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
2PE.3.PLAIN: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

2PE.3.BSB: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
2PE.3.KJV: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
2PE.3.PLAIN: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”

2PE.3.BSB: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
2PE.3.KJV: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
2PE.3.PLAIN: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,

2PE.3.BSB: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.
2PE.3.KJV: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
2PE.3.PLAIN: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.

2PE.3.BSB: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
2PE.3.KJV: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved to fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
2PE.3.PLAIN: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

2PE.3.BSB: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
2PE.3.KJV: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
2PE.3.PLAIN: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

2PE.3.BSB: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
2PE.3.KJV: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is long-suffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
2PE.3.PLAIN: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. Instead, he is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

2PE.3.BSB: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
2PE.3.KJV: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
2PE.3.PLAIN: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.

2PE.3.BSB: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
2PE.3.KJV: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought you to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
2PE.3.PLAIN: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness

2PE.3.BSB: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
2PE.3.KJV: Looking for and hastening to the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
2PE.3.PLAIN: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.

2PE.3.BSB: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
2PE.3.KJV: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwells righteousness.
2PE.3.PLAIN: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.

2PE.3.BSB: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.
2PE.3.KJV: Why, beloved, seeing that you look for such things, be diligent that you may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
2PE.3.PLAIN: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.

2PE.3.BSB: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.
2PE.3.KJV: And account that the long-suffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given to him has written to you;
2PE.3.PLAIN: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.

2PE.3.BSB: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
2PE.3.KJV: As also in all his letters, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, to their own destruction.
2PE.3.PLAIN: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.

2PE.3.BSB: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.
2PE.3.KJV: You therefore, beloved, seeing you know these things before, beware lest you also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own steadfastness.
2PE.3.PLAIN: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.

2PE.3.BSB: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
2PE.3.KJV: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
2PE.3.PLAIN: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever!

1JN.1.BSB: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
1JN.1.KJV: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked on, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
1JN.1.PLAIN: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.

1JN.1.BSB: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
1JN.1.KJV: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and show to you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested to us;)
1JN.1.PLAIN: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.

1JN.1.BSB: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
1JN.1.KJV: That which we have seen and heard declare we to you, that you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
1JN.1.PLAIN: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.

1JN.1.BSB: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
1JN.1.KJV: And these things write we to you, that your joy may be full.
1JN.1.PLAIN: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.

1JN.1.BSB: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
1JN.1.KJV: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
1JN.1.PLAIN: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.

1JN.1.BSB: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
1JN.1.KJV: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
1JN.1.PLAIN: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

1JN.1.BSB: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
1JN.1.KJV: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleans us from all sin.
1JN.1.PLAIN: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin.

1JN.1.BSB: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1JN.1.KJV: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1JN.1.PLAIN: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

1JN.1.BSB: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1JN.1.KJV: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
1JN.1.PLAIN: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just and will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

1JN.1.BSB: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
1JN.1.KJV: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
1JN.1.PLAIN: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.

1JN.2.BSB: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
1JN.2.KJV: My little children, these things write I to you, that you sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
1JN.2.PLAIN: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate with the Father — Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

1JN.2.BSB: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
1JN.2.KJV: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
1JN.2.PLAIN: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

1JN.2.BSB: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
1JN.2.KJV: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
1JN.2.PLAIN: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.

1JN.2.BSB: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
1JN.2.KJV: He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
1JN.2.PLAIN: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

1JN.2.BSB: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
1JN.2.KJV: But whoever keeps his word, in him truly is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
1JN.2.PLAIN: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:

1JN.2.BSB: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
1JN.2.KJV: He that says he stays in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
1JN.2.PLAIN: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.

1JN.2.BSB: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
1JN.2.KJV: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning.
1JN.2.PLAIN: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.

1JN.2.BSB: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
1JN.2.KJV: Again, a new commandment I write to you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shines.

1JN.5.BSB: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
1JN.5.KJV: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

1JN.5.BSB: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.

1JN.5.KJV: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.

1JN.5.PLAIN: For there are three that testify:

1JN.5.KJV: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
1JN.5.PLAIN: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.

1JN.5.BSB: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
1JN.5.KJV: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he has testified of his Son.

1JN.5.BSB: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
1JN.5.KJV: He that believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself: he that believes not God has made him a liar; because he believes not the record that God gave of his Son.

1JN.5.BSB: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
1JN.5.KJV: And this is the record, that God has given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
1JN.5.PLAIN: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.

1JN.5.BSB: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
1JN.5.KJV: He that has the Son has life; and he that has not the Son of God has not life.
1JN.5.PLAIN: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.

1JN.5.BSB: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
1JN.5.KJV: These things have I written to you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may believe on the name of the Son of God.
1JN.5.PLAIN: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.

1JN.5.BSB: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
1JN.5.KJV: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he hears us:

1JN.5.BSB: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
1JN.5.KJV: And if we know that he hear us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
1JN.5.PLAIN: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.

1JN.5.BSB: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
1JN.5.KJV: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not to death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not to death. There is a sin to death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
1JN.5.PLAIN: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.

1JN.5.BSB: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
1JN.5.KJV: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not to death.
1JN.5.PLAIN: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.

1JN.5.BSB: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
1JN.5.KJV: We know that whoever is born of God sins not; but he that is begotten of God keeps himself, and that wicked one touches him not.
1JN.5.PLAIN: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.

1JN.5.BSB: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
1JN.5.KJV: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in wickedness.
1JN.5.PLAIN: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.

1JN.5.BSB: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
1JN.5.KJV: And we know that the Son of God is come, and has given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
1JN.5.PLAIN: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.

1JN.5.BSB: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
1JN.5.KJV: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
1JN.5.PLAIN: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

2JN.1.BSB: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
2JN.1.KJV: The elder to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
2JN.1.PLAIN: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—

2JN.1.BSB: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
2JN.1.KJV: For the truth’s sake, which dwells in us, and shall be with us for ever.
2JN.1.PLAIN: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:

2JN.1.BSB: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
2JN.1.KJV: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
2JN.1.PLAIN: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.

2JN.1.BSB: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
2JN.1.KJV: I rejoiced greatly that I found of your children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
2JN.1.PLAIN: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.

2JN.1.BSB: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
2JN.1.KJV: And now I beseech you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to you, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
2JN.1.PLAIN: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.

2JN.1.BSB: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
2JN.1.KJV: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
2JN.1.PLAIN: And this is love: that we walk in obedience to his commands. This is the command that you have heard from the beginning — that you walk in love.

2JN.1.BSB: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
2JN.1.KJV: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
2JN.1.PLAIN: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

2JN.1.BSB: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
2JN.1.KJV: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have worked, but that we receive a full reward.
2JN.1.PLAIN: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.

2JN.1.BSB: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
2JN.1.KJV: Whoever transgresses, and stays not in the doctrine of Christ, has not God. He that stays in the doctrine of Christ, he has both the Father and the Son.
2JN.1.PLAIN: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.

2JN.1.BSB: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
2JN.1.KJV: If there come any to you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

2JN.1.BSB: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
2JN.1.KJV: For he that bids him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
2JN.1.PLAIN: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.

2JN.1.BSB: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
2JN.1.KJV: Having many things to write to you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come to you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
2JN.1.PLAIN: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

2JN.1.BSB: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
2JN.1.KJV: The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.
2JN.1.PLAIN: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.

3JN.1.BSB: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:

3JN.1.PLAIN: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:

3JN.1.KJV: Beloved, I wish above all things that you may prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospers.
3JN.1.PLAIN: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.

3JN.1.KJV: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brothers came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.

3JN.1.BSB: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.

3JN.1.PLAIN: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

3JN.1.BSB: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
3JN.1.KJV: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that does good is of God: but he that does evil has not seen God.
3JN.1.PLAIN: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does good is from God; anyone who does evil has not seen God.

3JN.1.BSB: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.

3JN.1.KJV: But I trust I shall shortly see you, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to you. Our friends salute you. Greet the friends by name.

JUD.1.BSB: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
JUD.1.KJV: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

JUD.1.KJV: Mercy to you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
JUD.1.PLAIN: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

JUD.1.BSB: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
JUD.1.KJV: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write to you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write to you, and exhort you that you should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered to the saints.
JUD.1.PLAIN: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.

JUD.1.KJV: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

JUD.1.KJV: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke you.

JUD.1.KJV: To execute judgment on all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

JUD.1.KJV: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
JUD.1.PLAIN: And indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;

JUD.1.BSB: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
JUD.1.KJV: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
JUD.1.PLAIN: save others by snatching them from the fire; and to still others show mercy tempered with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

JUD.1.BSB: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
JUD.1.KJV: Now to him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
JUD.1.PLAIN: Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy,

JUD.1.BSB: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. Amen.
JUD.1.KJV: To the only wise God our Savior, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
JUD.1.PLAIN: to the only wise God our Savior be glory, majesty, power, and authority, now and forevermore. Amen.

REV.1.BSB: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,
REV.1.KJV: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him, to show to his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel to his servant John:
REV.1.PLAIN: This is the revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave Him to show His servants what must soon come to pass. He made it known by sending His angel to His servant John,

REV.1.BSB: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
REV.1.KJV: Who bore record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
REV.1.PLAIN: who testifies to everything he saw. This is the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

REV.1.BSB: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.
REV.1.KJV: Blessed is he that reads, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
REV.1.PLAIN: Blessed is the one who reads aloud the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear and obey what is written in it, because the time is near.

REV.1.BSB: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven Spirits before His throne,
REV.1.KJV: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be to you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
REV.1.PLAIN: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from Him who is and was and is to come, and from the seven Spirits before His throne,

REV.1.BSB: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,
REV.1.KJV: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. To him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
REV.1.PLAIN: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,

REV.1.BSB: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
REV.1.KJV: And has made us kings and priests to God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
REV.1.PLAIN: who has made us to be a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

REV.1.BSB: Behold, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.
REV.1.KJV: Behold, he comes with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
REV.1.PLAIN: Look closely — He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him—even those who pierced Him. And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him. So shall it be! Amen.

REV.1.BSB: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, who is and was and is to come—the Almighty.
REV.1.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, says the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
REV.1.PLAIN: 'I am the Alpha and the Omega,' says the Lord God, 'who is, and who was, and who is to come — the Almighty.'

REV.1.BSB: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.
REV.1.KJV: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
REV.1.PLAIN: I, John, your brother and partner in the tribulation and kingdom and perseverance that are in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and my testimony about Jesus.

REV.1.BSB: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
REV.1.KJV: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
REV.1.PLAIN: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

REV.1.BSB: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
REV.1.KJV: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What you see, write in a book, and send it to the seven churches which are in Asia; to Ephesus, and to Smyrna, and to Pergamos, and to Thyatira, and to Sardis, and to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.
REV.1.PLAIN: saying, “Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”

REV.1.BSB: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
REV.1.KJV: And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
REV.1.PLAIN: Then I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me. And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,

REV.1.BSB: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.
REV.1.KJV: And in the middle of the seven candlesticks one like to the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the breasts with a golden girdle.
REV.1.PLAIN: and among the lampstands was One like the Son of Man, dressed in a long robe, with a golden sash around His chest.

REV.1.BSB: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.
REV.1.KJV: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
REV.1.PLAIN: The hair of His head was white like wool, as white as snow, and His eyes were like a blazing fire.

REV.1.BSB: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.
REV.1.KJV: And his feet like to fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
REV.1.PLAIN: His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice was like the roar of many waters.

REV.1.BSB: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
REV.1.KJV: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp two edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shines in his strength.
REV.1.PLAIN: He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

REV.1.BSB: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
REV.1.KJV: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand on me, saying to me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
REV.1.PLAIN: When I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man. But He placed His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,

REV.1.BSB: the Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
REV.1.KJV: I am he that lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for ever more, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
REV.1.PLAIN: I am the Living One. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and the grave.

REV.1.BSB: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.
REV.1.KJV: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
REV.1.PLAIN: Therefore write down the things you have seen, and the things that are, and the things that will happen after this.

REV.1.BSB: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.
REV.1.KJV: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which you saw are the seven churches.
REV.1.PLAIN: This is the mystery of the seven stars you saw in My right hand and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

REV.2.BSB: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
REV.2.KJV: To the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things says he that holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the middle of the seven golden candlesticks;
REV.2.PLAIN: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.

REV.2.BSB: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
REV.2.KJV: I know your works, and your labor, and your patience, and how you can not bear them which are evil: and you have tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and have found them liars:
REV.2.PLAIN: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.

REV.2.BSB: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
REV.2.KJV: And have borne, and have patience, and for my name’s sake have labored, and have not fainted.
REV.2.PLAIN: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.

REV.2.BSB: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
REV.2.KJV: Nevertheless I have somewhat against you, because you have left your first love.
REV.2.PLAIN: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
