REV.2.BSB: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
REV.2.KJV: Remember therefore from where you are fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come to you quickly, and will remove your candlestick out of his place, except you repent.
REV.2.PLAIN: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.

REV.2.BSB: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
REV.2.KJV: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
REV.2.PLAIN: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

REV.2.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
REV.2.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the middle of the paradise of God.
REV.2.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.

REV.2.BSB: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
REV.2.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things says the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
REV.2.PLAIN: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.

REV.2.BSB: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
REV.2.KJV: I know your works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but you are rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
REV.2.PLAIN: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.

REV.2.BSB: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
REV.2.KJV: Fear none of those things which you shall suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that you may be tried; and you shall have tribulation ten days: be you faithful to death, and I will give you a crown of life.
REV.2.PLAIN: Don't be afraid of what you are about to suffer. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you the crown of life.

REV.2.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
REV.2.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches; He that overcomes shall not be hurt of the second death.
REV.2.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.

REV.2.BSB: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
REV.2.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things says he which has the sharp sword with two edges;
REV.2.PLAIN: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.

REV.2.BSB: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits. Yet you have held fast to My name and have not denied your faith in Me, even in the day when My faithful witness Antipas was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
REV.2.KJV: I know your works, and where you dwell, even where Satan’s seat is: and you hold fast my name, and have not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.
REV.2.PLAIN: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits. Yet you have held fast to My name and have not denied your faith in Me, even in the day when My faithful witness Antipas was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

REV.2.BSB: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
REV.2.KJV: But I have a few things against you, because you have there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit fornication.
REV.2.PLAIN: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.

REV.2.BSB: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
REV.2.KJV: So have you also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
REV.2.PLAIN: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

REV.2.BSB: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
REV.2.KJV: Repent; or else I will come to you quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
REV.2.PLAIN: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.

REV.2.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
REV.2.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he that receives it.
REV.2.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.

REV.2.BSB: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
REV.2.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things says the Son of God, who has his eyes like to a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
REV.2.PLAIN: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.

REV.2.BSB: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latter deeds are greater than your first.
REV.2.KJV: I know your works, and charity, and service, and faith, and your patience, and your works; and the last to be more than the first.
REV.2.PLAIN: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latter deeds are greater than your first.

REV.2.BSB: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
REV.2.KJV: Notwithstanding I have a few things against you, because you suffer that woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
REV.2.PLAIN: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.

REV.2.BSB: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
REV.2.KJV: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
REV.2.PLAIN: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.

REV.2.BSB: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
REV.2.KJV: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
REV.2.PLAIN: Look closely — I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.

REV.2.BSB: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
REV.2.KJV: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searches the reins and hearts: and I will give to every one of you according to your works.
REV.2.PLAIN: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.

REV.2.BSB: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you.
REV.2.KJV: But to you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put on you none other burden.
REV.2.PLAIN: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you.

REV.2.BSB: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.
REV.2.KJV: But that which you have already hold fast till I come.
REV.2.PLAIN: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.

REV.2.BSB: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
REV.2.KJV: And he that overcomes, and keeps my works to the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
REV.2.PLAIN: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.

REV.2.BSB: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery—just as I have received authority from My Father.
REV.2.KJV: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
REV.2.PLAIN: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery—just as I have received authority from My Father.

REV.2.BSB: And I will give him the morning star.
REV.2.KJV: And I will give him the morning star.
REV.2.PLAIN: And I will give him the morning star.

REV.2.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.2.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.2.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

REV.3.BSB: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
REV.3.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things says he that has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know your works, that you have a name that you live, and are dead.
REV.3.PLAIN: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.

REV.3.BSB: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
REV.3.KJV: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found your works perfect before God.
REV.3.PLAIN: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which was about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.

REV.3.BSB: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
REV.3.KJV: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore you shall not watch, I will come on you as a thief, and you shall not know what hour I will come on you.
REV.3.PLAIN: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.

REV.3.BSB: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
REV.3.KJV: You have a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
REV.3.PLAIN: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.

REV.3.BSB: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
REV.3.KJV: He that overcomes, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
REV.3.PLAIN: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.

REV.3.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.3.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.3.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

REV.3.BSB: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
REV.3.KJV: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things says he that is holy, he that is true, he that has the key of David, he that opens, and no man shuts; and shuts, and no man opens;
REV.3.PLAIN: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.

REV.3.BSB: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. For you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
REV.3.KJV: I know your works: behold, I have set before you an open door, and no man can shut it: for you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have not denied my name.
REV.3.PLAIN: I know your deeds. See, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. For you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.

REV.3.BSB: Look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
REV.3.KJV: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
REV.3.PLAIN: Look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.

REV.3.BSB: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
REV.3.KJV: Because you have kept the word of my patience, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation, which shall come on all the world, to try them that dwell on the earth.
REV.3.PLAIN: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

REV.3.BSB: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
REV.3.KJV: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which you have, that no man take your crown.
REV.3.PLAIN: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.

REV.3.BSB: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
REV.3.KJV: Him that overcomes will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God: and I will write on him my new name.
REV.3.PLAIN: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.

REV.3.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.3.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.3.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

REV.3.BSB: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
REV.3.KJV: And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
REV.3.PLAIN: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.

REV.3.BSB: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
REV.3.KJV: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot: I would you were cold or hot.
REV.3.PLAIN: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!

REV.3.BSB: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
REV.3.KJV: So then because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spew you out of my mouth.
REV.3.PLAIN: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!

REV.3.BSB: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
REV.3.KJV: Because you say, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and know not that you are wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
REV.3.PLAIN: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

REV.3.BSB: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
REV.3.KJV: I counsel you to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that you may be rich; and white raiment, that you may be clothed, and that the shame of your nakedness do not appear; and anoint your eyes with eye salve, that you may see.
REV.3.PLAIN: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.

REV.3.BSB: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
REV.3.KJV: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
REV.3.PLAIN: Those I love, I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.

REV.3.BSB: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
REV.3.KJV: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
REV.3.PLAIN: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and share a meal with them, and they with me.

REV.3.BSB: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
REV.3.KJV: To him that overcomes will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
REV.3.PLAIN: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.

REV.3.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
REV.3.KJV: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
REV.3.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”

REV.4.BSB: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”
REV.4.KJV: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up here, and I will show you things which must be hereafter.
REV.4.PLAIN: After this I looked and saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had previously heard speak to me like a trumpet was saying, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things.”

REV.4.BSB: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.
REV.4.KJV: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
REV.4.PLAIN: At once I was in the Spirit, and I saw a throne standing in heaven, with someone seated on it.

REV.4.BSB: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.
REV.4.KJV: And he that sat was to look on like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like to an emerald.
REV.4.PLAIN: The One seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleamed like an emerald encircled the throne.

REV.4.BSB: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.
REV.4.KJV: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and on the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
REV.4.PLAIN: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and on these thrones sat twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads.

REV.4.BSB: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven Spirits of God.
REV.4.KJV: And out of the throne proceeded lightning and thunder and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
REV.4.PLAIN: From the throne came flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder. Before the throne burned seven torches of fire. These are the seven Spirits of God.

REV.4.BSB: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.
REV.4.KJV: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like to crystal: and in the middle of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
REV.4.PLAIN: And before the throne was something like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and back.

REV.4.BSB: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
REV.4.KJV: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
REV.4.PLAIN: The first living creature was like a lion, the second like a calf, the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.

REV.4.BSB: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
REV.4.KJV: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, LORD God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
REV.4.PLAIN: And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”

REV.4.BSB: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,
REV.4.KJV: And when those beasts give glory and honor and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who lives for ever and ever,
REV.4.PLAIN: And whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the One seated on the throne who lives forever and ever,

REV.4.BSB: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
REV.4.KJV: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that lives for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
REV.4.PLAIN: the twenty-four elders fall down before the One seated on the throne, and they worship Him who lives forever and ever. They cast their crowns before the throne, saying:

REV.4.BSB: “Worthy are You, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for You created all things; by Your will they exist and came to be.”
REV.4.KJV: You are worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honor and power: for you have created all things, and for your pleasure they are and were created.
REV.4.PLAIN: You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they existed and were created.

REV.5.BSB: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.
REV.5.KJV: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
REV.5.PLAIN: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.

REV.5.BSB: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
REV.5.KJV: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
REV.5.PLAIN: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”

REV.5.BSB: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
REV.5.KJV: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
REV.5.PLAIN: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.

REV.5.BSB: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
REV.5.KJV: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
REV.5.PLAIN: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.

REV.5.BSB: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”
REV.5.KJV: And one of the elders says to me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
REV.5.PLAIN: Then one of the elders said to me, “Do not weep! Look closely — the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

REV.5.BSB: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
REV.5.KJV: And I beheld, and, see, in the middle of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the middle of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
REV.5.PLAIN: Then I saw a Lamb who appeared to have been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

REV.5.BSB: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.
REV.5.KJV: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.
REV.5.PLAIN: And He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the One seated on the throne.

REV.5.BSB: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
REV.5.KJV: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odors, which are the prayers of saints.
REV.5.PLAIN: When He had taken the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

REV.5.BSB: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
REV.5.KJV: And they sung a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for you were slain, and have redeemed us to God by your blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
REV.5.PLAIN: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.

REV.5.BSB: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”
REV.5.KJV: And have made us to our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
REV.5.PLAIN: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.”

REV.5.BSB: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.
REV.5.KJV: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
REV.5.PLAIN: Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels and living creatures and elders encircling the throne, and their number was myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands.

REV.5.BSB: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
REV.5.KJV: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honor, and glory, and blessing.
REV.5.PLAIN: Worthy is the Lamb who was slain to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!

REV.5.BSB: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
REV.5.KJV: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honor, and glory, and power, be to him that sits on the throne, and to the Lamb for ever and ever.
REV.5.PLAIN: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”

REV.5.BSB: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
REV.5.KJV: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that lives for ever and ever.
REV.5.PLAIN: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.

REV.6.BSB: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, “Come!”
REV.6.KJV: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
REV.6.PLAIN: Then I watched as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a thunderous voice, “Come!”

REV.6.BSB: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
REV.6.KJV: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given to him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
REV.6.PLAIN: So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.

REV.6.BSB: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
REV.6.KJV: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
REV.6.PLAIN: And when the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”

REV.6.BSB: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword.
REV.6.KJV: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given to him a great sword.
REV.6.PLAIN: Then another horse went forth. It was bright red, and its rider was granted permission to take away peace from the earth and to make men slay one another. And he was given a great sword.

REV.6.BSB: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.
REV.6.KJV: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and see a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
REV.6.PLAIN: And when the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” Then I looked and saw a black horse, and its rider held in his hand a pair of scales.

REV.6.BSB: And I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.”
REV.6.KJV: And I heard a voice in the middle of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see you hurt not the oil and the wine.
REV.6.PLAIN: And I heard what sounded like a voice from among the four living creatures, saying, “A quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius, and do not harm the oil and wine.”

REV.6.BSB: And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”
REV.6.KJV: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
REV.6.PLAIN: And when the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”

REV.6.BSB: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.
REV.6.KJV: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given to them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
REV.6.PLAIN: Then I looked and saw a pale green horse. Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades followed close behind. And they were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, by famine, by plague, and by the beasts of the earth.

REV.6.BSB: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.
REV.6.KJV: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
REV.6.PLAIN: And when the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God and for the testimony they had upheld.

REV.6.BSB: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?”
REV.6.KJV: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
REV.6.PLAIN: And they cried out in a loud voice, “How long, O Lord, holy and true, until You avenge our blood and judge those who dwell upon the earth?”

REV.6.BSB: Then each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little while longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers, were killed, just as they had been killed.
REV.6.KJV: And white robes were given to every one of them; and it was said to them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellow servants also and their brothers, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
REV.6.PLAIN: Each of them was given a white robe and told to rest a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants was complete.

REV.6.BSB: And when I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,
REV.6.KJV: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, see, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
REV.6.PLAIN: And when I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, there was a great earthquake, and the sun became black like sackcloth of goat hair, and the whole moon turned blood red,

REV.6.BSB: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.
REV.6.KJV: And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, even as a fig tree casts her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
REV.6.PLAIN: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth like unripe figs dropping from a tree shaken by a great wind.

REV.6.BSB: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
REV.6.KJV: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
REV.6.PLAIN: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

REV.6.BSB: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
REV.6.KJV: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every slave, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
REV.6.PLAIN: Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

REV.6.BSB: And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.
REV.6.KJV: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
REV.6.PLAIN: And they said to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One seated on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb.

REV.6.BSB: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”
REV.6.KJV: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
REV.6.PLAIN: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”

REV.7.BSB: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.
REV.7.KJV: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
REV.7.PLAIN: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back its four winds so that no wind would blow on land or sea or on any tree.

REV.7.BSB: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:
REV.7.KJV: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
REV.7.PLAIN: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, with the seal of the living God. And he called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

REV.7.BSB: “Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have sealed the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
REV.7.KJV: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
REV.7.PLAIN: “Do not harm the land or sea or trees until we have sealed the foreheads of the servants of our God.”

REV.7.BSB: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:
REV.7.KJV: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
REV.7.PLAIN: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel:

REV.7.BSB: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,
REV.7.KJV: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
REV.7.PLAIN: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,

REV.7.BSB: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,
REV.7.KJV: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nephthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
REV.7.PLAIN: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,

REV.7.BSB: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,
REV.7.KJV: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
REV.7.PLAIN: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,

REV.7.BSB: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, and from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.
REV.7.KJV: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
REV.7.PLAIN: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, and from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.

REV.7.BSB: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
REV.7.KJV: After this I beheld, and, see, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
REV.7.PLAIN: After this I looked, and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people, and language, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, wearing white robes and holding palm branches.

REV.7.BSB: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
REV.7.KJV: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.
REV.7.PLAIN: And they cried out in a loud voice: “Salvation to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

REV.7.BSB: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,
REV.7.KJV: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
REV.7.PLAIN: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. And they fell facedown before the throne and worshiped God,

REV.7.BSB: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
REV.7.KJV: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, be to our God for ever and ever. Amen.
REV.7.PLAIN: saying, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

REV.7.BSB: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”
REV.7.KJV: And one of the elders answered, saying to me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and from where came they?
REV.7.PLAIN: Then one of the elders addressed me: “These in white robes,” he asked, “who are they, and where have they come from?”

REV.7.BSB: “Sir,” I answered, “you know.” So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
REV.7.KJV: And I said to him, Sir, you know. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
REV.7.PLAIN: “Sir,” I answered, “you know.” So he replied, “These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

REV.7.BSB: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
REV.7.KJV: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sits on the throne shall dwell among them.
REV.7.PLAIN: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.

REV.7.BSB: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’
REV.7.KJV: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
REV.7.PLAIN: ‘Never again will they hunger, and never will they thirst; nor will the sun beat down upon them, nor any scorching heat.’

REV.7.BSB: For the Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ and ‘God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’”
REV.7.KJV: For the Lamb which is in the middle of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them to living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
REV.7.PLAIN: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; he will lead them to springs of living water, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

REV.8.BSB: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
REV.8.KJV: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
REV.8.PLAIN: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

REV.8.BSB: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
REV.8.KJV: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
REV.8.PLAIN: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.

REV.8.BSB: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
REV.8.KJV: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given to him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
REV.8.PLAIN: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.

REV.8.BSB: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
REV.8.KJV: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.
REV.8.PLAIN: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, rose up before God from the angel's hand.

REV.8.BSB: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
REV.8.KJV: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunder, and lightning, and an earthquake.
REV.8.PLAIN: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.

REV.8.BSB: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
REV.8.KJV: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
REV.8.PLAIN: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

REV.8.BSB: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
REV.8.KJV: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast on the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
REV.8.PLAIN: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.

REV.8.BSB: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
REV.8.KJV: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
REV.8.PLAIN: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,

REV.8.BSB: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
REV.8.KJV: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
REV.8.PLAIN: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

REV.8.BSB: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
REV.8.KJV: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell on the third part of the rivers, and on the fountains of waters;
REV.8.PLAIN: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

REV.8.BSB: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.
REV.8.KJV: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
REV.8.PLAIN: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.

REV.8.BSB: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.
REV.8.KJV: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
REV.8.PLAIN: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.

REV.8.BSB: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”
REV.8.KJV: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the middle of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabitants of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
REV.8.PLAIN: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”

REV.9.BSB: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.
REV.9.KJV: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven to the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
REV.9.PLAIN: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.

REV.9.BSB: The star opened the pit of the Abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.
REV.9.KJV: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
REV.9.PLAIN: The star opened the pit of the Abyss, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke from the pit.

REV.9.BSB: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.
REV.9.KJV: And there came out of the smoke locusts on the earth: and to them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
REV.9.PLAIN: And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of the scorpions of the earth.

REV.9.BSB: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
REV.9.KJV: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
REV.9.PLAIN: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only the people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

REV.9.BSB: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
REV.9.KJV: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he strikes a man.
REV.9.PLAIN: The locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.

REV.9.BSB: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.
REV.9.KJV: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
REV.9.PLAIN: In those days men will seek death and will not find it; they will long to die, but death will escape them.

REV.9.BSB: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men.
REV.9.KJV: And the shapes of the locusts were like to horses prepared to battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
REV.9.PLAIN: And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men.

REV.9.BSB: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.
REV.9.KJV: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
REV.9.PLAIN: They had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions.

REV.9.BSB: They also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
REV.9.KJV: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
REV.9.PLAIN: They also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.

REV.9.BSB: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.
REV.9.KJV: And they had tails like to scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
REV.9.PLAIN: They had tails with stingers like scorpions, which had the power to injure people for five months.

REV.9.BSB: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.
REV.9.KJV: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue has his name Apollyon.
REV.9.PLAIN: They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon.

REV.9.BSB: The first woe has passed. Behold, two woes are still to follow.
REV.9.KJV: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
REV.9.PLAIN: The first woe has passed. Look closely — two woes are still to follow.

REV.9.BSB: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God
REV.9.KJV: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
REV.9.PLAIN: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God

REV.9.BSB: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”
REV.9.KJV: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
REV.9.PLAIN: saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.”

REV.9.BSB: So the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.
REV.9.KJV: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
REV.9.PLAIN: So the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

REV.9.BSB: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.
REV.9.KJV: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
REV.9.PLAIN: And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million; I heard their number.

REV.9.BSB: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
REV.9.KJV: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
REV.9.PLAIN: Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this: The riders had breastplates the colors of fire, sapphire, and sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.

REV.9.BSB: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.
REV.9.KJV: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
REV.9.PLAIN: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that proceeded from their mouths.

REV.9.BSB: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.
REV.9.KJV: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like to serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
REV.9.PLAIN: For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails; indeed, their tails were like snakes, having heads with which to inflict harm.

REV.9.BSB: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
REV.9.KJV: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
REV.9.PLAIN: Now the rest of mankind who were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the works of their hands. They did not stop worshiping demons and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.

REV.9.BSB: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.
REV.9.KJV: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
REV.9.PLAIN: Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.

REV.10.BSB: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
REV.10.KJV: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was on his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
REV.10.PLAIN: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.

REV.10.BSB: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
REV.10.KJV: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot on the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
REV.10.PLAIN: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

REV.10.BSB: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.
REV.10.KJV: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roars: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
REV.10.PLAIN: Then he cried out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And when he cried out, the seven thunders sounded their voices.

REV.10.BSB: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”
REV.10.KJV: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
REV.10.PLAIN: When the seven thunders had spoken, I was about to put it in writing. But I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down.”

REV.10.BSB: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.
REV.10.KJV: And the angel which I saw stand on the sea and on the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
REV.10.PLAIN: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to heaven.

REV.10.BSB: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!
REV.10.KJV: And swore by him that lives for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
REV.10.PLAIN: And he swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it: “There will be no more delay!

REV.10.BSB: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, just as He proclaimed to His servants the prophets.”
REV.10.KJV: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he has declared to his servants the prophets.
REV.10.PLAIN: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets.

REV.10.BSB: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”
REV.10.KJV: And the voice which I heard from heaven spoke to me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which stands on the sea and on the earth.
REV.10.PLAIN: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the small scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.”

REV.10.BSB: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
REV.10.KJV: And I went to the angel, and said to him, Give me the little book. And he said to me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make your belly bitter, but it shall be in your mouth sweet as honey.
REV.10.PLAIN: And I went to the angel and said, “Give me the small scroll.” “Take it and eat it,” he said. “It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

REV.10.BSB: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
REV.10.KJV: And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
REV.10.PLAIN: So I took the small scroll from the angel’s hand and ate it; and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.

REV.10.BSB: And they told me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”
REV.10.KJV: And he said to me, You must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
REV.10.PLAIN: And they told me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.”

REV.11.BSB: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
REV.11.KJV: And there was given me a reed like to a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
REV.11.PLAIN: Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.

REV.11.BSB: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.
REV.11.KJV: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given to the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
REV.11.PLAIN: But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.

REV.11.BSB: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”
REV.11.KJV: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and three score days, clothed in sackcloth.
REV.11.PLAIN: And I will empower my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth.”

REV.11.BSB: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
REV.11.KJV: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
REV.11.PLAIN: These witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

REV.11.BSB: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
REV.11.KJV: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth, and devours their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
REV.11.PLAIN: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.

REV.11.BSB: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
REV.11.KJV: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
REV.11.PLAIN: These witnesses have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall during the days of their prophecy, and power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they wish.

REV.11.BSB: When the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.
REV.11.KJV: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascends out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
REV.11.PLAIN: When the two witnesses have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will wage war with them, and will overpower and kill them.

REV.11.BSB: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city—figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where their Lord was also crucified.
REV.11.KJV: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
REV.11.PLAIN: Their bodies will lie in the street of the great city—figuratively called Sodom and Egypt—where their Lord was also crucified.

REV.11.BSB: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.
REV.11.KJV: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
REV.11.PLAIN: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.

REV.11.BSB: And those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them, and will celebrate and send one another gifts, because these two prophets had tormented them.
REV.11.KJV: And they that dwell on the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelled on the earth.
REV.11.PLAIN: And those who dwell on the earth will gloat over them, and will celebrate and send one another gifts, because these two prophets had tormented them.

REV.11.BSB: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.
REV.11.KJV: And after three days and an half the spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet; and great fear fell on them which saw them.
REV.11.PLAIN: But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the two witnesses, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who saw them.

REV.11.BSB: And the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them.
REV.11.KJV: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying to them, Come up here. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
REV.11.PLAIN: And the witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying, “Come up here.” And they went up to heaven in a cloud as their enemies watched them.

REV.11.BSB: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
REV.11.KJV: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
REV.11.PLAIN: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand were killed in the quake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

REV.11.BSB: The second woe has passed. Behold, the third woe is coming shortly.
REV.11.KJV: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe comes quickly.
REV.11.PLAIN: The second woe has passed. Look closely — the third woe is coming shortly.

REV.11.BSB: Then the seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and loud voices called out in heaven: “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ, and He will reign forever and ever.”
REV.11.KJV: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
REV.11.PLAIN: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven saying, 'The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever.'

REV.11.BSB: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
REV.11.KJV: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell on their faces, and worshipped God,
REV.11.PLAIN: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,

REV.11.BSB: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.
REV.11.KJV: Saying, We give you thanks, O LORD God Almighty, which are, and were, and are to come; because you have taken to you your great power, and have reigned.
REV.11.PLAIN: saying: “We give thanks to You, O Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because You have taken Your great power and have begun to reign.

REV.11.BSB: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
