REV.11.KJV: And the nations were angry, and your wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that you should give reward to your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear your name, small and great; and should destroy them which destroy the earth.
REV.11.PLAIN: The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

REV.11.BSB: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
REV.11.KJV: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightning, and voices, and thunder, and an earthquake, and great hail.
REV.11.PLAIN: Then the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in His temple. And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.

REV.12.BSB: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
REV.12.KJV: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars:
REV.12.PLAIN: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

REV.12.BSB: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.
REV.12.KJV: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
REV.12.PLAIN: She was pregnant and crying out in the pain and agony of giving birth.

REV.12.BSB: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.
REV.12.KJV: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on his heads.
REV.12.PLAIN: Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads, ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.

REV.12.BSB: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, tossing them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.
REV.12.KJV: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
REV.12.PLAIN: His tail swept a third of the stars from the sky, tossing them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, ready to devour her child as soon as she gave birth.

REV.12.BSB: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.
REV.12.KJV: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up to God, and to his throne.
REV.12.PLAIN: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was caught up to God and to His throne.

REV.12.BSB: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.
REV.12.KJV: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and three score days.
REV.12.PLAIN: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where God had prepared a place for her to be nourished for 1,260 days.

REV.12.BSB: Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
REV.12.KJV: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
REV.12.PLAIN: Then a war broke out in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

REV.12.BSB: But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.
REV.12.KJV: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
REV.12.PLAIN: But the dragon was not strong enough, and no longer was any place found in heaven for him and his angels.

REV.12.BSB: And the great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.
REV.12.KJV: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceives the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
REV.12.PLAIN: And the great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.

REV.12.BSB: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.
REV.12.KJV: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brothers is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
REV.12.PLAIN: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying: “Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down— he who accuses them day and night before our God.

REV.12.BSB: They have conquered him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony. And they did not love their lives so as to shy away from death.
REV.12.KJV: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives to the death.
REV.12.PLAIN: They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

REV.12.BSB: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.”
REV.12.KJV: Therefore rejoice, you heavens, and you that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabitants of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down to you, having great wrath, because he knows that he has but a short time.
REV.12.PLAIN: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea; with great fury the devil has come down to you, knowing he has only a short time.”

REV.12.BSB: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.
REV.12.KJV: And when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
REV.12.PLAIN: And when the dragon saw that he had been thrown to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

REV.12.BSB: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.
REV.12.KJV: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
REV.12.PLAIN: But the woman was given two wings of a great eagle to fly from the presence of the serpent to her place in the wilderness, where she was nourished for a time, and times, and half a time.

REV.12.BSB: Then from the mouth of the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.
REV.12.KJV: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
REV.12.PLAIN: Then from the mouth of the serpent spewed water like a river to overtake the woman and sweep her away in the torrent.

REV.12.BSB: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that had poured from the dragon’s mouth.
REV.12.KJV: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
REV.12.PLAIN: But the earth helped the woman and opened its mouth to swallow up the river that had poured from the dragon’s mouth.

REV.12.BSB: And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
REV.12.KJV: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
REV.12.PLAIN: And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.

REV.13.BSB: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
REV.13.KJV: And I stood on the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads the name of blasphemy.
REV.13.PLAIN: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.

REV.13.BSB: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
REV.13.KJV: And the beast which I saw was like to a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
REV.13.PLAIN: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.

REV.13.BSB: One of the heads of the beast appeared to be mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
REV.13.KJV: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
REV.13.PLAIN: One of the heads of the beast appeared to be mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.

REV.13.BSB: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
REV.13.KJV: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power to the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like to the beast? who is able to make war with him?
REV.13.PLAIN: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”

REV.13.BSB: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
REV.13.KJV: And there was given to him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given to him to continue forty and two months.
REV.13.PLAIN: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.

REV.13.BSB: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.
REV.13.KJV: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
REV.13.PLAIN: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.

REV.13.BSB: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
REV.13.KJV: And it was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
REV.13.PLAIN: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.

REV.13.BSB: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
REV.13.KJV: And all that dwell on the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
REV.13.PLAIN: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.

REV.13.BSB: He who has an ear, let him hear:
REV.13.KJV: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
REV.13.PLAIN: He who has an ear, let him hear:

REV.13.BSB: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.
REV.13.KJV: He that leads into captivity shall go into captivity: he that kills with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
REV.13.PLAIN: This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of God's people.

REV.13.BSB: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
REV.13.KJV: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke as a dragon.
REV.13.PLAIN: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.

REV.13.BSB: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
REV.13.KJV: And he exercises all the power of the first beast before him, and causes the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
REV.13.PLAIN: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.

REV.13.BSB: And the second beast performed great signs to cause even fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.
REV.13.KJV: And he does great wonders, so that he makes fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
REV.13.PLAIN: And the second beast performed great signs to cause even fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.

REV.13.BSB: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
REV.13.KJV: And deceives them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
REV.13.PLAIN: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.

REV.13.BSB: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.
REV.13.KJV: And he had power to give life to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
REV.13.PLAIN: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.

REV.13.BSB: And the second beast required all people small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
REV.13.KJV: And he causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
REV.13.PLAIN: And the second beast required all people small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,

REV.13.BSB: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.
REV.13.KJV: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
REV.13.PLAIN: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.

REV.13.BSB: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
REV.13.KJV: Here is wisdom. Let him that has understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred three score and six.
REV.13.PLAIN: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.

REV.14.BSB: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.
REV.14.KJV: And I looked, and, see, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.
REV.14.PLAIN: Then I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with Him 144,000 who had His name and His Father’s name written on their foreheads.

REV.14.BSB: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps.
REV.14.KJV: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
REV.14.PLAIN: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of many waters and the loud rumbling of thunder. And the sound I heard was like harpists strumming their harps.

REV.14.BSB: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
REV.14.KJV: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
REV.14.PLAIN: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

REV.14.BSB: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.
REV.14.KJV: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed from among men, being the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
REV.14.PLAIN: These are the ones who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins. They follow the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been redeemed from among men as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb.

REV.14.BSB: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
REV.14.KJV: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
REV.14.PLAIN: And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.

REV.14.BSB: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
REV.14.KJV: And I saw another angel fly in the middle of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach to them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
REV.14.PLAIN: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.

REV.14.BSB: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”
REV.14.KJV: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
REV.14.PLAIN: And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.”

REV.14.BSB: Then a second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”
REV.14.KJV: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
REV.14.PLAIN: Then a second angel followed, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, who has made all the nations drink the wine of the passion of her immorality.”

REV.14.BSB: And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
REV.14.KJV: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
REV.14.PLAIN: And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,

REV.14.BSB: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.
REV.14.KJV: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
REV.14.PLAIN: he too will drink the wine of God’s anger, poured undiluted into the cup of His wrath. And he will be tormented in fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.

REV.14.BSB: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”
REV.14.KJV: And the smoke of their torment ascends up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.
REV.14.PLAIN: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”

REV.14.BSB: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
REV.14.KJV: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
REV.14.PLAIN: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

REV.14.BSB: And I heard a voice from heaven telling me to write, “Blessed are the dead—those who die in the Lord from this moment on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labors, for their deeds will follow them.”
REV.14.KJV: And I heard a voice from heaven saying to me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from now on: Yes, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; and their works do follow them.
REV.14.PLAIN: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, 'Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on. Yes, says the Spirit, they will rest from their labors, for their deeds follow them.'

REV.14.BSB: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
REV.14.KJV: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and on the cloud one sat like to the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
REV.14.PLAIN: And I looked and saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was One like the Son of Man, with a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.

REV.14.BSB: Then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest; for the crop of the earth is ripe.”
REV.14.KJV: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in your sickle, and reap: for the time is come for you to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
REV.14.PLAIN: Then another angel came out of the temple, crying out in a loud voice to the One seated on the cloud, “Swing Your sickle and reap, because the time has come to harvest; for the crop of the earth is ripe.”

REV.14.BSB: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
REV.14.KJV: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
REV.14.PLAIN: So the One seated on the cloud swung His sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

REV.14.BSB: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.
REV.14.KJV: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
REV.14.PLAIN: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

REV.14.BSB: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”
REV.14.KJV: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
REV.14.PLAIN: Still another angel, with authority over the fire, came from the altar and called out in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the vine of the earth, because its grapes are ripe.”

REV.14.BSB: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.
REV.14.KJV: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
REV.14.PLAIN: So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered the grapes of the earth, and he threw them into the great winepress of God’s wrath.

REV.14.BSB: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.
REV.14.KJV: And the wine press was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the wine press, even to the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
REV.14.PLAIN: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and the blood that flowed from it rose as high as the bridles of the horses for a distance of 1,600 stadia.

REV.15.BSB: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.
REV.15.KJV: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
REV.15.PLAIN: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.

REV.15.BSB: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name. They were holding harps from God,
REV.15.KJV: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
REV.15.PLAIN: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name. They were holding harps from God,

REV.15.BSB: and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
REV.15.KJV: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are your ways, you King of saints.
REV.15.PLAIN: Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the nations.

REV.15.BSB: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
REV.15.KJV: Who shall not fear you, O Lord, and glorify your name? for you only are holy: for all nations shall come and worship before you; for your judgments are made manifest.
REV.15.PLAIN: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”

REV.15.BSB: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.
REV.15.KJV: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
REV.15.PLAIN: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.

REV.15.BSB: And out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean and bright linen and girded with golden sashes around their chests.
REV.15.KJV: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
REV.15.PLAIN: And out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean and bright linen and girded with golden sashes around their chests.

REV.15.BSB: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
REV.15.KJV: And one of the four beasts gave to the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.
REV.15.PLAIN: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

REV.15.BSB: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
REV.15.KJV: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
REV.15.PLAIN: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

REV.16.BSB: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.”
REV.16.KJV: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God on the earth.
REV.16.PLAIN: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out on the earth the seven bowls of God’s wrath.”

REV.16.BSB: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and loathsome, malignant sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.
REV.16.KJV: And the first went, and poured out his vial on the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore on the men which had the mark of the beast, and on them which worshipped his image.
REV.16.PLAIN: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and loathsome, malignant sores broke out on those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image.

REV.16.BSB: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died.
REV.16.KJV: And the second angel poured out his vial on the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
REV.16.PLAIN: And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it turned to blood like that of the dead, and every living thing in the sea died.

REV.16.BSB: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.
REV.16.KJV: And the third angel poured out his vial on the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
REV.16.PLAIN: And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned to blood.

REV.16.BSB: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
REV.16.KJV: And I heard the angel of the waters say, You are righteous, O Lord, which are, and were, and shall be, because you have judged thus.
REV.16.PLAIN: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.

REV.16.BSB: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.”
REV.16.KJV: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
REV.16.PLAIN: For they have spilled the blood of saints and prophets, and You have given them blood to drink, as they deserve.”

REV.16.BSB: And I heard the altar reply: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.”
REV.16.KJV: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
REV.16.PLAIN: And I heard the altar reply: “Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are Your judgments.”

REV.16.BSB: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.
REV.16.KJV: And the fourth angel poured out his vial on the sun; and power was given to him to scorch men with fire.
REV.16.PLAIN: Then the fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given power to scorch the people with fire.

REV.16.BSB: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues; yet they did not repent and give Him glory.
REV.16.KJV: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which has power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
REV.16.PLAIN: And the people were scorched by intense heat, and they cursed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues; yet they did not repent and give Him glory.

REV.16.BSB: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness, and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish
REV.16.KJV: And the fifth angel poured out his vial on the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
REV.16.PLAIN: And the fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness, and men began to gnaw their tongues in anguish

REV.16.BSB: and curse the God of heaven for their pains and sores; yet they did not repent of their deeds.
REV.16.KJV: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
REV.16.PLAIN: and curse the God of heaven for their pains and sores; yet they did not repent of their deeds.

REV.16.BSB: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.
REV.16.KJV: And the sixth angel poured out his vial on the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
REV.16.PLAIN: And the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings of the East.

REV.16.BSB: And I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs coming out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
REV.16.KJV: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
REV.16.PLAIN: And I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs coming out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.

REV.16.BSB: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.
REV.16.KJV: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth to the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
REV.16.PLAIN: These are demonic spirits that perform signs and go out to all the kings of the earth, to assemble them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty.

REV.16.BSB: “Behold, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who remains awake and clothed, so that he will not go naked and let his shame be exposed.”
REV.16.KJV: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watches, and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
REV.16.PLAIN: Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps their clothes on.

REV.16.BSB: And they assembled the kings in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
REV.16.KJV: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
REV.16.PLAIN: And they assembled the kings in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

REV.16.BSB: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, “It is done!”
REV.16.KJV: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
REV.16.PLAIN: Then the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, “It is done!”

REV.16.BSB: And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth—so mighty was the great quake.
REV.16.KJV: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightning; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were on the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
REV.16.PLAIN: And there were flashes of lightning, and rumblings, and peals of thunder, and a great earthquake the likes of which had not occurred since men were upon the earth—so mighty was the great quake.

REV.16.BSB: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
REV.16.KJV: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
REV.16.PLAIN: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. And God remembered Babylon the great and gave her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.

REV.16.BSB: Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.
REV.16.KJV: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
REV.16.PLAIN: Then every island fled, and no mountain could be found.

REV.16.BSB: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above. And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.
REV.16.KJV: And there fell on men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
REV.16.PLAIN: And great hailstones weighing almost a hundred pounds each rained down on them from above. And men cursed God for the plague of hail, because it was so horrendous.

REV.17.BSB: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
REV.17.KJV: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying to me, Come here; I will show to you the judgment of the great whore that sits on many waters:
REV.17.PLAIN: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.

REV.17.BSB: The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.”
REV.17.KJV: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
REV.17.PLAIN: The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.”

REV.17.BSB: And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
REV.17.KJV: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit on a scarlet colored beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
REV.17.PLAIN: And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness, where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.

REV.17.BSB: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.
REV.17.KJV: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet color, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
REV.17.PLAIN: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls. She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality.

REV.17.BSB: And on her forehead a mysterious name was written: BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
REV.17.KJV: And on her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
REV.17.PLAIN: And on her forehead a mysterious name was written: BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

REV.17.BSB: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.
REV.17.KJV: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
REV.17.PLAIN: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus. And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.

REV.17.BSB: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
REV.17.KJV: And the angel said to me, Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
REV.17.PLAIN: “Why are you so amazed?” said the angel. “I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

REV.17.BSB: The beast that you saw—it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
REV.17.KJV: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
REV.17.PLAIN: The beast that you saw—it was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction. And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.

REV.17.BSB: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
REV.17.KJV: And here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.
REV.17.PLAIN: This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

REV.17.BSB: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
REV.17.KJV: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he comes, he must continue a short space.
REV.17.PLAIN: There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.

REV.17.BSB: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
REV.17.KJV: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into perdition.
REV.17.PLAIN: The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.

REV.17.BSB: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings, along with the beast.
REV.17.KJV: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
REV.17.PLAIN: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings, along with the beast.

REV.17.BSB: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.
REV.17.KJV: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength to the beast.
REV.17.PLAIN: These kings have one purpose: to yield their power and authority to the beast.

REV.17.BSB: They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings; and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.”
REV.17.KJV: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
REV.17.PLAIN: They will wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will triumph over them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings — and with him will be his called, chosen, and faithful followers.

REV.17.BSB: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
REV.17.KJV: And he says to me, The waters which you saw, where the whore sits, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
REV.17.PLAIN: Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.

REV.17.BSB: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
REV.17.KJV: And the ten horns which you saw on the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
REV.17.PLAIN: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

REV.17.BSB: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
REV.17.KJV: For God has put in their hearts to fulfill his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
REV.17.PLAIN: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.

REV.17.BSB: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
REV.17.KJV: And the woman which you saw is that great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.
REV.17.PLAIN: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”

REV.18.BSB: After this I saw another angel descending from heaven with great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.
REV.18.KJV: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
REV.18.PLAIN: After this I saw another angel descending from heaven with great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.

REV.18.BSB: And he cried out in a mighty voice: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird, and every detestable beast.
REV.18.KJV: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
REV.18.PLAIN: And he cried out in a mighty voice: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird, and every detestable beast.

REV.18.BSB: All the nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality. The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown wealthy from the extravagance of her luxury.”
REV.18.KJV: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
REV.18.PLAIN: All the nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality. The kings of the earth were immoral with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown wealthy from the extravagance of her luxury.”

REV.18.BSB: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: “Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins or contract any of her plagues.
REV.18.KJV: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that you be not partakers of her sins, and that you receive not of her plagues.
REV.18.PLAIN: Then I heard another voice from heaven say, 'Come out of her, my people, so that you will not share in her sins.'

REV.18.BSB: For her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
REV.18.KJV: For her sins have reached to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.
REV.18.PLAIN: For her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities.

REV.18.BSB: Give back to her as she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done; mix her a double portion in her own cup.
REV.18.KJV: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double to her double according to her works: in the cup which she has filled fill to her double.
REV.18.PLAIN: Give back to her as she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done; mix her a double portion in her own cup.

REV.18.BSB: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’
REV.18.KJV: How much she has glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
REV.18.PLAIN: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her the same measure of torment and grief. In her heart she says, ‘I sit as queen; I am not a widow and will never see grief.’

REV.18.BSB: Therefore her plagues will come in one day— death and grief and famine— and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”
REV.18.KJV: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judges her.
REV.18.PLAIN: Therefore her plagues will come in one day— death and grief and famine— and she will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.”

REV.18.BSB: Then the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and wail at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her.
REV.18.KJV: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall mourn her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
REV.18.PLAIN: Then the kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her will weep and wail at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her.

REV.18.BSB: In fear of her torment, they will stand at a distance and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, the mighty city of Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.”
REV.18.KJV: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is your judgment come.
REV.18.PLAIN: In fear of her torment, they will stand at a distance and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, the mighty city of Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.”

REV.18.BSB: And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because there is no one left to buy their cargo—
REV.18.KJV: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buys their merchandise any more:
REV.18.PLAIN: And the merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her, because there is no one left to buy their cargo—

REV.18.BSB: cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; of fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; of all kinds of citron wood and every article of ivory, precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
REV.18.KJV: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
REV.18.PLAIN: cargo of gold, silver, precious stones, and pearls; of fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet; of all kinds of citron wood and every article of ivory, precious wood, bronze, iron, and marble;

REV.18.BSB: of cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; of wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; of cattle, sheep, horses, and chariots; of slaves and souls of men.
REV.18.KJV: And cinnamon, and odors, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
REV.18.PLAIN: of cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; of wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; of cattle, sheep, horses, and chariots; of slaves and souls of men.

REV.18.BSB: And they will say: “The fruit of your soul’s desire has departed from you; all your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be seen again.”
REV.18.KJV: And the fruits that your soul lusted after are departed from you, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from you, and you shall find them no more at all.
REV.18.PLAIN: And they will say: “The fruit of your soul’s desire has departed from you; all your luxury and splendor have vanished, never to be seen again.”

REV.18.BSB: The merchants who sold these things and grew their wealth from her will stand at a distance, in fear of her torment. They will weep and mourn,
REV.18.KJV: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
REV.18.PLAIN: The merchants who sold these things and grew their wealth from her will stand at a distance, in fear of her torment. They will weep and mourn,

REV.18.BSB: saying: “Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!
REV.18.KJV: And saying, Alas, alas that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
REV.18.PLAIN: saying: “Woe, woe to the great city, clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls!

REV.18.BSB: For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!” Every shipmaster, passenger, and sailor, and all who make their living from the sea, will stand at a distance
REV.18.KJV: For in one hour so great riches is come to nothing. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
REV.18.PLAIN: For in a single hour such fabulous wealth has been destroyed!” Every shipmaster, passenger, and sailor, and all who make their living from the sea, will stand at a distance

REV.18.BSB: and cry out at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her. “What city was ever like this great city?” they will exclaim.
REV.18.KJV: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like to this great city!
REV.18.PLAIN: and cry out at the sight of the smoke rising from the fire that consumes her. “What city was ever like this great city?” they will exclaim.

REV.18.BSB: Then they will throw dust on their heads as they weep and mourn and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.”
REV.18.KJV: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
REV.18.PLAIN: Then they will throw dust on their heads as they weep and mourn and cry out: “Woe, woe to the great city, where all who had ships on the sea were enriched by her wealth! For in a single hour she has been destroyed.”

REV.18.BSB: Rejoice over her, O heaven, O saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
REV.18.KJV: Rejoice over her, you heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets; for God has avenged you on her.
REV.18.PLAIN: Rejoice over her, O heaven, O saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.

REV.18.BSB: Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again.
REV.18.KJV: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
REV.18.PLAIN: Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying: “With such violence the great city of Babylon will be cast down, never to be seen again.

REV.18.BSB: And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.
REV.18.KJV: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in you; and no craftsman, of whatever craft he be, shall be found any more in you; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in you;
REV.18.PLAIN: And the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will never ring out in you again. Nor will any craftsmen of any trade be found in you again, nor the sound of a millstone be heard in you again.

REV.18.BSB: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”
REV.18.KJV: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in you; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in you: for your merchants were the great men of the earth; for by your sorceries were all nations deceived.
REV.18.PLAIN: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voices of a bride and bridegroom will never call out in you again. For your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because all the nations were deceived by your sorcery.”

REV.18.BSB: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.
REV.18.KJV: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain on the earth.
REV.18.PLAIN: And there was found in her the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who had been slain on the earth.

REV.19.BSB: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
REV.19.KJV: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honor, and power, to the Lord our God:
REV.19.PLAIN: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!

REV.19.BSB: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”
REV.19.KJV: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he has judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
REV.19.PLAIN: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”

REV.19.BSB: And a second time they called out: “Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.”
REV.19.KJV: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
REV.19.PLAIN: And a second time they called out: “Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.”

REV.19.BSB: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying: “Amen, Hallelujah!”
REV.19.KJV: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
REV.19.PLAIN: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying: “Amen, Hallelujah!”

REV.19.BSB: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”
REV.19.KJV: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all you his servants, and you that fear him, both small and great.
REV.19.PLAIN: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”

REV.19.BSB: And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.
REV.19.KJV: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunder, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigns.
REV.19.PLAIN: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and loud peals of thunder, shouting: 'Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.'

REV.19.BSB: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.
REV.19.KJV: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honor to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife has made herself ready.
REV.19.PLAIN: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.

REV.19.BSB: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.
REV.19.KJV: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
REV.19.PLAIN: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.

REV.19.BSB: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”
REV.19.KJV: And he says to me, Write, Blessed are they which are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he says to me, These are the true sayings of God.
REV.19.PLAIN: Then the angel told me to write, “Held in quiet grace are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” And he said to me, “These are the true words of God.”

REV.19.BSB: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
REV.19.KJV: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said to me, See you do it not: I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
REV.19.PLAIN: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”

REV.19.BSB: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
REV.19.KJV: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat on him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he does judge and make war.
REV.19.PLAIN: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.

REV.19.BSB: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.
REV.19.KJV: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
REV.19.PLAIN: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.

REV.19.BSB: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.
REV.19.KJV: And he was clothed with a clothing dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
REV.19.PLAIN: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.

REV.19.BSB: The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow Him on white horses.
REV.19.KJV: And the armies which were in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
REV.19.PLAIN: The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow Him on white horses.

REV.19.BSB: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
REV.19.KJV: And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treads the wine press of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
REV.19.PLAIN: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.

REV.19.BSB: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
REV.19.KJV: And he has on his clothing and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
REV.19.PLAIN: On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: King of Kings and Lord of Lords.

REV.19.BSB: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
REV.19.KJV: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the middle of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together to the supper of the great God;
REV.19.PLAIN: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he cried out in a loud voice to all the birds flying overhead, “Come, gather together for the great supper of God,

REV.19.BSB: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.”
REV.19.KJV: That you may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
REV.19.PLAIN: so that you may eat the flesh of kings and commanders and mighty men, of horses and riders, of everyone slave and free, small and great.”

REV.19.BSB: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.
REV.19.KJV: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
REV.19.PLAIN: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies assembled to wage war against the One seated on the horse, and against His army.

REV.19.BSB: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.
REV.19.KJV: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that worked miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
REV.19.PLAIN: But the beast was captured along with the false prophet, who on its behalf had performed signs deceiving those who had the mark of the beast and worshiped its image. Both the beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.

REV.19.BSB: And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse. And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
REV.19.KJV: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat on the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
REV.19.PLAIN: And the rest were killed with the sword that proceeded from the mouth of the One seated on the horse. And all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

REV.20.BSB: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss, holding in his hand a great chain.
REV.20.KJV: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
REV.20.PLAIN: Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the Abyss, holding in his hand a great chain.

REV.20.BSB: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
REV.20.KJV: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
REV.20.PLAIN: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent who is the devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

REV.20.BSB: And he threw him into the Abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him, so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete. After that, he must be released for a brief period of time.
REV.20.KJV: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal on him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
REV.20.PLAIN: And he threw him into the Abyss, shut it, and sealed it over him, so that he could not deceive the nations until the thousand years were complete. After that, he must be released for a brief period of time.

REV.20.BSB: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
REV.20.KJV: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark on their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
REV.20.PLAIN: Then I saw the thrones, and those seated on them had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or hands. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

REV.20.BSB: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.
REV.20.KJV: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
REV.20.PLAIN: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.

REV.20.BSB: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for a thousand years.
REV.20.KJV: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
REV.20.PLAIN: Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him.

REV.20.BSB: When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison,
REV.20.KJV: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
REV.20.PLAIN: When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison,

REV.20.BSB: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—to assemble them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the seashore.
REV.20.KJV: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog, and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
REV.20.PLAIN: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—to assemble them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the seashore.

REV.20.BSB: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.
REV.20.KJV: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
REV.20.PLAIN: And they marched across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. But fire came down from heaven and consumed them.

REV.20.BSB: And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
REV.20.KJV: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
REV.20.PLAIN: And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, into which the beast and the false prophet had already been thrown. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

REV.20.BSB: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.
REV.20.KJV: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
REV.20.PLAIN: Then I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from His presence, and no place was found for them.

REV.20.BSB: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And there were open books, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
REV.20.KJV: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
REV.20.PLAIN: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. And there were open books, and one of them was the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to their deeds, as recorded in the books.
