REV.20.BSB: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.
REV.20.KJV: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
REV.20.PLAIN: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead, and each one was judged according to his deeds.

REV.20.BSB: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire.
REV.20.KJV: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
REV.20.PLAIN: Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death—the lake of fire.

REV.20.BSB: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
REV.20.KJV: And whoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
REV.20.PLAIN: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.

REV.21.BSB: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
REV.21.KJV: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
REV.21.PLAIN: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

REV.21.BSB: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
REV.21.KJV: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
REV.21.PLAIN: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

REV.21.BSB: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.
REV.21.KJV: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
REV.21.PLAIN: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Look closely — the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.

REV.21.BSB: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
REV.21.KJV: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
REV.21.PLAIN: God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, no more grief or crying or pain — the old order of things has passed away.

REV.21.BSB: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”
REV.21.KJV: And he that sat on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said to me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
REV.21.PLAIN: And the one seated on the throne said, 'Behold, I am making all things new.' Then he said, 'Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.'

REV.21.BSB: And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.
REV.21.KJV: And he said to me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give to him that is thirsty of the fountain of the water of life freely.
REV.21.PLAIN: And he said to me, 'It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will freely give from the spring of the water of life.'

REV.21.BSB: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.
REV.21.KJV: He that overcomes shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
REV.21.PLAIN: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.

REV.21.BSB: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.”
REV.21.KJV: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and fornicators, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
REV.21.PLAIN: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.”

REV.21.BSB: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
REV.21.KJV: And there came to me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come here, I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.
REV.21.PLAIN: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”

REV.21.BSB: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,
REV.21.KJV: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
REV.21.PLAIN: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,

REV.21.BSB: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
REV.21.KJV: Having the glory of God: and her light was like to a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
REV.21.PLAIN: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.

REV.21.BSB: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.
REV.21.KJV: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
REV.21.PLAIN: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.

REV.21.BSB: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
REV.21.KJV: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
REV.21.PLAIN: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.

REV.21.BSB: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
REV.21.KJV: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
REV.21.PLAIN: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

REV.21.BSB: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.
REV.21.KJV: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
REV.21.PLAIN: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.

REV.21.BSB: The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length. And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.
REV.21.KJV: And the city lies foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
REV.21.PLAIN: The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length. And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.

REV.21.BSB: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.
REV.21.KJV: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
REV.21.PLAIN: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.

REV.21.BSB: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.
REV.21.KJV: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like to clear glass.
REV.21.PLAIN: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.

REV.21.BSB: The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone: The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
REV.21.KJV: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
REV.21.PLAIN: The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone: The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

REV.21.BSB: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
REV.21.KJV: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
REV.21.PLAIN: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

REV.21.BSB: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.
REV.21.KJV: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
REV.21.PLAIN: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.

REV.21.BSB: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
REV.21.KJV: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
REV.21.PLAIN: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

REV.21.BSB: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.
REV.21.KJV: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
REV.21.PLAIN: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.

REV.21.BSB: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
REV.21.KJV: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honor into it.
REV.21.PLAIN: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.

REV.21.BSB: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.
REV.21.KJV: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
REV.21.PLAIN: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.

REV.21.BSB: And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.
REV.21.KJV: And they shall bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
REV.21.PLAIN: And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.

REV.21.BSB: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
REV.21.KJV: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defiles, neither whatever works abomination, or makes a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
REV.21.PLAIN: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.

REV.22.BSB: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb
REV.22.KJV: And he showed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
REV.22.PLAIN: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

REV.22.BSB: down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
REV.22.KJV: In the middle of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bore twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
REV.22.PLAIN: down the middle of the main street of the city. On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

REV.22.BSB: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
REV.22.KJV: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
REV.22.PLAIN: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.

REV.22.BSB: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.
REV.22.KJV: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
REV.22.PLAIN: They will see His face, and His name will be on their foreheads.

REV.22.BSB: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
REV.22.KJV: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God gives them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
REV.22.PLAIN: There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun. For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.

REV.22.BSB: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”
REV.22.KJV: And he said to me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show to his servants the things which must shortly be done.
REV.22.PLAIN: Then the angel said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.”

REV.22.BSB: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.”
REV.22.KJV: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keeps the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
REV.22.PLAIN: “Look closely — I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.”

REV.22.BSB: And I am John, who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
REV.22.KJV: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which showed me these things.
REV.22.PLAIN: And I am John, who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

REV.22.BSB: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”
REV.22.KJV: Then says he to me, See you do it not: for I am your fellow servant, and of your brothers the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
REV.22.PLAIN: But he said to me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God!”

REV.22.BSB: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.
REV.22.KJV: And he says to me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
REV.22.PLAIN: Then he told me, “Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near.

REV.22.BSB: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”
REV.22.KJV: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
REV.22.PLAIN: Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile; let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.”

REV.22.BSB: “Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
REV.22.KJV: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
REV.22.PLAIN: “Look closely — I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.

REV.22.BSB: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
REV.22.KJV: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
REV.22.PLAIN: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

REV.22.BSB: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
REV.22.KJV: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
REV.22.PLAIN: Held in quiet grace are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.

REV.22.BSB: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
REV.22.KJV: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and fornicators, and murderers, and idolaters, and whoever loves and makes a lie.
REV.22.PLAIN: But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

REV.22.BSB: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”
REV.22.KJV: I Jesus have sent my angel to testify to you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
REV.22.PLAIN: “I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.”

REV.22.BSB: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the one who hears say, “Come!” And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
REV.22.KJV: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is thirsty come. And whoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
REV.22.PLAIN: The Spirit and the bride say, 'Come!' And let the one who hears say, 'Come!' Let anyone who is thirsty come; and whoever wishes, let them take the free gift of the water of life.

REV.22.BSB: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
REV.22.KJV: For I testify to every man that hears the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add to these things, God shall add to him the plagues that are written in this book:
REV.22.PLAIN: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book: If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.

REV.22.BSB: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
REV.22.KJV: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
REV.22.PLAIN: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.

REV.22.BSB: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
REV.22.KJV: He which testifies these things says, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
REV.22.PLAIN: He who testifies to these things says, 'Surely I am coming soon.' Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

REV.22.BSB: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
REV.22.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
REV.22.PLAIN: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God's people. Amen.
